FUNCTION get_Clearing_Account( p_RegisterNumber IN NUMBER) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

v_ClearingAccount  REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_COLL_ACCOUNT.G_ACC_NO1%TYPE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN IS
    SELECT DISTINCT T.G_ACC_NO1 CLEARING_ACCOUNT
    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_COLL_ACCOUNT T
    WHERE T.C_ID     = TO_CHAR(p_RegisterNumber)
    AND T.C_ACC_TYPE = '0000' -- INCPB-821829
    ;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

FOR X IN CR_MAIN LOOP
    v_ClearingAccount := X.CLEARING_ACCOUNT;
    EXIT;
END LOOP;

RETURN v_ClearingAccount;

END get_Clearing_Account;


PROCEDURE get_Date_Last_Available_Day( p_in_Type        IN NUMBER, -- 1= Une date / 2=une pÃ©ride
                                       p_in_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                                       p_in_Date        IN DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_From  OUT DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_To    OUT DATE) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);

v_Date_From             DATE;
v_Date_To               DATE;

CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV IS
   SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
   FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
   WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO   = p_in_Fund_Number
     AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date
     AND T.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y'
   UNION
   SELECT C.DATE_NAV
   FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
   WHERE C.FA_NUM    = p_in_Fund_Number --'280604'
     AND C.DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date --'31-dec-18'
   ORDER BY 1 DESC   ;

CURSOR CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV(p_Date_From IN DATE) IS
   SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
   FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
   WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO  = p_in_Fund_Number
     AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV < p_Date_From
     AND T.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y'
   UNION
   SELECT C.DATE_NAV
   FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
   WHERE C.FA_NUM   = p_in_Fund_Number --'280604'
     AND C.DATE_NAV < p_Date_From --'31-dec-18'
   ORDER BY 1 DESC ;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

IF p_in_Type = 1 THEN
   FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV LOOP
       v_Date_From := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
       v_Date_To   := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
       EXIT;
   END LOOP;

   ELSE
   -- RÃ©cup date To
   FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV LOOP
       v_Date_To   := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
       EXIT;
   END LOOP;
   -- RÃ©cup date From
   FOR VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV IN CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV (v_Date_To) LOOP
       v_Date_From   := NVL(VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
       EXIT;
   END LOOP;
END IF;

    p_out_Date_From := v_Date_From;
    p_out_Date_To   := v_Date_To;

Exception
    When Err Then
         null;
    when others then
         null;
END get_Date_Last_Available_Day;

PROCEDURE get_Date_Last_Published_Day( p_in_Type        IN NUMBER, -- 1= Une date / 2=une pÃ©ride
                                       p_in_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                                       p_in_Date        IN DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_From  OUT DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_To    OUT DATE) IS

    v_status                NUMBER :=1;
    v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);

    v_Date_From             DATE;
    v_Date_To               DATE;

    CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV IS
       SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
       FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
       WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO   = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date
         AND T.NAV_PUB = 'A'
       UNION
       SELECT C.DATE_NAV
       FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
       WHERE C.FA_NUM    = p_in_Fund_Number --'280604'
         AND C.DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date --'31-dec-18'
       ORDER BY 1 DESC;

    CURSOR CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV(p_Date_From IN DATE) IS
       SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
       FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
       WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO  = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV < p_Date_From
         AND T.NAV_PUB = 'A'
       UNION
       SELECT C.DATE_NAV
       FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
       WHERE C.FA_NUM   = p_in_Fund_Number --'280604'
         AND C.DATE_NAV < p_Date_From --'31-dec-18'
       ORDER BY 1 DESC ;


    Err Exception;

    BEGIN

    IF p_in_Type = 1 THEN
       FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV LOOP
           v_Date_From := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
           v_Date_To   := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
           EXIT;
       END LOOP;


       ELSE
       -- RÃ©cup date To
       FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV LOOP
           v_Date_To   := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
           EXIT;
       END LOOP;

       -- RÃ©cup date From
       FOR VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV IN CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV (v_Date_To) LOOP
           v_Date_From   := NVL(VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
           EXIT;
       END LOOP;

    END IF;

     -- Pour la dte de dÃ©but, on ajoute un jour
     p_out_Date_From := GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(p_in_Fund_Number,v_Date_From);
     p_out_Date_From := p_out_Date_From +1;
     p_out_Date_To   := GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(p_in_Fund_Number,v_Date_To);

    Exception
        When Err Then
             null;
        when others then
             null;

END get_Date_Last_Published_Day;

PROCEDURE get_Date_Published_Period ( p_in_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                                       p_in_Date_From   IN DATE,
                                       p_in_Date_To     IN DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_From  OUT DATE,
                                       p_out_Date_To    OUT DATE) IS

    v_status                NUMBER :=1;
    v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);

    v_Date_From             DATE;
    v_Date_To               DATE;

    CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV IS
       SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
       FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
       WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO   = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date_To
         AND T.NAV_PUB = 'A'
        UNION
       SELECT C.DATE_NAV
       FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
       WHERE C.FA_NUM    = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND C.DATE_NAV <= p_in_Date_To
       ORDER BY 1 DESC;

    CURSOR CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV(p_Date_From IN DATE,p_Date_To IN DATE) IS
       SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV
       FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
       WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO  = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV >= LEAST(p_Date_From,p_Date_To) --p_Date_From
         AND T.NAV_PUB = 'A'
       UNION
       SELECT C.DATE_NAV
       FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
       WHERE C.FA_NUM    = p_in_Fund_Number
         AND C.DATE_NAV >= LEAST(p_Date_From,p_Date_To) --p_Date_From
       ORDER BY 1;

    Err Exception;

    BEGIN
     -- RÃ©cup date To
     FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV LOOP
         v_Date_To   := NVL(VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
         EXIT;
     END LOOP;

     -- RÃ©cup date From

     FOR VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV IN CR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV (p_in_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP
         v_Date_From   := NVL(VCR_PREVIOUS_DATE_NAV.DATE_NAV,SYSDATE);
         EXIT;
     END LOOP;

        p_out_Date_From := v_Date_From;
        p_out_Date_To   := v_Date_To;

    Exception
        When Err Then
             null;
        when others then
             null;

END get_Date_Published_Period;

FUNCTION get_Nb_Envoi_Rel_Adressage( p_Rep_Id IN NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS

v_Nb_Envoi       NUMBER:=0;
v_Heure_Sys      VARCHAR2(4);
v_Date_Sys       DATE;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'HH24'),'HH24MI') INTO v_Heure_Sys FROM DUAL;
v_Date_Sys := TRUNC(SYSDATE);

-- Nb de relation Ã  traiter
SELECT COUNT(T.REL_ID) NB
INTO v_Nb_Envoi
FROM RELATION_ADRESSAGE T
WHERE T.REL_REP_ID = p_Rep_Id
  AND PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_JOUR_ENVOI(v_Date_Sys,T.REL_ID) = 1
  AND ( T.REL_PARAM_3   = v_Heure_Sys
        OR T.REL_PARAM_4 = v_Heure_Sys
        OR T.REL_PARAM_5 =  v_Heure_Sys
        OR T.REL_PARAM_6 =  v_Heure_Sys
        OR T.REL_PARAM_7 =  v_Heure_Sys
      );

RETURN v_Nb_Envoi;

END get_Nb_Envoi_Rel_Adressage;

FUNCTION get_Jour_Envoi( p_Date IN DATE, p_Id_Rel_Adressage IN NUMBER) RETURN INTEGER IS

v_Jour_Envoi          INTEGER:=0;
v_Frequence           REPADMIN.RELATION_ADRESSAGE.REL_FREQ%TYPE:= 0 ;

v_Jour_Sem            NUMBER;
v_Jour_Mois           NUMBER;
v_Dernier_Jour_Mois   DATE;
v_Date                DATE;

Err Exception;



BEGIN

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'ALTER SESSION SET NLS_TERRITORY = AMERICA';

v_Date := TRUNC(p_Date);

SELECT T.REL_FREQ
INTO v_Frequence
FROM REPADMIN.RELATION_ADRESSAGE T
WHERE T.REL_ID = p_Id_Rel_Adressage;

SELECT TO_CHAR(v_Date,'D'),TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(v_Date,'DD'))
INTO v_Jour_Sem,v_Jour_Mois
FROM DUAL;

SELECT LAST_DAY(v_Date) - DECODE( TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(v_Date), 'D'), 7,1, 1,2, 0)
INTO v_Dernier_Jour_Mois
FROM DUAL;

CASE
     -- Quotidien
     WHEN v_Frequence=0 THEN
          RETURN 1;
     -- Lundi au vendredi
     WHEN v_Frequence IN (2,3,4,5,6) AND v_Frequence = v_Jour_Sem THEN
          RETURN 1;
     -- 1ER JOUR DU MOIS
     WHEN v_Frequence=7 THEN
          IF v_Jour_Mois = 1 OR (v_Jour_Mois = 2 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-1,'D') = 1) OR
             (v_Jour_Mois = 3 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-2,'D') = 6) THEN

             RETURN 1;
          END IF;
     -- 1ER ET 15EME JOUR DU MOIS
     WHEN v_Frequence=8 THEN
          IF v_Jour_Mois = 1 OR (v_Jour_Mois = 2 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-1,'D') = 1) OR
             (v_Jour_Mois = 3 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-2,'D') = 6) THEN

             RETURN 1;
          END IF;

          IF v_Jour_Mois = 15 OR (v_Jour_Mois = 16 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-1,'D') = 1) OR
             (v_Jour_Mois = 17 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-2,'D') = 6) THEN

             RETURN 1;
          END IF;

     -- 5EME ET 15EME JOUR DU MOIS
     WHEN v_Frequence=9 THEN
          IF v_Jour_Mois = 5 OR (v_Jour_Mois = 6 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-1,'D') = 1) OR
             (v_Jour_Mois = 7 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-2,'D') = 6) THEN

             RETURN 1;
          END IF;

          IF v_Jour_Mois = 15 OR (v_Jour_Mois = 16 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-1,'D') = 1) OR
             (v_Jour_Mois = 17 AND TO_CHAR(v_Date-2,'D') = 6) THEN

             RETURN 1;
          END IF;
     -- DERNIER JOUR DU MOIS
     WHEN v_Frequence=10 THEN
          IF v_Date = v_Dernier_Jour_Mois THEN

             RETURN 1;
          END IF;
     ELSE
          NULL;
END CASE;

RETURN 0;

END get_Jour_Envoi;

PROCEDURE get_Info_Static_Isin ( p_in_Isin_Code         IN VARCHAR2,
                                 p_out_Structure_Number OUT NUMBER,
                                 p_out_TA_Number        OUT VARCHAR2,
                                 p_out_FA_Number        OUT VARCHAR2,
                                 p_out_Fund_Ccy         OUT VARCHAR2,
                                 p_out_Part_FA          OUT VARCHAR2,
                                 p_out_Part_TA          OUT VARCHAR2,
                                 p_out_Part_Ccy         OUT VARCHAR2,
                                 p_out_FA_Code          OUT VARCHAR2
                                ) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);

v_Exist_TF              BOOLEAN:= FALSE;

CURSOR CR_TF IS
    SELECT T.STRUCTURE_NUM,T.TA_NUM,T.FA_NUM,T.FUND_CCY,
           T.PART_FA_CODE,T.PART_TA_CODE,T.PART_CCY,T.FA_CODE
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN T
    WHERE T.ISIN_CODE = p_in_Isin_Code;

CURSOR CR_TA IS
    SELECT F.C_FUND TA_NUM,T.C_MF_FUND FA_NUM,--F.L_FUND_NAME,
           NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY(T.C_MF_FUND),REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES',F.C_CCY)) FUND_CCY,
           T.C_SHARE PART_TA,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES',S.C_SEC_CCY) PART_CCY,
           F.C_N_TFC TFC_NUMBER,T.C_N_ID TA_INTERNAL_CODE
    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUNDS F,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE T,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_SEC_MASTER S
    WHERE T.C_N_ID = ( SELECT DISTINCT S.C_N_ID
                       FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_SEC_INTL_ID S
                       WHERE S.G_ID_VALUE = p_in_Isin_Code --'LU0300834669'
                      )
      AND T.C_MF_FUND = F.C_MF_FUND
      AND T.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- RÃ©cup table fonds.  Si pas dans la table fonds, on va dans le TA
FOR VCR_TF IN CR_TF LOOP
    v_Exist_TF             := TRUE;
    p_out_Structure_Number := VCR_TF.STRUCTURE_NUM;
    p_out_TA_Number        := VCR_TF.TA_NUM;
    p_out_FA_Number        := VCR_TF.FA_NUM;
    p_out_Fund_Ccy         := VCR_TF.FUND_CCY;
    p_out_Part_FA          := VCR_TF.PART_FA_CODE;
    p_out_Part_TA          := VCR_TF.PART_TA_CODE;
    p_out_Part_Ccy         := VCR_TF.PART_CCY;
    p_out_FA_Code          := VCR_TF.FA_CODE;
    EXIT;
END LOOP;

IF v_Exist_TF = FALSE THEN
   FOR VCR_TA IN CR_TA LOOP
        p_out_TA_Number := VCR_TA.TA_NUM;
        p_out_FA_Number := VCR_TA.FA_NUM;
        p_out_Fund_Ccy  := VCR_TA.FUND_CCY;
        p_out_Part_FA   := NULL;
        p_out_Part_TA   := VCR_TA.PART_TA;
        p_out_Part_Ccy  := VCR_TA.PART_CCY;

        p_out_FA_Code   := '01'; -- Default
        FOR X IN ( SELECT TF.STRUCTURE_NUM,TF.FA_CODE
                   FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
                   WHERE TF.TFC_NUMBER = VCR_TA.TFC_NUMBER ) LOOP

            p_out_FA_Code          := X.FA_CODE;
            p_out_Structure_Number := X.STRUCTURE_NUM;
            EXIT;
        END LOOP;
        EXIT;
    END LOOP;
END IF;

    Exception
        When Err Then
             null;
        when others then
             null;

END get_Info_Static_Isin;

FUNCTION get_Struct_Num_With_FundId_RKS ( p_in_Fund_Id IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS

v_status          NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err         VARCHAR2(2000);

v_Struct_Number   NUMBER;

CURSOR CR_MAIN IS
     WITH 
         -- RECUPERATION DE LA PART
         SHARECLASS AS (SELECT S.IDT_ENTITE, S.CDE_ENTITE_ACTIF,S.CHAMP1_ENTITE
                          FROM REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_ENTITE S
                         WHERE S.IDT_TYPE_ENTITE = 22),
         -- RÃ‰CUPÃ‰RATION DU COMPARTIMENT (ID_COMP) EN FONCTION DE LA PART (ID_SHARE)
         COMPARTMENT AS (SELECT C.IDT_ENTITE ID_COMP, RDS.IDT_OBJET ID_SHARE, C.CDE_ENTITE_ACTIF
                           FROM REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_ENTITE C
                                JOIN REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_RELATION_DETAIL RDC
                                  ON (    RDC.IDT_OBJET = C.IDT_ENTITE
                                      AND RDC.TYPE_OBJET = 'ENT'
                                      AND RDC.SENS_RELATION = 'ASC')
                                JOIN REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_RELATION R320
                                  ON (    R320.IDT_RELATION = RDC.IDT_RELATION
                                      AND R320.IDT_TYPE_RELATION = 320
                                      AND R320.CDE_ETAT_RELATION != 'SUP'
                                      AND R320.CDE_RELATION_ACTIF = 1)
                                JOIN REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_RELATION_DETAIL RDS
                                  ON (    RDS.IDT_RELATION = R320.IDT_RELATION
                                      AND RDS.TYPE_OBJET = 'ENT'
                                      AND RDS.SENS_RELATION = 'DSC')
                          WHERE C.IDT_TYPE_ENTITE = 42),
         -- RÃ‰CUPÃ‰RATION DU FONDS (ID_FUND) EN FONCTION DU COMPARTIMENT (ID_COMP)
         FUND AS (SELECT F.IDT_ENTITE ID_FUND, RDC2.IDT_OBJET ID_COMP
                    FROM REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_ENTITE F
                         JOIN REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_RELATION_DETAIL RDF
                           ON (    RDF.IDT_OBJET = F.IDT_ENTITE
                               AND RDF.TYPE_OBJET = 'ENT'
                               AND RDF.SENS_RELATION = 'ASC')
                         JOIN REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_RELATION R260
                           ON (    R260.IDT_RELATION = RDF.IDT_RELATION
                               AND R260.IDT_TYPE_RELATION = 260
                               AND R260.CDE_ETAT_RELATION != 'SUP'
                               AND R260.CDE_RELATION_ACTIF = 1)
                         JOIN REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_RELATION_DETAIL RDC2
                           ON (    RDC2.IDT_RELATION = R260.IDT_RELATION
                               AND RDC2.TYPE_OBJET = 'ENT'
                               AND RDC2.SENS_RELATION = 'DSC')
                   WHERE F.IDT_TYPE_ENTITE = 6
                     AND F.CDE_ENTITE_ACTIF = 1)
    SELECT F.*, S.*
      FROM SHARECLASS S
           JOIN COMPARTMENT C ON (C.ID_SHARE = S.IDT_ENTITE)
           JOIN FUND F ON (F.ID_COMP = C.ID_COMP)
     WHERE F.ID_FUND = p_in_Fund_Id --19789
     ORDER BY S.CDE_ENTITE_ACTIF DESC -- INCPB-827872
     ;
Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- RÃ©cup table fonds.  Si pas dans la table fonds, on va dans le TA
FOR X IN CR_MAIN LOOP
    FOR Y IN ( SELECT TF.STRUCTURE_NUM
               FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
               WHERE TF.ISIN_CODE= X.CHAMP1_ENTITE ) LOOP
        v_Struct_Number := Y.STRUCTURE_NUM;   
        EXIT;       
    END LOOP;           
    EXIT;
END LOOP;

RETURN NVL(v_Struct_Number,0);-- INCPB-827872

    Exception
        When Err Then
             null;
        when others then
             null;

END get_Struct_Num_With_FundId_RKS;

FUNCTION get_Reason_Blocked_Code_RKS ( p_in_Code IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS

v_status          NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err         VARCHAR2(2000);

v_Reason          REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_CDE_TBL_DESCR.CDE_TBL_CODE_DESCR%TYPE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN IS
    SELECT * 
    FROM REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_CDE_TBL_DESCR T
    WHERE T.CDE_TBL_NAME = 'BLOCKING REASON CODES'
      AND T.CDE_TBL_CODE = p_in_Code;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- RÃ©cup table fonds.  Si pas dans la table fonds, on va dans le TA
FOR X IN CR_MAIN LOOP
    v_Reason := X.CDE_TBL_CODE_DESCR;
    EXIT;
END LOOP;

RETURN v_Reason;

    Exception
        When Err Then
             null;
        when others then
             null;

END get_Reason_Blocked_Code_RKS;

---------------------------------------
-- Get Date Blocked (string to date) --
---------------------------------------
FUNCTION get_Date_Blocked ( p_in_Date IN VARCHAR2) RETURN DATE IS

v_status          NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err         VARCHAR2(2000);

v_Date_Blocked    DATE;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

CASE 
    WHEN p_in_Date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(p_in_Date))=10 THEN
         v_Date_Blocked := TO_DATE(p_in_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY');
    WHEN p_in_Date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(p_in_Date))=19 THEN
         v_Date_Blocked := TO_DATE(p_in_Date,'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS');
    ELSE
         NULL;
END CASE;  
RETURN v_Date_Blocked;

    Exception
        When Err Then
             null;
        when others then
             null;

END get_Date_Blocked;

---------------------------------------------------------
-- Liste des fonds avec le Fund Type en fct de la date
---------------------------------------------------------
procedure proc_Fonds(p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                     p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                     p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status              NUMBER :=0;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                  NUMBER;

v_Date_To             DATE;
r_Fds                 LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS%ROWTYPE;
r_Tfc                 WRK_QUERIES_TA_TFC%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_FA IS
    SELECT DISTINCT T.FA_NUM,T.FUND_NAME,T.FUND_CCY,
           T.FUND_TYPE,T.FA_REF_NUM FA_NUM_REF,
           T.DE_DROIT,T.ACTIVATION,T.D_ACTIVATION,T.LIQUIDATION,T.D_LIQUIDATION,
           T.STRUCTURE_NUM,S.STRUCTURE_NAME,
           DECODE(T.LIQUIDATION,2,1,2) FUND_ACTIF
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_STRUCT S
    WHERE T.STRUCTURE_NUM = S.N_STRUCTURE(+)
    ORDER BY T.FA_NUM;

CURSOR CR_TFC IS
    SELECT DISTINCT T.FA_NUM,T.STRUCTURE_NUM,T.STRUCTURE_NOM,
           F.C_FUND TA_NUM,F.C_N_TFC TFC_NUMBER
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS T,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUNDS  F
    WHERE T.FA_NUM = F.C_MF_FUND(+)
    ORDER BY T.FA_NUM;

CURSOR CR_TFC_NAME (p_Tfc_Number IN NUMBER) IS
    SELECT T.L_TFC_NAME
    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_TFC  T
    WHERE T.C_N_TFC = p_Tfc_Number
    ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC;

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Fonds';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

---------------------------
--  RÃ©cup des paramÃ¨tres --
---------------------------
r_Fds.User_Id        := p_User_Id;
r_Fds.Date_Creation  :=SYSDATE;

-------------------------------------------
--      RÃ©initialisation de la table     --
-------------------------------------------

DELETE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS T
WHERE T.USER_ID      = r_Fds.User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION < SYSDATE - 1;

DELETE FROM WRK_QUERIES_TA_TFC;

-- Insertion des fonds dans la table FUND_BILAN_FONDS
FOR X IN CR_FA LOOP

    r_Fds.Flag             := 0;
    r_Fds.Fa_Num           := X.fa_num;
    r_Fds.Fund_Name        := X.fund_name;
    r_Fds.Fund_Ccy         := X.fund_ccy;
    r_Fds.Fund_Type        := X.FUND_TYPE;
    r_Fds.Fa_Ref_Num       := X.FA_NUM_REF;
    r_Fds.De_Droit         := X.DE_DROIT;
    r_Fds.Activation       := X.activation;
    r_Fds.d_Activation     := X.d_activation;
    r_Fds.Liquidation      := X.liquidation;
    r_Fds.d_Liquidation    := X.d_liquidation;
    r_Fds.Structure_Number := X.STRUCTURE_NUM;
    r_Fds.Structure_Name   := X.STRUCTURE_NAME;
    r_Fds.Fund_Actif       := X.FUND_ACTIF;

    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS
      (FLAG,
       FA_NUM,
       FUND_NAME,
       FUND_CCY,
       FUND_TYPE,
       FA_REF_NUM,
       DE_DROIT,
       FUND_ACTIF,
       ACTIVATION,
       D_ACTIVATION,
       LIQUIDATION,
       D_LIQUIDATION,
       USER_ID,
       DATE_CREATION,
       STRUCTURE_NUMBER,
       STRUCTURE_NAME)
    VALUES
      (r_Fds.Flag,
       r_Fds.Fa_Num,
       r_Fds.Fund_Name,
       r_Fds.Fund_Ccy,
       r_Fds.Fund_Type,
       r_Fds.Fa_Ref_Num,
       r_Fds.De_Droit,
       r_Fds.Fund_Actif,
       r_Fds.Activation,
       r_Fds.d_Activation,
       r_Fds.Liquidation,
       r_Fds.d_Liquidation,
       r_Fds.User_Id,
       r_Fds.Date_Creation,
       r_Fds.Structure_Number,
       r_Fds.Structure_Name);

END LOOP;

-- Table TFC
r_Tfc.Date_Creation := SYSDATE;
FOR X1 IN CR_TFC LOOP
    r_Tfc.Structure_Number := X1.STRUCTURE_NUM;
    r_Tfc.Fund_Number_Fa   := X1.FA_NUM;
    r_Tfc.Fund_Number_Ta   := X1.TA_NUM;
    r_Tfc.Tfc_Number       := X1.TFC_NUMBER;
    IF NVL(r_Tfc.Tfc_Number,0) <> 0 THEN
        FOR X2 IN CR_TFC_NAME(r_Tfc.Tfc_Number) LOOP
            r_Tfc.Tfc_Name := X2.L_TFC_NAME;
            EXIT;
        END LOOP;

        INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_TFC
               ( STRUCTURE_NUMBER,
                 FUND_NUMBER_FA,
                 FUND_NUMBER_TA,
                 TFC_NUMBER,
                 TFC_NAME,
                 DATE_CREATION)
        VALUES ( r_Tfc.Structure_Number,
                 r_Tfc.Fund_Number_Fa,
                 r_Tfc.Fund_Number_Ta,
                 r_Tfc.Tfc_Number,
                 r_Tfc.Tfc_Name,
                 r_Tfc.Date_Creation);
    END IF;
END LOOP;
COMMIT;

p_status           :=1;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status:=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='ProblÃ¨me lors de la sÃ©lection des fonds actifs Ã  la date de conso : '
                || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Fonds',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
END proc_Fonds;

-------------------------------------
-- Remonte les codes opÃ©rations TA --
-------------------------------------
procedure proc_Ta_Code_Ope( p_User_Id IN VARCHAR2,
                            p_status  OUT NUMBER,
                            p_msg_err OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status              NUMBER :=0;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                  NUMBER;

CURSOR CR_MAIN IS
   SELECT T.C_ELEMENT,T.L_LIBELLE
   FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_MESSAGE  T
   WHERE T.C_table = 'COPER'
     AND T.C_ELEMENT <> '@@@@'
     AND T.C_LNG     = 2
     AND T.C_ELEMENT NOT IN ( SELECT C.CODE_OPE
                              FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE C
                              WHERE C.USER_ID = p_User_Id)
   ORDER BY T.C_ELEMENT;

CURSOR CR_SETUP IS
   SELECT T.C_ELEMENT,T.L_LIBELLE
   FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_MESSAGE  T
   WHERE T.C_table = 'COPER'
     AND T.C_ELEMENT <> '@@@@'
     AND T.C_LNG     = 2
     AND T.C_ELEMENT NOT IN ( SELECT C.CODE_OPE
                              FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE_SETUP C)
   ORDER BY T.C_ELEMENT;

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Code_Ope';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Insertion des codes opÃ©rations TA non encore prÃ©sents
FOR X IN CR_MAIN LOOP

    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE
      (FLAG,
       CODE_OPE,
       LIBELLE,
       USER_ID)
    VALUES
      (0,
       X.C_ELEMENT,
       X.L_LIBELLE,
       p_User_Id);

END LOOP;

-- Insertion des codes opÃ©rations TA non encore prÃ©sents
FOR X IN CR_SETUP LOOP

    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE_SETUP
      (CODE_OPE,
       LIBELLE,
       INFLOW_OUTFLOW)
    VALUES
      (X.C_ELEMENT,
       X.L_LIBELLE,
       0);

END LOOP;

COMMIT;

p_status           :=1;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status:=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='ProblÃ¨me lors de la remontÃ©e des codes opÃ©rations TA'
                || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Code_Ope',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
END proc_Ta_Code_Ope;

-----------------------------------------
-- Remonte les codes opÃ©rations eFront --
-----------------------------------------
procedure proc_eFront_Code_Ope( p_User_Id IN VARCHAR2,
                                p_status  OUT NUMBER,
                                p_msg_err OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status              NUMBER :=0;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                  NUMBER;

CURSOR CR_MAIN IS
    SELECT DISTINCT 1 OPERATION_TYPE,T.OPE_CODE OPERATION_CODE,T.FOP_DESCR OPERATION_NAME
    FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_ACCOUNT_INVESTOR T
    WHERE T.OPE_CODE IS NOT NULL
      AND T.OPE_CODE NOT IN (SELECT C.OPERATION_CODE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_SETUP_EF_CODE_OPE C)
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT 1 OPERATION_TYPE,T.OPERATIONTYPE OPERATION_CODE,C.L_DESCRIPTION
    FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_T_FUND_TRANSACTIONS T,
         EFRONT.DATA_EF_OPERATION_CODE C
    WHERE T.OPERATIONTYPE IS NOT NULL
      AND T.OPERATIONTYPE NOT IN (SELECT C.OPERATION_CODE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_SETUP_EF_CODE_OPE C)
      AND T.OPERATIONTYPE = C.C_CODE(+)
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT 2,D.TRANSACTION_TYPE,C.L_DESCRIPTION
    FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_T_DIRECT_TRANSACTIONS D,
         EFRONT.DATA_EF_OPERATION_CODE C
    WHERE D.TRANSACTION_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      AND D.TRANSACTION_TYPE NOT IN (SELECT C.OPERATION_CODE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_SETUP_EF_CODE_OPE C)
      AND D.TRANSACTION_TYPE = C.C_CODE(+);
      
Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_eFront_Code_Ope';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Insertion des codes opÃ©rations TA non encore prÃ©sents
FOR X IN CR_MAIN LOOP

    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.LUXREP_SETUP_EF_CODE_OPE
      (OPERATION_TYPE,
       OPERATION_CODE,
       FLAG_DEFAULT,
       CREATION_BY,
       CREATION_DATE,
       OPERATION_NAME)
    VALUES
      (X.OPERATION_TYPE,
       X.OPERATION_CODE,
       0,
       p_User_Id,
       SYSDATE,
       X.OPERATION_NAME);

END LOOP;
COMMIT;

p_status           :=1;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status:=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='ProblÃ¨me lors de la remontÃ©e des codes opÃ©rations eFront'
                || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_eFront_Code_Ope',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
END proc_eFront_Code_Ope;

----------
-- Mvts --
----------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Mvts(p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                        p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                        p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                        p_Code_Service IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                        p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                        p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                        p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Code_Service          VARCHAR2(2);
v_Tx_Ch_Ope             NUMBER;

v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;
v_Date_Nav_From_EF      DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To_EF        DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To_MF        DATE;
v_Lot_From              NUMBER;
v_Lot_To                NUMBER;

v_Code_Puid             DWH_AMS_SEC_INTL_ID.G_ID_VALUE%TYPE;
v_Underlying_Code_Puid  DWH_AMS_SEC_INTL_ID.G_ID_VALUE%TYPE;

v_Underlying_Code_Service    VARCHAR2(2);
v_Underlying_Quotation_Place DWH_AMS_SEC_MASTER.c_Quotation_Place%TYPE;


r_tr                    WRK_QUERIES_BCR_MVTS%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_BO ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
               p_Lot_From    IN NUMBER,
               p_Lot_To      IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
           T.C_SRV SEC_SRV,T.C_N_ID SEC_CODE_INTERNE_FA,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV) SEC_CODE_ISIN,
           REPADMIN.GET_SEC_NAME( T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV) SEC_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_SEC_CCY(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV) SEC_CCY,
           S.C_SEC_TYP GTI_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('SOF_TYP',S.C_SEC_TYP) GTI_NAME,
           S.C_COUNTRY SEC_COUNTRY_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('COUNTRY',S.C_COUNTRY) SEC_COUNTRY_NAME,
           T.D_ACC OPE_DATE_ACC,T.D_TRADE OPE_TRADE_DATE,T.D_VALUE OPE_DATE_VALUE,
           T.C_OPE OPE_CODE,T.N_ENTRY OPE_ENTRY,T.N_CONTRACT OPE_CONTRAT,
           T.Q_QTY OPE_QUANTITY,T.P_PRICE OPE_PRICE,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,D.A_GROSS,-D.A_GROSS) GROSS_AMOUNT,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,D.A_NET,-D.A_NET) NET_AMOUNT,
           T.A_BUY,T.A_BUY_PTF,
           T.A_SALE,T.A_SALE_PTF,
           DECODE(D.R_EXCHANGE,0,0,1/D.R_EXCHANGE) X_RATE_SEC_CCY_SETTL_CCY,
           (C.R_EXCHANGE/REPADMIN.GET_CCY_INFO(REPADMIN.GET_SEC_CCY(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV),'UNIT')) X_RATE_SETTL_CCY_FUND_CCY ,
           DECODE(D.R_EXCHANGE,0,0,((C.R_EXCHANGE/REPADMIN.GET_CCY_INFO(REPADMIN.GET_SEC_CCY(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV),'UNIT'))/D.R_EXCHANGE)) X_RATE_SEC_CCY_FUND_CCY,
           NVL(T.A_FEES,0) OPE_FEES,
           NVL(T.A_FEES_PTF,0) OPE_FEES_PTF,
           T.A_INTEREST OPE_INTEREST,T.A_INTEREST_PTF OPE_INTEREST_PTF,
           T.A_PNL OPE_REALIZED,T.A_PNL_PTF OPE_REALIZED_PTF,
           T.C_STATUS OPE_STATUT,
           REPADMIN.GET_UNDERLYING_CODE_INTERNE_FA(T.C_SRV,T.C_N_ID) UNDERLYING_CODE_INTERNE_FA,
           S.C_QUOTATION_PLACE QUOTATION_PLACE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_LOT(T.C_FUND,T.N_LOT) DATE_NAV,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('OPE',T.C_OPE) OPE_CODE_NAME
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_MVT  T,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_CASH_MVT  C,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET  D,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_SEC_MASTER  S
    WHERE T.C_FUND IN (SELECT F.FA_NUM
                       FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                       WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                         AND F.FA_NUM  = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                         AND F.FLAG    = 1)
    AND T.N_LOT    >  p_Lot_From
    AND T.N_LOT    <= p_Lot_To
    AND T.C_SRV    IN ('BO','PO')
    AND T.C_N_ID   = S.C_N_ID
    AND T.C_FUND   = D.C_FUND
    AND T.C_SRV    = D.C_SRV
    AND T.N_ENTRY  = D.N_ENTRY
    AND T.C_STATUS = D.C_STATUS
    AND T.C_FUND   = C.C_FUND(+)
    AND T.C_SRV    = C.C_SRV(+)
    AND T.N_ENTRY  = C.N_ENTRY(+)
    AND C.C_N_ACC(+)    = 15000
    ORDER BY T.N_ENTRY,T.D_ACC;

CURSOR CR_FU ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
               p_Lot_From    IN NUMBER,
               p_Lot_To      IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
           T.C_SRV SEC_SRV,T.C_N_ID SEC_CODE_INTERNE_FA,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV) SEC_CODE_ISIN,
           REPADMIN.GET_SEC_NAME( T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV) SEC_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_SEC_CCY(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV) SEC_CCY,
           S.C_SEC_TYP GTI_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('SOF_TYP',S.C_SEC_TYP) GTI_NAME,
           S.C_COUNTRY SEC_COUNTRY_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('COUNTRY',S.C_COUNTRY) SEC_COUNTRY_NAME,
           T.D_ACC OPE_DATE_ACC,T.D_TRADE OPE_TRADE_DATE,T.D_VALUE OPE_DATE_VALUE,
           T.C_OPE OPE_CODE,T.N_ENTRY OPE_ENTRY,T.N_CONTRACT OPE_CONTRAT,
           T.Q_QTY OPE_QUANTITY,D.P_FUT OPE_PRICE,
           DECODE(T.C_OPE,310,T.A_BUY,T.A_SALE) OPE_AMOUNT,
           DECODE(T.C_OPE,310,T.A_BUY_PTF,T.A_SALE_PTF) OPE_AMOUNT_PTF,
           T.A_FEES OPE_FEES,T.A_FEES_PTF OPE_FEES_PTF,
           T.A_INTEREST OPE_INTEREST,T.A_INTEREST_PTF OPE_INTEREST_PTF,
           T.A_PNL OPE_REALIZED,T.A_PNL_PTF OPE_REALIZED_PTF,
           T.C_STATUS OPE_STATUT,
           F.C_N_UNDERLYING UNDERLYING_CODE_INTERNE_FA,
           F.C_QUOTATION_PLACE QUOTATION_PLACE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_LOT(T.C_FUND,T.N_LOT) DATE_NAV,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('OPE',T.C_OPE) OPE_CODE_NAME
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_MVT  T,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_FUTURES_MASTER  F,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_SEC_MASTER  S,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_DEAL_FUTURE D
    WHERE T.C_FUND IN (SELECT F.FA_NUM
                       FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                       WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                         AND F.FA_NUM  = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                         AND F.FLAG    = 1)
    AND T.N_LOT    >  p_Lot_From
    AND T.N_LOT    <= p_Lot_To
    AND T.C_SRV    = 'FU'
    AND T.C_N_ID   = F.C_N_ID
    AND S.C_N_ID   = F.C_N_UNDERLYING
    AND T.C_FUND   = D.C_FUND
    AND T.N_LOT    = D.N_LOT
    AND T.C_SRV    = D.C_SRV
    AND T.N_ENTRY  = D.N_ENTRY
    AND T.N_ENTRY_PTF = D.N_ENTRY_PTF
    AND T.C_N_ID      = D.C_N_ID
    ORDER BY T.N_ENTRY,T.D_ACC;

CURSOR CR_OP ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
               p_Lot_From    IN NUMBER,
               p_Lot_To      IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
           T.C_SRV SEC_SRV,T.C_N_ID SEC_CODE_INTERNE_FA,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV) SEC_CODE_ISIN,
           REPADMIN.GET_SEC_NAME( T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV) SEC_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_SEC_CCY(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV) SEC_CCY,
           S.C_SEC_TYP GTI_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('SOF_TYP',S.C_SEC_TYP) GTI_NAME,
           S.C_COUNTRY SEC_COUNTRY_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('COUNTRY',S.C_COUNTRY) SEC_COUNTRY_NAME,
           T.D_ACC OPE_DATE_ACC,T.D_TRADE OPE_TRADE_DATE,T.D_VALUE OPE_DATE_VALUE,
           T.C_OPE OPE_CODE,T.N_ENTRY OPE_ENTRY,T.N_CONTRACT OPE_CONTRAT,
           T.Q_QTY OPE_QUANTITY,D.P_PREMIUM OPE_PRICE,
           DECODE(T.C_OPE,300,T.A_BUY,DECODE(T.C_OPE,307,T.A_BUY,T.A_SALE)) OPE_AMOUNT,
           DECODE(T.C_OPE,300,T.A_BUY_PTF,DECODE(T.C_OPE,307,T.A_BUY_PTF,T.A_SALE_PTF)) OPE_AMOUNT_PTF,
           T.A_FEES OPE_FEES,T.A_FEES_PTF OPE_FEES_PTF,
           T.A_INTEREST OPE_INTEREST,T.A_INTEREST_PTF OPE_INTEREST_PTF,
           T.A_PNL OPE_REALIZED,T.A_PNL_PTF OPE_REALIZED_PTF,
           T.C_STATUS OPE_STATUT,
           F.C_N_UNDERLYING UNDERLYING_CODE_INTERNE_FA,
           F.C_QUOTATION_PLACE QUOTATION_PLACE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_LOT(T.C_FUND,T.N_LOT) DATE_NAV,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('OPE',T.C_OPE) OPE_CODE_NAME
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_MVT  T,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER  F,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_SEC_MASTER  S,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_DEAL_OPTION D
    WHERE T.C_FUND IN (SELECT F.FA_NUM
                       FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                       WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                         AND F.FA_NUM  = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                         AND F.FLAG    = 1)
    AND T.N_LOT    >  p_Lot_From
    AND T.N_LOT    <= p_Lot_To
    AND T.C_SRV    = 'OP'
    AND T.C_N_ID   = F.C_N_ID
    AND S.C_N_ID   = F.C_N_UNDERLYING(+)
    AND T.C_FUND   = D.C_FUND
    AND T.N_LOT    = D.N_LOT
    AND T.C_SRV    = D.C_SRV
    AND T.N_ENTRY  = D.N_ENTRY
    AND T.N_ENTRY_PTF = D.N_ENTRY_PTF
    AND T.C_N_ID      = D.C_N_ID
    ORDER BY T.N_ENTRY,T.D_ACC;


  -- Retourne la liste des mouvements d'achats et de ventes
  CURSOR CR_MVT_EF ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                     p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                     p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE ) IS

    SELECT C.FA_NUM FUND_NUMBER,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           S.C_SRV SEC_SERVICE,0 SEC_CODE_INTERNE_FA,S.C_ISIN_CODE SEC_CODE_ISIN,
           S.L_NAME SEC_NAME,S.C_SEC_CCY SEC_CCY,S.C_SEC_TYP GTI_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('SOF_TYP',S.C_SEC_TYP) GTI_NAME,
           S.C_COUNTRY SEC_COUNTRY_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('COUNTRY',S.C_COUNTRY) SEC_COUNTRY_NAME,
           C.DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.OPERATIONDATE) OPE_DATE_ACC,C.DATE_NAV OPE_TRADE_DATE,TRUNC(T.OPERATIONDATE) OPE_DATE_VALUE,
           T.OPERATIONTYPE OPE_CODE,
           NULL OPE_QUANTITY,NULL OPE_PRICE,
           (CASE
              WHEN T.OPERATIONTYPE IN ('201','202') THEN
                  NVL(T1.CAPITALCALLED,0)
              WHEN T.OPERATIONTYPE IN ('200','204') THEN
                  NVL(T1.COMMITMENT,0)
              WHEN T.OPERATIONTYPE IN ('244') THEN
                  NVL(T1.REMAININGCOMMITMENT,0)
              WHEN T.OPERATIONTYPE IN ('-201') THEN
                  NVL(T1.DISTRIBUTION,0)
              ELSE
                NULL
           END) OPE_AMOUNT,
           (CASE
              WHEN T.OPERATIONTYPE IN ('201','202') THEN
                  NVL(T1.CAPITALCALLED,0)
              WHEN T.OPERATIONTYPE IN ('200','204') THEN
                  NVL(T1.COMMITMENT,0)
              WHEN T.OPERATIONTYPE IN ('244') THEN
                  NVL(T1.REMAININGCOMMITMENT,0)
              WHEN T.OPERATIONTYPE IN ('-201') THEN
                  NVL(T1.DISTRIBUTION,0)
              ELSE
                NULL
           END) OPE_AMOUNT_PTF,
           0 OPE_FEES,0 OPE_FEES_PTF,
           0 OPE_INTEREST ,0 OPE_INTEREST_PTF ,
           0 OPE_REALIZED ,0 OPE_REALIZED_PTF,
           20 OPE_STATUT,S.PUID_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_EFRONT_OPE_NAME(T.OPERATIONTYPE) OPE_NAME
    FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_T_FUND_TRANSACTIONS T,
         EFRONT.ORIG_EF_T_FUND_TRANS_INVE_CURR T1,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_SEC_MASTER S,
         REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS TF
    WHERE C.CLOSING_ID          IN ( SELECT C.CLOSING_ID
                                     FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
                                     WHERE C.FA_NUM   =  p_Fund_Number --'280604'
                                       AND C.DATE_NAV >  p_Date_Nav_From --'01-jan-18'
                                       AND C.DATE_NAV <= p_Date_Nav_To --'31-dec-18'
                                    )
      AND C.CLOSING_ID          = T.CLOSING_ID
      AND T.OPERATIONTYPE       IN ( SELECT O.OPERATION_CODE
                                     FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_SETUP_EF_CODE_OPE O
                                     WHERE O.OPERATION_TYPE = 1
                                       AND O.FLAG_DEFAULT   = 1)
      AND  T.FUND_ID            = S.ID_INSTRUMENT
      AND T.OPERATION_ID        = T1.OPERATION_ID
      AND C.FA_NUM              = TF.FA_NUM
    UNION
    SELECT C.FA_NUM FUND_NUMBER,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           S.C_SRV SEC_SERVICE,0 SEC_CODE_INTERNE_FA,S.C_ISIN_CODE SEC_CODE_ISIN,
           S.L_NAME SEC_NAME,S.C_SEC_CCY SEC_CCY,S.C_SEC_TYP GTI_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('SOF_TYP',S.C_SEC_TYP) GTI_NAME,
           S.C_COUNTRY SEC_COUNTRY_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('COUNTRY',S.C_COUNTRY) SEC_COUNTRY_NAME,
           C.DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.REFERENCE_DATE) OPE_DATE_ACC,C.DATE_NAV OPE_TRADE_DATE,C.DATE_NAV OPE_DATE_VALUE,
           T.TRANSACTION_TYPE OPE_CODE,
           DECODE(T1.TRANSACTION_TYPE,'BD03',T1.BUYSHARES,T1.SELLSHARES) OPE_QUANTITY ,
           NULL OPE_PRICE,
           DECODE(T1.TRANSACTION_TYPE,'BD03',-NVL(T1.AMOUNT,0),NVL(T1.AMOUNT,0)) OPE_AMOUNT,
           DECODE(T.TRANSACTION_TYPE,'BD03',-NVL(T.AMOUNT,0),NVL(T.AMOUNT,0)) OPE_AMOUNT_PTF,
           0 OPE_FEES,0 OPE_FEES_PTF,
           0 OPE_INTEREST ,0 OPE_INTEREST_PTF ,
           0 OPE_REALIZED ,0 OPE_REALIZED_PTF,
           20 OPE_STATUT,S.PUID_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_EFRONT_OPE_NAME(T1.TRANSACTION_TYPE) OPE_NAME
    FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_T_DIRECT_TRANSACTIONS T,
         EFRONT.ORIG_EF_T_DIR_TRANS_INVE_CURR T1,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_SEC_MASTER S,
         REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS TF
    WHERE C.CLOSING_ID          IN ( SELECT C.CLOSING_ID
                                     FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
                                     WHERE C.FA_NUM   =  p_Fund_Number --'280604'
                                       AND C.DATE_NAV >  p_Date_Nav_From --'01-jan-18'
                                       AND C.DATE_NAV <= p_Date_Nav_To --'31-dec-18'
                                    )
      AND C.CLOSING_ID          = T.CLOSING_ID
      AND T.TRANSACTION_TYPE    IN ( SELECT O.OPERATION_CODE
                                     FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_SETUP_EF_CODE_OPE O
                                     WHERE O.OPERATION_TYPE = 2
                                       AND O.FLAG_DEFAULT   = 1)
      AND T.INSTRUMENTFATHER_ID = S.ID_INSTRUMENT
      AND T.TRANSACTION_ID      = T1.TRANSACTION_ID
      AND C.FA_NUM              = TF.FA_NUM
    ORDER BY 8,9;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Mvts';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_MVTS T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

-- On parcours les fonds et rÃ©cup les date nav et les lots
FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM,REPADMIN.GET_EFRONT_DATE(F.FA_NUM) EFRONT_DATE,
                          F.D_ACTIVATION
                   FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                   WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                     AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

    IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
          get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 2,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                       v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
    ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
    ELSE
          v_Date_Nav_From := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,-1);
          v_Date_Nav_To   := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_To,-1);
    END IF;

    CASE
       -- Tout dans Multifonds
       WHEN VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE IS NULL THEN
           v_Lot_From := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,0);
           v_Lot_To   := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_To,0);

           v_Date_Nav_From_EF := NULL;
           v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := NULL;

       -- Tout dans eFront
       WHEN VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE <= v_Date_Nav_From THEN
           v_Lot_From       := 0;
           v_Lot_To         := 0;

           v_Date_Nav_From_EF := NVL(v_Date_Nav_From,VCR_FONDS.D_ACTIVATION-1);
           v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := v_Date_Nav_To;

       -- Une partie dans Multifonds et une partie dans eFront
       WHEN VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE <= v_Date_Nav_To THEN
           v_Lot_From         := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,0);

           v_Date_Nav_From_EF := NULL;
           v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := NULL;
    END CASE;

    ------------------------
    -- Data de Multifonds --
    ------------------------
    IF v_Lot_To <> 0 THEN

        -- BO
        IF p_Code_Service IS NULL OR p_Code_Service='BO' THEN

           FOR X IN CR_BO (VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Lot_From,v_Lot_To) LOOP

                  ELSE
                  r_tr.ope_amount   := NVL(X.A_SALE,0);
               END IF;
               r_tr.ope_fees     := X.OPE_FEES;
               r_tr.Ope_Fees_Ptf := X.OPE_FEES_PTF;

               IF NVL(X.A_BUY,0)<>0 THEN
                  IF X.OPE_STATUT = 20 THEN
                     r_tr.Ope_Amount_Ptf := NVL(X.A_BUY_PTF,0) + r_tr.Ope_Fees_Ptf;
                     ELSE
                     r_tr.Ope_Amount_Ptf := NVL(X.A_BUY_PTF,0) - r_tr.Ope_Fees_Ptf;
                  END IF;

                  ELSE

                     ELSE
