                   p_User_Id,
                   SYSDATE,
                   r_tr.sec_code_bloomberg,
                   r_tr.underlying_code_bloomberg,
                   X.DATE_NAV,
                   X.OPE_CODE_NAME);

           END LOOP;
        END IF;
    END IF; -- Fin partie Multifonds

    --------------------
    -- Data de eFront --
    --------------------
    IF v_Date_Nav_From_EF IS NOT NULL AND v_Date_Nav_To_EF IS NOT NULL THEN

        -- BO
        IF p_Code_Service IS NULL OR p_Code_Service='BO' THEN

           FOR VCR_EF IN CR_MVT_EF (VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From_EF,v_Date_Nav_To_EF) LOOP

               r_tr                         := NULL;

               v_Code_Puid                  := NULL;
               v_Underlying_Code_Puid       := NULL;
               v_Underlying_Code_Service    := NULL;
               v_Underlying_Quotation_Place := NULL;

               -- Code Bloomberg
                v_Code_Puid             := VCR_EF.PUID_CODE;
                r_tr.sec_code_bloomberg := GET_BLOOMBERG_TICKER(v_Code_Puid,VCR_EF.SEC_CCY);

               -- Underlying
               -- Pas d'underlying

               -- Code Bloomberg Underlying
               INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_MVTS
                  (fund_number,
                   fund_name,
                   fund_ccy,
                   sec_service,
                   sec_code_isin,
                   sec_code_interne_fa,
                   sec_name,
                   sec_ccy,
                   sec_country_code,
                   sec_country_name,
                   ope_date_acc,
                   ope_date_trade,
                   ope_date_value,
                   ope_code,
                   ope_entry,
                   ope_contrat,
                   ope_libelle,
                   ope_quantity,
                   ope_price,
                   ope_amount,
                   ope_amount_ptf,
                   ope_fees,
                   ope_fees_ptf,
                   ope_interest,
                   ope_interest_ptf,
                   ope_realized,
                   ope_realized_ptf,
                   ope_statut,
                   underlying_code_interne_fa,
                   underlying_code_isin,
                   underlying_name,
                   underlying_ccy,
                   sec_gti_code,
                   sec_gti_name,
                   user_id,
                   date_creation,
                   sec_code_bloomberg,
                   underlying_code_bloomberg,
                   date_nav,
                   ope_code_name)
                VALUES
                  (VCR_EF.fund_number,
                   VCR_EF.fund_name,
                   VCR_EF.fund_ccy,
                   VCR_EF.SEC_SERVICE,
                   VCR_EF.sec_code_isin,
                   VCR_EF.sec_code_interne_fa,
                   VCR_EF.sec_name,
                   VCR_EF.sec_ccy,
                   VCR_EF.sec_country_code,
                   VCR_EF.sec_country_name,
                   VCR_EF.ope_date_acc,
                   VCR_EF.OPE_TRADE_DATE,
                   VCR_EF.ope_date_value,
                   VCR_EF.ope_code,
                   NULL, --VCR_EF.ope_entry,
                   NULL,
                   NULL,
                   VCR_EF.ope_quantity,
                   VCR_EF.ope_price,
                   VCR_EF.ope_amount,
                   VCR_EF.Ope_Amount_Ptf,
                   VCR_EF.Ope_Fees,
                   VCR_EF.ope_fees_ptf,
                   VCR_EF.ope_interest,
                   VCR_EF.ope_interest_ptf,
                   VCR_EF.ope_realized,
                   VCR_EF.ope_realized_ptf,
                   VCR_EF.ope_statut,
                   r_tr.underlying_code_interne_fa,
                   r_tr.underlying_code_isin,
                   r_tr.underlying_name,
                   r_tr.Underlying_Ccy,
                   VCR_EF.GTI_CODE,
                   VCR_EF.GTI_NAME,
                   p_User_Id,
                   SYSDATE,
                   r_tr.sec_code_bloomberg,
                   r_tr.underlying_code_bloomberg,
                   VCR_EF.DATE_NAV,
                   VCR_EF.OPE_NAME);
           END LOOP;
        END IF;
    END IF; -- Fin partie eFront
END LOOP;
COMMIT;

    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

         -- Error Monitoring
         Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Mvts',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Mvts;

--------------------------
-- Coupons - Dividendes --
--------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Div(p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                       p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                       p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                       p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                       p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                       p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Code_Service          VARCHAR2(2);

v_Date_Acc              DATE;
v_Entry_Ptf             NUMBER;

v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;
v_Lot_From              NUMBER;
v_Lot_To                NUMBER;

r_tr                    WRK_QUERIES_BCR_MVTS%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_DIV ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                p_Lot_From    IN NUMBER,
                p_Lot_To      IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
           T.C_SRV_POSITION SEC_SRV,T.C_N_ID SEC_CODE_INTERNE_FA,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV_POSITION) SEC_CODE_ISIN,
           REPADMIN.GET_SEC_NAME( T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV_POSITION) SEC_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_SEC_CCY(T.C_N_ID,T.C_SRV_POSITION) SEC_CCY,
           S.C_COUNTRY SEC_COUNTRY_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWH_MESSAGE('COUNTRY',S.C_COUNTRY) SEC_COUNTRY_NAME,
           T.D_ACC DIV_DATE_ACC,T.D_TRADE DIV_DATE_TRADE,T.D_VALUE DIV_DATE_VALUE,
           T.D_EXECUTION DIV_DATE_EXE,T.D_PAYMENT DIV_DATE_PAYMENT,
           T.C_OPE DIV_CODE,T.C_N_ACC DIV_ACCOUNT,T.N_ENTRY DIV_ENTRY,
           T.N_ENTRY_PTF DIV_ENTRY_PTF,T.N_CONTRACT DIV_CONTRAT,T.L_DEAL DIV_LIBELLE,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,T.Q_QTY,-T.Q_QTY) DIV_QUANTITY,
           T.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY DIV_UNIT_AMOUNT_SEC_CCY,
           T.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY DIV_UNIT_AMOUNT_SETTL_CCY,
           T.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY DIV_SETTL_CCY,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,T.A_GROSS,-T.A_GROSS) DIV_GROSS_AMOUNT,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,T.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX + T.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
                  -(T.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX + T.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2)) DIV_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,T.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX + T.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
                  -(T.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX + T.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2)) DIV_RECOVERABLE_TAX,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,T.A_TAX + T.A_TAX_2,
                  -(T.A_TAX + T.A_TAX_2)) DIV_OTHER_TAX,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,T.A_FEE_COR,-T.A_FEE_COR) DIV_FEES,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,T.A_NET,-T.A_NET) DIV_NET_AMOUNT,
           DECODE(T.C_STATUS,20,T.A_NET_PTF_CCY,-T.A_NET_PTF_CCY) DIV_NET_AMOUNT_PTF,
           T.R_INTEREST DIV_INTEREST_RATE,
           T.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY DIV_X_RATE_PTF_CCY,T.R_EXCHANGE_RATE DIV_X_RATE,
           T.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY DIV_X_RATE_TAX_CCY,T.C_STATUS DIV_STATUT
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND  T,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_SEC_MASTER  S
    WHERE T.C_FUND IN (SELECT F.FA_NUM
                       FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                       WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                         AND F.FA_NUM  = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                         AND F.FLAG    = 1)
      AND T.N_LOT    >  p_Lot_From
      AND T.N_LOT    <= p_Lot_To
--      AND T.D_ACC  BETWEEN v_Date_From AND v_Date_To
      AND T.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID
    ORDER BY T.N_ENTRY,T.D_ACC;


Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Div';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_DIV T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

-- Parcours des fonds
FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                   FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                   WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                     AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP


    IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
          get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 2,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                       v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
    ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
    ELSE
          v_Date_Nav_From := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,-1);
          v_Date_Nav_To   := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_To,-1);
    END IF;
    v_Lot_From := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,0);
    v_Lot_To   := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_To,0);


    -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
    FOR X IN CR_DIV (VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Lot_From,v_Lot_To) LOOP

        INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_DIV
          (fund_number,
           fund_name,
           fund_ccy,
           sec_service,
           sec_code_isin,
           sec_code_interne_fa,
           sec_name,
           sec_ccy,
           sec_country_code,
           sec_country_name,
           div_date_acc,
           div_date_trade,
           div_date_value,
           div_date_exe,
           div_date_payment,
           div_code,
           div_account,
           div_entry,
           div_entry_ptf,
           div_contrat,
           div_libelle,
           div_quantity,
           div_unit_amount_sec_ccy,
           div_unit_amount_settl_ccy,
           div_settl_ccy,
           div_gross_amount,
           div_unrecoverable_tax,
           div_recoverable_tax,
           div_other_tax,
           div_fees,
           div_net_amount,
           div_net_amount_ptf,
           div_interest_rate,
           div_x_rate_ptf_ccy,
           div_x_rate,
           div_x_rate_tax_ccy,
           div_statut,
           user_id,
           date_creation)
        VALUES
          (X.fund_number,
           X.fund_name,
           X.fund_ccy,
           X.SEC_SRV,
           X.sec_code_isin,
           X.sec_code_interne_fa,
           X.sec_name,
           X.sec_ccy,
           X.sec_country_code,
           X.sec_country_name,
           X.div_date_acc,
           X.div_date_trade,
           X.div_date_value,
           X.div_date_exe,
           X.div_date_payment,
           X.div_code,
           X.div_account,
           X.div_entry,
           X.Div_Entry_Ptf,
           X.div_contrat,
           X.div_libelle,
           X.div_quantity,
           X.div_unit_amount_sec_ccy,
           X.div_unit_amount_settl_ccy,
           X.div_settl_ccy,
           X.div_gross_amount,
           X.div_unrecoverable_tax,
           X.div_recoverable_tax,
           X.div_other_tax,
           X.div_fees,
           X.div_net_amount,
           X.div_net_amount_ptf,
           X.div_interest_rate,
           X.div_x_rate_ptf_ccy,
           X.div_x_rate,
           X.div_x_rate_tax_ccy,
           X.div_statut,
           p_User_Id,
           SYSDATE);


    END LOOP;
    COMMIT;

    -- Verrue pour voir si toutes les opÃ©rations avec un statut 30 ont
    -- bien l'opÃ©ration originale prÃ©sente dans la liste
    -- Ex. 280623 - Entry 145, il y a l'extourne de l'opÃ© mais pas l'opÃ©
    FOR X IN (SELECT T.*
              FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_DIV T
              WHERE T.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                AND T.DIV_STATUT = '30'
                AND T.DIV_ENTRY   NOT IN (SELECT T.DIV_ENTRY
                                          FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_DIV T
                                          WHERE T.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                          AND T.DIV_STATUT = '20')) LOOP

        -- Parcours des opÃ© extournÃ©es dont l'opÃ© n'est pas prÃ©sentes
        -- Si la date accounting de l'opÃ© est entre Date From et Date To => insertion
        v_Date_Acc := NULL;
        FOR X1 IN (SELECT C.D_ACC,C.N_ENTRY_PTF
                   FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_CASH_MVT  C
                   WHERE C.C_FUND      = X.FUND_NUMBER
                     AND C.C_OPE       = X.DIV_CODE
                     AND C.N_ENTRY     = X.DIV_ENTRY
                     AND C.N_ENTRY_PTF <> X.DIV_ENTRY_PTF) LOOP


            v_Date_Acc  := X1.D_ACC;
            v_Entry_Ptf := X1.N_ENTRY_PTF;
            EXIT;
        END LOOP;

        IF v_Date_Acc IS NOT NULL AND
           v_Date_Acc BETWEEN v_Date_From AND v_Date_To THEN

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_DIV
              (fund_number,
               fund_name,
               fund_ccy,
               sec_service,
               sec_code_isin,
               sec_code_interne_fa,
               sec_name,
               sec_ccy,
               sec_country_code,
               sec_country_name,
               div_date_acc,
               div_date_trade,
               div_date_value,
               div_date_exe,
               div_date_payment,
               div_code,
               div_account,
               div_entry,
               div_entry_ptf,
               div_contrat,
               div_libelle,
               div_quantity,
               div_unit_amount_sec_ccy,
               div_unit_amount_settl_ccy,
               div_settl_ccy,
               div_gross_amount,
               div_unrecoverable_tax,
               div_recoverable_tax,
               div_other_tax,
               div_fees,
               div_net_amount,
               div_net_amount_ptf,
               div_interest_rate,
               div_x_rate_ptf_ccy,
               div_x_rate,
               div_x_rate_tax_ccy,
               div_statut,
               user_id,
               date_creation)
            VALUES
              (X.fund_number,
               X.fund_name,
               X.fund_ccy,
               X.SEC_SERVICE,
               X.sec_code_isin,
               X.sec_code_interne_fa,
               X.sec_name,
               X.sec_ccy,
               X.sec_country_code,
               X.sec_country_name,
               v_Date_Acc, --
               X.div_date_trade,
               X.div_date_value,
               X.div_date_exe,
               X.div_date_payment,
               X.div_code,
               X.div_account,
               X.div_entry,
               v_Entry_Ptf, --
               X.div_contrat,
               X.div_libelle,
               X.div_quantity,
               X.div_unit_amount_sec_ccy,
               X.div_unit_amount_settl_ccy,
               X.div_settl_ccy,
               -X.div_gross_amount,
               -X.div_unrecoverable_tax,
               -X.div_recoverable_tax,
               -X.div_other_tax,
               -X.div_fees,
               -X.div_net_amount,
               -X.div_net_amount_ptf,
               X.div_interest_rate,
               X.div_x_rate_ptf_ccy,
               X.div_x_rate,
               X.div_x_rate_tax_ccy,
               20,
               p_User_Id,
               SYSDATE);
        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END LOOP;
COMMIT;


    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Div',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Div;

------------------
-- Sub et Red FA --
------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Sub_Red_Fa(p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                              p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                              p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Code_Service          VARCHAR2(2);

v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;
v_Date_Nav_From_EF      DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To_EF        DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To_MF        DATE;
v_Lot_From              NUMBER;
v_Lot_To                NUMBER;
r_Row                   WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SUB_RED%ROWTYPE;

v_Nb_Decimales          NUMBER;
v_Date_Nav              DATE;
v_Price_Part_Ccy        NUMBER;
v_Price_Fund_Ccy        NUMBER;

CURSOR CR_AC ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
               p_Lot_From    IN NUMBER,
               p_Lot_To      IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT T.N_LOT, T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE) PART,TF.PART_CCY,
           T.C_N_ID CODE_INTERNE_FA,TF.ISIN_CODE CODE_ISIN,
           T.D_ACC OPE_DATE_ACC,T.D_TRADE OPE_TRADE_DATE,T.D_VALUE OPE_DATE_VALUE,
           T.C_OPE OPE_CODE,DECODE(T.C_OPE,'080','SUBSCRIPTION','REDEMPTION') OPE_NAME,
           T.N_ENTRY OPE_ENTRY,
           T.Q_QTY OPE_QUANTITY,T.P_PRICE OPE_PRICE,
           DECODE(T.C_OPE,'080',T.A_BUY,T.A_SALE) OPE_AMOUNT,
           DECODE(T.C_OPE,'080',T.A_BUY_PTF,T.A_SALE_PTF) OPE_AMOUNT_PTF,
           T.C_STATUS OPE_STATUT,C.C_CCY OPE_CCY,C.R_EXCHANGE OPE_X_RATE
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_MVT  T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_CASH_MVT C
    WHERE T.C_FUND     IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                          FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                          WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                            AND F.FA_NUM  = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                            AND F.FLAG    = 1)
     AND T.N_LOT       >  p_Lot_From
     AND T.N_LOT       <= p_Lot_To
     AND T.C_SRV       = 'AC'
     AND T.C_N_ID      = TF.INTERNAL_FA_CODE
     AND T.N_LOT       = C.N_LOT
     AND T.N_ENTRY     = C.N_ENTRY
     AND T.N_ENTRY_PTF = C.N_ENTRY_PTF
     AND C.C_N_ACC     = 15000
    ORDER BY T.N_ENTRY,T.D_ACC;

   CURSOR CR_AC_EF ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                     p_date_beg    IN DATE,
                     p_date_end    IN DATE) IS

        SELECT S.C_ISIN_CODE ISIN_CODE,TF.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,S.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,
               TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,  TF.PART_FA_CODE SHARECLASS_CODE,
               TF.PART_NAME SHARECLASS_NAME,TF.PART_CCY SHARECLASS_CCY,TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,
               C.DATE_NAV D_ACC,TRUNC(A1.CLOSEDATE) D_TRADE,TRUNC(A1.CLOSEDATE) D_VALUE,
               A1.OPE_CODE OPERATION_CODE,DECODE(A1.OPE_CODE,'101','SUBSCRIPTION','REDEMPTION') OPERATION_NAME,
               A1.NBSHARES QUANTITY,
               A1.AMOUNT AMOUNT_SHARECLASS_CCY,
               A1.AMOUNT AMOUNT_FUND_CCY,
               (CASE
                 WHEN A1.NBSHARES < 0 THEN
                   30
                 ELSE
                   20
               END ) C_STATUS,

               NULL N_ENTRY,A1.IQID
        FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_ACCOUNT_INVESTOR A1,
             EFRONT.DATA_FA_PTF_SHARE S,
             REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
             EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
        WHERE A1.CLOSING_ID       IN ( SELECT CL.CLOSING_ID
                                       FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING CL
                                       WHERE CL.FA_NUM    = p_Fund_Number --'232128'
                                         AND CL.DATE_NAV >= p_date_beg --'31-DEC-17'
                                         AND CL.DATE_NAV <= p_date_end --'30-SEP-18'
                               )
          AND S.C_FUND           = p_Fund_Number --'232128'
          AND A1.OPE_CODE        IN ('-101','102','101')
          AND A1.AMOUNT          IS NOT NULL
          AND A1.FUNDSHARE       =S.SHARE_ID
          AND A1.CLOSING_ID      = C.CLOSING_ID
          AND S.C_ISIN_CODE      = TF.ISIN_CODE;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Sub_Red_Fa';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SUB_RED T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
-- Parcours des fonds
FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM,GET_EFRONT_DATE(F.FA_NUM) EFRONT_DATE
                   FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                   WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                     AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

    IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
          get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 2,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                       v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
    ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
          ELSE
          v_Date_Nav_From := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,-1);
          v_Date_Nav_To   := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_To,-1);
    END IF;

    CASE
       -- Tout dans Multifonds
       WHEN VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE IS NULL THEN
           v_Lot_From := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,0);
           v_Lot_To   := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_To,0);

           v_Date_Nav_From_EF := NULL;
           v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := NULL;

       -- Tout dans eFront
       WHEN VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE <= v_Date_Nav_From THEN
           v_Lot_From       := 0;
           v_Lot_To         := 0;

           v_Date_Nav_From_EF := v_Date_Nav_From;
           v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := v_Date_Nav_To;

       -- Une partie dans Multifonds et une partie dans eFront
       WHEN VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE <= v_Date_Nav_To THEN
           v_Lot_From         := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,0);
           v_Date_Nav_To_MF   := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE-1,-1);
           v_Lot_To           := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_To_MF,0);

           v_Date_Nav_From_EF := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE;
           v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := v_Date_Nav_To;

       -- Pour Ã©viter bug
       ELSE
           v_Lot_From         := 0;
           v_Lot_To           := 0;

           v_Date_Nav_From_EF := NULL;
           v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := NULL;
    END CASE;

    ------------------------
    -- Data de Multifonds --
    ------------------------
    IF v_Lot_To <> 0 THEN

        FOR X IN CR_AC (VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Lot_From,v_Lot_To) LOOP

            IF X.FUND_CCY = X.PART_CCY THEN

               r_Row.Ope_Amount_Ptf := X.OPE_AMOUNT_PTF;
               r_Row.Ope_Amount     := X.OPE_AMOUNT;
               r_Row.Ope_Price      := X.OPE_PRICE;

               ELSE
                  v_Nb_Decimales       :=GET_FUND_NB_DECIMALES(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,1);

                  v_Date_Nav           :=GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_LOT(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,X.N_LOT);
                  v_Date_Nav           :=GET_NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLIEE_PS(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav,-1);
                  v_Price_Part_Ccy     :=GET_PRICE_FA_PART_CCY(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,X.PART,v_Date_Nav);
                  v_Price_Fund_Ccy     :=GET_PRICE_FA_PART(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,X.PART,v_Date_Nav);

                  r_Row.Ope_Price      := v_Price_Part_Ccy;
                  r_Row.Ope_Amount     := ROUND(X.OPE_QUANTITY * v_Price_Part_Ccy,v_Nb_Decimales);
                  r_Row.Ope_Amount_Ptf := ROUND(X.OPE_QUANTITY * v_Price_Fund_Ccy,v_Nb_Decimales);

            END IF;

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SUB_RED
              (fund_number,
               fund_name,
               fund_ccy,
               part,
               part_ccy,
               code_isin,
               code_interne_fa,
               ope_date_acc,
               ope_date_trade,
               ope_date_value,
               ope_code,
               ope_name,
               ope_entry,
               ope_quantity,
               ope_price,
               ope_amount,
               ope_amount_ptf,
               ope_statut,
               user_id,
               date_creation)
            VALUES
              (X.fund_number,
               X.fund_name,
               X.fund_ccy,
               X.part,
               X.part_ccy,
               X.code_isin,
               X.code_interne_fa,
               X.ope_date_acc,
               X.OPE_TRADE_DATE,
               X.ope_date_value,
               X.ope_code,
               X.ope_name,
               X.ope_entry,
               X.ope_quantity,
               r_Row.Ope_Price,
               r_Row.ope_amount,
               r_Row.ope_amount_ptf,
               X.OPE_STATUT,
               p_User_Id,
               SYSDATE);

        END LOOP;
    END IF;

    --------------------
    -- Data de eFront --
    --------------------
    IF v_Date_Nav_From_EF IS NOT NULL AND v_Date_Nav_To_EF IS NOT NULL THEN

        FOR X IN CR_AC_EF (VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From_EF,v_Date_Nav_To_EF) LOOP
            r_Row.Ope_Price   := NULL;
            IF NVL(X.QUANTITY,0) <> 0 THEN
               r_Row.Ope_Price   := ROUND(X.AMOUNT_SHARECLASS_CCY / X.QUANTITY,2);
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SUB_RED
              (fund_number,
               fund_name,
               fund_ccy,
               part,
               part_ccy,
               code_isin,
               code_interne_fa,
               ope_date_acc,
               ope_date_trade,
               ope_date_value,
               ope_code,
               ope_name,
               ope_entry,
               ope_quantity,
               ope_price,
               ope_amount,
               ope_amount_ptf,
               ope_statut,
               user_id,
               date_creation)
            VALUES
              (X.FUND_NUMBER,
               X.FUND_NAME,
               X.FUND_CCY,
               X.SHARECLASS_CODE,
               X.SHARECLASS_CCY,
               X.ISIN_CODE,
               X.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,
               X.D_ACC,
               X.D_TRADE,
               X.D_VALUE,
               X.OPERATION_CODE,
               X.OPERATION_NAME,
               NULL, --ope_entry,
               X.QUANTITY,
               r_Row.Ope_Price,
               X.AMOUNT_SHARECLASS_CCY,
               X.AMOUNT_FUND_CCY,
               X.C_STATUS,
               p_User_Id,
               SYSDATE);

        END LOOP;
    END IF;

END LOOP;
COMMIT;

    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Sub_Red_Fa',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Sub_Red_Fa;

---------------------
-- Taux Change Nav --
---------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Tx_Ch_Nav(p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                             p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                             p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                             p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                             p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                             p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;
v_Lot_From              NUMBER;
v_Lot_To                NUMBER;

r_tr                    WRK_QUERIES_BCR_MVTS%ROWTYPE;




------- XRATE NAV -----------------
CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
           T.D_NAV,T.C_CCY,T.R_EXCHANGE_MF,T.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY,
           T.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY,T.G_ROUNDING_PTF_CCY,T.G_ROUNDING_CCY,
           T.N_DECIMAL_PTF_CCY,T.N_DECIMAL_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES  T
    INNER JOIN repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
            ON b.fund_no = t.c_fund
    WHERE T.C_FUND IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                        WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                          AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                          AND F.FLAG    = 1)
      AND T.D_NAV  BETWEEN p_Date_Nav_From AND p_Date_Nav_To
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.c_nav_typ = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1));                     -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial) 

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Tx_Ch_Nav';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_TX_CH_NAV T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

IF p_Period_Type IN ('LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY', 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV') THEN

     FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                        WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                          AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

        IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 1,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
        ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
        END IF;

        -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
        FOR X IN CR_MAIN(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To) LOOP

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_TX_CH_NAV
              (fonds_num_fa,
               fonds_nom,
               fonds_ccy,
               date_nav,
               ccy,
               exchange_mf,
               ccy_to_ptf_ccy,
               ptf_ccy_to_ccy,
               rounding_ptf_ccy,
               rounding_ccy,
               decimal_ptf_ccy,
               decimal_ccy,
               user_id,
               date_creation)
            VALUES
              (X.FUND_NUMBER,
               X.FUND_NAME,
               X.FUND_CCY,
               X.D_NAV,
               X.C_CCY,
               X.R_EXCHANGE_MF,
               X.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY,
               X.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY,
               X.G_ROUNDING_PTF_CCY,
               X.G_ROUNDING_CCY,
               X.N_DECIMAL_PTF_CCY,
               X.N_DECIMAL_CCY,
               p_User_Id,
               SYSDATE);
        END LOOP;
     END LOOP;

     ELSE

     FOR X IN CR_MAIN(NULL,v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

          INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_TX_CH_NAV
            (fonds_num_fa,
             fonds_nom,
             fonds_ccy,
             date_nav,
             ccy,
             exchange_mf,
             ccy_to_ptf_ccy,
             ptf_ccy_to_ccy,
             rounding_ptf_ccy,
             rounding_ccy,
             decimal_ptf_ccy,
             decimal_ccy,
             user_id,
             date_creation)
          VALUES
            (X.FUND_NUMBER,
             X.FUND_NAME,
             X.FUND_CCY,
             X.D_NAV,
             X.C_CCY,
             X.R_EXCHANGE_MF,
             X.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY,
             X.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY,
             X.G_ROUNDING_PTF_CCY,
             X.G_ROUNDING_CCY,
             X.N_DECIMAL_PTF_CCY,
             X.N_DECIMAL_CCY,
             p_User_Id,
             SYSDATE);

     END LOOP;
END IF;
-- Insertion des donnÃ©es

COMMIT;

<<Fin_Proc>>
    p_status  :=v_status;
    p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Tx_Ch_Nav',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Tx_Ch_Nav;

-------------------
-- Grands Livres --
-------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Grands_Livres( p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                                  p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                                  p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                  p_Compte_From  IN NUMBER,
                                  p_Compte_To    IN NUMBER,
                                  p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                                  p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                                  p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');

v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;
v_Lot_From              NUMBER;
v_Lot_To                NUMBER;

r_Row                   WRK_QUERIES_BCR_GD_LIVRE%ROWTYPE;

v_Trade_Date_Max        DATE;
  
CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number    IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Lot_From       IN NUMBER,
                 p_Lot_To         IN NUMBER,
                 p_Trade_Date_Max IN DATE) IS  -- INCPB-622159   

    SELECT C.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,
           C.C_N_ACC ACCOUNT_NUMBER,C.N_SUF ACCOUNT_SUF ,
           REPADMIN.GET_LIB_CPT_BILAN(C.C_N_ACC,'20') ACCOUNT_NAME,C.C_CCY ACCOUNT_CCY,
           C.C_ACC_WAY ACCOUNT_SENS,C.C_SRV CODE_SERVICE,
           C.C_OPE CODE_OPE,C.C_STATUS STATUT,
           C.D_ACC ACC_DATE,C.D_TRADE TRADE_DATE,C.D_VALUE VALUE_DATE,
           C.L_MVT OPE_DESCRIPTION,C.N_ENTRY NUM_ENTRY,C.N_ENTRY_PTF NUM_ENTRY_PTF,
           C.A_MVT AMOUNT,C.A_MVT_PTF AMOUNT_FUND_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_CASH_MVT  C
    WHERE C.C_FUND   =  p_Fund_Number
      AND C.D_TRADE  <= NVL(p_Trade_Date_Max,C.D_TRADE) -- INCPB-622159       
      AND C.N_LOT    >  p_Lot_From
      AND C.N_LOT    <= p_Lot_To
      AND C.C_N_ACC  >= p_Compte_From
      AND C.C_N_ACC  <= p_Compte_To
    ORDER BY C.C_FUND,C.C_N_ACC,C.N_ENTRY,C.D_ACC;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Grands_Livres';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_GD_LIVRE T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

-- On parcours les fonds et rÃ©cup les date nav et les lots
FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM,F.FUND_NAME,F.FUND_CCY,
                          REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAV_BACKDATED(F.FA_NUM) BACKDATED -- INCPB-622159
                   FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                   WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                     AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP


    r_Row.Fund_Number := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
    r_Row.Fund_Name   := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
    r_Row.Fund_Ccy    := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;

    IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
          get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 2,r_Row.Fund_Number,SYSDATE,
                                       v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
    ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
          ELSE
          v_Date_Nav_From := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(r_Row.Fund_Number,v_Date_From,-1);
          v_Date_Nav_To   := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(r_Row.Fund_Number,v_Date_To,-1);
    END IF;
    v_Lot_From := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(r_Row.Fund_Number,v_Date_Nav_From,0);
    v_Lot_To   := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(r_Row.Fund_Number,v_Date_Nav_To,0);

    -- INCPB-622159 : Si le fonds est backdated, on prend le + petit lot de la date nav from
    v_Trade_Date_Max     := NULL;
    IF NVL(VCR_FONDS.BACKDATED,0) = 1 THEN
       FOR X IN ( SELECT MIN(T.N_LOT) LOT_NUMBER 
                  FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_LOT T
                  WHERE T.C_FUND = r_Row.Fund_Number
                    AND T.D_NAV  = v_Date_Nav_From ) LOOP

            v_Lot_From := NVL(X.LOT_NUMBER,0);
            EXIT;        
        END LOOP; 
        v_Trade_Date_Max := v_Date_Nav_To;
    END IF;

    -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
    FOR X IN CR_MAIN (r_Row.Fund_Number,v_Lot_From,v_Lot_To,v_Trade_Date_Max) LOOP

        INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_GD_LIVRE
          (fund_number,
           fund_name,
           fund_ccy,
           account_number,
           account_suf,
           account_name,
           account_ccy,
           account_sens,
           ope_code_service,
           ope_code,
           ope_date_acc,
           ope_date_trade,
           ope_date_value,
           ope_description,
           ope_entry,
           ope_entry_ptf,
           ope_amount,
           ope_amount_ptf,
           ope_statut,
           user_id,
           date_creation)
        VALUES
          (r_Row.Fund_Number,
           r_Row.Fund_Name,
           r_Row.Fund_Ccy,
           X.ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
           X.ACCOUNT_SUF,
           X.ACCOUNT_NAME,
           X.ACCOUNT_CCY,
           X.ACCOUNT_SENS,
           X.CODE_SERVICE,
           X.CODE_OPE,
           X.ACC_DATE,
           X.TRADE_DATE,
           X.VALUE_DATE,
           X.OPE_DESCRIPTION,
           X.NUM_ENTRY,
           X.NUM_ENTRY_PTF,
           X.AMOUNT,
           X.AMOUNT_FUND_CCY,
           X.STATUT,
           p_User_Id,
           SYSDATE);
    END LOOP;
END LOOP;
COMMIT;


    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Grands_Livres',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Grands_Livres;

-------------------------------------------------
-- Query 'Accrued Expenses' (Rapport MFFA 960) --
-------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Accrued_Expenses( p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                                     p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                                     p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                     p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                                     p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                                     p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');

v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;

v_Lot_From              NUMBER;
v_Lot_To                NUMBER;

r_tr                    WRK_QUERIES_BCR_ACCRUED_EXP%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
           DECODE(T.C_NAV_TYP,'O',1,2)   NAV_TYPE,
           T.D_NAV DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.D_H_PROCESSING) DATE_CALCUL ,
           N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION DATE_PUB,
           N.NAV_DATE_TRT_FIN DATE_SITUATION,
           T.C_OPE_TRANS_FEES OPE_CODE,TO_CHAR(T.C_N_FEE) FEES_CODE,
           C.XLIBELLE FEES_DESCRIPTION , C.CODE_GRP_MULTICLASS GROUPE_MC,
           T.A_MARGIN BASED_AMOUNT,
           DECODE(T.R_INTEREST,NULL,NULL,T.R_INTEREST) PERCENTAGE,
           T.D_PREV_NAV_DATE VALUE_DATE,T.D_NEXT_NAV_DATE MATURITY_DATE,
           T.N_ACCRUED_DAYS NB_DAYS,T.A_NET ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
           T.A_PNL ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,T.A_PNL_PTF ACCRUED_FUND_CCY,
           'MF' DATA_SOURCE,REPADMIN.GET_EFRONT_DATE(T.C_FUND) EFRONT_DATE,
           NULL EFRONT_CLOSING_ID,NULL EFRONT_FUND_ID
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_NAV_ARC_RESULT  T,
         REPADMIN.MF_CHARGES   C,
         REPADMIN.NAV  N
    WHERE T.C_FUND           IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                                  FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                                  WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                                    AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                                    AND F.FLAG    = 1)
      AND T.D_NAV            >= p_Date_Nav_From --'01-jan-17'
      AND T.D_NAV            <= p_Date_Nav_To --'31-dec-18'
      AND T.C_OPE_TRANS      = '960'
      AND T.C_OPE_TRANS_FEES = C.COPER
      AND T.C_N_FEE          = C.NOFRAIS
      AND T.C_FUND           = N.NAV_FUND_NO
      AND T.D_NAV            = N.NAV_DATE_NAV
      AND T.D_PREV_NAV_DATE  IS NOT NULL -- CRQ61596
      AND T.D_NEXT_NAV_DATE  IS NOT NULL -- CRQ61596
    UNION
    SELECT C.FA_NUM FUND_NUMBER,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY, 1 NAV_TYPE,C.DATE_NAV,C.DATE_CALCUL,
           C.DATE_NAV DATE_PUB,C.DATE_NAV DATE_SITUATION,
           NULL OPE_CODE,NULL FEES_CODE,TRIM(T.FEE_TYPE) FEES_DESCRIPTION,NULL GROUPE_MC,
           ROUND(T.BASE_AMOUNT,2) BASED_AMOUNT,
           DECODE(T.BASE_RATE,NULL,NULL,T.BASE_RATE * 100) PERCENTAGE,
           C.DATE_BEGIN VALUE_DATE,
           C.DATE_END MATURITY_DATE,T.NB_DAYS,
           ROUND(T.FEE_AMOUNT,2) ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
           ROUND(T.ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,2) ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,
           ROUND(T.ACCRUED_TO_DATE_FUND_CCY,2) ACCRUED_FUND_CCY,
           'EF' DATA_SOURCE,REPADMIN.GET_EFRONT_DATE(C.FA_NUM) EFRONT_DATE,
           T.CLOSING_ID EFRONT_CLOSING_ID,T.FUND_ID EFRONT_FUND_ID
    FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_ACCR_EXPENSES T,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C,
         REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS TF
    WHERE C.FA_NUM       IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                                FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                                WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                                  AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                                  AND F.FLAG    = 1)
      AND C.DATE_NAV     >= p_Date_Nav_From --'30-JUN-18'
      AND C.DATE_NAV     <= p_Date_Nav_To --'30-JUN-18'
      AND C.FA_NUM       = TF.FA_NUM
      AND C.CLOSING_ID   = T.CLOSING_ID
    ORDER BY 1,5,9,10;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Accrued_Expenses';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_ACCRUED_EXP T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

IF p_Period_Type IN ('LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY', 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV') THEN

     FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM,REPADMIN.GET_EFRONT_DATE(F.FA_NUM) EFRONT_DATE
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                        WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                          AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

        IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 1,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
        -- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
        ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
        END IF;

        -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
        FOR X IN CR_MAIN(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To) LOOP

            IF (X.DATA_SOURCE = 'MF' AND (X.EFRONT_DATE IS NULL OR X.DATE_NAV < X.EFRONT_DATE)) OR
               (X.DATA_SOURCE = 'EF' AND (X.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND X.DATE_NAV >= X.EFRONT_DATE)) THEN

                -- RÃ©cup du code fee
                r_tr.fees_code := X.FEES_CODE;
                IF X.DATA_SOURCE = 'EF' AND (X.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND X.DATE_NAV >= X.EFRONT_DATE) THEN
                   FOR Y IN ( SELECT T.FEE_CODE
                              FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_FEES T
                              WHERE T.CLOSING  = X.EFRONT_CLOSING_ID
                                AND T.FEE_TYPE = X.FEES_DESCRIPTION ) LOOP

                       r_tr.fees_code := Y.FEE_CODE;
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;

                   IF r_tr.fees_code IS NULL THEN
                       FOR Y IN ( SELECT T.FEE_CODE
                                  FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_FEES_SETUP T
                                  WHERE T.FUND_ID  = X.EFRONT_FUND_ID
                                    AND T.FEE_TYPE = X.FEES_DESCRIPTION ) LOOP

                           r_tr.fees_code := Y.FEE_CODE;
                           EXIT;
                       END LOOP;

                   END IF;

                   IF r_tr.fees_code IS NULL THEN
                      r_tr.fees_code := X.FEES_DESCRIPTION;
                   END IF;
                END IF;

                INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_ACCRUED_EXP
                  (fund_number,
                   fund_name,
                   fund_ccy,
                   nav_type,
                   date_nav,
                   date_calcul,
                   date_pub,
                   date_situation,
                   ope_code,
                   fees_code,
                   fees_description,
                   groupe_mc,
                   based_amount,
                   percentage,
                   value_date,
                   maturity_date,
                   nb_days,
                   accrued_amount,
                   accrual_adj_fund_ccy,
                   accrued_fund_ccy,
                   user_id,
                   date_creation)
                VALUES
                  (X.FUND_NUMBER,
                   X.FUND_NAME,
                   X.FUND_CCY,
                   X.NAV_TYPE,
                   X.DATE_NAV,
                   X.DATE_CALCUL,
                   X.DATE_PUB,
                   X.DATE_SITUATION,
                   X.OPE_CODE,
                   r_tr.fees_code,
                   X.FEES_DESCRIPTION,
                   X.GROUPE_MC,
                   X.BASED_AMOUNT,
                   X.PERCENTAGE,
                   X.VALUE_DATE,
                   X.MATURITY_DATE,
                   X.NB_DAYS,
                   X.ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
                   X.ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,
                   X.ACCRUED_FUND_CCY,
                   p_User_Id,
                   SYSDATE);

            END IF;
        END LOOP;


   END LOOP; -- Fin parcours fonds

   ELSE

    -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
    FOR X IN CR_MAIN(NULL,v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

        IF (X.DATA_SOURCE = 'MF' AND (X.EFRONT_DATE IS NULL OR X.DATE_NAV < X.EFRONT_DATE)) OR
           (X.DATA_SOURCE = 'EF' AND (X.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND X.DATE_NAV >= X.EFRONT_DATE)) THEN

            -- RÃ©cup du code fee
            r_tr.fees_code := X.FEES_CODE;
            IF X.DATA_SOURCE = 'EF' AND (X.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND X.DATE_NAV >= X.EFRONT_DATE) THEN
               FOR Y IN ( SELECT T.FEE_CODE
                          FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_FEES T
                          WHERE T.CLOSING  = X.EFRONT_CLOSING_ID
                            AND T.FEE_TYPE = X.FEES_DESCRIPTION ) LOOP

                   r_tr.fees_code := Y.FEE_CODE;
                   EXIT;
               END LOOP;

               IF r_tr.fees_code IS NULL THEN
                   FOR Y IN ( SELECT T.FEE_CODE
                              FROM EFRONT.ORIG_EF_FEES_SETUP T
                              WHERE T.FUND_ID  = X.EFRONT_FUND_ID
                                AND T.FEE_TYPE = X.FEES_DESCRIPTION ) LOOP

                       r_tr.fees_code := Y.FEE_CODE;
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;

               END IF;

               IF r_tr.fees_code IS NULL THEN
                  r_tr.fees_code := X.FEES_DESCRIPTION;
               END IF;
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_ACCRUED_EXP
              (fund_number,
               fund_name,
               fund_ccy,
               nav_type,
               date_nav,
               date_calcul,
               date_pub,
               date_situation,
               ope_code,
               fees_code,
               fees_description,
               groupe_mc,
               based_amount,
               percentage,
               value_date,
               maturity_date,
               nb_days,
               accrued_amount,
               accrual_adj_fund_ccy,
               accrued_fund_ccy,
               user_id,
               date_creation)
            VALUES
              (X.FUND_NUMBER,
               X.FUND_NAME,
               X.FUND_CCY,
               X.NAV_TYPE,
               X.DATE_NAV,
               X.DATE_CALCUL,
               X.DATE_PUB,
               X.DATE_SITUATION,
               X.OPE_CODE,
               r_tr.fees_code,
               X.FEES_DESCRIPTION,
               X.GROUPE_MC,
               X.BASED_AMOUNT,
               X.PERCENTAGE,
               X.VALUE_DATE,
               X.MATURITY_DATE,
               X.NB_DAYS,
               X.ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
               X.ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,
               X.ACCRUED_FUND_CCY,
               p_User_Id,
               SYSDATE);

        END IF;
    END LOOP;
END IF;
COMMIT;


    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Accrued_Expenses',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Accrued_Expenses;


PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Accrued_Expenses_v1( p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                                     p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                                     p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                     p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                                     p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                                     p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');

v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;

v_Date_Nav_From_MF      DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To_MF        DATE;
v_Date_Nav_From_EF      DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To_EF        DATE;

v_Lot_From              NUMBER;
v_Lot_To                NUMBER;

r_tr                    WRK_QUERIES_BCR_MVTS%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN_OLD ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
           DECODE(T.C_NAV_TYP,'O',1,2)   NAV_TYPE,
           T.D_NAV DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.D_H_PROCESSING) DATE_CALCUL ,
           N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION DATE_PUB,
           N.NAV_DATE_TRT_FIN DATE_SITUATION,
           T.C_OPE_TRANS_FEES OPE_CODE,T.C_N_FEE FEES_CODE,
           C.XLIBELLE FEES_DESCRIPTION , C.CODE_GRP_MULTICLASS GROUPE_MC,
           T.A_MARGIN BASED_AMOUNT,T.R_INTEREST PERCENTAGE,
           T.D_PREV_NAV_DATE VALUE_DATE,T.D_NEXT_NAV_DATE MATURITY_DATE,
           T.N_ACCRUED_DAYS NB_DAYS,T.A_NET ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
           T.A_PNL ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,T.A_PNL_PTF ACCRUED_FUND_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_NAV_ARC_RESULT  T,
         REPADMIN.MF_CHARGES   C,
         REPADMIN.NAV  N
    WHERE T.C_FUND           IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                                  FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                                  WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                                    AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                                    AND F.FLAG    = 1)
      AND T.D_NAV            BETWEEN p_Date_Nav_From AND p_Date_Nav_To
      AND T.C_OPE_TRANS      = '960'
      AND T.C_OPE_TRANS_FEES = C.COPER
      AND T.C_N_FEE          = C.NOFRAIS
      AND T.C_FUND           = N.NAV_FUND_NO
      AND T.D_NAV            = N.NAV_DATE_NAV
      AND T.D_PREV_NAV_DATE  IS NOT NULL -- CRQ61596
      AND T.D_NEXT_NAV_DATE  IS NOT NULL -- CRQ61596
    ORDER BY T.C_FUND,T.D_NAV,T.C_OPE_TRANS_FEES;


  CURSOR CR_MAIN_EF ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                      p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                      p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS

      SELECT C.FA_NUM FUND_NUMBER,C.FUND_NAME,C.FUND_CCY, 1 NAV_TYPE,C.DATE_NAV,C.DATE_CALCUL,
             C.DATE_NAV DATE_PUB,C.DATE_NAV DATE_SITUATION,
             NULL OPE_CODE,S.FEE_CODE FEES_CODE,S.FEE_TYPE FEES_DESCRIPTION,NULL GROUPE_MC,
             ROUND(T.BASE_AMOUNT,2) BASED_AMOUNT,
             T.BASE_RATE PERCENTAGE,TRUNC(T.PERIOD_DATE_FROM) VALUE_DATE,
             TRUNC(T.PERIOD_DATE_TO) MATURITY_DATE,T.NB_DAYS,
             ROUND(T.FEE_AMOUNT,2) ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
             ROUND(T.ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,2) ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,
             ROUND(T.ACCRUED_TO_DATE_FUND_CCY,2) ACCRUED_FUND_CCY
      FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_ACCR_EXPENSES T,
           EFRONT.ORIG_EF_FEES_SETUP S,
           EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
      WHERE C.FA_NUM       IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                                FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                                WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                                  AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                                  AND F.FLAG    = 1)
        AND C.DATE_NAV     >= p_Date_Nav_From --'30-JUN-18'
        AND C.DATE_NAV     <= p_Date_Nav_To --'30-JUN-18'
        AND C.CLOSING_ID   = T.CLOSING_ID
        AND T.FEE_SETUP_ID = S.FEE_SETUP_ID;


CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
           DECODE(T.C_NAV_TYP,'O',1,2)   NAV_TYPE,
           T.D_NAV DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.D_H_PROCESSING) DATE_CALCUL ,
           N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION DATE_PUB,
           N.NAV_DATE_TRT_FIN DATE_SITUATION,
           T.C_OPE_TRANS_FEES OPE_CODE,TO_CHAR(T.C_N_FEE) FEES_CODE,
           C.XLIBELLE FEES_DESCRIPTION , C.CODE_GRP_MULTICLASS GROUPE_MC,
           T.A_MARGIN BASED_AMOUNT,T.R_INTEREST PERCENTAGE,
           T.D_PREV_NAV_DATE VALUE_DATE,T.D_NEXT_NAV_DATE MATURITY_DATE,
           T.N_ACCRUED_DAYS NB_DAYS,T.A_NET ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
           T.A_PNL ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,T.A_PNL_PTF ACCRUED_FUND_CCY,
           'MF' SOUCRCE,REPADMIN.GET_EFRONT_DATE(T.C_FUND) EFRONT_DATE
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_NAV_ARC_RESULT  T,
         REPADMIN.MF_CHARGES   C,
         REPADMIN.NAV  N
    WHERE T.C_FUND           IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                                  FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                                  WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                                    AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                                    AND F.FLAG    = 1)
      AND T.D_NAV            >= p_Date_Nav_From --'01-jan-17'
      AND T.D_NAV            <= p_Date_Nav_To --'31-dec-18'
      AND T.C_OPE_TRANS      = '960'
      AND T.C_OPE_TRANS_FEES = C.COPER
      AND T.C_N_FEE          = C.NOFRAIS
      AND T.C_FUND           = N.NAV_FUND_NO
      AND T.D_NAV            = N.NAV_DATE_NAV
      AND T.D_PREV_NAV_DATE  IS NOT NULL -- CRQ61596
      AND T.D_NEXT_NAV_DATE  IS NOT NULL -- CRQ61596

    UNION

    SELECT C.FA_NUM FUND_NUMBER,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY, 1 NAV_TYPE,C.DATE_NAV,C.DATE_CALCUL,
           C.DATE_NAV DATE_PUB,C.DATE_NAV DATE_SITUATION,
           NULL OPE_CODE,S.FEE_CODE FEES_CODE,S.FEE_TYPE FEES_DESCRIPTION,NULL GROUPE_MC,
           ROUND(T.BASE_AMOUNT,2) BASED_AMOUNT,
           T.BASE_RATE PERCENTAGE,TRUNC(T.PERIOD_DATE_FROM) VALUE_DATE,
           TRUNC(T.PERIOD_DATE_TO) MATURITY_DATE,T.NB_DAYS,
           ROUND(T.FEE_AMOUNT,2) ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
           ROUND(T.ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,2) ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,
           ROUND(T.ACCRUED_TO_DATE_FUND_CCY,2) ACCRUED_FUND_CCY,
           'EF' SOUCRCE,REPADMIN.GET_EFRONT_DATE(C.FA_NUM) EFRONT_DATE
    FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_ACCR_EXPENSES T,
         EFRONT.ORIG_EF_FEES_SETUP S,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C,
         REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS TF
    WHERE C.FA_NUM       IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                                FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                                WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                                  AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(NULL,F.FA_NUM)
                                  AND F.FLAG    = 1)
      AND C.DATE_NAV     >= p_Date_Nav_From --'30-JUN-18'
      AND C.DATE_NAV     <= p_Date_Nav_To --'30-JUN-18'
      AND C.FA_NUM       = TF.FA_NUM
      AND C.CLOSING_ID   = T.CLOSING_ID
      AND T.FEE_SETUP_ID = S.FEE_SETUP_ID
    ORDER BY 1,5,9,10;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_ACCRUED_EXP T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;


IF p_Period_Type IN ('LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY', 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV') THEN

     FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM,REPADMIN.GET_EFRONT_DATE(F.FA_NUM) EFRONT_DATE
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                        WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                          AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

        IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 1,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
        -- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
        ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
        END IF;

        CASE
           -- Tout dans Multifonds
           WHEN VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE IS NULL THEN

               v_Date_Nav_From_MF := v_Date_Nav_From;
               v_Date_Nav_To_MF   := v_Date_Nav_To;

               v_Date_Nav_From_EF := NULL;
               v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := NULL;

           -- Tout dans eFront
           WHEN VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE <= v_Date_Nav_From THEN
               v_Date_Nav_From_MF := NULL;
               v_Date_Nav_To_MF   := NULL;

               v_Date_Nav_From_EF := v_Date_Nav_From;
               v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := v_Date_Nav_To;

           -- Une partie dans Multifonds et une partie dans eFront
           WHEN VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE <= v_Date_Nav_To THEN

               v_Date_Nav_From_MF := v_Date_Nav_From;
               v_Date_Nav_To_MF   := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE-1,-1);

               v_Date_Nav_From_EF := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE;
               v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := v_Date_Nav_To;

           -- Pour Ã©viter bug
           ELSE
               v_Date_Nav_From_MF := NULL;
               v_Date_Nav_To_MF   := NULL;

               v_Date_Nav_From_EF := NULL;
               v_Date_Nav_To_EF   := NULL;
        END CASE;

        -- Insertion des donnÃ©es Multifonds
        IF v_Date_Nav_From_MF IS NOT NULL AND v_Date_Nav_To_MF IS NOT NULL THEN

            FOR X IN CR_MAIN(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From_MF,v_Date_Nav_To_MF) LOOP

                INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_ACCRUED_EXP
                  (fund_number,
                   fund_name,
                   fund_ccy,
                   nav_type,
                   date_nav,
                   date_calcul,
                   date_pub,
                   date_situation,
                   ope_code,
                   fees_code,
                   fees_description,
                   groupe_mc,
                   based_amount,
                   percentage,
                   value_date,
                   maturity_date,
                   nb_days,
                   accrued_amount,
                   accrual_adj_fund_ccy,
                   accrued_fund_ccy,
                   user_id,
                   date_creation)
                VALUES
                  (X.FUND_NUMBER,
                   X.FUND_NAME,
                   X.FUND_CCY,
                   X.NAV_TYPE,
                   X.DATE_NAV,
                   X.DATE_CALCUL,
                   X.DATE_PUB,
                   X.DATE_SITUATION,
                   X.OPE_CODE,
                   X.FEES_CODE,
                   X.FEES_DESCRIPTION,
                   X.GROUPE_MC,
                   X.BASED_AMOUNT,
                   X.PERCENTAGE,
                   X.VALUE_DATE,
                   X.MATURITY_DATE,
                   X.NB_DAYS,
                   X.ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
                   X.ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,
                   X.ACCRUED_FUND_CCY,
                   p_User_Id,
                   SYSDATE);
            END LOOP;
        END IF;

        -- Insertion des donnÃ©es eFront
        IF v_Date_Nav_From_EF IS NOT NULL AND v_Date_Nav_To_EF IS NOT NULL THEN

            FOR X IN CR_MAIN_EF(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From_EF,v_Date_Nav_To_EF) LOOP

                INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_ACCRUED_EXP
                  (fund_number,
                   fund_name,

                   accrued_fund_ccy,
                   user_id,
                   date_creation)
                VALUES
                  (X.FUND_NUMBER,
                   X.FUND_NAME,
                   X.FUND_CCY,
                   X.NAV_TYPE,
                   X.DATE_NAV,
                   X.DATE_CALCUL,
                   X.DATE_PUB,
                   X.DATE_SITUATION,
                   X.OPE_CODE,
                   X.FEES_CODE,
                   X.FEES_DESCRIPTION,
                   X.GROUPE_MC,
                   X.BASED_AMOUNT,
                   X.PERCENTAGE,
                   X.VALUE_DATE,
                   X.MATURITY_DATE,
                   X.NB_DAYS,
                   X.ACCRUED_AMOUNT,
                   X.ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,
                   X.ACCRUED_FUND_CCY,
                   p_User_Id,
                   SYSDATE);
            END LOOP;
        END IF;
   END LOOP; -- Fin parcours fonds

   ELSE

    -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
    FOR X IN CR_MAIN(NULL,v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

        INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_ACCRUED_EXP
          (fund_number,
           fund_name,
           fund_ccy,
           nav_type,
           date_nav,
           date_calcul,
           date_pub,
           date_situation,
           ope_code,
           fees_code,

           maturity_date,
           nb_days,
           accrued_amount,
           accrual_adj_fund_ccy,
           accrued_fund_ccy,
           user_id,
           date_creation)
        VALUES
          (X.FUND_NUMBER,
           X.FUND_NAME,
           X.FUND_CCY,
           X.NAV_TYPE,
           X.DATE_NAV,
           X.DATE_CALCUL,
           X.DATE_PUB,
           X.DATE_SITUATION,
           X.OPE_CODE,
           X.FEES_CODE,
           X.FEES_DESCRIPTION,
           X.GROUPE_MC,
           X.BASED_AMOUNT,
           X.PERCENTAGE,
           X.VALUE_DATE,
           X.MATURITY_DATE,

           X.ACCRUAL_ADJ_FUND_CCY,
           X.ACCRUED_FUND_CCY,
           p_User_Id,
           SYSDATE);
    END LOOP;
END IF;
COMMIT;


    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then

          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
