END proc_Bcr_Accrued_Expenses_v1;

--------------------------------------
-- Query Variation du PNL par parts --
--------------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Pnl_Delta( p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                              p_Compte_From  IN NUMBER,
                              p_Compte_To    IN NUMBER,
                              p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                              p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;

r_tr                    WRK_QUERIES_BCR_MVTS%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE) PART,
           TF.PART_CCY,TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,
           T.D_NAV DATE_NAV, TRUNC(T.D_H_PROCESSED) DATE_CALCUL,
           T.C_N_ACC ACCOUNT_NUMBER, REPADMIN.GET_LIB_CPT_BILAN(T.C_N_ACC,'20') ACCOUNT_NAME,
           T.C_ACC_GRP ACCOUNT_GROUP,T.A_VARIATION,T.C_NAV_TYP NAV_TYPE,
           REPADMIN.GET_RATIO_ALLOCATION(T.C_FUND,T.C_SHARE,T.D_NAV) RATIO_ALLOCATION
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_NAV_ARC_PNL_DELTA  T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE T.C_FUND  IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                         FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                         WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                           AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                           AND F.FLAG    = 1)
      AND T.D_NAV   >= p_Date_Nav_From
      AND T.D_NAV   <= p_Date_Nav_To
      AND T.C_N_ACC >= p_Compte_From
      AND T.C_N_ACC <= p_Compte_To
      AND T.C_FUND  = TF.FA_NUM
      AND T.C_SHARE = TF.PART_FA_CODE
      AND b.fund_no = t.c_fund
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.c_nav_typ = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                      -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial) 
    ORDER BY T.C_FUND,T.D_NAV,T.C_SHARE,T.C_N_ACC;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Pnl_Delta';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_PNL_DELTA T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
IF p_Period_Type IN ('LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY', 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV') THEN

     FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                        WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                          AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

        IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 1,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
        ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
        END IF;

        -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
        FOR X IN CR_MAIN(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To) LOOP

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_PNL_DELTA
              (fund_number,
               fund_name,
               fund_ccy,
               part,
               part_ccy,
               code_isin,
               code_interne_fa,
               date_nav,
               date_calcul,
               account_number,
               account_name,
               account_group,
               pnl_amount,
               ratio_allocation,
               nav_type,
               user_id,
               date_creation)
            VALUES
              (X.FUND_NUMBER,
               X.FUND_NAME,
               X.FUND_CCY,
               X.PART,
               X.PART_CCY,
               X.ISIN_CODE,
               X.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,
               X.DATE_NAV,
               X.DATE_CALCUL,
               X.ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
               X.ACCOUNT_NAME,
               X.ACCOUNT_GROUP,
               X.A_VARIATION,
               X.RATIO_ALLOCATION,
               X.NAV_TYPE,
               p_User_Id,
               SYSDATE);

        END LOOP;
      END LOOP;

      ELSE

      FOR X IN CR_MAIN(NULL,v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

          INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_PNL_DELTA
            (fund_number,
             fund_name,
             fund_ccy,
             part,
             part_ccy,
             code_isin,
             code_interne_fa,
             date_nav,
             date_calcul,
             account_number,
             account_name,
             account_group,
             pnl_amount,
             ratio_allocation,
             nav_type,
             user_id,
             date_creation)
          VALUES
            (X.FUND_NUMBER,
             X.FUND_NAME,
             X.FUND_CCY,
             X.PART,
             X.PART_CCY,
             X.ISIN_CODE,
             X.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,
             X.DATE_NAV,
             X.DATE_CALCUL,
             X.ACCOUNT_NUMBER,
             X.ACCOUNT_NAME,
             X.ACCOUNT_GROUP,
             X.A_VARIATION,
             X.RATIO_ALLOCATION,
             X.NAV_TYPE,
             p_User_Id,
             SYSDATE);

      END LOOP;

END IF;


COMMIT;


    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Pnl_Delta',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Pnl_Delta;

----------------------------
-- Query 'Cash + Deposit' --
----------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Cash_Deposit( p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                                 p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                                 p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                 p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                                 p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                                 p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;


r_tr                    WRK_QUERIES_BCR_CASH_DEPOSIT %ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT T.C_FUND FONDS_NUM_FA,
               REPADMIN.get_fund_name_tb_fds(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
               REPADMIN.get_fund_ccy_tb_fds(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
               T.D_NAV,REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(T.C_FUND,T.D_NAV) DATE_CALCUL,
               REPADMIN.GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(T.C_FUND,T.D_NAV) DATE_PUB,
               T.C_N_ACC COMPTE,T.L_DETAIL LIBELLE,
               T.C_INVEST_CCY CCY , T.N_CONTRACT CONTRAT, T.D_LAST_COUPON LAST_COUPON,
               T.N_ACCRUED_DAYS ACCRUED_DAYS,T.A_MARKET_VALUE AMOUNT,
               T.A_MARKET_VALUE_PTF AMOUNT_PTF,T.R_INTEREST INTEREST_RATE,
               NVL(T.A_ACCRUED_INTEREST,0) ACCRUED_INTEREST,
               NVL(T.A_ACCRUED_INTEREST_PTF,0) ACCRUED_INTEREST_PTF
        FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL  T
       INNER JOIN repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
               ON b.fund_no = t.c_fund
        WHERE T.C_FUND    IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                               FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                               WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                                 AND F.FA_NUM = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                                 AND F.FLAG    = 1)
        AND T.D_NAV       >= p_Date_Nav_From --'30-SEP-12'
        AND T.D_NAV       <= p_Date_Nav_To --'30-SEP-12'
        AND T.C_N_ACC     IN (15000,15100,15110)
        AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.c_nav_typ = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
             OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                      -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
        ORDER BY 2,3,T.C_N_ACC,T.C_INVEST_CCY;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Cash_Deposit';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_CASH_DEPOSIT T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
IF p_Period_Type IN ('LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY', 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV') THEN

     FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                        WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                          AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

        IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 1,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
        ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
        END IF;

        -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
        FOR X IN CR_MAIN(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To) LOOP

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_CASH_DEPOSIT
              (fund_number,
               fund_name,
               fund_ccy,
               date_nav,
               date_calcul,
               date_pub,
               account_number,
               account_name,
               account_ccy,
               contract_number,
               last_coupon,
               accrued_days,
               amount_ccy,
               amount_ptf,
               interest_rate,
               accrued_interest,
               accrued_interest_ptf,
               user_id,
               date_creation)
            values
              (X.FONDS_NUM_FA,
               X.FUND_NAME,
               X.FUND_CCY,
               X.D_NAV,
               X.DATE_CALCUL,
               X.DATE_PUB,
               X.COMPTE,
               X.LIBELLE,
               X.CCY,
               X.CONTRAT,
               X.LAST_COUPON,
               X.ACCRUED_DAYS,
               X.AMOUNT,
               X.AMOUNT_PTF,
               X.INTEREST_RATE,
               X.ACCRUED_INTEREST,
               X.ACCRUED_INTEREST_PTF,
               p_User_Id,
               SYSDATE);
        END LOOP;
      END LOOP;

    ELSE

    FOR X IN CR_MAIN(NULL,v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

        INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_CASH_DEPOSIT
          (fund_number,
           fund_name,
           fund_ccy,
           date_nav,
           date_calcul,
           date_pub,
           account_number,
           account_name,
           account_ccy,
           contract_number,
           last_coupon,
           accrued_days,
           amount_ccy,
           amount_ptf,
           interest_rate,
           accrued_interest,
           accrued_interest_ptf,
           user_id,
           date_creation)
        values
          (X.FONDS_NUM_FA,
           X.FUND_NAME,
           X.FUND_CCY,
           X.D_NAV,
           X.DATE_CALCUL,
           X.DATE_PUB,
           X.COMPTE,
           X.LIBELLE,
           X.CCY,
           X.CONTRAT,
           X.LAST_COUPON,
           X.ACCRUED_DAYS,
           X.AMOUNT,
           X.AMOUNT_PTF,
           X.INTEREST_RATE,
           X.ACCRUED_INTEREST,
           X.ACCRUED_INTEREST_PTF,
           p_User_Id,
           SYSDATE);

    END LOOP;
END IF;
COMMIT;


    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Cash_Deposit',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Cash_Deposit;

---------------------
-- Query 'Ptf Nav' --
---------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Ptf_Nav( p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                            p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                            p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                            p_Account_From IN NUMBER DEFAULT 0,
                            p_Account_To   IN NUMBER DEFAULT 999999,
                            p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                            p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                            p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;


r_tr                    WRK_QUERIES_BCR_PTF_NAV%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.*
        FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL  T
       INNER JOIN repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
          ON      b.fund_no = t.c_fund
        WHERE T.C_FUND    =  p_Fund_Number
        AND T.D_NAV       >= p_Date_Nav_From --'30-SEP-12'
        AND T.D_NAV       <= p_Date_Nav_To --'30-SEP-12'
        AND T.C_N_ACC     >= p_Account_From
        AND T.C_N_ACC     <= p_Account_To
        AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.c_nav_typ = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
             OR (b.nav_backdated = 1));                     -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Ptf_Nav';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_PTF_NAV T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
r_tr.user_id       := p_User_Id;
r_tr.date_creation := SYSDATE;

FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                        WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                          AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

    v_Date_Nav_From := v_Date_From;
    v_Date_Nav_To   := v_Date_To;

    IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
        get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 1,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                     v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
    ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);

    END IF;

    -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
    FOR X IN CR_MAIN(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To) LOOP

        r_tr.c_isin_code := NULL;
        IF NVL(X.C_N_ID,0) <> 0 THEN
           r_tr.c_isin_code := GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC(X.C_N_ID,X.C_SRV);
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_BCR_PTF_NAV
          (n_lot,
           c_fund,
           d_nav,
           a_accrued_interest,
           a_accrued_interest_ptf,
           a_cost_valuated_ptf,
           a_cost_value,
           a_cost_value_ptf,
           a_global_cost_portfolio,
           a_interest_cur_period,
           a_interest_cur_period_ptf,
           a_market_value,
           a_market_value_bid,
           a_market_value_offer,
           a_market_value_ptf,
           a_market_value_ptf_bid,
           a_market_value_ptf_offer,
           a_nav_net,
           a_payed_off,
           a_pnl,
           a_pnl_exchange,
           a_pnl_market,
           a_realized_pnl,
           a_realized_pnl_exchange,
           a_realized_pnl_market,
           a_recoverable_tax,
           a_rpy_value_mat,
           a_rpy_value_mat_ptf,
           a_sec_control_portfolio,
           a_sum_pct_rec_tax,
           a_sum_pct_unrec_tax,
           a_unrecoverable_tax,
           a_yield,
           c_invest_ccy,
           c_invest_2_ccy,
           c_ptf_ccy,
           c_ccy_val_group,
           c_country,
           c_economic_sector,
           c_fund_umbrella,
           c_grouping_totals,
           c_income_typ,
           c_n_acc,
           c_n_acc_cor,
           c_n_deposit_counter_part,
           c_n_issuer_guarantee,
           c_n_ptf_manager,
           c_n_id,
           c_price_mode,
           c_sof_typ,
           c_srv,
           c_status,
           c_usance,
           c_val_grp,
           c_val_mdl,
           d_last_coupon,
           d_maturity,
           d_next_coupon,
           d_price,
           d_value,
           g_contract_size,
           g_sorting_key,
           l_detail,
           n_accrued_days,
           n_contract,
           n_days_for_yield,
           n_remaining_days_maturity,
           n_remaining_days_next_coupon,
           n_stale_days,
           n_suff,
           p_cost_price,
           p_val_price,
           p_val_price_bid,
           p_val_price_offer,
           q_qty,
           r_historical_rate,
           r_interest,
           y_interest_adj,
           r_pik_factor,
           a_interest,
           a_interest_ptf,
           a_adjust_pik_interest,
           a_adjust_pik_interest_ptf,
           g_actuarial_yield,
           g_yield_to_maturity,

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Ptf_Nav',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Ptf_Nav;

---------------------
-- Query 'Ptf Nav' --
---------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Short_Long_Position(  p_Date_From    IN VARCHAR2,
                                         p_Date_To      IN VARCHAR2,
                                         p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                         p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                                         p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                                         p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;


r_Dat                   WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SH_LG_DATA%ROWTYPE;
r_Rep                   WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SH_LG_REPORT%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_Nav_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.NAV_FUND_NO FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.NAV_FUND_NO) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.NAV_FUND_NO) FUND_CCY,T.NAV_DATE_NAV,
           TRUNC(T.NAV_DATE_TRT) DATE_CALCUL,T.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_TYPE(T.NAV_FUND_NO,T.NAV_DATE_NAV) FUND_TYPE,
           P.FPR_C_FUND_P POOL_NUMBER,P.FPR_C_INVEST_CCY POOL_CCY,
           NVL(P.FPR_CHANGE,1) EXCHANGE_RATE,
           ROUND(REPADMIN.GET_DET_TX_DET_BY_DATE(T.NAV_FUND_NO,P.FPR_C_FUND_P,T.NAV_DATE_NAV,
              REPADMIN.GET_FUND_TYPE(T.NAV_FUND_NO,T.NAV_DATE_NAV),1,1),6) DETENTION_RATE
        FROM REPADMIN.NAV T,
             FUND_POOL_REPARTITION P,
             repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
        WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO  =  p_Fund_Number --'280030'
          AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV >= p_Date_Nav_From --'01-MAR-14'
          AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV <= p_Date_Nav_To --'31-MAR-14'
          AND T.NAV_FUND_NO  = P.FPR_C_FUND(+)
          AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV = P.FPR_D_NAV(+)
          AND b.fund_no = t.NAV_FUND_NO
          AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.nav_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
               OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                        -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial) 

        ORDER BY T.NAV_DATE_NAV,P.FPR_C_FUND_P ;

CURSOR CR_SHORT_POSITION ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                           p_Date_Nav    IN DATE) IS

    SELECT SUM(T.MKT_VALUE_FA_PTF) MKT_VALUE
        FROM REPADMIN.CFA_RECON_SFI_FA  T
        WHERE T.FUND             = p_Fund_Number
          AND T.DATE_NAV         = p_Date_Nav
          AND T.TK               IS NOT NULL
          AND T.MKT_VALUE_FA_PTF < 0;

CURSOR CR_LONG_POSITION ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                          p_Date_Nav    IN DATE) IS

    SELECT SUM(T.MKT_VALUE_FA_PTF) MKT_VALUE
        FROM REPADMIN.CFA_RECON_SFI_FA  T
        WHERE T.FUND             = p_Fund_Number
          AND T.DATE_NAV         = p_Date_Nav
          AND T.TK               IS NOT NULL
          AND T.MKT_VALUE_FA_PTF > 0;

CURSOR CR_NETTING_FUTUR_POSITION ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_Date_Nav    IN DATE) IS

    SELECT SUM(T.MKT_VALUE_FA_PTF) MKT_VALUE
        FROM REPADMIN.CFA_RECON_SFI_FA  T
        WHERE T.FUND             = p_Fund_Number
          AND T.DATE_NAV         = p_Date_Nav
          AND T.TK               IS NOT NULL
          AND T.TYPE             = 'F';

CURSOR CR_REPORT IS
    SELECT T.FUND_NUMBER,T.FUND_NAME,T.FUND_CCY,
           T.DATE_NAV,T.DATE_CALCUL,T.DATE_PUB,
           SUM(T.LONG_POS_PTF_CONSO) LONG_POS_PTF,
           SUM(T.SHORT_POS_PTF_CONSO) SHORT_POS_PTF,
           SUM(T.NETTING_FUTUR_POS_PTF_CONSO) NETTING_FUTUR_POS_PTF
    FROM WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SH_LG_DATA T
    WHERE T.USER_ID = p_User_Id
    GROUP BY T.FUND_NUMBER,T.FUND_NAME,T.FUND_CCY,
           T.DATE_NAV,T.DATE_CALCUL,T.DATE_PUB
    ORDER BY T.DATE_NAV;



Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Short_Long_Position';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SH_LG_REPORT T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SH_LG_DATA T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
r_Dat.user_id       := p_User_Id;
r_Dat.date_creation := SYSDATE;

FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                   FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                   WHERE F.USER_ID   = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                     AND F.FA_NUM    = NVL(F.FA_REF_NUM,F.FA_NUM)
                     AND F.FUND_TYPE IN (1,2,4)
                     AND F.FLAG      = 1) LOOP

    v_Date_Nav_From := v_Date_From;
    v_Date_Nav_To   := v_Date_To;

    IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
        get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 1,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                     v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
    ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);

    END IF;

    -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
    FOR X IN CR_MAIN(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To) LOOP

        r_Dat.fund_number    := X.FUND_NUMBER;
        r_Dat.fund_name      := X.FUND_NAME;
        r_Dat.fund_ccy       := X.FUND_CCY;
        r_Dat.date_nav       := X.NAV_DATE_NAV;
        r_Dat.date_calcul    := X.DATE_CALCUL;
        r_Dat.date_pub       := X.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION;
        r_Dat.Fund_Type      := X.FUND_TYPE;
        r_Dat.Pool_Number    := X.POOL_NUMBER;
        r_Dat.Detention_Rate := X.DETENTION_RATE;
        r_Dat.Exchange_Rate  := X.EXCHANGE_RATE;

        -- RÃ©cup de la position long
        r_Dat.long_pos_ptf := 0;
        FOR VCR_LONG IN CR_LONG_POSITION (NVL(X.POOL_NUMBER,X.FUND_NUMBER),r_Dat.date_nav) LOOP
            r_Dat.long_pos_ptf := NVL(VCR_LONG.MKT_VALUE,0);
            EXIT;
        END LOOP;

        -- RÃ©cup de la position short
        r_Dat.short_pos_ptf := 0;
        FOR VCR_SHORT IN CR_SHORT_POSITION (NVL(X.POOL_NUMBER,X.FUND_NUMBER),r_Dat.date_nav) LOOP
            r_Dat.short_pos_ptf := NVL(VCR_SHORT.MKT_VALUE,0);
            EXIT;
        END LOOP;

        -- RÃ©cup du netting (short/long) des futurs et CFD
        r_Dat.netting_futur_pos_ptf := 0;
        FOR VCR_NETTING IN CR_NETTING_FUTUR_POSITION (NVL(X.POOL_NUMBER,X.FUND_NUMBER),r_Dat.date_nav) LOOP
            r_Dat.netting_futur_pos_ptf := NVL(VCR_NETTING.MKT_VALUE,0);
            EXIT;
        END LOOP;

        -- Convertion dans la devise du compartiment en fct du tx de dÃ©tention
        r_Dat.Long_Pos_Ptf_Conso := ROUND( r_Dat.long_pos_ptf * r_Dat.Detention_Rate / 100
                                           * r_Dat.Exchange_Rate,2);

        r_Dat.Short_Pos_Ptf_Conso := ROUND( r_Dat.short_pos_ptf * r_Dat.Detention_Rate / 100
                                            * r_Dat.Exchange_Rate,2);

        r_Dat.Netting_Futur_Pos_Ptf_Conso := ROUND( r_Dat.netting_futur_pos_ptf * r_Dat.Detention_Rate / 100
                                                    * r_Dat.Exchange_Rate,2);

        -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
        INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SH_LG_DATA
          (fund_number,
           fund_name,
           fund_ccy,
           date_nav,
           date_calcul,
           date_pub,
           fund_type,
           pool_number,
           long_pos_ptf,
           short_pos_ptf,
           netting_futur_pos_ptf,
           detention_rate,
           exchange_rate,
           long_pos_ptf_conso,
           short_pos_ptf_conso,
           netting_futur_pos_ptf_conso,
           user_id,
           date_creation)
         VALUES
          (r_Dat.fund_number,
           r_Dat.fund_name,
           r_Dat.fund_ccy,
           r_Dat.date_nav,
           r_Dat.date_calcul,
           r_Dat.date_pub,
           r_Dat.fund_type,
           r_Dat.pool_number,
           r_Dat.long_pos_ptf,
           r_Dat.short_pos_ptf,
           r_Dat.netting_futur_pos_ptf,
           r_Dat.detention_rate,
           r_Dat.exchange_rate,
           r_Dat.long_pos_ptf_conso,
           r_Dat.short_pos_ptf_conso,
           r_Dat.netting_futur_pos_ptf_conso,
           r_Dat.user_id,
           r_Dat.date_creation);

    END LOOP;
END LOOP;
COMMIT;

-- Report
r_Rep.user_id       := p_User_Id;
r_Rep.date_creation := r_Dat.date_creation;

FOR VCR_REPORT IN CR_REPORT LOOP

    r_Rep.Fund_Number           := VCR_REPORT.FUND_NUMBER;
    r_Rep.Fund_Name             := VCR_REPORT.FUND_NAME;
    r_Rep.Fund_Ccy              := VCR_REPORT.FUND_CCY;
    r_Rep.Date_Nav              := VCR_REPORT.DATE_NAV;
    r_Rep.Date_Calcul           := VCR_REPORT.DATE_CALCUL;
    r_Rep.Date_Pub              := VCR_REPORT.DATE_PUB;
    r_Rep.Long_Pos_Ptf          := ROUND(VCR_REPORT.LONG_POS_PTF,2);
    r_Rep.Short_Pos_Ptf         := ROUND(VCR_REPORT.SHORT_POS_PTF,2);
    r_Rep.Netting_Futur_Pos_Ptf := ROUND(VCR_REPORT.NETTING_FUTUR_POS_PTF,2);

    INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_BCR_SH_LG_REPORT
      (fund_number,
       fund_name,
       fund_ccy,
       date_nav,
       date_calcul,
       date_pub,
       long_pos_ptf,
       short_pos_ptf,
       netting_futur_pos_ptf,
       user_id,
       date_creation)
    VALUES
      (r_Rep.fund_number,
       r_Rep.fund_name,
       r_Rep.fund_ccy,
       r_Rep.date_nav,
       r_Rep.date_calcul,
       r_Rep.date_pub,
       r_Rep.long_pos_ptf,
       r_Rep.short_pos_ptf,
       r_Rep.netting_futur_pos_ptf,
       r_Rep.user_id,
       r_Rep.date_creation);




END LOOP;
COMMIT;


    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Ptf_Nav',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Short_Long_Position;

-------------------
-- Rapport Futur --
-------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Futur_Report( p_Date         IN VARCHAR2,
                                 p_Period_Type  IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                 p_User_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                                 p_status       OUT NUMBER,
                                 p_msg_err      OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date                  DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date,'YYYYMMDD');

v_Lot_Number            NUMBER;
v_Date_Nav              DATE;
v_Qty_Cumulee           NUMBER;
v_Compteur              NUMBER;
v_NbPrix_Zero           NUMBER:=0;

r_Rep                   WRK_QUERIES_BCR_FUTUR%ROWTYPE;
r_Dat                   WRK_QUERIES_BCR_FUTUR_DATA%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_DATA ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_Nav    IN DATE,
                 p_Lot_Number  IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT M.C_FUND SUBFUND_NUMBER,F.C_N_ID INTERNAL_FA_CODE ,D.C_OPE OPE_CODE,
           D.N_CONTRACT CONTRACT_NUMBER,D.N_ENTRY OPE_ENTRY_NUMBER,
           D.N_ENTRY_PTF OPE_ENTRY_PTF_NUMBER,D.Q_QTY OPE_QUANTITY,
           F.C_FUT_CCY SEC_CCY,F.D_MATURITY MATURITY_DATE,F.G_CONTRACT_SIZE CONTRACT_SIZE,
           D.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY SETTLEMENT_CCY,
           D.C_STATUS OPE_STATUS,M.N_LOT LOT_NUMBER,
           D.D_ACC OPE_ACC_DATE,D.D_TRADE OPE_TRADE_DATE,D.D_VALUE OPE_VALUE_DATE,
           D.L_DEAL OPE_DESCRIPTION,
           D.P_FUT OPE_PRICE,M.A_MVT OPE_AMOUNT, V.C_SRV CODE_SERVICE,
           V.D_NAV DATE_NAV,V.Q_QTY FINAL_QUANTITY, V.P_COST_PRICE COST_PRICE,
           V.P_VAL_PRICE EVALUATION_PRICE,V.A_MARKET_VALUE EVALUATION_AMOUNT

    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_PORTFOLIO P,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_DEAL_FUTURE D,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_FUTURES_MASTER F,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_CASH_MVT M,
         REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL V,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE /*P.D_END_EXERCISE = '29-FEB-2016'
      AND */D.Q_QTY <> 0
      AND M.C_N_ACC     IN ( SELECT T.ACCOUNT_NUMBER
                             FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FUTUR_ACCOUNT T)
      AND D.C_STATUS    = '20'
      AND M.N_LOT       <= p_Lot_Number --'01-SEP-15'
--      AND M.D_ACC < '01-SEP-15'
      AND P.C_FUND      = D.C_FUND
      AND D.C_FUND      = M.C_FUND
      AND D.C_STATUS    = M.C_STATUS
      AND D.N_ENTRY     = M.N_ENTRY
      AND D.C_SRV       = M.C_SRV -- INCPB-563839      
      AND F.C_N_ID      = D.C_N_ID
      AND M.C_FUND      = V.C_FUND
      AND D.C_N_ID      = V.C_N_ID
      AND D.N_CONTRACT  = V.N_CONTRACT
      AND V.C_FUND      = p_Fund_Number --'367506'
      AND V.D_NAV       = p_Date_Nav --'31-AUG-15'
      AND D.N_ENTRY     NOT IN ( SELECT DF.N_ENTRY
                                 FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_DEAL_FUTURE DF
                                 WHERE DF.C_FUND     = D.C_FUND
                                   AND DF.C_N_ID     = D.C_N_ID
                                   AND DF.N_CONTRACT = D.N_CONTRACT
                                   AND DF.N_LOT      <= p_Lot_Number
                                   AND DF.C_STATUS   = '30')
      AND b.fund_no = v.c_fund
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND v.c_nav_typ = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                      -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
    ORDER BY M.C_FUND,F.C_N_ID,D.N_ENTRY,D.N_ENTRY_PTF;

CURSOR CR_REPORT (p_SubFund_Number IN VARCHAR2) IS

    SELECT T.SUBFUND_NUMBER,T.SUBFUND_NAME,T.SUBFUND_CCY,T.NAV_TYPE,T.DATE_NAV,
           T.DATE_CALCUL,T.DATE_PUB,T.ISIN_CODE,T.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,T.CODE_SERVICE,
           T.SECURITY_NAME,T.SECURITY_CCY,T.MATURITY_DATE,T.CONTRACT_NUMBER,
           T.CALCUL_TYPE,T.CALCUL_TYPE_VALUE,T.CONTRACT_SIZE,
           T.FINAL_QUANTITY,MAX(T.OPE_ENTRY_NUMBER) ENTRY_NUMBER,
--           MAX(T.OPE_ENTRY_PTF_NUMBER) ENTRY_PTF_NUMBER,
           MAX(T.OPE_LOT_NUMBER) OPE_LOT
    FROM WRK_QUERIES_BCR_FUTUR_DATA T
    WHERE T.USER_ID      = p_User_Id -- 'JLIVET'
    AND T.SUBFUND_NUMBER = p_SubFund_Number --'802'
    GROUP BY T.SUBFUND_NUMBER,T.SUBFUND_NAME,T.SUBFUND_CCY,T.NAV_TYPE,T.DATE_NAV,
           T.DATE_CALCUL,T.DATE_PUB,T.ISIN_CODE,T.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,T.CODE_SERVICE,
           T.SECURITY_NAME,T.SECURITY_CCY,T.MATURITY_DATE,T.CONTRACT_NUMBER,
           T.CALCUL_TYPE,T.CALCUL_TYPE_VALUE,T.CONTRACT_SIZE,
           T.FINAL_QUANTITY;

CURSOR CR_COST_EVALUATION ( p_SubFund_Number   IN VARCHAR2,
                            p_Internal_Fa_Code IN NUMBER,
                            p_Contrat_Number   IN NUMBER,
                            p_Lot_Number       IN NUMBER,
                            p_Entry_Number     IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT T.COST_PRICE,T.COST_AMOUNT,
           T.EVALUATION_PRICE,T.EVALUATION_AMOUNT
    FROM WRK_QUERIES_BCR_FUTUR_DATA T
    WHERE T.USER_ID            = p_User_Id -- 'JLIVET'
    AND T.SUBFUND_NUMBER       = p_SubFund_Number --'802'
    AND T.INTERNAL_FA_CODE     = p_Internal_Fa_Code
    AND T.CONTRACT_NUMBER      = p_Contrat_Number
    AND T.OPE_LOT_NUMBER       = p_Lot_Number
    AND T.OPE_ENTRY_NUMBER     = p_Entry_Number;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Futur_Report';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es pour ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_FUTUR_DATA T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_FUTUR T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
-- Parcours des fonds
FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM,F.FUND_NAME,F.FUND_CCY
                   FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                   WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                     AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

    IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
          get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 1,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                       v_Date_Nav,v_Date_Nav);
    ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav,v_Date_Nav);
          ELSE
          v_Date_Nav := GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date,-1);
    END IF;

    r_Rep.Subfund_Number := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
    r_Rep.Subfund_Name   := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
    r_Rep.Subfund_Ccy    := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;
    r_Rep.Date_Nav       := v_Date_Nav;
    r_Rep.Date_Calcul    := GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav);
    r_Rep.Date_Pub       := GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav);

    v_Lot_Number         := GET_LOT_DATE_NAV(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav,0);

    -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
    r_Dat.Internal_Fa_Code := 0;
    FOR VCR_DATA IN CR_DATA ( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,
                              v_Date_Nav,
                              v_Lot_Number ) LOOP

        IF VCR_DATA.INTERNAL_FA_CODE <> r_Dat.Internal_Fa_Code THEN

           -- RÃ©-initialisation
           r_Dat.Internal_Fa_Code := VCR_DATA.INTERNAL_FA_CODE;
           r_Dat.Isin_Code        := GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC(VCR_DATA.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,VCR_DATA.CODE_SERVICE);
           r_Dat.Code_Service     := VCR_DATA.CODE_SERVICE;
           r_Dat.Security_Name    := GET_SEC_NAME (VCR_DATA.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,VCR_DATA.CODE_SERVICE);
           r_Dat.Security_Ccy     := VCR_DATA.SEC_CCY;
           r_Dat.Maturity_Date    := VCR_DATA.Maturity_Date;
           r_Dat.Contract_Number  := VCR_DATA.Contract_Number;
           r_Dat.Contract_Size    := NVL(VCR_DATA.CONTRACT_SIZE,1);

           v_Qty_Cumulee     := 0;
           r_Dat.Cost_Price  := 0;
           r_Dat.Cost_Amount := 0;

           v_Compteur        := 1;

           r_Dat.Calcul_Type := GET_CALCUL_TYPE_FUTUR(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,
                                v_Date_Nav,r_Dat.Internal_Fa_Code);

           CASE r_Dat.Calcul_Type
               WHEN '00' THEN
                    r_Dat.Calcul_Type_Value := 1;

               WHEN '01' THEN
                    r_Dat.Calcul_Type_Value := 0.01;
               ELSE
                    r_Dat.Calcul_Type_Value := 0;
           END CASE;

           ELSE
           v_Compteur := v_Compteur + 1;
        END IF;

        IF NVL(VCR_DATA.OPE_PRICE,0) = 0 THEN -- Au cas oÃ¹ il n'y a pas de prix, on renvoie un message d'alerte Ã  l'utilisateur !!!
           v_NbPrix_Zero:=v_NbPrix_Zero+1;
        END IF;

        CASE VCR_DATA.OPE_CODE
             WHEN '310' THEN
                  CASE
                       WHEN v_Qty_Cumulee >=0 THEN

                            r_Dat.Cost_Amount := r_Dat.Cost_Amount + NVL(VCR_DATA.OPE_AMOUNT,0);

                       WHEN v_Qty_Cumulee<0 THEN

                            r_Dat.Cost_Amount := r_Dat.Cost_Amount +
                                                 (r_Dat.Cost_Amount / v_Qty_Cumulee *
                                                  NVL(VCR_DATA.OPE_QUANTITY,0));

                       ELSE
                           NULL;
                  END CASE;

             WHEN '311' THEN
                  CASE
                       WHEN v_Qty_Cumulee <=0 THEN

                            r_Dat.Cost_Amount := r_Dat.Cost_Amount + NVL(-VCR_DATA.OPE_AMOUNT,0);

                       WHEN v_Qty_Cumulee >0 THEN

                            r_Dat.Cost_Amount := r_Dat.Cost_Amount -
                                                 (r_Dat.Cost_Amount / v_Qty_Cumulee *
                                                  NVL(VCR_DATA.OPE_QUANTITY,0));
                       ELSE
                           NULL;
                  END CASE;

             ELSE
                NULL;
        END CASE;

        IF v_Compteur = 1 THEN
           r_Dat.Cost_Price := NVL(VCR_DATA.OPE_PRICE,0);
           ELSE
           IF  v_Qty_Cumulee <> 0 AND  r_Dat.Contract_Size <> 0 AND r_Dat.Calcul_Type_Value <> 0 THEN
               r_Dat.Cost_Price := ROUND(r_Dat.Cost_Amount / v_Qty_Cumulee / r_Dat.Contract_Size / r_Dat.Calcul_Type_Value,6);
           END IF;
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_BCR_FUTUR_DATA
          (subfund_number,
           subfund_name,
           subfund_ccy,
           nav_type,
           date_nav,
           date_calcul,
           date_pub,
           isin_code,
           internal_fa_code,
           code_service,
           security_name,
           security_ccy,
           maturity_date,
           contract_number,
           contract_size,
           calcul_type,
           calcul_type_value,
           ope_lot_number,
           ope_entry_number,
           ope_entry_ptf_number,
           ope_code,
           ope_description,
           ope_acc_date,
           ope_trade_date,
           ope_value_date,
           ope_quantity,
           ope_price,
           ope_amount,
           final_quantity,
           cost_price,
           cost_amount,
           evaluation_price,
           evaluation_amount,
           user_id,
           date_creation)
        VALUES
          (r_Rep.Subfund_Number,
           r_Rep.Subfund_Name,
           r_Rep.Subfund_Ccy,
           NULL,
           r_Rep.Date_Nav,
           r_Rep.Date_Calcul,
           r_Rep.Date_Pub,
           r_Dat.Isin_Code,
           r_Dat.Internal_Fa_Code,
           r_Dat.Code_Service,
           r_Dat.security_name,
           r_Dat.Security_Ccy,
           r_Dat.maturity_date,
           r_Dat.contract_number,
           r_Dat.contract_size,
           r_Dat.Calcul_Type,
           r_Dat.Calcul_Type_Value,
           VCR_DATA.lot_number,
           VCR_DATA.ope_entry_number,
           VCR_DATA.ope_entry_ptf_number,
           VCR_DATA.ope_code,
           VCR_DATA.ope_description,
           VCR_DATA.ope_acc_date,
           VCR_DATA.ope_trade_date,
           VCR_DATA.ope_value_date,
           VCR_DATA.ope_quantity,
           VCR_DATA.ope_price,
           VCR_DATA.ope_amount,
           VCR_DATA.final_quantity,
           r_Dat.Cost_Price,
           r_Dat.Cost_Amount,
           VCR_DATA.EVALUATION_PRICE,
           VCR_DATA.EVALUATION_AMOUNT,
           p_user_id,
           SYSDATE);
    END LOOP;

    -- Insertion Report
    FOR VCR_REPORT IN CR_REPORT (r_Rep.Subfund_Number) LOOP
        r_Rep.Cost_Price        := 0;
        r_Rep.Cost_Amount       := 0;
        r_Rep.Evaluation_Price  := 0;
        r_Rep.Evaluation_Amount := 0;

        FOR X IN CR_COST_EVALUATION ( r_Rep.Subfund_Number,
                                      VCR_REPORT.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,
                                      VCR_REPORT.CONTRACT_NUMBER,
                                      VCR_REPORT.OPE_LOT,
                                      VCR_REPORT.ENTRY_NUMBER ) LOOP

            r_Rep.Cost_Price        := NVL(X.COST_PRICE,0);
            r_Rep.Cost_Amount       := NVL(X.COST_AMOUNT,0);
            r_Rep.Evaluation_Price  := NVL(X.EVALUATION_PRICE,0);
            r_Rep.Evaluation_Amount := NVL(X.EVALUATION_AMOUNT,0);

            EXIT;
        END LOOP;

        r_Rep.exchange_rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF( r_Rep.Subfund_Number,
                                                      VCR_REPORT.DATE_NAV,
                                                      VCR_REPORT.SECURITY_CCY,
                                                      1);

        r_Rep.Cost_Amount_Subfund_Ccy       := ROUND(r_Rep.Cost_Amount * r_Rep.exchange_rate,2);
        r_Rep.evaluation_amount_subfund_ccy := ROUND(r_Rep.Evaluation_Amount * r_Rep.exchange_rate,2);

        r_Rep.unrealised_sec_ccy            := r_Rep.Evaluation_Amount - r_Rep.Cost_Amount;
        r_Rep.unrealised_subfund_ccy        := ROUND(r_Rep.unrealised_sec_ccy * r_Rep.exchange_rate,2);

        INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_BCR_FUTUR
          (subfund_number,
           subfund_name,
           subfund_ccy,
           nav_type,
           date_nav,
           date_calcul,
           date_pub,
           isin_code,
           internal_fa_code,
           code_service,
           security_name,
           security_ccy,
           maturity_date,
           contract_number,
           contract_size,
           calcul_type,
           calcul_type_value,
           final_quantity,
           cost_price,
           cost_amount,
           cost_amount_subfund_ccy,
           evaluation_price,
           evaluation_amount,
           evaluation_amount_subfund_ccy,
           unrealised_sec_ccy,
           unrealised_subfund_ccy,
           exchange_rate,
           user_id,
           date_creation)
        VALUES
          (VCR_REPORT.Subfund_Number,
           VCR_REPORT.Subfund_Name,
           VCR_REPORT.Subfund_Ccy,
           VCR_REPORT.NAV_TYPE,
           VCR_REPORT.Date_Nav,
           VCR_REPORT.Date_Calcul,
           VCR_REPORT.Date_Pub,
           VCR_REPORT.Isin_Code,
           VCR_REPORT.Internal_Fa_Code,
           VCR_REPORT.Code_Service,
           VCR_REPORT.security_name,
           VCR_REPORT.Security_Ccy,
           VCR_REPORT.maturity_date,
           VCR_REPORT.contract_number,
           VCR_REPORT.contract_size,
           VCR_REPORT.Calcul_Type,
           VCR_REPORT.Calcul_Type_Value,
           VCR_REPORT.FINAL_QUANTITY,
           r_Rep.COST_PRICE,
           r_Rep.COST_AMOUNT,
           r_Rep.Cost_Amount_Subfund_Ccy,
           r_Rep.EVALUATION_PRICE,
           r_Rep.EVALUATION_AMOUNT,
           r_Rep.evaluation_amount_subfund_ccy,
           r_Rep.unrealised_sec_ccy,
           r_Rep.unrealised_subfund_ccy,
           r_Rep.exchange_rate,
           p_user_id,
           SYSDATE);

    END LOOP;

END LOOP;
COMMIT;

    IF v_NbPrix_Zero > 0 THEN
       p_status := -2;
       p_msg_err := 'Attention : il y a ' || v_NbPrix_Zero || ' opÃ©ration(s) sur futurs sans prix !';
    END IF;

    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Futur_Report',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Futur_Report;

-------------------------------------
-- Query 'Statistiques IRP Report' --
-------------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Stat_Irp_Report ( p_Date_From_Str IN VARCHAR2,
                                     p_Date_To_Str   IN VARCHAR2,
                                     p_User_Id       IN VARCHAR2,
                                     p_status        OUT NUMBER,
                                     p_msg_err       OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From_Str,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To_Str,'YYYYMMDD');
r_Dat                   WRK_QUERIES_BCR_STAT_IRP%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_FT ( p_Date_From IN DATE,
               p_Date_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT TO_CHAR(T.DATE_ENVOI,'YYYYMM') MOIS,TRUNC(T.DATE_ENVOI) DATE_ENVOI,R.REPORT_NAME,
           SUM(T.FORMAT_MFFA) + SUM(T.FORMAT_PICTET)  + SUM(T.FORMAT_XLS)  + SUM(T.FORMAT_CSV) TOTAL_PUB_AUTO
    FROM REPADMIN.FONDS_TIERS_PUB_V2 T,
         REPADMIN.MFFA_REP_PARAM_REPORT R
    WHERE TRUNC(T.DATE_ENVOI) >= p_Date_From --'31-DEC-13'
      AND TRUNC(T.DATE_ENVOI) <= p_Date_To --'01-JAN-15'
      AND T.REPORT_ID = R.REPORT_ID
    GROUP BY TO_CHAR(T.DATE_ENVOI,'YYYYMM'),TRUNC(T.DATE_ENVOI),R.REPORT_NAME;

CURSOR CR_WS ( p_Date_From IN DATE,
               p_Date_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT TO_CHAR(T.DATE_INSERT,'YYYYMM') MOIS,TRUNC(T.DATE_INSERT) DATE_INSERT,T.APPLICATION,COUNT(T.APPLICATION) NB
    FROM REPADMIN.WEBSERVICE_DATA T
    WHERE TRUNC(T.DATE_INSERT) >= p_Date_From --'31-DEC-13'
      AND TRUNC(T.DATE_INSERT) <= p_Date_To --'01-JAN-15'
      AND T.APPLICATION IN ('ACCINVENTORY','ACCRUEDEXP','BILANPTFCONSO','BILANSHEETCONSO',
          'CASHDEPOSIT','DIVIDENDE','EXCHANGERATE','FIRSTPAGENAV','FORWEXCHVALU','GENERALLEDGER',
          'HISTORICALNAV','INTERESTBONDS','MVTSFUNDPTF','OPTIONSREPORT','RECONCILIATIONNAV',
          'TAPOSITIONS','TATRANSACTIONS','TRADINGFEES')
    GROUP BY TO_CHAR(T.DATE_INSERT,'YYYYMM'),TRUNC(T.DATE_INSERT),T.APPLICATION;


Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Stat_Irp_Report';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_STAT_IRP T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

COMMIT;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
r_Dat.user_id       := p_User_Id;
r_Dat.date_creation := SYSDATE;

FOR X1 IN CR_FT (v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

    INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_BCR_STAT_IRP
      (month_report,
       date_report,
       report_source,
       report_name,
       report_number,
       user_id,
       date_creation)
    VALUES
      (X1.MOIS,
       X1.DATE_ENVOI,
       1,
       X1.REPORT_NAME,
       X1.TOTAL_PUB_AUTO,
       p_User_Id,
       r_Dat.date_creation);
END LOOP;

FOR X2 IN CR_WS (v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

    INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_BCR_STAT_IRP
      (month_report,
       date_report,
       report_source,
       report_name,
       report_number,
       user_id,
       date_creation)
    VALUES
      (X2.MOIS,
       X2.DATE_INSERT,
       2,
       X2.APPLICATION,
       X2.NB,
       p_User_Id,
       r_Dat.date_creation);
END LOOP;

COMMIT;


    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Stat_Irp_Report',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Stat_Irp_Report;

------------------------------
-- Query 'Container Avaloq' --
------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Bcr_Container ( p_User_Id       IN VARCHAR2,
                               p_status        OUT NUMBER,
                               p_msg_err       OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

CURSOR CR_MAIN IS
    SELECT DISTINCT F.FUND_NUMBER,T.FUND_NAME,T.FUND_CCY,F.ONLY_IN_EFRONT,
           F.DOSSIER_NUMBER,F.BP_AVALOQ,F.CONTAINER_AVALOQ,
           F.START_DATE,F.CLOSE_DATE,
           p_User_Id USER_ID,SYSDATE DATE_CREATION
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_CPT_AVQ F,
         REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS T
    WHERE F.FUND_NUMBER = T.FA_NUM
      AND T.USER_ID     = p_User_Id
      AND T.FLAG        = 1;
     

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Bcr_Container';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_CONTAINER T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

COMMIT;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
FOR X IN CR_MAIN LOOP

    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_BCR_CONTAINER VALUES X;

END LOOP;
COMMIT;

    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Container',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Bcr_Container;

------------------------------------
-- Liste des Registres Bloques TA --
------------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Registre_Blocked ( p_status  OUT NUMBER,
                                     p_msg_err OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status              NUMBER :=0;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                  NUMBER;

v_Date_Creation       DATE:=SYSDATE;
r_Blocked             REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED%ROWTYPE;
v_Register_Number     REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED.REGISTER_NUMBER%TYPE;

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Registre_Blocked';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-------------------------------------------------------------------
--      RÃ©initialisation de la table LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED --
-------------------------------------------------------------------
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'TRUNCATE TABLE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED';


FOR X IN (
      SELECT --'INSTITUTIONAL' AS TYPE,
             ENTITE.REF_MFTA_ENTITE AS REGISTRE_NUMBER,
             ENTITE.IDT_ENTITE AS REGISTREID,
             ENTITE.CDE_ENTITE_ACTIF AS ACTIVE,
             'Y' ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED,
             0 FUNDS_BLOCKED,                  
             NVL(ENTITE.CHAMP17_ENTITE,'N') AS FULL_BLOCKED,
             ENTITE.CHAMP18_ENTITE AS FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP18_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_REASON_BLOCKED_CODE_RKS(ENTITE.CHAMP18_ENTITE)) AS FULL_BLOCKED_REASON,                       
             NULL FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP23_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP23_ENTITE)) AS LAST_BLOCKED,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP24_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP24_ENTITE)) AS LAST_UNBLOCKED,
             NVL(ENTITE.CHAMP20_ENTITE,'N') AS REDEM_BLOCKED,
             ENTITE.CHAMP21_ENTITE AS REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP21_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_REASON_BLOCKED_CODE_RKS(ENTITE.CHAMP21_ENTITE)) AS REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON,                                    
             NULL REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP38_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP38_ENTITE)) AS LAST_RED_BLOCK_DATE,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP39_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP39_ENTITE)) AS LAST_RED_UNBLOCK_DATE,
             SYSDATE INSERT_DATE
      FROM REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_ENTITE ENTITE
      WHERE IDT_TYPE_ENTITE        = 4
        AND ENTITE.CDE_ETAT_ENTITE <> 'SUP'
--        AND (ENTITE.CHAMP17_ENTITE = 'Y' OR ENTITE.CHAMP20_ENTITE  = 'Y') --INCPB-693814
        AND (ENTITE.CHAMP23_ENTITE IS NOT NULL OR ENTITE.CHAMP24_ENTITE IS NOT NULL OR
             ENTITE.CHAMP38_ENTITE IS NOT NULL OR ENTITE.CHAMP39_ENTITE IS NOT NULL)--INCPB-693814
      UNION
      SELECT --'INSTITUTIONAL_ASIA' AS TYPE,
             ENTITE.REF_MFTA_ENTITE AS REGISTRE_NUMBER,
             ENTITE.IDT_ENTITE AS REGISTREID,
             ENTITE.CDE_ENTITE_ACTIF AS ACTIVE,
             'Y' ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED,
             0 FUNDS_BLOCKED,         
             NVL(ENTITE.CHAMP17_ENTITE,'N') AS FULL_BLOCKED,
             ENTITE.CHAMP18_ENTITE AS FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP18_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_REASON_BLOCKED_CODE_RKS(ENTITE.CHAMP18_ENTITE)) AS FULL_BLOCKED_REASON,                                    
             NULL FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP23_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP23_ENTITE)) AS LAST_BLOCKED,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP24_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP24_ENTITE)) AS LAST_UNBLOCKED,
             NVL(ENTITE.CHAMP20_ENTITE,'N') AS REDEM_BLOCKED,
             ENTITE.CHAMP21_ENTITE AS REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP21_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_REASON_BLOCKED_CODE_RKS(ENTITE.CHAMP21_ENTITE)) AS REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON,                                                 
             NULL REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP37_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP37_ENTITE)) AS LAST_RED_BLOCK_DATE,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP38_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP38_ENTITE)) AS LAST_RED_UNBLOCK_DATE,
             SYSDATE INSERT_DATE
      FROM REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_ENTITE ENTITE 
      WHERE IDT_TYPE_ENTITE       = 11
       AND ENTITE.CDE_ETAT_ENTITE <> 'SUP'
--       AND (ENTITE.CHAMP17_ENTITE = 'Y' OR ENTITE.CHAMP20_ENTITE = 'Y') --INCPB-693814
        AND (ENTITE.CHAMP23_ENTITE IS NOT NULL OR ENTITE.CHAMP24_ENTITE IS NOT NULL OR
             ENTITE.CHAMP37_ENTITE IS NOT NULL OR ENTITE.CHAMP38_ENTITE IS NOT NULL)--INCPB-693814
       UNION
      -- EXTRACTION REGISTRE INDIVIDUAL
      SELECT --'INDIVIDUAL' AS TYPE,
             ENTITE.REF_MFTA_ENTITE AS REGISTRE_NUMBER,
             ENTITE.IDT_ENTITE AS REGISTREID,
             ENTITE.CDE_ENTITE_ACTIF AS ACTIVE,
             'Y' ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED,    
             0 FUNDS_BLOCKED,                       
             NVL(ENTITE.CHAMP13_ENTITE,'N') AS REDEM_BLOCKED,         
             ENTITE.CHAMP14_ENTITE AS FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP14_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_REASON_BLOCKED_CODE_RKS(ENTITE.CHAMP14_ENTITE)) AS FULL_BLOCKED_REASON,                                                 
             NULL FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP19_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP19_ENTITE)) AS LAST_BLOCKED,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP20_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP20_ENTITE)) AS LAST_UNBLOCKED,
             NVL(ENTITE.CHAMP16_ENTITE,'N') AS REDEM_BLOCKED,
             ENTITE.CHAMP17_ENTITE AS REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP17_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_REASON_BLOCKED_CODE_RKS(ENTITE.CHAMP17_ENTITE)) AS REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON,                                                              
             NULL REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP35_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP35_ENTITE)) AS LAST_RED_BLOCK_DATE,
             DECODE(ENTITE.CHAMP36_ENTITE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(ENTITE.CHAMP36_ENTITE)) AS LAST_RED_UNBLOCK_DATE,
             SYSDATE INSERT_DATE
      FROM REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_ENTITE ENTITE
      WHERE IDT_TYPE_ENTITE = 2
       AND ENTITE.CDE_ETAT_ENTITE <> 'SUP'
--       AND (ENTITE.CHAMP13_ENTITE = 'Y' OR ENTITE.CHAMP16_ENTITE = 'Y')  --INCPB-693814  
        AND (ENTITE.CHAMP19_ENTITE IS NOT NULL OR ENTITE.CHAMP20_ENTITE IS NOT NULL OR
             ENTITE.CHAMP35_ENTITE IS NOT NULL OR ENTITE.CHAMP36_ENTITE IS NOT NULL)--INCPB-693814

      ORDER BY 1,2) LOOP
    
          -- Suppression si existant
          IF v_Register_Number IS NOT NULL AND v_Register_Number = X.REGISTRE_NUMBER THEN
             DELETE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED T
             WHERE T.REGISTER_NUMBER = X.REGISTRE_NUMBER;
          END IF;
          v_Register_Number := X.REGISTRE_NUMBER;
    
          INSERT INTO REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED VALUES X;
    
    END LOOP;
   COMMIT;
   
-- Insertion des registres bloques par ombrelles
INSERT INTO REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED
        (
          SELECT ENTITE.REF_MFTA_ENTITE AS REGISTRE_NUMBER,RELATION.*
          FROM
          (SELECT
              RELDET.IDT_OBJET AS REGISTREID,
              REL.CDE_RELATION_ACTIF AS ACTIVE,
              'N' ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED,    
              REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_STRUCT_NUM_WITH_FUNDID_RKS(REL.CHAMP1_ROLE) AS FUNDS_BLOCKED,                       
              NVL(REL.CHAMP4_ROLE,'N') AS FULL_BLOCKED,
              REL.CHAMP5_ROLE AS FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
              DECODE(REL.CHAMP5_ROLE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_REASON_BLOCKED_CODE_RKS(REL.CHAMP5_ROLE)) AS FULL_BLOCKED_REASON,                                                         
              REL.CHAMP13_ROLE AS FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
              DECODE(REL.CHAMP8_ROLE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(REL.CHAMP8_ROLE)) AS LAST_BLOCKED,
              DECODE(REL.CHAMP9_ROLE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(REL.CHAMP9_ROLE)) AS LAST_UNBLOCKED,
              NVL(REL.CHAMP6_ROLE,'N') AS REDEM_BLOCKED,
              REL.CHAMP7_ROLE AS REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
              DECODE(REL.CHAMP7_ROLE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_REASON_BLOCKED_CODE_RKS(REL.CHAMP7_ROLE)) AS REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON,                                                         
              REL.CHAMP12_ROLE AS REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
              DECODE(REL.CHAMP10_ROLE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(REL.CHAMP10_ROLE)) AS LAST_RED_BLOCK_DATE,
              DECODE(REL.CHAMP11_ROLE,NULL,NULL,REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_DATE_BLOCKED(REL.CHAMP11_ROLE)) AS LAST_RED_UNBLOCK_DATE,
              SYSDATE INSERT_DATE
          FROM REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_RELATION REL
              LEFT OUTER JOIN REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_RELATION_DETAIL RELDET
                      ON REL.IDT_RELATION = RELDET.IDT_RELATION
          WHERE IDT_TYPE_RELATION = 714
          AND REL.CDE_ETAT_RELATION IN ('CRS', 'VLD')
          AND REL.CDE_RELATION_ACTIF = 1
--          AND (REL.CHAMP4_ROLE = 'Y' OR REL.CHAMP6_ROLE='Y') --INCPB-693814
          AND (REL.CHAMP8_ROLE IS NOT NULL OR REL.CHAMP9_ROLE IS NOT NULL OR
               REL.CHAMP10_ROLE IS NOT NULL OR REL.CHAMP11_ROLE IS NOT NULL)--INCPB-693814
          ) RELATION 
          LEFT JOIN REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_ENTITE ENTITE ON RELATION.REGISTREID = ENTITE.IDT_ENTITE
          LEFT JOIN REPADMIN.DOC_NUM_ENTITE ENTITEFUND ON RELATION.FUNDS_BLOCKED = ENTITEFUND.IDT_ENTITE
          WHERE ENTITE.REF_MFTA_ENTITE NOT IN ( SELECT R.REGISTER_NUMBER from REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED R)  
             OR ENTITE.REF_MFTA_ENTITE IN ( SELECT R.REGISTER_NUMBER FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED R
                                            WHERE RELATION.FULL_BLOCKED <> R.FULL_BLOCKED
                                               OR RELATION.REDEM_BLOCKED <> R.REDEM_BLOCKED )          
    );

COMMIT;

p_status           :=1;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status:=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :=''
                || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Registre_Blocked',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
end proc_Ta_Registre_Blocked;

----------------------------
-- Liste des Registres TA --
----------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Registre(p_status  OUT NUMBER,
                           p_msg_err OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status              NUMBER :=0;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_Insert         DATE:=SYSDATE; --INCPB-671099
r_Blocked             LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED%ROWTYPE;

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Registre';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'TRUNCATE TABLE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES';

----------------------------------------------------------
--      Refresh de la table LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED --
----------------------------------------------------------
proc_Ta_Registre_Blocked( p_status  => v_status  ,
                          p_msg_err => v_msg_err);

IF v_status <> 1 THEN   
   p_status  := v_status;
   p_msg_err := v_msg_err;
   GOTO FIN_PROC;
END IF;                                    

------------------------------------------------
--      Refresh de la LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES     --
------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES(REGISTER_NUMBER,REGISTER_NAME,OUTLET_NUM,CLIENT_NUM,CLIENT_NAME,
            REGISTER_TYPE,REGISTER_TYPE_NAME,GROUP_TYPE,GROUP_TYPE_NAME,
            PERSON_TYPE,PERSON_TYPE_NAME,
            REG_TYPE,REG_TYPE_NAME,
            SETTLEMENT_TYPE,SETTLEMENT_NAME,
            RESIDENCE_CODE,RESIDENCE_NAME,
            CITY_CODE,CITY_NAME,
            DATE_CREATION,DATE_UPDATE,
            DATE_INSERT,DATE_LAST_UPDATE, --INCPB-671099
            TAX_RESIDENCE_CODE,TAX_RESIDENCE_NAME,
            CLEARING_FLAG,CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,CLEARING_ACCOUNT,FLAG_STP,
            CUSTODY_SETTLE_CODE,CUSTODY_SETTLE_DESC)
    (SELECT T.C_N_REGISTER,REPADMIN.GET_REGISTRE_TA_LIBELLE(T.C_N_REGISTER) L_NAME, --INCPB-651339
            T.C_N_OUTLET,T.C_N_CLIENT,TRIM(C.L_NAME) CLIENT_NAME,
           T.C_REGISTER_TYP REGISTER_TYPE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('TYPREG',T.C_REGISTER_TYP) REGISTER_TYPE_NAME,
           T.C_GROUP_TYP GROUP_TYPE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('TYPGRP',T.C_GROUP_TYP) GROUP_NAME,
           T.C_PERSON_TYP,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('TYPPERS',T.C_PERSON_TYP) PERSON_TYPE_NAME,
           T.C_REG_TYP,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('REGTYP',T.C_REG_TYP) REG_TYPE_NAME,
           T.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('SETTLE',T.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP) SETTLEMENT_TYPE_NAME,
           T.C_RESIDENCE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('COUNTRY',T.C_RESIDENCE) RESIDENCE_NAME,
           T.C_CITY,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('COUNTRY',T.C_CITY) CITY_NAME,
           T.D_CREATED,T.D_UPDATED,
           v_Date_Insert,v_Date_Insert,--INCPB-671099
           T.C_TAX_RESIDENCE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('COUNTRY',T.C_TAX_RESIDENCE) TAX_RESIDENCE,
           DECODE(T.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL,NULL,0,1) CLEARING_FLAG,
           T.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
           GET_TA_REG_NAME(T.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL) CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
           PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.get_Clearing_Account(T.C_N_REGISTER) CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
           REPADMIN.GET_REGISTRE_TA_STP(T.C_N_REGISTER) FLAG_STP,
           T.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE CUSTODY_SETTLE_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('CDELIV', T.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE) CUSTODY_SETTLE_DESC
    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER  T,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_CLIENT  C
    WHERE T.C_N_CLIENT   = C.C_N_CLIENT
    );

-- Update des champs de blocage
FOR X IN (SELECT T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED,T.FULL_BLOCKED,T.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
                 T.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON,T.FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT,T.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE,
                 T.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE,
                 T.REDEM_BLOCKED,
                 T.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
                 T.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON,
                 T.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
                 T.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE,
                 T.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE
         FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED T
/*         WHERE T.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE  = ( SELECT MAX(DECODE(B.FULL_BLOCKED,'Y',B.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE,B.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE)) 
                                             FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED B 
                                             WHERE B.REGISTER_NUMBER = T.REGISTER_NUMBER) 
            OR T.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE = ( SELECT MAX(DECODE(B.FULL_BLOCKED,'Y',B.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE,B.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE))  
                                             FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED B 
                                             WHERE B.REGISTER_NUMBER = T.REGISTER_NUMBER )
*/
              ) LOOP
         
        UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES T
        SET T.ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED            = X.ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED,
            T.FULL_BLOCKED                 = X.FULL_BLOCKED,
            T.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE     = X.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
            T.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON          = X.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON,
            T.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE       = X.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE,
            T.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE  = X.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE,
            T.REDEM_BLOCKED                = X.REDEM_BLOCKED,
            T.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE    = X.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
            T.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON         = X.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON,
            T.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT        = X.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT,
            T.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE      = X.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE,
            T.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE = X.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE
        WHERE T.REGISTER_NUMBER            = X.REGISTER_NUMBER;

END LOOP;         
COMMIT;

p_status           :=1;

<<FIN_PROC>>
NULL;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status:=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :=''
                || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Registre',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
end proc_Ta_Registre;

-- Liste des Registres TA par User --
-------------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Registre_User(p_User_Id IN VARCHAR2,
                                p_status  OUT NUMBER,
                                p_msg_err OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status              NUMBER :=0;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_Insert_Max     DATE;
v_Date_Creation       DATE:=SYSDATE;


CURSOR CR_MAIN IS
    SELECT T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.REGISTER_NAME,T.OUTLET_NUM,T.CLIENT_NUM,
           T.CLIENT_NAME,T.REGISTER_TYPE,T.REGISTER_TYPE_NAME,T.GROUP_TYPE,
           T.GROUP_TYPE_NAME,T.PERSON_TYPE,T.PERSON_TYPE_NAME,T.REG_TYPE,T.REG_TYPE_NAME,
           T.SETTLEMENT_TYPE,T.SETTLEMENT_NAME,T.RESIDENCE_CODE,
           T.RESIDENCE_NAME,T.CITY_CODE,T.CITY_NAME,T.TAX_RESIDENCE_CODE,
           T.TAX_RESIDENCE_NAME,T.DATE_CREATION,T.DATE_UPDATE,T.DATE_INSERT,
           T.DATE_LAST_UPDATE,
           T.CLEARING_FLAG,T.CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
           T.CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,T.CLEARING_ACCOUNT,T.FLAG_STP
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES T;

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN


-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Registre_User';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

---------------------
-- Suppression     --
---------------------

DELETE FROM  REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG T
WHERE T.USER_ID          = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_LAST_UPDATE <= SYSDATE-1;
COMMIT;

FOR X IN CR_MAIN LOOP

    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG
      (flag,
       register_number,
       register_name,
       outlet_num,
       client_num,
       client_name,
       register_type,
       register_type_name,
       group_type,
       group_type_name,
       person_type,
       person_type_name,
       reg_type,
       reg_type_name,
       settlement_type,
       settlement_name,
       residence_code,
       residence_name,
       city_code,
       city_name,
       tax_residence_code,
       tax_residence_name,
       clearing_flag,
       clearing_register_number,
       clearing_register_name,
       clearing_account,
       date_creation,
       date_update,
       date_insert,
       date_last_update,
       flag_stp,
       user_id)
    VALUES
      (NULL,
       X.register_number,
       X.register_name,
       X.outlet_num,
       X.client_num,
       X.client_name,
       X.register_type,
       X.register_type_name,
       X.group_type,
       X.group_type_name,
       X.person_type,
       X.person_type_name,
       X.reg_type,
       X.reg_type_name,
       X.settlement_type,
       X.settlement_name,
       X.residence_code,
       X.residence_name,
       X.city_code,
       X.city_name,
       X.tax_residence_code,
       X.tax_residence_name,
       X.CLEARING_FLAG,
       X.CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
       X.CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
       X.CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
       X.date_creation,
       X.date_update,
       X.date_insert,
       v_Date_Creation,
       X.FLAG_STP,
       p_User_Id);

END LOOP;

COMMIT;

UPDATE REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG T
SET T.DATE_LAST_UPDATE = v_Date_Creation
WHERE T.USER_ID=p_User_Id;
COMMIT;

p_status           :=1;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status:=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);
when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :=''
                || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Registre_User',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
END proc_Ta_Registre_User;

--------------------
-- TA : Sub - Red --
--------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Sub_Red(p_Reg_Type       IN NUMBER, -- 1 = Tous les registres, 2 = Registres FlagÃ©s
                          p_Code_Ope_Type  IN NUMBER, -- 1 = Tous les codes opÃ©, 2 = Codes opÃ© FlagÃ©s
                          p_User_Id        IN VARCHAR2,
                          p_Period_Type    IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                          p_Date_From      IN VARCHAR2,
                          p_Date_To        IN VARCHAR2,
                          p_Version        IN NUMBER,
                          p_Report_Ccy     IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                          p_status         OUT NUMBER,
                          p_msg_err        OUT VARCHAR2) IS


v_status              NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_date_creation       DATE:= SYSDATE;

v_Date_From           DATE;
v_Date_To             DATE;

v_Date_From_TA        DATE;
v_Date_To_TA          DATE;

v_Date_From_EF        DATE;
v_Date_To_EF          DATE;

v_Date_Nav_From       DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To         DATE;


v_Flag_Min            NUMBER;
v_Flag_Max            NUMBER;

v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope   NUMBER;
v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope   NUMBER;

v_Tx_Ch               NUMBER;
v_Nb_Decimales        NUMBER;

v_Archive             BOOLEAN:=FALSE;
v_Nb_Ope_Archive      NUMBER;
v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Period NUMBER:=NVL(GET_GLOBAL_VAR_VALUE('TA_ARC_NB_FDS_PER'),0);
v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Date   NUMBER:=NVL(GET_GLOBAL_VAR_VALUE('TA_ARC_NB_FDS_DATE'),0);

v_Compartiment_Ccy    TAB_FND_MAIN.FUND_CCY%TYPE;
v_Fa_Ref_Num          TAB_FND_MAIN.FA_REF_NUM%TYPE;
v_Pool_Num            TAB_FND_FUND_TYPE.FA_POOL_NUM%TYPE;

r_Row                 WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED%ROWTYPE;
v_part_exrate         WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate%TYPE;
v_report_exrate       WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate%TYPE;

CURSOR CR_FONDS ( p_Date_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT Q.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_To) FA_NUM_REF,
           GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_To)) FUND_CCY_REF,
           GET_FUND_NUM_POOL(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_To) POOL_NUMBER,
           TF.CALCUL,DECODE(TF.EFRONT,1,1,0) EFRONT,TF.EFRONT_DATE,
           Q.D_ACTIVATION
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
     AND Q.FLAG     = 1
     AND Q.FA_NUM   = TF.FA_NUM(+)
    UNION
    SELECT TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(T.FUND_NUMBER_FA_TA,p_Date_To) FA_NUM_REF,
           GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(T.FUND_NUMBER_FA_TA,p_Date_To)) FUND_CCY_REF,
           GET_FUND_NUM_POOL(T.FUND_NUMBER_FA_TA,p_Date_To) POOL_NUMBER,
           TF.CALCUL,DECODE(TF.EFRONT,1,1,0) EFRONT,TF.EFRONT_DATE,
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_FIRST_DATE_NAV(TF.FA_NUM) D_ACTIVATION
    FROM REPADMIN.TURNOVER_CORRESP_NUM_FA_TA T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE T.FUND_NUMBER_FA IN (SELECT Q.FA_NUM
                              FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q
                              WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                                AND Q.FLAG    = 1)
     AND T.FUND_NUMBER_FA  = TF.FA_NUM(+);

CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                     p_Date_Nav    IN DATE) IS
    SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.NAV_DATE_TRT) DATE_CALCUL,
           T.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION,T.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION DATE_PUB
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV T
    INNER JOIN repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
            ON b.fund_no = t.nav_fund_no
    WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO = p_Fund_Number --'280158'
    AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV <= p_Date_Nav
    AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.nav_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
         OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                        -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial) 
    ORDER BY T.NAV_DATE_NAV DESC;

CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV_EF ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                        p_Date_Nav    IN DATE) IS

    SELECT C.DATE_NAV,C.DATE_CALCUL,C.DATE_NAV DATE_PUB
    FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C
    WHERE C.FA_NUM    = p_Fund_Number --'280158'
      AND C.DATE_NAV <= p_Date_Nav
    ORDER BY C.DATE_NAV DESC;
