-- CURSEURS SUR LES SUB-RED --
------------------------------
CURSOR CR_MAIN_V1( p_Fa_Num            IN VARCHAR2,
                   p_Date_From         IN DATE,
                   p_Date_To           IN DATE,
                   p_Flag_Min          IN NUMBER,
                   p_Flag_Max          IN NUMBER,
                   p_Flag_Min_Code_Ope IN NUMBER,
                   p_Flag_Max_Code_Ope IN NUMBER) IS

   WITH pool_ta_num AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT TF2.TA_NUM, TF2.ISIN_CODE
          FROM   REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF1
          CROSS JOIN REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF2
          WHERE  TF1.FA_NUM = p_Fa_Num
            AND  (   NVL(TF2.FA_POOL_NUM, TF2.FA_NUM) = NVL(TF1.FA_POOL_NUM, TF1.FA_NUM)
                  OR REPLACE(TF1.FUND_NAME, 'POOL - ', '') = REPLACE(TF2.FUND_NAME, 'POOL - ', ''))
        ),
        pool_ta_num_hist AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT T_HIST.OPT_NPTF AS TA_NUM
          FROM   REPADMIN.OP_TA T_HIST
          WHERE  T_HIST.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN IN (SELECT ISIN_CODE FROM pool_ta_num WHERE ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL)
        ),
        pool_ta_num_all AS (
          SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_num
          UNION
          SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_num_hist
        )
   SELECT T.OPT_NPTF TA_NUMBER,
          NVL(NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE), T.OPT_TPART) PART,
          T.OPT_QUOT_CCY PART_CCY,CASE
                                      WHEN TF.ISIN_CODE     IS NOT NULL THEN TF.ISIN_CODE
                                      WHEN T.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN IS NOT NULL THEN T.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN
                                      ELSE (SELECT MAX(T2.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN)
                                            FROM   REPADMIN.OP_TA T2
                                            WHERE  T2.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO
                                              AND  T2.OPT_OP_CODE         = '0016'
                                              AND  T2.OPT_OP_DATE         = T.OPT_OP_DATE
                                              AND  T2.OPT_TPART           = T.OPT_TPART
                                              AND  T2.OPT_NPTF            IN (SELECT TBF.TA_NUM
                                                                              FROM   REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TBF
                                                                              WHERE  TBF.FA_NUM = p_Fa_Num))
                                   END ISIN_CODE,
--          T.OPT_FUNDS_CCY PART_CCY,OPT_FUNDS_ISIN ISIN_CODE,
          T.OPT_OP_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('COPER',T.OPT_OP_CODE) OPE_CODE_NAME,
          T.OPT_QUANTITY * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) OPT_QUANTITY,
          T.OPT_QUOT_CCY QUOT_CCY,T.OPT_PRICE QUOT_CCY_PRICE,
          T.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,
          T.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,
          T.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,
          T.OPT_PRICE_FUNDS_CCY PRICE_FUND_CCY,
          T.OPT_COMM_TYPE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('TCOMM',T.OPT_COMM_TYPE) TYPE_COM,
          T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPT_INPUT_DATE,
          T.OPT_OP_DATE, T.OPT_VALUE_DATE,
          T.OPT_EXT_CODE EXT_CODE,T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,
          DECODE(T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,NULL,0,1) OPE_STP,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,0,1) CLEARING_FLAG,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,NULL,T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO) CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,NULL,R.L_NAME) CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,NULL,T.OPT_NREGISTER_ACC_NO) CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
          T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA OPE_NUM_TA,OPT_OUTLET_NO OUTLET_NUMBER,OPT_TYPE_LOG TYPE_LOG,
          V.N_DAYS,T.OPT_CLIENT_CODE,T.OPT_CLIENT_NAME,T.OPT_OP_DATE_REC,
          TRUNC(T.OPT_INPUT_DATE) INPUT_DATE_TRUNC
   FROM REPADMIN.OP_TA  T,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER  R,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE  V,
        REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
   WHERE T.OPT_NPTF           IN (SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_num_all)
     AND T.OPT_OP_DATE        >= p_Date_From --'01-DEC-09'
     AND T.OPT_OP_DATE        <= p_Date_To --'31-DEC-09'
     AND T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = R.C_N_REGISTER(+)
     AND (   T.OPT_OP_CODE != '0018'
          OR (T.OPT_OP_CODE = '0018'
              AND T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO IN (
                     SELECT DISTINCT T2.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO
                     FROM   REPADMIN.OP_TA T2
                     WHERE  T2.OPT_OP_CODE = '0016'
                       AND  T2.OPT_OP_DATE BETWEEN p_Date_From AND p_Date_To
                       AND  (   T2.OPT_NPTF IN (SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_num_all)
                             OR T2.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN IN (SELECT ISIN_CODE FROM pool_ta_num WHERE ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL)))))
     AND T.OPT_NPTF           = TF.TA_NUM(+)
     AND T.OPT_TPART          = TF.PART_TA_CODE(+)
     AND T.OPT_NPTF           = V.C_FUND(+)
     AND T.OPT_OP_CODE        = V.C_OPE(+)
     AND T.OPT_OP_CODE       IN  (SELECT DISTINCT C.CODE_OPE
                                  FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE C
                                  WHERE C.USER_ID      = p_User_Id
                                    AND C.CODE_OPE     NOT IN ('0014','0015')
                                    AND (NVL(C.FLAG,0) = p_Flag_Min_Code_Ope
                                     OR  NVL(C.FLAG,0) = p_Flag_Max_Code_Ope))
     AND (T.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '04'
       OR (T.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '03'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   REPADMIN.OP_TA T2
                           WHERE  T2.OPT_OP_NUM_TA = T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA
                             AND  T2.OPT_OUTLET_NO = T.OPT_OUTLET_NO
                             AND  T2.OPT_OP_CODE   = T.OPT_OP_CODE
                             AND  T2.OPT_TYPE_LOG  = '04')));

          T.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,
          T.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,
          T.OPT_PRICE_FUNDS_CCY PRICE_FUND_CCY,
          T.OPT_COMM_TYPE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('TCOMM',T.OPT_COMM_TYPE) TYPE_COM,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO) REGISTER_NUMBER,
          T.OPT_INPUT_DATE,T.OPT_OP_DATE, T.OPT_VALUE_DATE,
          T.OPT_EXT_CODE EXT_CODE,T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,
          DECODE(T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,NULL,0,1) OPE_STP,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,0,1) CLEARING_FLAG,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,NULL,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO) CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,NULL,R.L_NAME) CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,NULL,T.OPT_NREGISTER_ACC_NO) CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
          T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA OPE_NUM_TA,OPT_OUTLET_NO OUTLET_NUMBER,OPT_TYPE_LOG TYPE_LOG,
          V.N_DAYS,T.OPT_CLIENT_CODE,T.OPT_CLIENT_NAME,T.OPT_OP_DATE_REC,
          TRUNC(T.OPT_INPUT_DATE) INPUT_DATE_TRUNC
   FROM REPADMIN.OP_TA_ARC T,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER  R,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE  V,
        REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
   WHERE T.OPT_NPTF          IN (SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_num_all)
     AND T.OPT_OP_DATE       >= p_Date_From--'16-FEB-12'
     AND T.OPT_OP_DATE       <= p_Date_To--'16-FEB-12'
     AND T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO = R.C_N_REGISTER(+)
     AND (   T.OPT_OP_CODE != '0018'
          OR (T.OPT_OP_CODE = '0018'
              AND T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO IN (
                     SELECT DISTINCT T2.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO
                     FROM   REPADMIN.OP_TA T2
                     WHERE  T2.OPT_OP_CODE = '0016'
                       AND  T2.OPT_OP_DATE BETWEEN p_Date_From AND p_Date_To
                       AND  (   T2.OPT_NPTF IN (SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_num_all)
                             OR T2.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN IN (SELECT ISIN_CODE FROM pool_ta_num WHERE ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL)))))
     AND T.OPT_NPTF           = TF.TA_NUM(+)
     AND T.OPT_TPART          = TF.PART_TA_CODE(+)
     AND T.OPT_NPTF          = V.C_FUND(+)
     AND T.OPT_OP_CODE       = V.C_OPE(+)
     AND T.OPT_OP_CODE       IN  (SELECT DISTINCT C.CODE_OPE
                                  FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE C
                                  WHERE C.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                    AND (NVL(C.FLAG,0) = p_Flag_Min_Code_Ope
                                     OR  NVL(C.FLAG,0) = p_Flag_Max_Code_Ope))
     AND (T.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '04'
       OR (T.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '03'
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM   REPADMIN.OP_TA T2
                           WHERE  T2.OPT_OP_NUM_TA = T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA
                             AND  T2.OPT_OUTLET_NO = T.OPT_OUTLET_NO
                             AND  T2.OPT_OP_CODE   = T.OPT_OP_CODE
                             AND  T2.OPT_TYPE_LOG  = '04')));

CURSOR CR_NB_OPE_ARC ( p_Fa_Num    IN VARCHAR2,
                       p_Date_From IN DATE,
                       p_Date_To   IN DATE) IS

   SELECT COUNT(T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA) NB_OPE
   FROM REPADMIN.OP_TA_ARC  T
   WHERE T.OPT_OP_DATE        >= p_Date_From --'01-JAN-08'
     AND T.OPT_OP_DATE        <= p_Date_To --'31-AUG-14'
     AND T.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN     IN ( SELECT DISTINCT TBF.ISIN_CODE
                                   FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TBF
                                   WHERE TBF.FA_NUM = p_Fa_Num);

CURSOR CR_REG_CONTRACT_V1( p_Fa_Num            IN VARCHAR2,
                           p_Date_From         IN DATE,
                           p_Date_To           IN DATE,
                           p_Flag_Min          IN NUMBER,
                           p_Flag_Max          IN NUMBER,
                           p_Flag_Min_Code_Ope IN NUMBER,
                           p_Flag_Max_Code_Ope IN NUMBER) IS

   SELECT T.C_FUND TA_NUMBER,
          NVL(NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE), T.C_SHARE_TYP) PART,
          TF.PART_CCY PART_CCY,TF.ISIN_CODE ISIN_CODE,
          T.C_OPE OPT_OP_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('COPER',T.C_OPE) OPE_CODE_NAME,
          T.Q_CONTRACT OPT_QUANTITY,
          TF.PART_CCY QUOT_CCY,T.P_MNT_UNIT QUOT_CCY_PRICE,
          T.A_GROSS QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,
          T.A_MNT_NET QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,
          T.A_TOT_COMM QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,
          T.P_MNT_UNIT PRICE_FUND_CCY,
          T.C_COMM OPT_COMM_TYPE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('TCOMM',T.C_COMM) TYPE_COM,
          T.C_N_REGISTER REGISTER_NUMBER,
          T.D_CREATED OPT_INPUT_DATE,T.D_TRADE, T.D_VALUE,
          DECODE(T.D_DEXTOURNE,NULL,'N','Y') EXT_CODE,NULL OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,
          DECODE(NULL,NULL,0,1) OPE_STP,
          DECODE(T.C_N_REGISTER_DEAL,T.C_N_REGISTER,0,1) CLEARING_FLAG,
          DECODE(T.C_N_REGISTER_DEAL,T.C_N_REGISTER,NULL,T.C_N_REGISTER_DEAL) CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
          DECODE(T.C_N_REGISTER_DEAL,T.C_N_REGISTER,NULL,R.L_NAME) CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
          DECODE(T.C_N_REGISTER_DEAL,T.C_N_REGISTER,NULL,PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.GET_CLEARING_ACCOUNT(T.C_N_REGISTER_DEAL)) CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
          T.N_ORDER OPE_NUM_TA,T.C_N_OUTLET OUTLET_NUMBER,T.C_PAY_TYP TYPE_LOG,
          V.N_DAYS,NULL OPT_CLIENT_CODE,NULL OPT_CLIENT_NAME,NULL OPT_OP_DATE_REC,
          TRUNC(T.D_CREATED) INPUT_DATE_TRUNC
   FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REG_CONTRACT  T,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER  R,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE  V,
        REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
   WHERE T.D_TRADE        >= p_Date_From --'01-APR-16'
     AND T.D_TRADE        <= p_Date_To --'10-APR- 16'
     AND T.N_LOT          = ( SELECT MAX(C.N_LOT)
                              FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REG_CONTRACT C
                              WHERE C.C_FUND       = T.C_FUND
                                AND C.N_ORDER      = T.N_ORDER
                                AND C.C_N_REGISTER = T.C_N_REGISTER
                             )
     AND T.C_N_REGISTER   = R.C_N_REGISTER
     AND (T.C_FUND        IN ( SELECT TF1.TA_NUM FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF1 WHERE TF1.FA_NUM = p_Fa_Num) --'233438'
       OR T.C_SHARE_TYP  IN ( SELECT DISTINCT PS.C_SHARE FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE PS WHERE PS.C_MF_FUND = p_Fa_Num))
     AND T.C_FUND         = TF.TA_NUM(+)
     AND T.C_SHARE_TYP    = TF.PART_TA_CODE(+)
     AND T.C_FUND         = V.C_FUND(+)
     AND T.C_OPE          = V.C_OPE(+)
     AND T.C_OPE          IN ( SELECT DISTINCT C.CODE_OPE
                               FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE C
                               WHERE C.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                 AND C.CODE_OPE     IN ('0014','0015')
                                 AND (NVL(C.FLAG,0) = p_Flag_Min_Code_Ope
                                  OR  NVL(C.FLAG,0) = p_Flag_Max_Code_Ope));

CURSOR CR_REG_CONTRACT_V2( p_Fa_Num            IN VARCHAR2,
                           p_Date_From         IN DATE,
                           p_Date_To           IN DATE,
                           p_Flag_Min          IN NUMBER,
                           p_Flag_Max          IN NUMBER,
                           p_Flag_Min_Code_Ope IN NUMBER,

          T.N_ORDER OPE_NUM_TA,T.C_N_OUTLET OUTLET_NUMBER,T.C_PAY_TYP TYPE_LOG,

   FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REG_CONTRACT  T,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER  R,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE  V,
        REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
   WHERE T.D_TRADE        >= p_Date_From --'01-APR-16'
     AND T.D_TRADE        <= p_Date_To --'10-APR- 16'
     AND T.N_LOT          = ( SELECT MAX(C.N_LOT)
                              FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REG_CONTRACT C

     AND T.C_N_REGISTER   = R.C_N_REGISTER
     AND (T.C_FUND        IN ( SELECT TF1.TA_NUM FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF1 WHERE TF1.FA_NUM = p_Fa_Num) --'233438'
       OR T.C_SHARE_TYP  IN ( SELECT DISTINCT PS.C_SHARE FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE PS WHERE PS.C_MF_FUND = p_Fa_Num))
     AND T.C_FUND         = TF.TA_NUM(+)
     AND T.C_SHARE_TYP    = TF.PART_TA_CODE(+)
     AND T.C_FUND         = V.C_FUND(+)
     AND T.C_OPE          = V.C_OPE(+)
     AND T.C_OPE          IN ( SELECT DISTINCT C.CODE_OPE
                               FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE C
                               WHERE C.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                 AND C.CODE_OPE     IN ('0014','0015')
                                 AND (NVL(C.FLAG,0) = p_Flag_Min_Code_Ope
                                  OR  NVL(C.FLAG,0) = p_Flag_Max_Code_Ope));

CURSOR CR_MAIN_EF ( p_Fa_Num            IN VARCHAR2,
                    p_Date_From         IN DATE,
                    p_Date_To           IN DATE) IS
                   
    SELECT C.FA_NUM,TF.TA_NUM TA_NUMBER,
           SH.C_SHARE PART,SH.C_ISIN_CODE ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,
           C.DATE_NAV,C.DATE_CALCUL,C.DATE_NAV DATE_PUB,
           NVL(FOP_SENDDATE, CLOSEDATE) INPUT_DATE,T.CLOSEDATE TRADE_DATE,T.CLOSEDATE VALUE_DATE,T.OPE_CODE,T.FOP_DESCR,
           DECODE(REGEXP_INSTR(P.PTA_REG_ACC,'-'),0,NVL(P.PTA_REG_ACC,0),TRIM(SUBSTR(P.PTA_REG_ACC,REGEXP_INSTR(P.PTA_REG_ACC,'-')+1))) PTA_REG_ACC,               
           P.REGISTER_SHORTCODE,P.REGISTER_NAME,T.NBSHARES,N.NAP_PRICE_PART,
           NVL(T.COMMITTEDAMOUNT1,0) COMMITMENT,
           (NVL(T.AMOUNT02,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT03,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT04,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT18,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT40,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT19,0) + 
             NVL(T.AMOUNT06,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT20,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT09,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT21,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT12,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT22,0)) TOTAL_CALL,
           (NVL(T.AMOUNT13,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT14,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT17,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT23,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT25,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT24,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT28,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT26,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT29,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT88,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT61,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT89,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT62,0) + 
            NVL(T.AMOUNT90,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT63,0)) TOTAL_DISTRIBUTION,
           NVL(T.AMOUNT02,0) CAPITAL_INVESTED,
           (NVL(T.AMOUNT04,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT18,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT40,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT19,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT93,0)) MGNT_FEES,
           (NVL(T.AMOUNT06,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT20,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT12,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT22,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT94,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT95,0)) OTHER_FEES,
           NVL(T.AMOUNT24,0) RETURN_OF_CAPITAL,
           NVL(T.AMOUNT39,0) REDRAWABLE,
           (NVL(T.AMOUNT17,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT71,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT72,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT73,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT74,0) + --NVL(T.AMOUNT86,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT87,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT88,0) + 
            NVL(T.AMOUNT61,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT97,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT98,0)) GAIN_LOSSES,
           (NVL(T.AMOUNT09,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT14,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT90,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT63,0)) INTERESTS,
           (NVL(T.AMOUNT13,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT89,0) + NVL(T.AMOUNT62,0)) DIVIDENDS,
           NVL(T.AMOUNT95,0) OTHER_INCOME,
           NULL TOTAL_INCOMES,NULL OPT_OP_DATE_REC       
    from EFRONT.ORIG_EF_ACCOUNT_INVESTOR T,  
         EFRONT.DATA_EF_POS_TA P,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_PTF_SHARE SH,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C,
         EFRONT.DATA_EF_NAV_PART N,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF         
    WHERE T.CLOSING_ID IN ( SELECT CL.CLOSING_ID 
                            FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING CL 
                            WHERE CL.FA_NUM    = p_Fa_Num --'442876'
                              AND CL.DATE_NAV >= p_Date_From --'01-JAN-17'
                              AND CL.DATE_NAV <= p_Date_To --'01-JAN-17'
                          )
      AND T.CLOSING_ID   = C.CLOSING_ID
      AND T.CLOSING_ID   = P.CLOSING_ID
      AND T.SUBSCRIBER   = P.INVESTOR_ID
      AND T.FUNDSHARE    = P.SHARE_ID
      AND T.FUNDSHARE    = SH.SHARE_ID
      AND SH.C_ISIN_CODE = TF.ISIN_CODE
      AND C.FA_NUM       = N.NAP_FUND_NO
      AND C.DATE_NAV     = N.NAP_DATE_NAV
      AND SH.C_SHARE     = N.NAP_TPARTS
      AND T.OPE_CODE     IN ( SELECT CO.OPERATION_CODE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_SETUP_EF_CODE_OPE CO WHERE CO.FLAG_TA_SUB_RED = 1 );

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Sub_Red';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Nettoyage
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED T
WHERE T.USER_ID      =  p_User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

-- Nb Fonds FlagÃ©s
FOR VCR_NB_FONDS IN ( SELECT COUNT(T.FA_NUM) NB_FONDS
                      FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS T
                      WHERE T.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                      AND T.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

    IF p_Date_From <> p_Date_To AND
       NVL(VCR_NB_FONDS.NB_FONDS,0) <= v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Period THEN

       v_Archive := TRUE;
    END IF;

    IF p_Date_From = p_Date_To AND
       NVL(VCR_NB_FONDS.NB_FONDS,0) <= v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Date THEN

       v_Archive := TRUE;
    END IF;
    EXIT;
END LOOP;

CASE p_Reg_Type
     -- Tous les registres
     WHEN 1 THEN
          v_Flag_Min := 0;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;

     -- Registres sÃ©lectionnÃ©s
     WHEN 2 THEN
          v_Flag_Min := 1;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;

     --
     ELSE
          v_Flag_Min := 0;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;
END CASE;

--
CASE p_Code_Ope_Type
     -- Tous les codes opÃ©
     WHEN 1 THEN
          v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope := 0;
          v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope := 1;

     -- Codes opÃ© sÃ©lectionnÃ©s
     WHEN 2 THEN
          v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope := 1;
          v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope := 1;

     --
     ELSE
          v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope := 0;
          v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope := 1;
END CASE;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
FOR VCR_FONDS IN CR_FONDS (v_Date_To) LOOP

    -- RÃ©cup des dates from et to si LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY
    v_Date_From        := TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
    v_Date_To          := TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');
    v_Compartiment_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY);
    v_Fa_Ref_Num       := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_REF,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM);
    v_Pool_Num         := GET_FUND_NUM_POOL(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_To);

    vg_eFront          := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT;
    vg_eFront_Date     := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE;

    v_Date_From_TA     := NULL;
    v_Date_To_TA       := NULL;  
    v_Date_From_EF     := NULL;
    v_Date_To_EF       := NULL;  

    IF vg_eFront = 0 OR (vg_eFront = 1 AND vg_eFront_Date > v_Date_To) THEN
      
        CASE 
            WHEN p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN    
    
               IF VCR_FONDS.CALCUL IN ('21') THEN

                   FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV (VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE) LOOP
                       v_Date_To := VCR_DATE_NAV.NAV_DATE_NAV;
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;

                   v_Date_From := TRUNC(TO_DATE(v_Date_To),'MONTH');

                   PKG_TURNOVER_WD.Get_Period_Sub_Red(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,v_Date_To,v_Date_From,v_Date_To);

                   v_date_from :=ADD_MONTHS(v_date_from,-1);
                   v_Date_To   :=v_Date_To-1;

                   ELSE

                   FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV (VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE) LOOP
                       v_Date_Nav_To := VCR_DATE_NAV.NAV_DATE_NAV;
                       v_Date_To     := VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_CALCUL - 1;
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;

                   FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV (VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_To-1) LOOP
                       v_Date_Nav_From := VCR_DATE_NAV.NAV_DATE_NAV;
                       v_Date_From     := VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_CALCUL;
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;

               END IF;    
            WHEN p_Period_Type = 'BEFORE_LAST_TRADE_DATE' THEN        
               get_Date_Last_Published_Day( 2, VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                            v_Date_From,v_Date_To);        
            ELSE
                NULL;          
        END CASE;

        v_Date_From_TA := v_Date_From;
        v_Date_To_TA   := v_Date_To;          

        ELSE
    
        CASE 
            WHEN p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN

               FOR VCR_DATE_NAV_EF IN CR_DATE_NAV_EF(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE) LOOP
                   v_Date_From   := VCR_DATE_NAV_EF.DATE_NAV;
                   v_Date_To     := VCR_DATE_NAV_EF.DATE_NAV;
                   EXIT;
               END LOOP;

               v_Date_From_EF := v_Date_From;
               v_Date_To_EF   := v_Date_To; 
                             
            WHEN p_Period_Type = 'BEFORE_LAST_TRADE_DATE' THEN        
               get_Date_Last_Published_Day( 2, VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                            v_Date_From_EF,v_Date_To_EF); 
                                    
            ELSE

            CASE
               -- Tous dans eFront
               WHEN vg_eFront_Date <= v_Date_From THEN

                    v_Date_From_EF := v_Date_From;
                    v_Date_To_EF   := v_Date_To; 

               -- Dans TA et eFront
               WHEN vg_eFront_Date > v_Date_From AND vg_eFront_Date <= v_Date_To THEN

                    IF VCR_FONDS.D_ACTIVATION = vg_eFront_Date THEN
                        v_Date_From_TA := NULL;
                        v_Date_To_TA   := NULL;

                        v_Date_From_EF := vg_eFront_Date;
                        v_Date_To_EF   := v_Date_To;                     
                    ELSE                                           
                        v_Date_From_TA := v_Date_From;
                        v_Date_To_TA   := vg_eFront_Date;

                        v_Date_From_EF := vg_eFront_Date + 1;
                        v_Date_To_EF   := v_Date_To;                     
                    END IF;
               ELSE
                    NULL;                                                       
            END CASE;

        END CASE;

    END IF;

    ------------------------------------------
    --                  TA                  --
    ------------------------------------------

    --Regarde si il y a des opÃ©rations dans l'archive
    IF v_Date_From_TA IS NOT NULL AND v_Date_To_TA IS NOT NULL THEN

        -- Regarde si il y a des opÃ©rations dans l'archive
        v_Nb_Ope_Archive := 0;
        IF v_Archive = TRUE THEN
           FOR VCR_NB_OPE IN CR_NB_OPE_ARC (VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From_TA,v_Date_To_TA) LOOP
               v_Nb_Ope_Archive := NVL(VCR_NB_OPE.NB_OPE,0);
               EXIT;
           END LOOP;
        END IF;

        CASE p_Version

             WHEN 1 THEN

                FOR X IN CR_MAIN_V1( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From_TA,v_Date_To_TA,
                                     v_Flag_Min,v_Flag_Max,
                                     v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope,v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope) LOOP

                    r_Row           := NULL;

                    r_Row.Ef_Flag   := 0;

                    -- LTA-1110 : RÃ©cupÃ©rer le vrai FA_NUM depuis TAB_FND_MAIN pour les opÃ©rations de merge
                    -- au lieu d'utiliser systÃ©matiquement VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM (le fonds de rÃ©fÃ©rence)
                    -- StratÃ©gie : matcher par ISIN (prioritÃ© 1), sinon par TA_NUM+PART (prioritÃ© 2),
                    -- sinon par TA_NUM seul avec la date d'activation la plus rÃ©cente (prioritÃ© 3)
                    BEGIN
                      SELECT TF.FA_NUM, TF.FUND_NAME, TF.FUND_CCY
                      INTO   r_Row.Fa_Num, r_Row.Fund_Name, r_Row.Fund_Ccy
                      FROM   REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
                      WHERE  TF.TA_NUM = X.TA_NUMBER
                        AND  (   (X.ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TF.ISIN_CODE = X.ISIN_CODE)  -- PrioritÃ© 1: match ISIN
                              OR (X.ISIN_CODE IS NULL AND TF.PART_FA_CODE = X.PART)        -- PrioritÃ© 2: match PART si pas d'ISIN
                              OR (X.ISIN_CODE IS NULL AND X.PART IS NULL))                 -- PrioritÃ© 3: TA_NUM seul
                      ORDER BY TF.D_ACTIVATION DESC NULLS LAST  -- En cas de doublons, prendre le plus rÃ©cent
                      FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY;
                    EXCEPTION
                      WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                        -- Fallback sur le fonds de rÃ©fÃ©rence si TA_NUM non trouvÃ©
                        r_Row.Fa_Num    := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
                        r_Row.Fund_Name := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
                        r_Row.Fund_Ccy  := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;
                    END;

                    r_Row.Ta_Number := X.TA_NUMBER;
                    r_Row.Code_Isin := X.ISIN_CODE;
                    r_Row.Part_Ccy  := X.PART_CCY;

                    IF r_Row.Code_Isin IS NULL THEN
                        FOR X1 IN ( SELECT T.C_N_ID
                                    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE  T
                                    WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = r_Row.Fa_Num
                                      AND T.C_SHARE   = X.PART
                                    ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC ) LOOP

                            r_Row.Code_Isin := REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC_TA(X1.C_N_ID);
                            EXIT;
                        END LOOP;
                    END IF;

                    -- RÃ©cup des infos dans la devise de quotation/paiement
                    r_Row.Ope_Qty               := NVL(X.OPT_QUANTITY,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy              := X.QUOT_CCY;
                    r_Row.Price                 := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_PRICE,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount   := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission   := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,0);

                    -- Calcul des montants dans la devise de la part
                    IF r_Row.Part_Ccy = r_Row.Quot_Ccy THEN
                       r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := r_Row.Price;
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount        := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Commission        := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,0);
                       ELSE
                       r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := NVL(X.PRICE_FUND_CCY,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Qty * r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy,2);
                       IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission = 0 THEN
                           r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount := r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount;
                           r_Row.Ope_Commission := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission;
                          ELSE
                           v_Tx_Ch := 1;
                           IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount <> 0 THEN
                               v_Tx_Ch := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount / r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount,10);
                           END IF;

                           r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount * v_Tx_Ch,2);
                           r_Row.Ope_Commission := r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount -  r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount;
                       END IF;
                    END IF;

                    -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport
                    r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_FOR_PRICE_OPE_TA(r_Row.Fa_Num,X.INPUT_DATE_TRUNC);
                    r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa := REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                    r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                    CASE
                         -- Pas de devise => devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NULL THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                         -- Devise de la part
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                         -- Devise du fonds
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Fund_Ccy;
                         -- Devise du compartiments
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '3' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,r_Row.Fund_Ccy);
                         -- Devise passÃ©e en paramÃ¨tre
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NOT NULL THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := p_Report_Ccy;
                         ELSE
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                    END CASE;

                    -- Taux de change
                    CASE
                         -- Devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                         WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Part_Ccy THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := 1;
                         -- Devise du fonds
                         WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Fund_Ccy AND r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                              IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Fund_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                              END IF;
                         -- Devise du compartiments
                         WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                              IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,v_Compartiment_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                              END IF;
                         ELSE
                              v_part_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_row.part_ccy, 1);
                              v_report_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_Row.Rep_Ccy, 2);
                              
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := v_part_exrate * v_report_exrate;
                              IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 THEN
                                  r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_CM(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa,r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa);
                                  IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 AND v_Pool_Num IS NOT NULL THEN
                                     r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                                  END IF;                        
                              END IF;
                    END CASE;

                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Commission * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price        := ROUND(r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,6);

                    --DBY - Projet GREC - 22/10/2014.
                    execute immediate
                        'begin repadmin.pkg_oe_ext_ref_client.get_client_code_and_name('
                        ||'  p_order_ref=>:param1'
                        ||' ,p_norder=>:param2'
                        ||' ,p_noutlet=>:param3'
                        ||' ,p_type_log=>:param4'
                        ||' ,p_coperation=>:param5'
                        ||' ,p_client_code=>:param6'
                        ||' ,p_client_name=>:param7'
                        ||'); end;'
                    using in X.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN, --NORDER_EXTERN
                          in X.OPE_NUM_TA, --NORDER
                          in X.OUTLET_NUMBER, --NOUTLET
                          in X.TYPE_LOG, --TYPE_LOG
                          in X.OPT_OP_CODE, --COPERATION
                          out r_Row.CLIENT_CODE,
                          out r_Row.CLIENT_NAME
                    ;

                    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED

                    SELECT X.REGISTER_NUMBER,

                       r_Row.Price,

                       X.N_DAYS,

                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price,
                       r_Row.CLIENT_CODE, --X.OPT_CLIENT_CODE,
                       r_Row.CLIENT_NAME, --X.OPT_CLIENT_NAME,

                IF v_Archive = TRUE AND v_Nb_Ope_Archive > 0 THEN

                    FOR X IN CR_MAIN_V1_ARC( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From_TA,v_Date_To_TA,

                        r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission   := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,0);

                        -- Calcul des montants dans la devise de la part
                        IF r_Row.Part_Ccy = r_Row.Quot_Ccy THEN
                           r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := r_Row.Price;

                           r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Qty * r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy,2);
                           IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission = 0 THEN

                           END IF;

                        -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport

                        r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa := REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                        r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                        CASE

                                  r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                             -- Devise de la part
                             WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN

                             -- Devise du fonds
                             WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN

                        r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);

                           r_Row.Ta_Number,

                           VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME,
                           VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY,
                           X.PART,

                           CAST(X.CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER AS NUMBER),
                           X.CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
                           X.CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
                           p_user_id,
                           v_date_creation,
                           X.OPE_NUM_TA,
                           X.OUTLET_NUMBER,
                           X.TYPE_LOG,
                           r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,
                           r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa,
                           r_Row.Price,
                           r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy,
                           X.N_DAYS,
                           r_Row.Rep_Ccy,
                           r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,
                           r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount,
                           r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount,
                           r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission,
                           r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price,
                           r_Row.CLIENT_CODE, --X.OPT_CLIENT_CODE,
                           r_Row.CLIENT_NAME, --X.OPT_CLIENT_NAME,
                           r_Row.Quot_Ccy,
                           r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount,
                           r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount,
                           r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission,
                           r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa,
                           X.OPT_OP_DATE_REC,
                           r_Row.Ef_Flag
                        FROM DUAL
                        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED W
                            WHERE W.user_id = p_user_id
                              AND W.ope_num_ta = X.OPE_NUM_TA
                              AND W.ope_outlet_number = X.OUTLET_NUMBER
                              AND W.ope_code = X.OPT_OP_CODE
                        );

                    END LOOP;

                END IF;

                -- Insertion des opÃ©rations (reprise '0014' et split '0015') non reprises dans OP_TA (ni cash_log_file)
                FOR VCR_REG IN CR_REG_CONTRACT_V1( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From_TA,v_Date_To_TA,
                                             v_Flag_Min,v_Flag_Max,
                                             v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope,v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope) LOOP

                    r_Row           := NULL;

                    r_Row.Ef_Flag   := 0;
                    r_Row.Fa_Num    := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
                    r_Row.Fund_Name := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
                    r_Row.Fund_Ccy  := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;

                    r_Row.Ta_Number := VCR_REG.TA_NUMBER;
                    r_Row.Code_Isin := VCR_REG.ISIN_CODE;
                    r_Row.Part_Ccy  := VCR_REG.PART_CCY;

                    IF r_Row.Code_Isin IS NULL THEN
                        FOR X1 IN ( SELECT T.C_N_ID
                                    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE  T
                                    WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = r_Row.Fa_Num
                                      AND T.C_SHARE   = VCR_REG.PART
                                    ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC ) LOOP

                            r_Row.Code_Isin := REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC_TA(X1.C_N_ID);
                            EXIT;
                        END LOOP;
                    END IF;

                    -- RÃ©cup des infos dans la devise de quotation/paiement
                    r_Row.Ope_Qty               := NVL(VCR_REG.OPT_QUANTITY,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy              := VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY;
                    r_Row.Price                 := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_PRICE,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount   := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission   := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,0);

                    -- Calcul des montants dans la devise de la part
                    IF r_Row.Part_Ccy = r_Row.Quot_Ccy THEN
                       r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := r_Row.Price;
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount        := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Commission        := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,0);
                       ELSE
                       r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := NVL(VCR_REG.PRICE_FUND_CCY,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Qty * r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy,2);
                       IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission = 0 THEN
                           r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount := r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount;
                           r_Row.Ope_Commission := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission;
                          ELSE
                           v_Tx_Ch := 1;
                           IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount <> 0 THEN
                               v_Tx_Ch := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount / r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount,10);
                           END IF;

                           r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount * v_Tx_Ch,2);
                           r_Row.Ope_Commission := r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount -  r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount;
                       END IF;
                    END IF;

                    -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport
                    r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_FOR_PRICE_OPE_TA(r_Row.Fa_Num,VCR_REG.INPUT_DATE_TRUNC);
                    r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa := REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                    r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                    CASE
                         -- Pas de devise => devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NULL THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                         -- Devise de la part
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                         -- Devise du fonds
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Fund_Ccy;
                         -- Devise du compartiments
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '3' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,r_Row.Fund_Ccy);
                         -- Devise passÃ©e en paramÃ¨tre
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NOT NULL THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := p_Report_Ccy;
                         ELSE
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                    END CASE;

                    -- Taux de change
                    CASE
                         -- Devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                         WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Part_Ccy THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := 1;
                         -- Devise du fonds
                         WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Fund_Ccy AND r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                              IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Fund_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                              END IF;
                         -- Devise du compartiments
                         WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                              IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,v_Compartiment_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                              END IF;
                         ELSE
                              v_part_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_row.part_ccy, 1);
                              v_report_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_Row.Rep_Ccy, 2);
                              
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := v_part_exrate * v_report_exrate;
                              IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 THEN
                                  r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_CM(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa,r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa);
                                  IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 AND v_Pool_Num IS NOT NULL THEN
                                     r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                                  END IF;                        
                              END IF;
                    END CASE;

                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Commission * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price        := ROUND(r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,6);

                    --DBY - Projet GREC - 22/10/2014.
                    execute immediate
                        'begin repadmin.pkg_oe_ext_ref_client.get_client_code_and_name('
                        ||'  p_order_ref=>:param1'
                        ||' ,p_norder=>:param2'
                        ||' ,p_noutlet=>:param3'
                        ||' ,p_type_log=>:param4'
                        ||' ,p_coperation=>:param5'
                        ||' ,p_client_code=>:param6'
                        ||' ,p_client_name=>:param7'
                        ||'); end;'
                    using in VCR_REG.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN, --NORDER_EXTERN
                          in VCR_REG.OPE_NUM_TA, --NORDER
                          in VCR_REG.OUTLET_NUMBER, --NOUTLET
                          in VCR_REG.TYPE_LOG, --TYPE_LOG
                          in VCR_REG.OPT_OP_CODE, --COPERATION
                          out r_Row.CLIENT_CODE,
                          out r_Row.CLIENT_NAME
                    ;

                    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED
                      (register_number,
                       ta_number,

                    VALUES
                      (VCR_REG.REGISTER_NUMBER,
                       r_Row.Ta_Number,
                       VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,
                       VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME,

                       r_Row.Part_Ccy,

                       p_user_id,

             WHEN 2 THEN

                FOR X IN CR_MAIN_V2( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From_TA,v_Date_To_TA,v_Flag_Min,v_Flag_Max,
                                     v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope,v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope) LOOP

                    r_Row           := NULL;

                    r_Row.Ef_Flag   := 0;

                    -- LTA-1110 : RÃ©cupÃ©rer le vrai FA_NUM depuis TAB_FND_MAIN pour les opÃ©rations de merge
                    -- au lieu d'utiliser systÃ©matiquement VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM (le fonds de rÃ©fÃ©rence)
                    -- StratÃ©gie : matcher par ISIN (prioritÃ© 1), sinon par TA_NUM+PART (prioritÃ© 2),
                    -- sinon par TA_NUM seul avec la date d'activation la plus rÃ©cente (prioritÃ© 3)
                    BEGIN
                      SELECT TF.FA_NUM, TF.FUND_NAME, TF.FUND_CCY
                      INTO   r_Row.Fa_Num, r_Row.Fund_Name, r_Row.Fund_Ccy
                      FROM   REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
                      WHERE  TF.TA_NUM = X.TA_NUMBER
                        AND  (   (X.ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TF.ISIN_CODE = X.ISIN_CODE)  -- PrioritÃ© 1: match ISIN
                              OR (X.ISIN_CODE IS NULL AND TF.PART_FA_CODE = X.PART)        -- PrioritÃ© 2: match PART si pas d'ISIN
                              OR (X.ISIN_CODE IS NULL AND X.PART IS NULL))                 -- PrioritÃ© 3: TA_NUM seul
                      ORDER BY TF.D_ACTIVATION DESC NULLS LAST  -- En cas de doublons, prendre le plus rÃ©cent
                      FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY;
                    EXCEPTION
                      WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                        -- Fallback sur le fonds de rÃ©fÃ©rence si TA_NUM non trouvÃ©
                        r_Row.Fa_Num    := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
                        r_Row.Fund_Name := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
                        r_Row.Fund_Ccy  := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;
                    END;

                    r_Row.Ta_Number := X.TA_NUMBER;
                    r_Row.Code_Isin := X.ISIN_CODE;
                    r_Row.Part_Ccy  := X.PART_CCY;

                                    WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = r_Row.Fa_Num
                                      AND T.C_SHARE   = X.PART
                                    ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC ) LOOP

                            r_Row.Code_Isin := REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC_TA(X1.C_N_ID);
                            EXIT;
                        END LOOP;
                    END IF;

                    -- RÃ©cup des infos dans la devise de quotation/paiement
                    r_Row.Ope_Qty               := NVL(X.OPT_QUANTITY,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy              := X.QUOT_CCY;
                    r_Row.Price                 := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_PRICE,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount   := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission   := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,0);

                    -- Calcul des montants dans la devise de la part
                    IF r_Row.Part_Ccy = r_Row.Quot_Ccy THEN
                       r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := r_Row.Price;
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount        := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Commission        := NVL(X.QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,0);

                       ELSE

                       r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := NVL(X.PRICE_FUND_CCY,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Qty * r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy,2);
                       IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission = 0 THEN
                           r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount := r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount;
                           r_Row.Ope_Commission := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission;
                          ELSE
                           v_Tx_Ch := 1;
                           IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount <> 0 THEN
                               v_Tx_Ch := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount / r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount,10);
                           END IF;

                           r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount * v_Tx_Ch,2);
                           r_Row.Ope_Commission := r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount -  r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount;
                       END IF;
                    END IF;

                    -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport
                    r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_FOR_PRICE_OPE_TA(r_Row.Fa_Num,X.INPUT_DATE_TRUNC);
                    r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa := REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                    r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                    CASE
                         -- Pas de devise => devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NULL THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                         -- Devise de la part
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                         -- Devise du fonds
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Fund_Ccy;
                         -- Devise du compartiments
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '3' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,r_Row.Fund_Ccy);
                         -- Devise passÃ©e en paramÃ¨tre
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NOT NULL THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := p_Report_Ccy;
                         ELSE
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                    END CASE;

                    -- Taux de change
                   CASE
                           -- Devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                           WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Part_Ccy THEN
                                r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := 1;
                           -- Devise du fonds
                           WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Fund_Ccy AND r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                                r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                                IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                                   r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Fund_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                                END IF;
                           -- Devise du compartiments
                           WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                                r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                                IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                                   r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,v_Compartiment_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                                END IF;
                           ELSE
                              v_part_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_row.part_ccy, 1);
                              v_report_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_Row.Rep_Ccy, 2);
                              
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := v_part_exrate * v_report_exrate;
                              IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 THEN
                                  r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_CM(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa,r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa);
                                  IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 AND v_Pool_Num IS NOT NULL THEN
                                     r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                                  END IF;                        
                              END IF;
                    END CASE;

                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Commission * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price        := ROUND(r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,6);

                    --DBY - Projet GREC - 22/10/2014.
                    execute immediate
                        'begin repadmin.pkg_oe_ext_ref_client.get_client_code_and_name('
                        ||'  p_order_ref=>:param1'
                        ||' ,p_norder=>:param2'
                        ||' ,p_noutlet=>:param3'
                        ||' ,p_type_log=>:param4'
                        ||' ,p_coperation=>:param5'
                        ||' ,p_client_code=>:param6'
                        ||' ,p_client_name=>:param7'
                        ||'); end;'
                    using in X.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN, --NORDER_EXTERN
                          in X.OPE_NUM_TA, --NORDER
                          in X.OUTLET_NUMBER, --NOUTLET
                          in X.TYPE_LOG, --TYPE_LOG

                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Commission * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price        := ROUND(r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,6);

                    --DBY - Projet GREC - 22/10/2014.
                    execute immediate
                        'begin repadmin.pkg_oe_ext_ref_client.get_client_code_and_name('
                        ||'  p_order_ref=>:param1'
                        ||' ,p_norder=>:param2'
                        ||' ,p_noutlet=>:param3'
                        ||' ,p_type_log=>:param4'
                        ||' ,p_coperation=>:param5'
                        ||' ,p_client_code=>:param6'
                        ||' ,p_client_name=>:param7'
                        ||'); end;'
                    using in VCR_REG.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN, --NORDER_EXTERN
                          in VCR_REG.OPE_NUM_TA, --NORDER
                          in VCR_REG.OUTLET_NUMBER, --NOUTLET
                          in VCR_REG.TYPE_LOG, --TYPE_LOG
                          in VCR_REG.OPT_OP_CODE, --COPERATION
                          out r_Row.CLIENT_CODE,
                          out r_Row.CLIENT_NAME
                    ;

                    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED
                      (register_number,
                       ta_number,
                       fa_num,
                       fund_name,
                       fund_ccy,
                       part,
                       part_ccy,
                       code_isin,
                       ope_date_input,
                       ope_date_ope,
                       ope_date_value,
                       ope_code,
                       ope_code_name,
                       ope_qty,
                       ope_gross_amount,
                       ope_net_amount,
                       ope_commission,
                       ope_commission_type,
                       ope_commission_name,
                       ope_reversal_code,
                       ope_stp_reference,
                       ope_stp_flag,
                       clearing_flag,
                       clearing_register_number,
                       clearing_register_name,
                       clearing_account,
                       user_id,
                       date_creation,
                       ope_num_ta,
                       ope_outlet_number,
                       ope_type_log,
                       date_nav_fa,
                       date_calcul_fa,
                       price,
                       price_fund_ccy,
                       ope_code_nb_days,
                       REP_CCY,
                       REP_CCY_X_RATE,
                       REP_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,
                       REP_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,
                       REP_CCY_COMMISSION,
                       REP_CCY_PRICE,
                       CLIENT_CODE,
                       CLIENT_NAME,
                       QUOT_CCY,
                       QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,
                       QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,
                       QUOT_CCY_COMMISSION,
                       DATE_PUB_FA,
                       OPE_DATE_RECEPTION,
                       EF_FLAG)
                    VALUES
                      (VCR_REG.REGISTER_NUMBER,
                       r_Row.Ta_Number,
                       VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,
                       VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME,
                       VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY,
                       VCR_REG.PART,
                       r_Row.Part_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Code_Isin,
                       VCR_REG.OPT_INPUT_DATE,
                       VCR_REG.D_TRADE,
                       VCR_REG.D_VALUE,
                       VCR_REG.OPT_OP_CODE,
                       VCR_REG.OPE_CODE_NAME,
                       r_Row.Ope_Qty,
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount,
                       r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount,
                       r_Row.Ope_Commission,
                       VCR_REG.OPT_COMM_TYPE,
                       VCR_REG.TYPE_COM,
                       VCR_REG.EXT_CODE,
                       VCR_REG.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,
                       VCR_REG.OPE_STP,
                       VCR_REG.CLEARING_FLAG,
                       VCR_REG.CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
                       VCR_REG.CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
                       VCR_REG.CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
                       p_user_id,
                       v_date_creation,
                       VCR_REG.OPE_NUM_TA,
                       VCR_REG.OUTLET_NUMBER,
                       VCR_REG.TYPE_LOG,
                       r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,
                       r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa,
                       r_Row.Price,
                       r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy,
                       VCR_REG.N_DAYS,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price,
                       r_Row.CLIENT_CODE, --X.OPT_CLIENT_CODE,
                       r_Row.CLIENT_NAME, --X.OPT_CLIENT_NAME,
                       r_Row.Quot_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount,
                       r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount,
                       r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission,
                       r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa,
                       VCR_REG.OPT_OP_DATE_REC,
                       r_Row.Ef_Flag);

                END LOOP;

             ELSE
               NULL;
        END CASE;

    END IF;

    ----------------------------------------------
    --                  eFRONT                  --
    ----------------------------------------------
    IF v_Date_From_EF IS NOT NULL AND v_Date_To_EF IS NOT NULL THEN
      
    
        FOR X IN CR_MAIN_EF( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From_EF,v_Date_To_EF) LOOP

            r_Row           := NULL;

            r_Row.Ef_Flag   := 1;

            -- LTA-1110 : Utiliser le FA_NUM retournÃ© par le curseur EFront au lieu de VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM
            r_Row.Fa_Num    := NVL(X.FA_NUM, VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM);

            -- RÃ©cupÃ©rer le FUND_NAME et FUND_CCY depuis TAB_FND_MAIN
            -- En priorisant le matching par ISIN si disponible, sinon par PART
            BEGIN
              SELECT TF.FUND_NAME, TF.FUND_CCY
              INTO   r_Row.Fund_Name, r_Row.Fund_Ccy
              FROM   REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
              WHERE  TF.FA_NUM = r_Row.Fa_Num
                AND  (   (X.ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TF.ISIN_CODE = X.ISIN_CODE)
                      OR (X.ISIN_CODE IS NULL AND TF.PART_CCY = X.PART_CCY))
              ORDER BY TF.D_ACTIVATION DESC NULLS LAST
              FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY;
            EXCEPTION
              WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                -- Fallback sur le fonds de rÃ©fÃ©rence
                r_Row.Fund_Name := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
                r_Row.Fund_Ccy  := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;
            END;

            r_Row.Ta_Number := X.TA_NUMBER;
            r_Row.Code_Isin := X.ISIN_CODE;
            r_Row.Part_Ccy  := X.PART_CCY;

            r_Row.Register_Number := X.PTA_REG_ACC;
            FOR Y IN ( SELECT R.C_N_OUTLET
                       FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER R
                       WHERE R.C_N_REGISTER = r_Row.Register_Number) LOOP

                r_Row.Ope_Outlet_Number := Y.C_N_OUTLET;
                EXIT;      
            END LOOP;          
            
            IF r_Row.Code_Isin IS NULL THEN
                FOR X1 IN ( SELECT T.C_N_ID
                            FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE  T
                            WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = r_Row.Fa_Num
                              AND T.C_SHARE   = X.PART
                            ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC ) LOOP

                    r_Row.Code_Isin := REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC_TA(X1.C_N_ID);
                    EXIT;
                END LOOP;
            END IF;

            -- RÃ©cup des infos dans la devise de quotation/paiement
            r_Row.Ope_Qty               := NVL(X.NBSHARES,0);
            r_Row.Quot_Ccy              := NULL; --X.QUOT_CCY;
            IF r_Row.Ope_Qty <> 0 THEN
               r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount := NVL(X.TOTAL_CALL,0);
               r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount   := NVL(X.TOTAL_CALL,0);
               r_Row.Price                 := ROUND(r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount / r_Row.Ope_Qty,2);
               ELSE
               r_Row.Price                 := 0;
               r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount := 0;
               r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount   := 0;
            END IF;
            r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission   := 0;

            -- Calcul des montants dans la devise de la part
            r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := r_Row.Price;
            r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount;
            r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount        := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount;
            r_Row.Ope_Commission        := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission;

            -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport
            r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa           := X.DATE_NAV;
            r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa        := X.DATE_CALCUL;
            r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa           := X.DATE_PUB;

            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMITMENT := X.COMMITMENT;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CALL       := X.TOTAL_CALL;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI     := X.TOTAL_DISTRIBUTION;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CAPITAL    := X.CAPITAL_INVESTED;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_MGNT_FEES  := X.MGNT_FEES;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_FEES   := X.OTHER_FEES;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_RETURN_CAP := X.RETURN_OF_CAPITAL;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DEDRAWABLE := X.REDRAWABLE;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_GL         := X.GAIN_LOSSES;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_INTERESTS  := X.INTERESTS;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DIVIDENDS  := X.DIVIDENDS;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_INC    := X.OTHER_INCOME;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_TOT_INC    := X.TOTAL_INCOMES;
            
            IF NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMITMENT,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CALL,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI,0) + 
               NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CAPITAL,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_MGNT_FEES,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_FEES,0) +
               NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_RETURN_CAP,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DEDRAWABLE,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_GL,0) +
               NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_INTERESTS,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DIVIDENDS,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_INC,0) +
               NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_TOT_INC,0) = 0 THEN
               
               GOTO CR_MAIN_EF_SUIVANT;  
            
            END IF;
             
            CASE
                 -- Pas de devise => devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NULL THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                 -- Devise de la part
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                 -- Devise du fonds
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Fund_Ccy;
                 -- Devise du compartiments
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '3' THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,r_Row.Fund_Ccy);
                 -- Devise passÃ©e en paramÃ¨tre
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NOT NULL THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := p_Report_Ccy;
                 ELSE
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
            END CASE;

            -- Taux de change
            CASE
                 -- Devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                 WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Part_Ccy THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := 1;
                 -- Devise du fonds
                 WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Fund_Ccy AND r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                      IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                         r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Fund_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                      END IF;
                 -- Devise du compartiments
                 WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                      IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                         r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,v_Compartiment_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                      END IF;
                 ELSE
                      v_part_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_row.part_ccy, 1);
                      v_report_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_Row.Rep_Ccy, 2);
                              
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := v_part_exrate * v_report_exrate;
                      IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 THEN
                          r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_CM(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa,r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa);
                          IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 AND v_Pool_Num IS NOT NULL THEN
                             r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                          END IF;                        
                      END IF;
            END CASE;

            r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Commission * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price        := ROUND(r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,6);

            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_COMMITMENT := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMITMENT * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_CALL       := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CALL * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_DISTRI     := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_CAPITAL    := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CAPITAL * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_MGNT_FEES  := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_MGNT_FEES * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_OTH_FEES   := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_FEES * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_RETURN_CAP := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_RETURN_CAP * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_DEDRAWABLE := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DEDRAWABLE * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_GL         := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_GL * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_INTERESTS  := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_INTERESTS * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_DIVIDENDS  := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DIVIDENDS * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_OTH_INC    := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_INC * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_TOT_INC    := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_TOT_INC * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED
              (register_number,
               ta_number,
               fa_num,
               fund_name,
               fund_ccy,
               part,
               part_ccy,
               code_isin,
               ope_date_input,
               ope_date_ope,
               ope_date_value,
               ope_code,
               ope_code_name,
               ope_qty,
               ope_gross_amount,
               ope_net_amount,
               ope_commission,
               ope_commission_type,
               ope_commission_name,
               ope_reversal_code,
               ope_stp_reference,
               ope_stp_flag,
               clearing_flag,
               clearing_register_number,
               clearing_register_name,
               clearing_account,
               user_id,
               date_creation,
               ope_num_ta,
               ope_outlet_number,
               ope_type_log,
               date_nav_fa,
               date_calcul_fa,
               price,
               price_fund_ccy,
               ope_code_nb_days,
               REP_CCY,
               REP_CCY_X_RATE,
               REP_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,
               REP_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,
               REP_CCY_COMMISSION,
               REP_CCY_PRICE,
               CLIENT_CODE,
               CLIENT_NAME,
               QUOT_CCY,
               QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,
               QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,
               QUOT_CCY_COMMISSION,
               DATE_PUB_FA,
               OPE_DATE_RECEPTION,
               EF_FLAG,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMITMENT,               
               EF_QUOT_CCY_CALL,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_CAPITAL,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_MGNT_FEES,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_FEES,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_RETURN_CAP,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_DEDRAWABLE,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_GL,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_INTERESTS,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_DIVIDENDS,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_INC,
               EF_QUOT_CCY_TOT_INC,
               EF_REP_CCY_COMMITMENT, 
               EF_REP_CCY_CALL,
               EF_REP_CCY_DISTRI,
               EF_REP_CCY_CAPITAL,
               EF_REP_CCY_MGNT_FEES,
               EF_REP_CCY_OTH_FEES,
               EF_REP_CCY_RETURN_CAP,
               EF_REP_CCY_DEDRAWABLE,
               EF_REP_CCY_GL,
               EF_REP_CCY_INTERESTS,
               EF_REP_CCY_DIVIDENDS,
               EF_REP_CCY_OTH_INC,
               EF_REP_CCY_TOT_INC
               )
            VALUES
              (r_Row.Register_Number,
               r_Row.Ta_Number,
               VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,
               VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME,
               VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY,
               X.PART,
               r_Row.Part_Ccy,
               r_Row.Code_Isin,
               X.INPUT_DATE,
               X.TRADE_DATE,
               X.VALUE_DATE,
               X.OPE_CODE,
               X.FOP_DESCR,
               r_Row.Ope_Qty,
               r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount,
               r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount,
               r_Row.Ope_Commission,
               NULL,--X.OPT_COMM_TYPE,
               NULL,--X.TYPE_COM,
               NULL,--X.EXT_CODE,
               NULL,--X.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,
               0,--X.OPE_STP,
               NULL,--X.CLEARING_FLAG,
               NULL,--X.CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
               NULL,--X.CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
               NULL,--X.CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
               p_user_id,
               v_date_creation,
               NULL,--X.OPE_NUM_TA,
               r_Row.Ope_Outlet_Number,
               NULL, --X.TYPE_LOG,
               r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,
               r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa,
               r_Row.Price,
               r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy,
               NULL, --X.N_DAYS,
               r_Row.Rep_Ccy,
               r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,
               r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount,
               r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount,
               r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission,
               r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price,
               r_Row.CLIENT_CODE, --X.OPT_CLIENT_CODE,

               r_Row.Quot_Ccy,
