                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount   := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,0);
                    r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission   := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,0);

                    -- Calcul des montants dans la devise de la part
                    IF r_Row.Part_Ccy = r_Row.Quot_Ccy THEN
                       r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := r_Row.Price;
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount        := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Commission        := NVL(VCR_REG.QUOT_CCY_COMM_AMOUNT,0);
                       ELSE
                       r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := NVL(VCR_REG.PRICE_FUND_CCY,0);
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Qty * r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy,2);
                       IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission = 0 THEN
                           r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount := r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount;
                           r_Row.Ope_Commission := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission;
                          ELSE
                           v_Tx_Ch := 1;
                           IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount <> 0 THEN
                               v_Tx_Ch := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount / r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount,10);
                           END IF;

                           r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount * v_Tx_Ch,2);
                           r_Row.Ope_Commission := r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount -  r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount;
                       END IF;
                    END IF;

                    -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport
                    r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_FOR_PRICE_OPE_TA(r_Row.Fa_Num,VCR_REG.INPUT_DATE_TRUNC);
                    r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa := REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                    r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                    CASE
                         -- Pas de devise => devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NULL THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                         -- Devise de la part
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                         -- Devise du fonds
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Fund_Ccy;
                         -- Devise du compartiments
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '3' THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,r_Row.Fund_Ccy);
                         -- Devise passÃ©e en paramÃ¨tre
                         WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NOT NULL THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := p_Report_Ccy;
                         ELSE
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                    END CASE;

                    -- Taux de change
                    CASE
                         -- Devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                         WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Part_Ccy THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := 1;
                         -- Devise du fonds
                         WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Fund_Ccy AND r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                              IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Fund_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                              END IF;
                         -- Devise du compartiments
                         WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                              IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,v_Compartiment_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                              END IF;
                         ELSE
                              v_part_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_row.part_ccy, 1);
                              v_report_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_Row.Rep_Ccy, 2);
                              
                              r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := v_part_exrate * v_report_exrate;
                              IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 THEN
                                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_CM(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa,r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa);
                                 IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 AND v_Pool_Num IS NOT NULL THEN
                                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                                 END IF;                        
                              END IF;
                    END CASE;

                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Commission * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
                    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price        := ROUND(r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,6);

                    --DBY - Projet GREC - 22/10/2014.
                    execute immediate
                        'begin repadmin.pkg_oe_ext_ref_client.get_client_code_and_name('
                        ||'  p_order_ref=>:param1'
                        ||' ,p_norder=>:param2'
                        ||' ,p_noutlet=>:param3'
                        ||' ,p_type_log=>:param4'
                        ||' ,p_coperation=>:param5'
                        ||' ,p_client_code=>:param6'
                        ||' ,p_client_name=>:param7'
                        ||'); end;'
                    using in VCR_REG.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN, --NORDER_EXTERN
                          in VCR_REG.OPE_NUM_TA, --NORDER
                          in VCR_REG.OUTLET_NUMBER, --NOUTLET
                          in VCR_REG.TYPE_LOG, --TYPE_LOG
                          in VCR_REG.OPT_OP_CODE, --COPERATION
                          out r_Row.CLIENT_CODE,
                          out r_Row.CLIENT_NAME
                    ;

                    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED
                      (register_number,
                       ta_number,
                       fa_num,
                       fund_name,
                       fund_ccy,
                       part,
                       part_ccy,
                       code_isin,
                       ope_date_input,
                       ope_date_ope,
                       ope_date_value,
                       ope_code,
                       ope_code_name,
                       ope_qty,
                       ope_gross_amount,
                       ope_net_amount,
                       ope_commission,
                       ope_commission_type,
                       ope_commission_name,
                       ope_reversal_code,
                       ope_stp_reference,
                       ope_stp_flag,
                       clearing_flag,
                       clearing_register_number,
                       clearing_register_name,
                       clearing_account,
                       user_id,
                       date_creation,
                       ope_num_ta,
                       ope_outlet_number,
                       ope_type_log,
                       date_nav_fa,
                       date_calcul_fa,
                       price,
                       price_fund_ccy,
                       ope_code_nb_days,
                       REP_CCY,
                       REP_CCY_X_RATE,
                       REP_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,
                       REP_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,
                       REP_CCY_COMMISSION,
                       REP_CCY_PRICE,
                       CLIENT_CODE,
                       CLIENT_NAME,
                       QUOT_CCY,
                       QUOT_CCY_GROSS_AMOUNT,
                       QUOT_CCY_NET_AMOUNT,
                       QUOT_CCY_COMMISSION,
                       DATE_PUB_FA,
                       OPE_DATE_RECEPTION,
                       EF_FLAG)
                    VALUES
                      (VCR_REG.REGISTER_NUMBER,
                       r_Row.Ta_Number,
                       VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,
                       VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME,
                       VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY,
                       VCR_REG.PART,
                       r_Row.Part_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Code_Isin,
                       VCR_REG.OPT_INPUT_DATE,
                       VCR_REG.D_TRADE,
                       VCR_REG.D_VALUE,
                       VCR_REG.OPT_OP_CODE,
                       VCR_REG.OPE_CODE_NAME,
                       r_Row.Ope_Qty,
                       r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount,
                       r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount,

                       VCR_REG.OPT_COMM_TYPE,

                       VCR_REG.EXT_CODE,

                       p_user_id,
                       v_date_creation,

                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission,
                       r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price,
                       r_Row.CLIENT_CODE, --X.OPT_CLIENT_CODE,
                       r_Row.CLIENT_NAME, --X.OPT_CLIENT_NAME,
                       r_Row.Quot_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount,

                       r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission,
                       r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa,
                       VCR_REG.OPT_OP_DATE_REC,
                       r_Row.Ef_Flag);

                END LOOP;

             ELSE
               NULL;
        END CASE;

    END IF;

    ----------------------------------------------
    --                  eFRONT                  --
    ----------------------------------------------
    IF v_Date_From_EF IS NOT NULL AND v_Date_To_EF IS NOT NULL THEN
      
    
        FOR X IN CR_MAIN_EF( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From_EF,v_Date_To_EF,v_Flag_Min,v_Flag_Max) LOOP

            r_Row           := NULL;

            r_Row.Ef_Flag   := 1;

            -- LTA-1110 : Utiliser le FA_NUM retournÃ© par le curseur EFront au lieu de VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM
            r_Row.Fa_Num    := NVL(X.FA_NUM, VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM);

            -- RÃ©cupÃ©rer le FUND_NAME et FUND_CCY depuis TAB_FND_MAIN
            -- En priorisant le matching par ISIN si disponible, sinon par PART
            BEGIN
              SELECT TF.FUND_NAME, TF.FUND_CCY
              INTO   r_Row.Fund_Name, r_Row.Fund_Ccy
              FROM   REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
              WHERE  TF.FA_NUM = r_Row.Fa_Num
                AND  (   (X.ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL AND TF.ISIN_CODE = X.ISIN_CODE)
                      OR (X.ISIN_CODE IS NULL AND TF.PART_CCY = X.PART_CCY))
              ORDER BY TF.D_ACTIVATION DESC NULLS LAST
              FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY;
            EXCEPTION
              WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
                -- Fallback sur le fonds de rÃ©fÃ©rence
                r_Row.Fund_Name := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
                r_Row.Fund_Ccy  := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;
            END;

            r_Row.Ta_Number := X.TA_NUMBER;
            r_Row.Code_Isin := X.ISIN_CODE;
            r_Row.Part_Ccy  := X.PART_CCY;

            r_Row.Register_Number := X.PTA_REG_ACC;
            FOR Y IN ( SELECT R.C_N_OUTLET
                       FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER R
                       WHERE R.C_N_REGISTER = r_Row.Register_Number) LOOP

                r_Row.Ope_Outlet_Number := Y.C_N_OUTLET;
                EXIT;      
            END LOOP;          
            
            
            
            IF r_Row.Code_Isin IS NULL THEN
                FOR X1 IN ( SELECT T.C_N_ID
                            FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE  T
                            WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = r_Row.Fa_Num
                              AND T.C_SHARE   = X.PART
                            ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC ) LOOP

                    r_Row.Code_Isin := REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC_TA(X1.C_N_ID);
                    EXIT;
                END LOOP;
            END IF;

            -- RÃ©cup des infos dans la devise de quotation/paiement
            r_Row.Ope_Qty               := NVL(X.NBSHARES,0);
            r_Row.Quot_Ccy              := NULL; --X.QUOT_CCY;
            IF r_Row.Ope_Qty <> 0 THEN
               r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount := NVL(X.TOTAL_CALL,0);
               r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount   := NVL(X.TOTAL_CALL,0);
               r_Row.Price                 := ROUND(r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount / r_Row.Ope_Qty,2);
               ELSE
               r_Row.Price                 := 0;
               r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount := 0;
               r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount   := 0;
            END IF;
            r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission   := 0;

            -- Calcul des montants dans la devise de la part
            r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy        := r_Row.Price;
            r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount      := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Gross_Amount;
            r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount        := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Net_Amount;
            r_Row.Ope_Commission        := r_Row.Quot_Ccy_Commission;

            -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport
            r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa           := X.DATE_NAV;
            r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa        := X.DATE_CALCUL;
            r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa           := X.DATE_PUB;

            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMITMENT := X.COMMITMENT;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CALL       := X.TOTAL_CALL;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI     := X.TOTAL_DISTRIBUTION;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CAPITAL    := X.CAPITAL_INVESTED;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_MGNT_FEES  := X.MGNT_FEES;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_FEES   := X.OTHER_FEES;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_RETURN_CAP := X.RETURN_OF_CAPITAL;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DEDRAWABLE := X.REDRAWABLE;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_GL         := X.GAIN_LOSSES;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_INTERESTS  := X.INTERESTS;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DIVIDENDS  := X.DIVIDENDS;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_INC    := X.OTHER_INCOME;
            r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_TOT_INC    := X.TOTAL_INCOMES;

            IF NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMITMENT,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CALL,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI,0) + 
               NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CAPITAL,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_MGNT_FEES,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_FEES,0) +
               NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_RETURN_CAP,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DEDRAWABLE,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_GL,0) +
               NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_INTERESTS,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DIVIDENDS,0) + NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_INC,0) +
               NVL(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_TOT_INC,0) = 0 THEN
               
               GOTO CR_MAIN_EF_SUIVANT;  
            
            END IF;
                           
            CASE
                 -- Pas de devise => devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NULL THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                 -- Devise de la part
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                 -- Devise du fonds
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Fund_Ccy;
                 -- Devise du compartiments
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '3' THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,r_Row.Fund_Ccy);
                 -- Devise passÃ©e en paramÃ¨tre
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NOT NULL THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := p_Report_Ccy;
                 ELSE
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
            END CASE;

            -- Taux de change
            CASE
                 -- Devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                 WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Part_Ccy THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := 1;
                 -- Devise du fonds
                 WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = r_Row.Fund_Ccy AND r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                      IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                         r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Fund_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                      END IF;
                 -- Devise du compartiments
                 WHEN r_Row.Rep_Ccy = v_Compartiment_Ccy THEN
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Part_Ccy,1);
                      IF NVL(r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
                         r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,v_Compartiment_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                      END IF;
                 ELSE
                      v_part_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_row.part_ccy, 1);
                      v_report_exrate := GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF(v_Fa_Ref_Num, r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa, r_Row.Rep_Ccy, 2);
                              
                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := v_part_exrate * v_report_exrate;
                      IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 THEN
                          r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_CM(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa,r_Row.Date_Calcul_Fa,r_Row.Date_Pub_Fa);
                          IF r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate = 0 AND v_Pool_Num IS NOT NULL THEN
                             r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav_Fa);
                          END IF;                        
                      END IF;
            END CASE;

            r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Gross_Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Gross_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Net_Amount   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Net_Amount * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Commission   := ROUND(r_Row.Ope_Commission * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Price        := ROUND(r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,6);

            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_COMMITMENT := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMITMENT * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_CALL       := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CALL * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_DISTRI     := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_CAPITAL    := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_CAPITAL * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_MGNT_FEES  := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_MGNT_FEES * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_OTH_FEES   := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_FEES * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_RETURN_CAP := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_RETURN_CAP * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_DEDRAWABLE := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DEDRAWABLE * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_GL         := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_GL * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_INTERESTS  := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_INTERESTS * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_DIVIDENDS  := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_DIVIDENDS * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_OTH_INC    := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_OTH_INC * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);
            r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_TOT_INC    := ROUND(r_Row.EF_QUOT_CCY_TOT_INC * r_Row.Rep_Ccy_x_Rate,2);

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_SUB_RED
              (register_number,

               ope_type_log,

               EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMITMENT,

               EF_REP_CCY_INTERESTS,
               EF_REP_CCY_DIVIDENDS,

               )
            VALUES

               NULL,--X.OPT_COMM_TYPE,

               0,--X.OPE_STP,

               p_user_id,

               r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_OTH_INC,
               r_Row.EF_REP_CCY_TOT_INC               
               );
        
        <<CR_MAIN_EF_SUIVANT>>
        NULL;

        END LOOP;

    END IF;

END LOOP;
COMMIT;

p_status           :=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status  :=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='Erreur : ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM/*dbms_utility.format_error_stack||chr(10)||dbms_utility.format_error_backtrace*/, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Sub_Red_Filtre_Reg',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
END proc_Ta_Sub_Red_Filtre_Reg;

-------------------
-- TA : Position --
-------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Position(p_Reg_Type            IN NUMBER, -- 1 = Tous les registres, 2 = Registres FlagÃ©s
                           p_User_Id             IN VARCHAR2,
                           p_Period_Type         IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                           p_Date_Position_From  IN VARCHAR2,
                           p_Date_Position_To    IN VARCHAR2,
                           p_Date_Creation       IN VARCHAR2  DEFAULT '19000101',
                           p_Report_Ccy          IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                           p_Type_Date           IN NUMBER DEFAULT 3, -- 1 = Position Date / 2 = Trade Date / 3 = En fct du fonds
                           p_status              OUT NUMBER,
                           p_msg_err             OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                   NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err                  VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                       NUMBER;

v_date_creation            DATE:= SYSDATE;

v_Date_Position_From       DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_Position_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Position_To         DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_Position_To,'YYYYMMDD');

v_Date_Pos_Ta_From         DATE;
v_Date_Pos_Ta_To           DATE;

v_Date_Pos_EF_From         DATE;
v_Date_Pos_EF_To           DATE;

v_Trade_Date_From          DATE;
v_Trade_Date_To            DATE;

v_Pos_Date_Min             DATE:=SYSDATE-366;

--v_Tx_Change                NUMBER;
r_Row                      WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS%ROWTYPE;
v_Part_Fa                  VARCHAR2(3);

v_Archive                  BOOLEAN:=FALSE;
v_Nb_Pos_Archive           NUMBER;
v_Type_Date_Fonds          NUMBER;  -- 1 = Trade Date / 2 = Position Date
v_Date_From_Fonds          DATE;
v_Date_To_Fonds            DATE;
v_Date_Position_Fonds      DATE;
v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Period      NUMBER:=NVL(GET_GLOBAL_VAR_VALUE('TA_ARC_NB_FDS_PER'),0);
v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Date        NUMBER:=NVL(GET_GLOBAL_VAR_VALUE('TA_ARC_NB_FDS_DATE'),0);

CURSOR CR_FONDS ( p_Date_Pos_From IN DATE,
                  p_Date_Pos_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT Q.FA_NUM FUND_ID,Q.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_Pos_To) FA_NUM_REF,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_Pos_To)) FUND_CCY_REF,
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_Pos_From,1) DATE_NAV_FROM,
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_Pos_To,-1) DATE_NAV_TO,
           DECODE(TF.EFRONT,1,1,0) EFRONT,TF.EFRONT_DATE,
           DECODE(TF.EFRONT_TA,1,1,0) EFRONT_TA,TF.EFRONT_TA_DATE -- INCBP-1001039        
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
     AND Q.FLAG     = 1
     AND Q.FA_NUM   = TF.FA_NUM(+)
     AND TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA IS NOT NULL;

CURSOR CR_DATE_POS( p_Fund_Id                IN VARCHAR2,
                    p_Date_From              IN DATE,
                    p_Date_To                IN DATE) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT T.PTA_POS_DATE,T.PTA_REG_ACC REGISTRE,
           T.PTA_FUND_ID FUND_NUMBER,NVL(NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE), T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE) PART,
           --T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE PART,
           T.PTA_QUANTITY QTY,T.PTA_NAV,T.PTA_AMOUNT AMOUNT,T.PTA_NAV_DATE,
           T.PTA_FUND_TK CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,
           TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,T.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY QUOT_CCY_CODE_TA,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES',T.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY) QUOT_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA  T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
    WHERE T.PTA_POS_DATE        BETWEEN p_Date_From AND p_Date_To --'30-SEP-10'
--      AND T.PTA_FUND_TK         = TF.TELEKURS_CODE(+)
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID         = p_Fund_Id
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID         = TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA(+)
      AND T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE       = TF.Part_Ta_Code(+) -- LUXIAM1957
      AND NVL(T.PTA_QUANTITY,0) <> 0
      AND T.PTA_NAV_DATE        IS NOT NULL;

CURSOR CR_DATE_POS_ARC ( p_Fund_Id                IN VARCHAR2,
                         p_Date_From              IN DATE,
                         p_Date_To                IN DATE) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT T.PTA_POS_DATE,T.PTA_REG_ACC REGISTRE,
           T.PTA_FUND_ID FUND_NUMBER,NVL(NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE), T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE) PART,
           --T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE PART,
           T.PTA_QUANTITY QTY,T.PTA_NAV,T.PTA_AMOUNT AMOUNT,T.PTA_NAV_DATE,
           T.PTA_FUND_TK CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,
           TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,T.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY QUOT_CCY_CODE_TA,
           GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES',T.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY) QUOT_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA_ARC  T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
    WHERE T.PTA_POS_DATE BETWEEN p_Date_From AND p_Date_To --'30-SEP-10'
--      AND T.PTA_FUND_TK         = TF.TELEKURS_CODE(+)
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID         = p_Fund_Id
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID         = TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA(+)
      AND T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE       = TF.Part_Ta_Code(+) -- LUXIAM1957
      AND NVL(T.PTA_QUANTITY,0) <> 0;

CURSOR CR_TRADE_DATE( p_Fund_Id                IN VARCHAR2,
                      p_TradeDate_From         IN DATE,
                      p_TradeDate_To           IN DATE) IS

    SELECT P.PTA_S_POS_DATE POS_DATE,P.PTA_REG_ACC REGISTER_NUMBER,
           TF.FA_NUM FUND_NUMBER,NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE) PART,
           P.PTA_QUANTITY QTY,T.P_SHARE,ROUND(P.PTA_QUANTITY * T.P_SHARE,2) AMOUNT,T.D_NAVDATE DATE_NAV_TA,
           TF.TELEKURS_CODE CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,
           TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,T.C_CURRENCY QUOT_CCY_CODE_TA,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES',T.C_CURRENCY) QUOT_CCY,
           REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_DATE_PUB(TF.FA_NUM,T.D_NAVDATE) DATE_NAV,
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(TF.FA_NUM,REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_DATE_PUB(TF.FA_NUM,T.D_NAVDATE)) POSITION_DATE
    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_NAV_SHARE_PRICE T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF,
         REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS P
    WHERE T.D_NAVDATE           >= p_TradeDate_From
      AND T.D_NAVDATE           <= p_TradeDate_To
      AND P.PTA_FUND_ID         = p_Fund_Id
      AND T.C_FUND              = TF.TA_NUM
      AND T.C_SHARE_TYP         = TF.Part_Ta_Code
      AND T.C_FUND              = P.PTA_TAFUND_ID
      AND T.C_SHARE_TYP         = P.PTA_UNIT_TYPE
      AND P.PTA_S_POS_DATE      <= T.D_APPLICATION
      AND P.PTA_E_POS_DATE      >= T.D_APPLICATION -- INCPB-543894
      AND NVL(P.PTA_QUANTITY,0) <> 0;

CURSOR CR_TB_FONDS(p_Code_Isin IN VARCHAR2) IS

    SELECT TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,TF.PART_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
    WHERE TF.ISIN_CODE = p_Code_Isin;

CURSOR CR_NB_DATE_POS_ARC ( p_Fa_Num    IN VARCHAR2,
                            p_Date_From IN DATE) IS

   SELECT COUNT(T.PTA_FUND_ID) NB_POS
   FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA_ARC  T
   WHERE T.PTA_POS_DATE >= p_Date_From --'01-JAN-08'
     AND T.PTA_FUND_ID  = p_Fa_Num;

CURSOR CR_NB_TRADE_DATE_ARC ( p_Fa_Num    IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_Date_From IN DATE) IS

   SELECT COUNT(T.PTA_FUND_ID) NB_POS
   FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA_ARC  T
   WHERE T.PTA_NAV_DATE >= p_Date_From --'01-JAN-08'
     AND T.PTA_FUND_ID  = p_Fa_Num;

CURSOR CR_NUM_TA ( p_Fund_Id       IN VARCHAR2,
                   p_Quotation_Ccy IN VARCHAR2) IS
   SELECT T.C_FUND
   FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUNDS T
   WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = p_Fund_Id
     AND T.C_CCY     = p_Quotation_Ccy
   ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC;

CURSOR CR_MAIN_EF ( p_Fund_Id      IN VARCHAR2,
                    p_DateNav_From IN DATE,
                    p_DateNav_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT C.DATE_NAV POS_DATE,
           DECODE(REGEXP_INSTR(T.PTA_REG_ACC,'-'),0,NVL(T.PTA_REG_ACC,0),TRIM(SUBSTR(T.PTA_REG_ACC,REGEXP_INSTR(T.PTA_REG_ACC,'-')+1))) REGISTER_NUMBER,                   
           C.FA_NUM FUND_NUMBER,T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE PART,
           T.PTA_QUANTITY QTY,N.NAP_PRICE_PART P_SHARE,ROUND(T.PTA_QUANTITY * N.NAP_PRICE_PART,2) AMOUNT,
           C.DATE_NAV DATE_NAV_TA,TF.TELEKURS_CODE CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,
           NULL QUOTATION_CCY_CODE_TA,TF.PART_CCY QUOT_CCY,C.DATE_NAV,C.DATE_NAV POSITION_DATE,
           --T.REGISTER_NAME,
           T.COMMITMENT,T.CALLS,T.DISTRI,T.REDRAWABLE,T.RCTI,
           T.COMMITMENT_SHR_CCY,T.CALLS_SHR_CCY,T.DISTRI_SHR_CCY,T.REDRAWABLE_SHR_CCY,T.RCTI_SHR_CCY
    FROM EFRONT.DATA_EF_POS_TA T,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C,
         EFRONT.DATA_EF_NAV_PART N,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE T.CLOSING_ID IN ( SELECT CL.CLOSING_ID 
                            FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING CL 
                            WHERE CL.FA_NUM    = p_Fund_Id --'442876'
                              AND CL.DATE_NAV >= p_DateNav_From --'01-JAN-17'
                              AND CL.DATE_NAV <= p_DateNav_To --'31-DEC-20'                              
                           )
      AND T.CLOSING_ID    = C.CLOSING_ID
      AND T.PTA_QUANTITY  IS NOT NULL
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID   = N.NAP_FUND_NO
      AND T.PTA_POS_DATE  = N.NAP_DATE_NAV
      AND T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE = N.NAP_TPARTS
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID   = TF.FA_NUM
      AND T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE = TF.PART_FA_CODE;

--INCPB-1001039
CURSOR CR_NAV_PARTS ( p_SubFund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                      p_DateNav_From   IN DATE,
                      p_DateNav_To     IN DATE) IS
                      
    SELECT N.NAP_DATE_NAV POS_DATE,
           N.NAP_FUND_NO FUND_NUMBER,
           N.NAP_QT_PART,N.NAP_PRICE_PART,
           N.NAP_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV_TA,TF.TELEKURS_CODE CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,
           NULL QUOTATION_CCY_CODE_TA,TF.PART_CCY QUOT_CCY,N.NAP_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV,
           REPADMIN.GET_LAST_DATE_NAV_POS_TA_EFRONT(TF.ISIN_CODE,N.NAP_DATE_NAV) LAST_DATE_NAV_POS_TA
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS N,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE N.NAP_FUND_NO          = p_SubFund_Number--'256546' --'442876'
      AND N.NAP_DATE_NAV        >= p_DateNav_From --'01-JAN-18'
      AND N.NAP_DATE_NAV        <= p_DateNav_To --'31-DEC-22'                              
      AND N.NAP_FUND_NO         = TF.FA_NUM
      AND N.NAP_TPARTS          = TF.PART_FA_CODE
      AND b.fund_no = n.nap_fund_no
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND n.nap_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                        -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
      ;

--INCPB-1001039
CURSOR CR_DATA_PETAL_POSITIONS ( p_Isin_Code IN VARCHAR2,
                                 p_DateNav   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.REGISTER_ID REGISTER_NUMBER,                   
           T.POS_QUANTITY QTY,
           --T.REGISTER_NAME,
           T.OPE_COMMITMENT,T.OPE_CAPITAL_CALLED,T.OPE_DISTRIBUTION,NULL OPE_REDRAWABLE,NULL OPE_RCTI,
           T.OPE_COMMITMENT_SHR_CCY,T.OPE_CAPITAL_CALLED_SHR_CCY,T.OPE_DISTRIBUTION_SHR_CCY,NULL OPE_REDRAWABLE_SHR_CCY,NULL OPE_RCTI_SHR_CCY
    FROM EFRONT.DATA_PETAL_POSITIONS T
    WHERE T.ISIN_CODE           = p_Isin_Code --'256546' --'442876'
      AND T.POS_NAV_DATE        = p_DateNav  --'01-JAN-18'
      AND NVL(T.POS_QUANTITY,0) > 0
      AND T.OPE_INDEX           = ( SELECT MAX(PO.OPE_INDEX) FROM EFRONT.DATA_PETAL_POSITIONS PO
                                    WHERE PO.SHARECLASS_ID = T.SHARECLASS_ID
                                      AND PO.POS_NAV_DATE  = T.POS_NAV_DATE
                                      AND PO.REGISTER_ID   = T.REGISTER_ID
                                      AND PO.INVESTOR_ID   = T.INVESTOR_ID
                                   )
      ;
            
Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Position';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Nettoyage
DELETE FROM WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS T
WHERE T.USER_ID      =  p_User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

-- Nb Fonds FlagÃ©s
FOR VCR_NB_FONDS IN ( SELECT COUNT(T.FA_NUM) NB_FONDS
                      FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS T
                      WHERE T.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                      AND T.FLAG    = 1) LOOP


    IF v_Date_Position_From <> v_Date_Position_To AND
       NVL(VCR_NB_FONDS.NB_FONDS,0) <= v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Period THEN

       v_Archive := TRUE;
    END IF;

    IF v_Date_Position_From = v_Date_Position_To AND
       NVL(VCR_NB_FONDS.NB_FONDS,0) <= v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Date THEN

       v_Archive := TRUE;
    END IF;

    EXIT;
END LOOP;

IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
   v_Date_Position_From := TRUNC(SYSDATE);
   v_Date_Position_To   := TRUNC(SYSDATE);
END IF;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
FOR VCR_FONDS IN CR_FONDS (v_Date_Position_From,v_Date_Position_To) LOOP

    vg_eFront          := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT;
    vg_eFront_Date     := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE;
    vg_eFront_Ta       := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_TA; -- INCPB-1001039
    vg_eFront_Ta_Date  := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_TA_DATE; -- INCPB-1001039
    
    v_Date_Pos_TA_From := NULL;
    v_Date_Pos_TA_To   := NULL;  
    v_Date_Pos_EF_From := NULL;
    v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := NULL; 
    
    -- DÃ©termine le type de date
    CASE
       WHEN p_Type_Date IN (1,2) THEN
         v_Type_Date_Fonds := p_Type_Date;
       WHEN p_Type_Date = 3 THEN

         CASE REPADMIN.GET_DATE_TA_TYPE(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Position_To)
              -- En calculation Date => position date
              WHEN 1 THEN
                   v_Type_Date_Fonds := 1;
              -- En pricing Date => trade date
              WHEN 2 THEN
                   v_Type_Date_Fonds := 2;
              -- Par dÃ©faut, trade date
              ELSE
                   v_Type_Date_Fonds := 2;
         END CASE;

       ELSE
         v_Type_Date_Fonds := 2; -- Trade Date par dÃ©faut
    END CASE;

    -- Si c'est un fonds eFront et en LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY, on va directement dans la partie eFront
    v_Date_Pos_EF_From := NULL;
    v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := NULL;

    -- INCPB-1001039
    CASE
       -- FA and TA in eFront
       WHEN vg_eFront = 1 AND vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           FOR VCR_CLOSING IN ( SELECT T.DATE_NAV
                                FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING T
                                WHERE T.FA_NUM = VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM
                                ORDER BY T.DATE_NAV DESC) LOOP

               v_Date_Pos_EF_From := VCR_CLOSING.DATE_NAV;
               EXIT;                 
           END LOOP;                     
           v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := v_Date_Pos_EF_From;
           GOTO eFront;

       -- FA in MFFA and TA in eFront    
       WHEN vg_eFront = 0 AND vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           v_Date_Pos_EF_From := VCR_FONDS.DATE_NAV_TO;
           v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := VCR_FONDS.DATE_NAV_TO;
           GOTO eFront;
       ELSE    
           NULL;
    END CASE;
    
    -- En position date (en trade date, on doit d'abord les rÃ©cupÃ©rer avant de pouvoir faire ce traitement)
    IF v_Type_Date_Fonds <> 2 THEN
      
        -- En position date, si tout dans eFront
        IF vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND NVL(p_Period_Type,'NORMAL') <> 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' AND vg_eFront_Ta_Date <= v_Date_Position_From THEN
