                                    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
                                    WHERE TF.ISIN_CODE = r_Row.Code_Isin) LOOP

                            r_Row.Part_Ccy  := X2.PART_CCY;
                            r_Row.Ta_Number := X2.TA_NUM;
                            EXIT;
                        END LOOP;
                        EXIT;
                    END LOOP;
                END IF;

                IF r_Row.Ta_Number IS NULL OR r_Row.Part_Ccy <> r_Row.Quot_Ccy THEN
                   FOR X2 IN CR_NUM_TA ( VCR_FONDS.FUND_ID ,r_Row.Quot_Ccy ) LOOP
                       r_Row.Ta_Number := X2.C_FUND;
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;
                END IF;

                -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport
                CASE
                     -- Pas de devise => devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NULL THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                     -- Devise de la part
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                     -- Devise du fonds
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Fund_Ccy;
                     -- Devise du compartiments
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '3' THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,r_Row.Fund_Ccy);
                     -- Devise passÃ©e en paramÃ¨tre
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NOT NULL THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := p_Report_Ccy;
                     ELSE
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                END CASE;

                -- Taux de change
                IF r_Row.Part_Ccy = r_Row.Report_Ccy THEN
                   r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy := 1;
                   ELSE
                   r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy := REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_EF(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Report_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav);
                END IF;


                -- RÃ©cup des positions en fonction de la date position
                FOR VCR_POS_TA_EF IN CR_DATA_PETAL_POSITIONS ( r_Row.Code_Isin,r_Row.Date_Position) LOOP
                
                    r_Row.Register_Number           := VCR_POS_TA_EF.REGISTER_NUMBER;
                    r_Row.Qty                       := NVL(VCR_POS_TA_EF.QTY,0);

                    r_Row.Amount                    := ROUND(r_Row.Qty * r_Row.Nav,2);
                    r_Row.Quot_Amount               := ROUND(r_Row.Qty * r_Row.Nav,2);
                    
                    r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Commit        :=NVL(VCR_POS_TA_EF.OPE_COMMITMENT_SHR_CCY,0);
                    r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Contrib       :=NVL(VCR_POS_TA_EF.OPE_CAPITAL_CALLED_SHR_CCY,0);
                    r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Distri        :=NVL(VCR_POS_TA_EF.OPE_DISTRIBUTION_SHR_CCY,0);
                    r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Recall_Distri :=NVL(VCR_POS_TA_EF.OPE_REDRAWABLE_SHR_CCY,0);
                    r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Remain_Commit :=NVL(VCR_POS_TA_EF.OPE_RCTI_SHR_CCY,0);
                                    
                    r_Row.Nav_Rep_Ccy               := ROUND(r_Row.Nav * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,6);
                    r_Row.Amount_Rep_Ccy            := ROUND(r_Row.Amount * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);

                    r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Commit         :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Commit * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                    r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Contrib        :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Contrib * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                    r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Distri         :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Distri * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                    r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Recall_Distri  :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Recall_Distri * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                    r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Remain_Commit  :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Remain_Commit * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);

                    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS
                      (register_number,
                       ta_number,
                       fa_num,
                       fund_name,
                       fund_ccy,
                       part,
                       part_ccy,
                       code_isin,
                       qty,
                       nav,
                       amount,
                       date_nav,
                       date_position,
                       user_id,
                       date_creation,
                       REPORT_CCY,
                       NAV_REP_CCY,
                       AMOUNT_REP_CCY,
                       X_RATE_REP_CCY,
                       QUOT_CCY,
                       QUOT_NAV,
                       QUOT_AMOUNT,
                       EF_FLAG,
                       EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMIT,
                       EF_QUOT_CCY_CONTRIB,
                       EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI,
                       EF_QUOT_CCY_RECALL_DISTRI,
                       EF_QUOT_CCY_REMAIN_COMMIT,
                       EF_REP_CCY_COMMIT,
                       EF_REP_CCY_CONTRIB,
                       EF_REP_CCY_DISTRI,
                       EF_REP_CCY_RECALL_DISTRI,
                       EF_REP_CCY_REMAIN_COMMIT)
                    VALUES
                      (r_Row.Register_Number,
                       r_Row.Ta_Number,
                       r_Row.Fa_Num,
                       r_Row.Fund_Name,
                       r_Row.Fund_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Part,
                       r_Row.Part_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Code_Isin,
                       r_Row.Qty,
                       r_Row.Nav,
                       r_Row.Amount,
                       r_Row.Date_Nav,
                       r_Row.Date_Position,
                       p_User_Id,
                       v_date_creation,
                       r_Row.Report_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Nav_Rep_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Amount_Rep_Ccy,
                       r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Quot_Ccy,
                       r_Row.Quot_Nav,
                       r_Row.Quot_Amount,
                       r_Row.Ef_Flag,
                       r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Commit,
                       r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Contrib,
                       r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Distri,
                       r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Recall_Distri,
                       r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Remain_Commit,
                       r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Commit,
                       r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Contrib,
                       r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Distri,
                       r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Recall_Distri,
                       r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Remain_Commit);

                END LOOP;
            END LOOP;

           ELSE
           -- FA and TA in eFront
            FOR X IN CR_MAIN_EF( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA,v_Date_Pos_EF_From,v_Date_Pos_EF_To) LOOP

                r_Row := NULL;

                r_Row.Ef_Flag         := 1;
                r_Row.Register_Number := X.REGISTER_NUMBER;
                r_Row.Fa_Num          := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
                r_Row.Fund_Name       := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
                r_Row.Fund_Ccy        := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;
                r_Row.Part            := X.PART;
                r_Row.Quot_Ccy        := X.QUOT_CCY;
                r_Row.Quot_Nav        := NVL(X.P_SHARE,0);
                r_Row.Quot_Amount     := NVL(X.AMOUNT,0);
                r_Row.Qty             := NVL(X.QTY,0);

                r_Row.Date_Nav        := X.DATE_NAV;
                r_Row.Date_Position   := X.POSITION_DATE;
                r_Row.Nav             := NVL(X.P_SHARE,0);
                r_Row.Amount          := NVL(X.AMOUNT,0);

                r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Commit        :=NVL(X.COMMITMENT_SHR_CCY,0);
                r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Contrib       :=NVL(X.CALLS_SHR_CCY,0);
                r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Distri        :=NVL(X.DISTRI_SHR_CCY,0);
                r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Recall_Distri :=NVL(X.REDRAWABLE_SHR_CCY,0);
                r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Remain_Commit :=NVL(X.RCTI_SHR_CCY,0);

                IF X.ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
                    r_Row.Code_Isin := X.ISIN_CODE;
                    r_Row.Part_Ccy  := X.PART_CCY;
                    r_Row.Ta_Number := X.TA_NUM;
                    ELSE
                    FOR X1 IN ( SELECT T.C_N_ID
                                FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE  T
                                WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA
                                  AND T.C_SHARE   = X.PART
                                ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC ) LOOP

                        r_Row.Code_Isin := REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC_TA(X1.C_N_ID);
                        FOR X2 IN ( SELECT TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM
                                    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
                                    WHERE TF.ISIN_CODE = r_Row.Code_Isin) LOOP

                            r_Row.Part_Ccy  := X2.PART_CCY;
                            r_Row.Ta_Number := X2.TA_NUM;
                            EXIT;
                        END LOOP;
                        EXIT;
                    END LOOP;
                END IF;

                IF r_Row.Ta_Number IS NULL OR r_Row.Part_Ccy <> r_Row.Quot_Ccy THEN
                   FOR X2 IN CR_NUM_TA ( VCR_FONDS.FUND_ID ,r_Row.Quot_Ccy ) LOOP
                       r_Row.Ta_Number := X2.C_FUND;
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;
                END IF;

                -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport
                CASE
                     -- Pas de devise => devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NULL THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                     -- Devise de la part
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                     -- Devise du fonds
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Fund_Ccy;
                     -- Devise du compartiments
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '3' THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,r_Row.Fund_Ccy);
                     -- Devise passÃ©e en paramÃ¨tre
                     WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NOT NULL THEN
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := p_Report_Ccy;
                     ELSE
                          r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                END CASE;

                -- Taux de change
                IF r_Row.Part_Ccy = r_Row.Report_Ccy THEN
                   r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy := 1;
                   ELSE
                   r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy := REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_EF(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Report_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav);
                END IF;

                r_Row.Nav_Rep_Ccy               := ROUND(r_Row.Nav * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,6);
                r_Row.Amount_Rep_Ccy            := ROUND(r_Row.Amount * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);

                r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Commit        :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Commit * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Contrib       :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Contrib * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Distri        :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Distri * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Recall_Distri :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Recall_Distri * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Remain_Commit :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Remain_Commit * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);

                INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS
                  (register_number,
                   ta_number,
                   fa_num,
                   fund_name,
                   fund_ccy,
                   part,
                   part_ccy,
                   code_isin,
                   qty,
                   nav,
                   amount,
                   date_nav,
                   date_position,
                   user_id,
                   date_creation,
                   REPORT_CCY,
                   NAV_REP_CCY,
                   AMOUNT_REP_CCY,
                   X_RATE_REP_CCY,
                   QUOT_CCY,
                   QUOT_NAV,
                   QUOT_AMOUNT,
                   EF_FLAG,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMIT,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_CONTRIB,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_RECALL_DISTRI,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_REMAIN_COMMIT,
                   EF_REP_CCY_COMMIT,
                   EF_REP_CCY_CONTRIB,
                   EF_REP_CCY_DISTRI,
                   EF_REP_CCY_RECALL_DISTRI,
                   EF_REP_CCY_REMAIN_COMMIT)
                VALUES
                  (r_Row.Register_Number,
                   r_Row.Ta_Number,
                   r_Row.Fa_Num,
                   r_Row.Fund_Name,
                   r_Row.Fund_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Part,
                   r_Row.Part_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Code_Isin,
                   r_Row.Qty,
                   r_Row.Nav,
                   r_Row.Amount,
                   r_Row.Date_Nav,
                   r_Row.Date_Position,
                   p_User_Id,
                   v_date_creation,
                   r_Row.Report_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Nav_Rep_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Amount_Rep_Ccy,
                   r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Quot_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Quot_Nav,
                   r_Row.Quot_Amount,
                   r_Row.Ef_Flag,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Commit,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Contrib,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Distri,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Recall_Distri,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Remain_Commit,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Commit,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Contrib,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Distri,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Recall_Distri,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Remain_Commit);

            END LOOP;

        END IF;


    END IF;
    
END LOOP;
COMMIT;

p_status           :=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status  :=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='Erreur : ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Position',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
END proc_Ta_Position;

-------------------------------------------------
-- TA : Position AVEC FILTRE SUR LES REGISTRES --
-------------------------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Position_Filtre_Reg( p_Reg_Type            IN NUMBER, -- 1 = Tous les registres, 2 = Registres FlagÃ©s
                                       p_User_Id             IN VARCHAR2,
                                       p_Period_Type         IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                       p_Date_Position_From  IN VARCHAR2,
                                       p_Date_Position_To    IN VARCHAR2,
                                       p_Date_Creation       IN VARCHAR2  DEFAULT '19000101',
                                       p_Report_Ccy          IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                       p_Type_Date           IN NUMBER DEFAULT 3, -- 1 = Position Date / 2 = Trade Date / 3 = En fct du fonds
                                       p_status              OUT NUMBER,
                                       p_msg_err             OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                   NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err                  VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                       NUMBER;

v_date_creation            DATE:= SYSDATE;

v_Date_Position_From       DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_Position_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Position_To         DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_Position_To,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Creation_Registre   DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_Creation,'YYYYMMDD');

v_Date_Pos_Ta_From         DATE;
v_Date_Pos_Ta_To           DATE;

v_Date_Pos_EF_From         DATE;
v_Date_Pos_EF_To           DATE;

v_Trade_Date_From          DATE;
v_Trade_Date_To            DATE;

v_Flag_Min                 NUMBER;
v_Flag_Max                 NUMBER;

v_Pos_Date_Min             DATE:=SYSDATE-366;

--v_Tx_Change                NUMBER;
r_Row                      WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS%ROWTYPE;
v_Part_Fa                  VARCHAR2(3);

v_Archive                  BOOLEAN:=FALSE;
v_Nb_Pos_Archive           NUMBER;
v_Type_Date_Fonds          NUMBER;  -- 1 = Trade Date / 2 = Position Date
v_Date_From_Fonds          DATE;
v_Date_To_Fonds            DATE;
v_Date_Position_Fonds      DATE;
v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Period      NUMBER:=NVL(GET_GLOBAL_VAR_VALUE('TA_ARC_NB_FDS_PER'),0);
v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Date        NUMBER:=NVL(GET_GLOBAL_VAR_VALUE('TA_ARC_NB_FDS_DATE'),0);

CURSOR CR_FONDS ( p_Date_Pos_From IN DATE,
                  p_Date_Pos_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT Q.FA_NUM FUND_ID,Q.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA,
           GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_Pos_To) FA_NUM_REF,
           GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_Pos_To)) FUND_CCY_REF,
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_Pos_From,1) DATE_NAV_FROM,
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date_Pos_To,-1) DATE_NAV_TO,
           DECODE(TF.EFRONT,1,1,0) EFRONT,TF.EFRONT_DATE,
           DECODE(TF.EFRONT_TA,1,1,0) EFRONT_TA,TF.EFRONT_TA_DATE -- INCBP-1001039        
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
     AND Q.FLAG     = 1
     AND Q.FA_NUM   = TF.FA_NUM(+)
     AND TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA IS NOT NULL;

CURSOR CR_DATE_POS( p_Fund_Id                IN VARCHAR2,
                    p_Date_From              IN DATE,
                    p_Date_To                IN DATE,
                    p_Date_Creation_Registre IN DATE,
                    p_Flag_Min               IN NUMBER,
                    p_Flag_Max               IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT T.PTA_POS_DATE,T.PTA_REG_ACC REGISTRE,
           T.PTA_FUND_ID FUND_NUMBER,NVL(NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE), T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE) PART,
           --T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE PART,
           T.PTA_QUANTITY QTY,T.PTA_NAV,T.PTA_AMOUNT AMOUNT,T.PTA_NAV_DATE,
           T.PTA_FUND_TK CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,
           TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,T.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY QUOT_CCY_CODE_TA,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES',T.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY) QUOT_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA  T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
    WHERE T.PTA_POS_DATE        BETWEEN p_Date_From AND p_Date_To --'30-SEP-10'
--      AND T.PTA_FUND_TK         = TF.TELEKURS_CODE(+)
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID         = p_Fund_Id
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID         = TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA(+)
      AND T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE       = TF.Part_Ta_Code(+) -- LUXIAM1957
      AND NVL(T.PTA_QUANTITY,0) <> 0
      AND T.PTA_NAV_DATE        IS NOT NULL
      AND T.PTA_REG_ACC         IN ( SELECT DISTINCT REG.REGISTER_NUMBER
                                     FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG REG
                                     WHERE REG.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
                                       AND REG.DATE_CREATION >= p_Date_Creation_Registre
                                       AND (NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Min
                                         OR  NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Max));

CURSOR CR_DATE_POS_ARC ( p_Fund_Id                IN VARCHAR2,
                         p_Date_From              IN DATE,
                         p_Date_To                IN DATE,
                         p_Date_Creation_Registre IN DATE,
                         p_Flag_Min               IN NUMBER,
                         p_Flag_Max               IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT T.PTA_POS_DATE,T.PTA_REG_ACC REGISTRE,
           T.PTA_FUND_ID FUND_NUMBER,NVL(NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE), T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE) PART,
           --T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE PART,
           T.PTA_QUANTITY QTY,T.PTA_NAV,T.PTA_AMOUNT AMOUNT,T.PTA_NAV_DATE,
           T.PTA_FUND_TK CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,
           TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,T.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY QUOT_CCY_CODE_TA,
           GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES',T.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY) QUOT_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA_ARC  T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
    WHERE T.PTA_POS_DATE BETWEEN p_Date_From AND p_Date_To --'30-SEP-10'
--      AND T.PTA_FUND_TK         = TF.TELEKURS_CODE(+)
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID         = p_Fund_Id
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID         = TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA(+)
      AND T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE       = TF.Part_Ta_Code(+) -- LUXIAM1957
      AND NVL(T.PTA_QUANTITY,0) <> 0
      AND T.PTA_REG_ACC         IN ( SELECT DISTINCT REG.REGISTER_NUMBER
                                     FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG REG
                                     WHERE REG.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
                                       AND REG.DATE_CREATION >= p_Date_Creation_Registre
                                       AND (NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Min
                                        OR  NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Max));

CURSOR CR_TRADE_DATE( p_Fund_Id                IN VARCHAR2,
                      p_TradeDate_From         IN DATE,
                      p_TradeDate_To           IN DATE,
                      p_Date_Creation_Registre IN DATE,
                      p_Flag_Min               IN NUMBER,
                      p_Flag_Max               IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT P.PTA_S_POS_DATE POS_DATE,P.PTA_REG_ACC REGISTER_NUMBER,
           TF.FA_NUM FUND_NUMBER,NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE) PART,
           P.PTA_QUANTITY QTY,T.P_SHARE,ROUND(P.PTA_QUANTITY * T.P_SHARE,2) AMOUNT,T.D_NAVDATE DATE_NAV_TA,
           TF.TELEKURS_CODE CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,
           TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,T.C_CURRENCY QUOT_CCY_CODE_TA,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES',T.C_CURRENCY) QUOT_CCY,
           REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_DATE_PUB(TF.FA_NUM,T.D_NAVDATE) DATE_NAV,
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_CALCUL(TF.FA_NUM,REPADMIN.GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_DATE_PUB(TF.FA_NUM,T.D_NAVDATE)) POSITION_DATE
    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_NAV_SHARE_PRICE T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF,
         REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS P
    WHERE T.D_NAVDATE           >= p_TradeDate_From
      AND T.D_NAVDATE           <= p_TradeDate_To
      AND P.PTA_FUND_ID         = p_Fund_Id
      AND T.C_FUND              = TF.TA_NUM
      AND T.C_SHARE_TYP         = TF.Part_Ta_Code
      AND T.C_FUND              = P.PTA_TAFUND_ID
      AND T.C_SHARE_TYP         = P.PTA_UNIT_TYPE
      AND P.PTA_S_POS_DATE      <= T.D_APPLICATION
      AND P.PTA_E_POS_DATE      >= T.D_APPLICATION -- INCPB-543894
      AND NVL(P.PTA_QUANTITY,0) <> 0
      AND P.PTA_REG_ACC         IN ( SELECT DISTINCT REG.REGISTER_NUMBER
                                     FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG REG
                                     WHERE REG.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
                                       AND REG.DATE_CREATION >= p_Date_Creation_Registre
                                       AND (NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Min
                                        OR  NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Max));

CURSOR CR_TB_FONDS(p_Code_Isin IN VARCHAR2) IS

    SELECT TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,TF.PART_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
    WHERE TF.ISIN_CODE = p_Code_Isin;

CURSOR CR_NB_DATE_POS_ARC ( p_Fa_Num    IN VARCHAR2,
                            p_Date_From IN DATE) IS

   SELECT COUNT(T.PTA_FUND_ID) NB_POS
   FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA_ARC  T
   WHERE T.PTA_POS_DATE >= p_Date_From --'01-JAN-08'
     AND T.PTA_FUND_ID  = p_Fa_Num;

CURSOR CR_NB_TRADE_DATE_ARC ( p_Fa_Num    IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_Date_From IN DATE) IS

   SELECT COUNT(T.PTA_FUND_ID) NB_POS
   FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA_ARC  T
   WHERE T.PTA_NAV_DATE >= p_Date_From --'01-JAN-08'
     AND T.PTA_FUND_ID  = p_Fa_Num;

CURSOR CR_NUM_TA ( p_Fund_Id       IN VARCHAR2,
                   p_Quotation_Ccy IN VARCHAR2) IS
   SELECT T.C_FUND
   FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUNDS T
   WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = p_Fund_Id
     AND T.C_CCY     = p_Quotation_Ccy
   ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC;

CURSOR CR_MAIN_EF ( p_Fund_Id                IN VARCHAR2,
                    p_DateNav_From           IN DATE,
                    p_DateNav_To             IN DATE,
                    p_Date_Creation_Registre IN DATE,
                    p_Flag_Min               IN NUMBER,
                    p_Flag_Max               IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT C.DATE_NAV POS_DATE,
           DECODE(REGEXP_INSTR(T.PTA_REG_ACC,'-'),0,NVL(T.PTA_REG_ACC,0),TRIM(SUBSTR(T.PTA_REG_ACC,REGEXP_INSTR(T.PTA_REG_ACC,'-')+1))) REGISTER_NUMBER,                   
           C.FA_NUM FUND_NUMBER,T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE PART,
           T.PTA_QUANTITY QTY,N.NAP_PRICE_PART P_SHARE,ROUND(T.PTA_QUANTITY * N.NAP_PRICE_PART,2) AMOUNT,
           C.DATE_NAV DATE_NAV_TA,TF.TELEKURS_CODE CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,
           NULL QUOTATION_CCY_CODE_TA,TF.PART_CCY QUOT_CCY,C.DATE_NAV,C.DATE_NAV POSITION_DATE,
           --T.REGISTER_NAME,
           T.COMMITMENT,T.CALLS,T.DISTRI,T.REDRAWABLE,T.RCTI,
           T.COMMITMENT_SHR_CCY,T.CALLS_SHR_CCY,T.DISTRI_SHR_CCY,T.REDRAWABLE_SHR_CCY,T.RCTI_SHR_CCY
    FROM EFRONT.DATA_EF_POS_TA T,
         EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING C,
         EFRONT.DATA_EF_NAV_PART N,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE T.CLOSING_ID IN ( SELECT CL.CLOSING_ID 
                            FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING CL 
                            WHERE CL.FA_NUM    = p_Fund_Id --'442876'
                              AND CL.DATE_NAV >= p_DateNav_From --'01-JAN-17'
                              AND CL.DATE_NAV <= p_DateNav_To --'31-DEC-20'                              
                           )
      AND T.CLOSING_ID    = C.CLOSING_ID
      AND T.PTA_QUANTITY  IS NOT NULL
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID   = N.NAP_FUND_NO
      AND T.PTA_POS_DATE  = N.NAP_DATE_NAV
      AND T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE = N.NAP_TPARTS
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID   = TF.FA_NUM
      AND T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE = TF.PART_FA_CODE
      AND T.PTA_REG_ACC   IN ( SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(REG.REGISTER_NUMBER)
                               FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG REG
                               WHERE REG.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
                                 AND REG.DATE_CREATION >= p_Date_Creation_Registre
                                 AND (NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Min
                                  OR  NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Max));

--INCPB-1001039
CURSOR CR_NAV_PARTS ( p_SubFund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                      p_DateNav_From   IN DATE,
                      p_DateNav_To     IN DATE) IS
                      
    SELECT N.NAP_DATE_NAV POS_DATE,
           N.NAP_FUND_NO FUND_NUMBER,
           N.NAP_QT_PART,N.NAP_PRICE_PART,
           N.NAP_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV_TA,TF.TELEKURS_CODE CODE_TELEKURS,TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,
           NULL QUOTATION_CCY_CODE_TA,TF.PART_CCY QUOT_CCY,N.NAP_DATE_NAV DATE_NAV,
           REPADMIN.GET_LAST_DATE_NAV_POS_TA_EFRONT(TF.ISIN_CODE,N.NAP_DATE_NAV) LAST_DATE_NAV_POS_TA
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS N,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE N.NAP_FUND_NO          = p_SubFund_Number--'256546' --'442876'
      AND N.NAP_DATE_NAV        >= p_DateNav_From --'01-JAN-18'
      AND N.NAP_DATE_NAV        <= p_DateNav_To --'31-DEC-22'                              
      AND N.NAP_FUND_NO         = TF.FA_NUM
      AND N.NAP_TPARTS          = TF.PART_FA_CODE
      AND b.fund_no = n.nap_fund_no
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND n.nap_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                        -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
      ;

--INCPB-1001039
CURSOR CR_DATA_PETAL_POSITIONS ( p_Isin_Code              IN VARCHAR2,
                                 p_DateNav                IN DATE,
                                 p_Date_Creation_Registre IN DATE,
                                 p_Flag_Min               IN NUMBER,
                                 p_Flag_Max               IN NUMBER) IS

    SELECT T.REGISTER_ID REGISTER_NUMBER,                   
           T.POS_QUANTITY QTY,
           --T.REGISTER_NAME,
           T.OPE_COMMITMENT,T.OPE_CAPITAL_CALLED,T.OPE_DISTRIBUTION,NULL OPE_REDRAWABLE,NULL OPE_RCTI,
           T.OPE_COMMITMENT_SHR_CCY,T.OPE_CAPITAL_CALLED_SHR_CCY,T.OPE_DISTRIBUTION_SHR_CCY,NULL OPE_REDRAWABLE_SHR_CCY,NULL OPE_RCTI_SHR_CCY
    FROM EFRONT.DATA_PETAL_POSITIONS T
    WHERE T.ISIN_CODE           = p_Isin_Code --'256546' --'442876'
      AND T.POS_NAV_DATE        = p_DateNav  --'01-JAN-18'
      AND NVL(T.POS_QUANTITY,0) > 0
      AND T.OPE_INDEX           = ( SELECT MAX(PO.OPE_INDEX) FROM EFRONT.DATA_PETAL_POSITIONS PO
                                    WHERE PO.SHARECLASS_ID = T.SHARECLASS_ID
                                      AND PO.POS_NAV_DATE  = T.POS_NAV_DATE
                                      AND PO.REGISTER_ID   = T.REGISTER_ID
                                      AND PO.INVESTOR_ID   = T.INVESTOR_ID
                                   )
      AND T.REGISTER_ID   IN ( SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(REG.REGISTER_NUMBER)
                               FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG REG
                               WHERE REG.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
                                 AND REG.DATE_CREATION >= p_Date_Creation_Registre
                                 AND (NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Min
                                  OR  NVL(REG.FLAG,0)  = p_Flag_Max)
                              );
      
Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Position';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Nettoyage
DELETE FROM WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS T
WHERE T.USER_ID      =  p_User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

-- Nb Fonds FlagÃ©s
FOR VCR_NB_FONDS IN ( SELECT COUNT(T.FA_NUM) NB_FONDS
                      FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS T
                      WHERE T.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                      AND T.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

    IF v_Date_Position_From <> v_Date_Position_To AND
       NVL(VCR_NB_FONDS.NB_FONDS,0) <= v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Period THEN

       v_Archive := TRUE;
    END IF;

    IF v_Date_Position_From = v_Date_Position_To AND
       NVL(VCR_NB_FONDS.NB_FONDS,0) <= v_Nb_Fonds_Arc_Date THEN

       v_Archive := TRUE;
    END IF;

    EXIT;
END LOOP;

CASE p_Reg_Type
     -- Tous les registres
     WHEN 1 THEN
          v_Flag_Min := 0;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;

     -- Registres sÃ©lectionnÃ©s
     WHEN 2 THEN
          v_Flag_Min := 1;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;

     --
     ELSE
          v_Flag_Min := 0;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;
END CASE;

IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
   v_Date_Position_From := TRUNC(SYSDATE);
   v_Date_Position_To   := TRUNC(SYSDATE);
END IF;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
FOR VCR_FONDS IN CR_FONDS (v_Date_Position_From,v_Date_Position_To) LOOP

    vg_eFront          := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT;
    vg_eFront_Date     := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE;
    vg_eFront_Ta       := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_TA; -- INCPB-1001039
    vg_eFront_Ta_Date  := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_TA_DATE; -- INCPB-1001039
        
    v_Date_Pos_TA_From := NULL;
    v_Date_Pos_TA_To   := NULL;  
    v_Date_Pos_EF_From := NULL;
    v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := NULL; 
    
    -- DÃ©termine le type de date
    CASE
       WHEN p_Type_Date IN (1,2) THEN
         v_Type_Date_Fonds := p_Type_Date;
       WHEN p_Type_Date = 3 THEN

         CASE REPADMIN.GET_DATE_TA_TYPE(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Position_To)
              -- En calculation Date => position date
              WHEN 1 THEN
                   v_Type_Date_Fonds := 1;
              -- En pricing Date => trade date
              WHEN 2 THEN
                   v_Type_Date_Fonds := 2;
              -- Par dÃ©faut, trade date
              ELSE
                   v_Type_Date_Fonds := 2;
         END CASE;

       ELSE
         v_Type_Date_Fonds := 2; -- Trade Date par dÃ©faut
    END CASE;

    -- Si c'est un fonds eFront et en LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY, on va directement dans la partie eFront
    v_Date_Pos_EF_From := NULL;
    v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := NULL;
    
    -- INCPB-1001039
    CASE
       -- FA and TA in eFront
       WHEN vg_eFront = 1 AND vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           FOR VCR_CLOSING IN ( SELECT T.DATE_NAV
                                FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING T
                                WHERE T.FA_NUM = VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM
                                ORDER BY T.DATE_NAV DESC) LOOP

               v_Date_Pos_EF_From := VCR_CLOSING.DATE_NAV;
               EXIT;                 
           END LOOP;                     
           v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := v_Date_Pos_EF_From;
           GOTO eFront;

       -- FA in MFFA and TA in eFront    
       WHEN vg_eFront = 0 AND vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           v_Date_Pos_EF_From := VCR_FONDS.DATE_NAV_TO;
           v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := VCR_FONDS.DATE_NAV_TO;
           GOTO eFront;
       ELSE    
           NULL;
    END CASE;
    
    -- En position date (en trade date, on doit d'abord les rÃ©cupÃ©rer avant de pouvoir faire ce traitement)
    IF v_Type_Date_Fonds <> 2 THEN
      
        -- En position date, si tout dans eFront
        IF vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND NVL(p_Period_Type,'NORMAL') <> 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' AND vg_eFront_Ta_Date <= v_Date_Position_From THEN
           v_Date_Pos_EF_From := GREATEST(v_Date_Position_From,vg_eFront_Ta_Date);
           v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := v_Date_Position_To;
           GOTO eFront;
        END IF;    
        
        -- En position date, si une partie dans TA et une partie dans eFront
        IF vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND NVL(p_Period_Type,'NORMAL') <> 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' AND vg_eFront_Ta_Date <= v_Date_Position_To THEN
           v_Date_Pos_EF_From := GREATEST(v_Date_Position_From,vg_eFront_Ta_Date);
           v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := v_Date_Position_To;
        END IF;
    
    END IF;    
    -- INCPB-1001039    
    
/*    IF vg_eFront = 1 AND p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
       FOR VCR_CLOSING IN ( SELECT T.DATE_NAV
                            FROM EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING T
                            WHERE T.FA_NUM = VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM
                            ORDER BY T.DATE_NAV DESC) LOOP

           v_Date_Pos_EF_From := VCR_CLOSING.DATE_NAV;
           EXIT;                 
       END LOOP;                     
       v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := v_Date_Pos_EF_From;
       GOTO eFront;
    END IF;

    -- En position date (en trade date, on doit d'abord les rÃ©cupÃ©rer avant de pouvoir faire ce traitement)
    IF v_Type_Date_Fonds <> 2 THEN
      
        -- En position date, si tout dans eFront
        IF vg_eFront = 1 AND NVL(p_Period_Type,'NORMAL') <> 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' AND vg_eFront_Date <= v_Date_Position_From THEN
           v_Date_Pos_EF_From := GREATEST(v_Date_Position_From,vg_eFront_Date);
           v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := v_Date_Position_To;
           GOTO eFront;
        END IF;    
        
        -- En position date, si une partie dans TA et une partie dans eFront
        IF vg_eFront = 1 AND NVL(p_Period_Type,'NORMAL') <> 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' AND vg_eFront_Date <= v_Date_Position_To THEN
           v_Date_Pos_EF_From := GREATEST(v_Date_Position_From,vg_eFront_Date);
           v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := v_Date_Position_To;
        END IF;
    
    END IF;*/

    ------------------------------------------
    --                  TA                  --
    ------------------------------------------
        
    -- TRADE DATE --
    IF v_Type_Date_Fonds = 2 THEN

        -- RÃ©cup des Trade Date from et date to
        -- INCPB-492159 : on va rÃ©cupÃ©rer la derniÃ¨re trade date dans la DWT_GTA_NAV_SHARE_PRICE
        --                vu qu'il n'y a plus des positions pour tous les jours
        IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           v_Trade_Date_From := REPADMIN.GET_LAST_TRADE_DATE_TA(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA,SYSDATE);
           v_Trade_Date_To   := v_Trade_Date_From;
           ELSE
           v_Trade_Date_From := REPADMIN.GET_LAST_TRADE_DATE_TA(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA,v_Date_Position_From);
           v_Trade_Date_To   := REPADMIN.GET_LAST_TRADE_DATE_TA(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA,v_Date_Position_To);
           
           -- Tout dans eFront
           IF vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND vg_eFront_Ta_Date <= v_Trade_Date_From THEN -- INCPB-1001039
              v_Date_Pos_EF_From := v_Trade_Date_From;
              v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := v_Trade_Date_To;
              GOTO eFront;
           END IF;

           -- Une partie dans TA et une partie dans eFront
           IF vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND vg_eFront_Ta_Date <= v_Trade_Date_To THEN -- INCPB-1001039
              v_Date_Pos_EF_From := GREATEST(v_Trade_Date_From,vg_eFront_Ta_Date); -- INCPB-1001039
              v_Date_Pos_EF_To   := v_Trade_Date_To;
              v_Trade_Date_To    := v_Date_Pos_EF_From - 1;
           END IF;
        END IF;

        FOR X IN CR_TRADE_DATE( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA,v_Trade_Date_From,v_Trade_Date_To,
                                v_Date_Creation_Registre,v_Flag_Min,v_Flag_Max) LOOP

            r_Row := NULL;

            r_Row.Ef_Flag     := 0;
            r_Row.Fa_Num      := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
            r_Row.Fund_Name   := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
            r_Row.Fund_Ccy    := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;
            r_Row.Part        := X.PART;
            r_Row.Quot_Ccy    := X.QUOT_CCY;
            r_Row.Quot_Nav    := NVL(X.P_SHARE,0);
            r_Row.Quot_Amount := NVL(X.AMOUNT,0);
            r_Row.Qty         := NVL(X.QTY,0);

            IF X.ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN
                r_Row.Code_Isin := X.ISIN_CODE;
                r_Row.Part_Ccy  := X.PART_CCY;
                r_Row.Ta_Number := X.TA_NUM;
                ELSE
                FOR X1 IN ( SELECT T.C_N_ID
                            FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_PTF_SHARE  T
                            WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA
                              AND T.C_SHARE   = X.PART
                            ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC ) LOOP

                    r_Row.Code_Isin := REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC_TA(X1.C_N_ID);
                    FOR X2 IN ( SELECT TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM
                                FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
                                WHERE TF.ISIN_CODE = r_Row.Code_Isin) LOOP

                        r_Row.Part_Ccy  := X2.PART_CCY;
                        r_Row.Ta_Number := X2.TA_NUM;
                        EXIT;
                    END LOOP;
                    EXIT;
                END LOOP;
            END IF;

            IF r_Row.Ta_Number IS NULL OR r_Row.Part_Ccy <> r_Row.Quot_Ccy THEN
               FOR X2 IN CR_NUM_TA ( VCR_FONDS.FUND_ID ,r_Row.Quot_Ccy ) LOOP
                   r_Row.Ta_Number := X2.C_FUND;
                   EXIT;
               END LOOP;
            END IF;

            -- RÃ©cup de la devise du rapport
            r_Row.Date_Nav := X.DATE_NAV_TA;

            -- RÃ©cup du prix et montant dans la devise de la part
            IF r_Row.Quot_Ccy <> r_Row.Part_Ccy THEN

               r_Row.Nav    := GET_PRICE_FA_PART(r_Row.Fa_Num,X.PART_FA_CODE,r_Row.Date_Nav,1,0);
               r_Row.Amount := ROUND(r_Row.Qty * r_Row.Nav,2);
               ELSE
               r_Row.Nav    := NVL(X.P_SHARE,0);
               r_Row.Amount := NVL(X.AMOUNT,0);
            END IF;

            CASE
                 -- Pas de devise => devise de la part par dÃ©faut
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NULL THEN
                      r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                 -- Devise de la part
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '1' THEN
                      r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
                 -- Devise du fonds
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '2' THEN
                      r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Fund_Ccy;
                 -- Devise du compartiments
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy = '3' THEN
                      r_Row.Report_Ccy := NVL(VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY_REF,r_Row.Fund_Ccy);
                 -- Devise passÃ©e en paramÃ¨tre
                 WHEN p_Report_Ccy IS NOT NULL THEN
                      r_Row.Report_Ccy := p_Report_Ccy;
                 ELSE
                      r_Row.Report_Ccy := r_Row.Part_Ccy;
            END CASE;

            -- Taux de change
            IF r_Row.Part_Ccy = r_Row.Report_Ccy THEN
               r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy := 1;
               ELSE
               r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(r_Row.Part_Ccy,r_Row.Report_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Nav);
            END IF;

            r_Row.Nav_Rep_Ccy    := ROUND(r_Row.Nav * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,6);
            r_Row.Amount_Rep_Ccy := ROUND(r_Row.Amount * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);


            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS
              (register_number,
               ta_number,
               fa_num,
               fund_name,
               fund_ccy,
               part,
               part_ccy,
               code_isin,
               qty,
               nav,
               amount,
               date_nav,
               date_position,
               user_id,
               date_creation,
               REPORT_CCY,
               NAV_REP_CCY,
               AMOUNT_REP_CCY,
               X_RATE_REP_CCY,
               QUOT_CCY,
               QUOT_NAV,
               QUOT_AMOUNT,
               EF_FLAG)
            VALUES
              (X.REGISTER_NUMBER,
               r_Row.Ta_Number,
               r_Row.Fa_Num,
               r_Row.Fund_Name,
               r_Row.Fund_Ccy,
               r_Row.Part,
               r_Row.Part_Ccy,
               r_Row.Code_Isin,
               r_Row.Qty,
               r_Row.Nav,
               r_Row.Amount,
               r_Row.Date_Nav,
               X.POSITION_DATE,
               p_User_Id,
               v_date_creation,
               r_Row.Report_Ccy,
               r_Row.Nav_Rep_Ccy,
               r_Row.Amount_Rep_Ccy,
               r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,
               r_Row.Quot_Ccy,
               r_Row.Quot_Nav,
               r_Row.Quot_Amount,
               r_Row.Ef_Flag);

        END LOOP;

        -- POSITION DATE --
        ELSE

        -- Regarde si il y a des opÃ©rations dans l'archive
        v_Nb_Pos_Archive := 0;
        IF v_Archive = TRUE THEN
           FOR VCR_NB_POS IN CR_NB_DATE_POS_ARC ( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA,
                                                  v_Date_Position_From) LOOP

               v_Nb_Pos_Archive := NVL(VCR_NB_POS.NB_POS,0);
               EXIT;
           END LOOP;
        END IF;

        -- RÃ©cup des date from et date to
        v_Date_From_Fonds := NVL(GET_LAST_DATE_POSITION_TA(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA,v_Date_Position_From),v_Date_Position_From);
        v_Date_To_Fonds   := NVL(GET_LAST_DATE_POSITION_TA(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA,v_Date_Position_To),v_Date_Position_To);

        IF vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND vg_eFront_Ta_Date IS NOT NULL THEN -- INCPB-1001039
           v_Date_To_Fonds := LEAST(v_Date_To_Fonds,vg_eFront_Ta_Date-1);
        END IF;
        
        FOR X IN CR_DATE_POS( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA,v_Date_From_Fonds,v_Date_To_Fonds,
                              v_Date_Creation_Registre,v_Flag_Min,v_Flag_Max) LOOP

            r_Row := NULL;

            r_Row.Ef_Flag     := 0;
            r_Row.Fa_Num      := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
            r_Row.Fund_Name   := VCR_FONDS.FUND_NAME;
            r_Row.Fund_Ccy    := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;
            r_Row.Part        := X.PART;
            r_Row.Quot_Ccy    := X.QUOT_CCY;
            r_Row.Quot_Nav    := NVL(X.PTA_NAV,0);
            r_Row.Quot_Amount := NVL(X.AMOUNT,0);
            r_Row.Qty         := NVL(X.QTY,0);

            IF X.ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN

                r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Contrib       :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Contrib * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Distri        :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Distri * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Recall_Distri :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Recall_Distri * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);
                r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Remain_Commit :=ROUND(r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Remain_Commit * r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,2);

                INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS
                  (register_number,
                   ta_number,
                   fa_num,
                   fund_name,
                   fund_ccy,
                   part,
                   part_ccy,
                   code_isin,
                   qty,
                   nav,
                   amount,
                   date_nav,
                   date_position,
                   user_id,
                   date_creation,
                   REPORT_CCY,
                   NAV_REP_CCY,
                   AMOUNT_REP_CCY,
                   X_RATE_REP_CCY,
                   QUOT_CCY,
                   QUOT_NAV,
                   QUOT_AMOUNT,
                   EF_FLAG,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_COMMIT,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_CONTRIB,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_DISTRI,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_RECALL_DISTRI,
                   EF_QUOT_CCY_REMAIN_COMMIT,
                   EF_REP_CCY_COMMIT,
                   EF_REP_CCY_CONTRIB,
                   EF_REP_CCY_DISTRI,
                   EF_REP_CCY_RECALL_DISTRI,
                   EF_REP_CCY_REMAIN_COMMIT)
                VALUES
                  (r_Row.Register_Number,
                   r_Row.Ta_Number,
                   r_Row.Fa_Num,
                   r_Row.Fund_Name,
                   r_Row.Fund_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Part,
                   r_Row.Part_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Code_Isin,
                   r_Row.Qty,
                   r_Row.Nav,
                   r_Row.Amount,
                   r_Row.Date_Nav,
                   r_Row.Date_Position,
                   p_User_Id,
                   v_date_creation,
                   r_Row.Report_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Nav_Rep_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Amount_Rep_Ccy,
                   r_Row.x_Rate_Rep_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Quot_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Quot_Nav,
                   r_Row.Quot_Amount,
                   r_Row.Ef_Flag,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Commit,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Contrib,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Distri,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Recall_Distri,
                   r_Row.Ef_Quot_Ccy_Remain_Commit,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Commit,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Contrib,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Distri,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Recall_Distri,
                   r_Row.Ef_Rep_Ccy_Remain_Commit);

            END LOOP;

        END IF;

    END IF;
    
END LOOP;
COMMIT;

p_status           :=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status  :=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='Erreur : ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Position_Filtre_Reg',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
END proc_Ta_Position_Filtre_Reg;

--INCPB-1040772
FUNCTION Get_Date_Nav_Prev (p_fund IN VARCHAR2, p_date_nav IN DATE) RETURN DATE IS
  
  V_DATE_NAV DATE;
  
BEGIN
  SELECT DISTINCT N.NAV_DATE_NAV 
     INTO V_DATE_NAV
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV N
   WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = p_fund
     AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV < p_date_nav
     AND N.NAV_TYP_TRT = 'O'
   ORDER BY N.NAV_DATE_NAV DESC
   FETCH FIRST ROW only;
   
   RETURN V_DATE_NAV;
   
 EXCEPTION
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    repadmin.warning_log('Get_Date_Nav_Prev',    
             SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150) || ' fund: ' || p_fund || ' date: ' || p_date_nav);
    
    RETURN p_date_nav;  
   
END;

--INCPB-1040772
FUNCTION Get_TA_code_part (p_fonds IN VARCHAR2, p_part IN VARCHAR2) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
  
  V_part_TA  TAB_FND_MAIN.part_ta_code%TYPE;
  
BEGIN
  SELECT tf.part_ta_code
    INTO V_part_TA
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
   WHERE TF.FA_NUM = p_fonds
     AND TF.PART_FA_CODE = p_part;
   
   RETURN V_part_TA;
   
 EXCEPTION
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    repadmin.warning_log('Get_TA_code_part',    
             SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150) || ' fund: ' || p_fonds || ' PART: ' || p_part);
    
    RETURN p_part;  
   
END;
  
  
----------------------------------
-- TA : RÃ©con Position TA et FA --
----------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Position_Globale( p_User_Id   IN VARCHAR2,
                                    p_Date_Nav  IN VARCHAR2,
                                    p_status    OUT NUMBER,
                                    p_msg_err   OUT VARCHAR2) IS


v_status                   NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err                  VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                       NUMBER;

v_date_creation            DATE:= SYSDATE;

v_Date_Nav                 DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_Nav,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Nav_Fund            DATE;
v_Date_Nav_Part            DATE;  -- LTA-1111 : date NAV du sous-fonds (peut diffÃ©rer du fonds maÃ®tre)
v_Date_Pub_Fund            DATE;
v_Date_Calcul_Fund         DATE;
v_Date_Position            DATE;
v_Fund_Id                  POS_TA.PTA_FUND_ID%TYPE;
v_Fa_Num                   LUXREP_TB_FONDS.FA_NUM%TYPE;
v_Archive                  VARCHAR2(1);

v_Pos_Date_Min             DATE:=SYSDATE-366;

r_Row                      WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS%ROWTYPE;
v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie      TAB_FND_MAIN.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE%TYPE;
V_part_TA                  TAB_FND_MAIN.part_ta_code%TYPE; --INCPB-1040772                

CURSOR CR_POS( p_Date_Position IN DATE,
               p_Fund_Id       IN VARCHAR2
               ,p_part         IN VARCHAR2 --INCPB-1032559
               ) IS
               
    SELECT SUM(T.PTA_QUANTITY) QTY
    FROM REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS t
    WHERE T.PTA_FUND_ID   = p_Fund_Id --'955569'
    and t.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= p_Date_Position--'20-jun-23'
    and t.pta_e_pos_date >= p_Date_Position --'20-jun-23'
    and ( t.pta_unit_type = p_part
          -- LTA-1111 : fallback NULL restreint aux fonds mono-part, sinon une part
          -- sans PART_TA_CODE (ex: classe dÃ©poolÃ©e inactive) hÃ©rite Ã  tort du total du fonds
          OR ( p_part IS NULL
               AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS T2
                                WHERE T2.PTA_FUND_ID    = t.PTA_FUND_ID
                                  AND T2.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= p_Date_Position
                                  AND T2.PTA_E_POS_DATE >= p_Date_Position
                                  AND T2.PTA_UNIT_TYPE  <> t.PTA_UNIT_TYPE )
             )
        )
    ;

/*CURSOR CR_POS( p_Date_Position IN DATE,
               p_Fund_Id       IN VARCHAR2) IS
               
    SELECT T.PTA_FUND_TK CODE_TELEKURS,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_TK(T.PTA_FUND_TK) CODE_ISIN,
           SUM(T.PTA_QUANTITY) QTY
    FROM REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS t
    WHERE T.PTA_FUND_ID   = p_Fund_Id --'955569'
    and t.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= p_Date_Position--'20-jun-23'
    and t.pta_e_pos_date >= p_Date_Position --'20-jun-23'
    GROUP BY T.PTA_FUND_TK;
*/    
CURSOR CR_TB_FONDS(p_Code_Isin IN VARCHAR2) IS

    SELECT TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE          
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
    WHERE TF.ISIN_CODE = p_Code_Isin;

CURSOR CR_FONDS (p_Date IN DATE) IS
    -- LTA-1111 : GROUP BY FA_NUM pour garantir une seule ligne par fonds.
    -- FA_NUM_IN_TA retirÃ© ici et dÃ©placÃ© au niveau part (CR_PARTS) pour
    -- gÃ©rer les fonds en cours de dÃ©pooling dont les parts pointent vers
    -- des registres TA diffÃ©rents (pool vs individuel).
    SELECT Q.FA_NUM,
           MAX(TF.NAV_BACKDATED) NAV_BACKDATED, --INCPB-976962
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date,-1, 'Y') DATE_NAV,
           MAX(TF.EFRONT)         EFRONT,
           MAX(TF.EFRONT_DATE)    EFRONT_DATE,
           MAX(TF.EFRONT_TA)      EFRONT_TA,
           MAX(TF.EFRONT_TA_DATE) EFRONT_TA_DATE -- INCPB-1001039
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id
      AND Q.FLAG    = 1
      AND (Q.ACTIVATION = 1 AND Q.D_ACTIVATION <= p_Date)
      AND (Q.LIQUIDATION = 2 OR (Q.LIQUIDATION = 1 AND Q.D_LIQUIDATION > p_Date))
      AND Q.FA_NUM       = TF.FA_NUM
    GROUP BY Q.FA_NUM;

CURSOR CR_PARTS (p_FA_NUM IN VARCHAR2,p_Date IN DATE) IS
    -- LTA-1111 : FA_NUM_IN_TA ajoutÃ© pour gÃ©rer le dÃ©pooling part par part.
    -- Chaque part peut pointer vers un registre TA diffÃ©rent (pool ou individuel).
    -- LTA-1111 : FA_POOL_NUM ajoutÃ© pour inclure les parts des sous-fonds rattachÃ©s
    -- au fonds maÃ®tre aprÃ¨s dÃ©pooling (ex: 244061E/G/U, 271382C, 593136J â†’ 329194).
    SELECT TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY, TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,
           NVL(TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA, TF.FA_NUM) FA_NUM_IN_TA
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE (TF.FA_NUM = p_FA_NUM OR TF.FA_POOL_NUM = p_FA_NUM)
      AND (TF.ACTIVATION = 2 OR (TF.ACTIVATION = 1 AND TF.D_ACTIVATION <= p_Date))  -- LTA-1111 : ACTIVATION=2 = toujours actif (par analogie avec LIQUIDATION=2)
      AND (TF.LIQUIDATION = 2 OR (TF.LIQUIDATION = 1 AND TF.D_LIQUIDATION > p_Date));

--INCPB-1001039
CURSOR CR_POS_EF ( p_Isin_Code IN VARCHAR2,
                   p_DateNav   IN DATE
                   ) IS

    SELECT SUM(NVL(T.POS_QUANTITY,0)) QTY
    FROM EFRONT.DATA_PETAL_POSITIONS T
    WHERE T.ISIN_CODE           = p_Isin_Code --'256546' --'442876'
      AND T.POS_NAV_DATE        = p_DateNav  --'01-JAN-18'
      AND NVL(T.POS_QUANTITY,0) > 0
      AND T.OPE_INDEX           = ( SELECT MAX(PO.OPE_INDEX) FROM EFRONT.DATA_PETAL_POSITIONS PO
                                    WHERE PO.SHARECLASS_ID = T.SHARECLASS_ID
                                      AND PO.POS_NAV_DATE  = T.POS_NAV_DATE
                                      AND PO.REGISTER_ID   = T.REGISTER_ID
                                      AND PO.INVESTOR_ID   = T.INVESTOR_ID
                                   )                          
      ;

CURSOR CR_POS_FA (p_FA_Num IN VARCHAR2,p_DateNav IN DATE, p_Part IN VARCHAR2) IS
    SELECT N.NAP_QT_PART,N.NAP_PRICE_PART,N.NAP_MNT_PART
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS N
    INNER JOIN repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
            ON b.fund_no = n.nap_fund_no
    WHERE N.NAP_FUND_NO  = p_FA_Num
      AND N.NAP_DATE_NAV = p_DateNav
      AND N.NAP_TPARTS   = r_Row.Part
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND n.nap_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1));                       -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)

CURSOR CR_POS_FA_EF (p_FA_Num IN VARCHAR2,p_DateNav IN DATE, p_Part IN VARCHAR2) IS
    SELECT N.NAP_QT_PART,N.NAP_PRICE_PART,N.NAP_MNT_PART
    FROM EFRONT.DATA_EF_NAV_PART N
    WHERE N.NAP_FUND_NO  = p_FA_Num
      AND N.NAP_DATE_NAV = p_DateNav
      AND N.NAP_TPARTS   = r_Row.Part;

                            
Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Position_Globale';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Nettoyage
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS T
WHERE T.USER_ID      =  p_User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;



-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
FOR VCR_FONDS IN CR_FONDS ( v_Date_Nav ) LOOP

    v_Fa_Num        := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
    v_Date_Nav_Fund := VCR_FONDS.DATE_NAV;

    v_Date_Pub_Fund    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund);
    v_Date_Calcul_Fund := REPADMIN.get_nav_date_calcul(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund);

    vg_eFront          := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT;
    vg_eFront_Date     := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE;
    vg_eFront_Ta       := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_TA;
    vg_eFront_Ta_Date  := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_TA_DATE;

    -- Parcours des parts
    FOR VCR_PARTS IN CR_PARTS (v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund) LOOP

       r_Row                 := NULL;

       r_Row.Qty             := 0;
       r_Row.Qty_Fa          := 0;
       r_Row.Qty_Diff        := 0;

       -- LTA-1111 : FA_NUM_IN_TA par part pour gÃ©rer les parts en cours de
       -- dÃ©pooling dont les positions TA sont encore dans le pool.
       v_Fund_Id             := VCR_PARTS.FA_NUM_IN_TA;

       -- LTA-1111 : date NAV propre au sous-fonds pour Ã©viter Qty_Fa=0 sur des
       -- fonds dont le calendrier NAV diffÃ¨re du fonds maÃ®tre (ex: FA 541850 / ZP).
       IF VCR_PARTS.FA_NUM = v_Fa_Num THEN
           v_Date_Nav_Part := v_Date_Nav_Fund;
       ELSE
           v_Date_Nav_Part := REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(VCR_PARTS.FA_NUM, v_Date_Nav, -1, 'Y');
       END IF;

       r_Row.code_isin       := VCR_PARTS.ISIN_CODE;
       r_Row.Fa_Num          := VCR_PARTS.FA_NUM;
       r_Row.Fund_Name       := VCR_PARTS.FUND_NAME;
       r_Row.Fund_Ccy        := VCR_PARTS.FUND_CCY;
       r_Row.Part            := VCR_PARTS.PART_FA_CODE;
       r_Row.Part_Ccy        := VCR_PARTS.PART_CCY;
       r_Row.Ta_Number       := VCR_PARTS.TA_NUM;
       v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie := NVL(VCR_PARTS.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,VCR_PARTS.PART_FA_CODE);

       V_part_TA          := Get_TA_code_part(r_Row.Fa_Num,r_Row.Part); --INCPB-1040772

      -- Position TA
      CASE
        -- TA dans Multifonds
        WHEN vg_eFront_Ta = 0 OR (vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND v_Date_Nav_Fund < vg_eFront_Ta_Date) THEN
           --REPADMIN.GET_DATE_POSITION_TA(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund,v_Date_Position,v_Archive);   --INCPB-1040772   
           v_Date_Position := Get_Date_Nav_Prev(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund);   --INCPB-1040772  

           -- RÃ©cup de la position TA
           FOR X IN CR_POS(v_Date_Position,v_Fund_Id, V_part_TA) LOOP   --INCPB-1032559
               r_Row.Qty := NVL(X.QTY,0); 
               EXIT;
           END LOOP;

        -- TA dans eFront
        WHEN vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND v_Date_Nav_Fund >= vg_eFront_Ta_Date THEN
           v_Date_Position := REPADMIN.GET_LAST_DATE_NAV_POS_TA_EFRONT(VCR_PARTS.ISIN_CODE,v_Date_Nav_Fund);        

           -- RÃ©cup de la position TA
           IF v_Date_Position IS NOT NULL THEN
               FOR X IN CR_POS_EF(VCR_PARTS.ISIN_CODE,v_Date_Position) LOOP  
                   r_Row.Qty := NVL(X.QTY,0); 
                   EXIT;
               END LOOP;
           END IF;
           
        ELSE
           --REPADMIN.GET_DATE_POSITION_TA(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund,v_Date_Position,v_Archive);  --INCPB-1040772    
           v_Date_Position := Get_Date_Nav_Prev(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund);              --INCPB-1040772  

           -- RÃ©cup de la position FA
           FOR X IN CR_POS(v_Date_Position,v_Fund_Id, V_part_TA) LOOP  --INCPB-1032559
               r_Row.Qty := NVL(X.QTY,0); 
               EXIT;
           END LOOP;

      END CASE;
    
    
      -- Positions FA
      CASE
        -- FA dans Multifonds
        WHEN vg_eFront = 0 OR (vg_eFront = 1 AND v_Date_Nav_Fund < vg_eFront_Date) THEN

           -- LTA-1111 : r_Row.Fa_Num (= VCR_PARTS.FA_NUM) au lieu de v_Fa_Num pour
           -- chercher dans le sous-fonds (ex: 244061E) et non dans le fonds maÃ®tre (329194).
           -- LTA-1111 : v_Date_Nav_Part au lieu de v_Date_Nav_Fund pour utiliser la
           -- date NAV propre au sous-fonds (Ã©vite Qty_Fa=0 si calendrier NAV diffÃ©rent).
           FOR X IN CR_POS_FA(r_Row.Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Part,r_Row.Part) LOOP
               r_Row.Qty_Fa := NVL(X.NAP_QT_PART,0);
               r_Row.Nav    := NVL(X.NAP_PRICE_PART,0);
               r_Row.Amount := NVL(X.NAP_MNT_PART,0);
               EXIT;
           END LOOP;

        -- FA dans eFront
        WHEN vg_eFront = 1 AND v_Date_Nav_Fund >= vg_eFront_Date THEN

           FOR X IN CR_POS_FA_EF(r_Row.Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Part,r_Row.Part) LOOP
               r_Row.Qty_Fa := NVL(X.NAP_QT_PART,0);
               r_Row.Nav    := NVL(X.NAP_PRICE_PART,0);
               r_Row.Amount := NVL(X.NAP_MNT_PART,0);
               EXIT;
           END LOOP;

        ELSE

           FOR X IN CR_POS_FA(r_Row.Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Part,r_Row.Part) LOOP
               r_Row.Qty_Fa := NVL(X.NAP_QT_PART,0);
               r_Row.Nav    := NVL(X.NAP_PRICE_PART,0);
               r_Row.Amount := NVL(X.NAP_MNT_PART,0);
               EXIT;
           END LOOP;

      END CASE;

      r_Row.Qty_Diff := r_Row.Qty - r_Row.Qty_Fa;

      IF r_Row.Qty = 0 AND r_Row.Qty_Fa = 0 THEN
        GOTO Suivant;
      END IF;

      INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS
        (ta_number,
         fa_num,
         fund_name,
         fund_ccy,
         part,
         part_ccy,
         code_isin,
         qty,
         nav,
         amount,
         date_position,
         date_nav,
         date_calcul,
         date_pub,
         user_id,
         date_creation,
         Qty_Fa,
         Qty_Diff)
      VALUES
        (r_Row.Ta_Number,
         r_Row.Fa_Num,
         r_Row.Fund_Name,
         r_Row.Fund_Ccy,
         v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie, --X.PART,
         r_Row.Part_Ccy,
         r_Row.Code_Isin,
         r_Row.Qty,
         r_Row.Nav,
         r_Row.Amount,
         v_Date_Position, --X.PTA_POS_DATE,
         v_Date_Nav_Fund,
         v_Date_Calcul_Fund,
         v_Date_Pub_Fund,
         p_User_Id,
         v_date_creation,
         r_Row.Qty_Fa,
         r_Row.Qty_Diff);

        <<Suivant>>
        NULL;
    
    END LOOP;
END LOOP;
COMMIT;

p_status           :=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status  :=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='Renvoie Session Id : ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Position_Globale',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
END proc_Ta_Position_Globale;

----------------------------------
-- TA : RÃ©con Position TA et FA --
----------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Position_Globale_v1( p_User_Id   IN VARCHAR2,
                                    p_Date_Nav  IN VARCHAR2,
                                    p_status    OUT NUMBER,
                                    p_msg_err   OUT VARCHAR2) IS


v_status                   NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err                  VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                       NUMBER;

v_date_creation            DATE:= SYSDATE;

v_Date_Nav                 DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_Nav,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Nav_Fund            DATE;
v_Date_Pub_Fund            DATE;
v_Date_Calcul_Fund         DATE;
v_Date_Position            DATE;
v_Fund_Id                  POS_TA.PTA_FUND_ID%TYPE;
v_Fa_Num                   LUXREP_TB_FONDS.FA_NUM%TYPE;
v_Archive                  VARCHAR2(1);

v_Pos_Date_Min             DATE:=SYSDATE-366;

r_Row                      WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS%ROWTYPE;
v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie      TAB_FND_MAIN.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE%TYPE;

CURSOR CR_POS( p_Date_Position IN DATE,
               p_Fund_Id       IN VARCHAR2) IS
               
    SELECT T.PTA_FUND_TK CODE_TELEKURS,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_TK(T.PTA_FUND_TK) CODE_ISIN,
           SUM(T.PTA_QUANTITY) QTY
    FROM REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS t
    WHERE T.PTA_FUND_ID   = p_Fund_Id --'955569'
    and t.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= p_Date_Position--'20-jun-23'
    and t.pta_e_pos_date >= p_Date_Position --'20-jun-23'
    GROUP BY T.PTA_FUND_TK;

CURSOR CR_TB_FONDS(p_Code_Isin IN VARCHAR2) IS

    SELECT TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
    WHERE TF.ISIN_CODE = p_Code_Isin;

CURSOR CR_FONDS (p_Date IN DATE) IS
    SELECT DISTINCT Q.FA_NUM,TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA,TF.NAV_BACKDATED, --INCPB-976962
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date,-1) DATE_NAV,
           TF.EFRONT,TF.EFRONT_DATE,TF.EFRONT_TA,TF.EFRONT_TA_DATE -- INCPB-1001039
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id
      AND Q.FLAG    = 1
      AND (Q.ACTIVATION = 1 AND Q.D_ACTIVATION <= p_Date)
      AND (Q.LIQUIDATION = 2 OR (Q.LIQUIDATION = 1 AND Q.D_LIQUIDATION > p_Date))
      AND Q.FA_NUM       = TF.FA_NUM;

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Position_Globale';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Nettoyage
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS T
WHERE T.USER_ID      =  p_User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;



-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
FOR VCR_FONDS IN CR_FONDS ( v_Date_Nav ) LOOP

    v_Fund_Id       := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA;
    v_Fa_Num        := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
    v_Date_Nav_Fund := VCR_FONDS.DATE_NAV;

    v_Date_Pub_Fund    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund);
    v_Date_Calcul_Fund := REPADMIN.get_nav_date_calcul(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund);

/*    vg_eFront          := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT;
    vg_eFront_Date     := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_DATE;
    vg_eFront_Ta       := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_TA;
    vg_eFront_Ta_Date  := VCR_FONDS.EFRONT_TA_DATE;

    -- RÃ©cup de la date de position et si on va dans l'archive ou non
    CASE
      -- TA dans Multifonds
      WHEN vg_eFront_Ta = 0 OR (vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND v_Date_Nav_Fund < vg_eFront_Ta_Date) THEN
         REPADMIN.GET_DATE_POSITION_TA(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund,v_Date_Position,v_Archive);        
      -- TA dans eFront
      WHEN vg_eFront_Ta = 1 AND v_Date_Nav_Fund >= vg_eFront_Ta_Date THEN
         REPADMIN.GET_LAST_DATE_NAV_POS_TA_EFRONT(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund,v_Date_Position,v_Archive);        
      ELSE
         REPADMIN.GET_DATE_POSITION_TA(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund,v_Date_Position,v_Archive);    
    END CASE;*/

    -- RÃ©cup de la date de position et si on va dans l'archive ou non
    REPADMIN.GET_DATE_POSITION_TA(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund,v_Date_Position,v_Archive);        

    IF v_Date_Nav_Fund IS NULL OR v_Date_Position IS NULL THEN
      GOTO Suivant;
    END IF;

    -- RÃ©cup de la position FA
    FOR X IN CR_POS(v_Date_Position,v_Fund_Id) LOOP

        r_Row := NULL;
        r_Row.Code_Isin := X.CODE_ISIN;
        IF r_Row.Code_Isin IS NOT NULL THEN
           FOR X1 IN CR_TB_FONDS(X.CODE_ISIN) LOOP
               r_Row.Fa_Num          := X1.FA_NUM;
               r_Row.Fund_Name       := X1.FUND_NAME;
               r_Row.Fund_Ccy        := X1.FUND_CCY;
               r_Row.Part            := X1.PART_FA_CODE;
               r_Row.Part_Ccy        := X1.PART_CCY;
               r_Row.Ta_Number       := X1.TA_NUM;
               v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie := NVL(X1.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,X1.PART_FA_CODE);
               EXIT;
           END LOOP;
           ELSE
           FOR X2 IN ( SELECT TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
                              TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,
                              TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE
                       FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
                       WHERE TF.TELEKURS_CODE = X.CODE_TELEKURS) LOOP
               r_Row.Code_Isin       := X2.ISIN_CODE;
               r_Row.Fa_Num          := X2.FA_NUM;
               r_Row.Fund_Name       := X2.FUND_NAME;
               r_Row.Fund_Ccy        := X2.FUND_CCY;
               r_Row.Part            := X2.PART_FA_CODE;
               r_Row.Part_Ccy        := X2.PART_CCY;
               r_Row.Ta_Number       := X2.TA_NUM;
               v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie := NVL(X2.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,X2.PART_FA_CODE);
               EXIT;
           END LOOP;
        END IF;

        -- Quantity FA
        r_Row.Qty    := NVL(X.QTY,0);
        r_Row.Qty_Fa := 0;
        FOR X3 IN ( SELECT N.NAP_QT_PART,N.NAP_PRICE_PART,N.NAP_MNT_PART
                    FROM NAV_PARTS N
                    WHERE N.NAP_FUND_NO  = r_Row.Fa_Num
                      AND N.NAP_DATE_NAV = v_Date_Nav_Fund
                      AND N.NAP_TPARTS   = r_Row.Part) LOOP

            r_Row.Qty_Fa := NVL(X3.NAP_QT_PART,0);
            r_Row.Nav    := NVL(X3.NAP_PRICE_PART,0);
            r_Row.Amount := NVL(X3.NAP_MNT_PART,0);
            EXIT;
        END LOOP;
        r_Row.Qty_Diff := r_Row.Qty - r_Row.Qty_Fa;

        INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS
          (ta_number,
           fa_num,
           fund_name,
           fund_ccy,
           part,
           part_ccy,
           code_isin,
           qty,
           nav,
           amount,
           date_position,
           date_nav,
           date_calcul,
           date_pub,
           user_id,
           date_creation,
           Qty_Fa,
           Qty_Diff)
        VALUES
          (r_Row.Ta_Number,
           r_Row.Fa_Num,
           r_Row.Fund_Name,
           r_Row.Fund_Ccy,
           v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie, --X.PART,
           r_Row.Part_Ccy,
           r_Row.Code_Isin,
           X.QTY,
           r_Row.Nav,
           r_Row.Amount,
           v_Date_Position, --X.PTA_POS_DATE,
           v_Date_Nav_Fund,
           v_Date_Calcul_Fund,
           v_Date_Pub_Fund,
           p_User_Id,
           v_date_creation,
           r_Row.Qty_Fa,
           r_Row.Qty_Diff);

    END LOOP;

    <<Suivant>>
    NULL;
END LOOP;

p_status           :=v_status;

-- End Monitoring

when err then
      p_status  :=v_status;

when others then

PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Position_Globale_Old( p_User_Id   IN VARCHAR2,
                                    p_Date_Nav  IN VARCHAR2,
                                    p_status    OUT NUMBER,
                                    p_msg_err   OUT VARCHAR2) IS


v_status                   NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err                  VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                       NUMBER;

v_date_creation            DATE:= SYSDATE;

v_Date_Nav                 DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_Nav,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Nav_Fund            DATE;
v_Date_Pub_Fund            DATE;
v_Date_Calcul_Fund         DATE;
v_Date_Position            DATE;
v_Fund_Id                  POS_TA.PTA_FUND_ID%TYPE;
v_Fa_Num                   LUXREP_TB_FONDS.FA_NUM%TYPE;
v_Archive                  VARCHAR2(1);

v_Pos_Date_Min             DATE:=SYSDATE-366;

r_Row                      WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS%ROWTYPE;
v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie      TAB_FND_MAIN.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE%TYPE;

CURSOR CR_POS( p_Date_Position IN DATE,
               p_Fund_Id       IN VARCHAR2) IS
    SELECT T.PTA_POS_DATE,T.PTA_FUND_ID FUND_NUMBER,T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE PART,
           SUM(NVL(T.PTA_QUANTITY,0)) QTY,T.PTA_NAV_DATE,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_TK(T.PTA_FUND_TK) CODE_ISIN,
           T.PTA_FUND_TK CODE_TELEKURS
    FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA  T
    WHERE T.PTA_POS_DATE = p_Date_Position
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID  = p_Fund_Id
      AND T.PTA_NAV_DATE IS NOT NULL
      AND NVL(T.PTA_NAV,0) <> 0
    GROUP BY T.PTA_POS_DATE,T.PTA_FUND_ID,T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE,
             T.PTA_NAV_DATE,T.PTA_FUND_TK;

CURSOR CR_POS_ARC( p_Date_Position IN DATE,
                   p_Fund_Id       IN VARCHAR2) IS
    SELECT T.PTA_POS_DATE,T.PTA_FUND_ID FUND_NUMBER,T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE PART,
           SUM(NVL(T.PTA_QUANTITY,0)) QTY,T.PTA_NAV_DATE,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_TK(T.PTA_FUND_TK) CODE_ISIN,
           T.PTA_FUND_TK CODE_TELEKURS
    FROM REPADMIN.POS_TA_ARC  T
    WHERE T.PTA_POS_DATE = p_Date_Position
      AND T.PTA_FUND_ID  = p_Fund_Id
      AND T.PTA_NAV_DATE IS NOT NULL
      AND NVL(T.PTA_NAV,0) <> 0
    GROUP BY T.PTA_POS_DATE,T.PTA_FUND_ID,T.PTA_UNIT_TYPE,
             T.PTA_NAV_DATE,T.PTA_FUND_TK;

CURSOR CR_TB_FONDS(p_Code_Isin IN VARCHAR2) IS

    SELECT TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
    WHERE TF.ISIN_CODE = p_Code_Isin;

CURSOR CR_FONDS (p_Date IN DATE) IS
    SELECT DISTINCT Q.FA_NUM,TF.FA_NUM_IN_TA,
           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(Q.FA_NUM,p_Date,-1) DATE_NAV
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id
      AND Q.FLAG    = 1
      AND (Q.ACTIVATION = 1 AND Q.D_ACTIVATION <= p_Date)
      AND (Q.LIQUIDATION = 2 OR (Q.LIQUIDATION = 1 AND Q.D_LIQUIDATION > p_Date))
      AND Q.FA_NUM       = TF.FA_NUM;

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Position_Globale';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Nettoyage
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS T
WHERE T.USER_ID      =  p_User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;



-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
FOR VCR_FONDS IN CR_FONDS ( v_Date_Nav ) LOOP

    v_Fund_Id       := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM_IN_TA;
    v_Fa_Num        := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
    v_Date_Nav_Fund := VCR_FONDS.DATE_NAV;

    v_Date_Pub_Fund    := REPADMIN.GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund);
    v_Date_Calcul_Fund := REPADMIN.get_nav_date_calcul(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund);

    -- RÃ©cup de la date de position et si on va dans l'archive ou non
    REPADMIN.GET_DATE_POSITION_TA(v_Fa_Num,v_Date_Nav_Fund,v_Date_Position,v_Archive);

    IF v_Date_Nav_Fund IS NULL OR v_Date_Position IS NULL THEN
      GOTO Suivant;
    END IF;

    -- RÃ©cup de la position FA

    CASE v_Archive

        WHEN 'N' THEN

            FOR X IN CR_POS(v_Date_Position,v_Fund_Id) LOOP

                r_Row := NULL;
                r_Row.Code_Isin := X.CODE_ISIN;
                IF r_Row.Code_Isin IS NOT NULL THEN
                   FOR X1 IN CR_TB_FONDS(X.CODE_ISIN) LOOP
                       r_Row.Fa_Num          := X1.FA_NUM;
                       r_Row.Fund_Name       := X1.FUND_NAME;
                       r_Row.Fund_Ccy        := X1.FUND_CCY;
                       r_Row.Part            := X1.PART_FA_CODE;
                       r_Row.Part_Ccy        := X1.PART_CCY;
                       r_Row.Ta_Number       := X1.TA_NUM;
                       v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie := NVL(X1.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,X1.PART_FA_CODE);
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;
                   ELSE
                   FOR X2 IN ( SELECT TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
                                      TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,
                                      TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE
                               FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
                               WHERE TF.TELEKURS_CODE = X.CODE_TELEKURS) LOOP
                       r_Row.Code_Isin       := X2.ISIN_CODE;
                       r_Row.Fa_Num          := X2.FA_NUM;
                       r_Row.Fund_Name       := X2.FUND_NAME;
                       r_Row.Fund_Ccy        := X2.FUND_CCY;
                       r_Row.Part            := X2.PART_FA_CODE;
                       r_Row.Part_Ccy        := X2.PART_CCY;
                       r_Row.Ta_Number       := X2.TA_NUM;
                       v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie := NVL(X2.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,X2.PART_FA_CODE);
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;
                END IF;

                -- Quantity FA
                r_Row.Qty    := NVL(X.QTY,0);
                r_Row.Qty_Fa := 0;
                FOR X3 IN ( SELECT N.NAP_QT_PART,N.NAP_PRICE_PART,N.NAP_MNT_PART
                            FROM NAV_PARTS N
                            WHERE N.NAP_FUND_NO  = r_Row.Fa_Num

                    r_Row.Qty_Fa := NVL(X3.NAP_QT_PART,0);
                    r_Row.Nav    := NVL(X3.NAP_PRICE_PART,0);

                    EXIT;
                END LOOP;
                r_Row.Qty_Diff := r_Row.Qty - r_Row.Qty_Fa;

                INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_POS

                   fa_num,

                   fund_ccy,
