                   part_ccy,
                   code_isin,
                   qty,
                   nav,
                   amount,
                   date_position,
                   date_nav,
                   date_calcul,
                   date_pub,
                   user_id,
                   date_creation,
                   Qty_Fa,
                   Qty_Diff)
                VALUES
                  (r_Row.Ta_Number,
                   r_Row.Fa_Num,
                   r_Row.Fund_Name,
                   r_Row.Fund_Ccy,
                   v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie, --X.PART,
                   r_Row.Part_Ccy,
                   r_Row.Code_Isin,
                   X.QTY,
                   r_Row.Nav,
                   r_Row.Amount,
                   X.PTA_POS_DATE,
                   v_Date_Nav_Fund,
                   v_Date_Calcul_Fund,
                   v_Date_Pub_Fund,
                   p_User_Id,
                   v_date_creation,
                   r_Row.Qty_Fa,
                   r_Row.Qty_Diff);

            END LOOP;

        -- Insertion des donnÃ©es ARCHIVEES
        WHEN 'Y' THEN

            FOR X IN CR_POS_ARC(v_Date_Position,v_Fund_Id) LOOP

                r_Row := NULL;
                r_Row.Code_Isin := X.CODE_ISIN;
                IF r_Row.Code_Isin IS NOT NULL THEN
                   FOR X1 IN CR_TB_FONDS(X.CODE_ISIN) LOOP
                       r_Row.Fa_Num          := X1.FA_NUM;
                       r_Row.Fund_Name       := X1.FUND_NAME;
                       r_Row.Fund_Ccy        := X1.FUND_CCY;
                       r_Row.Part            := X1.PART_FA_CODE;
                       r_Row.Part_Ccy        := X1.PART_CCY;
                       r_Row.Ta_Number       := X1.TA_NUM;
                       v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie := NVL(X1.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,X1.PART_FA_CODE);
                       EXIT;
                   END LOOP;
                   ELSE
                   FOR X2 IN ( SELECT TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
                                      TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.TA_NUM,
                                      TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE
                               FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
                               WHERE TF.TELEKURS_CODE = X.CODE_TELEKURS) LOOP
                       r_Row.Code_Isin       := X2.ISIN_CODE;
                       r_Row.Fa_Num          := X2.FA_NUM;
                       r_Row.Fund_Name       := X2.FUND_NAME;
                       r_Row.Fund_Ccy        := X2.FUND_CCY;
                       r_Row.Part            := X2.PART_FA_CODE;
                       r_Row.Part_Ccy        := X2.PART_CCY;
                       r_Row.Ta_Number       := X2.TA_NUM;
                       v_Part_Fa_Code_Publie := NVL(X2.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,X2.PART_FA_CODE);

                -- Quantity FA

                r_Row.Qty_Fa := 0;
                FOR X3 IN ( SELECT N.NAP_QT_PART,N.NAP_PRICE_PART,N.NAP_MNT_PART
                            FROM NAV_PARTS N
                            WHERE N.NAP_FUND_NO  = r_Row.Fa_Num
                              AND N.NAP_DATE_NAV = v_Date_Nav_Fund

                    r_Row.Qty_Fa := NVL(X3.NAP_QT_PART,0);

---------------------------
-- TA : Inflow - Outflow --
---------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Inflow_Outflow ( p_Reg_Type       IN NUMBER, -- 1 = Tous les registres, 2 = Registres FlagÃ©s
                                   p_Code_Ope_Type  IN NUMBER, -- 1 = Tous les codes opÃ©, 2 = Codes opÃ© FlagÃ©s
                                   p_User_Id        IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_Date_From      IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_Date_To        IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_Rep_Ccy        IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_status         OUT NUMBER,
                                   p_msg_err        OUT VARCHAR2) IS


v_status              NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                  NUMBER;

v_date_creation       DATE:= SYSDATE;

v_Date_From           DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');

v_Flag_Min            NUMBER;
v_Flag_Max            NUMBER;

v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope   NUMBER;
v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope   NUMBER;

r_Row                 WRK_QUERIES_TA_IN_OUT%ROWTYPE;
--v_Tx_Change           NUMBER;
v_Date_From_Ta        DATE;
v_Date_To_Ta          DATE;

v_Nav_Suiv_Existe     BOOLEAN;

CURSOR CR_IN_OUT( v_Code_Isin         IN VARCHAR2,
                  v_Date_From         IN DATE,
                  v_Date_To           IN DATE,
                  v_Flag_Min          IN NUMBER,
                  v_Flag_Max          IN NUMBER,
                  v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope IN NUMBER,
                  v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope IN NUMBER,
                  v_In_Out            IN NUMBER) IS

   SELECT SUM(T.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1)) AMOUNT,
          SUM(T.OPT_QUANTITY * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1)) QUANTITY
   FROM REPADMIN.OP_TA  T,
        REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE_SETUP C
   WHERE T.OPT_OP_DATE       >= v_Date_From --'01-DEC-11'
     AND T.OPT_OP_DATE       < v_Date_To --'31-DEC-11'
     AND T.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN    = v_Code_Isin --'LU0255977372'
     AND T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO IN ( SELECT DISTINCT REG.REGISTER_NUMBER
                                  FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG REG
                                  WHERE REG.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                    AND (NVL(REG.FLAG,0) = v_Flag_Min
                                     OR  NVL(REG.FLAG,0) = v_Flag_Max))
     AND T.OPT_OP_CODE       IN ( SELECT DISTINCT C.CODE_OPE
                                  FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE C
                                  WHERE C.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                    AND (NVL(C.FLAG,0) = v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope
                                     OR  NVL(C.FLAG,0) = v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope))
     AND T.OPT_OP_CODE    = C.CODE_OPE
     AND C.INFLOW_OUTFLOW = v_In_Out --1
  ORDER BY T.OPT_NPTF,T.OPT_TPART;

--ok
CURSOR CR_NAV (p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2) IS
    SELECT T.NAP_FUND_NO FUND_NUMBER,TF.TA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_TYPE(T.NAP_FUND_NO,T.NAP_DATE_NAV) FUND_TYPE,
           NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(T.NAP_FUND_NO,T.NAP_DATE_NAV),T.NAP_FUND_NO) FUND_NUMBER_REF,
           NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE,TF.PART_FA_CODE) PART,
           --T.NAP_TPARTS,
           TF.PART_CCY,TF.ISIN_CODE,
           T.NAP_DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.NAP_DATE_TRT) DATE_CALCUL,T.NAP_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION,
           NVL(M.NAP_PRICE_PART,T.NAP_PRICE_PART) PRICE_PART_CCY,
           T.NAP_PRICE_PART PRICE_FUND_CCY,
           NVL(M.NAP_MNT_PART,T.NAP_MNT_PART) TNA_PART_CCY,
           T.NAP_MNT_PART TNA_FUND_CCY,
           REPADMIN.GET_TNA_FDS(T.NAP_FUND_NO,T.NAP_DATE_NAV) TNA_FONDS,
           REPADMIN.GET_TNA_FDS_TOT_LIVE(T.NAP_FUND_NO,T.NAP_DATE_NAV) TNA_COMP
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS T,
         REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY M,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE T.NAP_FUND_NO         = p_Fund_Number
      AND TRUNC(T.NAP_DATE_TRT) >= v_Date_From --'01-JAN-12'
      AND TRUNC(T.NAP_DATE_TRT) <= v_Date_To --'31-JAN-12'
      AND T.NAP_FUND_NO         = TF.FA_NUM
      AND T.NAP_TPARTS          = TF.PART_FA_CODE
      AND T.NAP_CONTROLE        = 'Y'
      AND T.NAP_TA              = 'Y'
      AND T.NAP_FUND_NO         = M.NAP_FUND_NO(+)
      AND T.NAP_DATE_NAV        = M.NAP_DATE_NAV(+)
      AND T.NAP_TPARTS          = M.NAP_TPARTS(+)
      AND T.NAP_TYP_TRT         = M.NAP_TYP_TRT (+)
      AND b.fund_no = t.nap_fund_no
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.nap_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                        -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
    ORDER BY T.NAP_FUND_NO,T.NAP_DATE_NAV,T.NAP_TPARTS;

CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV_PREC ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                          p_Date_Nav    IN DATE,
                          p_Part        IN VARCHAR2) IS

    SELECT T.NAP_TPARTS,T.NAP_DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.NAP_DATE_TRT) DATE_CALCUL,
           NVL(MC.NAP_MNT_PART,T.NAP_MNT_PART) TNA_PART_CCY,
           T.NAP_PRICE_PART PRICE_FUND_CCY,
           NVL(MC.NAP_PRICE_PART,T.NAP_PRICE_PART) PRICE_PART_CCY
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS T,
         REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY MC,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE T.NAP_FUND_NO  = p_Fund_Number
      AND T.NAP_DATE_NAV < p_Date_Nav
      AND T.NAP_TPARTS   = p_Part
      AND T.NAP_FUND_NO  = MC.NAP_FUND_NO(+)
      AND T.NAP_DATE_NAV = MC.NAP_DATE_NAV(+)
      AND T.NAP_TPARTS   = MC.NAP_TPARTS(+)
      AND T.NAP_TYP_TRT  = MC.NAP_TYP_TRT (+)
      AND T.NAP_CONTROLE = 'Y'
      AND T.NAP_TA       = 'Y'
      AND b.fund_no = t.nap_fund_no
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.nap_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                        -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
    ORDER BY T.NAP_DATE_NAV DESC;

-- ok
CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV_SUIV ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                          p_Date_Nav    IN DATE) IS
    SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.NAV_DATE_TRT) DATE_CALCUL
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV T,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO  = p_Fund_Number
      AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV > p_Date_Nav
      AND T.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y'
      AND T.NAV_TA       = 'Y'
      AND b.fund_no = t.nav_fund_no
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.nav_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                        -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
    ORDER BY T.NAV_DATE_NAV;

CURSOR CR_NAV_SUIV ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                     p_Date_Nav    IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.NAP_FUND_NO FUND_NUMBER,TF.TA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_TYPE(T.NAP_FUND_NO,T.NAP_DATE_NAV) FUND_TYPE,
           NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(T.NAP_FUND_NO,T.NAP_DATE_NAV),T.NAP_FUND_NO) FUND_NUMBER_REF,
           T.NAP_TPARTS,TF.PART_CCY,TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.TELEKURS_CODE,
           T.NAP_DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.NAP_DATE_TRT) DATE_CALCUL
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE T.NAP_FUND_NO         = p_Fund_Number
      AND T.NAP_DATE_NAV        = p_Date_Nav
      AND T.NAP_FUND_NO         = TF.FA_NUM
      AND T.NAP_TPARTS          = TF.PART_FA_CODE
      AND T.NAP_CONTROLE        = 'Y'
      AND T.NAP_TA              = 'Y'
      AND b.fund_no = t.nap_fund_no
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.nap_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                        -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
    ORDER BY T.NAP_FUND_NO,T.NAP_DATE_NAV,T.NAP_TPARTS;

CURSOR CR_PARTS ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                  p_Date_Ope_Ta IN DATE) IS

    SELECT TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_TYPE,
           NVL(TF.FA_REF_NUM,TF.FA_NUM) FA_REF_NUM,
           TF.PART_FA_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.ISIN_CODE
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
    WHERE TF.FA_NUM      = p_Fund_Number --'280350'
      AND TF.ACTIVATION  = 1
      AND TF.LIQUIDATION = 2
    UNION
    -- Pour les nouvelles parts crÃ©es dans TA et pas encore dans FA
    SELECT T.OPT_MULTIFONDS_ID,TF.FUND_TYPE,
           NVL(TF.FA_REF_NUM,T.OPT_MULTIFONDS_ID) FA_REF_NUM,
           T.OPT_TPART,T.OPT_QUOT_CCY,T.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN
    FROM REPADMIN.OP_TA T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF
       WHERE T.OPT_MULTIFONDS_ID = TF.FA_NUM(+)
         AND T.OPT_OP_DATE       > p_Date_Ope_Ta --'01-AUG-12'
         AND T.OPT_NPTF          IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T.C_FUND
                                      FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUNDS  T
                                      WHERE T.C_MF_FUND = p_Fund_Number --'280350'
                                      UNION
                                      SELECT DISTINCT P.FUND_NUMBER_TA
                                      FROM REPADMIN.TURNOVER_CORRESP_NUM_FA_TA  P
                                      WHERE P.FUND_NUMBER_FA = p_Fund_Number);

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Inflow_Outflow';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Nettoyage
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_IN_OUT T
WHERE T.USER_ID      =  p_User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;


CASE p_Reg_Type
     -- Tous les registres
     WHEN 1 THEN
          v_Flag_Min := 0;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;

     -- Registres sÃ©lectionnÃ©s
     WHEN 2 THEN
          v_Flag_Min := 1;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;

     --
     ELSE
          v_Flag_Min := 0;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;
END CASE;

CASE p_Code_Ope_Type
     -- Tous les codes opÃ©
     WHEN 1 THEN
          v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope := 0;
          v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope := 1;

     -- Codes opÃ© sÃ©lectionnÃ©s
     WHEN 2 THEN
          v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope := 1;
          v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope := 1;

     --
     ELSE
          v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope := 0;
          v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope := 1;
END CASE;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT Q.FA_NUM,Q.FUND_NAME,Q.FUND_CCY
                   FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q
                   WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                     AND Q.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

    r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Type := p_Rep_Ccy;
    r_Row.Fa_Num       := VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM;
    r_Row.Fund_Ccy     := VCR_FONDS.FUND_CCY;

    v_Date_From_Ta     := NULL;
    v_Date_To_Ta       := NULL;
    v_Nav_Suiv_Existe  := FALSE;

    FOR X IN CR_NAV ( r_Row.Fa_Num)  LOOP

        r_Row.Fa_Num_Ref       := X.FUND_NUMBER_REF;
        r_Row.Fund_Name        := GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(r_Row.Fa_Num_Ref);
        r_Row.Part             := X.PART;
        r_Row.Part_Ccy         := X.PART_CCY;
        r_Row.Code_Isin        := X.ISIN_CODE;
        r_Row.Date_Nav_Prev    := X.NAP_DATE_NAV;
        r_Row.Date_Calcul_Prev := X.DATE_CALCUL;
        r_Row.Tna_Part         := X.TNA_PART_CCY;
        r_Row.Tna_Fund         := X.TNA_FONDS;
        r_Row.Tna_Comp         := X.TNA_COMP;
        r_Row.Price_Part_Ccy   := X.PRICE_PART_CCY;
        r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy   := X.PRICE_FUND_CCY;

        v_Date_From_Ta         := r_Row.Date_Calcul_Prev;

        -- RÃ©cup de la date de nav suivante pour dÃ©terminer
        -- la Date Ope TA To et la date de nav Ã  laquelle
        -- les opÃ© TA vont rentrer dans la nav
        v_Date_To_Ta         := NULL;
        r_Row.Date_Nav       := NULL;
        r_Row.Date_Calcul    := NULL;

        FOR X1 IN CR_DATE_NAV_SUIV ( r_Row.Fa_Num,
                                     r_Row.Date_Nav_Prev) LOOP

             v_Nav_Suiv_Existe := TRUE;

             r_Row.Date_Nav    := X1.NAV_DATE_NAV;
             r_Row.Date_Calcul := X1.DATE_CALCUL;
             v_Date_To_Ta      := X1.DATE_CALCUL;
             EXIT;
        END LOOP;
        IF v_Date_To_Ta IS NULL THEN
           v_Date_To_Ta := SYSDATE;
        END IF;

        r_Row.Qty_In      := 0;
        r_Row.Amount_In   := 0;
        FOR VCR_IN_OUT IN CR_IN_OUT( r_Row.Code_Isin,v_Date_From_Ta,v_Date_To_Ta,
                                     v_Flag_Min,v_Flag_Max,
                                     v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope,v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope,1) LOOP

            r_Row.Qty_In    := NVL(VCR_IN_OUT.QUANTITY,0);
--            r_Row.Amount_In := NVL(VCR_IN_OUT.AMOUNT,0);
            EXIT;
        END LOOP;

        r_Row.Qty_Out     := 0;
        r_Row.Amount_Out  := 0;
        FOR VCR_IN_OUT IN CR_IN_OUT( r_Row.Code_Isin,v_Date_From_Ta,v_Date_To_Ta,
                                     v_Flag_Min,v_Flag_Max,
                                     v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope,v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope,-1) LOOP

            r_Row.Qty_Out    := NVL(VCR_IN_OUT.QUANTITY,0);
--            r_Row.Amount_Out := NVL(VCR_IN_OUT.AMOUNT,0);
            EXIT;
        END LOOP;

        r_Row.Qty_Net    := NVL(r_Row.Qty_In,0) - NVL(r_Row.Qty_Out,0);
        r_Row.Amount_In  := ROUND(r_Row.Qty_In * r_Row.Price_Part_Ccy,2);
        r_Row.Amount_Out := ROUND(r_Row.Qty_Out * r_Row.Price_Part_Ccy,2);
        r_Row.Amount_Net := NVL(r_Row.Amount_In,0) - NVL(r_Row.Amount_Out,0);

        CASE
            WHEN p_Rep_Ccy = '1' THEN
                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy := X.PART_CCY;
            WHEN p_Rep_Ccy = '2' THEN
                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy := X.FUND_CCY;
            WHEN p_Rep_Ccy = '3' THEN
--                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy := REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(X.FUND_NUMBER_REF);
                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy := REPADMIN.GET_COMPARTIMENT_CCY(X.FUND_NUMBER); --INCPB-821829
            ELSE
                 r_Row.Rep_Ccy := p_Rep_Ccy;
        END CASE;

        r_Row.x_Rate             := GET_X_RATE_MF_CM( r_Row.Part_Ccy, --INCPB-821829
                                                      r_Row.Rep_Ccy,
                                                      r_Row.Fa_Num,
                                                      r_Row.Date_Nav_Prev,
                                                      r_Row.Date_Calcul_Prev,
                                                      X.NAP_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION);

        IF NVL(r_Row.x_Rate,0)=0 THEN
           r_Row.x_Rate := GET_X_RATE_MF_2(X.PART_CCY,r_Row.Rep_Ccy,r_Row.Date_Calcul_Prev);
        END IF;
        r_Row.Amount_In_Rep_Ccy  := ROUND(r_Row.Amount_In * r_Row.x_Rate,2);
        r_Row.Amount_Out_Rep_Ccy := ROUND(r_Row.Amount_Out * r_Row.x_Rate,2);
        r_Row.Amount_Net_Rep_Ccy := NVL(r_Row.Amount_In_Rep_Ccy,0) - NVL(r_Row.Amount_Out_Rep_Ccy,0);
        r_Row.Tna_Rep_Ccy        := ROUND(r_Row.Tna_Fund * r_Row.x_Rate,2);

        INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_TA_IN_OUT
          (fa_num_ref,
           fa_num,
           fund_name,
           fund_ccy,
           part,
           part_ccy,
           code_isin,
           date_nav_prev,
           date_calcul_prev,
           date_nav,
           date_calcul,
           qty_in,
           qty_out,
           qty_net,
           price_part_ccy,
           price_fund_ccy,
           amount_in,
           amount_out,
           amount_net,
           tna_part,
           tna_fund,
           tna_comp,
           rep_ccy_type,
           rep_ccy,
           x_rate,
           amount_in_rep_ccy,
           amount_out_rep_ccy,
           amount_net_rep_ccy,
           tna_rep_ccy,
           user_id,
           date_creation)
        VALUES
          (r_Row.Fa_Num_Ref,
           r_Row.Fa_Num,
           r_Row.FUND_NAME,
           r_Row.FUND_CCY,
           r_Row.PART,
           r_Row.PART_CCY,
           r_Row.Code_Isin,
           r_Row.Date_Nav_Prev,
           r_Row.Date_Calcul_Prev,
           r_Row.Date_Nav,
           r_Row.Date_Calcul,
           r_Row.Qty_In,
           r_Row.Qty_Out,
           r_Row.Qty_Net,
           r_Row.Price_Part_Ccy,
           r_Row.Price_Fund_Ccy,
           r_Row.Amount_In,
           r_Row.Amount_Out,
           r_Row.Amount_Net,
           r_Row.Tna_Part,
           r_Row.Tna_Fund,
           r_Row.Tna_Comp,
           r_Row.Rep_Ccy_Type,
           r_Row.Rep_Ccy,
           r_Row.x_Rate,
           r_Row.Amount_In_Rep_Ccy,
           r_Row.Amount_Out_Rep_Ccy,
           r_Row.Amount_Net_Rep_Ccy,
           r_Row.Tna_Rep_Ccy,
           p_User_Id,
           v_date_creation);

    END LOOP;
END LOOP;
COMMIT;

p_status           :=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status  :=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='Renvoie Session Id : ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Inflow_Outflow',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
end proc_Ta_Inflow_Outflow;

--------------------------------------
-- TA : OpÃ©ration s/Comptes BloquÃ©s --
--------------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Ope_Cpt_Bloque ( p_Reg_Type       IN NUMBER, -- 1 = Tous les registres, 2 = Registres FlagÃ©s
                                   p_Code_Ope_Type  IN NUMBER, -- 1 = Tous les codes opÃ©, 2 = Codes opÃ© FlagÃ©s
                                   p_User_Id        IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_Date_From      IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_Date_To        IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_status         OUT NUMBER,
                                   p_msg_err        OUT VARCHAR2) IS


v_status              NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                  NUMBER;

v_date_creation       DATE:= SYSDATE;

v_Date_From           DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');

v_Flag_Min            NUMBER;
v_Flag_Max            NUMBER;

v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope   NUMBER;
v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope   NUMBER;

CURSOR CR_MAIN ( v_Date_From         IN DATE,
                 v_Date_To           IN DATE,
                 v_Flag_Min          IN NUMBER,
                 v_Flag_Max          IN NUMBER,
                 v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope IN NUMBER,
                 v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope IN NUMBER) IS

   SELECT T.OPT_NPTF TA_NUMBER,TF.FA_NUM FA_NUMBER,
          TF.FUND_NAME,T.OPT_FUNDS_CCY FUND_CCY,T.OPT_TPART PART,
          T.OPT_QUOT_CCY PART_CCY,OPT_FUNDS_ISIN CODE_ISIN,
          T.OPT_OP_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('COPER',T.OPT_OP_CODE) OPE_CODE_NAME,
          T.OPT_QUANTITY * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) OPT_QUANTITY,
          T.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) GROSS_AMOUNT,
          T.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) NET_AMOUNT,
          T.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ * DECODE(T.OPT_TYPE_LOG,'03',1,'04',-1) COMM_AMOUNT,
          T.OPT_COMM_TYPE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('TCOMM',T.OPT_COMM_TYPE) TYPE_COM,
          T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPT_INPUT_DATE,
          T.OPT_OP_DATE, T.OPT_VALUE_DATE,
          T.OPT_EXT_CODE EXT_CODE,T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,
          DECODE(T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,NULL,0,1) OPE_STP,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,0,1) CLEARING_FLAG,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,NULL,T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO) CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,NULL,R.L_NAME) CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
          DECODE(T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO,T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO,NULL,T.OPT_NREGISTER_ACC_NO) CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
          T.OPT_OP_NUM_TA OPE_NUM_TA,OPT_OUTLET_NO OUTLET_NUMBER,OPT_TYPE_LOG TYPE_LOG,
          T.OPT_PRICE,T.OPT_PRICE_FUNDS_CCY,V.N_DAYS,T.OPT_CDEF_DELIV,
/*          RB.FULL_BLOCKED,
          DECODE(RB.FULL_BLOCKED,'Y',RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE,RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE) BLOCKED_DATE,
          DECODE(RB.FULL_BLOCKED,'Y',RB.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE) BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
          DECODE(RB.FULL_BLOCKED,'Y',RB.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON,RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON) BLOCKED_REASON,
          DECODE(RB.FULL_BLOCKED,'Y',RB.FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT,RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT) BLOCKED_COMMENT,*/
         (CASE 
            WHEN T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE) THEN
                 'Y'
            ELSE
                 'N'  
         END) FULL_BLOCKED,
         (CASE 
            WHEN T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE) THEN
                 RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE
            ELSE
                 RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE
         END) BLOCKED_DATE,
         (CASE 
            WHEN T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE) THEN
                 RB.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE
            ELSE
                 RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE
         END) BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
         (CASE 
            WHEN T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE) THEN
                 RB.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON
            ELSE
                 RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON
         END) BLOCKED_REASON,
         (CASE 
            WHEN T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE) THEN
                 RB.FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT
            ELSE
                 RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT
         END) BLOCKED_COMMENT,                  
          R.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE CUSTODY_SETTLE_CODE,REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE('CDELIV', R.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE) CUSTODY_SETTLE_DESC
  FROM REPADMIN.OP_TA  T,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER  R,
        REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE  V,
        REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
        REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED RB
   WHERE OPT_OP_DATE >= v_Date_From --'01-DEC-09'
     AND OPT_OP_DATE <= v_Date_To --'31-DEC-09'
     AND T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = R.C_N_REGISTER
     AND T.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = RB.REGISTER_NUMBER
     AND T.OPT_NPTF IN (SELECT DISTINCT T.C_FUND
                        FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUNDS  T
                        WHERE T.C_MF_FUND IN (SELECT Q.FA_NUM
                                              FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q
                                              WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                                AND Q.FLAG    = 1)
                        UNION
                        SELECT DISTINCT P.FUND_NUMBER_TA
                        FROM REPADMIN.TURNOVER_CORRESP_NUM_FA_TA  P
                        WHERE P.FUND_NUMBER_FA IN (SELECT Q.FA_NUM
                                                   FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS Q
                                                   WHERE Q.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                                     AND Q.FLAG    = 1))
     AND T.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN    = TF.ISIN_CODE
     AND T.OPT_NPTF          = V.C_FUND(+)
     AND T.OPT_OP_CODE       = V.C_OPE(+)
     AND T.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO IN (SELECT DISTINCT REG.REGISTER_NUMBER
                                 FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_REG REG
                                 WHERE REG.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                   AND (NVL(REG.FLAG,0) = v_Flag_Min
                                    OR  NVL(REG.FLAG,0) = v_Flag_Max))
     AND T.OPT_OP_CODE       IN  (SELECT DISTINCT C.CODE_OPE
                                  FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_CODE_OPE C
                                  WHERE C.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                    AND (NVL(C.FLAG,0) = v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope
                                     OR  NVL(C.FLAG,0) = v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope))
    AND (
        -- Full blocked
        (T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE))
       OR
        -- Redem blocked
        (T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE))
       OR
        -- Full blocked on this funds
        (RB.FUNDS_BLOCKED = TF.STRUCTURE_NUM AND T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE))
       OR
        -- Redem blocked on this funds
        (RB.FUNDS_BLOCKED = TF.STRUCTURE_NUM AND T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE))
        )
/*    AND (
        -- Full blocked
        (RB.ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED = 'Y' AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED = 'Y' AND T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)))
       OR
        -- Redem blocked
        (RB.ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED = 'Y' AND (RB.REDEM_BLOCKED = 'Y' AND T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)))
       OR
        -- Full blocked on this funds
        (RB.ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED = 'N' AND RB.FUNDS_BLOCKED = TF.STRUCTURE_NUM AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED = 'Y' AND T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)))
       OR
        -- Redem blocked on this funds
        (RB.ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED = 'N' AND RB.FUNDS_BLOCKED = TF.STRUCTURE_NUM AND (RB.FULL_BLOCKED = 'N' AND T.OPT_OP_DATE >= RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR T.OPT_OP_DATE < RB.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)))
        )*/        
        ;


Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Ope_Cpt_Bloque';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Nettoyage
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_CPT_BLOQUE T
WHERE T.USER_ID      =  p_User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;


CASE p_Reg_Type
     -- Tous les registres
     WHEN 1 THEN
          v_Flag_Min := 0;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;

     -- Registres sÃ©lectionnÃ©s
     WHEN 2 THEN
          v_Flag_Min := 1;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;

     --
     ELSE
          v_Flag_Min := 0;
          v_Flag_Max := 1;
END CASE;

--
CASE p_Code_Ope_Type
     -- Tous les codes opÃ©
     WHEN 1 THEN
          v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope := 0;
          v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope := 1;

     -- Codes opÃ© sÃ©lectionnÃ©s
     WHEN 2 THEN
          v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope := 1;
          v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope := 1;

     --
     ELSE
          v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope := 0;
          v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope := 1;
END CASE;

-- Insertion des donnÃ©es
FOR X IN CR_MAIN( v_Date_From,v_Date_To,v_Flag_Min,v_Flag_Max,
                  v_Flag_Min_Code_Ope,v_Flag_Max_Code_Ope) LOOP

    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_CPT_BLOQUE
      (register_number,
       ta_number,
       fa_num,
       fund_name,
       fund_ccy,
       part,
       part_ccy,
       code_isin,
       ope_date_input,
       ope_date_ope,
       ope_date_value,
       ope_code,
       ope_code_name,
       ope_qty,
       ope_gross_amount,
       ope_net_amount,
       ope_commission,
       ope_commission_type,
       ope_commission_name,
       ope_reversal_code,
       ope_stp_reference,
       ope_stp_flag,
       clearing_flag,
       clearing_register_number,
       clearing_register_name,
       clearing_account,
       user_id,
       date_creation,
       ope_num_ta,
       ope_outlet_number,
       ope_type_log,
       price,
       price_fund_ccy,
       ope_code_nb_days,
       FULL_BLOCKED,
       BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
       BLOCKED_REASON,
       BLOCKED_COMMENT,
       BLOCKED_DATE,
       CUSTODY_SETTLE_CODE,
       CUSTODY_SETTLE_DESC)
    VALUES
      (X.REGISTER_NUMBER,
       X.TA_NUMBER,
       X.FA_NUMBER,
       X.FUND_NAME,
       X.FUND_CCY,
       X.PART,
       X.PART_CCY,
       X.CODE_ISIN,
       X.OPT_INPUT_DATE,
       X.OPT_OP_DATE,
       X.OPT_VALUE_DATE,
       X.OPT_OP_CODE,
       X.OPE_CODE_NAME,
       X.OPT_QUANTITY,
       X.GROSS_AMOUNT,
       X.NET_AMOUNT,
       X.COMM_AMOUNT,
       X.OPT_COMM_TYPE,
       X.TYPE_COM,
       X.EXT_CODE,
       X.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN,
       X.OPE_STP,
       X.CLEARING_FLAG,
       X.CLEARING_REGISTER_NUMBER,
       X.CLEARING_REGISTER_NAME,
       X.CLEARING_ACCOUNT,
       p_user_id,
       v_date_creation,
       X.OPE_NUM_TA,
       X.OUTLET_NUMBER,
       X.TYPE_LOG,
       X.OPT_PRICE,
       X.OPT_PRICE_FUNDS_CCY,
       X.N_DAYS,
       X.FULL_BLOCKED,
       X.BLOCKED_REASON_CODE,
       X.BLOCKED_REASON,
       X.BLOCKED_COMMENT,
       X.BLOCKED_DATE,
       X.CUSTODY_SETTLE_CODE,
       X.CUSTODY_SETTLE_DESC);

END LOOP;


COMMIT;

p_status           :=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status  :=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='Renvoie Session Id : ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Ope_Cpt_Bloque',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
end proc_Ta_Ope_Cpt_Bloque;

-- CRM : Fees --

PROCEDURE proc_Crm_Fees(p_User_Id     IN VARCHAR2,
                        p_Period_Type IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                        p_Date_From   IN VARCHAR2,
                        p_Date_To     IN VARCHAR2,
                        p_status      OUT NUMBER,
                        p_msg_err     OUT VARCHAR2) IS


v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_date_creation         DATE:= SYSDATE;

v_Date_From             DATE;
v_Date_To               DATE;

v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;

v_Calcul                TAB_FND_MAIN.CALCUL%TYPE;

r_Row                   WRK_QUERIES_CRM_FEES%ROWTYPE;

CURSOR CR_AVALUX ( v_Avalux_Num   IN VARCHAR2,
                   v_Date_From    IN DATE,
                   v_Date_To      IN DATE) IS

    SELECT T.COMPANY_CODE,T.MESSAGEID,T.L007_NO_ORDER_AVQ NO_ORDER_AVQ,T.TEREF_OPER_OP,T.LOT,
           T.DATE_RECORD,T.COOPER CODE_OPE,T.L001_COOPER_TYP CODE_OPE_TYPE,
           TRIM(T.L001_TEFACTU_L39) || ' - ' || TRIM(T.L007_OPE_TEFACTU_L73) OPE_DESCRIPTION,
           T.L007_AVQ_ASSET_GROUP SEC_VEHICULE,
           T.L007_COPAYSL_ISO_VAL || T.L007_NOVAL_NEN_L9 || T.L007_NOCTL_VAL_ISIN CODE_ISIN, T.GRINFIN,
           T.L001_NOCLI_ORD BP_NUMBER, TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM T.L007_NOCNTNR_AVQ) CONT_NUMBER,
           TO_DATE(T.L001_DSORD,'YYYYMMDD') DATE_ORDER,
           TO_DATE(T.L001_DSOPER,'YYYYMMDD') DATE_OPE,TO_DATE(T.L001_DSVAL,'YYYYMMDD') DATE_VALUE,
           TRIM(T.L007_ASSET_PUID) CODE_PUID,
           PKG_MESI_PROCESS_TRANSACTION.GET_PUID_MF(T.L007_COPAYSL_ISO_VAL || T.L007_NOVAL_NEN_L9 ||
              T.L007_NOCTL_VAL_ISIN,T.L001_COMONL_ISO_OPER,T.COMPANY_CODE) CODE_PUID_FULL,
           T.L007_NOCLI_BROK_NOUV BROKER_NUMBER, T.L007_AVQ_STEX_BROKER_NAME BROKER_NAME,
           T.L001_COMONL_ISO_CC_PAIM_TIT ACCOUNT_CCY,
           T.L001_COMONL_ISO_OPER OPE_CCY,T.L001_COMONL_ISO_RC FUND_CCY,
           T.L001_CHMON_CC_MONRC X_RATE_OPE_CCY_FUND_CCY,
           T.L001_CHMONRC_FS X_RATE_FUND_CCY_CHF,
           T.L001_CHMONRV_FS X_RATE_OPE_CCY_CHF,
           ABS(T.L001_QTFACTU_D5) QUANTITY,T.L001_CUTIT_1 PRICE,
           DECODE(T.L001_SIMONT_BRUT_MONOP,'-', T.L001_MTBRUT_MONOP * -1,
                                                T.L001_MTBRUT_MONOP) GROSS_AMOUNT_OPE_CCY,
           DECODE(T.L001_SIMONT_NET_MON_CC,'-', T.L001_MTNET_MON_CC * -1,
                                                T.L001_MTNET_MON_CC) NET_AMOUNT_OPE_CCY,
           DECODE(T.L007_SIMTFTOT_MONOP_MONTANT,'-',T.L007_MTFTOT_MONOP_MONTANT * -1,
                                                    T.L007_MTFTOT_MONOP_MONTANT) TOTAL_FRAIS_OPE_CCY,
           T.L001_MTBRUT_FS GROSS_AMOUNT_CHF,
           T.L001_MTFCOR_MONOP CORRESP_FEES_OPE_CCY,T.L001_MTFCOR_FS CORRESP_FEES_CHF,
           T.L001_MTTAXET_MONOP FOREIGN_TAX_OPE_CCY,T.L001_MTTAXET_FS FOREIGN_TAX_CHF,
           T.L001_MTHACHA_MONOP HANDLING_CHARGES_OPE_CCY,T.L001_MTHACHA_FS HANDLING_CHARGES_CHF,
           T.L001_MTCTGE_MON_CC COURTAGE_FEE_OPE_CCY,T.L001_MTCTGE_FS COURTAGE_FEE_CHF,
           T.L001_MTTAXCT_MON_CC OTHER_FEE_OPE_CCY,T.L001_MTTAXCT_FS OTHER_FEE_CHF,
           T.L001_MTFDIV_MON_CC DIV_TAX_OPE_CCY,T.L001_MTFDIV_FS DIV_TAX_CHF,
           T.L001_MTTF_MON_CC OTHER_FEE_OPE_CCY_1,T.L001_MTTF_FS OTHER_FEE_CHF_1
    FROM REPADMIN.MESI_TRANSACTION_L001  T
    WHERE T.L001_NOCLI_ORD = v_Avalux_Num --'280548'
      AND T.L001_DSOPER    >= TO_CHAR(v_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD')
      AND T.L001_DSOPER    <= TO_CHAR(v_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');

CURSOR CR_DATE_NAV ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                     p_Date_Nav    IN DATE) IS
    SELECT T.NAV_DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.NAV_DATE_TRT) DATE_CALCUL,
           T.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION
    FROM REPADMIN.NAV T,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE T.NAV_FUND_NO = p_Fund_Number --'280158'
    AND T.NAV_DATE_NAV <= p_Date_Nav
    AND b.fund_no = t.nav_fund_no
    AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.nav_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
         OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                        -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
    ORDER BY T.NAV_DATE_NAV DESC;

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Crm_Fees';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Nettoyage
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_CRM_FEES T
WHERE T.USER_ID      =  p_User_Id
  OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;


FOR X IN (SELECT T.FA_NUM
          FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS T
          WHERE T.USER_ID = p_User_Id
            AND T.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

      v_Date_From := TO_DATE(p_Date_From,'YYYYMMDD');
      v_Date_To   := TO_DATE(p_Date_To,'YYYYMMDD');

      IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN

         FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV (X.FA_NUM,SYSDATE) LOOP
             v_Date_Nav_To := VCR_DATE_NAV.NAV_DATE_NAV;
             v_Date_To     := VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_CALCUL-1;
             EXIT;
         END LOOP;

         FOR VCR_DATE_NAV IN CR_DATE_NAV (X.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_To-1) LOOP
             v_Date_Nav_From := VCR_DATE_NAV.NAV_DATE_NAV;
             v_Date_From     := VCR_DATE_NAV.DATE_CALCUL;
             EXIT;
         END LOOP;
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
      ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( X.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_From,v_Date_To);
      END IF;

      FOR X1 IN (SELECT DISTINCT T.C_EXT_FUND
                 FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_EQUI_FONDS  T
                 WHERE T.C_FUND IN (SELECT DISTINCT TF.FA_NUM
                                    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
                                    WHERE TF.FA_REF_NUM = X.FA_NUM --'280857'
                                    UNION
                                    SELECT DISTINCT TF.FA_POOL_NUM
                                    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
                                    WHERE TF.FA_REF_NUM = X.FA_NUM --'280857'
                                    UNION
                                    SELECT DISTINCT TF.FA_NUM
                                    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN  TF
                                    WHERE TF.FA_NUM = X.FA_NUM)) LOOP

            -- Insertion des donnÃ©es Avalux
            FOR X3 IN CR_AVALUX(X1.C_EXT_FUND,v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

                r_Row.Sec_Code_Interne_Fa := NULL;
                FOR X4 IN ( SELECT T.C_N_ID
                            FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_SEC_INTL_ID  T
                            WHERE T.G_ID_VALUE = X3.CODE_PUID_FULL
                              AND T.C_ID_TYP   = 25
                            ORDER BY T.N_LOT) LOOP

                    r_Row.Sec_Code_Interne_Fa := X4.C_N_ID;
                    EXIT;
                END LOOP;

                INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_CRM_FEES
                  (fa_num,
                   sfi_num,
                   ope_date,
                   ope_num,
                   ope_code,
                   ope_description,
                   ope_ccy,
                   sec_vehicule,
                   sec_code_isin,
                   sec_code_interne_fa,
                   broker_number,
                   broker_name,
                   broker_fees,
                   broker_fees_chf,
                   deposit_fees,
                   deposit_fees_chf,
                   correspondant_fees,
                   correspondant_fees_chf,
                   pictet_fees,
                   pictet_fees_chf,
                   other_fees,
                   other_fees_chf,
                   user_id,
                   date_creation)
                VALUES
                  (X.FA_NUM,
                   X3.BP_NUMBER,
                   X3.DATE_OPE,
                   X3.NO_ORDER_AVQ,
                   X3.CODE_OPE,
                   X3.OPE_DESCRIPTION,
                   X3.OPE_CCY,
                   X3.SEC_VEHICULE,
                   X3.CODE_ISIN,
                   r_Row.Sec_Code_Interne_Fa,
                   X3.BROKER_NUMBER,
                   X3.BROKER_NAME,
                   X3.COURTAGE_FEE_OPE_CCY + X3.HANDLING_CHARGES_OPE_CCY,
                   X3.COURTAGE_FEE_CHF + X3.HANDLING_CHARGES_CHF,
                   NULL,
                   NULL,
                   X3.CORRESP_FEES_OPE_CCY,
                   X3.CORRESP_FEES_CHF,
                   NULL,
                   NULL,
                   X3.OTHER_FEE_OPE_CCY + X3.DIV_TAX_OPE_CCY + X3.OTHER_FEE_OPE_CCY_1,
                   X3.OTHER_FEE_CHF + X3.DIV_TAX_CHF + X3.OTHER_FEE_CHF_1,
                   p_User_Id,
                   v_date_creation);

            END LOOP;
      END LOOP;
END LOOP;
COMMIT;

p_status           :=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status  :=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='Renvoie Session Id : ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Crm_Fees',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
END proc_Crm_Fees;

--------------------------------------
-- TA : OpÃ©ration s/Comptes BloquÃ©s --
--------------------------------------
PROCEDURE proc_Do_Refresh_Class ( p_User_Id IN VARCHAR2,
                                  p_status  OUT NUMBER,
                                  p_msg_err OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status              NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err             VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                  NUMBER;

v_date_creation       DATE:= SYSDATE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN IS
    SELECT T.INTERNAL_FA_CODE
    FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN T
    WHERE T.FUND_TYPE IN (1,2,4)
      AND T.ACTIVATION  = 1
      AND T.LIQUIDATION = 2
      AND T.INTERNAL_FA_CODE NOT IN ( SELECT C.INTERNAL_FA_CODE
                                      FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_SETUP_DO_CLASS C);

Err               EXCEPTION;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Do_Refresh_Class';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Insertion des parts non-prÃ©sentes
FOR X IN CR_MAIN LOOP

    INSERT INTO LUXREP_SETUP_DO_CLASS
      (internal_fa_code,
       class_reference,
       creation_by,
       creation_date)
    VALUES
      (X.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,
       0,
       p_User_Id,
       v_date_creation);

END LOOP;

-- Suppression des parts liquidÃ©es
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_SETUP_DO_CLASS C
WHERE C.INTERNAL_FA_CODE IN ( SELECT T.INTERNAL_FA_CODE
                              FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN T
                              WHERE T.FUND_TYPE IN (1,2,4)
                                AND T.ACTIVATION  = 1
                                AND T.LIQUIDATION = 1);

COMMIT;

p_status           :=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

------------------------------------------------------------------
--    Gestion des erreurs
-------------------------------------------------------------------
exception
when err then
      p_status  :=v_status;
      p_msg_err :=v_msg_err;
      rollback;
      -- Error Monitoring
      ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

when others then
      p_status:=-1;
      p_msg_err :='Renvoie Session Id : ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
      rollback;

      -- Error Monitoring
      Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

      ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Do_Refresh_Class',P_message => p_msg_err);
      commit;
end proc_Do_Refresh_Class;

PROCEDURE proc_Ra_Linearisation ( p_Date_From_Str    IN VARCHAR2,
                                  p_Date_To_Str      IN VARCHAR2,
                                  p_User_Id          IN VARCHAR2,
                                  p_Structure_Number IN NUMBER,
                                  p_Type_Date        IN NUMBER DEFAULT 1,
                                  p_status           OUT NUMBER,
                                  p_msg_err          OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From_Str,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To_Str,'YYYYMMDD');

v_Quarter               VARCHAR2(6);
v_Creation_Date         DATE:= SYSDATE;

CURSOR CR_FACTURES_TD ( p_Date_From IN DATE,
                        p_Date_To   IN DATE) IS

      SELECT T.N_STRUCTURE,S.STRUCTURE_NAME,
             NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(T.FUND_NUM,p_Date_To),T.FUND_NUM) FUND_NUMBER_REF,
             T.FUND_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,T.FUND_CCY,NULL PART,
             T.GEN_DATE,T.DATE_MUTUALISATION, REPADMIN.get_nav_date_nav(T.FUND_NUM,T.DATE_MUTUALISATION,-1) DATE_NAV,
             T.TRANSIT_ACC_SFI,T.TRANSIT_CONTRACT,NULL TYPE_COMPTE,
             SUM(DECODE(T.TYPE_OP,'FACTURE',T.AMOUNT_TTC_BY_FUND,-T.AMOUNT_TTC_BY_FUND)) MONTANT,T.BILL_CCY,
             NULL MONTANT_TVA,T.TVA_CCY,REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_MF_2(T.BILL_CCY,'EUR',p_Date_To,6) X_RATE,
             NULL MONTANT_EUR ,NULL TVA_MONTANT_EUR ,NULL TOTAL_MONTANT_EUR ,
             NVL(L.FLAG_PARTS_Z,0) PARTS_Z_EXCLUES,
             REPADMIN.GET_TNA_RATIO_CLASS_Z(T.FUND_NUM,REPADMIN.get_nav_date_nav(T.FUND_NUM,T.DATE_MUTUALISATION,-1)) RATIO_Z,
             NULL MONTANT_EUR_Z,NULL TVA_MONTANT_EUR_Z, NULL TOTAL_MONTANT_EUR_Z,
             T.N_OP,E.WE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE,L.VALUE_DATE
      FROM REPADMIN.WKF_FULL_DETAILS_FACTU T,
           REPADMIN.BILL_OP_LIST L,
           REPADMIN.TAB_FND_STRUCT S,
           REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS TF,
           REPADMIN.WKF_EVENTS E
      WHERE T.N_STRUCTURE      = p_Structure_Number
        AND T.GEN_DATE         >= p_Date_From --'01-APR-15'
        AND T.GEN_DATE         <= p_Date_To --'30-JUN-15'
        AND T.N_OP             = L.N_OP
        AND T.N_STRUCTURE      = S.N_STRUCTURE
        AND T.FUND_NUM         = TF.FA_NUM
        AND T.N_OP             = E.WE_DESCRIPTION_SECONDAIRE
        AND E.WE_LAST_TASK_NAME IN ('Archiver Dossier','Comptabiliser Manco') -- CRQ82118
        AND E.WE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE < p_Date_To + 1
      GROUP BY T.N_STRUCTURE,S.STRUCTURE_NAME,T.FUND_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,T.FUND_CCY,
            T.DATE_MUTUALISATION,T.GEN_DATE,REPADMIN.get_nav_date_nav(T.FUND_NUM,T.GEN_DATE,-1),
            T.BILL_CCY,T.TRANSIT_ACC_SFI,T.TRANSIT_CONTRACT,
            T.TVA_CCY,L.FLAG_PARTS_Z,T.N_OP,E.WE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE,L.VALUE_DATE;

CURSOR CR_FACTURES_PD ( p_Date_From IN DATE,
                        p_Date_To   IN DATE) IS

      SELECT T.N_STRUCTURE,S.STRUCTURE_NAME,
             NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(T.FUND_NUM,p_Date_To),T.FUND_NUM) FUND_NUMBER_REF,
             T.FUND_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,T.FUND_CCY,NULL PART,
             T.GEN_DATE,T.DATE_MUTUALISATION, REPADMIN.get_nav_date_nav(T.FUND_NUM,T.DATE_MUTUALISATION,-1) DATE_NAV,
             T.TRANSIT_ACC_SFI,T.TRANSIT_CONTRACT,NULL TYPE_COMPTE,
             SUM(DECODE(T.TYPE_OP,'FACTURE',T.AMOUNT_TTC_BY_FUND,-T.AMOUNT_TTC_BY_FUND)) MONTANT,T.BILL_CCY,
             NULL MONTANT_TVA,T.TVA_CCY,REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_MF_2(T.BILL_CCY,'EUR',p_Date_To,6) X_RATE,
             NULL MONTANT_EUR ,NULL TVA_MONTANT_EUR ,NULL TOTAL_MONTANT_EUR ,
             NVL(L.FLAG_PARTS_Z,0) PARTS_Z_EXCLUES,
             REPADMIN.GET_TNA_RATIO_CLASS_Z(T.FUND_NUM,REPADMIN.get_nav_date_nav(T.FUND_NUM,T.DATE_MUTUALISATION,-1)) RATIO_Z,
             NULL MONTANT_EUR_Z,NULL TVA_MONTANT_EUR_Z, NULL TOTAL_MONTANT_EUR_Z,
             T.N_OP,E.WE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE,L.VALUE_DATE
      FROM REPADMIN.WKF_FULL_DETAILS_FACTU T,
           REPADMIN.BILL_OP_LIST L,
           REPADMIN.TAB_FND_STRUCT S,
           REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS TF,
           REPADMIN.WKF_EVENTS E
      WHERE T.N_STRUCTURE      = p_Structure_Number
        AND T.N_OP             = L.N_OP
        AND T.N_STRUCTURE      = S.N_STRUCTURE
        AND T.FUND_NUM         = TF.FA_NUM
        AND T.N_OP             = E.WE_DESCRIPTION_SECONDAIRE
        AND E.WE_LAST_TASK_NAME IN ('Archiver Dossier','Comptabiliser Manco') -- CRQ82118
        AND E.WE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE >= p_Date_From
        AND E.WE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE < p_Date_To + 1
      GROUP BY T.N_STRUCTURE,S.STRUCTURE_NAME,T.FUND_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME,T.FUND_CCY,
            T.DATE_MUTUALISATION,T.GEN_DATE,REPADMIN.get_nav_date_nav(T.FUND_NUM,T.GEN_DATE,-1),
            T.BILL_CCY,T.TRANSIT_ACC_SFI,T.TRANSIT_CONTRACT,
            T.TVA_CCY,L.FLAG_PARTS_Z,T.N_OP,E.WE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE,L.VALUE_DATE;

CURSOR CR_SYNDRY_FEES ( p_Date_From IN DATE,
                        p_Date_To   IN DATE) IS

    SELECT DISTINCT TF.STRUCTURE_NUM,S.STRUCTURE_NAME,
           NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(T.C_FUND,p_Date_To),T.C_FUND) FUND_NUMBER_REF,
           T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           T.C_SHARE ,TF.PART_CCY,TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,
           DECODE(P.FLAG_Z,3,1,P.FLAG_Z) CLASS_GROUP,
           NULL CLASS_GROUP_NAME,
           T.C_N_ACC,REPADMIN.GET_LIB_CPT_BILAN(T.C_N_ACC,'20') ACCOUNT_NAME,
           -SUM(T.A_VARIATION) SUNDRY_FEES,
           REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_MF_2(TF.FUND_CCY,'EUR',p_Date_To,6) X_RATE,
           ROUND(-SUM(T.A_VARIATION) * REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_MF_2(TF.FUND_CCY,'EUR',p_Date_To,6),2) SUNDRY_FEES_EUR
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_NAV_ARC_PNL_DELTA T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
         REPADMIN.BILL_LISTE_PARTS P,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_STRUCT S,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE T.C_FUND IN ( SELECT DISTINCT TB.FA_NUM
                        FROM REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TB
                        WHERE TB.STRUCTURE_NUM = p_Structure_Number )
      AND T.C_FUND  IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T.FA_NUM
                         FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS T
                         WHERE T.STRUCTURE_NUM = p_Structure_Number
                         AND  NVL(T.FA_REF_NUM,T.FA_NUM) =
                              NVL(NULL,NVL(T.FA_REF_NUM,T.FA_NUM)))
      --NVL(p_Fund_Number,T.C_FUND)
      AND T.D_NAV   >= p_Date_From --'01-APR-15'
      AND T.D_NAV   <= p_Date_To --'30-JUN-15'
      AND T.C_FUND  = TF.FA_NUM
      AND T.C_SHARE = TF.PART_FA_CODE
      AND T.C_SHARE = P.PARTS
      AND TF.STRUCTURE_NUM = S.N_STRUCTURE
      AND T.C_N_ACC IN (41170,41171)
      AND b.fund_no = t.c_fund
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.c_nav_typ = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1))                      -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)
    GROUP BY TF.STRUCTURE_NUM,S.STRUCTURE_NAME,T.C_FUND,TF.FUND_NAME,TF.FUND_CCY,
           T.C_SHARE,TF.PART_CCY,TF.ISIN_CODE,TF.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,
           T.C_N_ACC,P.FLAG_Z;



r_Bill  WRK_QUERIES_RA_LINEAR_BILL%ROWTYPE;
r_Fees  WRK_QUERIES_RA_LINEAR_FEES%ROWTYPE;

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ra_Linearisation';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_RA_LINEAR_BILL T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_RA_LINEAR_FEES T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

COMMIT;

-- DonnÃ©es communes
v_Quarter := get_quarter(v_Date_To);

-- Factures
CASE p_Type_Date
     -- By Trade Date
     WHEN 1 THEN
        FOR X1 IN CR_FACTURES_TD (v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

            r_Bill := NULL;

            -- Montant en Eur
            r_Bill.Bill_Amount_Eur    := ROUND(X1.MONTANT * X1.X_RATE,2);
            r_Bill.Tva_Amount_Eur     := ROUND(X1.TVA_MONTANT_EUR * X1.X_RATE,2);
            r_Bill.Total_Amount_Eur   := ROUND(X1.TOTAL_MONTANT_EUR * X1.X_RATE,2);
            --IF X1.PARTS_Z_EXCLUES = 1 THEN                                                      --INCPB-216045
            IF X1.PARTS_Z_EXCLUES = 0 THEN                                                        --INCPB-216045
              r_Bill.Bill_Amount_z_Eur  := ROUND(r_Bill.Bill_Amount_Eur * X1.RATIO_Z,2);
              r_Bill.Tva_Amount_z_Eur   := ROUND(r_Bill.Tva_Amount_Eur * X1.RATIO_Z,2);
              r_Bill.Total_Amount_z_Eur := ROUND(r_Bill.Total_Amount_Eur * X1.RATIO_Z,2);
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_RA_LINEAR_BILL
              (fund_number,
               subfund_id,
               subfund_number,
               part,
               date_from,
               date_to,
               date_eoq,
               quarter,
               date_generation,
               date_mutualisation,
               date_nav,
               transit_account,
               transit_contract,
               account_type,
               bill_amount,
               bill_ccy,
               tva_amount,
               tva_ccy,
               x_rate,
               bill_amount_eur,
               tva_amount_eur,
               total_amount_eur,
               parts_z_excluded,
               parts_z_ratio,
               bill_amount_z_eur,
               tva_amount_z_eur,
               total_amount_z_eur,
               user_id,
               date_creation,
               ope_number,
               payment_date,
               payment_value_date)
            VALUES
              (X1.N_STRUCTURE,
               X1.FUND_NUMBER_REF,
               X1.FUND_NUM,
               X1.PART,
               v_date_from,
               v_date_to,
               v_date_to,
               v_Quarter,
               X1.GEN_DATE,
               X1.DATE_MUTUALISATION,
               X1.DATE_NAV,
               X1.TRANSIT_ACC_SFI,
               X1.TRANSIT_CONTRACT,
               X1.TYPE_COMPTE,
               X1.MONTANT,
               X1.BILL_CCY,
               X1.MONTANT_TVA,
               X1.TVA_CCY,
               X1.X_RATE,
               r_Bill.Bill_Amount_Eur,
               r_Bill.Tva_Amount_Eur,
               r_Bill.Total_Amount_Eur,
               X1.PARTS_Z_EXCLUES,
               X1.RATIO_Z,
               r_Bill.Bill_Amount_z_Eur,
               r_Bill.Tva_Amount_z_Eur,
               r_Bill.Total_Amount_z_Eur,
               p_User_Id,
               v_Creation_Date,
               X1.N_OP,
               X1.WE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE,
               X1.VALUE_DATE);

        END LOOP;

     -- By Payment Date
     WHEN 2 THEN
        FOR X1 IN CR_FACTURES_PD (v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

            r_Bill := NULL;

            -- Montant en Eur
            r_Bill.Bill_Amount_Eur    := ROUND(X1.MONTANT * X1.X_RATE,2);
            r_Bill.Tva_Amount_Eur     := ROUND(X1.TVA_MONTANT_EUR * X1.X_RATE,2);
            r_Bill.Total_Amount_Eur   := ROUND(X1.TOTAL_MONTANT_EUR * X1.X_RATE,2);
            --IF X1.PARTS_Z_EXCLUES = 1 THEN                                                      --INCPB-216045
            IF X1.PARTS_Z_EXCLUES = 0 THEN                                                        --INCPB-216045
              r_Bill.Bill_Amount_z_Eur  := ROUND(r_Bill.Bill_Amount_Eur * X1.RATIO_Z,2);
              r_Bill.Tva_Amount_z_Eur   := ROUND(r_Bill.Tva_Amount_Eur * X1.RATIO_Z,2);
              r_Bill.Total_Amount_z_Eur := ROUND(r_Bill.Total_Amount_Eur * X1.RATIO_Z,2);
            END IF;

            INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_RA_LINEAR_BILL
              (fund_number,
               subfund_id,
               subfund_number,
               part,
               date_from,
               date_to,
               date_eoq,
               quarter,
               date_generation,
               date_mutualisation,
               date_nav,
               transit_account,
               transit_contract,
               account_type,
               bill_amount,
               bill_ccy,
               tva_amount,
               tva_ccy,
               x_rate,
               bill_amount_eur,
               tva_amount_eur,
               total_amount_eur,
               parts_z_excluded,
               parts_z_ratio,
               bill_amount_z_eur,
               tva_amount_z_eur,
               total_amount_z_eur,
               user_id,
               date_creation,
               ope_number,
               payment_date,
               payment_value_date)
            VALUES
              (X1.N_STRUCTURE,
               X1.FUND_NUMBER_REF,
               X1.FUND_NUM,
               X1.PART,
               v_date_from,
               v_date_to,
               v_date_to,
               v_Quarter,
               X1.GEN_DATE,
               X1.DATE_MUTUALISATION,
               X1.DATE_NAV,
               X1.TRANSIT_ACC_SFI,
               X1.TRANSIT_CONTRACT,
               X1.TYPE_COMPTE,
               X1.MONTANT,
               X1.BILL_CCY,
               X1.MONTANT_TVA,
               X1.TVA_CCY,
               X1.X_RATE,
               r_Bill.Bill_Amount_Eur,
               r_Bill.Tva_Amount_Eur,
               r_Bill.Total_Amount_Eur,
               X1.PARTS_Z_EXCLUES,
               X1.RATIO_Z,
               r_Bill.Bill_Amount_z_Eur,
               r_Bill.Tva_Amount_z_Eur,
               r_Bill.Total_Amount_z_Eur,
               p_User_Id,
               v_Creation_Date,
               X1.N_OP,
               X1.WE_LAST_UPDATED_DATE,
               X1.VALUE_DATE);

        END LOOP;

     ELSE
       NULL;
END CASE;


-- Fees
FOR X IN CR_SYNDRY_FEES (v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

    INSERT INTO WRK_QUERIES_RA_LINEAR_FEES
      (fund_number,
       subfund_id,
       subfund_number,
       part,
       part_ccy,
       isin_code,
       internal_fa_code,
       class_group,
       date_from,
       date_to,
       date_eoq,
       quarter,
       account_number,
       account_name,
       fees_amount,
       x_rate,
       fees_amount_eur,
       user_id,
       date_creation)
    VALUES
      (X.STRUCTURE_NUM,
       X.FUND_NUMBER_REF,
       X.FUND_NUMBER,
       X.C_SHARE,
       X.PART_CCY,
       X.ISIN_CODE,
       X.INTERNAL_FA_CODE,
       X.CLASS_GROUP,
       v_date_from,
       v_date_to,
       v_date_to,
       v_Quarter,
       X.C_N_ACC,
       X.ACCOUNT_NAME,
       X.SUNDRY_FEES,
       X.X_RATE,
       X.SUNDRY_FEES_EUR,
       p_User_Id,
       v_Creation_Date);


END LOOP;
COMMIT;


    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ra_Linearisation',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Ra_Linearisation;
