PROCEDURE proc_Fa_Fees_Rate ( p_Date_From_Str IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_Date_To_Str   IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_Period_Type   IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                              p_User_Id       IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_status        OUT NUMBER,
                              p_msg_err       OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From_Str,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To_Str,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_Nav_From         DATE;
v_Date_Nav_To           DATE;

v_Creation_Date         DATE:= SYSDATE;

CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Fund_Number IN VARCHAR2,
                 p_Date_From   IN DATE,
                 p_Date_To     IN DATE) IS

    SELECT TF.ISIN_CODE,T.C_FUND FUND_NUMBER,REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_NAME,
           REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.C_FUND) FUND_CCY,
           G.TPARTS SHARECLASS,TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE PUBLISH_SHARECLASS,
           DECODE(T.C_NAV_TYP,'O',1,2)   NAV_TYPE,
           T.D_NAV DATE_NAV,TRUNC(T.D_H_PROCESSING) DATE_CALCUL ,
           N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION DATE_PUB,
           T.C_OPE_TRANS_FEES OPE_CODE,T.C_N_FEE FEES_CODE,
           C.XLIBELLE FEES_DESCRIPTION , C.CODE_GRP_MULTICLASS GROUPE_MC,
           T.R_INTEREST PERCENTAGE
    FROM REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_NAV_ARC_RESULT  T,
         REPADMIN.MF_CHARGES   C,
         REPADMIN.NAV  N,
         REPADMIN.MF_GRP_MULTICLASS G,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
         repadmin.v_fund_backdated_flag b
    WHERE T.C_FUND           IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                                  FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                                  WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                    AND F.FA_NUM  = NVL(p_Fund_Number,F.FA_NUM)
                                    AND F.FLAG    = 1)
      AND T.D_NAV            >= p_Date_From
      AND T.D_NAV            <= p_Date_To
      AND T.C_OPE_TRANS      = '960'
      AND T.C_OPE_TRANS_FEES = C.COPER
      AND T.C_N_FEE          = C.NOFRAIS
      AND T.C_FUND           = N.NAV_FUND_NO
      AND T.D_NAV            = N.NAV_DATE_NAV
      AND T.D_PREV_NAV_DATE  IS NOT NULL
      AND T.D_NEXT_NAV_DATE  IS NOT NULL
      AND T.C_FUND           = G.NPTF
      AND G.ACC_TYPE         ='0'
      AND G.CODE_MULTICLASS  = NVL(C.CODE_GRP_MULTICLASS,1)
      AND G.NPTF             = TF.FA_NUM
      AND G.TPARTS           = TF.PART_FA_CODE
      AND B.FUND_NO          = T.C_FUND
      AND (   (b.nav_backdated = 0 AND t.c_nav_typ = 'O'    -- Normal : Official NAV type only
                                   AND n.nav_typ_trt = 'O') -- Normal : Official NAV type only
           OR (b.nav_backdated = 1));                       -- Backdated : all NAV types (Official and Unofficial)

Err Exception;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Fa_Fees_Rate';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- Suppression des donnÃ©es de ce user_id
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_FA_FEES_RATE T
WHERE T.USER_ID       = p_User_Id
   OR T.DATE_CREATION <= SYSDATE-1;

COMMIT;

IF p_Period_Type IN ('LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY', 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV') THEN

     FOR VCR_FONDS IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                        WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id --'JLIVET'
                          AND F.FLAG    = 1) LOOP

        IF p_Period_Type = 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN
           get_Date_Last_Available_Day( 1,VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
-- CRQ 55927   Ajout de la gestion des 2 nouvelles pÃ©riodicitÃ©s
        ELSIF p_Period_Type = 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV' THEN
           get_Date_Published_Period( VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_From,SYSDATE,
                                        v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To);
        END IF;

        -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
        FOR X IN CR_MAIN(VCR_FONDS.FA_NUM,v_Date_Nav_From,v_Date_Nav_To) LOOP

            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_FA_FEES_RATE
              (fund_number,
               fund_name,
               fund_ccy,
               part_fa_code,
               part_fa_code_publiee,
               isin_code,
               nav_type,
               date_nav,
               date_calcul,
               date_pub,
               ope_code,
               fees_code,
               fees_description,
               groupe_mc,
               percentage,
               user_id,
               date_creation)
            VALUES
              (X.FUND_NUMBER,
               X.FUND_NAME,
               X.FUND_CCY,
               X.SHARECLASS,
               X.PUBLISH_SHARECLASS,
               X.ISIN_CODE,
               X.NAV_TYPE,
               X.DATE_NAV,
               X.DATE_CALCUL,
               X.DATE_PUB,
               X.OPE_CODE,
               X.FEES_CODE,
               X.FEES_DESCRIPTION,
               X.GROUPE_MC,
               X.PERCENTAGE,
               p_User_Id,
               SYSDATE);

        END LOOP;
   END LOOP;

   ELSE

    -- Insertion des donnÃ©es
    FOR X IN CR_MAIN(NULL,v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP

        INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_FA_FEES_RATE
          (fund_number,
           fund_name,
           fund_ccy,
           part_fa_code,
           part_fa_code_publiee,
           isin_code,
           nav_type,
           date_nav,
           date_calcul,
           date_pub,
           ope_code,
           fees_code,
           fees_description,
           groupe_mc,
           percentage,
           user_id,
           date_creation)
        VALUES
          (X.FUND_NUMBER,
           X.FUND_NAME,
           X.FUND_CCY,
           X.SHARECLASS,
           X.PUBLISH_SHARECLASS,
           X.ISIN_CODE,
           X.NAV_TYPE,
           X.DATE_NAV,
           X.DATE_CALCUL,
           X.DATE_PUB,
           X.OPE_CODE,
           X.FEES_CODE,
           X.FEES_DESCRIPTION,
           X.GROUPE_MC,
           X.PERCENTAGE,
           p_User_Id,
           SYSDATE);
    END LOOP;
END IF;
COMMIT;

    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => 'PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Fa_Fees_Rate',P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Fa_Fees_Rate;

PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Pending_Extract ( p_Return_Code     OUT INTEGER,     -- Code de retour de la procÃ©dure
                                    p_Error_Message   OUT VARCHAR2) IS -- Message d'erreur) IS

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*  Author            : JLIVET                                                            */
/*  Created           : 31/03/2020                                                        */
/*  Reference Number  :                                                                   */
/*  Purpose           : Extraction Ordres Pending TA                                      */
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*  Modifications                                                                         */
/*  Author  Updated       Reference    Purpose                                            */
/*                                                                                        */
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

v_Date_From_Extract     DATE:= REPADMIN.GET_GLOBAL_VAR_DATE('PENDING_TA_DATE_FROM');
v_X_Rate_Date           DATE;
v_X_Rate_Date_Ta_Max    DATE;
v_Nb_New_Pending        NUMBER;

r_Pending_Ta            REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING%ROWTYPE;
r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING%ROWTYPE;

v_Exchange_In_Exist     BOOLEAN;

V_ID                    NUMBER;
Err                     Exception;



CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Date_From IN DATE) IS

    SELECT TF.STRUCTURE_NUM,T.C_FUND TA_NUM,TF.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_CCY,
           NULL FA_REF_NUM,NULL REF_CCY,
           TF.PART_FA_CODE,T.C_SHARE_TYP PART_TA_CODE,TF.PART_CCY,T.G_ID_VALUE_1 ISIN_CODE,TF.FA_CODE,
           T.C_N_OUTLET,T.C_N_REGISTER,T.C_N_REGISTER_DEAL,T.N_LOT,
           DECODE(T.N_LINKED_NORDER,NULL,T.N_ORDER,T.N_LINKED_NORDER) N_ORDER,
           MAX(T.D_TRADE) D_TRADE,MAX(T.D_VALUE) D_VALUE,T.D_RECIEVED,
           DECODE(T.C_OPE,'0004','0007',T.C_OPE) OPE_CODE,
--           DECODE(T.C_OPE,'0007',2,0) OPE_SWITCH,
                      CASE 
             WHEN T.C_OPE = '0007' THEN 2
             WHEN T.C_OPE = '0004' THEN 1           
             ELSE 0
           END OPE_SWITCH,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES',T.C_ORDER_CCY) ORDER_CCY ,
           NVL(T.Q_ORDER,T.Q_SUB) Q_ORDER,NVL(T.A_ORDER,T.A_RED) A_ORDER,T.C_STATUS,
           MAX(T.C_DEAL_STATUS) C_DEAL_STATUS,T.P_SHARE_TYP PRICE_PART_CCY,
--           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(TF.FA_NUM,MAX(T.D_TRADE),-1,'Y') PRICE_DATE_NAV, -- INCPB-545401
--           REPADMIN.GET_NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLIEE(TF.FA_NUM,MAX(T.D_TRADE),-1) PRICE_DATE_NAV, -- INCPB-763179
--           REPADMIN.GET_LAST_TRADE_DATE_TA(TF.FA_NUM,MAX(T.D_TRADE)) PRICE_DATE_NAV, -- LXS-21528 / INCPB-963463
           REPADMIN.GET_LAST_TRADE_DATE_TA_BY_PART(TF.FA_NUM,TF.PART_FA_CODE,MAX(T.D_TRADE)) PRICE_DATE_NAV, -- INCPB-963463
           NULL X_RATE,NULL X_RATE_DATE,NULL AMOUNT_PART_CCY,NULL AMOUNT_COMP_CCY,
           NULL TNA,NULL TNA_PERCENT,T.G_ID_VALUE_2 ISIN_CODE_SWITCH,1 FLAG_NEW,SYSDATE DATE_CREATION,1 FLAG_NEW_REPORT,
           T.C_OPE OPE_CODE_ORIGINAL,T.N_ORDER ORDER_NUMBER_ORIGINAL,T.C_N_LEG_LINK LINK_LEG,T.N_LINKED_NORDER LINK_ORDER_NUMBER --INCPB-858372
    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_ORDER T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN TF,
         ( SELECT O.N_LOT LOT_NUMBER,O.N_ORDER,O.C_N_OUTLET,MAX(O.C_STATUS) MAX_STATUS
           FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_ORDER O
           WHERE O.N_LOT           = ( SELECT MAX(L.N_LOT)
                                       FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_ORDER L
                                       WHERE L.C_N_OUTLET = O.C_N_OUTLET
                                         AND L.N_ORDER    = O.N_ORDER
                                     )
           HAVING MAX(O.C_STATUS) = '10'
           GROUP BY O.N_LOT,O.N_ORDER,O.C_N_OUTLET
          ) MS
    WHERE T.G_ID_VALUE_1           = TF.ISIN_CODE
      AND T.N_ORDER                = MS.N_ORDER
      AND T.C_N_OUTLET             = MS.C_N_OUTLET
      AND T.N_LOT                  = MS.LOT_NUMBER
      AND (T.C_N_OUTLET,T.N_ORDER,T.N_LOT) NOT IN ( SELECT P.OUTLET_NUMBER,P.ORDER_NUMBER_ORIGINAL,P.OPE_LOT_NUMBER --INCPB-444645 + INCPB-858372
                                                    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING P)
      AND T.D_TRADE                >= p_Date_From --'31-dec-18'
      --AND T.c_n_Outlet=156956--.C_FUND                 = 'ALTDIHU' -- Pour test
    GROUP BY TF.STRUCTURE_NUM,T.C_FUND,TF.FA_NUM,TF.PART_FA_CODE,T.N_ORDER,T.D_RECIEVED,
          T.C_N_REGISTER,T.C_N_REGISTER_DEAL,T.C_N_OUTLET,TF.FUND_CCY,TF.FA_CODE,
          T.C_SHARE_TYP,T.G_ID_VALUE_1,T.C_OPE,T.C_ORDER_CCY,T.A_ORDER,T.A_RED,T.Q_ORDER,T.Q_SUB,
          T.P_SHARE_TYP,TF.PART_CCY,T.C_STATUS,T.G_ID_VALUE_2,T.N_LOT,
          T.C_N_LEG_LINK ,T.N_LINKED_NORDER  --INCPB-858372
          ;

CURSOR CR_SWITCH IS
    SELECT T.OUTLET_NUMBER,T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER,T.CODE_ISIN,T.PART_CCY,T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY,
           T2.CODE_ISIN CODE_ISIN_OUT,T2.PART_CCY PART_CCY_OUT
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
    LEFT OUTER JOIN REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T2
      ON T.OUTLET_NUMBER   = T2.OUTLET_NUMBER
    AND T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER = T2.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER
    WHERE T.OPE_SWITCH     = 2
      AND T.FLAG_NEW       = 1
      AND T2.OPE_SWITCH    = 1
      AND T2.FLAG_NEW      = 1;


BEGIN

p_Return_Code           := 0;
p_Error_Message         := NULL;

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Pending_Extract';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

----------------------------------------------
--     Traitement des ordres en pending     --
----------------------------------------------

-- Date taux de change et taux de change
SELECT MAX(T.D_RATE)
INTO v_X_Rate_Date_Ta_Max
FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_EXCHANGE_RATES T;

SELECT MAX(T.X_RATE_DATE)
INTO v_X_Rate_Date
FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
WHERE T.FLAG_NEW = 0;

-- Suppression des pendings qui ne le sont plus ou qui ont subi une modification
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
WHERE (T.OUTLET_NUMBER,T.ORDER_NUMBER_ORIGINAL,T.OPE_LOT_NUMBER) NOT IN ( SELECT O.C_N_OUTLET,O.N_ORDER,MAX(O.N_LOT) MAX_LOT --INCPB-858372
--WHERE (T.OUTLET_NUMBER,T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER,T.OPE_LOT_NUMBER) NOT IN ( SELECT O.C_N_OUTLET,O.N_ORDER,MAX(O.N_LOT) MAX_LOT --INCPB-444645
                                                                     FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_ORDER O
                                                                     WHERE O.D_TRADE        >= v_Date_From_Extract
                                                                     HAVING MAX(O.C_STATUS) = '10'
                                                                     GROUP BY O.N_ORDER,O.C_N_OUTLET
                                                                    );

-- INCPB-488128 : Update des pendings qui n'ont pas les champs essentiels populÃ©s (remontÃ© avant le setup dans la table fonds)
FOR X IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T.CODE_ISIN
           FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
           WHERE T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER IS NULL
              OR T.FUND_REF_CCY     IS NULL
              OR T.FUND_CCY         IS NULL
              OR T.PART_FA          IS NULL
              OR T.FA_CODE          IS NULL ) LOOP


       r_Pending_Ta.Code_Isin := X.CODE_ISIN;

       get_Info_Static_Isin( r_Pending_Ta.Code_Isin,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Structure_Number,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Ta_Number,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Num,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ccy,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Part_Fa,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Part_Ta,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Part_Ccy,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Code);

       r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Ref_Num   := NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Num,SYSDATE),r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Num);  
--     r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ref_Ccy := NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Ref_Num),r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ccy);

       --on prend la devise de reference du compartiment --NLL
       r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ref_Ccy := NVL(REPADMIN.Get_Compartiment_Ccy(r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Ref_Num),r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ccy);

       UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
       SET T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER = r_Pending_Ta.Structure_Number,
           T.FA_NUM           = r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Num,
           T.FUND_CCY         = r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ccy,
           T.FA_REF_NUM       = r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Ref_Num,
           T.FUND_REF_CCY     = r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ref_Ccy,
           T.PART_FA          = r_Pending_Ta.Part_Fa,
           T.FA_CODE          = r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Code
       WHERE T.CODE_ISIN      = r_Pending_Ta.Code_Isin
         AND (T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER IS NULL
          OR T.FUND_REF_CCY      IS NULL
          OR T.FUND_CCY          IS NULL
          OR T.PART_FA           IS NULL
          OR T.FA_CODE           IS NULL);

END LOOP;


UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
  SET T.FLAG_NEW = 0;

COMMIT;

-- Insertion des nouveaux pendings
OPEN CR_MAIN (v_Date_From_Extract);
LOOP
    FETCH CR_MAIN INTO r_Pending_Ta;
    EXIT WHEN CR_MAIN%NOTFOUND;

    IF r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Num IS NULL THEN
       get_Info_Static_Isin( r_Pending_Ta.Code_Isin,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Structure_Number,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Ta_Number,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Num,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ccy,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Part_Fa,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Part_Ta,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Part_Ccy,
                             r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Code);
    END IF;
    
    r_Pending_Ta.Date_Creation := SYSDATE; --INCPB-580368
    INSERT INTO REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING VALUES r_Pending_Ta;

    --INCPB-858372 : insertion de la seconde jambe uniquement pour les anciens switchs
    -- Pour cela, on regarde si il y a un exchange in correspondant
    IF r_Pending_Ta.Ope_Code = '0007' THEN

       v_Exchange_In_Exist := FALSE;
       FOR X IN ( SELECT T.C_N_OUTLET,T.C_OPE,T.N_ORDER
                  FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_ORDER T
                  WHERE T.C_N_OUTLET      = r_Pending_Ta.Outlet_Number
                    AND T.C_OPE           = '0004'
                    AND T.N_LINKED_NORDER = r_Pending_Ta.Ope_Order_Number ) LOOP
                    
           v_Exchange_In_Exist := TRUE;         
           EXIT;         
       END LOOP;

       IF v_Exchange_In_Exist = FALSE THEN
             r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out                  := r_Pending_Ta;

             r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Code_Isin        := r_Pending_Ta.Code_Isin_Switch;
             r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Code_Isin_Switch := r_Pending_Ta.Code_Isin;
             r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Ope_Switch       := 1; -- OUT

             r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Ope_Qty          := NULL;
             r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Ope_Amount       := NULL;

             get_Info_Static_Isin( r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Code_Isin,
                                   r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Structure_Number,
                                   r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Ta_Number,
                                   r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Fa_Num,
                                   r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Fund_Ccy,
                                   r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Part_Fa,
                                   r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Part_Ta,
                                   r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Part_Ccy,
                                   r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out.Fa_Code);

             INSERT INTO REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING VALUES r_Pending_Ta_Switch_Out;
       END IF;
    END IF;
END LOOP;
CLOSE CR_MAIN;
COMMIT;

-- Regarde le nb de nouveaux pendings
SELECT COUNT(T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER) NB
INTO v_Nb_New_Pending
FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
WHERE T.FLAG_NEW = 1;

IF v_Nb_New_Pending > 0 THEN

    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.FA_REF_NUM = NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(T.FA_NUM,T.PRICE_DATE_NAV),T.FA_NUM)
    WHERE T.FLAG_NEW   = 1;

/*    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.FUND_REF_CCY = NVL(REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS(T.FA_REF_NUM),T.FUND_CCY)
    WHERE T.FLAG_NEW   = 1;
*/
    --on prend la devise de reference du compartiment --NLL
    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.FUND_REF_CCY = NVL(REPADMIN.Get_Compartiment_Ccy(T.FA_REF_NUM),T.FUND_CCY)
    WHERE T.FLAG_NEW   = 1;


    -- Date, prix des parts et montants par parts des fonds calcules par le FA
    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.PRICE_PART_CCY        = REPADMIN.GET_PRICE_TRADE_DATE_TA(T.TA_NUMBER,T.PART_TA,T.PRICE_DATE_NAV)
    WHERE T.FLAG_NEW              = 1
      AND NVL(T.PRICE_PART_CCY,0) = 0;

/*  -- Plus necessaire vu qu'on prend les prix et tna pour tous les pending dans le TA
    -- Si pas encore de nav dans FA, on va rechercher le prix dans le TA --NLL
    FOR VCR_PRICE_TA IN ( SELECT T.OUTLET_NUMBER,T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER,T.FA_NUM,TA_NUMBER,T.PART_TA,T.OPE_DATE_OPE,T.OPE_QTY
                         FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
                         WHERE T.FA_CODE  = '01'
                           AND T.FLAG_NEW = 1
                           AND T.PRICE_PART_CCY IS NULL
                           AND T.OPE_AMOUNT     IS NULL
                       ) LOOP
 
         FOR Y IN ( SELECT T.D_NAVDATE,T.P_SHARE
                    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_NAV_SHARE_PRICE T
                    WHERE T.C_FUND      =  VCR_PRICE_TA.Ta_Number
                      AND T.C_SHARE_TYP =  VCR_PRICE_TA.Part_Ta
                      AND T.D_NAVDATE   <= VCR_PRICE_TA.Ope_Date_Ope
                    ORDER BY T.D_NAVDATE DESC ) LOOP
 
             r_Pending_Ta.Price_Date_Nav := Y.D_NAVDATE;
             r_Pending_Ta.Price_Part_Ccy := Y.P_SHARE;
             EXIT;
         END LOOP;
 
         UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
           SET T.PRICE_DATE_NAV   = r_Pending_Ta.Price_Date_Nav,
               T.PRICE_PART_CCY   = r_Pending_Ta.Price_Part_Ccy
         WHERE T.OUTLET_NUMBER    = VCR_PRICE_TA.OUTLET_NUMBER
           AND T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER = VCR_PRICE_TA.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER;
 
    END LOOP;*/
    
    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY = NVL(T.OPE_AMOUNT,ROUND(T.OPE_QTY * T.PRICE_PART_CCY,2)),
          T.TNA             = REPADMIN.GET_TNA_FDS_TOT_TA(T.FA_REF_NUM,T.PRICE_DATE_NAV)
    WHERE T.FLAG_NEW        = 1;

/*  -- Plus necessaire vu qu'on prend les prix et tna pour tous les pending dans le TA
    -- Date, prix des parts et montants par parts des fonds NON calcules par le FA
    FOR VCR_FA_CODE IN ( SELECT T.OUTLET_NUMBER,T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER,T.FA_NUM,TA_NUMBER,T.PART_TA,T.OPE_DATE_OPE,T.OPE_QTY
                         FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
                         WHERE T.FA_CODE  <> '01'
                           AND T.FLAG_NEW = 1
                       ) LOOP

         FOR Y IN ( SELECT T.D_NAVDATE,T.P_SHARE
                    FROM REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_NAV_SHARE_PRICE T
                    WHERE T.C_FUND      =  VCR_FA_CODE.Ta_Number
                      AND T.C_SHARE_TYP =  VCR_FA_CODE.Part_Ta
                      AND T.D_NAVDATE   <= VCR_FA_CODE.Ope_Date_Ope
                    ORDER BY T.D_NAVDATE DESC ) LOOP

             r_Pending_Ta.Price_Date_Nav := Y.D_NAVDATE;
             r_Pending_Ta.Price_Part_Ccy := Y.P_SHARE;
             EXIT;
         END LOOP;

         --INCPB-661831
         r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Ref_Num      := REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NUM_FA_REF(VCR_FA_CODE.FA_NUM,r_Pending_Ta.Price_Date_Nav);
         --r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ref_Ccy    := REPADMIN.GET_FUND_CCY(r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Ref_Num);
         
         --on prend la devise de reference du compartiment --NLL
         r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ref_Ccy    := REPADMIN.Get_Compartiment_Ccy(r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Ref_Num);
         
         r_Pending_Ta.Tna             := REPADMIN.GET_TNA_FDS_TOT_TA(r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Ref_Num,r_Pending_Ta.Price_Date_Nav);

         UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
           SET T.FA_REF_NUM       = r_Pending_Ta.Fa_Ref_Num,
               T.FUND_REF_CCY     = r_Pending_Ta.Fund_Ref_Ccy, 
               T.PRICE_DATE_NAV   = r_Pending_Ta.Price_Date_Nav,
               T.PRICE_PART_CCY   = r_Pending_Ta.Price_Part_Ccy,
               T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY  = NVL(T.OPE_AMOUNT,ROUND(T.OPE_QTY * r_Pending_Ta.Price_Part_Ccy,2)),
               T.TNA              = r_Pending_Ta.Tna
         WHERE T.OUTLET_NUMBER    = VCR_FA_CODE.OUTLET_NUMBER
           AND T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER = VCR_FA_CODE.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER;

    END LOOP;
*/
    -- Update du montant dans la devise de la part pour les switchs OUT
    FOR VCR_SWITCH IN CR_SWITCH LOOP
       IF VCR_SWITCH.PART_CCY = VCR_SWITCH.PART_CCY_OUT THEN
          UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
          SET T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY    = VCR_SWITCH.AMOUNT_PART_CCY
          WHERE T.OUTLET_NUMBER    = VCR_SWITCH.OUTLET_NUMBER
            AND T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER = VCR_SWITCH.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER
            AND T.CODE_ISIN        = VCR_SWITCH.CODE_ISIN_OUT
            AND T.OPE_SWITCH       = 1;

          ELSE

          UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
          SET T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY    = ROUND(VCR_SWITCH.AMOUNT_PART_CCY *
                                     REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_MFTA(VCR_SWITCH.PART_CCY,VCR_SWITCH.PART_CCY_OUT,v_X_Rate_Date_Ta_Max),2)
          WHERE T.OUTLET_NUMBER    = VCR_SWITCH.OUTLET_NUMBER
            AND T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER = VCR_SWITCH.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER
            AND T.CODE_ISIN        = VCR_SWITCH.CODE_ISIN_OUT
            AND T.OPE_SWITCH       = 1;
       END IF;

    END LOOP;
END IF;

-- Si la date des derniers taux de change du TA est la mÃªme que dans la table des pendings,
-- on n'update que les nouveaux pendings.  Sinon, on update tous les pendings
IF v_X_Rate_Date = v_X_Rate_Date_Ta_Max THEN

    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.X_RATE_DATE   = v_X_Rate_Date_Ta_Max
    WHERE T.FLAG_NEW = 1;

    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.X_RATE   = 1
    WHERE T.PART_CCY = T.FUND_REF_CCY
      AND T.FLAG_NEW = 1;

    -- INCPB-527490 : OPE_CCY<>PART_CCY
    FOR VCR_X_RATE IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T.OPE_CCY,T.PART_CCY,
                               REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_MFTA(T.OPE_CCY,T.PART_CCY,T.X_RATE_DATE) X_RATE
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
                        WHERE T.OPE_CCY <> T.PART_CCY
                          AND T.FLAG_NEW = 1 ) LOOP
                         
        UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
          SET T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY = ROUND(T.OPE_AMOUNT * VCR_X_RATE.X_RATE,2)
        WHERE T.PART_CCY        = VCR_X_RATE.PART_CCY
          AND T.OPE_CCY         = VCR_X_RATE.OPE_CCY
          AND T.FLAG_NEW        = 1;

    END LOOP;
    
    FOR VCR_X_RATE IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T.PART_CCY,T.FUND_REF_CCY,
                               REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_MFTA(T.PART_CCY,T.FUND_REF_CCY,T.X_RATE_DATE) X_RATE
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
                        WHERE T.PART_CCY <> T.FUND_REF_CCY
                          AND T.FLAG_NEW = 1 ) LOOP

        UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
          SET T.X_RATE       = VCR_X_RATE.X_RATE
        WHERE T.PART_CCY     = VCR_X_RATE.PART_CCY
          AND T.FUND_REF_CCY = VCR_X_RATE.FUND_REF_CCY
          AND T.FLAG_NEW     = 1;

    END LOOP;

    -- Montant dans la devise du compartiment et pourcentage par rapport Ã  la TNA
    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.AMOUNT_COMP_CCY = ROUND(T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY * T.X_RATE,2)
    WHERE T.FLAG_NEW        = 1;

    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.TNA_PERCENT = ROUND(T.AMOUNT_COMP_CCY / T.TNA,10)
    WHERE NVL(T.TNA,0)  <> 0
      AND T.FLAG_NEW    = 1;

   ELSE

    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.X_RATE_DATE   = v_X_Rate_Date_Ta_Max;

    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.X_RATE   = 1
    WHERE T.PART_CCY = T.FUND_REF_CCY;

    -- INCPB-527490 : OPE_CCY<>PART_CCY
    FOR VCR_X_RATE IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T.OPE_CCY,T.PART_CCY,
                               REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_MFTA(T.OPE_CCY,T.PART_CCY,T.X_RATE_DATE) X_RATE
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
                        WHERE T.OPE_CCY <> T.PART_CCY
                          AND T.FLAG_NEW = 1 ) LOOP
                         
        UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
          SET T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY = ROUND(T.OPE_AMOUNT * VCR_X_RATE.X_RATE,2)
        WHERE T.PART_CCY        = VCR_X_RATE.PART_CCY
          AND T.OPE_CCY         = VCR_X_RATE.OPE_CCY;

    END LOOP;
    
    FOR VCR_X_RATE IN ( SELECT DISTINCT T.PART_CCY,T.FUND_REF_CCY,
                               REPADMIN.GET_X_RATE_MFTA(T.PART_CCY,T.FUND_REF_CCY,T.X_RATE_DATE) X_RATE
                        FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
                        WHERE T.PART_CCY <> T.FUND_REF_CCY) LOOP

        UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
          SET T.X_RATE       = VCR_X_RATE.X_RATE
        WHERE T.PART_CCY     = VCR_X_RATE.PART_CCY
          AND T.FUND_REF_CCY = VCR_X_RATE.FUND_REF_CCY;

    END LOOP;

    -- Montant dans la devise du compartiment et pourcentage par rapport Ã  la TNA
    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.AMOUNT_COMP_CCY = ROUND(T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY * T.X_RATE,2);

    UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
      SET T.TNA_PERCENT = ROUND(T.AMOUNT_COMP_CCY / T.TNA,10)
    WHERE NVL(T.TNA,0)  <> 0;

END IF;
COMMIT;

-- INCPB-527490 + INCPB-580368 : suppression des doublons
FOR X IN ( SELECT DISTINCT O.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER,O.OUTLET_NUMBER,MAX(O.OPE_LOT_NUMBER) OPE_LOT_NUMBER
           FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING O
           GROUP BY O.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER,O.OUTLET_NUMBER,O.OPE_SWITCH
           HAVING COUNT(O.OPE_LOT_NUMBER) >1) LOOP
           
    DELETE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
    WHERE T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER = X.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER
      AND T.OUTLET_NUMBER    = X.OUTLET_NUMBER
      AND T.OPE_LOT_NUMBER   <> X.OPE_LOT_NUMBER;

END LOOP;
COMMIT;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception

    When Err Then
         -- Retour de la procÃ©dure
         p_Return_Code   := SqlCode;
         p_Error_Message := substr(SqlErrM, 1, 150);

         Rollback;
         -- Error Monitoring
         ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

         RAISE;

    when others then
         -- Retour de la procÃ©dure
         p_Return_Code   := SqlCode;
         p_Error_Message := substr(SqlErrM, 1, 150);

         rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_Error_Message, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,P_message => p_Error_Message);

END proc_Ta_Pending_Extract;

PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Pending_Prepa_Envoi ( p_Return_Code     OUT INTEGER,     -- Code de retour de la procÃ©dure
                                        p_Error_Message   OUT VARCHAR2) IS -- Message d'erreur) IS

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*  Author            : JLIVET                                                            */
/*  Created           : 31/03/2020                                                        */
/*  Reference Number  :                                                                   */
/*  Purpose           : Parcours des relations adressage et envoi du rapport Pending TA   */
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*  Modifications                                                                         */
/*  Author  Updated       Reference    Purpose                                            */
/*                                                                                        */
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

v_Heure_Sys             VARCHAR2(4);
v_Date_Sys              DATE;

V_ID                    NUMBER;
Err                     Exception;
v_Rep_Id                NUMBER;
v_Param_Id              NUMBER;

v_User_Id               VARCHAR2(20);
v_Date_From_Str         VARCHAR2(8);
v_Date_To_Str           VARCHAR2(8);

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);

BEGIN

p_Return_Code           := 0;
p_Error_Message         := NULL;


-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Pending_Prepa_Envoi';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

--------------------------------------------
--     CrÃ©ation du rapport pending TA     --
--------------------------------------------

/*-- Pour Control-M toutes les demi-heures
SELECT
  (CASE
    WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'MI')) <= 30
      THEN TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'HH24'),'HHMI') --+ 30/1440
      ELSE TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'HH24') + 30/1440,'HHMI')
  END) heure_minute
INTO v_Heure_Sys
FROM DUAL;*/

-- Pour Control-M toutes les heures
SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'HH24'),'HH24MI') INTO v_Heure_Sys FROM DUAL;
v_Date_Sys := TRUNC(SYSDATE);

SELECT T.REP_ID
INTO v_Rep_Id
FROM REPADMIN.REPORT_DEFINITION T
WHERE T.REP_NAME = 'PENDING_TA';

-- Parcours des relations d'adressage
FOR VCR_REL IN ( SELECT T.*
                 FROM REPADMIN.RELATION_ADRESSAGE T
                 WHERE T.REL_REP_ID = v_Rep_Id) LOOP


    -- On regarde si on est un jour d'envoi selon la frÃ©quence au niveau de la relation
    IF PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.get_Jour_Envoi(v_Date_Sys,VCR_REL.REL_ID)=0 THEN
       GOTO Next_Relation;
    END IF;

    IF VCR_REL.REL_PARAM_3 = v_Heure_Sys OR VCR_REL.REL_PARAM_4 = v_Heure_Sys OR
       VCR_REL.REL_PARAM_5 = v_Heure_Sys OR VCR_REL.REL_PARAM_6 = v_Heure_Sys OR
       VCR_REL.REL_PARAM_7 = v_Heure_Sys THEN

       v_User_Id       :='AUTO_' || VCR_REL.REL_ID;

       -- Suppression si existant dans LUXREP_ENVOI
       DELETE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_ENVOI T
       WHERE T.REP_ID          = v_Rep_Id
         AND T.REL_ID          = VCR_REL.REL_ID
         AND T.REL_DATE_ENVOI  = v_Date_Sys
         AND T.REL_HEURE_ENVOI = v_Heure_Sys;

       -- Insertion dans LUXREP_ENVOI
       INSERT INTO REPADMIN.LUXREP_ENVOI(REP_ID,REL_ID,REL_DATE_ENVOI,REL_HEURE_ENVOI,REPORT_USER_ID)
       VALUES(v_Rep_Id,VCR_REL.REL_ID,v_Date_Sys,v_Heure_Sys,v_User_Id);

       -- RÃ©cup date from
       v_Date_From_Str := TO_CHAR(NVL(VCR_REL.REL_START_DATE,TRUNC(SYSDATE,'YEAR')),'YYYYMMDD');
       v_Date_To_Str   := NULL;

       -- GÃ©nÃ©ration du rapport si l'heure system correspond Ã  une heure d'envoi
       proc_Ta_Pending_Report( p_User_Id         => v_User_Id,
                               p_Date_From_Str   => v_Date_From_Str,
                               p_Date_To_Str     => v_Date_To_Str,
                               p_Envoi_Auto      => 1,
                               p_Type_Envoi_Auto => VCR_REL.REL_PARAM_1,
                               p_Groupe_BL       => VCR_REL.REL_PARAM_2,
                               p_status          => v_status,
                               p_msg_err         => v_msg_err);


      UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_ENVOI T
      SET T.REPORT_STATUT     = DECODE(v_status,1,1,2),
          T.REPORT_STATUT_MSG = v_msg_err,
          T.STATUT_ENVOI      = DECODE(v_status,1,1,NULL)
      WHERE T.REP_ID          = v_Rep_Id
        AND T.REL_ID          = VCR_REL.REL_ID
        AND T.REL_DATE_ENVOI  = v_Date_Sys
        AND T.REL_HEURE_ENVOI = v_Heure_Sys;
      
      ------------------------------------------------------
      -- LXS-17801 
      -- si canal = EMAIL + MQ (8) alors 
      -- Creation du message MQ Ã  destination du fis-luxis-asset
      IF VCR_REL.REL_CANAL_ID = 8 THEN 
          proc_TA_Pending_MQ (p_User_Id         => v_User_Id,
                              p_Affiche_Data    => VCR_REL.REL_PARAM_8, -- 1 Afficher, 2 Masquer, 3 Anonymiser
                              p_Numero_Message  => VCR_REL.REL_NUM_MESSAGE,
                              p_status          => v_status,
                              p_msg_err         => v_msg_err);
      END IF;                              
      ------------------------------------------------------
      
    END IF;

    <<Next_Relation>>
    NULL;
END LOOP;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception

    When Err Then
         -- Retour de la procÃ©dure
         p_Return_Code   := SqlCode;
         p_Error_Message := substr(SqlErrM, 1, 150);

         Rollback;
         -- Error Monitoring
         ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

         RAISE;

    when others then
         -- Retour de la procÃ©dure
         p_Return_Code   := SqlCode;
         p_Error_Message := substr(SqlErrM, 1, 150);

         rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_Error_Message, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,P_message => p_Error_Message);

END proc_Ta_Pending_Prepa_Envoi;

PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Pending_Report ( p_User_Id         IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_Date_From_Str   IN VARCHAR2,
                                   p_Date_To_Str     IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                   p_Envoi_Auto      IN NUMBER DEFAULT 0, -- 0 = via interface / 1 = envoi auto via relation adressage
                                   p_Type_Envoi_Auto IN NUMBER DEFAULT 0, -- 1 = Group Subfund / 2 = Group Fund / 3 = Business Line
                                   p_Groupe_BL       IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT NULL,
                                   p_status          OUT NUMBER,
                                   p_msg_err         OUT VARCHAR2) IS

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
V_ID                    NUMBER;

v_Date_From             DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_From_Str,'YYYYMMDD');
v_Date_To               DATE:= TO_DATE(p_Date_To_Str,'YYYYMMDD');

Err                     Exception;

CURSOR CR_MAIN ( p_Date_From IN DATE,
                 p_Date_To   IN DATE ) IS

    SELECT T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER, S.STRUCTURE_NAME, T.TA_NUMBER, T.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME, T.FUND_CCY, T.FA_REF_NUM, T.FUND_REF_CCY,
           T.PART_FA, T.PART_TA, T.PART_CCY, T.CODE_ISIN, T.FA_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_CODE('TAB_FND_FA',T.FA_CODE) FA_CODE_NAME,T.OUTLET_NUMBER,
           T.REGISTER_NUMBER, REPADMIN.GET_REGISTRE_TA_LIBELLE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER) L_NAME, --INCPB-651339
           R.C_RESIDENCE REGISTRE_COUNTRY_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWT_GTA_MESSAGE('COUNTRY','C_ELEMENT', R.C_RESIDENCE,'L_LIBELLE','2') REGISTRE_COUNTRY,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER) OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,R2.L_NAME) OPE_REGISTER_NAME,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,R2.C_RESIDENCE) OPE_REGISTRE_COUNTRY_CODE,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,
             REPADMIN.GET_DWT_GTA_MESSAGE('COUNTRY','C_ELEMENT', R2.C_RESIDENCE,'L_LIBELLE','2')) OPE_REGISTRE_COUNTRY,
           T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER, T.OPE_DATE_OPE, T.OPE_DATE_VALUE, T.OPE_DATE_RECEIVED,
           T.OPE_CODE, REPADMIN.GET_DWT_GTA_MESSAGE('COPER','C_ELEMENT', T.OPE_CODE,'L_LIBELLE','2') OPE_CODE_NAME,
           T.OPE_SWITCH, T.OPE_CCY, T.OPE_QTY, T.OPE_AMOUNT, T.OPE_STATUS,T.OPE_DEAL_STATUS,T.PRICE_PART_CCY, T.PRICE_DATE_NAV,
           T.X_RATE, T.X_RATE_DATE, T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY, T.AMOUNT_COMP_CCY, T.TNA, T.TNA_PERCENT,
           T.FLAG_NEW_REPORT,p_User_Id USER_ID,SYSDATE
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_STRUCT S,
         REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS TF,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER R,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER R2
    WHERE T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER    = S.N_STRUCTURE
      AND T.FA_NUM              = TF.FA_NUM
      AND T.REGISTER_NUMBER     = R.C_N_REGISTER
      AND T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER = R2.C_N_REGISTER
--      AND T.OPE_DEAL_STATUS     IN ('005','105') -- Pas de filtre via l'application Luxrep Queries (FGENGLER)
--      AND T.OPE_CODE            IN ('0001','0002','0007') -- Pas de filtre via l'application Luxrep Queries (FGENGLER)
      AND T.FA_NUM              IN ( SELECT F.FA_NUM
                                     FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS F
                                     WHERE F.USER_ID = p_User_Id
                                       AND F.FLAG    = 1 )
      AND T.OPE_DATE_OPE        >= p_Date_From
      AND T.OPE_DATE_OPE        <= NVL(p_Date_To,T.OPE_DATE_OPE)
      ;

CURSOR CR_GR_SUBFUND ( p_Date_From IN DATE,
                       p_Date_To   IN DATE ) IS

    SELECT T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER, S.STRUCTURE_NAME, T.TA_NUMBER, T.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME, T.FUND_CCY, T.FA_REF_NUM, T.FUND_REF_CCY,
           T.PART_FA, T.PART_TA, T.PART_CCY, T.CODE_ISIN, T.FA_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_CODE('TAB_FND_FA',T.FA_CODE) FA_CODE_NAME,T.OUTLET_NUMBER,
           T.REGISTER_NUMBER, REPADMIN.GET_REGISTRE_TA_LIBELLE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER) REGISTER_NAME, --INCPB-651339
           R.C_RESIDENCE REGISTRE_COUNTRY_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWT_GTA_MESSAGE('COUNTRY','C_ELEMENT', R.C_RESIDENCE,'L_LIBELLE','2') REGISTRE_COUNTRY,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER) OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,R2.L_NAME) OPE_REGISTER_NAME,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,R2.C_RESIDENCE) OPE_REGISTRE_COUNTRY_CODE,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,
             REPADMIN.GET_DWT_GTA_MESSAGE('COUNTRY','C_ELEMENT', R2.C_RESIDENCE,'L_LIBELLE','2')) OPE_REGISTRE_COUNTRY,
           T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER, T.OPE_DATE_OPE, T.OPE_DATE_VALUE, T.OPE_DATE_RECEIVED,
           T.OPE_CODE, REPADMIN.GET_DWT_GTA_MESSAGE('COPER','C_ELEMENT', T.OPE_CODE,'L_LIBELLE','2') OPE_CODE_NAME,
           T.OPE_SWITCH,T.OPE_CCY, T.OPE_QTY, T.OPE_AMOUNT, T.OPE_STATUS, T.OPE_DEAL_STATUS, T.PRICE_PART_CCY, T.PRICE_DATE_NAV,
           T.X_RATE, T.X_RATE_DATE, T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY, T.AMOUNT_COMP_CCY, T.TNA, T.TNA_PERCENT,
           T.FLAG_NEW_REPORT, p_User_Id USER_ID,SYSDATE
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_STRUCT S,
         REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS TF,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER R,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER R2
    WHERE T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER    = S.N_STRUCTURE
      AND T.FA_NUM              = TF.FA_NUM
      AND T.REGISTER_NUMBER     = R.C_N_REGISTER
      AND T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER = R2.C_N_REGISTER
      AND T.Ope_Status          = '10'
      AND T.OPE_CODE            IN ('0001','0002','0007')
      AND T.FA_NUM              IN ( SELECT F.FUND_NUMBER
                                     FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_GROUPE_FONDS F
                                     WHERE F.GROUP_NUMBER = p_Groupe_BL )
      AND T.CODE_ISIN           NOT IN ( SELECT E.EXCLU_ID
                                         FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_GROUPE_EXCLU E
                                         WHERE E.GROUP_TYPE   = 1
                                           AND E.GROUP_NUMBER = p_Groupe_BL )
      AND T.OPE_DATE_OPE        >= p_Date_From
      AND T.OPE_DATE_OPE        <= NVL(p_Date_To,T.OPE_DATE_OPE)
      ;

CURSOR CR_GR_OMBRELLE ( p_Date_From IN DATE,
                        p_Date_To   IN DATE ) IS

    SELECT T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER, S.STRUCTURE_NAME, T.TA_NUMBER, T.FA_NUM,TF.FUND_NAME, T.FUND_CCY, T.FA_REF_NUM, T.FUND_REF_CCY,
           T.PART_FA, T.PART_TA, T.PART_CCY, T.CODE_ISIN, T.FA_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_CODE_CODE('TAB_FND_FA',T.FA_CODE) FA_CODE_NAME,T.OUTLET_NUMBER,
           T.REGISTER_NUMBER, REPADMIN.GET_REGISTRE_TA_LIBELLE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER) REGISTER_NAME, --INCPB-651339
           R.C_RESIDENCE REGISTRE_COUNTRY_CODE,
           REPADMIN.GET_DWT_GTA_MESSAGE('COUNTRY','C_ELEMENT', R.C_RESIDENCE,'L_LIBELLE','2') REGISTRE_COUNTRY,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER) OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,R2.L_NAME) OPE_REGISTER_NAME,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,R2.C_RESIDENCE) OPE_REGISTRE_COUNTRY_CODE,
           DECODE(T.REGISTER_NUMBER,T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,NULL,
             REPADMIN.GET_DWT_GTA_MESSAGE('COUNTRY','C_ELEMENT', R2.C_RESIDENCE,'L_LIBELLE','2')) OPE_REGISTRE_COUNTRY,
           T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER, T.OPE_DATE_OPE, T.OPE_DATE_VALUE, T.OPE_DATE_RECEIVED,
           T.OPE_CODE, REPADMIN.GET_DWT_GTA_MESSAGE('COPER','C_ELEMENT', T.OPE_CODE,'L_LIBELLE','2') OPE_CODE_NAME,
           T.OPE_SWITCH,T.OPE_CCY, T.OPE_QTY, T.OPE_AMOUNT, T.OPE_STATUS, T.OPE_DEAL_STATUS, T.PRICE_PART_CCY, T.PRICE_DATE_NAV,
           T.X_RATE, T.X_RATE_DATE, T.AMOUNT_PART_CCY, T.AMOUNT_COMP_CCY, T.TNA, T.TNA_PERCENT,
           T.FLAG_NEW_REPORT,p_User_Id USER_ID,SYSDATE
    FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T,
         REPADMIN.TAB_FND_STRUCT S,
         REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS TF,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER R,
         REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER R2
    WHERE T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER    = S.N_STRUCTURE
      AND T.FA_NUM              = TF.FA_NUM
      AND T.REGISTER_NUMBER     = R.C_N_REGISTER
      AND T.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER = R2.C_N_REGISTER
      AND T.Ope_Status          = '10'
      AND T.OPE_CODE            IN ('0001','0002','0007')
      AND T.STRUCTURE_NUMBER    IN ( SELECT F.UMBRELLA_NUMBER
                                     FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_GROUPE_UMBRELLA F
                                     WHERE F.GROUP_NUMBER = p_Groupe_BL )
      AND T.FA_NUM              NOT IN ( SELECT E.EXCLU_ID
                                         FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_QUERIES_GROUPE_EXCLU E
                                         WHERE E.GROUP_TYPE   = 2
                                           AND E.GROUP_NUMBER = p_Groupe_BL )
      AND T.OPE_DATE_OPE         >= p_Date_From
      AND T.OPE_DATE_OPE         <= NVL(p_Date_To,T.OPE_DATE_OPE)
      ;

BEGIN

-- Start Monitoring
vg_MaProc := 'proc_Ta_Pending_Report';
START_MONITOR(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,V_ID);

-- INCPB-537291 + INCPB-580368 : suppression des doublons
FOR X IN ( SELECT DISTINCT O.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER,O.OUTLET_NUMBER,MAX(O.OPE_LOT_NUMBER) OPE_LOT_NUMBER
           FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING O
           GROUP BY O.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER,O.OUTLET_NUMBER,O.OPE_SWITCH
           HAVING COUNT(O.OPE_LOT_NUMBER) >1) LOOP
           
    DELETE FROM REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
    WHERE T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER = X.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER
      AND T.OUTLET_NUMBER    = X.OUTLET_NUMBER
      AND T.OPE_LOT_NUMBER   <> X.OPE_LOT_NUMBER;

END LOOP;
COMMIT;

--------------------------------------------
--     CrÃ©ation du rapport pending TA     --
--------------------------------------------
DELETE FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING T
WHERE T.USER_ID = p_User_Id;

-- Insertion des nouveaux pendings
CASE p_Envoi_Auto

     WHEN 0 THEN

        FOR X IN CR_MAIN ( v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP
            X.SYSDATE := SYSDATE;
            INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING VALUES X;

        END LOOP;

     WHEN 1 THEN

          CASE p_Type_Envoi_Auto

               WHEN 1 THEN

                  FOR X IN CR_GR_SUBFUND ( v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP
                      X.SYSDATE := SYSDATE;
                      INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING VALUES X;

                  END LOOP;

               WHEN 2 THEN

                  FOR X IN CR_GR_OMBRELLE ( v_Date_From,v_Date_To) LOOP
                      X.SYSDATE := SYSDATE;
                      INSERT INTO REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING VALUES X;

                  END LOOP;

               WHEN 3 THEN
                  NULL;
               ELSE
                  NULL;
          END CASE;

          -- Update Flag New Report
          UPDATE REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_PENDING T
          SET T.FLAG_NEW_REPORT = 0
          WHERE (T.OUTLET_NUMBER,T.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER) IN ( SELECT P.OUTLET_NUMBER,P.OPE_ORDER_NUMBER
                                                          FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING P
                                                          WHERE P.USER_ID = p_User_Id);
     ELSE
         NULL;
END CASE;

COMMIT;

    p_status:=v_status;

-- End Monitoring
END_MONITOR(V_ID);

Exception
    When Err Then
          p_status:=v_status;
          p_msg_err:=v_msg_err;
          Rollback;
          -- Error Monitoring
          ERR_MONITOR(SQLERRM,V_ID);

    when others then
          p_status:=-1;
          p_msg_err :='Erreur :' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 150);
          rollback;

          -- Error Monitoring
          Repadmin.Err_Monitor(vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc || ' - Error : '  || p_msg_err, v_ID);

          ERROR_LOG(P_PGM => vg_MonPackage ||  '.' || vg_MaProc,P_message => p_msg_err);

END proc_Ta_Pending_Report;

PROCEDURE proc_Ta_Pending_MQ (p_User_Id         IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_Affiche_Data    IN VARCHAR2, -- 1 Afficher, 2 Masquer, 3 Anonymiser
                              p_Numero_Message  IN VARCHAR2,
                              p_status          OUT NUMBER,
                              p_msg_err         OUT VARCHAR2) IS

/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*  Author            : NLL                                                               */
/*  Created           : 17/11/2021                                                        */
/*  Reference Number  : LXS-17801                                                         */
/*  Purpose           : Parcours du rapport Pending TA et envoi vers MQ Series            */
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*  Modifications                                                                         */
/*  Author  Updated       Reference    Purpose                                            */
/*                                                                                        */
/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/


V_ID                    NUMBER;
Err                     Exception;

v_User_Id               VARCHAR2(20);

v_status                NUMBER :=1;
v_msg_err               VARCHAR2(2000);
v_message               mq_sent_msg.mqm_message_clob%TYPE;
v_message_data          VARCHAR2(3000);
v_message_data_all      mq_sent_msg.mqm_message_clob%TYPE;
v_message_header        VARCHAR2(300);
v_message_footer        VARCHAR2(50);
v_numero_message_MQ     NUMBER;
v_register_name         WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.Register_Name%type;
v_ope_register_name     WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.Ope_Register_Name%type;    

CURSOR CR_SUBFUND (p_User_Id IN VARCHAR2) IS
  SELECT DISTINCT T.FA_NUM
  FROM REPADMIN.WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING T
  WHERE T.USER_ID = p_User_Id
  ORDER BY 1;

CURSOR cur_pending_TA (p_User_Id IN VARCHAR2,p_Fa_Num IN VARCHAR2) IS
  SELECT 
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.STRUCTURE_NUMBER AS STRUCTURE_NUMBER,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.STRUCTURE_NAME AS STRUCTURE_NAME,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.TA_NUMBER AS TA_NUMBER,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.FA_NUM AS FA_NUM,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.FUND_NAME AS FUND_NAME,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.FUND_CCY AS FUND_CCY,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.FA_REF_NUM AS FA_REF_NUM,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.FUND_REF_CCY AS FUND_REF_CCY,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.PART_FA AS PART_FA,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.PART_TA AS PART_TA,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.PART_CCY AS PART_CCY,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.CODE_ISIN AS CODE_ISIN,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.FA_CODE AS FA_CODE,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.FA_CODE_NAME AS FA_CODE_NAME,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.OUTLET_NUMBER AS OUTLET_NUMBER,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.REGISTER_NUMBER AS REGISTER_NUMBER,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.REGISTER_NAME AS REGISTER_NAME,  
    'Register Name ' || WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.REGISTER_NUMBER AS REGISTER_NAME_ANONYME, 
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.REGISTER_COUNTRY AS REGISTER_COUNTRY,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.REGISTER_COUNTRY_NAME AS REGISTER_COUNTRY_NAME,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER AS OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,  
    WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.OPE_REGISTER_NAME AS OPE_REGISTER_NAME,  
    DECODE(NVL(WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER,0),0,'','Clearing Register Name ' ||  WRK_QUERIES_TA_PENDING.OPE_REGISTER_NUMBER) AS OPE_REGISTER_NAME_ANONYME,
