-- BCR_DIV â€” SQL PUR MULTIFONDS / INFOCENTRE â€” VERSION FINALE v8 (DREMIO-SAFE)
--
-- v8 vs v7 : correction de l'erreur Dremio "$SCALAR_QUERY"
--   S1  zÃ©ro sous-requÃªte scalaire  â†’ params diffusÃ© par CROSS JOIN
--   S2  zÃ©ro sous-requÃªte corrÃ©lÃ©e  â†’ NOT EXISTS remplacÃ© par LEFT JOIN / IS NULL
--   S3  TO_CHAR au format Joda ('dd-MMM-yy'), littÃ©raux TIMESTAMP natifs
--
-- Corrections fonctionnelles conservÃ©es depuis v7 :
--   FIX1 Country Name  : AMS_MESSAGE.C_TABLE = 'COUNTRY' (et NON 'PAYS')
--   FIX2 Sec/Tax Ccy   : R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY + fallback devise fiscale
--   A    Service Code  : C_SRV_POSITION en 1er choix (â˜… SRV RÃ‰SOLU)
--   B    ISIN          : instr_typ NULL hors BO/PO/FU/OP (= GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC)
--   C    Security Name : format maturitÃ© type NLS (= GET_SEC_NAME)
--   D    Security Ccy  : C_FUT_CCY / C_OPT_CCY / C_SEC_CCY (= GET_SEC_CCY)
--   E    FenÃªtre NAV   : calendrier NAV filtrÃ© (substitut NAV_PUB / NAV_CONTROLE)
--   E'   PERIOD        : From = PREMIÃˆRE NAV >= d_from_in
--   E"   LAST_AVAIL.   : ancrÃ© sur d_to_in
--   F    dernier lot   : ROW_NUMBER sur N_LOT DESC aprÃ¨s bornage
--   G    statuts       : filtre explicite paramÃ©trÃ© (dÃ©faut 20 + 30)
--   H    Fund Name/Ccy : AMS_PORTFOLIO, bloc LUXREP_TB_FONDS prÃªt
--   I    C_STATUS      : VARCHAR2(2) â†’ comparaison texte + cast protÃ©gÃ©
--
-- RÃ¨gles conservÃ©es : 37 colonnes/ordre/libellÃ©s, pas de USER_ID ni DATE_CREATION,
-- verrue statut 30, dÃ©pooling, pas d'agrÃ©gat imbriquÃ©, CAST explicites sur les
-- deux branches du UNION ALL, aucune table REPADMIN/LUXIS active.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AS d_from_in,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-09-30 23:59:59' AS d_to_in,
        'PERIOD'                        AS period_type,
        '280299'                        AS p_fund_id,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)           AS p_depooling_mode,
        '2'                             AS p_lng,
        'AMS'                           AS p_nav_source,
        'N'                             AS p_nav_validated,  -- â—„ Ã©tait 'Y' (cause 1 & 3)
        'N'                             AS p_filter_status   -- â—„ Ã©tait 'Y' (cause 4)
),

-- ============================================================================
-- [VDS-1]  POPULATION DE FONDS
-- ============================================================================
ptf_all_rk AS (
    SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY, p.C_CONSOLIDATED, p.C_FUND_FATHER,
           p.Y_LIQUIDATED_FUND, p.D_LIQUIDATION,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p
),
ptf_all AS (
    SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY, C_CONSOLIDATED, C_FUND_FATHER,
           Y_LIQUIDATED_FUND, D_LIQUIDATION
    FROM ptf_all_rk WHERE rn = 1
),

-- S1/S2 : fund_list rattachÃ©e par LEFT JOIN (plus de "IN (SELECT â€¦)")
funds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pa.C_FUND
    FROM   ptf_all pa
           CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE (p.p_depooling_mode = 'POOLED_FUND_ONLY'
           AND TRIM(pa.C_FUND) = TRIM(p.p_fund_id))
       OR (p.p_depooling_mode = 'BEFORE_DEPOOLING'
           AND (   TRIM(pa.C_FUND)        = TRIM(p.p_fund_id)
                OR TRIM(pa.C_CONSOLIDATED) = TRIM(p.p_fund_id)))
       OR (p.p_depooling_mode = 'AFTER_DEPOOLING'
           AND TRIM(pa.C_CONSOLIDATED) =  TRIM(p.p_fund_id)
           AND TRIM(pa.C_FUND)        <> TRIM(p.p_fund_id))
       OR (p.p_depooling_mode IS NULL
           AND TRIM(pa.C_FUND) IN ('280299'))      -- â—„ LISTE DES FONDS ICI
                                                   --   ex. IN ('280299','280300')
),

-- ============================================================================
-- [VDS-2]  CHRONOLOGIE NAV ET FENÃŠTRE DE LOTS
-- ============================================================================
lot_all AS (
    SELECT l.C_FUND, l.D_NAV, l.N_LOT, l.C_TRAIT,
           l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV, l.D_H_DISPO
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l
         INNER JOIN funds f ON f.C_FUND = l.C_FUND
),

-- E : NAV Ã©ligibles â€” substitut AMS de NAV_PUB='A' / NAV_CONTROLE='Y'
nav_cal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.C_FUND, l.D_NAV
    FROM lot_all l CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE p.p_nav_source = 'AMS'
      AND (p.p_nav_validated <> 'Y' OR TRIM(l.C_TRAIT)       =  'N')          -- â—„ conditionnel
      AND (p.p_nav_validated <> 'Y' OR l.D_H_VALIDATION_NAV IS NOT NULL)      -- â—„ conditionnel
      -- D_H_DISPO retirÃ© du filtre : colonne trop souvent non alimentÃ©e
),

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Variante ISO-LUXIS : dÃ©commenter si REPADMIN.NAV / EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING
    -- sont exposÃ©es dans Dremio, puis passer p_nav_source = 'LUXIS'
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- UNION
    -- SELECT DISTINCT n.NAV_FUND_NO, n.NAV_DATE_NAV
    -- FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.REPADMIN.NAV n
    --      INNER JOIN funds f ON f.C_FUND = n.NAV_FUND_NO
    --      CROSS JOIN params p
    -- WHERE p.p_nav_source = 'LUXIS'
    --   AND (   (p.period_type =  'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' AND n.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y')
    --        OR (p.period_type <> 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' AND n.NAV_PUB      = 'A'))
    -- UNION
    -- SELECT DISTINCT c.FA_NUM, c.DATE_NAV
    -- FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.EFRONT.DATA_FA_CLOSING c
    --      INNER JOIN funds f ON f.C_FUND = c.FA_NUM
    --      CROSS JOIN params p
    -- WHERE p.p_nav_source = 'LUXIS'

-- S1 : les paramÃ¨tres sont matÃ©rialisÃ©s en colonnes AVANT toute agrÃ©gation
nav_cal_p AS (
    SELECT n.C_FUND, n.D_NAV, p.d_from_in, p.d_to_in
    FROM nav_cal n CROSS JOIN params p
),

nav_last AS (
    SELECT C_FUND, MAX(D_NAV) AS d_nav_last FROM nav_cal GROUP BY C_FUND
),

nav_stats AS (
    SELECT
        n.C_FUND,
        nl.d_nav_last                                                     AS d_nav_last,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.D_NAV <  nl.d_nav_last     THEN n.D_NAV END)      AS d_nav_second_last,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.D_NAV <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN n.D_NAV END)      AS d_nav_today,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.D_NAV <= n.d_to_in         THEN n.D_NAV END)      AS d_nav_to_period,
        MIN(CASE WHEN n.D_NAV >= n.d_from_in       THEN n.D_NAV END)      AS d_nav_from_published,
        MAX(CASE WHEN n.D_NAV <= n.d_from_in       THEN n.D_NAV END)      AS d_nav_from_period  -- â—„ REPLI
    FROM nav_cal_p n
         INNER JOIN nav_last nl ON nl.C_FUND = n.C_FUND
    GROUP BY n.C_FUND, nl.d_nav_last
),
-- E" : NAV prÃ©cÃ©dant la derniÃ¨re NAV <= d_to_in
nav_prev_to AS (
    SELECT n.C_FUND, MAX(n.D_NAV) AS d_nav_prev_to
    FROM nav_cal n INNER JOIN nav_stats s ON s.C_FUND = n.C_FUND
    WHERE n.D_NAV < s.d_nav_to_period
    GROUP BY n.C_FUND
),

nav_least AS (
    SELECT s.C_FUND,
           LEAST(p.d_from_in, COALESCE(s.d_nav_today, p.d_from_in)) AS d_least
    FROM nav_stats s CROSS JOIN params p
),
nav_from_tl AS (
    SELECT n.C_FUND, MIN(n.D_NAV) AS d_nav_from_tl
    FROM nav_cal n INNER JOIN nav_least nl ON nl.C_FUND = n.C_FUND
    WHERE n.D_NAV >= nl.d_least
    GROUP BY n.C_FUND
),

nav_window AS (
    SELECT
        s.C_FUND,
        -- E' conservÃ© (MIN >= from = rÃ¨gle LUXIS) MAIS avec repli v5 puis repli absolu
        CASE p.period_type
            WHEN 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN COALESCE(pv.d_nav_prev_to,
                                                    s.d_nav_second_last)
            WHEN 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV'   THEN COALESCE(tl.d_nav_from_tl,
                                                    s.d_nav_from_published,
                                                    s.d_nav_from_period)
            ELSE                           COALESCE(s.d_nav_from_published,
                                                    s.d_nav_from_period)       -- â—„ REPLI v5
        END AS d_nav_from,
        -- E" conservÃ©, avec repli sur la derniÃ¨re NAV connue
        CASE p.period_type
            WHEN 'LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY' THEN COALESCE(s.d_nav_to_period, s.d_nav_last)
            WHEN 'TO_LAST_DATE_NAV'   THEN COALESCE(s.d_nav_today,     s.d_nav_last)
            ELSE                           COALESCE(s.d_nav_to_period, s.d_nav_last) -- â—„ REPLI
        END AS d_nav_to
    FROM nav_stats s
         CROSS JOIN params p
         LEFT JOIN nav_from_tl tl ON tl.C_FUND = s.C_FUND
         LEFT JOIN nav_prev_to pv ON pv.C_FUND = s.C_FUND
),

lot_bounds AS (
    SELECT w.C_FUND, w.d_nav_from, w.d_nav_to,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l.D_NAV <= w.d_nav_to   THEN l.N_LOT END)              AS lot_to_incl,
           COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN l.D_NAV < w.d_nav_from THEN l.N_LOT END), -1)  AS lot_from_excl
    FROM nav_window w INNER JOIN lot_all l ON l.C_FUND = w.C_FUND
    WHERE w.d_nav_from IS NOT NULL AND w.d_nav_to IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY w.C_FUND, w.d_nav_from, w.d_nav_to
),

-- ============================================================================
-- [VDS-3]  Ã‰CRITURES DIVIDENDE / COUPON
-- ============================================================================
deal_rk AS (
    SELECT
        d.C_FUND, d.C_SRV, d.C_SRV_POSITION,
        d.C_N_ID, d.C_SEC_CCY, d.C_TAX_CCY,
        d.D_ACC, d.D_TRADE, d.D_VALUE, d.D_EXECUTION, d.D_PAYMENT,
        d.C_OPE, d.C_N_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF,
        d.N_CONTRACT, d.N_SUFF, d.L_DEAL, d.Q_QTY,
        d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY, d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY,
        d.A_GROSS,
        d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX, d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX,   d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        d.A_TAX, d.A_TAX_2, d.A_FEE_COR,
        d.A_NET, d.A_NET_PTF_CCY,
        d.R_INTEREST, d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY, d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE,
        d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY,
        TRIM(d.C_STATUS) AS C_STATUS_TXT,
        d.N_LOT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.C_FUND, d.C_SRV, d.N_ENTRY,
                         COALESCE(d.N_SUFF, 0), COALESCE(d.N_ENTRY_PTF, 0)
            ORDER BY d.N_LOT DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND d
         INNER JOIN lot_bounds b
                 ON b.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
                AND d.N_LOT <= b.lot_to_incl
                AND d.N_LOT >  b.lot_from_excl
),

deal_f AS (
    SELECT
        r.C_FUND, r.C_SRV, r.C_SRV_POSITION, r.C_N_ID, r.C_SEC_CCY, r.C_TAX_CCY,
        r.D_ACC, r.D_TRADE, r.D_VALUE, r.D_EXECUTION, r.D_PAYMENT,
        r.C_OPE, r.C_N_ACC, r.N_ENTRY, r.N_ENTRY_PTF,
        r.N_CONTRACT, r.N_SUFF, r.L_DEAL, r.Q_QTY,
        r.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY, r.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY, r.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY,
        r.A_GROSS,
        r.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX, r.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        r.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX,   r.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        r.A_TAX, r.A_TAX_2, r.A_FEE_COR,
        r.A_NET, r.A_NET_PTF_CCY,
        r.R_INTEREST, r.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY, r.R_EXCHANGE_RATE,
        r.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY, r.C_STATUS_TXT, r.N_LOT
    FROM deal_rk r CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE r.rn = 1
      AND (p.p_filter_status <> 'Y' OR r.C_STATUS_TXT IN ('20','30'))     -- G
),

-- ============================================================================
-- [VDS-4]  VERRUE STATUT 30 ORPHELIN   (S2 : LEFT JOIN au lieu de NOT EXISTS)
-- ============================================================================
entries_status20 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT C_FUND, N_ENTRY FROM deal_f WHERE C_STATUS_TXT = '20'
),
orphan_reversals AS (
    SELECT d.*
    FROM deal_f d
         LEFT JOIN entries_status20 e
                ON e.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND e.N_ENTRY = d.N_ENTRY
    WHERE d.C_STATUS_TXT = '30'
      AND e.N_ENTRY IS NULL
),
cash_mvt_rk AS (
    SELECT c.C_FUND, c.C_OPE, c.N_ENTRY, c.N_ENTRY_PTF, c.D_ACC,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.C_FUND, c.N_ENTRY
                              ORDER BY c.N_ENTRY_PTF ASC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_CASH_MVT c
         INNER JOIN orphan_reversals r
                 ON r.C_FUND = c.C_FUND AND r.C_OPE = c.C_OPE
                AND r.N_ENTRY = c.N_ENTRY AND c.N_ENTRY_PTF <> r.N_ENTRY_PTF
),
cash_mvt_orig AS (
    SELECT C_FUND, C_OPE, N_ENTRY, N_ENTRY_PTF, D_ACC FROM cash_mvt_rk WHERE rn = 1
),

reconstructed_originals AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(r.C_FUND                              AS VARCHAR)   AS C_FUND,
        CAST(r.C_SRV                               AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SRV,
        CAST(r.C_SRV_POSITION                      AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SRV_POSITION,
        CAST(r.C_N_ID                              AS BIGINT)    AS C_N_ID,
        CAST(r.C_SEC_CCY                           AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SEC_CCY,
        CAST(r.C_TAX_CCY                           AS VARCHAR)   AS C_TAX_CCY,
        CAST(cm.D_ACC                              AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_ACC,
        CAST(r.D_TRADE                             AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_TRADE,
        CAST(r.D_VALUE                             AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_VALUE,
        CAST(r.D_EXECUTION                         AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_EXECUTION,
        CAST(r.D_PAYMENT                           AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_PAYMENT,
        CAST(r.C_OPE                               AS VARCHAR)   AS C_OPE,
        CAST(r.C_N_ACC                             AS VARCHAR)   AS C_N_ACC,
        CAST(r.N_ENTRY                             AS BIGINT)    AS N_ENTRY,
        CAST(cm.N_ENTRY_PTF                        AS BIGINT)    AS N_ENTRY_PTF,
        CAST(r.N_CONTRACT                          AS BIGINT)    AS N_CONTRACT,
        CAST(r.N_SUFF                              AS BIGINT)    AS N_SUFF,
        CAST(r.L_DEAL                              AS VARCHAR)   AS L_DEAL,
        CAST(r.Q_QTY                               AS DOUBLE)    AS Q_QTY,
        CAST(r.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY                      AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNIT_SEC_CCY,
        CAST(r.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY               AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY,
        CAST(r.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY                    AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SETTLEMENT_CCY,
        CAST(-r.A_GROSS                            AS DOUBLE)    AS A_GROSS,
        CAST(-COALESCE(r.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX,   0) AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX,
        CAST(-COALESCE(r.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0) AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        CAST(-COALESCE(r.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX,     0) AS DOUBLE)    AS A_RECOVERABLE_TAX,
        CAST(-COALESCE(r.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2,   0) AS DOUBLE)    AS A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        CAST(-COALESCE(r.A_TAX,                 0) AS DOUBLE)    AS A_TAX,
        CAST(-COALESCE(r.A_TAX_2,               0) AS DOUBLE)    AS A_TAX_2,
        CAST(-r.A_FEE_COR                          AS DOUBLE)    AS A_FEE_COR,
        CAST(-r.A_NET                              AS DOUBLE)    AS A_NET,
        CAST(-r.A_NET_PTF_CCY                      AS DOUBLE)    AS A_NET_PTF_CCY,
        CAST(r.R_INTEREST                          AS DOUBLE)    AS R_INTEREST,
        CAST(r.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY                  AS DOUBLE)    AS R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY,
        CAST(r.R_EXCHANGE_RATE                     AS DOUBLE)    AS R_EXCHANGE_RATE,
        CAST(r.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY                  AS DOUBLE)    AS R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY,
        CAST('20'                                  AS VARCHAR)   AS C_STATUS_TXT,
        CAST(r.N_LOT                               AS BIGINT)    AS N_LOT
    FROM orphan_reversals r
         INNER JOIN cash_mvt_orig cm
                 ON cm.C_FUND = r.C_FUND AND cm.N_ENTRY = r.N_ENTRY
         CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE cm.D_ACC BETWEEN p.d_from_in AND p.d_to_in
),

all_deals AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(C_FUND                AS VARCHAR)   AS C_FUND,
        CAST(C_SRV                 AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SRV,
        CAST(C_SRV_POSITION        AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SRV_POSITION,
        CAST(C_N_ID                AS BIGINT)    AS C_N_ID,
        CAST(C_SEC_CCY             AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SEC_CCY,
        CAST(C_TAX_CCY             AS VARCHAR)   AS C_TAX_CCY,
        CAST(D_ACC                 AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_ACC,
        CAST(D_TRADE               AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_TRADE,
        CAST(D_VALUE               AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_VALUE,
        CAST(D_EXECUTION           AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_EXECUTION,
        CAST(D_PAYMENT             AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_PAYMENT,
        CAST(C_OPE                 AS VARCHAR)   AS C_OPE,
        CAST(C_N_ACC               AS VARCHAR)   AS C_N_ACC,
        CAST(N_ENTRY               AS BIGINT)    AS N_ENTRY,
        CAST(N_ENTRY_PTF           AS BIGINT)    AS N_ENTRY_PTF,
        CAST(N_CONTRACT            AS BIGINT)    AS N_CONTRACT,
        CAST(N_SUFF                AS BIGINT)    AS N_SUFF,
        CAST(L_DEAL                AS VARCHAR)   AS L_DEAL,
        CAST(Q_QTY                 AS DOUBLE)    AS Q_QTY,
        CAST(A_UNIT_SEC_CCY        AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNIT_SEC_CCY,
        CAST(A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY,
        CAST(C_SETTLEMENT_CCY      AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SETTLEMENT_CCY,
        CAST(A_GROSS               AS DOUBLE)    AS A_GROSS,
        CAST(A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX   AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX,
        CAST(A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2 AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        CAST(A_RECOVERABLE_TAX     AS DOUBLE)    AS A_RECOVERABLE_TAX,
        CAST(A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2   AS DOUBLE)    AS A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        CAST(A_TAX                 AS DOUBLE)    AS A_TAX,
        CAST(A_TAX_2               AS DOUBLE)    AS A_TAX_2,
        CAST(A_FEE_COR             AS DOUBLE)    AS A_FEE_COR,
        CAST(A_NET                 AS DOUBLE)    AS A_NET,
        CAST(A_NET_PTF_CCY         AS DOUBLE)    AS A_NET_PTF_CCY,
        CAST(R_INTEREST            AS DOUBLE)    AS R_INTEREST,
        CAST(R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY    AS DOUBLE)    AS R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY,
        CAST(R_EXCHANGE_RATE       AS DOUBLE)    AS R_EXCHANGE_RATE,
        CAST(R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY    AS DOUBLE)    AS R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY,
        CAST(C_STATUS_TXT          AS VARCHAR)   AS C_STATUS_TXT,
        CAST(N_LOT                 AS BIGINT)    AS N_LOT
    FROM deal_f

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CAST(C_FUND                AS VARCHAR)   AS C_FUND,
        CAST(C_SRV                 AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SRV,
        CAST(C_SRV_POSITION        AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SRV_POSITION,
        CAST(C_N_ID                AS BIGINT)    AS C_N_ID,
        CAST(C_SEC_CCY             AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SEC_CCY,
        CAST(C_TAX_CCY             AS VARCHAR)   AS C_TAX_CCY,
        CAST(D_ACC                 AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_ACC,
        CAST(D_TRADE               AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_TRADE,
        CAST(D_VALUE               AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_VALUE,
        CAST(D_EXECUTION           AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_EXECUTION,
        CAST(D_PAYMENT             AS TIMESTAMP) AS D_PAYMENT,
        CAST(C_OPE                 AS VARCHAR)   AS C_OPE,
        CAST(C_N_ACC               AS VARCHAR)   AS C_N_ACC,
        CAST(N_ENTRY               AS BIGINT)    AS N_ENTRY,
        CAST(N_ENTRY_PTF           AS BIGINT)    AS N_ENTRY_PTF,
        CAST(N_CONTRACT            AS BIGINT)    AS N_CONTRACT,
        CAST(N_SUFF                AS BIGINT)    AS N_SUFF,
        CAST(L_DEAL                AS VARCHAR)   AS L_DEAL,
        CAST(Q_QTY                 AS DOUBLE)    AS Q_QTY,
        CAST(A_UNIT_SEC_CCY        AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNIT_SEC_CCY,
        CAST(A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY,
        CAST(C_SETTLEMENT_CCY      AS VARCHAR)   AS C_SETTLEMENT_CCY,
        CAST(A_GROSS               AS DOUBLE)    AS A_GROSS,
        CAST(A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX   AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX,
        CAST(A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2 AS DOUBLE)    AS A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        CAST(A_RECOVERABLE_TAX     AS DOUBLE)    AS A_RECOVERABLE_TAX,
        CAST(A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2   AS DOUBLE)    AS A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2,
        CAST(A_TAX                 AS DOUBLE)    AS A_TAX,
        CAST(A_TAX_2               AS DOUBLE)    AS A_TAX_2,
        CAST(A_FEE_COR             AS DOUBLE)    AS A_FEE_COR,
        CAST(A_NET                 AS DOUBLE)    AS A_NET,
        CAST(A_NET_PTF_CCY         AS DOUBLE)    AS A_NET_PTF_CCY,
        CAST(R_INTEREST            AS DOUBLE)    AS R_INTEREST,
        CAST(R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY    AS DOUBLE)    AS R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY,
        CAST(R_EXCHANGE_RATE       AS DOUBLE)    AS R_EXCHANGE_RATE,
        CAST(R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY    AS DOUBLE)    AS R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY,
        CAST(C_STATUS_TXT          AS VARCHAR)   AS C_STATUS_TXT,
        CAST(N_LOT                 AS BIGINT)    AS N_LOT
    FROM reconstructed_originals
),

-- ============================================================================
-- [VDS-5]  RÃ‰FÃ‰RENTIEL TITRES
-- ============================================================================
sec_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID FROM all_deals WHERE C_N_ID IS NOT NULL
),

fut_rk AS (
    SELECT fm.C_N_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING, fm.D_MATURITY, fm.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fm.C_N_ID ORDER BY fm.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER fm
         INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = fm.C_N_ID
),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),

opt_rk AS (
    SELECT om.C_N_ID, om.C_N_UNDERLYING, om.D_MATURITY, om.C_OPT_NATURE, om.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY om.C_N_ID ORDER BY om.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER om
         INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = om.C_N_ID
),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY
        FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),

deals_svc AS (
    SELECT
        d.*,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV_POSITION), ''),
            CASE WHEN fu.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FU'
                 WHEN op.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'OP' END,
            NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV), '')
        )                            AS SVC,
        fu.C_N_UNDERLYING            AS FU_UND,
        fu.D_MATURITY                AS FU_MAT,
        fu.C_FUT_CCY                 AS FU_CCY,
        op.C_N_UNDERLYING            AS OP_UND,
        op.D_MATURITY                AS OP_MAT,
        op.C_OPT_CCY                 AS OP_CCY,
        UPPER(TRIM(op.C_OPT_NATURE)) AS OP_NATURE
    FROM all_deals d
         LEFT JOIN fut fu ON fu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
         LEFT JOIN opt op ON op.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
),
deals_key AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        -- GET_SEC_NAME / GET_SEC_COUNTRY : sous-jacent pour FU/OP, titre sinon
        CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_UND
                   WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_UND
                   ELSE t.C_N_ID END                AS C_N_ID_MASTER,
        CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_MAT
                   WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_MAT
                   ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) END AS D_MATURITY,
        CASE t.SVC WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_NATURE
                   ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END   AS C_OPT_NATURE,
        -- B : strictement GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC (NULL hors BO/PO/FU/OP)
        CASE t.SVC WHEN 'BO' THEN 'S'
                   WHEN 'PO' THEN 'S'
                   WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F'
                   WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O'
                   ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END   AS INSTR_TYP,
        -- D : GET_SEC_CCY â€” devise du DÃ‰RIVÃ‰ lui-mÃªme pour FU/OP
        CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_CCY
                   WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_CCY
                   ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END   AS SEC_CCY_DERIV
    FROM deals_svc t
),

sec_master_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID_MASTER AS C_N_ID
    FROM deals_key
    WHERE C_N_ID_MASTER IS NOT NULL
),

sm_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_N_ID,
           m.L_NAME,
           UPPER(TRIM(m.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY,            -- FIX1 : normalisation
           m.C_SEC_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_N_ID ORDER BY m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER m
         INNER JOIN sec_master_ids k ON k.C_N_ID = m.C_N_ID
),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),

isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP
                              ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i
         INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = i.C_N_ID
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11'
),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),

-- ============================================================================
-- [VDS-6]  RÃ‰FÃ‰RENTIELS DESCRIPTIFS
--   FIX1  : dans AMS_MESSAGE les pays sont sous C_TABLE = 'COUNTRY'
--   FIX1b : prioritÃ© C_LNG = p_lng ('2' = langue LUXIS), puis toute langue
--   S1    : p_lng diffusÃ© par CROSS JOIN (plus de sous-requÃªte scalaire
--           dans le ORDER BY de la fonction fenÃªtre â†’ fin de $SCALAR_QUERY)
-- ============================================================================
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE))   AS ctab,
        UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem,
        g.L_LIBELLE,
        g.L_ABREGE,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = p.p_lng THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                     g.N_LOT DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
         CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'OPT_NATURE')
),
ctry   AS (SELECT celem, L_LIBELLE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'COUNTRY'),
optnat AS (SELECT celem, L_ABREGE  FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'OPT_NATURE'),

-- H : libellÃ©s fonds â€” AMS par dÃ©faut, bloc iso-LUXIS prÃªt
ptf AS (
    SELECT pa.C_FUND, pa.L_FUND AS FUND_NAME, pa.C_CCY AS FUND_CCY
    FROM ptf_all pa
         INNER JOIN funds f ON f.C_FUND = pa.C_FUND          -- S1 : join, pas de IN(SELECT)

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Variante ISO-LUXIS (remplacer le SELECT ci-dessus) :
    -- SELECT tf.FA_NUM AS C_FUND, tf.FUND_NAME, tf.FUND_CCY
    -- FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS tf
    --      INNER JOIN funds f ON f.C_FUND = tf.FA_NUM
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
)


-- ============================================================================
-- PROJECTION FINALE â€” 37 colonnes exactes dans le bon ordre
-- ============================================================================
SELECT
    d.C_FUND                                                AS "SubFund Number",
    ptf.FUND_NAME                                           AS "SubFund Name",
    ptf.FUND_CCY                                            AS "SubFund Ccy",

    d.SVC                                                   AS "Service Code",

    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12)                          AS "Isin Code",

    d.C_N_ID                                                AS "Internal Fa Code",

    -- C : GET_SEC_NAME ; S3 : TO_CHAR au format Joda (Dremio), pas Oracle
    --   'dd-MMM-yy'  â†’ 15-JUN-26  (Ã©quivalent NLS Oracle 'DD-MON-RR')
    --   pour le format client, remplacer par 'dd/MM/yyyy'
    CASE d.SVC
        WHEN 'FU' THEN
            COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' '
            || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN
            COALESCE(optnat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' '
            || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME,     '') || ' '
            || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'BO' THEN sm.L_NAME
        WHEN 'PO' THEN sm.L_NAME
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)
    END                                                     AS "Security Name",

    -- D : GET_SEC_CCY d'abord (rÃ©fÃ©rentiel), devise de l'Ã©criture en secours
    COALESCE(d.SEC_CCY_DERIV, sm.C_SEC_CCY, d.C_SEC_CCY)    AS "Security Ccy",

    sm.C_COUNTRY                                            AS "Country Code",
    ctry.L_LIBELLE                                          AS "Country Name",

    d.D_ACC                                                 AS "Accounting Date",
    d.D_TRADE                                               AS "Trade Date",
    d.D_VALUE                                               AS "Value Date",
    d.D_EXECUTION                                           AS "Execution Date",
    d.D_PAYMENT                                             AS "Payment Date",
    d.C_OPE                                                 AS "Operation Code",
    d.C_N_ACC                                               AS "Account Number",
    d.N_ENTRY                                               AS "Entry",
    d.N_ENTRY_PTF                                           AS "Entry Ptf",
    d.N_CONTRACT                                            AS "Contract",
    d.L_DEAL                                                AS "Description",
    d.Q_QTY                                                 AS "Quantity",
    d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY                                        AS "Price in Security Ccy",
    d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY                                 AS "Price in Settlement Ccy",
    d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY                                      AS "Settlement Ccy",
    d.A_GROSS                                               AS "Gross Amount",
    COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX,   0)
      + COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0)                AS "Unrecoverable Tax",
    COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX,     0)
      + COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2,   0)                AS "Recoverable Tax",
    COALESCE(d.A_TAX,  0)
      + COALESCE(d.A_TAX_2, 0)                              AS "Other Tax",
    d.A_FEE_COR                                             AS "Fees in Security Ccy",
    d.A_NET                                                 AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy",

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\dremio_sql.py =====
"""Read-only SQL client for the FPL Dremio (INTG, and CTLQ with --env ctlq), for the assistant and the user alike.

    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py login            sign in (user name, hidden password); keeps the session token (DPAPI)
    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py login --token    or paste the session token of a signed-in browser
    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py probe            server status, then an authenticated read
    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py query -f q.sql -o out.csv [--max-rows N] [--timeout S]
    python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py query -o out.csv -          SQL from standard input

The user allowed SQL reads on Dremio on 1 Oct 2026, on one condition: nothing is modified, changed,
created or deleted. Two guards enforce it, and neither can be switched off:
  1. the statement: one statement, starting with SELECT or WITH, and no write, definition or passthrough
     keyword (EXTERNAL_QUERY and the like) anywhere outside string literals, quoted names and comments;
     a single scanner pass blinds those, an unbalanced quote or comment is refused, and `call` applies
     the check itself on the submit-a-query route (read_only_problem, _scan, _check_sql_body);
  2. the HTTP calls: one host, and only the status, catalog-read, submit-a-query, job-status,
     job-results and job-cancel routes (ALLOWED); a redirect is never followed (_NoRedirect), and
     `query -o` writes only under User Guides/dremio/ (out_path). Cancelling a job only stops our own query.
The token is the user's: Dremio's own permissions still apply on top. Personal access tokens are
switched off on this server (its public UI config says isPATEnabled false, 1 Oct 2026), so `login`
signs in with the user name and password through /apiv2/login and keeps only the session token that
Dremio returns, never the password; `login --token` keeps the session token of a signed-in browser instead
(in the browser console: copy(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user')).token)). When the session expires
(HTTP 401), the user runs `login` or `login --token` again; the assistant stops and asks. The server is
the fpl-INTG one: whether its data are production or a copy is OQ-052, so every result is graded B.
DEC-032 and RB-04 ("Dremio") hold the decision and the procedure. `login` must run in a real terminal:
the hidden prompt does not work inside an agent's shell. Standard library only.

Two servers, one at a time (DEC-033): `intg` (the default) and `ctlq`, chosen by `--env` on each command
(`login --token --env ctlq`, `probe --env ctlq`, `query --env ctlq ...`) or by `Client(env="ctlq")`. Each
has its own host constant and its own token file; a client calls only the host of its own environment, and
both guards apply unchanged. No production server is listed, and none can be added without a decision.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import getpass
import json
import os
import re
import ssl
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

# The only servers this client may call (DEC-032, DEC-033). INTG stays the default everywhere.
ENVIRONMENTS = {
    "intg": "dremio.apps.fpl-intg.kube.pictet.com",
    "ctlq": "dremio.apps.fpl-ctlq.kube.pictet.com",
}
DEFAULT_ENV = "intg"
HOST = ENVIRONMENTS[DEFAULT_ENV]
BASE = f"https://{HOST}"
CRED_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("APPDATA", os.path.expanduser("~"))) / "BA-Assistant"
CRED_FILE = CRED_DIR / "dremio-intg.token"
PAGE = 500  # Dremio returns at most 500 rows per results call

ALLOWED = [
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/apiv2/server_status$")),
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/catalog(/[A-Za-z0-9-]+)?$")),
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/catalog/by-path/[^?#]+$")),
    ("POST", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/sql$")),
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/job/[A-Za-z0-9-]+$")),
    ("GET", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/job/[A-Za-z0-9-]+/results$")),
    ("POST", re.compile(r"^/api/v3/job/[A-Za-z0-9-]+/cancel$")),
]

WRITE_WORDS = {
    "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE", "MERGE", "UPSERT", "CREATE", "DROP", "ALTER", "TRUNCATE",
    "GRANT", "REVOKE", "REFRESH", "COPY", "OPTIMIZE", "VACUUM", "ROLLBACK", "COMMIT", "CALL", "EXECUTE",
    "SET", "RESET", "USE", "RENAME", "COMMENT", "ANALYZE", "LOAD", "UNLOAD", "EXPORT", "IMPORT", "INTO",
    "EXEC", "PREPARE", "ATTACH", "DETACH", "LOCK",
}  # REPLACE is left out: it is also a string function; CREATE OR REPLACE is caught by CREATE
# Functions that hand a string to the source to run natively (the LUXIS source is Oracle): the string is
# blinded by the scanner, so the word itself is refused. Other functions stay allowed (DEC-032, risk accepted).
PASSTHROUGH_WORDS = {
    "EXTERNAL_QUERY", "OPENQUERY", "OPENROWSET", "OPENDATASOURCE", "DBLINK", "DBLINK_EXEC", "NATIVE_QUERY",
    "PASSTHROUGH", "PASS_THROUGH", "REMOTE_QUERY", "EXECUTE_IMMEDIATE",
}
BANNED_WORDS = WRITE_WORDS | PASSTHROUGH_WORDS
WORD = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*")
# A `--` comment ends at any of these, so the scanner never hides more text than a server could.
LINE_ENDS = "\n\r\x0b\x0c\x85\u2028\u2029"


class DremioError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def host_of(env: str) -> str:
    """The host of a known environment; any other name is refused."""
    if env not in ENVIRONMENTS:
        raise DremioError(f"refused: unknown Dremio environment {env!r} (known: {', '.join(ENVIRONMENTS)})")
    return ENVIRONMENTS[env]


def base_of(env: str) -> str:
    return f"https://{host_of(env)}"


def cred_file(env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> Path:
    """The token file of an environment: INTG keeps its historical name; read at call time so tests can redirect it."""
    host_of(env)
    return CRED_FILE if env == DEFAULT_ENV else CRED_DIR / f"dremio-{env}.token"


def _env_flag(env: str) -> str:
    return "" if env == DEFAULT_ENV else f" --env {env}"


def _scan(sql: str) -> str:
    """The statement with comments, string literals and quoted names blinded, in a single left to right
    pass: whichever token starts first wins, so a marker inside another token never opens a new one.
    Raises DremioError for an unbalanced quote or comment, or for a quoting style the scanner does not know."""
    out, i, n = [], 0, len(sql)
    while i < n:
        c = sql[i]
        if sql.startswith("--", i):
            while i < n and sql[i] not in LINE_ENDS:
                i += 1
            out.append(" ")
        elif sql.startswith("/*", i):
            end = sql.find("*/", i + 2)
            if end < 0:
                raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: unterminated /* comment")
            if "/*" in sql[i + 2:end]:
                raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: nested /* comment is ambiguous")
            i = end + 2
            out.append(" ")
        elif c in "'\"":
            j = i + 1
            while True:
                j = sql.find(c, j)
                if j < 0:
                    raise DremioError(f"refused, not a read-only query: unterminated {c} quote")
                if sql.startswith(c, j + 1):  # a doubled quote is an escaped quote
                    j += 2
                    continue
                break
            i = j + 1
            out.append(" " if c == "'" else " x ")
        elif c == "`":
            raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: backtick quoting is not supported by the guard")
        else:
            out.append(c)
            i += 1
    return "".join(out)


def read_only_problem(sql: str) -> str | None:
    """Why `sql` is refused, or None when it is a single read-only query."""
    try:
        bare = _scan(sql)
    except DremioError as exc:
        return str(exc).split(": ", 1)[1]
    body = bare.strip().rstrip(";").strip()
    if not body:
        return "the statement is empty"
    if ";" in body:
        return "one statement at a time: a semicolon may only end it"
    words = [w.upper() for w in WORD.findall(body)]
    if words[0] not in ("SELECT", "WITH"):
        return f"a read starts with SELECT or WITH, not {words[0]}"
    banned = sorted(set(words) & BANNED_WORDS)
    if banned:
        return "write or definition keyword outside a string: " + ", ".join(banned)
    return None


def _check_call(method: str, url: str, env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> None:
    host = host_of(env)
    parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    if parts.scheme != "https" or parts.hostname != host:
        raise DremioError(f"refused: only https://{host} may be called")
    if not any(m == method and rx.fullmatch(parts.path) for m, rx in ALLOWED):
        raise DremioError(f"refused: {method} {parts.path} is not a read route of this client")
    if ".." in parts.path or re.search(r"%(2e|2f|5c)", parts.path, re.I):
        raise DremioError(f"refused: {parts.path} holds a dot segment or an encoded separator")


def _check_sql_body(body) -> None:
    """Guard 1 for the submit-a-query route, so that `call` cannot be used to skip it."""
    if not isinstance(body, dict) or not isinstance(body.get("sql"), str) or set(body) - {"sql", "context"}:
        raise DremioError("refused: POST /api/v3/sql takes only a body of the form {\"sql\": <statement>}")
    problem = read_only_problem(body["sql"])
    if problem:
        raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: " + problem)


class _NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    """A redirect would carry the Authorization header to a URL the allowlist never saw."""

    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        raise DremioError(f"refused: the server answered HTTP {code} with a redirect; the client follows none")


def _dpapi():
    """Windows DPAPI (CryptProtectData/CryptUnprotectData), current-user scope. Standard library only."""
    import ctypes
    import ctypes.wintypes as wintypes

    class DATA_BLOB(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("cbData", wintypes.DWORD), ("pbData", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char))]

    def _blob(data: bytes) -> DATA_BLOB:
        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(data, len(data))
        return DATA_BLOB(len(data), ctypes.cast(buf, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char)))

    def _bytes(blob: DATA_BLOB) -> bytes:
        try:
            return ctypes.string_at(blob.pbData, blob.cbData)
        finally:
            ctypes.windll.kernel32.LocalFree(blob.pbData)

    def protect(data: bytes) -> bytes:
        inblob = _blob(data)
        outblob = DATA_BLOB()
        if not ctypes.windll.crypt32.CryptProtectData(
            ctypes.byref(inblob), None, None, None, None, 0, ctypes.byref(outblob)
        ):
            raise ctypes.WinError()
        return _bytes(outblob)

    def unprotect(data: bytes) -> bytes:
        inblob = _blob(data)
        outblob = DATA_BLOB()
        if not ctypes.windll.crypt32.CryptUnprotectData(
            ctypes.byref(inblob), None, None, None, None, 0, ctypes.byref(outblob)
        ):
            raise ctypes.WinError()
        return _bytes(outblob)

    return protect, unprotect


def save_token(token: str, scheme: str = "_dremio", env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> Path:
    protect, _ = _dpapi()
    target = cred_file(env)
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(protect(json.dumps({"scheme": scheme, "token": token}).encode("utf-8")))
    return target


def load_token(env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> str:
    """The Authorization header value: `_dremio<token>` for a session, `Bearer <token>` for a PAT."""
    source = cred_file(env)
    if not source.is_file():
        raise DremioError(f"no Dremio {env.upper()} session stored: run `python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py login"
                          f"{_env_flag(env)}` in a terminal")
    _, unprotect = _dpapi()
    raw = unprotect(source.read_bytes()).decode("utf-8")
    try:
        stored = json.loads(raw)
    except ValueError:
        stored = {"scheme": "Bearer", "token": raw}
    return ("Bearer " if stored["scheme"] == "Bearer" else "_dremio") + stored["token"]


LOGIN_PATH = "/apiv2/login"


def sign_in(user: str, password: str, env: str = DEFAULT_ENV) -> str:
    """POST the credentials once, to the host of `env` only, and return the session token Dremio gives back."""
    host = host_of(env)
    url = base_of(env) + LOGIN_PATH
    parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    if parts.scheme != "https" or parts.hostname != host:
        raise DremioError(f"refused: only https://{host} may be called")
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps({"userName": user, "password": password}).encode("utf-8"),
                                 method="POST", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        with Client(env=env).opener.open(req, timeout=60) as resp:
            body = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raise DremioError(f"sign-in refused (HTTP {exc.code}): check the user name and password") from None
    token = body.get("token")
    if not token:
        raise DremioError("sign-in answered without a token")
    return token


class Client:
    def __init__(self, auth: str | None = None, env: str = DEFAULT_ENV):
        self.env = env
        self.base = base_of(env)  # refuses an unknown environment before anything else
        self.auth = auth  # a full Authorization value; None reads the stored session of `env`
        self.opener = urllib.request.build_opener(
            urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}),  # an internal host: never through the web proxy
            urllib.request.HTTPSHandler(context=ssl.create_default_context()),
            _NoRedirect())

    def call(self, method: str, path: str, body: dict | None = None, auth: bool = True):
        url = self.base + path
        _check_call(method, url.split("?", 1)[0], self.env)
        if method == "POST" and urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).path == "/api/v3/sql":
            _check_sql_body(body)
        data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8") if body is not None else None
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        if auth:
            req.add_header("Authorization", self.auth or load_token(self.env))
        try:
            with self.opener.open(req, timeout=60) as resp:
                raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            text = exc.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")[:300]
            if exc.code == 401 and auth:
                raise DremioError(f"HTTP 401: the Dremio {self.env.upper()} session has expired or was refused; run "
                                  f"`python _private/kb/_build/dremio_sql.py login{_env_flag(self.env)}` or "
                                  f"`login --token{_env_flag(self.env)}` again in a terminal") from None
            raise DremioError(f"HTTP {exc.code} on {method} {path}: {text}") from None
        return json.loads(raw) if raw.strip().startswith(("{", "[")) else raw

    def query(self, sql: str, max_rows: int, timeout: int):
        problem = read_only_problem(sql)
        if problem:
            raise DremioError("refused, not a read-only query: " + problem)
        job = self.call("POST", "/api/v3/sql", {"sql": sql})["id"]
        start, state = time.time(), ""
        while True:
            status = self.call("GET", f"/api/v3/job/{job}")
            state = status.get("jobState", "")
            if state == "COMPLETED":
                break
            if state in ("FAILED", "CANCELED", "CANCELLED"):
                raise DremioError(f"job {job} {state}: {status.get('errorMessage', '')[:300]}")
            if time.time() - start > timeout:
                self.call("POST", f"/api/v3/job/{job}/cancel", {})
                raise DremioError(f"job {job} cancelled after {timeout} s")
            time.sleep(1.5)
        total = int(status.get("rowCount", 0))
        rows, columns = [], []
        offset = 0
        while offset < min(total, max_rows):
            limit = min(PAGE, max_rows - offset)
            page = self.call("GET", f"/api/v3/job/{job}/results?offset={offset}&limit={limit}")
            columns = columns or [c["name"] for c in page.get("schema", [])]
            rows += page.get("rows", [])
            offset += limit
        if not columns and total == 0:
            page = self.call("GET", f"/api/v3/job/{job}/results?offset=0&limit=1")
            columns = [c["name"] for c in page.get("schema", [])]
        return job, columns, rows, total


OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "User Guides" / "dremio"  # git-ignored: results stay local


def out_path(arg: str) -> Path:
    """The CSV path, refused unless it resolves to a place under User Guides, dremio (links included)."""
    path = Path(arg).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(OUT_DIR.resolve()):
        raise DremioError(f"refused: -o must name a file under {OUT_DIR}")
    return path


def write_csv(path: Path, columns: list[str], rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(columns)
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow(["" if r.get(c) is None else (json.dumps(r[c], ensure_ascii=False)
                        if isinstance(r.get(c), (dict, list)) else r.get(c)) for c in columns])


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Read-only SQL on the FPL Dremio (INTG by default, or CTLQ).")
    common = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    common.add_argument("--env", choices=list(ENVIRONMENTS), default=DEFAULT_ENV,
                        help="Dremio server: intg (default) or ctlq; each keeps its own session token")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    lg = sub.add_parser("login", parents=[common], help="sign in with user name and password; keeps only the session token")
    lg.add_argument("--token", action="store_true",
                    help="paste the session token of a signed-in browser instead of signing in")
    sub.add_parser("probe", parents=[common], help="server status and an authenticated catalog read")
    q = sub.add_parser("query", parents=[common], help="run one SELECT or WITH query and write the result as CSV")
    q.add_argument("sql_file", nargs="?", help="'-' for standard input")
    q.add_argument("-f", "--file", help="file holding the query")
    q.add_argument("-o", "--out", required=True, help="CSV file to write")
    q.add_argument("--max-rows", type=int, default=10000)
    q.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=300, help="seconds before the job is cancelled")
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    if not sys.stdout.isatty():
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    try:
        if args.cmd == "login" and args.token:
            raw = getpass.getpass(f"Dremio {args.env.upper()} session token copied from the browser (hidden): ").strip().strip('"')
            if not raw:
                print("nothing stored")
                return 1
            scheme = "Bearer" if raw.startswith("eyJ") else "_dremio"
            token = raw[len("_dremio"):] if raw.startswith("_dremio") else raw
            header = ("Bearer " if scheme == "Bearer" else "_dremio") + token
            Client(header, env=args.env).call("GET", "/api/v3/catalog")
            print(f"{args.env.upper()} token accepted; stored in {save_token(token, scheme, args.env)}")
        elif args.cmd == "login":
            user = input(f"Dremio {args.env.upper()} user name: ").strip()
            password = getpass.getpass("Dremio password (hidden, never stored): ")
            if not user or not password:
                print("nothing stored")
                return 1
            token = sign_in(user, password, args.env)
            del password
            Client("_dremio" + token, env=args.env).call("GET", "/api/v3/catalog")
            print(f"signed in to {args.env.upper()}; session token stored in {save_token(token, env=args.env)} (the password is not kept)")
        elif args.cmd == "probe":
            c = Client(env=args.env)
            print(f"{args.env.upper()} server status:", c.call("GET", "/apiv2/server_status", auth=False))
            data = c.call("GET", "/api/v3/catalog")
            print(f"authenticated: {len(data.get('data', []))} top-level catalog entries")
        else:
            src = args.file or args.sql_file
            if not src:
                p.error("give -f <file> or '-' for standard input")
            target = out_path(args.out)
            sql = sys.stdin.read() if src == "-" else Path(src).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            job, columns, rows, total = Client(env=args.env).query(sql, args.max_rows, args.timeout)
            write_csv(target, columns, rows)
            cut = f" (cut at {args.max_rows} of {total})" if total > len(rows) else ""
            print(f"job {job}: {len(rows)} rows, {len(columns)} columns written to {args.out}{cut}")
    except DremioError as exc:
        print(f"dremio_sql: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

    "Initial Mkt Value", "Exchange Rate", "Detention Rate", "Mkt Value",
    "Mkt Value Level 1", "Mkt Value Level 2", "Mkt Value Level 3", "Mkt Value Consolidated",
    "Account Number",
}

    "Initial Mkt Value", "Mkt Value", "Mkt Value Level 1", "Mkt Value Level 2",
    "Mkt Value Level 3", "Mkt Value Consolidated",

    "acc_det": {"cols": ACC_DET_COLS, "map": ACC_DET_MAP},
    "acc_conso": {"cols": ACC_CONSO_COLS, "map": ACC_CONSO_MAP},

# Types de fonds (TAB_FND_MAIN / FUND_TYPE) qui recoivent le plug 699999.
RECLASS_FUND_TYPES = {2, 4, 5}

# Assiette du controle CONTROLE_PTF (proc_Bilan_Controle / proc_Ptf_Controle).

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-conso-etat-financier\consoapp\conso.py =====
"""Moteur de consolidation du bilan (PKG_CONSO_ETATS_FINANCIERS, chaine Bilan uniquement).

Trois fonctions, dans l'ordre du package LUXIS : ponderer une ligne de niveau, consolider par
compte selon le type de consolidation (FUND_BILAN_CONSO_METHOD.FBCM_TYPE_CONSOLIDATION), puis
inserer le plug de reclassement 699999. Verifie a la cent sur le cas de reference du classeur
(reference\\acc_det_383079_2026-09-30.csv -> reference\\acc_conso_693773_2026-09-30.csv),
voir tests\\golden\\test_reference_luxis.py et ETAT.md.
"""
from .columns import RECLASS_ACCOUNT, RECLASS_FUND_TYPES, RECLASS_NAME

LEVEL_1 = "LEVEL 1"
LEVEL_2 = "LEVEL 2"
LEVEL_3 = "LEVEL 3"

TYPE_LEVEL_1 = "LEVEL 1"
TYPE_ALL_LEVEL = "ALL LEVEL"
TYPE_LEVEL_2_3 = "LEVEL 2+3"
TYPE_NO_CONSO = "NO CONSO"


def pondere(lignes):
    """Mkt Value de chaque ligne de niveau : ROUND(Initial Mkt Value x Exchange Rate x Detention Rate / 100, 2).

    Le taux de detention est force a 100 au niveau 1 (le pool se detient lui-meme en entier).
    Rend une nouvelle liste de dictionnaires, colonnes identiques, "Mkt Value" recalculee.
    """
    out = []
    for ligne in lignes:
        detention = 100.0 if ligne["Level"] == LEVEL_1 else float(ligne["Detention Rate"])
        valeur = round(float(ligne["Initial Mkt Value"]) * float(ligne["Exchange Rate"]) * detention / 100, 2)
        out.append({**ligne, "Mkt Value": valeur})
    return out


def consolide(lignes, subfund):
    """Agrege les lignes ponderees par compte et par niveau, puis applique le CASE du type de
    consolidation (FBCM_TYPE_CONSOLIDATION) pour rendre la valeur consolidee.

    `lignes` : sortie de `pondere`, une ligne par (compte, niveau), portant la fiche du pool
    (383079 dans le cas de reference). `subfund` : identite du sous-fonds consolide rapporte
    (le feeder 693773, pas le pool), un dictionnaire avec les cles "SubFund Number",
    "SubFund Name", "SubFund Ccy" et "Consolidation Ccy" : ces quatre colonnes de
    `reference\\acc_conso_*.csv` decrivent le rapport, pas l'extraction du pool, et ne figurent
    donc pas dans `lignes`. Le type de consolidation et le libelle du compte sont supposes
    constants pour un meme compte (ils le sont dans le classeur de reference). Rend une liste de
    dictionnaires au schema de `reference\\acc_conso_*.csv`, sans le plug 699999.
    """
    comptes = {}
    for ligne in lignes:
        compte = int(ligne["Account Number"])
        rec = comptes.setdefault(compte, {
            "SubFund Number": subfund["SubFund Number"], "SubFund Name": subfund["SubFund Name"],
            "SubFund Ccy": subfund["SubFund Ccy"], "Consolidation Ccy": subfund["Consolidation Ccy"],
            "Nav Date": ligne["Nav Date"], "Account Number": compte,
            "Account Name": ligne["Account Name"], "Consolidation Type": ligne["Consolidation Type"],
            LEVEL_1: 0.0, LEVEL_2: 0.0, LEVEL_3: 0.0,
        })
        rec[ligne["Level"]] += float(ligne["Mkt Value"])

    out = []
    for compte in sorted(comptes):
        rec = comptes[compte]
        l1, l2, l3 = rec.pop(LEVEL_1), rec.pop(LEVEL_2), rec.pop(LEVEL_3)
        type_conso = rec["Consolidation Type"]
        if type_conso == TYPE_LEVEL_1:
            consolide_val = l1
        elif type_conso == TYPE_ALL_LEVEL:
            consolide_val = l1 + l2 + l3
        elif type_conso == TYPE_LEVEL_2_3:
            consolide_val = l2 + l3
        elif type_conso == TYPE_NO_CONSO:
            consolide_val = 0.0
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"type de consolidation inconnu pour le compte {compte} : {type_conso!r}")
        out.append({
            **rec,
            "Mkt Value Level 1": round(l1, 2), "Mkt Value Level 2": round(l2, 2),
            "Mkt Value Level 3": round(l3, 2), "Mkt Value Consolidated": round(consolide_val, 2),
        })
    return out


def plug_reclass(resultat, type_fonds, compte=RECLASS_ACCOUNT, nom=RECLASS_NAME):
    """Insere la ligne de reclassement du pooling si le type de fonds la recoit (2, 4 ou 5) et
    si le total consolide n'est pas nul : le plug est l'oppose exact du total des autres comptes,
    si bien que le bilan consolide complet boucle a 0,00.
    """
    if type_fonds not in RECLASS_FUND_TYPES or not resultat:
        return list(resultat)
    total = round(sum(r["Mkt Value Consolidated"] for r in resultat), 2)
    if total == 0:
        return list(resultat)
    base = resultat[0]
    plug = {
        "SubFund Number": base["SubFund Number"], "SubFund Name": base["SubFund Name"],
        "SubFund Ccy": base["SubFund Ccy"], "Consolidation Ccy": base["Consolidation Ccy"],
        "Nav Date": base["Nav Date"], "Account Number": compte, "Account Name": nom,
        "Mkt Value Level 1": 0.0, "Mkt Value Level 2": 0.0, "Mkt Value Level 3": 0.0,
        "Mkt Value Consolidated": -total, "Consolidation Type": TYPE_ALL_LEVEL,
    }
    return [*resultat, plug]



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-conso-etat-financier\consoapp\dremio.py =====
"""Acces Dremio en lecture seule.

Chaque requete passe par sql_check.py (controle du catalogue) puis par dremio_sql.py (client
verrouille sur ses serveurs connus, INTG par defaut ou CTLQ avec dremio.serveur, SELECT et WITH
seulement). Ces deux fichiers sont importes depuis le depot BA Assistant, jamais modifies ni
copies. Aucun jeton n'est lu ici : le client garde la session de l'utilisateur ailleurs.
Repris de glapp\\dremio.py (frd-poc-general-ledger), sans le mode sans-LUXIS (hors perimetre).
"""
import sys
import time

from .paths import allowed_servers, build_dir, dremio_server, load_config


def auth_message():
    """Marche Ã  suivre quand la session Dremio a expirÃ© (HTTP 401)."""
    return "Session Dremio expirÃ©e : relancer la connexion dans le panneau Dremio."


class DremioFailure(RuntimeError):
    """Erreur Dremio ou refus de controle, avec un message utilisable par l'utilisateur."""


class AuthExpired(DremioFailure):
    pass


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self, out_dir=None, timeout=None, max_rows=None, cfg=None):
        self.cfg = cfg or load_config()
        # Serveur Dremio (dremio.serveur) : refuse avant toute requete un serveur que la configuration n'admet pas.
        self.server = dremio_server(self.cfg)
        if self.server not in allowed_servers(self.cfg):
            raise DremioFailure(f"serveur Dremio inconnu : {self.server} (admis : {', '.join(allowed_servers(self.cfg))})")
        self.out_dir = out_dir
        self.timeout = timeout or self.cfg["delai_requete_secondes"]
        self.max_rows = max_rows or self.cfg["lignes_max"]
        self.log = []
        self._dremio = self._check = self._catalogue = self._client = None
        if out_dir is not None:
            (out_dir / "sql").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def _load(self):
        if self._dremio is None:
            bd = str(build_dir(self.cfg))
            if bd not in sys.path:
                sys.path.insert(0, bd)
            try:
                import dremio_sql
                import sql_check
            except ImportError as exc:
                raise DremioFailure(f"client Dremio introuvable : {exc}") from None
            self._dremio, self._check = dremio_sql, sql_check
            self._catalogue = sql_check.load()
            try:
                self._client = dremio_sql.Client(env=self.server)
            except dremio_sql.DremioError as exc:
                raise DremioFailure(f"client Dremio refusÃ© pour le serveur {self.server} : {exc}") from None

    def check_sql(self, sql):
        """Controle du catalogue (sql_check). Retourne la liste des erreurs ; vide si la requete est acceptee."""
        self._load()
        return list(self._check.check(sql.lstrip("ï»¿"), self._catalogue).errors)

    def query(self, name, sql, max_rows=None, timeout=None):
        """Execute une requete lecture seule. Retourne la liste des lignes (dictionnaires). Jamais de troncature silencieuse."""
        self._load()
        if self.out_dir is not None:
            (self.out_dir / "sql" / f"{name}.sql").write_text(sql.strip() + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        errors = self.check_sql(sql)
        if errors:
            raise DremioFailure(f"requete {name} refusÃ©e par le controle de catalogue : {' ; '.join(errors)[:600]}")
        limit = max_rows or self.max_rows
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            job, _cols, rows, total = self._client.query(sql, limit, timeout or self.timeout)
        except self._dremio.DremioError as exc:
            msg = str(exc)
            if "HTTP 401" in msg:
                raise AuthExpired(auth_message()) from None
            raise DremioFailure(f"requete {name} a Ã©chouÃ© : {msg}") from None
        seconds = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
        if total > len(rows):
            raise DremioFailure(f"requete {name} tronquÃ©e : {total} lignes trouvÃ©es, {limit} rendues")
        self.log.append({"name": name, "job": job, "rows": len(rows), "seconds": seconds})
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    @property
    def request_count(self):
        return len(self.log)

    def probe(self):
        """Etat de la session : lecture authentifiee du catalogue. Retourne (ok, message)."""
        self._load()
        try:
            status = self._client.call("GET", "/api/v3/catalog", auth=True)
        except self._dremio.DremioError as exc:
            if "HTTP 401" in str(exc):
                return False, auth_message()
            return False, f"erreur inattendue : {exc}"
        except Exception as exc:  # reseau, jeton absent
            return False, f"serveur injoignable : {exc}"
        n = len(status.get("data", [])) if isinstance(status, dict) else 0
        return True, f"session valide, {n} Ã©lÃ©ments au catalogue"



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-conso-etat-financier\consoapp\engine.py =====
"""Moteur : enchaine les etapes SQL de la chaine Bilan, applique conso.py, controle, ecrit les
fichiers. Toute la logique de ponderation et de CASE est en Python (conso.py, decision
d'architecture d'ETAT.md) ; ce module se contente de : lire les etapes dans l'ordre LUXIS,
mettre en forme leurs lignes au schema attendu par conso.py, enchainer, controler, ecrire.
Repris de la trame de glapp\\engine.py (frd-poc-general-ledger), sans i18n (differe) et sans les
notions propres au Grand livre (lots, periodes BCR/IRP) : la chaine Bilan n'en a pas.
"""
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from . import conso, journal
from .columns import LEVEL_LABELS, RECLASS_FUND_TYPES, SPEC, TYPE_LABELS, in_ptf_control
from .outputs import num, write_csv, write_json
from .paths import load_config, output_dir
from .sqlrender import render_step


class ConsoError(Exception):
    """Erreur attendue (fonds absent, execution introuvable) : le message s'adresse a l'utilisateur."""


def _date(v):
    return str(v)[:10] if v not in (None, "") else None


def _int(v):
    return int(str(v).split(".")[0]) if v not in (None, "") else None


@dataclass
class RunResult:
    params: object
    fund: dict
    niveaux: list
    consolide: list
    controle_ptf: dict
    queries: list
    seconds: float
    folder: Path = None
    files: list = field(default_factory=list)
    ecarts_niveau: list = field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def status(self):
        if self.ecarts_niveau or self.controle_ptf.get("ecart"):
            return "ALERTE"
        return "OK"

    def to_json(self, cfg):
        return {
            "parametres": self.params.as_dict(), "fonds": self.fund.get("FUND_NAME"), "devise": self.fund.get("FUND_CCY"),
            "type_fonds": self.fund.get("FUND_TYPE"), "comptes_consolides": len(self.consolide),
            "bilan_consolide_total": round(sum(r["Mkt Value Consolidated"] for r in self.consolide), 2),
            "ecarts_niveau": self.ecarts_niveau[:50], "nombre_ecarts_niveau": len(self.ecarts_niveau),
            "controle_ptf": self.controle_ptf, "requetes": self.queries, "nombre_de_requetes": len(self.queries),
            "secondes": self.seconds, "notes": self.notes,
        }


def read_fund(params, gw, cfg, progress=None):
    """Etape 00 : fiche du fonds (TAB_FND_MAIN + FUND_BILAN_FONDS pour l'execution donnee)."""
    values = {"FUND": params.fund, "CONSO_ID": params.conso_id}
    rows = gw.query("00_fonds", render_step("00_fonds", values, {"AVEC_CONSO"}, params.source, cfg=cfg))
    if progress:
        progress(f"00_fonds : {len(rows)} ligne(s), {gw.log[-1]['seconds']} s")
    if not rows:
        raise ConsoError(f"fonds {params.fund} absent de la Table Fonds")
    return rows[0]


def read_structure(params, gw, cfg, progress=None):
    """Etape 01 : feeders et mid-pools directement rattaches au fonds, a la NAV donnee.

    Facultatif : seulement si params.nav_date est fourni (FUND_POOL_REPARTITION est indexee par
    date de detention, pas par CONSO_ID). Sans NAV, la structure n'est pas verifiee ici et
    l'appelant est repute l'avoir deja etablie (cas du test hors ligne, qui part directement du
    classeur de reference)."""
    if not params.nav_date:
        return []
    rows = gw.query("01_structure", render_step("01_structure", {"FUND": params.fund, "NAV": params.nav_date}, (), params.source, cfg=cfg))
    if progress:
        progress(f"01_structure : {len(rows)} ligne(s), {gw.log[-1]['seconds']} s")
    return rows


def read_niveaux(params, gw, cfg, progress=None):
    """Etape 30 : lignes de niveau deja calculees par LUXIS (FUND_BILAN_ACC_DET), mises en forme
    au schema attendu par conso.pondere (reference\\acc_det_*.csv)."""
    rows = gw.query("30_niveaux", render_step("30_niveaux", {"CONSO_ID": params.conso_id, "FUND": params.fund}, (), params.source, cfg=cfg))
    if progress:
        progress(f"30_niveaux : {len(rows)} ligne(s), {gw.log[-1]['seconds']} s")
    out = []
    for r in rows:
        niveau = _int(r["NIVEAU"])
        out.append({
            "Nav Date": _date(r["DATE_NAV"]), "Account Number": _int(r["COMPTE"]), "Account Name": r["LIBELLE"],
            "Initial Mkt Value": num(r["MKT_VALUE_INI"]), "Exchange Rate": num(r["TX_CHANGE"]),
            "Detention Rate": num(r["TX_DETENTION"]), "Mkt Value Luxis": num(r["MKT_VALUE_LUXIS"]),
            "Consolidation Type": TYPE_LABELS.get(str(r["TYPE_CONSOLIDATION"]), str(r["TYPE_CONSOLIDATION"])),
            "Level": LEVEL_LABELS.get(niveau, f"LEVEL {niveau}"),
        })
    return out


def check_niveaux(pondere):
    """Compare la valeur recalculee en Python (conso.pondere) a celle deja ecrite par LUXIS
    (colonne 'Mkt Value Luxis', ajoutee par read_niveaux). Rend les ecarts, vide si tout concorde
    a la cent : c'est la meme preuve que tests\\golden\\test_reference_luxis.py, mais en base."""
    out = []
    for r in pondere:
        if round(r["Mkt Value"] - r["Mkt Value Luxis"], 2) != 0:
            out.append({"compte": r["Account Number"], "niveau": r["Level"], "attendu_luxis": r["Mkt Value Luxis"], "obtenu": r["Mkt Value"]})
    return out


def read_controle_ptf(params, gw, cfg, progress=None):
    """Etape 50 : assiette titres, filtree en Python par columns.in_ptf_control (une seule
    regle, pas une copie en SQL, voir sql\\50_controle_ptf.sql)."""
    if not params.nav_date:
        return {"lignes": 0, "assiette": 0.0, "ecart": False}
    values = {"CONSO_ID": params.conso_id, "FUND": params.fund, "NAV": params.nav_date}
    rows = gw.query("50_controle_ptf", render_step("50_controle_ptf", values, (), params.source, cfg=cfg))
    if progress:
        progress(f"50_controle_ptf : {len(rows)} ligne(s), {gw.log[-1]['seconds']} s")
    assiette = [r for r in rows if in_ptf_control(r["ACC_NUM"])]
    total = round(sum(num(r["MARKET_VALUE_PTF"]) for r in assiette), 2)
    return {"lignes": len(assiette), "assiette": total, "ecart": False}


def run(params, gw, out_root=None, write=True, progress=None, cfg=None):
    """La chaine Bilan de bout en bout, pour un fonds et une execution LUXIS (CONSO_ID) donnes."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    t0 = time.time()
    folder = (Path(out_root) if out_root else output_dir(cfg)) / params.tag if write else None
    mark = len(gw.log)
    if folder is not None:
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    gw.out_dir = folder
    try:
        fund = read_fund(params, gw, cfg, progress)
        read_structure(params, gw, cfg, progress)
        niveaux = read_niveaux(params, gw, cfg, progress)
        pondere = conso.pondere(niveaux)
        ecarts = check_niveaux(pondere)
        subfund = {
            "SubFund Number": fund.get("FUND_NUMBER"), "SubFund Name": fund.get("FUND_NAME"),
            "SubFund Ccy": fund.get("FUND_CCY"), "Consolidation Ccy": fund.get("CONSO_CCY") or fund.get("FUND_CCY"),
        }
        consolide = conso.consolide(pondere, subfund)
        type_fonds = _int(fund.get("FUND_TYPE"))
        if type_fonds in RECLASS_FUND_TYPES:
            consolide = conso.plug_reclass(consolide, type_fonds)
        controle_ptf = read_controle_ptf(params, gw, cfg, progress)
        result = RunResult(params, fund, niveaux, consolide, controle_ptf, list(gw.log[mark:]), 0.0, folder, ecarts_niveau=ecarts)
        if ecarts:
            result.notes.append(f"{len(ecarts)} ecart(s) entre la ponderation Python et FBAD_MKT_VALUE (LUXIS) : voir ecarts_niveau")
        result.seconds = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
        result.queries = list(gw.log[mark:])
        if write:
            result.files = write_outputs(result, cfg)
        journal.log_event("run", cfg=cfg, tag=params.tag, comptes=len(consolide), secondes=result.seconds,
                           requetes=len(result.queries), statut=result.status)
        return result
    except Exception as exc:
        journal.log_event("run_erreur", cfg=cfg, tag=params.tag, erreur=str(exc)[:300])
        raise


def write_outputs(result, cfg):
    p, folder, spec = result.params, result.folder, SPEC["acc_conso"]
    files = []
    if "csv" in p.formats:
        write_csv(folder / f"{p.tag}.csv", spec["cols"], spec["map"], result.consolide)
        files.append(f"{p.tag}.csv")
    write_json(folder / f"{p.tag}.json", result.to_json(cfg))
    files.append(f"{p.tag}.json")
    return files
