===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\03_nav_header.sql =====
SELECT N.NAV_FUND_NO,
       N.NAV_DATE_NAV,
       COALESCE(CAST(L.D_H_PROCESS AS DATE), CAST(N.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE)) AS DATE_CALCUL,
       N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE_PUB,
       L.N_LOT AS LOT,
       CASE WHEN N.NAV_TYP_TRT = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS NAV_TYPE,
       COALESCE(N.NAV_MNT_PORFOLIO, 0) AS SEC_POSITION
FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, N_LOT, D_H_PROCESS
    FROM {{TBL_AMS_LOT}}
    WHERE C_FUND = {{FUND}}
      AND D_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
    ORDER BY N_LOT DESC
    LIMIT 1
) L ON L.C_FUND = N.NAV_FUND_NO
   AND L.D_NAV = N.NAV_DATE_NAV
WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
  AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\04_multiccy_nav.sql =====
WITH DATE_J1 AS (
    SELECT MAX(TB.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS DATE_NAV_J_1
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} TB
    JOIN {{TBL_AMS_LOT}} L
      ON TB.NAV_FUND_NO = L.C_FUND
     AND TB.NAV_DATE_NAV = L.D_NAV
    WHERE TB.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
      AND TB.NAV_DATE_NAV < {{DATE_NAV}}
),
N_DEDUP AS (
    SELECT N.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY N.C_FUND, N.D_NAV, N.C_SHARE ORDER BY N.N_LOT DESC) AS RN
    FROM {{TBL_AMS_NAV_ARC_MULTI_CCY}} N
    WHERE N.C_FUND = {{FUND}}
      AND N.D_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
),
T_DEDUP AS (
    SELECT T.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T.C_FUND, T.D_NAV, T.C_SHARE ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC) AS RN
    FROM {{TBL_AMS_NAV_ARC_SHARE_DETAIL}} T
    WHERE T.C_FUND = {{FUND}}
      AND T.D_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
),
FX_DEDUP AS (
    SELECT FX.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FX.C_FUND, FX.D_NAV, FX.C_CCY ORDER BY FX.N_LOT DESC) AS RN
    FROM {{TBL_AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES}} FX
    WHERE FX.C_FUND = {{FUND}}
      AND FX.D_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
)
SELECT N.C_FUND AS FUND_NUMBER,
       TF.FUND_NAME,
       TF.FUND_CCY,
       N.D_NAV AS DATE_NAV,
       N.C_SHARE AS PART,
       NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, TF.PART_FA_CODE) AS CODE_PART_FA_PUBLIE,
       TF.INTERNAL_FA_CODE AS CODE_INTERNE_FA,
       TF.PART_NAME,
       N.C_CCY AS PART_CCY,
       D.DATE_NAV_J_1,
       COALESCE(QJ1.NAP_QT_PART, 0) AS QTY_J_1,
       T.Q_SHARE_SUB AS SUB,
       T.Q_SHARE_RED AS RED,
       T.Q_OUTSTANDING AS QTY_J,
       T.A_OUTSTANDING AS TNA_FUND_CCY,
       T.P_SHARE AS PRICE_FUND_CCY,
       T.P_SHARE_SUB AS SUB_PRICE_FUND_CCY,
       T.P_SHARE_RED AS RED_PRICE_FUND_CCY,
       N.P_SHARE AS PRICE_PART_CCY,
       N.P_SHARE_SUB AS SUB_PRICE_PART_CCY,
       N.P_SHARE_RED AS RED_PRICE_PART_CCY,
       N.R_EXCHANGE AS EXCHANGE_RATE,
       COALESCE(FX.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY, 0) AS TX_CH,
       ROUND(T.Q_OUTSTANDING * T.P_SHARE * COALESCE(FX.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY, 0), 2) AS TNA_PART_CCY
FROM N_DEDUP N
JOIN T_DEDUP T
  ON N.C_FUND = T.C_FUND AND N.D_NAV = T.D_NAV AND N.C_SHARE = T.C_SHARE
JOIN {{TBL_FND_MAIN}} TF
  ON N.C_FUND = TF.FA_NUM AND N.C_SHARE = TF.PART_FA_CODE
JOIN {{TBL_NAV}} NN
  ON N.C_FUND = NN.NAV_FUND_NO AND N.D_NAV = NN.NAV_DATE_NAV
CROSS JOIN DATE_J1 D
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS}} QJ1
  ON QJ1.NAP_FUND_NO = N.C_FUND
 AND QJ1.NAP_DATE_NAV = D.DATE_NAV_J_1
 AND QJ1.NAP_TPARTS = N.C_SHARE
LEFT JOIN FX_DEDUP FX
  ON FX.C_FUND = N.C_FUND
 AND FX.D_NAV = N.D_NAV
 AND FX.C_CCY = N.C_CCY
 AND FX.RN = 1
WHERE N.RN = 1
  AND T.RN = 1



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\05_bcr_tx_ch_nav.sql =====
WITH FUND_FLAG AS (
    SELECT FA_NUM, MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NAV_BACKDATED, 2) = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS NAV_BACKDATED
    FROM {{TBL_FND_MAIN}}
    GROUP BY FA_NUM
), FUND_INFO AS (
    SELECT FA_NUM, MAX(FUND_NAME) AS FUND_NAME, MAX(FUND_CCY) AS FUND_CCY
    FROM {{TBL_FND_MAIN}}
    GROUP BY FA_NUM
), LATEST_LOT AS (
    SELECT T.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T.C_FUND, T.D_NAV, T.C_CCY ORDER BY T.N_LOT DESC) AS RN
    FROM {{TBL_AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES}} T
    WHERE T.C_FUND = {{FUND}}
      AND T.D_NAV BETWEEN {{DATE_FROM}} AND {{DATE_TO}}
)
SELECT T.C_FUND AS FUND_NUMBER,
       FI.FUND_NAME,
       FI.FUND_CCY,
       T.D_NAV,
       T.C_CCY,
       T.R_EXCHANGE_MF AS EXCHANGE_MF,
       T.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY AS CCY_TO_PTF_CCY,
       T.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY AS PTF_CCY_TO_CCY,
       T.G_ROUNDING_PTF_CCY,
       T.G_ROUNDING_CCY,
       T.N_DECIMAL_PTF_CCY,
       T.N_DECIMAL_CCY
FROM LATEST_LOT T
JOIN FUND_FLAG B ON B.FA_NUM = T.C_FUND
JOIN FUND_INFO FI ON FI.FA_NUM = T.C_FUND
WHERE T.RN = 1
  AND ((B.NAV_BACKDATED = 0 AND T.C_NAV_TYP = 'O') OR B.NAV_BACKDATED = 1)



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\06_nav_price.sql =====
-- Feuille Price du rapport nav (CR_PRICE, PKG_FIRST_NAV_PAGE.proc_Donnees_Sources, l.1066 a 1079).
-- Repli multi-devises (CR_PRICE_MULTI_CCY, GET_PRICE_FA_PART_CCY) traduit par la jointure PRICE_MC
-- ci-dessous : quand PART_CCY <> FUND_CCY, le prix vient de LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY,
-- jointe sur NAP_FUND_NO+NAP_TPARTS+NAP_DATE_NAV+NAP_TYP_TRT (meme cle que le PL/SQL), sinon de
-- NAV_PARTS directement. Verifie en direct le 07/10/2026 sur 280232/INE (EUR/USD) : la jointure ne
-- duplique pas de lignes et le prix EUR mesure (97.79913 au 27/07/2009) correspond a la table
-- multi-devises. Pas d'alias BUSINESS.FUND_ACCOUNTING pour cette table (TBL_NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY,
-- config/defaults.json), contrairement a NAV_PARTS.
-- GET_SEC_CCY ne filtre pas par lot (SELECT DISTINCT), ROW_NUMBER() ci-dessous ne garde qu'une
-- valeur par titre si plusieurs lots portaient des devises differentes (cas non observe).
-- TAB_FND_MAIN porte une ligne par classe de parts, pas par fonds (FA_NUM seul n'est pas une cle,
-- decouverte en direct sur 523379 : 3 lignes pour FA_NUM='523379', une par INTERNAL_FA_CODE) :
-- FUND_CCY est donc lu sur TF, deja filtree a la bonne classe par INTERNAL_FA_CODE = S.C_N_ID,
-- jamais par une seconde jointure sur FA_NUM seul qui tripplerait le resultat.
-- Switch A03 (config\anomalies.json) : quand PART_CCY<>FUND_CCY et qu'aucune ligne
-- NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY n'existe pour la part, deux regles possibles.
-- REGLE_LUXIS=False (corrige, par defaut) : prix laisse NULL, le moteur (checks.py) leve un
-- verdict NON_VERIFIABLE nommant la part plutot que de deviner une valeur.
-- REGLE_LUXIS=True (luxis) : reproduit l'heritage de la part precedente de la boucle CR_PRICE
-- (PKG_FIRST_NAV_PAGE.pkb l.1571-1591) par une fenetre LAST_VALUE ... IGNORE NULLS, ordonnee
-- par NAP_TPARTS croissant. Assumption : l'ordre reel du curseur CR_PRICE n'a pas ete relu
-- (clause ORDER BY de CR_MAIN non retrouvee), a confirmer avant de citer ce mode comme fidele.
WITH PTF_SHARE AS (
    SELECT C_FUND, C_SHARE, C_N_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT C_FUND, C_SHARE, C_N_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, C_SHARE ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_PTF_SHARE}}
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),
ISIN AS (
    SELECT C_N_ID, SUBSTR(G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS CODE_ISIN
    FROM (
        SELECT C_N_ID, G_ID_VALUE,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_N_ID ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_SEC_INTL_ID}}
        WHERE C_ID_TYP = '11' AND C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),
SEC_CCY AS (
    SELECT C_N_ID, C_SEC_CCY AS PART_CCY
    FROM (
        SELECT C_N_ID, C_SEC_CCY,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_N_ID ORDER BY C_SEC_CCY) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_SEC_MASTER}}
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
)
SELECT T.NAP_FUND_NO AS FUND_NUMBER,
       T.NAP_TPARTS AS PART,
       S.C_N_ID AS CODE_INTERNE_FA,
       ISIN.CODE_ISIN,
       NVL(TF.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, TF.PART_FA_CODE) AS CODE_PART_FA_A_PUBLIER,
       SEC_CCY.PART_CCY,
       TF.FUND_CCY,
       CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T.NAP_PRICE_PART
--#SI REGLE_LUXIS
            ELSE COALESCE(MC.NAP_PRICE_PART,
                 LAST_VALUE(MC.NAP_PRICE_PART) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY T.NAP_TPARTS)) END AS PRICE,
--#SINON
            ELSE MC.NAP_PRICE_PART END AS PRICE,
--#FIN
       CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T.NAP_PRICE_PART_SUB
--#SI REGLE_LUXIS
            ELSE COALESCE(MC.NAP_PRICE_PART_SUB,
                 LAST_VALUE(MC.NAP_PRICE_PART_SUB) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY T.NAP_TPARTS)) END AS PRICE_SUB,
--#SINON
            ELSE MC.NAP_PRICE_PART_SUB END AS PRICE_SUB,
--#FIN
       CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T.NAP_PRICE_PART_RED
--#SI REGLE_LUXIS
            ELSE COALESCE(MC.NAP_PRICE_PART_RED,
                 LAST_VALUE(MC.NAP_PRICE_PART_RED) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY T.NAP_TPARTS)) END AS PRICE_RED,
--#SINON
            ELSE MC.NAP_PRICE_PART_RED END AS PRICE_RED,
--#FIN
       T.NAP_QT_PART AS QTY,
       T.NAP_MNT_PART AS TNA
FROM {{TBL_NAV_PARTS}} T
JOIN PTF_SHARE S
  ON T.NAP_FUND_NO = S.C_FUND AND T.NAP_TPARTS = S.C_SHARE
LEFT JOIN ISIN ON ISIN.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID
LEFT JOIN SEC_CCY ON SEC_CCY.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_FND_MAIN}} TF ON TF.INTERNAL_FA_CODE = S.C_N_ID
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY}} MC
  ON MC.NAP_FUND_NO = T.NAP_FUND_NO AND MC.NAP_TPARTS = T.NAP_TPARTS
 AND MC.NAP_DATE_NAV = T.NAP_DATE_NAV AND MC.NAP_TYP_TRT = T.NAP_TYP_TRT
WHERE T.NAP_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
  AND T.NAP_DATE_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
  AND T.NAP_QT_PART <> 0



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\07_nav_exchrate.sql =====
-- Feuille Exchange_Rate du rapport nav (CR_CCY, PKG_FIRST_NAV_PAGE.proc_Donnees_Sources,
-- l.1144 a 1154 et 1695 a 1738). Type=1 de GET_X_RATE_FOR_NAV_MF (fonction lue en entier) donne
-- R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY, pas R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY (type=2, utilise par 04_multiccy_nav.sql pour un autre
-- besoin) : les deux colonnes existent sur la meme table et ne doivent pas etre confondues.
-- Date_Nav_Previous reprend le calcul de la date de nav precedente du gabarit 04 (DATE_J1), pas
-- un appel a get_nav_date_nav_prec_suiv traduit a part.
WITH DATE_NAV_PREV AS (
    SELECT MAX(TB.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS DATE_NAV_PREVIOUS
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} TB
    JOIN {{TBL_AMS_LOT}} L
      ON TB.NAV_FUND_NO = L.C_FUND
     AND TB.NAV_DATE_NAV = L.D_NAV
    WHERE TB.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
      AND TB.NAV_DATE_NAV < {{DATE_NAV}}
),
RATES AS (
    SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, C_CCY, R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY
    FROM (
        SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, C_CCY, R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV, C_CCY ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES}}
        WHERE C_FUND = {{FUND}}
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
)
SELECT CUR.C_FUND AS FUND_NUMBER,
       CUR.C_CCY AS CCY,
       {{DATE_NAV}} AS DATE_NAV,
       P.DATE_NAV_PREVIOUS,
       CUR.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY AS X_RATE,
       PRV.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY AS X_RATE_PREVIOUS,
       CASE WHEN PRV.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY IS NOT NULL AND PRV.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY <> 0
            THEN ROUND(((CUR.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY / PRV.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY) - 1) * 100, 2)
            ELSE NULL
       END AS X_RATE_VARIATION
FROM RATES CUR
CROSS JOIN DATE_NAV_PREV P
LEFT JOIN RATES PRV
  ON PRV.C_FUND = CUR.C_FUND
 AND PRV.C_CCY = CUR.C_CCY
 AND PRV.D_NAV = P.DATE_NAV_PREVIOUS
WHERE CUR.D_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
ORDER BY CUR.C_CCY



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\08_nav_rubriques.sql =====
-- Rubriques 4 (Cash and Cash Equivalent), 5 (Loans), 6 (Accruals / Receivables),
-- 7 (Formation Expenses) et 8 (Accrued Expenses) de la feuille Net_Asset_Value
-- (proc_Donnees_Sources + proc_Rapports, PKG_FIRST_NAV_PAGE.pkb). Rejoue
-- proc_Donnees_Sources (CR_BILAN, l.1003-1017, CR_PLAN_CPT, l.1060-1064) car
-- REPADMIN.FNP_DS_BILAN est vide sur INTG (NUIT-JOURNAL.md F01/F26). Verifie
-- cellule par cellule sur 523379/29-06-2026 : 9/9 lignes exactes au centime pour
-- les rubriques 6/7/8 (NUIT-JOURNAL.md F27).
--
-- Granularite : 4 et 5 par sous-rubrique seulement (CR_SUM_BILAN_BAL_POSITIVE/
-- NEGATIVE, pas de boucle par compte dans proc_Rapports pour ces rubriques),
-- 6, 7 et 8 par compte (CR_BILAN_COMPTE, boucle par compte, pas de sous-rubrique).
--
-- DROIT = '20' : plan comptable assume, pas verifie par une requete independante
-- (GET_PLAN_COMPTABLE_FOND non relue). Valide uniquement pour le fonds 523379
-- (comparaison cellule par cellule, F27). Un deuxieme DROIT existe sur INTG (GUID,
-- 112 comptes) : Gap, a revalider avant d'appliquer ce gabarit a un autre fonds.
--
-- UNREALIZED_TOTAL : verifie cellule par cellule contre l'echantillon reel (F27), au
-- centime pres pour 6/7/8 (9/9) et pour la sous-rubrique 4 "Current accounts" (555314.27
-- mesure contre 555314 publie).
--
-- COST_DEBIT/MKT_CREDIT (Gap, pas verifies) : ce gabarit les derive naivement du signe
-- du solde (negatif -> Debit, positif ou nul -> Credit), par compte avant sommation. Pour
-- la sous-rubrique 4 "Current accounts" cela donne Debit=0/Credit=555314.27, alors que
-- l'echantillon reel porte Debit=-133.64/Credit=555448 (le total seul coincide, 555314 vs
-- 555314.27) : le vrai decoupage Debit/Credit n'est donc pas une simple separation par
-- signe du solde cumule, mecanisme exact non identifie (CR_SUM_BILAN_BAL_POSITIVE/NEGATIVE
-- a relire en detail). Pour 6/7/8, chaque compte n'a qu'un seul signe sur l'echantillon
-- mesure, donc la colonne Debit ou Credit vaut 0 par construction, mais seul le total a ete
-- compare cellule par cellule, pas la repartition Debit/Credit elle-meme.
--
-- Colonnes de rubriques 2 (Investments Cost) et 3 (Investments Unrealized) ne sont pas
-- dans ce gabarit : elles dependent de FNP_DS_PTF/CR_PTF (positions titres), non encore
-- traduit (Gap, Lot 1 en cours).
--
-- Marqueur RUBRIQUES_4_8 (double accolades, non ecrites ici pour ne pas etre substituees dans
-- ce commentaire) : sous-ensemble de rubriques demande (fnpapp.params.Params.rubriques),
-- intersecte avec {4,5,6,7,8} par le moteur, par defaut (aucun sous-ensemble demande) vaut
-- "4,5,6,7,8", comportement inchange a l'octet. Filtre applique ici, en amont des deux
-- WHERE RUBRIQUE IN (...) ci-dessous, qui partagent donc deja le meme sous-ensemble.
WITH LOT AS (
    SELECT N_LOT
    FROM {{TBL_AMS_LOT}}
    WHERE C_FUND = {{FUND}}
      AND D_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
),
BILAN AS (
    SELECT P.CATEGORIE AS RUBRIQUE,
           P.SS_CATEGORIE AS SS_RUBRIQUE,
           T.C_N_ACC AS COMPTE,
           P.COMPTE_LIBELLE AS COMPTE_LIBELLE,
           SUM(-T.A_MARKET_VALUE_PTF) AS BALANCE
    FROM {{TBL_AMS_ACC_POS}} T
    JOIN {{TBL_PARAM_PLAN_CPT}} P
      ON P.COMPTE = T.C_N_ACC AND P.DROIT = '20'
    JOIN LOT ON LOT.N_LOT = T.N_LOT
    WHERE T.C_FUND = {{FUND}}
      AND T.Y_VARIATION = 'N'
      AND T.A_MARKET_VALUE_PTF <> 0
      AND P.CATEGORIE IN ({{RUBRIQUES_4_8}})
    GROUP BY P.CATEGORIE, P.SS_CATEGORIE, T.C_N_ACC, P.COMPTE_LIBELLE
)
SELECT RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE, NULL AS COMPTE, NULL AS COMPTE_LIBELLE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN BALANCE < 0 THEN BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS COST_DEBIT,
       SUM(CASE WHEN BALANCE >= 0 THEN BALANCE ELSE 0 END) AS MKT_CREDIT,
       SUM(BALANCE) AS UNREALIZED_TOTAL
FROM BILAN
WHERE RUBRIQUE IN (4, 5)
GROUP BY RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE
UNION ALL
SELECT RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE, COMPTE, COMPTE_LIBELLE,
       CASE WHEN BALANCE < 0 THEN BALANCE ELSE 0 END AS COST_DEBIT,
       CASE WHEN BALANCE >= 0 THEN BALANCE ELSE 0 END AS MKT_CREDIT,
       BALANCE AS UNREALIZED_TOTAL
FROM BILAN
WHERE RUBRIQUE IN (6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE, COMPTE



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\09_nav_rubriques_ptf.sql =====
-- Rubriques 2 (Investments Cost) et 3 (Investments Unrealized) de la feuille
-- Net_Asset_Value (proc_Donnees_Sources, CR_PTF, et proc_Rapports, CASE v_Rubrique
-- WHEN 2 / WHEN 3, PKG_FIRST_NAV_PAGE.pkb). Rejoue CR_PTF (l.1029-1463) car
-- REPADMIN.FNP_DS_PTF n'est fiable sur INTG qu'en volume limite (NUIT-JOURNAL.md F26).
--
-- Mecanisme confirme en direct le 07/10/2026 (invalide F28, qui supposait des comptes
-- catalogue 3 alimentes directement) :
--   - Seuls les comptes CATEGORIE=2 ("Cost X") de FNP_PARAM_PLAN_CPT passent le filtre
--     (C_N_ID IS NOT NULL OR C_SRV='FX') de CR_PTF, les comptes CATEGORIE=3 ("Unrealized
--     X", ex. 14110/14111/14122/14123 sur 523379) existent dans DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL mais
--     ont systematiquement C_N_ID NULL et C_SRV != 'FX', donc ne sont jamais lus par ce
--     curseur ni inseres dans FNP_DS_PTF avec RUBRIQUE=3 (verifie en direct : 0 ligne avec
--     C_N_ID NOT NULL ni C_SRV='FX' pour ces 4 comptes sur 523379/29-06-2026).
--   - La rubrique 3 n'est donc jamais materialisee comme un groupe de comptes distinct :
--     proc_Rapports (CASE v_Rubrique WHEN 3, l.2852-2878) la calcule en relisant le MEME
--     groupe de lignes que la rubrique 2 ("Cost X" correspondante, trouvee via
--     FNP_PARAM_RUB.LIEN_PTF, l.2819-2830), mais en prenant SEC_PNL_EXCH/SEC_PNL_MKT/
--     SEC_PNL_TOTAL au lieu de SEC_COST_VALUE_PTF/SEC_MKT_VALUE_PTF/SEC_PNL_TOTAL. Sauf le
--     cas SOURCE=2 ("Unrealized Forward contracts", RUBRIQUE_NUM=14, LIEN_PTF=1) qui est
--     sourcee par le bilan (CR_SUM_BILAN), pas par le portefeuille : non reproduit ici,
--     car cette ligne n'a pas de correspondance LIEN_PTF>=2 et n'apparait donc jamais dans
--     la jointure PAR_COST ci-dessous (comportement voulu, pas un oubli).
--
-- Le libelle de sous-categorie (Cost Equities, Unrealized Bonds, etc.) vient de
-- FNP_PARAM_RUB (NIVEAU=3, LIEN_RUBRIQUE=2 ou 3, RUBRIQUE_NUM=SS_CATEGORIE), pas du
-- type de titre (SEC_GTI/GET_CODE_GTI_GAIN, piste exploree et abandonnee le 07/10/2026,
-- NUIT-JOURNAL.md F28/F30).
--
-- DROIT = '20' : meme hypothese que sql\08_nav_rubriques.sql, non revalidee hors
-- 523379 (Gap).
--
-- Recalcul de PNL par service (C_SRV), identique a CR_PTF (l.1328-1396) :
--   FU (futures)  : PNL remis a zero puis recalcule via des taux de change cost/mkt
--                   reconstruits (A_COST_VALUE_PTF/A_COST_VALUATED_PTF et
--                   A_MARKET_VALUE_PTF/A_COST_VALUE), et A_COST_VALUE/A_COST_VALUE_PTF
--                   mis a zero (les futures n'ont pas de cout de revient publie).
--   OP (options)  : meme principe mais taux de change mkt reconstruit via
--                   A_MARKET_VALUE_PTF/A_MARKET_VALUE (pas via A_COST_VALUE), et le
--                   cout de revient n'est pas remis a zero.
--   Autre service : compte 14060 seulement, A_PAYED_OFF est soustrait de la valeur de
--                   marche et du PNL marche (cas documente dans le code source sans
--                   commentaire explicatif de la raison).
--
-- Marqueur RUBRIQUES_2_3 (double accolades, non ecrites ici pour ne pas etre substituees dans
-- ce commentaire) : sous-ensemble de rubriques demande (fnpapp.params.Params.rubriques),
-- intersecte avec {2,3} par le moteur, par defaut (aucun sous-ensemble demande) vaut "2,3",
-- comportement inchange a l'octet. Filtre applique en dernier (ALL_RUB), apres RUB2/RUB3 :
-- demander seulement la rubrique 3 ne change donc rien au calcul de RUB2 (meme groupe de
-- lignes, LIEN_PTF), seulement a ce qui est rendu.
--
-- Non repris ici (Gap, portee a part, ne touche pas aux montants de cette requete) :
-- CR_PTF_ADJ (l.1044-1058, DWH_AMS_CASH_MVT, ajustements de tresorerie, SEC_Y_N=2) :
-- l'agregation finale (CR_PTF(p_Rubrique,p_Ss_Rubrique), l.2615-2624) filtre SEC_Y_N=1,
-- donc exclut deja ces ajustements des rubriques 2/3, CR_PTF_ADJ sert ailleurs (a
-- confirmer, hypothese : rubriques 4/5, F27).
WITH BASE AS (
    SELECT T.C_N_ACC AS COMPTE,
           T.C_SRV AS SERVICE,
           NVL(T.A_COST_VALUATED_PTF, 0) AS COST_VALUATED_PTF,
           NVL(T.A_COST_VALUE, 0) AS COST_VALUE,
           NVL(T.A_COST_VALUE_PTF, 0) AS COST_VALUE_PTF,
           NVL(T.A_MARKET_VALUE, 0) AS MARKET_VALUE,
           NVL(T.A_MARKET_VALUE_PTF, 0) AS MARKET_VALUE_PTF,
           NVL(T.A_PNL_MARKET, 0) AS PNL_MKT,
           NVL(T.A_PNL_EXCHANGE, 0) AS PNL_EXCH,
           NVL(T.A_PAYED_OFF, 0) AS PAYED_OFF
    FROM {{TBL_AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL}} T
    WHERE T.C_FUND = {{FUND}}
      AND T.D_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
      AND (T.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL OR T.C_SRV = 'FX')
      AND T.C_N_ACC IN (SELECT DISTINCT N.COMPTE
                         FROM {{TBL_PARAM_PLAN_CPT}} N
                         WHERE N.CATEGORIE = 2 AND N.DROIT = '20')
),
RATES AS (
    SELECT COMPTE, SERVICE, COST_VALUATED_PTF, COST_VALUE, COST_VALUE_PTF, MARKET_VALUE,
           MARKET_VALUE_PTF, PNL_MKT, PNL_EXCH, PAYED_OFF,
           CASE WHEN SERVICE = 'FU' AND COST_VALUATED_PTF <> 0 THEN COST_VALUE_PTF / COST_VALUATED_PTF
                WHEN SERVICE = 'OP' AND COST_VALUATED_PTF <> 0 THEN COST_VALUE_PTF / COST_VALUATED_PTF
                ELSE 0 END AS EXCH_RATE_COST,
           CASE WHEN SERVICE = 'FU' AND COST_VALUE <> 0 THEN MARKET_VALUE_PTF / COST_VALUE
                WHEN SERVICE = 'OP' AND MARKET_VALUE <> 0 THEN MARKET_VALUE_PTF / MARKET_VALUE
                ELSE 0 END AS EXCH_RATE_MKT
    FROM BASE
),
ADJ AS (
    SELECT COMPTE,
           CASE WHEN SERVICE IN ('FU', 'OP') THEN 0 ELSE COST_VALUE END AS A_COST_VALUE,
           CASE WHEN SERVICE = 'FU' THEN 0 ELSE COST_VALUE_PTF END AS A_COST_VALUE_PTF,
           CASE WHEN SERVICE = 'FU' THEN ROUND((MARKET_VALUE - COST_VALUATED_PTF) * EXCH_RATE_COST, 2)
                WHEN SERVICE = 'OP' THEN ROUND((MARKET_VALUE - COST_VALUATED_PTF) * EXCH_RATE_MKT, 2)
                WHEN COMPTE = 14060 THEN PNL_MKT - PAYED_OFF
                ELSE PNL_MKT END AS A_PNL_MKT,
           CASE WHEN SERVICE IN ('FU', 'OP') THEN ROUND(COST_VALUE * (EXCH_RATE_MKT - EXCH_RATE_COST), 2)
                ELSE PNL_EXCH END AS A_PNL_EXCH,
           CASE WHEN SERVICE = 'FU' THEN
                    ROUND((MARKET_VALUE - COST_VALUATED_PTF) * EXCH_RATE_COST, 2)
                    + ROUND(COST_VALUE * (EXCH_RATE_MKT - EXCH_RATE_COST), 2)
                WHEN SERVICE = 'OP' THEN
                    ROUND((MARKET_VALUE - COST_VALUATED_PTF) * EXCH_RATE_MKT, 2)
                    + ROUND(COST_VALUE * (EXCH_RATE_MKT - EXCH_RATE_COST), 2)
                WHEN COMPTE = 14060 THEN (PNL_MKT - PAYED_OFF) + PNL_EXCH
                ELSE PNL_MKT + PNL_EXCH END AS A_PNL_TOTAL,
           CASE WHEN SERVICE = 'FU' THEN 0 ELSE MARKET_VALUE_PTF END AS A_MARKET_VALUE_PTF_RAW,
           CASE WHEN COMPTE = 14060 AND SERVICE NOT IN ('FU', 'OP') THEN MARKET_VALUE_PTF - PAYED_OFF
                ELSE CASE WHEN SERVICE = 'FU' THEN 0 ELSE MARKET_VALUE_PTF END END AS A_MARKET_VALUE_PTF
    FROM RATES
),
PAR_COST AS (
    SELECT P.SS_CATEGORIE AS COST_NUM,
           SUM(A.A_COST_VALUE_PTF) AS COST_VALUE_PTF, SUM(A.A_MARKET_VALUE_PTF) AS MARKET_VALUE_PTF,
           SUM(A.A_PNL_MKT) AS PNL_MKT, SUM(A.A_PNL_EXCH) AS PNL_EXCH, SUM(A.A_PNL_TOTAL) AS PNL_TOTAL
    FROM ADJ A
    JOIN {{TBL_PARAM_PLAN_CPT}} P ON P.COMPTE = A.COMPTE AND P.DROIT = '20'
    GROUP BY P.SS_CATEGORIE
),
-- Rubrique 2 "Cost X" : une ligne par sous-categorie de cout, telle que lue.
RUB2 AS (
    SELECT 2 AS RUBRIQUE, PC.COST_NUM AS SS_RUBRIQUE, RC.RUBRIQUE_NOM AS SS_RUBRIQUE_NOM,
           PC.COST_VALUE_PTF AS COST_DEBIT, PC.MARKET_VALUE_PTF AS MKT_CREDIT, PC.PNL_TOTAL AS UNREALIZED_TOTAL
    FROM PAR_COST PC
    JOIN {{TBL_PARAM_RUB}} RC ON RC.NIVEAU = 3 AND RC.LIEN_RUBRIQUE = 2 AND RC.RUBRIQUE_NUM = PC.COST_NUM
),
-- Rubrique 3 "Unrealized X" correspondante : meme groupe de lignes que la rubrique 2
-- liee (FNP_PARAM_RUB.LIEN_PTF), colonnes PNL au lieu des colonnes de cout/marche
-- (proc_Rapports, CASE v_Rubrique WHEN 3, l.2852-2878). RUBRIQUE_NUM=14 ("Unrealized
-- Forward contracts", SOURCE=2) n'a pas de LIEN_PTF>=2 et n'apparait donc jamais ici :
-- voir le Gap documente en tete de ce fichier.
RUB3 AS (
    SELECT 3 AS RUBRIQUE, RU.RUBRIQUE_NUM AS SS_RUBRIQUE, RU.RUBRIQUE_NOM AS SS_RUBRIQUE_NOM,
           PC.PNL_EXCH AS COST_DEBIT, PC.PNL_MKT AS MKT_CREDIT, PC.PNL_TOTAL AS UNREALIZED_TOTAL
    FROM {{TBL_PARAM_RUB}} RU
    JOIN PAR_COST PC ON PC.COST_NUM = RU.LIEN_PTF
    WHERE RU.NIVEAU = 3 AND RU.LIEN_RUBRIQUE = 3 AND RU.SOURCE <> 2
),
ALL_RUB AS (
    SELECT RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE_NOM, COST_DEBIT, MKT_CREDIT, UNREALIZED_TOTAL FROM RUB2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE_NOM, COST_DEBIT, MKT_CREDIT, UNREALIZED_TOTAL FROM RUB3
)
SELECT RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE_NOM, COST_DEBIT, MKT_CREDIT, UNREALIZED_TOTAL
FROM ALL_RUB
WHERE RUBRIQUE IN ({{RUBRIQUES_2_3}})
ORDER BY RUBRIQUE, SS_RUBRIQUE



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\10_nav_perf_previous.sql =====
-- Feuille Performance du rapport nav, type de perf 1 seulement (Previous Nav %), les 4 autres
-- types (MTD/QTD/YTD/Closing) restent en Gap (voir NUIT-JOURNAL.md, Lot 2).
-- Traduit PROC_PERF_SHARECLASS (REPADMIN, lignes 108-254) tel qu'il est reellement appele par
-- proc_Donnees_Sources (PKG_FIRST_NAV_PAGE.pkb l.1634) : p_In_Type_Date=2 (Date Pub),
-- p_In_Type_Perf=1 (Previous Nav %), p_In_Type_Nav=3 (controlee et publiee), PAS les parametres
-- 1/1/1 qu'on pourrait deviner du commentaire d'en-tete de la procedure.
-- Chaine : v_Date_Pub_To = NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION de la nav courante (GET_DATE_PUB_WITH_DATE_NAV)
-- -> v_Date_From = v_Date_Pub_To - 1 -> v_Date_Pub_From = derniere NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION <=
-- v_Date_From avec NAV_CONTROLE='Y' et NAV_PUB='A' (GET_NAV_DATE_PUB_PUBLIEE) -> v_Date_Nav_From =
-- NAV_DATE_NAV de cette publication (GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_DATE_PUB). Prix aux deux dates via
-- GET_PRICE_FA_PART_CCY (meme repli multi-devises que sql\06_nav_price.sql).
-- Branche eFront (GET_IS_EFRONT_SUBFUND) non traduite : Gap, comme pour 06_nav_price.sql.
-- Cas r_nav_ini (fonds sans nav precedente controlee et publiee, PROC_PERF_SHARECLASS l.151-172)
-- non traduit : si DATE_PUB_FROM est NULL, PRICE_FROM et PERF restent NULL (Gap, fonds trop recent
-- ou jamais controle/publie, pas rencontre sur l'echantillon 523379).
-- NULLIF sur le denominateur (trouve le 08/10/2026 sur 280299/2026-09-18, CTLQ) : sans lui, une
-- part dont le prix precedent est NULL ou nul fait planter la requete (Gandiva, "divide by zero
-- error") avant meme que le CASE qui devrait la neutraliser s'applique. NULLIF rend le resultat
-- NULL comme prevu plutot que de faire echouer toute la requete, sans changer le resultat des
-- parts a denominateur non nul (523379/29-06-2026 inchange).
WITH PTF_SHARE AS (
    SELECT C_FUND, C_SHARE, C_N_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT C_FUND, C_SHARE, C_N_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, C_SHARE ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_PTF_SHARE}}
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),
ISIN AS (
    SELECT C_N_ID, SUBSTR(G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS CODE_ISIN
    FROM (
        SELECT C_N_ID, G_ID_VALUE,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_N_ID ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_SEC_INTL_ID}}
        WHERE C_ID_TYP = '11' AND C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),
SEC_CCY AS (
    SELECT C_N_ID, C_SEC_CCY AS PART_CCY
    FROM (
        SELECT C_N_ID, C_SEC_CCY,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_N_ID ORDER BY C_SEC_CCY) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_SEC_MASTER}}
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),
PUB_TO AS (
    SELECT MAX(N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION) AS DATE_PUB_TO
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}} AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
),
PUB_FROM AS (
    SELECT MAX(N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION) AS DATE_PUB_FROM
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N, PUB_TO
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
      AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION <= PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO - INTERVAL '1' DAY
      AND N.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y' AND N.NAV_PUB = 'A'
),
NAV_FROM AS (
    SELECT MIN(N.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS DATE_NAV_FROM
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N, PUB_FROM
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
      AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION = PUB_FROM.DATE_PUB_FROM
)
SELECT S.C_FUND AS FUND_NUMBER,
       S.C_SHARE AS PART,
       S.C_N_ID AS CODE_INTERNE_FA,
       ISIN.CODE_ISIN,
       NAV_FROM.DATE_NAV_FROM,
       {{DATE_NAV}} AS DATE_NAV_TO,
       CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_FROM.NAP_PRICE_PART
            ELSE COALESCE(MC_FROM.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_FROM.NAP_PRICE_PART) END AS PREVIOUS_PRICE,
       CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART
            ELSE COALESCE(MC_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART) END AS PRICE,
       ROUND(
           (CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART
                 ELSE COALESCE(MC_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART) END)
           /
           NULLIF(
               (CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_FROM.NAP_PRICE_PART
                     ELSE COALESCE(MC_FROM.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_FROM.NAP_PRICE_PART) END),
               0)
           - 1, 10) AS PREVIOUS_PERF
FROM PTF_SHARE S
CROSS JOIN NAV_FROM
LEFT JOIN ISIN ON ISIN.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID
LEFT JOIN SEC_CCY ON SEC_CCY.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_FND_MAIN}} TF ON TF.INTERNAL_FA_CODE = S.C_N_ID
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS}} T_TO
  ON T_TO.NAP_FUND_NO = S.C_FUND AND T_TO.NAP_TPARTS = S.C_SHARE AND T_TO.NAP_DATE_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY}} MC_TO
  ON MC_TO.NAP_FUND_NO = T_TO.NAP_FUND_NO AND MC_TO.NAP_TPARTS = T_TO.NAP_TPARTS
 AND MC_TO.NAP_DATE_NAV = T_TO.NAP_DATE_NAV AND MC_TO.NAP_TYP_TRT = T_TO.NAP_TYP_TRT
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS}} T_FROM
  ON T_FROM.NAP_FUND_NO = S.C_FUND AND T_FROM.NAP_TPARTS = S.C_SHARE
 AND T_FROM.NAP_DATE_NAV = NAV_FROM.DATE_NAV_FROM
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY}} MC_FROM
  ON MC_FROM.NAP_FUND_NO = T_FROM.NAP_FUND_NO AND MC_FROM.NAP_TPARTS = T_FROM.NAP_TPARTS
 AND MC_FROM.NAP_DATE_NAV = T_FROM.NAP_DATE_NAV AND MC_FROM.NAP_TYP_TRT = T_FROM.NAP_TYP_TRT
WHERE S.C_FUND = {{FUND}}



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\11_nav_perf_mtd_qtd_ytd.sql =====
-- Feuille Performance du rapport nav, types de perf 2/3/4 (Month to Date, Quarter to Date,
-- Year to Date). Type 1 (Previous Nav %) : sql\10_nav_perf_previous.sql. Type 5 (Closing) :
-- Gap (voir en-tete, section finale).
-- Meme procedure PROC_PERF_SHARECLASS (REPADMIN, l.108-172, branche p_In_Type_Date=2 reelement
-- appelee), meme chaine de resolution que le type 1 (GET_NAV_DATE_PUB_PUBLIEE puis
-- GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_DATE_PUB puis GET_PRICE_FA_PART_CCY) : seul le calcul initial de v_Date_From
-- change (l.111-131) :
--   Type 2 (Month to Date)   : v_Date_From = GET_DATE_END_MONTH(v_Date_Pub_To, -1)
--                               = fin du mois civil precedent
--   Type 3 (Quarter to Date) : v_Date_From = GET_DATE_END_QUARTER(v_Date_Pub_To, -1)
--                               = fin du trimestre civil precedent
--   Type 4 (Year to Date)    : v_Date_From = 31 decembre de l'annee civile precedente
-- GET_DATE_END_MONTH (REPADMIN, 71 lignes) decale d'un mois (ADD_MONTHS) puis mappe le mois
-- obtenu sur sa propre fin de mois : equivalent a LAST_DAY(date - INTERVAL '1' MONTH), confirme
-- en direct sur Dremio (NUIT-JOURNAL.md F34, 2026-05-29 -> 2026-05-31).
-- GET_DATE_END_QUARTER (REPADMIN, 71 lignes) decale de 3 mois puis mappe le mois obtenu sur la
-- fin de SON trimestre, pas sur la fin de ce seul mois : NE PAS traduire par
-- LAST_DAY(date - INTERVAL '3' MONTH) (faux pour les mois qui ne sont pas en fin de trimestre,
-- par exemple mai - 3 mois = fevrier, LAST_DAY donnerait fin fevrier au lieu de fin mars/Q1).
-- Traduit ici par un CASE direct sur le trimestre de la date de depart (equivalent demontre :
-- ADD_MONTHS(-3) retombe toujours dans le trimestre precedent, donc mapper ce mois sur son
-- propre trimestre revient a prendre le trimestre precedent de la date de depart).
-- Branche eFront et cas r_nav_ini non traduits (meme Gap que sql\10_nav_perf_previous.sql).
-- NULLIF sur les trois denominateurs (meme trouvaille et meme raison que
-- sql\10_nav_perf_previous.sql, 08/10/2026 sur 280299/2026-09-18, CTLQ).
WITH PTF_SHARE AS (
    SELECT C_FUND, C_SHARE, C_N_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT C_FUND, C_SHARE, C_N_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, C_SHARE ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_PTF_SHARE}}
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),
ISIN AS (
    SELECT C_N_ID, SUBSTR(G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS CODE_ISIN
    FROM (
        SELECT C_N_ID, G_ID_VALUE,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_N_ID ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_SEC_INTL_ID}}
        WHERE C_ID_TYP = '11' AND C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),
SEC_CCY AS (
    SELECT C_N_ID, C_SEC_CCY AS PART_CCY
    FROM (
        SELECT C_N_ID, C_SEC_CCY,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_N_ID ORDER BY C_SEC_CCY) AS RN
        FROM {{TBL_AMS_SEC_MASTER}}
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),
PUB_TO AS (
    SELECT MAX(N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION) AS DATE_PUB_TO
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}} AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
),
DATES AS (
    SELECT
        LAST_DAY(PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO - INTERVAL '1' MONTH) AS DATE_FROM_MTD,
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO) IN (1, 2, 3)
                THEN TO_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO) - 1 AS VARCHAR) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD')
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO) IN (4, 5, 6)
                THEN TO_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO) AS VARCHAR) || '0331', 'YYYYMMDD')
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO) IN (7, 8, 9)
                THEN TO_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO) AS VARCHAR) || '0630', 'YYYYMMDD')
            ELSE TO_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO) AS VARCHAR) || '0930', 'YYYYMMDD')
        END AS DATE_FROM_QTD,
        TO_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM PUB_TO.DATE_PUB_TO) - 1 AS VARCHAR) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') AS DATE_FROM_YTD
    FROM PUB_TO
),
PUB_FROM_MTD AS (
    SELECT MAX(N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION) AS DATE_PUB_FROM
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N, DATES
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
      AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION <= DATES.DATE_FROM_MTD
      AND N.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y' AND N.NAV_PUB = 'A'
),
PUB_FROM_QTD AS (
    SELECT MAX(N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION) AS DATE_PUB_FROM
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N, DATES
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
      AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION <= DATES.DATE_FROM_QTD
      AND N.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y' AND N.NAV_PUB = 'A'
),
PUB_FROM_YTD AS (
    SELECT MAX(N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION) AS DATE_PUB_FROM
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N, DATES
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
      AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION <= DATES.DATE_FROM_YTD
      AND N.NAV_CONTROLE = 'Y' AND N.NAV_PUB = 'A'
),
NAV_FROM_MTD AS (
    SELECT MIN(N.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS DATE_NAV_FROM
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N, PUB_FROM_MTD
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}} AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION = PUB_FROM_MTD.DATE_PUB_FROM
),
NAV_FROM_QTD AS (
    SELECT MIN(N.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS DATE_NAV_FROM
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N, PUB_FROM_QTD
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}} AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION = PUB_FROM_QTD.DATE_PUB_FROM
),
NAV_FROM_YTD AS (
    SELECT MIN(N.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS DATE_NAV_FROM
    FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N, PUB_FROM_YTD
    WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}} AND N.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION = PUB_FROM_YTD.DATE_PUB_FROM
)
SELECT S.C_FUND AS FUND_NUMBER,
       S.C_SHARE AS PART,
       S.C_N_ID AS CODE_INTERNE_FA,
       ISIN.CODE_ISIN,
       CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART
            ELSE COALESCE(MC_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART) END AS PRICE,
       NAV_FROM_MTD.DATE_NAV_FROM AS DATE_NAV_MTD_FROM,
       CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_MTD.NAP_PRICE_PART
            ELSE COALESCE(MC_MTD.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_MTD.NAP_PRICE_PART) END AS MTD_PRICE_FROM,
       ROUND(
           (CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART
                 ELSE COALESCE(MC_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART) END)
           /
           NULLIF(
               (CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_MTD.NAP_PRICE_PART
                     ELSE COALESCE(MC_MTD.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_MTD.NAP_PRICE_PART) END),
               0)
           - 1, 10) AS MTD_PERF,
       NAV_FROM_QTD.DATE_NAV_FROM AS DATE_NAV_QTD_FROM,
       CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_QTD.NAP_PRICE_PART
            ELSE COALESCE(MC_QTD.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_QTD.NAP_PRICE_PART) END AS QTD_PRICE_FROM,
       ROUND(
           (CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART
                 ELSE COALESCE(MC_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART) END)
           /
           NULLIF(
               (CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_QTD.NAP_PRICE_PART
                     ELSE COALESCE(MC_QTD.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_QTD.NAP_PRICE_PART) END),
               0)
           - 1, 10) AS QTD_PERF,
       NAV_FROM_YTD.DATE_NAV_FROM AS DATE_NAV_YTD_FROM,
       CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_YTD.NAP_PRICE_PART
            ELSE COALESCE(MC_YTD.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_YTD.NAP_PRICE_PART) END AS YTD_PRICE_FROM,
       ROUND(
           (CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART
                 ELSE COALESCE(MC_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_TO.NAP_PRICE_PART) END)
           /
           NULLIF(
               (CASE WHEN SEC_CCY.PART_CCY = TF.FUND_CCY THEN T_YTD.NAP_PRICE_PART
                     ELSE COALESCE(MC_YTD.NAP_PRICE_PART, T_YTD.NAP_PRICE_PART) END),
               0)
           - 1, 10) AS YTD_PERF
FROM PTF_SHARE S
CROSS JOIN NAV_FROM_MTD
CROSS JOIN NAV_FROM_QTD
CROSS JOIN NAV_FROM_YTD
LEFT JOIN ISIN ON ISIN.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID
LEFT JOIN SEC_CCY ON SEC_CCY.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_FND_MAIN}} TF ON TF.INTERNAL_FA_CODE = S.C_N_ID
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS}} T_TO
  ON T_TO.NAP_FUND_NO = S.C_FUND AND T_TO.NAP_TPARTS = S.C_SHARE AND T_TO.NAP_DATE_NAV = {{DATE_NAV}}
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY}} MC_TO
  ON MC_TO.NAP_FUND_NO = T_TO.NAP_FUND_NO AND MC_TO.NAP_TPARTS = T_TO.NAP_TPARTS
 AND MC_TO.NAP_DATE_NAV = T_TO.NAP_DATE_NAV AND MC_TO.NAP_TYP_TRT = T_TO.NAP_TYP_TRT
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS}} T_MTD
  ON T_MTD.NAP_FUND_NO = S.C_FUND AND T_MTD.NAP_TPARTS = S.C_SHARE
 AND T_MTD.NAP_DATE_NAV = NAV_FROM_MTD.DATE_NAV_FROM
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY}} MC_MTD
  ON MC_MTD.NAP_FUND_NO = T_MTD.NAP_FUND_NO AND MC_MTD.NAP_TPARTS = T_MTD.NAP_TPARTS
 AND MC_MTD.NAP_DATE_NAV = T_MTD.NAP_DATE_NAV AND MC_MTD.NAP_TYP_TRT = T_MTD.NAP_TYP_TRT
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS}} T_QTD
  ON T_QTD.NAP_FUND_NO = S.C_FUND AND T_QTD.NAP_TPARTS = S.C_SHARE
 AND T_QTD.NAP_DATE_NAV = NAV_FROM_QTD.DATE_NAV_FROM
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY}} MC_QTD
  ON MC_QTD.NAP_FUND_NO = T_QTD.NAP_FUND_NO AND MC_QTD.NAP_TPARTS = T_QTD.NAP_TPARTS
 AND MC_QTD.NAP_DATE_NAV = T_QTD.NAP_DATE_NAV AND MC_QTD.NAP_TYP_TRT = T_QTD.NAP_TYP_TRT
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS}} T_YTD
  ON T_YTD.NAP_FUND_NO = S.C_FUND AND T_YTD.NAP_TPARTS = S.C_SHARE
 AND T_YTD.NAP_DATE_NAV = NAV_FROM_YTD.DATE_NAV_FROM
LEFT JOIN {{TBL_NAV_PARTS_MULTI_CCY}} MC_YTD
  ON MC_YTD.NAP_FUND_NO = T_YTD.NAP_FUND_NO AND MC_YTD.NAP_TPARTS = T_YTD.NAP_TPARTS
 AND MC_YTD.NAP_DATE_NAV = T_YTD.NAP_DATE_NAV AND MC_YTD.NAP_TYP_TRT = T_YTD.NAP_TYP_TRT
WHERE S.C_FUND = {{FUND}}

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\13_date_calcul_lookup.sql =====
-- FPN-004/005 : resolution amont de la NAV Calculation Date vers la vraie NAV Date (NAV_DATE_NAV).
-- Meme source et meme regle de dernier lot que 03_nav_header.sql (DATE_CALCUL = COALESCE(D_H_PROCESS,
-- NAV_DATE_TRT)), mais sans connaitre encore la date NAV : le dernier lot est choisi par couple
-- (C_FUND, D_NAV) via ROW_NUMBER() au lieu du LIMIT 1 d'une sous-requete deja filtree sur une seule date.
SELECT N.NAV_FUND_NO, N.NAV_DATE_NAV
FROM {{TBL_NAV}} N
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT C_FUND, D_NAV, N_LOT, D_H_PROCESS,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C_FUND, D_NAV ORDER BY N_LOT DESC) AS RN
    FROM {{TBL_AMS_LOT}}
    WHERE C_FUND = {{FUND}}
) L ON L.C_FUND = N.NAV_FUND_NO AND L.D_NAV = N.NAV_DATE_NAV AND L.RN = 1
WHERE N.NAV_FUND_NO = {{FUND}}
  AND COALESCE(CAST(L.D_H_PROCESS AS DATE), CAST(N.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE)) = {{DATE_CALCUL}}
ORDER BY N.NAV_DATE_NAV DESC

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\sql\views\00_fiche_fonds.sql =====
-- Forme de vue Dremio candidate (cahier v2, Â§122 et Lot 8 point 7) pour 00_fiche_fonds.sql.
-- "Forme", pas une vue : ce fichier n'est jamais joue comme CREATE VIEW. L'acces Dremio de ce
-- projet est volontairement lecture seule, un seul SELECT/WITH a la fois (DEC-032,
-- _private\kb\registry\live-status.md) ; la passerelle (fnpapp.dremio.Gateway) ne sait de toute
-- facon pas emettre de DDL. Si une vue reelle devait un jour etre creee (hors de ce projet, par
-- qui en a le droit sur Dremio), ce serait avec ce corps-ci.
--
-- Interet mesure (voir docs\VIEWS.md) : aujourd'hui, chaque appel a 00_fiche_fonds.sql fait
-- replanifier a Dremio exactement le meme JOIN+ROW_NUMBER pour chaque fonds et chaque execution
-- (rendu par sqlrender.render_step avec FUND en litteral). Une vue reelle figerait ce plan une
-- fois ; chaque appel deviendrait un filtre simple sur colonnes indexees (FA_NUM) au lieu d'une
-- sous-requete complete. Candidat choisi : 00_fiche_fonds parce qu'il est appele par les trois
-- sorties (nav, multiccy, bcr) et par le refus eFront du Lot 8 point 5 (docs\EFRONT.md), donc
-- le plus reutilise de tous les gabarits.
SELECT FA_NUM, FA_POOL_NUM, POOL_NAME, EFRONT, EFRONT_DATE, FUND_NAME, FUND_CCY
FROM (
    SELECT FA_NUM, FA_POOL_NUM, POOL_NAME, EFRONT, EFRONT_DATE, FUND_NAME, FUND_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FA_NUM ORDER BY INTERNAL_FA_CODE) AS RN
    FROM {{TBL_FND_MAIN}}
) X
WHERE RN = 1
-- Le filtre WHERE FA_NUM = {{FUND}} du gabarit d'origine disparait : avec une vraie vue,
-- l'appelant ferait SELECT * FROM <vue> WHERE FA_NUM = 'xxxxx' (filtre applique par Dremio sur
-- le resultat de la vue, pas reinjecte dans son corps).

"""Lot 7 (cahier v2, S1 "Usage" / S7 formel) : tools/compare_corpus_ctlq.py, rapprochement
croise intg (recalcul) / ctlq (sortie stockee de l'echantillon fige corpus_reference.json).

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\tests\integration\test_config_sources.py =====
"""Teste chaque table nommee dans config/defaults.json contre le catalogue Dremio
reel, sur les deux serveurs (cahier v2, E6). Sans session valide sur un serveur,
les tests de ce serveur se sautent avec leur raison : ils ne doivent jamais
echouer pour une cause d'environnement (cahier v2, section 7).

Le piege documente (CHAINAGE-DONNEES.md section 3) : MFGA.DWH.AMS_NAV_ARC_SDNAR02
et MFGA.DWH.AMS_LOT sont des homonymes presque vides du bon schema
MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH. Ce test verifie que la table configuree a bien plus de
lignes que son homonyme, pour que l'erreur ne se reproduise pas en silence.
"""
import json
import unittest

from fnpapp import dremio, paths

HOMONYMS = {
    "MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_NAV_ARC_SDNAR02": "MFGA.DWH.AMS_NAV_ARC_SDNAR02",
    "MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT": "MFGA.DWH.AMS_LOT",
}

# F25 (NUIT-JOURNAL.md) : BUSINESS.FUND_ACCOUNTING.MFGA_DWH_AMS_PTF_SHARE n'existe que sur
# INTG. Mesure le 07/10/2026 : job Dremio en erreur sur CTLQ ("Object ... not found"), alors
# que la meme table repond sur INTG (13 687 lignes, voir defaults.json). Pas une anomalie a
# corriger, un fait d'environnement : les tables sources.fa curees ne sont pas toutes
# repliquees sur CTLQ, contrairement aux tables sources.fnp/bcr (sorties LUXIS).
NOT_ON_CTLQ = {"BUSINESS.FUND_ACCOUNTING.MFGA_DWH_AMS_PTF_SHARE"}


def table_names():
    cfg = paths.load_config()
    names = set()
    for section in ("fa", "fnp", "bcr"):
        tables = cfg.get("sources", {}).get(section, {})
        for key, value in tables.items():
            if key.startswith("_"):
                continue
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.count(".") == 2:
                names.add(value)
    return sorted(names)


def gateway_for(serveur):
    cfg = paths.load_config()
    cfg = paths.with_server(cfg, serveur)
    gw = dremio.Gateway(cfg)
    try:
        if not gw.probe():
            return None
    except Exception:
        return None
    return gw


def row_count(gw, table, out_dir):
    sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM {table}"
    _, _, rows, _ = gw.query("test_config_sources", sql, out_dir, max_rows=1, timeout=60)
    if not rows:
        return 0
    return int(rows[0]["n"])


class ConfigSourcesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.out_dir = paths.APP_DIR / "out" / "test_config_sources"
        self.out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.tables = table_names()

    def test_tables_declared(self):
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(self.tables), 10, self.tables)

    def test_each_table_exists_on_ctlq(self):
        gw = gateway_for("ctlq")
        if gw is None:
            self.skipTest("pas de session Dremio valide sur CTLQ")
        failures = []
        for table in self.tables:
            if table in NOT_ON_CTLQ:
                continue
            try:
                row_count(gw, table, self.out_dir)
            except Exception as exc:
                failures.append(f"{table}: {exc}")
        self.assertEqual(failures, [], failures[:10])

    def test_each_table_exists_on_intg(self):
        gw = gateway_for("intg")
        if gw is None:
            self.skipTest("pas de session Dremio valide sur INTG")
        failures = []
        for table in self.tables:
            try:
                row_count(gw, table, self.out_dir)
            except Exception as exc:
                failures.append(f"{table}: {exc}")
        self.assertEqual(failures, [], failures[:10])

    def test_no_homonym_schema_trap(self):
        gw = gateway_for("intg")
        if gw is None:
            self.skipTest("pas de session Dremio valide sur INTG")
        for correct, wrong in HOMONYMS.items():
            self.assertIn(correct, self.tables, f"{correct} absent de defaults.json")
            n_correct = row_count(gw, correct, self.out_dir)
            try:
                n_wrong = row_count(gw, wrong, self.out_dir)
            except Exception:
                continue
            self.assertGreater(
                n_correct, n_wrong,
                f"piege d'homonyme : {correct} ({n_correct} lignes) ne depasse pas "
                f"{wrong} ({n_wrong} lignes)",
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\tests\unit\test_batch.py =====
"""Lot 8 point 3 (cahier v2) : batch --all-funds, fnpapp.batch.run_batch. Sans Dremio : la
liste des fonds (engine.list_funds_for_date) et l'execution par fonds (service.run_fields)
sont substituees par des bouchons. Seules la reprise, le decoupage par morceaux et le
recapitulatif sont testes ici."""
import datetime as dt
import json
import shutil
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from fnpapp import batch
from fnpapp.engine import FnpError
from fnpapp.paths import APP_DIR

OUT_REL = "out/_test_batch"
OUT_ABS = APP_DIR / OUT_REL
DATE_NAV = dt.date(2026, 6, 29)
FONDS = ["111111", "222222", "333333"]


class TestBatch(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        if OUT_ABS.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(OUT_ABS)
        self.liste_patch = patch("fnpapp.batch.engine.list_funds_for_date", return_value=list(FONDS))
        self.liste_patch.start()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.liste_patch.stop()
        if OUT_ABS.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(OUT_ABS)

    def _etat(self):
        return json.loads((OUT_ABS / batch.STATE_NAME).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def test_tous_les_fonds_sans_limite(self):
        with patch("fnpapp.batch.service.run_fields", return_value=None) as rf:
            res = batch.run_batch(DATE_NAV, OUT_REL)
        self.assertEqual(res.total, 3)
        self.assertEqual(res.traites, 3)
        self.assertEqual(res.ok, 3)
        self.assertEqual(res.erreur, 0)
        self.assertEqual(res.restants, 0)
        self.assertEqual(rf.call_count, 3)
        self.assertEqual(len(self._etat()), 3)

    def test_reprise_par_morceaux(self):
        with patch("fnpapp.batch.service.run_fields", return_value=None):
            premier = batch.run_batch(DATE_NAV, OUT_REL, limit=1)
        self.assertEqual(premier.traites, 1)
        self.assertEqual(premier.deja_fait, 0)
        self.assertEqual(premier.restants, 2)

        with patch("fnpapp.batch.service.run_fields", return_value=None) as rf:
            second = batch.run_batch(DATE_NAV, OUT_REL)
        self.assertEqual(second.deja_fait, 1)
        self.assertEqual(second.traites, 2)
        self.assertEqual(second.restants, 0)
        self.assertEqual(rf.call_count, 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(self._etat()), 3)

    def test_echec_un_fonds_continue_les_autres(self):
        def stub(fields, **kw):
            if fields["fund"] == "222222":
                raise FnpError("fonds introuvable")
            return None

        with patch("fnpapp.batch.service.run_fields", side_effect=stub):
            res = batch.run_batch(DATE_NAV, OUT_REL)
        self.assertEqual(res.traites, 3)
        self.assertEqual(res.ok, 2)
        self.assertEqual(res.erreur, 1)
        etat = self._etat()
        self.assertEqual(etat["222222"]["statut"], "erreur")
        self.assertIn("fonds introuvable", etat["222222"]["detail"])
        self.assertEqual(etat["111111"]["statut"], "ok")

    def test_reset_efface_etat(self):
        with patch("fnpapp.batch.service.run_fields", return_value=None):
            batch.run_batch(DATE_NAV, OUT_REL)
        with patch("fnpapp.batch.service.run_fields", return_value=None) as rf:
            res = batch.run_batch(DATE_NAV, OUT_REL, reset=True)
        self.assertEqual(res.deja_fait, 0)
        self.assertEqual(res.traites, 3)
        self.assertEqual(rf.call_count, 3)

    def test_fonds_deja_fait_jamais_retraite(self):
        """Un fonds en erreur reste dans l'etat et n'est pas rejoue sans --reset (idempotence,
        docstring de fnpapp.batch)."""
        def stub(fields, **kw):
            raise FnpError("echec")

        with patch("fnpapp.batch.service.run_fields", side_effect=stub):
            batch.run_batch(DATE_NAV, OUT_REL, limit=1)
        with patch("fnpapp.batch.service.run_fields", return_value=None) as rf:
            res = batch.run_batch(DATE_NAV, OUT_REL)
        self.assertEqual(res.deja_fait, 1)
        self.assertEqual(rf.call_count, 2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class TestVerdictEcartExplique(unittest.TestCase):

    un simple ECART mais un ECART EXPLIQUE (config/anomalies.json)."""

    def test_ecart_confine_a_la_cle_expliquee(self):
        cols = ["Share / Class Type", "Price Share / Class Ccy"]
        ref = [{"Share / Class Type": "A", "Price Share / Class Ccy": "100"},
               {"Share / Class Type": "B", "Price Share / Class Ccy": "200"}]
        mine = [{"Share / Class Type": "A", "Price Share / Class Ccy": "100"},
                {"Share / Class Type": "B", "Price Share / Class Ccy": ""}]
        c = compare_tables(cols, mine, ref, cle="Share / Class Type", expliquees={"B"})
        self.assertFalse(c["identique"])
        self.assertEqual(c["verdict"], "ECART EXPLIQUE")
        self.assertIn("Ã‰CART EXPLIQUÃ‰", describe(c))

    def test_ecart_hors_cle_expliquee_reste_ecart(self):
        cols = ["Share / Class Type", "Price Share / Class Ccy"]
        ref = [{"Share / Class Type": "A", "Price Share / Class Ccy": "100"}]
        mine = [{"Share / Class Type": "A", "Price Share / Class Ccy": "999"}]
        c = compare_tables(cols, mine, ref, cle="Share / Class Type", expliquees={"B"})
        self.assertEqual(c["verdict"], "ECART")

"""Refus pre-vol d'une demande sur un ancien feeder depuis sa date de depooling
(fnpapp.depooling.check_fund), sur des structures reelles de config\\depooling.json."""
import unittest

from fnpapp.depooling import DepoolingError, check_fund, find, load_table

# Structure deja utilisee comme preuve dans docs/DEPOOLING.md.
POOL = "745635"
FEEDER = "745642"
DATE_DEPOOLING = "2026-06-25"


class TestFind(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.table = load_table()

    def test_pool_identifie(self):
        struct, role = find(self.table, POOL)
        self.assertEqual(role, "pool")
        self.assertEqual(struct["pool"], POOL)

    def test_feeder_identifie(self):
        struct, role = find(self.table, FEEDER)
        self.assertEqual(role, "feeder")
        self.assertEqual(struct["pool"], POOL)

    def test_fonds_inconnu(self):
        struct, role = find(self.table, "000000")
        self.assertIsNone(role)
        self.assertIsNone(struct)


class TestCheckFund(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.table = load_table()

    def test_feeder_avant_depooling_accepte(self):
        check_fund(FEEDER, "2026-06-24", table=self.table)

    def test_feeder_a_la_date_de_depooling_refuse(self):
        with self.assertRaises(DepoolingError) as ctx:
            check_fund(FEEDER, DATE_DEPOOLING, table=self.table)
        self.assertIn(POOL, str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertIn(FEEDER, str(ctx.exception))

    def test_feeder_apres_depooling_refuse(self):
        with self.assertRaises(DepoolingError):
            check_fund(FEEDER, "2026-06-26", table=self.table)

    def test_pool_toujours_accepte(self):
        check_fund(POOL, "2020-01-01", table=self.table)
        check_fund(POOL, "2026-06-25", table=self.table)
        check_fund(POOL, "2099-12-31", table=self.table)

    def test_fonds_inconnu_accepte(self):
        """Non present dans la table : check_fund ne doit pas se substituer a une autre
        verification (ex. existence du fonds), seul le dÃ©poolage releve de son perimetre."""
        check_fund("000000", "2026-06-25", table=self.table)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

            if step == "06_nav_price":
                return (None, None, [{"CODE_PART_FA_A_PUBLIER": f"A-{fund}"}], 1)
            if step == "07_nav_exchrate":
                return (None, None, [{"CCY": "USD"}], 1)
            return (None, None, [], 0)
        return query

        self.depooling_patch.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.depooling_patch.stop)

            params_list = [_params(fund="280232"), _params(fund="523379")]
            result = run_nav_multi(params_list, gw, write=False, cfg={}, multi_output="classeur")

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\tests\unit\test_repository_rules.py =====
"""Regles du depot (cahier v2, section 2) : jamais le motif de passerelle (deux points
suivis d'une barre oblique ou inverse, y compris via trois points de suspension), jamais
de tiret cadratin ou demi-cadratin, dans aucun fichier texte versionne.
"""
import re
import subprocess
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from fnpapp.paths import APP_DIR

TEXT_SUFFIXES = {".py", ".sql", ".md", ".json", ".html", ".txt", ".toml", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes", ".cfg", ".ini", ".csv"}
SKIP_DIRS = {"out", "logs", "__pycache__", ".git"}
# Motif construit par morceaux pour que ce fichier ne contienne pas lui-meme ce qu'il interdit :
# deux points echappes (donc separes par des barres inverses dans le source) suivis d'une classe barre.
GATEWAY_PATTERN = re.compile("\\." + "\\." + "[\\\\/]")
DASHES = re.compile("[" + chr(8212) + chr(8211) + "]")
IMAGE_DATA = re.compile(r"data:image/png;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+")


def tracked_text_files():
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"],
            cwd=APP_DIR, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
        ).stdout
        paths = [APP_DIR / line for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        paths = [p for p in APP_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
    result = []
    for p in paths:
        if not p.is_file():
            continue
        rel = p.relative_to(APP_DIR)
        if rel.parts[0] in SKIP_DIRS or any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in rel.parts):
            continue
        if p.suffix.lower() in TEXT_SUFFIXES or p.name in TEXT_SUFFIXES:
            result.append(p)
    return result


class RepositoryRulesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.files = tracked_text_files()

    def scan(self, pattern, label):
        found = []
        for p in self.files:
            text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            for n, line in enumerate(text.split("\n"), 1):
                line = IMAGE_DATA.sub("IMAGE", line)
                if pattern.search(line):
                    found.append(f"{p.relative_to(APP_DIR)}:{n}")
        self.assertEqual(found, [], f"{label} : {found[:10]}")

    def test_files_were_found(self):
        names = {p.name for p in self.files}
        self.assertTrue({"README.md", "defaults.json"} <= names, sorted(names)[:20])

    def test_no_gateway_pattern(self):
        self.scan(GATEWAY_PATTERN, "motif de passerelle (deux points suivis d'une barre)")

    def test_no_em_or_en_dash(self):
        self.scan(DASHES, "tiret cadratin ou demi-cadratin")

    def test_gitignore_covers_outputs(self):
        ignore = (APP_DIR / ".gitignore").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for entry in ("out/", "logs/", "__pycache__/"):
            self.assertIn(entry, ignore)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-first-nav-page\tests\unit\test_web.py =====
"""Lot 8 point 6 (cahier v2) : fnpapp.web, memes garde-fous que prompt-version-web.md.
Sans Dremio : service.run_fields est bouche. Un serveur reel est demarre sur 127.0.0.1,
port 0 (ephemere), pour exercer les vraies routes http.server plutot que les handlers
nus."""
import json
import shutil
import threading
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from fnpapp import web
from fnpapp.engine import RunResult
from fnpapp.params import Params
from fnpapp.paths import load_config, output_dir


def _get(url):
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5) as r:
            return r.status, r.read().decode("utf-8")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        return exc.code, exc.read().decode("utf-8")


def _post(url, data: dict):
    body = "&".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in data.items()).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST",
                                  headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as r:
            return r.status, r.read().decode("utf-8")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        return exc.code, exc.read().decode("utf-8")


class TestWeb(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.cfg = load_config()
        cls.server = web.build_server(cls.cfg, port=0)
        cls.port = cls.server.server_address[1]
        cls.base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{cls.port}"
        cls.thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        cls.thread.start()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.server.shutdown()
        cls.server.server_close()

    def setUp(self):
        web._reset_etat()

    def test_ecoute_127_0_0_1(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.server.server_address[0], "127.0.0.1")

    def test_page_accueil_sans_ressource_externe(self):
        status, body = _get(f"{self.base}/")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertNotIn("http://", body.replace(self.base, ""))
        self.assertNotIn("https://", body)
        self.assertNotIn("cdn.", body)

    def test_formulaire_appelle_service(self):
        fake = RunResult(params=Params(output="nav", fund="242013", serveur="intg"),
                          rows=[{"a": 1}], seconds=0.5, folder=Path("out") / "nav-242013",
                          files=["nav-242013.xlsx"], notes=[], controles={"verdict": "CONFORME"})
        with patch("fnpapp.web.service.run_fields", return_value=fake) as mocked:
            status, body = _post(f"{self.base}/run", {"output": "nav", "fund": "242013",
                                                        "date_nav": "2026-06-29"})
            self.assertEqual(status, 202)
            for _ in range(50):
                time.sleep(0.05)
                if not web._etat["en_cours"]:
                    break
            self.assertFalse(web._etat["en_cours"])
            self.assertIsNotNone(web._etat["resultat"])
            self.assertEqual(web._etat["resultat"]["fichiers"], ["nav-242013.xlsx"])
            mocked.assert_called_once()

    def test_une_execution_a_la_fois(self):
        gate = threading.Event()

        def _lent(fields, write, progress, cfg):
            gate.wait(timeout=2)
            return RunResult(params=Params(output="nav", fund="242013", serveur="intg"),
                              rows=[], seconds=0.0, files=[])

        with patch("fnpapp.web.service.run_fields", side_effect=_lent):
            status1, _ = _post(f"{self.base}/run", {"output": "nav", "fund": "242013",
                                                      "date_nav": "2026-06-29"})
            self.assertEqual(status1, 202)
            time.sleep(0.05)
            status2, body2 = _post(f"{self.base}/run", {"output": "nav", "fund": "999999",
                                                          "date_nav": "2026-06-29"})
            self.assertEqual(status2, 409)
            self.assertIn("deja en cours", json.loads(body2)["erreur"])
            gate.set()
            for _ in range(50):
                time.sleep(0.05)
                if not web._etat["en_cours"]:
                    break

    def test_telechargement_nom_invalide_refuse(self):
        web._etat["resultat"] = {"dossier": str(output_dir(self.cfg)), "fichiers": ["ok.csv"]}
        for mauvais in ("..%2fsecret.txt", "a/b.csv", "a\\b.csv"):
            status, _ = _get(f"{self.base}/download/{mauvais}")
            self.assertIn(status, (400, 404))

    def test_telechargement_fichier_non_annonce_refuse(self):
        web._etat["resultat"] = {"dossier": str(output_dir(self.cfg)), "fichiers": ["ok.csv"]}
        status, _ = _get(f"{self.base}/download/autre.csv")
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)

    def test_telechargement_fichier_valide(self):
        dossier = output_dir(self.cfg) / "_test_web_download"
        dossier.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fichier = dossier / "preuve.csv"
        fichier.write_bytes(b"a,b\n1,2\n")
        try:
            web._etat["resultat"] = {"dossier": str(dossier), "fichiers": ["preuve.csv"]}
            status, body = _get(f"{self.base}/download/preuve.csv")
            self.assertEqual(status, 200)
            self.assertEqual(body, "a,b\n1,2\n")
        finally:
            shutil.rmtree(dossier, ignore_errors=True)

    def test_statut_sans_execution(self):
        status, body = _get(f"{self.base}/status")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        data = json.loads(body)
        self.assertFalse(data["en_cours"])
        self.assertIsNone(data["erreur"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
