def _int(v):
    return int(str(v).split(".")[0]) if v not in (None, "") else None


def _date(v):
    return str(v)[:10] if v not in (None, "") else None


def check_fund(row, fund, sans_luxis=False):
    if not row:
        if sans_luxis and sansluxis.is_absent(fund):
            raise GlError(t("err.fund_absent_frozen", fund=fund, date=sansluxis.tables()["date"]))
        if sans_luxis:
            raise GlError(t("err.fund_absent_mfga", fund=fund))
        raise GlError(t("err.fund_absent_tfm", fund=fund))
    if str(row.get("EFRONT")) == "1":
        raise EfrontRefused(t("err.efront", fund=fund))


def luxis_free(params, values, flags):
    """Valeurs et drapeaux d'un modele, completes pour le mode sans LUXIS si params.sans_luxis (voir glapp.sansluxis)."""
    if not getattr(params, "sans_luxis", False):
        return values, flags
    return sansluxis.decorate(values, flags, params.fund)


def window_spec(params, nav=None, closing=None, cfg=None, today=None):
    """Etape de fenetre de lots : (nom du modele, valeurs, drapeaux)."""
    values, flags = {"FUND": params.fund}, set()
    if params.bcr_nav_period:
        # SYSDATE de LUXIS, rendu comme une date litterale pour que la valeur reste visible dans le JSON et testable.
        values["TODAY"] = today or dt.date.today().isoformat()
        if params.bcr_period == "to_last_date_nav":
            flags.add("BCR_NAV_PUBLIEE")
            values["DATE_FROM"] = params.date_from
        return (BCR_NAV_STEP,) + luxis_free(params, values, flags)
    if params.output == "bcr" or params.range_mode:
        values.update({"DATE_FROM": params.date_from, "DATE_TO": params.date_to})
        return (BCR_STEP,) + luxis_free(params, values, flags)
    values["NAV"] = nav
    if params.period in CLOSING_PERIODS:
        values["CLOSING_NAV"] = closing["nav"] if closing else None
        if closing:
            flags.add("HAS_CLOSING")
    if params.period in CALENDAR_CODES:
        flags.add(f"C{params.period:02d}")
    if params.period == 13 and params.corrected:
        flags.add("CORRIGE")
    if params.compat:
        flags.add("COMPAT")
    return (WINDOW_STEPS[params.period],) + luxis_free(params, values, flags)


def entries_spec(params, window, closing=None, cfg=None):
    """Etape des ecritures : (valeurs, drapeaux), a partir de la fenetre de lots."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    values = {"FUND": params.fund, "LOT_FROM": window["lot_from"], "LOT_TO": window["lot_to"]}
    flags = {SPEC[params.output]["sort_flag"]}
    if params.output == "bcr" and not params.compat:
        flags.add("PLAN_FIXE")
        values["PLAN"] = cfg["plan_comptable_bcr"]
    if params.acc_from is not None:
        flags.add("COMPTE_DE")
        values["ACC_FROM"] = params.acc_from
    if params.acc_to is not None:
        flags.add("COMPTE_A")
        values["ACC_TO"] = params.acc_to
    if params.acc_list is not None:
        flags.add("ACC_LIST")
        values["ACC_LIST"] = params.acc_list
    if window.get("trade_max"):
        flags.add("TRADE_MAX")
        values["TRADE_MAX"] = window["trade_max"]
    if params.date_filter:
        # Choix du Reporting (16/10/2026) : en plus de la fenetre de lots, la colonne choisie doit tomber dans
        # la plage demandee. validate() refuse ce choix hors mode plage et avec split_by_nav.
        flags.add({"accounting": "FILTRE_DATE_ACC", "trade": "FILTRE_DATE_TRADE", "value": "FILTRE_DATE_VALUE"}[params.date_column])
        values["DATE_FROM"] = params.date_from
        values["DATE_TO"] = params.date_to
    if params.output == "irp" and params.period == 16:
        values["SEUIL_RESULTAT"] = cfg["seuil_resultat"]
        if params.corrected and closing:
            flags.add("P16_CORRIGE")
            values["CLOSING_LOT"] = closing["lot"]
            values["CLOSING_NAV"] = closing["nav"]
        else:
            flags.add("P16_LUXIS")
            values["LOT_RESULT_FROM"] = 0 if params.corrected else window["lot_result_from"]
    return luxis_free(params, values, flags)


def account_catalogue(fund, output, gw, cfg=None, compat=False):
    """Plan comptable du fonds (etape 19), pour la selection cliquable de comptes de l'interface web : meme choix de plan que
    `entries_spec` (plan fixe pour le BCR, plan du dernier lot du fonds pour l'IRP), sans fenetre de lots. Rend une liste triee
    de {"numero": int, "nom": str}."""
    from .params import parse_fund
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    fund = parse_fund(fund)
    values, flags = {"FUND": fund}, set()
    if output == "bcr" and not compat:
        flags.add("PLAN_FIXE")
        values["PLAN"] = cfg["plan_comptable_bcr"]
    rows = gw.query("19_liste_comptes", render_step("19_liste_comptes", values, flags, cfg=cfg))
    return [{"numero": int(r["ACCOUNT_NUMBER"]), "nom": r["ACCOUNT_NAME"]} for r in rows]


def fund_catalogue(gw, cfg=None):
    """Catalogue des fonds (etape 42), pour la selection cliquable de fonds de l'interface web : tous les fonds de
    Table Fonds hors eFront, avec leur nom et leur devise, exactement comme `account_catalogue` pour les comptes
    d'un fonds. Rend une liste triee de {"numero": str, "nom": str, "devise": str}."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    rows = gw.query("42_liste_fonds", render_step("42_liste_fonds", {}, set(), cfg=cfg))
    return [{"numero": r["FUND_NUMBER"], "nom": r["FUND_NAME"], "devise": r["FUND_CCY"]} for r in rows]


def read_fund(params, gw, cfg, say=None):
    """Etape 00 : fiche du fonds (Table Fonds, ou MFGA et tables figees en mode sans LUXIS). Retourne un dictionnaire, vide si le fonds est absent."""
    values, flags = luxis_free(params, {"FUND": params.fund}, set())
    rows = gw.query("00_fonds", render_step("00_fonds", values, flags, params.source, cfg=cfg))
    if say:
        say(t("log.step_rows", step="00_fonds", n=len(rows), s=gw.log[-1]["seconds"]))
    if params.sans_luxis:
        return sansluxis.fiche(rows[0] if rows else None, params.fund)
    return rows[0] if rows else {}


def read_closing(rows):
    if not rows:
        return None
    return {"nav": _date(rows[0]["DATE_NAV_CLOT"]), "lot": _int(rows[0]["LOT_CLOT"]), "lot_rs": _int(rows[0]["LOT_RS"])}


def read_window(rows):
    if not rows:
        return None
    r = rows[0]
    return {"nav_to": _date(r["NAV_TO"]), "nav_from": _date(r["NAV_FROM"]), "lot_from": _int(r["LOT_FROM"]), "lot_to": _int(r["LOT_TO"]),
            "trade_max": _date(r["TRADE_DATE_MAX"]), "lot_result_from": _int(r["LOT_RESULT_FROM"])}


def resolve(params, gw, progress=None, cfg=None, known_fund=None):
    """Etapes 00 a 15 : fiche du fonds, NAV, cloture, fenetre de lots. Retourne (fonds, resolu, fenetre, cloture)."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    say = progress or (lambda *_: None)
    gw.sans_luxis = params.sans_luxis

    def q(step, values=None, flags=(), name=None):
        sql = render_step(step, values, flags, params.source, cfg=cfg)
        rows = gw.query(name or step, sql)
        say(t("log.step_rows", step=name or step, n=len(rows), s=gw.log[-1]["seconds"]))
        return rows

    if known_fund is not None:
        fund = known_fund
    else:
        fund = read_fund(params, gw, cfg, say)
    check_fund(fund, params.fund, params.sans_luxis)
    resolved, nav, closing = {}, params.nav_date, None
    if params.output == "irp" and not nav and not params.range_mode:
        r = q("01_nav_depuis_calcul", {"FUND": params.fund, "CALC": params.calc_date})
        nav = _date(r[0]["NAV_DATE"]) if r else None
        if not nav:
            raise GlError(t("err.no_nav_calc", calc=params.calc_date, fund=params.fund))
        resolved["nav_resolue_depuis_date_de_calcul"] = nav
    if params.output == "irp" and not params.range_mode:
        resolved["nav"] = nav
        if params.period in CLOSING_PERIODS:
            closing = read_closing(q("02_derniere_cloture", {"FUND": params.fund, "NAV": nav, "SEUIL_RESULTAT": cfg["seuil_resultat"]}))
            if closing:
                resolved.update({"cloture": closing["nav"], "lot_cloture": closing["lot"]})
            elif params.period == 16 and params.compat:
                raise GlError(t("err.compat_16_no_closing"))
    step, values, flags = window_spec(params, nav, closing, cfg)
    if params.bcr_nav_period:
        resolved["periode_bcr"] = params.bcr_period
        resolved["date_du_jour"] = values["TODAY"]
    window = read_window(q(step, values, flags))
    if window is None:
        if params.bcr_nav_period:
            raise GlError(t("err.bcr_no_nav_mode", fund=params.fund, mode=params.bcr_period, date=values["TODAY"]))
        if params.output == "bcr" or params.range_mode:
            raise GlError(t("err.no_nav_before_end", fund=params.fund, date=params.date_to))
        raise GlError(t("err.no_lot_for_nav", nav=nav, fund=params.fund))
    resolved.update({"nav_de": window["nav_from"], "nav_a": window["nav_to"], "lot_de": window["lot_from"], "lot_a": window["lot_to"]})
    if window["trade_max"]:
        resolved["date_transaction_max"] = window["trade_max"]
    if window["lot_result_from"] is not None:
        resolved["lot_resultat_depuis"] = window["lot_result_from"]
    if params.prenav and params.output == "irp":
        types = q("06_type_de_nav", {"FUND": params.fund, "NAV": window["nav_to"]})
        resolved["types_de_lot_de_la_nav"] = {str(r["C_NAV_TYP"]): _int(r["N_LOTS"]) for r in types}
    return fund, resolved, window, closing


def fetch_entries(params, gw, window, closing, cfg=None, progress=None):
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    values, flags = entries_spec(params, window, closing, cfg)
    sql = render_step("20_ecritures", values, flags, params.source, cfg=cfg)
    rows = gw.query("20_ecritures", sql)
    if progress:
        progress(t("log.step_rows", step="20_ecritures", n=len(rows), s=gw.log[-1]["seconds"]))
    return rows


def reference_for(params, cfg, explicit=None):
    """Classeur de reference LUXIS pour un rapprochement : explicite, ou celui de la config si le fonds correspond."""
    if explicit:
        return Path(explicit)
    ref = cfg["references_luxis"].get(params.output)
    if ref and ref["fonds"] == params.fund:
        return reference_workbook(params.output, cfg)
    return None


def load_reference_rows(path, cols):
    path = Path(path)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise GlError(t("err.reference_missing", name=path.name))
    return read_xlsx(path) if path.suffix.lower() == ".xlsx" else read_csv_rows(path)


def run_notes(params, fund, closing, cfg, resolved=None):
    """Notes Ã  l'exÃ©cution : cas oÃ¹ le rÃ©sultat dÃ©pend d'une rÃ¨gle LUXIS particuliÃ¨re ou d'une dÃ©cision Ã  prendre."""
    notes = []
    if getattr(params, "sans_luxis", False):
        notes.append(t("note.sans_luxis", date=sansluxis.tables()["date"]))
    if str(fund.get("NAV_BACKDATED")) in ("1", "1.0", "True", "true"):
        if params.compat:
            notes.append(t("note.backdated_compat"))
        else:
            notes.append(t("note.backdated"))
    if params.output == "irp" and params.period in (13, 16) and not params.corrected:
        notes.append(t("note.code_13_16", period=params.period))
    if params.output == "irp" and params.period == 16 and closing is None and not params.compat:
        notes.append(t("note.code_16_no_closing"))
    if params.output == "irp" and params.period in (13, 14) and closing is None:
        if params.compat:
            notes.append(t("note.no_closing_compat"))
        else:
            notes.append(t("note.no_closing"))
    if params.output == "bcr" and not params.compat:
        notes.append(t("note.bcr_plan", plan=cfg["plan_comptable_bcr"]))
    if params.bcr_nav_period:
        notes.append(t("note.bcr_nav_period", mode=params.bcr_period, date=(resolved or {}).get("date_du_jour"),
                       nav_from=(resolved or {}).get("nav_de"), nav_to=(resolved or {}).get("nav_a")))
    if params.prenav and params.output == "irp":
        types = (resolved or {}).get("types_de_lot_de_la_nav", {})
        if types.get("P"):
            notes.append(t("note.prenav", nav=(resolved or {}).get("nav_a"), n=types["P"]))
        else:
            notes.append(t("note.prenav_none"))
    if params.range_mode:
        notes.append(t("note.range", date_from=params.date_from, date_to=params.date_to))
    if params.date_filter:
        notes.append(t("note.date_column", column=t("date_column." + params.date_column), date_from=params.date_from, date_to=params.date_to))
    if params.output == "irp" and not params.range_mode and params.period not in cfg.get("periodes_publiees_rapport_17", []):
        notes.append(t("note.period_unpublished", period=params.period, published=", ".join(str(x) for x in cfg["periodes_publiees_rapport_17"])))
    return notes


def add_years(day, years):
    """La meme date, plusieurs annees plus tot (le 29 fevrier devient le 28)."""
    try:
        return day.replace(year=day.year - years)
    except ValueError:
        return day.replace(year=day.year - years, day=28)


def history_note(params, resolved, gw, cfg, today=None):
    """Signal "hors des 3 ans" : le Reporting veut trois ans d'historique. Une note, jamais un refus. La derniere NAV disponible n'est lue (etape 51)
    que si la date de depart est plus ancienne que la date du jour moins trois ans ; sinon elle est forcement dans les trois ans."""
    years = cfg.get("historique_annees", 3)
    starts = [x for x in (resolved.get("nav"), resolved.get("nav_de"), params.date_from) if x]
    if not years or not starts:
        return None
    start = dt.date.fromisoformat(str(min(starts))[:10])
    today = today or dt.date.today()
    if start >= add_years(today, years):
        return None
    last = getattr(gw, "_derniere_nav", None)
    if last is None:
        rows = gw.query("51_derniere_nav", render_step("51_derniere_nav", {}, (), params.source, cfg=cfg))
        last = _date(rows[0]["DERNIERE_NAV"]) if rows and rows[0].get("DERNIERE_NAV") else None
        gw._derniere_nav = last
    if last is None:
        return None
    horizon = add_years(dt.date.fromisoformat(last[:10]), years)
    if start < horizon:
        return t("note.history", years=years, start=f"{start:%d/%m/%Y}", horizon=f"{horizon:%d/%m/%Y}", last=last[:10])
    return None


def run(params, gw, out_root=None, reference=None, write=True, progress=None, cfg=None, with_nature=False, pre=None, known_fund=None):
    """Un Grand livre de bout en bout. reference : chemin explicite, ou True pour la reference LUXIS de la config."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    t0 = time.time()
    gw.sans_luxis = params.sans_luxis
    folder = (Path(out_root) if out_root else output_dir(cfg)) / params.tag if write else None
    mark = len(gw.log)
    if folder is not None:
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    gw.out_dir = folder
    if folder is not None:
        (folder / "sql").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        fund, resolved, window, closing = pre if pre is not None else resolve(params, gw, progress, cfg, known_fund=known_fund)
        rows = fetch_entries(params, gw, window, closing, cfg, progress)
        nature = None
        if with_nature:
            nature = classify(params, gw, window, cfg, progress)
        spec = SPEC[params.output]
        controls = checks.compute(rows)
        if cfg.get("controle_solde_final", True) and rows:
            pos_rows = gw.query("35_soldes_finaux", render_step("35_soldes_finaux", {"FUND": params.fund, "LOT_TO": window["lot_to"]}, (), params.source, cfg=cfg))
            if progress:
                progress(t("log.step_positions", step="35_soldes_finaux", n=len(pos_rows), s=gw.log[-1]["seconds"]))
            controls["solde_final"] = checks.final_balances(rows, pos_rows)
        verdicts = checks.verdicts(controls, params, cfg)
        result = RunResult(params, fund, resolved, rows, controls, verdicts, list(gw.log[mark:]), 0.0, folder, notes=list(params.notes), nature=nature)
        result.notes += run_notes(params, fund, closing, cfg, resolved)
        h = history_note(params, resolved, gw, cfg)
        if h:
            result.notes.append(h)
        if reference:
            ref_path = reference_for(params, cfg, None if reference is True else reference)
            if ref_path is None:
                result.notes.append(t("note.no_reference"))
            else:
                ref_rows = load_reference_rows(ref_path, spec["cols"])
                result.comparison = cmp.compare(spec["cols"], spec["map"], rows, ref_rows)
                result.reference = ref_path.name
        result.conformite = checks.conformity(params, controls, verdicts, result.comparison, result.notes)
        result.seconds = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
        result.queries = list(gw.log[mark:])
        if write:
            result.files = write_outputs(result, cfg)
        journal.log_event("run", cfg=cfg, tag=params.tag, lignes=len(rows), secondes=result.seconds, requetes=len(result.queries), statut=result.status)
        return result
    except Exception as exc:
        journal.log_event("run_erreur", cfg=cfg, tag=params.tag, erreur=str(exc)[:300])
        raise


def classify(params, gw, window, cfg, progress=None):
    """Controle facultatif : classement bilan / resultat par rubrique (regle durable) contre le seuil de LUXIS."""
    values = {"FUND": params.fund, "LOT_FROM": window["lot_from"], "LOT_TO": window["lot_to"], "SEUIL_RESULTAT": cfg["seuil_resultat"]}
    rows = gw.query("30_classement_bilan_resultat", render_step("30_classement_bilan_resultat", values, (), params.source, cfg=cfg))
    if progress:
        progress(t("log.step_rows", step="30_classement_bilan_resultat", n=len(rows), s=gw.log[-1]["seconds"]))
    ecarts = [r for r in rows if str(r["ECART"]) == "1"]
    return {"comptes": len(rows), "ecarts_rubrique_contre_seuil": len(ecarts),
            "non_classes": sum(1 for r in rows if r["NATURE_RUBRIQUE"] == "NON_CLASSE"),
            "comptes_en_ecart": [str(r["C_N_ACC"]) for r in ecarts][:50]}


def write_outputs(result, cfg):
    p, folder, spec = result.params, result.folder, SPEC[result.params.output]
    files = []
    if "csv" in p.formats:
        write_csv(folder / f"{p.tag}.csv", spec["cols"], spec["map"], result.rows)
        files.append(f"{p.tag}.csv")
    write_raw_csv(folder / f"{p.tag}_brut.csv", result.rows)
    files.append(f"{p.tag}_brut.csv")
    xlsx_ok = "xlsx" in p.formats and len(result.rows) <= cfg.get("xlsx_lignes_max", 1048575)
    if "xlsx" in p.formats and not xlsx_ok:
        result.notes.append(t("note.xlsx_too_big", n=len(result.rows), limit=cfg.get("xlsx_lignes_max", 1048575)))
    if xlsx_ok:
        write_xlsx(folder / f"{p.tag}.xlsx", TEMPLATES_DIR / spec["template"], spec["cols"], spec["map"], result.rows)
        files.append(f"{p.tag}.xlsx")
    lx = cfg.get("fichier_luxis", {})
    if lx.get("ecrire"):
        nav = result.resolved.get("nav") or result.resolved.get("nav_a") or p.date_to
        name = luxis_name(p.fund, nav, dt.datetime.now(), lx.get("prefixe", ""), lx.get("nom_rapport", "GeneralLedger"))
        result.luxis_name = name
        if "csv" in p.formats:
            data, altered = luxis_csv_bytes(spec["cols"], spec["map"], result.rows, lx)
            (folder / f"{name}.csv").write_bytes(data)
            files.append(f"{name}.csv")
            if altered:
                result.notes.append(t("note.csv_altered", n=altered))
        if xlsx_ok:
            write_xlsx(folder / f"{name}.xlsx", TEMPLATES_DIR / spec["template"], spec["cols"], spec["map"], result.rows)
            files.append(f"{name}.xlsx")
    write_json(folder / f"{p.tag}.json", result.to_json(cfg))
    files.append(f"{p.tag}.json")
    return files


@dataclass
class SplitResult:
    params: object
    fund: dict
    results: list
    queries: list
    seconds: float
    notes: list = field(default_factory=list)
    depooling: dict = None

    @property
    def status(self):
        return "ALERTE" if any(r.status == "ALERTE" for r in self.results) else "OK"


def run_split(params, gw, out_root=None, progress=None, cfg=None, with_nature=False, write=True):
    """Mode plage avec un fichier par NAV : une requÃªte de fiche, une requÃªte de fenÃªtres pour toutes les NAV de la plage, puis une requÃªte d'Ã©critures par NAV
    (code 1 de chaque NAV : les sorties quotidiennes de LUXIS). Un fichier continu garde l'enchaÃ®nement des soldes ; un fichier par NAV reproduit
    exactement ce que LUXIS publie chaque jour."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    t0 = time.time()
    mark = len(gw.log)
    say = progress or (lambda *_: None)
    gw.sans_luxis = params.sans_luxis
    fund = read_fund(params, gw, cfg)
    check_fund(fund, params.fund, params.sans_luxis)
    values, flags = luxis_free(params, {"FUND": params.fund, "DATE_FROM": params.date_from, "DATE_TO": params.date_to}, set())
    sql = render_step("17_navs_de_la_plage", values, flags, params.source, cfg=cfg)
    navs = gw.query("17_navs_de_la_plage", sql)
    say(t("log.navs_in_range", step="17_navs_de_la_plage", n=len(navs)))
    if not navs:
        raise GlError(t("err.no_nav_in_range", fund=params.fund, date_from=params.date_from, date_to=params.date_to))
    results = []
    for r in navs:
        nav = _date(r["NAV_TO"])
        window = {"nav_to": nav, "nav_from": _date(r["NAV_FROM"]), "lot_from": _int(r["LOT_FROM"]), "lot_to": _int(r["LOT_TO"]),
                  "trade_max": _date(r["TRADE_DATE_MAX"]), "lot_result_from": None}
        p = replace(params, nav_date=nav, date_from=None, date_to=None, period=1)
        resolved = {"nav": nav, "nav_de": window["nav_from"], "nav_a": nav, "lot_de": window["lot_from"], "lot_a": window["lot_to"]}
        if window["trade_max"]:
            resolved["date_transaction_max"] = window["trade_max"]
        results.append(run(p, gw, out_root=out_root, progress=progress, cfg=cfg, with_nature=with_nature, write=write, pre=(fund, resolved, window, None)))
    return SplitResult(params, fund, results, list(gw.log[mark:]), round(time.time() - t0, 1))

def set_lang(lang):
    """Langue de l'interface pour tout le processus (ligne de commande, fenÃªtre, fils d'exÃ©cution)."""
    if lang not in LANGS:

    """Serveur Dremio actif, pour les textes qui le nomment : une clÃ© "<clÃ©>@<serveur>" remplace alors "<clÃ©>"."""

def t(key, **kw):
    if _default["server"] != "intg" and f"{key}@{_default['server']}" in CATALOG["fr"]:

    text = CATALOG[get_lang()].get(key)

    return en_text if get_lang() == "en" and en_text else fr_text

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-general-ledger\glapp\journal.py =====
"""Journal des executions dans logs\\ : une ligne JSON par evenement, sans jeton ni identifiant."""
import datetime as dt
import json

from .paths import load_config, logs_dir


def log_event(kind, cfg=None, **fields):
    try:
        cfg = cfg or load_config()
        d = logs_dir(cfg)
        d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        now = dt.datetime.now()
        line = {"quand": now.isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "evenement": kind, **fields}
        with (d / f"journal_{now:%Y%m%d}.log").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(line, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")
    except OSError:
        pass



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-general-ledger\glapp\outputs.py =====
"""Ecriture et lecture des fichiers de sortie : CSV, XLSX au gabarit LUXIS (feuille "A"), JSON.

Le XLSX est ecrit avec zipfile, sans bibliotheque : le gabarit (dossier templates) est un classeur LUXIS vide de donnees ;
seuls la feuille de donnees et les chaines partagees sont remplacees, les styles, largeurs et formats sont conserves.
"""
import csv
import datetime as dt
import decimal
import html
import io
import json
import re
import zipfile
from html import escape

from .columns import AMOUNT_COLS, DATE_COLS, NUM_COLS

EPOCH = dt.date(1899, 12, 30)
NS_MAIN = "http" + ":" + "//schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"


def num(v):
    try:
        return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0


def cell_value(col, v):
    """Valeur d'une cellule de sortie : texte, date AAAA-MM-JJ, entier ou decimal."""
    if v is None or v == "":
        return ""
    if col in DATE_COLS:
        return str(v)[:10]
    if col in NUM_COLS:
        f = num(v)
        return int(f) if f == int(f) and col not in AMOUNT_COLS else f
    return str(v)


def write_csv(path, cols, mapping, rows):
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f, delimiter=";")
        w.writerow(cols)
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow([cell_value(c, r.get(mapping[c])) for c in cols])


def luxis_name(fund, nav, now, prefix="", report="GeneralLedger"):
    """Nom de fichier de LUXIS : <fonds> - <rapport>-<AAAA_MM_JJ de la NAV>_<HH_MM_SS_CC de la generation>, tous les espaces retires
    (FEN_REPORT.wdw, procedure globale de sauvegarde). Exemple : 242013-GeneralLedger-2026_06_29_10_45_39_74."""
    d = dt.date.fromisoformat(str(nav)[:10])
    stamp = f"{now:%H_%M_%S}_{now.microsecond // 10000:02d}"
    return (f"{prefix}{fund} - {report}-{d:%Y_%m_%d}_{stamp}").replace(" ", "")


def luxis_number(v):
    """Nombre comme WinDev le convertit en texte : point decimal, chiffres significatifs seulement, pas de separateur de milliers."""
    if v is None or v == "":
        return ""
    try:
        d = decimal.Decimal(str(v))
    except decimal.InvalidOperation:
        return str(v)
    if d == 0:
        return "0"
    s = format(d.normalize(), "f")
    return s


def luxis_cell(col, v, fmt, strip_apostrophes=True):
    if v is None or v == "":
        return ""
    if col in DATE_COLS:
        return dt.date.fromisoformat(str(v)[:10]).strftime(fmt)
    if col in NUM_COLS and col != "Sub-Account Number":
        return luxis_number(v)
    s = str(v)
    if strip_apostrophes:
        s = s.replace("'", "")
    return s


def luxis_csv_bytes(cols, mapping, rows, options, extra=None):
    """CSV au format de LUXIS : separateur ;, en-tete = libelles, dates jj.mm.aaaa, nombres au point sans zeros inutiles, ANSI (cp1252), fin de ligne CRLF,
    apostrophes retirees. LUXIS ne met aucun guillemet : un point-virgule ou un saut de ligne dans un texte est remplace par une espace pour ne pas
    casser le fichier (ecart assume, signale par la liste retournee). extra : colonnes supplementaires {libelle: fonction(ligne) -> texte}."""
    sep, eol = options["csv_separateur"], options["csv_fin_de_ligne"]
    extra = extra or {}
    altered = 0
    out = [sep.join(list(cols) + list(extra))]
    if options["csv_retirer_apostrophes"]:
        out[0] = out[0].replace("'", "")
    for r in rows:
        cells = [luxis_cell(c, r.get(mapping[c]), options["csv_format_date"], options["csv_retirer_apostrophes"]) for c in cols]
        cells += [str(f(r) or "") for f in extra.values()]
        clean = []
        for c in cells:
            if sep in c or "\r" in c or "\n" in c:
                altered += 1
                c = c.replace(sep, " ").replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ")
            clean.append(c)
        out.append(sep.join(clean))
    text = eol.join(out) + (eol if options["csv_retour_final"] else "")
    return text.encode(options["csv_encodage"], errors="replace"), altered


def write_raw_csv(path, rows):
    """CSV brut avec les colonnes techniques (lot, ligne, gestionnaire de portefeuille)."""
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        if rows:
            w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows[0].keys()))
            w.writeheader()
            w.writerows(rows)


def _col(i):
    s = ""
    i += 1
    while i:
        i, m = divmod(i - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + m) + s
    return s


def write_xlsx(path, template, cols, mapping, rows, annex=None):
    """XLSX au gabarit de la sortie LUXIS : feuille "A", largeurs, style d'en-tete, formats des nombres et des dates.
    annex : (nom de feuille, en-tetes, lignes) pour une feuille annexe apres la feuille A (colonne technique "Fonds d'origine") ; la feuille A ne change pas."""
    zt = zipfile.ZipFile(template)
    sheet = zt.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml").decode("utf-8")
    head, rest = sheet.split("<sheetData>", 1)
    tail = rest.split("</sheetData>", 1)[1]
    trows = re.findall(r"<row [^>]*>.*?</row>", rest.split("</sheetData>", 1)[0], re.S)
    styles = [re.search(r'\bs="(\d+)"', c).group(1) for c in re.findall(r"<c [^>]*?(?:>.*?</c>|[/]>)", trows[1], re.S)]
    hstyle = re.search(r'\bs="(\d+)"', trows[0]).group(1)
    strings, sidx = [], {}

    def si(s):
        if s not in sidx:
            sidx[s] = len(strings)
            strings.append(s)
        return sidx[s]

    xml = [f'<row r="1" spans="1:{len(cols)}">' + "".join(f'<c r="{_col(i)}1" s="{hstyle}" t="s"><v>{si(c)}</v></c>' for i, c in enumerate(cols)) + "</row>"]
    for n, r in enumerate(rows, 2):
        cells = []
        for i, c in enumerate(cols):
            v, ref, s = cell_value(c, r.get(mapping[c])), f"{_col(i)}{n}", styles[i] if i < len(styles) else "0"
            if v == "":
                cells.append(f'<c r="{ref}" s="{s}"/>')
            elif c in DATE_COLS:
                cells.append(f'<c r="{ref}" s="{s}"><v>{(dt.date.fromisoformat(v) - EPOCH).days}</v></c>')
            elif isinstance(v, (int, float)) and c != "Sub-Account Number":
                cells.append(f'<c r="{ref}" s="{s}"><v>{v}</v></c>')
            else:
                cells.append(f'<c r="{ref}" s="{s}" t="s"><v>{si(str(v))}</v></c>')
        xml.append(f'<row r="{n}" spans="1:{len(cols)}">' + "".join(cells) + "</row>")
    head = re.sub(r'<dimension ref="[^"]*"/>', f'<dimension ref="A1:{_col(len(cols) - 1)}{len(rows) + 1}"/>', head)
    sheet2 = None
    if annex:
        a_name, a_head, a_rows = annex
        a_xml = ['<row r="1">' + "".join(f'<c r="{_col(i)}1" s="{hstyle}" t="s"><v>{si(h)}</v></c>' for i, h in enumerate(a_head)) + "</row>"]
        for n, r in enumerate(a_rows, 2):
            cells = []
            for i, v in enumerate(r):
                if v is None or v == "":
                    continue
                if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
                    cells.append(f'<c r="{_col(i)}{n}"><v>{v}</v></c>')
                else:
                    cells.append(f'<c r="{_col(i)}{n}" t="s"><v>{si(str(v))}</v></c>')
            a_xml.append(f'<row r="{n}">' + "".join(cells) + "</row>")
        sheet2 = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<worksheet xmlns="' + NS_MAIN + '">'
                  f'<dimension ref="A1:{_col(len(a_head) - 1)}{len(a_rows) + 1}"/><sheetData>' + "".join(a_xml) + "</sheetData></worksheet>")
    sst = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<sst xmlns="' + NS_MAIN + '" '
           f'count="{len(strings)}" uniqueCount="{len(strings)}">' + "".join(f'<si><t xml:space="preserve">{escape(s, quote=False)}</t></si>' for s in strings) + "</sst>")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zo:
        for it in zt.infolist():
            if it.filename.startswith("[trash]"):
                continue
            data = zt.read(it.filename)
            if it.filename == "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml":
                data = (head + "<sheetData>" + "".join(xml) + "</sheetData>" + tail).encode("utf-8")
            elif it.filename == "xl/workbook.xml" and annex:
                data = data.decode("utf-8").replace("</sheets>", f'<sheet name="{escape(annex[0])}" sheetId="2" r:id="rId9"/></sheets>').encode("utf-8")
            elif it.filename == "xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels" and annex:
                data = data.decode("utf-8").replace("</Relationships>", '<Relationship Id="rId9" Type="http' + ':' + '//schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" Target="worksheets/sheet2.xml"/></Relationships>').encode("utf-8")
            elif it.filename == "[Content_Types].xml" and annex:
                data = data.decode("utf-8").replace("</Types>", '<Override PartName="/xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml"/></Types>').encode("utf-8")
            elif it.filename == "xl/sharedStrings.xml":
                data = sst.encode("utf-8")
            elif it.filename in ("docProps/core.xml", "docProps/app.xml"):
                t = data.decode("utf-8")
                t = re.sub(r"<dc:creator>.*?</dc:creator>", "<dc:creator>IT</dc:creator>", t)
                t = re.sub(r"<cp:lastModifiedBy>.*?</cp:lastModifiedBy>", "<cp:lastModifiedBy>IT</cp:lastModifiedBy>", t)
                t = re.sub(r"<Company>.*?</Company>", "<Company></Company>", t)
                data = t.encode("utf-8")
            zo.writestr(it, data)
        if sheet2:
            zo.writestr("xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml", sheet2.encode("utf-8"))
    zt.close()


def read_xlsx(path, sheet="sheet1"):
    """Lecteur minimal d'une feuille (valeurs seulement) : liste de dictionnaires indexes par l'en-tete.

    Deux formes de texte sont lues : la chaine partagee (t="s", index dans sharedStrings.xml), ecrite par les sorties de
    l'application, et la chaine en ligne (t="inlineStr", <is><t>texte</t></is>), ecrite par les exports "Exporter la
    feuille de calcul" d'Oracle APEX, dont la Table Fonds sauvegardee lue par tools\\depooling_table_fonds.py."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
        try:
            ss_xml = z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml").decode("utf-8")
        except KeyError:
            ss_xml = ""
        sheet = z.read(f"xl/worksheets/{sheet}.xml").decode("utf-8")
    ss = [html.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", m)) for m in re.findall(r"<si>(.*?)</si>", ss_xml, re.S)]
    out = []
    for row in re.findall(r"<row [^>]*>(.*?)</row>", sheet, re.S):
        vals = {}
        for attrs, body in re.findall(r"<c\b([^>]*?)(?:>(.*?)</c>|[/]>)", row, re.S):
            ref = re.search(r'\br="([A-Z]+)\d+"', attrs).group(1)
            if 't="inlineStr"' in attrs:
                m = re.search(r"<is>(.*?)</is>", body or "", re.S)
                vals[ref] = html.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", m.group(1))) if m else ""
                continue
            m = re.search(r"<v>(.*?)</v>", body or "")
            v = m.group(1) if m else ""
            if 't="s"' in attrs and v != "":
                v = ss[int(v)]
            vals[ref] = v
        out.append(vals)
    if not out:
        return []
    hdr = out[0]
    keys = sorted(hdr, key=lambda c: (len(c), c))
    return [{hdr[k]: r.get(k, "") for k in keys} for r in out[1:]]


def read_csv_rows(path):
    """Relit un CSV de sortie (point-virgule) en liste de dictionnaires indexes par l'en-tete : le CSV technique (UTF-8, dates ISO) comme le CSV au format
    de LUXIS (ANSI cp1252, dates jj.mm.aaaa, CRLF). L'encodage est detecte : UTF-8 si le fichier s'y decode, sinon cp1252."""
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        raw = fh.read()
    try:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8-sig")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        text = raw.decode("cp1252")
    return list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text, newline=""), delimiter=";"))


def write_json(path, obj):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str), encoding="utf-8")

"""Validation des parametres. Aucune chaine libre n'entre dans le SQL : chaque valeur est typee ici, puis re-verifiee au rendu."""
import datetime as dt
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from .i18n import t
from .paths import load_config


class ParamError(ValueError):
    """Parametre invalide : le message est en francais et s'adresse a l'utilisateur."""


FUND_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9A-Z]{3,10}", re.ASCII)
ISO_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")
FR_RE = re.compile(r"([0-9]{2})/([0-9]{2})/([0-9]{4})")
INT_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]+")
MAX_ACCOUNT = 999999999
# Les trois periodes du Grand livre BCR (LuxRep Queries). Le nom est celui du parametre p_Period_Type de
# PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Grands_Livres : NULL (la plage demandee), LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY, TO_LAST_DATE_NAV.
BCR_PERIODS = ("plage", "last_available_day", "to_last_date_nav")
# Colonne de AMS_CASH_MVT sur laquelle une plage date_from/date_to est en plus filtree (demande du Reporting,
# 16/10/2026). "lots" est le comportement d'origine : seule la fenetre de lots borne le rapport.
DATE_COLUMNS = ("lots", "accounting", "trade", "value")


def parse_fund(v):
    s = str(v).strip() if v is not None else ""
    if not FUND_RE.fullmatch(s):
        raise ParamError(t("param.fund_invalid", v=repr(v)))
    return s


def parse_date(v, name=None):
    """Date reelle au format AAAA-MM-JJ (ou JJ/MM/AAAA, convertie). Retourne la forme AAAA-MM-JJ."""
    name = name or t("field.date")
    if v is None or v == "":
        return None
    if isinstance(v, dt.date):
        s = v.isoformat()
    else:
        s = str(v).strip()
        m = FR_RE.fullmatch(s)
        if m:
            s = f"{m.group(3)}-{m.group(2)}-{m.group(1)}"
    if not ISO_RE.fullmatch(s):
        raise ParamError(t("param.date_format", name=name, v=repr(v)))
    try:
        d = dt.date.fromisoformat(s)
    except ValueError:
        raise ParamError(t("param.date_unknown", name=name, v=repr(v))) from None
    if not 1990 <= d.year <= 2100:
        raise ParamError(t("param.date_range", name=name, v=repr(v)))
    return s


def parse_int(v, name, lo=0, hi=MAX_ACCOUNT):
    if v is None or v == "":
        return None
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        raise ParamError(t("param.invalid", name=name, v=repr(v)))
    s = str(v).strip()
    if not INT_RE.fullmatch(s):
        raise ParamError(t("param.int_expected", name=name, v=repr(v)))
    n = int(s)
    if not lo <= n <= hi:
        raise ParamError(t("param.int_range", name=name, lo=lo, hi=hi, n=n))
    return n


MAX_ACC_LIST = 500


def parse_int_list(v, name, lo=0, hi=MAX_ACCOUNT, max_n=MAX_ACC_LIST):
    """Liste explicite de numeros de compte : chaine separee par des virgules, ou sequence. Taille bornee (piege de troncature
    silencieuse de Dremio au-dela de quelques centaines de valeurs litterales, docs\\CODE.md)."""
    if v is None or v == () or v == []:
        return None
    parts = [x.strip() for x in v.split(",")] if isinstance(v, str) else list(v)
    parts = [p for p in parts if p not in (None, "")]
    if not parts:
        return None
    if len(parts) > max_n:
        raise ParamError(t("param.acc_list_too_many", n=len(parts), max=max_n))
    out, seen = [], set()
    for p in parts:
        n = parse_int(p, name, lo, hi)
        if n not in seen:
            seen.add(n)
            out.append(n)
    return tuple(out)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Params:
    fund: str
    output: str = "irp"
    period: int = 1
    bcr_period: str = "plage"
    rule: str = "corrige"
    source: str = "ic"
    nav_date: str = None
    calc_date: str = None
    date_from: str = None
    date_to: str = None
    acc_from: int = None
    acc_to: int = None
    acc_list: tuple = None
    formats: tuple = ("xlsx", "csv")
    compat: bool = False
    split_by_nav: bool = False
    prenav: bool = False
    follow_depooling: bool = False
    sans_luxis: bool = False
    date_column: str = "lots"
    notes: tuple = field(default=(), compare=False)

    @property
    def corrected(self):
        return self.rule == "corrige" and self.period in (13, 16)

    @property
    def range_mode(self):
        """Mode plage de l'IRP : un fichier continu par fonds entre deux dates (ou un fichier par NAV avec split_by_nav)."""
        return self.output == "irp" and bool(self.date_from)

    @property
    def date_filter(self):
        """Vrai si la plage demandee filtre aussi une colonne de date de AMS_CASH_MVT, en plus de la fenetre de lots."""
        return self.date_column != "lots"

    @property
    def bcr_nav_period(self):
        """Vrai si la fenetre du BCR est deduite de la table NAV (etape 18) et non de la plage demandee (etape 15)."""
        return self.output == "bcr" and self.bcr_period != "plage"

    @property
    def tag(self):
        date_column_suffix = {"accounting": "_dacc", "trade": "_dtrade", "value": "_dvalue"}.get(self.date_column, "")
        suffix = ("_corrige" if self.corrected else "") + ("_compat" if self.compat else "") + ("_prenav" if self.prenav else "") + ("_depooling" if self.follow_depooling else "") + ("_split" if self.split_by_nav and not self.range_mode else "") + ("_sansluxis" if self.sans_luxis else "") + date_column_suffix
        if self.range_mode:
            return f"{self.output}_{self.fund}_{self.date_to.replace('-', '')}_plage{self.date_from.replace('-', '')}_{self.source}" + suffix
        if self.bcr_nav_period:
            # La fenetre vient de la table NAV : la date demandee ne nomme pas la sortie, le mode la nomme.
            return f"{self.output}_{self.fund}_{self.bcr_period}_{self.source}" + suffix
        d = (self.nav_date or self.calc_date or self.date_to or "").replace("-", "")
        return f"{self.output}_{self.fund}_{d}_p{self.period}_{self.source}" + suffix

    def as_dict(self):
        return {"fonds": self.fund, "sortie": self.output, "periode": self.period, "periode_bcr": self.bcr_period, "regle": self.rule, "source": self.source,
                "date_nav": self.nav_date, "date_calcul": self.calc_date, "date_de": self.date_from, "date_a": self.date_to,
                "comptes_de": self.acc_from, "comptes_a": self.acc_to, "comptes_liste": list(self.acc_list) if self.acc_list else None, "formats": list(self.formats),
                "compat_gl_reference": self.compat, "plage": self.range_mode, "un_fichier_par_nav": self.split_by_nav, "pre_nav": self.prenav,
                "suivre_depooling": self.follow_depooling, "sans_luxis": self.sans_luxis, "colonne_date": self.date_column}


def validate(fund, output=None, period=None, rule=None, source=None, nav_date=None, calc_date=None, date_from=None,
             date_to=None, acc_from=None, acc_to=None, acc_list=None, formats=None, compat=None, split_by_nav=False, prenav=False,
             follow_depooling=False, sans_luxis=None, bcr_period=None, date_column=None, cfg=None):
    """Valide un jeu de paramÃ¨tres et applique les valeurs par dÃ©faut de config\\defaults.json."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    output = output or cfg["sortie"]
    if output not in ("irp", "bcr"):
        raise ParamError(t("param.output_invalid", v=repr(output)))
    period = parse_int(period if period is not None else cfg["periode"], t("field.period"), 0, 99)
    if period not in cfg["periodes_admises"]:
        raise ParamError(t("param.period_unsupported", period=period, codes=", ".join(str(p) for p in cfg["periodes_admises"])))
    bcr_period = (bcr_period or cfg.get("periode_bcr", "plage")).lower()
    if bcr_period not in BCR_PERIODS:
        raise ParamError(t("param.bcr_period_invalid", v=repr(bcr_period), codes=", ".join(BCR_PERIODS)))
    rule = (rule or "corrige").lower()
    if rule not in ("luxis", "corrige"):
        raise ParamError(t("param.rule_invalid", v=repr(rule)))
    source = (source or "ic").lower()
    # bu : couche BUSINESS de Dremio, essai du 06/10/2026 (docs\CHAINAGE-DONNEES.md). Mode hybride,
    # les ecritures restent sur l'Infocentre ; pas un mode de production.
    if source not in ("ic", "lx", "bu"):
        raise ParamError(t("param.source_invalid", v=repr(source)))
    if formats is None:
        formats = cfg["formats"]
    if isinstance(formats, str):
        formats = [x.strip().lower() for x in formats.split(",") if x.strip()]
    formats = tuple(dict.fromkeys(f.lower() for f in formats))
    bad = [f for f in formats if f not in ("xlsx", "csv")]
    if bad or not formats:
        raise ParamError(t("param.format_invalid", v=bad or formats))
    fund = parse_fund(fund)
    nav_date, calc_date = parse_date(nav_date, t("field.nav_date")), parse_date(calc_date, t("field.calc_date"))
    date_from, date_to = parse_date(date_from, t("field.date_from")), parse_date(date_to, t("field.date_to"))
    acc_from, acc_to = parse_int(acc_from, t("field.acc_from")), parse_int(acc_to, t("field.acc_to"))
    acc_list = parse_int_list(acc_list, t("field.acc_list"))
    if acc_list is not None and (acc_from is not None or acc_to is not None):
        raise ParamError(t("param.acc_list_exclusive"))
    compat = bool(cfg.get("compat_gl_reference", False)) if compat is None else bool(compat)
    sans_luxis = bool(cfg.get("sans_luxis", False)) if sans_luxis is None else bool(sans_luxis)
    if sans_luxis and source == "lx":
        raise ParamError(t("param.sans_luxis_lx"))
    notes = []
    if rule == "corrige" and period not in (13, 16):
        notes.append(t("note.rule_no_effect"))
    if output == "irp":
        if bool(date_from) != bool(date_to):
            raise ParamError(t("param.irp_range_both"))
        modes = [bool(nav_date), bool(calc_date), bool(date_from and date_to)]
        if sum(modes) != 1:
            raise ParamError(t("param.irp_one_form"))
        if date_from and date_to:
            if date_from > date_to:
                raise ParamError(t("param.irp_range_order"))
            if period != 1:
                raise ParamError(t("param.irp_range_period"))
        if split_by_nav and not (date_from and date_to):
            raise ParamError(t("param.split_range"))
        if follow_depooling and not (date_from and date_to):
            raise ParamError(t("param.depooling_range"))
        if follow_depooling and split_by_nav:
            raise ParamError(t("param.depooling_split"))
        if bcr_period != "plage":
            # Les trois periodes sont celles du Grand livre BCR : le rapport 17 n'en a pas, il lit ses propres dates.
            notes.append(t("note.bcr_period_irp_only", mode=bcr_period))
            bcr_period = "plage"
    else:
        if split_by_nav or prenav or follow_depooling:
            raise ParamError(t("param.bcr_irp_options"))
        if nav_date or calc_date:
            raise ParamError(t("param.bcr_range_not_nav"))
        if bcr_period == "plage":
            if not (date_from and date_to):
                raise ParamError(t("param.bcr_range_both"))
            if date_from > date_to:
                raise ParamError(t("param.bcr_range_order"))
        else:
            # Modes LAST_AVAILABLE_DAY et TO_LAST_DATE_NAV : la fenetre vient de la table NAV de LUXIS
            # (etape 18), que le mode sans LUXIS est justement fait pour eviter.
            if sans_luxis:
                raise ParamError(t("param.bcr_nav_sans_luxis", mode=bcr_period))
            if bcr_period == "to_last_date_nav":
                # LUXIS lit la date de debut demandee et deduit la date de fin : get_Date_Published_Period.
                if not date_from:
                    raise ParamError(t("param.bcr_nav_date_from_needed"))
                if date_to:
                    notes.append(t("note.bcr_nav_date_to_ignored"))
                    date_to = None
            elif date_from or date_to:
                # LUXIS ne lit aucune des deux dates : get_Date_Last_Available_Day n'a que le fonds et SYSDATE.
                notes.append(t("note.bcr_nav_dates_ignored"))
                date_from = date_to = None
        if period != 1:
            raise ParamError(t("param.bcr_period"))
        if acc_list is None:
            if acc_from is None:
                acc_from = cfg["comptes"]["bcr"]["de"]
            if acc_to is None:
                acc_to = cfg["comptes"]["bcr"]["a"]
    if output == "irp" and acc_list is None:
        acc_from = acc_from if acc_from is not None else cfg["comptes"]["irp"]["de"]
        acc_to = acc_to if acc_to is not None else cfg["comptes"]["irp"]["a"]
    if acc_from is not None and acc_to is not None and acc_from > acc_to:
        raise ParamError(t("param.acc_reversed", a=acc_from, b=acc_to))
    date_column = (date_column or cfg.get("colonne_date", "lots")).lower()
    if date_column not in DATE_COLUMNS:
        raise ParamError(t("param.date_column_invalid", v=repr(date_column), codes=", ".join(DATE_COLUMNS)))
    if date_column != "lots":
        # La colonne choisie filtre AMS_CASH_MVT en plus de la fenetre de lots : il faut une plage demandee et
        # lue telle quelle, pas une fenetre deduite de la table NAV ni remplacee par une NAV unique.
        range_requested = bool(date_from and date_to) and (output == "irp" or bcr_period == "plage")
        if not range_requested:
            raise ParamError(t("param.date_column_range_only"))
        if split_by_nav:
            raise ParamError(t("param.date_column_split"))
    return Params(fund, output, period, bcr_period, rule, source, nav_date, calc_date, date_from, date_to, acc_from, acc_to, acc_list, formats, compat,
                  bool(split_by_nav), bool(prenav), bool(follow_depooling), sans_luxis, date_column, tuple(notes))

"""Chemins et configuration de l'application General Ledger.

Tous les chemins sont calcules a partir de l'emplacement du paquet : aucun chemin absolu n'est ecrit dans un fichier.
L'application vit dans le dossier User Guides de la racine BA Assistant ; la racine est donc deux niveaux au-dessus.
"""
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True

APP_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def _root(app_dir):
    """Racine BA Assistant : le dossier qui contient User Guides.

    En place, c'est deux niveaux au-dessus de l'application. Un arbre de travail git la met plus bas,
    d'un niveau (User Guides\\general-ledger-app.worktrees\\<branche>) ou de deux
    (.claude\\worktrees\\<branche>) : chercher le dossier User Guides couvre les trois cas.
    """
    for i, p in enumerate(app_dir.parents):
        if p.name == "User Guides":
            return app_dir.parents[i + 1]
    return app_dir.parent.parent


ROOT = _root(APP_DIR)
CONFIG_PATH = APP_DIR / "config" / "defaults.json"
SQL_DIR = APP_DIR / "sql"
VIEWS_DIR = SQL_DIR / "views"
TEMPLATES_DIR = APP_DIR / "templates"


def load_config(path=None):
    with open(path or CONFIG_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


DEFAULT_SERVER = "intg"


def dremio_server(cfg=None):
    """Serveur Dremio actif (clÃ© dremio.serveur), en minuscules ; intg si la clÃ© est absente."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    return str((cfg.get("dremio") or {}).get("serveur") or DEFAULT_SERVER).strip().lower()


def allowed_servers(cfg=None):
    """Serveurs Dremio admis par la configuration (dremio.serveurs_admis) ; intg seul si la clÃ© est absente."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    return [str(s).lower() for s in (cfg.get("dremio") or {}).get("serveurs_admis") or [DEFAULT_SERVER]]


def dremio_labels(cfg=None):
    """Section dremio du serveur actif : les libellÃ©s propres au serveur (dremio.par_serveur.<serveur>) remplacent ceux par dÃ©faut (INTG)."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    d = cfg.get("dremio") or {}
    return {**d, **((d.get("par_serveur") or {}).get(dremio_server(cfg)) or {})}


def with_server(cfg, server):
    """Copie de la configuration pointÃ©e sur un autre serveur Dremio ; None garde celui de la configuration."""
    if server is None:
        return cfg
    new = dict(cfg)
    new["dremio"] = {**(cfg.get("dremio") or {}), "serveur": str(server).strip().lower()}
    return new


def build_dir(cfg=None):
    """Dossier du client Dremio verrouillÃ© (dremio_sql.py) et du contrÃ´le SQL (sql_check.py) : fixe, dans le dÃ©pÃ´t BA Assistant."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    return ROOT / Path(*cfg["client_dremio"]["dossier_relatif_a_la_racine"].split("/"))


def reference_workbook(kind, cfg=None):
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    return ROOT / Path(*cfg["references_luxis"][kind]["classeur"].split("/"))


def output_dir(cfg=None):
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    return APP_DIR / cfg["dossier_sortie"]


def logs_dir(cfg=None):
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    return APP_DIR / cfg["dossier_journaux"]


NAME_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,60}")
FORBIDDEN_PARTS = {"_private", "projects", ".github", ".claude", ".git"}


def _t(key, **kw):
    from .i18n import t
    return t(key, **kw)


class PathError(ValueError):
    """Chemin ou nom refusÃ© : le message s'adresse Ã  l'utilisateur."""


def safe_name(name):
    """Nom de dossier de lot : lettres, chiffres, tiret bas et tiret, 60 caractÃ¨res au plus."""
    if not NAME_RE.fullmatch(name or ""):
        raise PathError(_t("path.name_invalid", v=repr(name)))
    return name


def safe_output_dir(path, cfg=None):
    """Dossier de sortie : dans le dÃ©pÃ´t de l'application (ou dans une racine autorisÃ©e par la configuration), jamais dans
    _private, Projects, .github, .claude ni .git."""
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    if path is None or str(path).strip() == "":
        return output_dir(cfg)
    p = (Path(path) if Path(path).is_absolute() else Path.cwd() / path).resolve()
    allowed = [APP_DIR.resolve()] + [Path(x).resolve() for x in cfg.get("sorties_hors_depot_autorisees", [])]
    if not any(p == a or a in p.parents for a in allowed):
        raise PathError(_t("path.out_outside"))
    rel = p.relative_to(next(a for a in allowed if p == a or a in p.parents))
    if any(part.lower() in FORBIDDEN_PARTS for part in rel.parts):
        raise PathError(_t("path.out_reserved"))
    return p

def case_summary(case):
    """Chiffres d'un cas de dÃ©monstration, communs au texte et au HTML."""
    res = case["res"]
    c = res.controls
    cmp = res.comparison
    out = {"titre": case["titre"], "lignes": len(res.rows), "comptes": c["comptes"], "secondes": res.seconds, "requetes": len(res.queries),
           "statut": res.status, "parametres": res.params.as_dict(), "resolu": res.resolved, "fonds": f"{res.fund.get('F_NAME')} ({res.fund.get('F_CCY')})"}
    if cmp is not None:
        out["rapprochement"] = {"reference": res.reference, "lignes_reference": cmp["lignes_reference"], "lignes_identiques": cmp["lignes_identiques_toutes_colonnes"],
                                "meme_rang": cmp["lignes_identiques_au_meme_rang"], "colonnes": cmp["colonnes"],
                                "colonnes_identiques": max(cmp["colonnes_identiques_au_meme_rang"], cmp["colonnes_identiques_a_l_ordre_pres_dans_la_cle"]),
                                "identique": cmp["identique"] or cmp["identique_a_l_ordre_pres_dans_la_cle"], "phrase": C.describe(cmp)}
    return out

"""Mode sans LUXIS (--sans-luxis) : aucune table LUXIS lue a l'execution.

Les champs que le mode LUXIS lit dans Table Fonds (TAB_FND_MAIN) et dans la table NAV de LUXIS viennent de MFGA, et, la ou MFGA ne concorde pas

def fiche(row, fund):

def exception_rows():

def exception_subquery(funds):
    """Sous-requÃªte qui tient lieu de GL_FUND_EXCEPTIONS pour quelques fonds (tests des vues, rien n'est crÃ©Ã©) : un SELECT de constantes par fonds,
    rÃ©unis par UNION ALL (jamais de VALUES). Un fonds sans exception n'a pas de ligne ; aucune ligne du tout rend une sous-requÃªte vide."""
    import re as _re
    by_fund = {r["SubFund Number"]: r for r in exception_rows()}
    parts = []
    for f in funds:
        r = by_fund.get(f)
        if r is None:
            continue

            raise ValueError(f)
        lit = lambda v: "CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)" if v == "" else f"'{v}'"
        date = "CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)" if not r["First NAV Date"] else f"TIMESTAMP '{r['First NAV Date']} 00:00:00'"
        parts.append(f"SELECT '{f}' AS \"SubFund Number\", {lit(r['SubFund Ccy'])} AS \"SubFund Ccy\", {lit(r['First NAV Rule'])} AS \"First NAV Rule\", "
                     f"{date} AS \"First NAV Date\", '{r['eFront']}' AS \"eFront\", '{r['NAV Backdated']}' AS \"NAV Backdated\", "
                     f"'{r['Outside Table Fonds']}' AS \"Outside Table Fonds\"")

        parts.append("SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS \"SubFund Number\", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS \"SubFund Ccy\", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS \"First NAV Rule\", "
                     "CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS \"First NAV Date\", 'N' AS \"eFront\", 'N' AS \"NAV Backdated\", 'N' AS \"Outside Table Fonds\" FROM (SELECT 1 AS X) z WHERE z.X = 0")
    return "(" + " UNION ALL ".join(parts) + ")"

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-general-ledger\glapp\sqlrender.py =====
"""Rendu des modeles SQL.

Un modele est un fichier sql\\*.sql. Il contient :
  - des commentaires de ligne entiere (commencant par deux tirets) : retires du SQL envoye a Dremio ;
  - des marqueurs {{NOM}} remplaces par une valeur validee (fonds, date, entier, table de la source choisie) ;
  - des blocs conditionnels, sur des lignes seules : --#SI DRAPEAU, --#SINON, --#FIN.
Aucun autre texte ne peut entrer dans la requete : une valeur qui n'a pas le bon type est refusee.
"""
import datetime as dt
import re

from .i18n import t
from .paths import SQL_DIR, load_config

PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"\{\{([A-Z_]+)\}\}")
BLOCK = re.compile(r"^\s*--#(SI|SINON|FIN)\b\s*([A-Z_0-9]*)\s*$")

KINDS = {
    "FUND": "fund", "PLAN": "plan",
    "NAV": "ts", "CALC": "ts", "DATE_FROM": "ts", "DATE_TO": "ts", "CLOSING_NAV": "ts?", "TRADE_MAX": "ts", "TODAY": "ts",
    "LOT_FROM": "int", "LOT_TO": "int", "LOT_RESULT_FROM": "int", "CLOSING_LOT": "int?",
    "ACC_FROM": "int", "ACC_TO": "int", "ACC_LIST": "int_list", "SEUIL_RESULTAT": "int", "LIMIT": "int",
    "ANTIDATE": "int", "FIRST_NAV": "ts", "CCY": "ccy",
}
TABLES = ("AMS_LOT", "AMS_CASH_MVT", "AMS_PORTFOLIO", "AMS_ACC_DEF", "AMS_ACC_LINK_CHARTS", "AMS_ACC_POS")
OPTIONAL_TABLES = ("AMS_NAV_ARC_SHARE_DETAIL", "AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL")
ISO = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")
INT_MAX = 2 ** 62


class RenderError(ValueError):
    pass


def _literal(name, kind, value):
    nullable = kind.endswith("?")
    base = kind.rstrip("?")
    if value is None:
        if not nullable:
            raise RenderError(t("render.absent_value", name=name))
        return "CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)" if base == "ts" else "CAST(NULL AS BIGINT)"
    if base == "plan":
        s = str(value)
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Z]{1,6}", s, re.ASCII):
            raise RenderError(t("render.plan_invalid", name=name))
        return f"'{s}'"
    if base == "ccy":
        s = str(value)
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z]{3}", s, re.ASCII):
            raise RenderError(t("render.ccy_invalid", name=name))
        return f"'{s}'"
    if base == "fund":
        s = str(value)
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Z]{3,10}", s, re.ASCII):
            raise RenderError(t("render.fund_invalid", name=name))
        return f"'{s}'"
    if base == "ts":
        s = value.isoformat() if isinstance(value, dt.date) else str(value)
        if not ISO.fullmatch(s):
            raise RenderError(t("render.date_invalid", name=name))
        try:
            dt.date.fromisoformat(s)
        except ValueError:
            raise RenderError(t("render.date_unknown", name=name)) from None
        return f"TIMESTAMP '{s} 00:00:00'"
    if base == "int":
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or not 0 <= value < INT_MAX:
            raise RenderError(t("render.int_invalid", name=name))
        return str(value)
    if base == "int_list":
        # Clause IN(...) de litteraux, jamais une jointure sur table/VALUES : au-dela de quelques
        # centaines de valeurs litterales Dremio tronque silencieusement sans erreur (docs\CODE.md).
        seq = tuple(value)
        if not seq:
            raise RenderError(t("render.int_list_empty", name=name))
        nums = []
        for v in seq:
            if isinstance(v, bool) or not isinstance(v, int) or not 0 <= v < INT_MAX:
                raise RenderError(t("render.int_invalid", name=name))
            nums.append(str(v))
        return "(" + ", ".join(nums) + ")"
    raise RenderError(t("render.kind_unknown", kind=kind))


def source_tables(source, cfg=None):
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    src = cfg["sources"][source]
    t = {f"TBL_{k}": src[k] for k in TABLES}
    # Tables lues seulement par le mode sans LUXIS (Infocentre MFGA) : absentes de la copie LUXIS.
    t.update({f"TBL_{k}": src[k] for k in OPTIONAL_TABLES if k in src})
    # Trois tables transverses. Une source peut les redefinir (mode bu : Table Fonds de la couche
    # BUSINESS) ; sans cle propre, c'est la valeur commune qui s'applique, comme pour ic et lx.
    com = cfg["sources"]
    t["TBL_TFM"] = src.get("table_fonds", com["table_fonds"])
    t["TBL_NAV"] = src.get("table_nav", com["table_nav"])
    t["TBL_PLAN"] = src.get("plan_comptable_rubriques", com["plan_comptable_rubriques"])
    return t


def template_path(name):
    return SQL_DIR / f"{name}.sql"


def load_template(name):
    p = template_path(name)
    if not p.is_file():
        raise RenderError(t("render.template_missing", name=name))
    return p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")


def _apply_blocks(text, flags):
    out, stack = [], []
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        m = BLOCK.match(line)
        if not m:
            if all(stack):
                out.append(line)
            continue
        word, flag = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        if word == "SI":
            if not flag:
                raise RenderError(t("render.if_no_flag"))
            stack.append(flag in flags)
        elif word == "SINON":
            if not stack:
                raise RenderError(t("render.else_no_if"))
            stack[-1] = not stack[-1]
        else:
            if not stack:
                raise RenderError(t("render.end_no_if"))
            stack.pop()
    if stack:
        raise RenderError(t("render.if_not_closed"))
    return "\n".join(out)


def render(text, values=None, flags=(), source="ic", keep_comments=False, cfg=None, symbolic=False):
    """Rend un modele : blocs, valeurs typees, tables de la source. Retourne le SQL (une seule instruction).

    symbolic=True laisse un jeton <NOM> a la place d'une valeur absente : pour l'affichage seulement (show-sql), jamais pour l'execution.
    """
    values, flags = values or {}, set(flags)
    tables = source_tables(source, cfg)
    body = _apply_blocks(text, flags)

    def sub(m):
        name = m.group(1)
        if name in tables:
            return tables[name]
        if name not in KINDS:
            raise RenderError(t("render.marker_unknown", name=name))
        if name not in values:
            if symbolic:
                return f"<{name}>"
            raise RenderError(t("render.missing_value", name=name))
        return _literal(name, KINDS[name], values[name])

    lines = [ln.rstrip() for ln in body.split("\n")]
    code = []
    for ln in lines:
        if not ln.lstrip().startswith("--"):
            ln = PLACEHOLDER.sub(sub, ln)
            if "{{" in ln or "}}" in ln:
                raise RenderError(t("render.marker_unresolved"))
            code.append(ln)
    if ";" in "\n".join(code):
        raise RenderError(t("render.semicolon"))
    out = lines if keep_comments else code
    sql = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", "\n".join(out)).strip("\n")
    return sql + "\n"

def render_step(name, values=None, flags=(), source="ic", keep_comments=False, cfg=None, symbolic=False):
    return render(load_template(name), values, flags, source, keep_comments, cfg, symbolic)



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-general-ledger\glapp\web.py =====
"""Page locale (navigateur), seul mode de lancement de l'application : python -m glapp.
Aucune validation ni execution n'est dupliquee ici, tout passe par glapp.service. Serveur lie a 127.0.0.1 uniquement, bibliotheque
standard seulement (http.server), aucune ressource externe dans les pages. Une seule execution a la fois : une deuxieme est refusee.

Le jeton de session Dremio peut etre colle depuis cette page (route /api/dremio/token) : il n'est jamais renvoye, journalise ni

comme `login --token` en ligne de commande ; aucun mecanisme de stockage parallele n'est introduit ici.
"""
import json
import socket

import webbrowser
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

def _dremio_module(cfg):
    """Le client Dremio verrouille (dremio_sql.py), importe comme glapp.dremio le fait deja : jamais copie ni modifie."""
    bd = str(build_dir(cfg))
    if bd not in sys.path:

def submit_dremio_token(raw, env, cfg):
    """Valide puis enregistre un jeton de session Dremio colle depuis la page, comme `dremio_sql.py login --token`.
    Le jeton n'est jamais journalise ni renvoye : seule une exception (sans le jeton dans son message) peut sortir d'ici."""
    raw = (raw or "").strip().strip('"')
    if not raw:
        raise ValueError(t("web.token_missing"))
    dremio_sql = _dremio_module(cfg)
    scheme = "Bearer" if raw.startswith("eyJ") else "_dremio"
    token = raw[len("_dremio"):] if raw.startswith("_dremio") else raw
    header = ("Bearer " if scheme == "Bearer" else "_dremio") + token
    try:
        dremio_sql.Client(header, env=env).call("GET", "/api/v3/catalog")
    except dremio_sql.DremioError as exc:
        raise ValueError(str(exc)) from None
    dremio_sql.save_token(token, scheme, env)


class Job:
    """Etat de l'unique execution en cours ou terminee : protege par un verrou, lu par /api/status."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.reset()

    def reset(self):
        self.busy = False
        self.kind = None
        self.log = []
        self.done = False
        self.error = None
        self.result = None
        self.folders = []

    def start(self, kind, worker):
        with self.lock:
            if self.busy:
                return False
            self.reset()
            self.busy = True
            self.kind = kind
        threading.Thread(target=self._run, args=(worker,), daemon=True).start()
        return True

    def _progress(self, text):
        with self.lock:
            self.log.append(text)

    def _run(self, worker):
        try:
            result, folders = worker(self._progress)
            with self.lock:
                self.result, self.folders = result, folders
        except AuthExpired as exc:
            with self.lock:
                self.error = str(exc)
        except EfrontRefused as exc:
            with self.lock:
                self.error = t("cli.err.refused", exc=exc)
        except EXPECTED_ERRORS as exc:
            with self.lock:
                self.error = t("cli.err.error", exc=exc)
        except Exception as exc:  # une exception imprevue ne doit pas figer le serveur
            with self.lock:
                self.error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
        finally:
            with self.lock:
                self.busy = False
                self.done = True

    def snapshot(self):
        with self.lock:
            files = []
            for folder in self.folders:
                if folder and folder.is_dir():
                    files.extend(sorted(p.name for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_file()))
            return {"busy": self.busy, "kind": self.kind, "log": list(self.log), "done": self.done,
                    "error": self.error, "result": self.result, "files": files}


def _result_dict(res):
    """Un RunResult (ou le resultat d'un mode plage) en dictionnaire JSON : memes donnees que print_result (cli.py) et
    _insert_result (gui.py), sans aucune logique nouvelle."""
    if hasattr(res, "results"):
        labels = [{"fund": r.params.fund, "role": role_label(r.depooling["role"])} if res.depooling else {} for r in res.results]
        return {"split": True, "results": [{**_single_result(r), **label} for r, label in zip(res.results, labels)], "queries": len(res.queries), "seconds": res.seconds,
                "depooling": bool(res.depooling)}
    return {"split": False, **_single_result(res)}


def _single_result(res):
    preview_cols = list(res.rows[0].keys()) if res.rows else []
    return {
        "folder": str(res.folder) if res.folder else None,
        "files": list(res.files) if res.files else [],
        "verdicts": [{"name": n, "value": str(v), "verdict": verdict_label(ve), "expl": ex} for n, v, ve, ex in res.verdicts],
        "notes": list(res.notes),
        "conformite": res.conformite,
        "comparison": res.comparison,
        "reference": res.reference,
        "nature": res.nature,
        "status": res.status,
        "lines": len(res.rows),
        "queries": len(res.queries),
        "seconds": res.seconds,
        "preview_columns": preview_cols,
        "preview_rows": [[str(r.get(c, "")) for c in preview_cols] for r in res.rows[:20]],
    }


def _fields_from(body):
    return {k: body.get(k) for k in service.FIELDS}


def run_job(fields, cfg):
    def worker(progress):
        res = service.run_fields(fields, compare_ref=True, nature=True, progress=progress, cfg=cfg)
        if hasattr(res, "results"):
            folders = [r.folder for r in res.results if r.folder]
        else:
            folders = [res.folder] if getattr(res, "folder", None) else []
        return _result_dict(res), folders
    return worker


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "GeneralLedgerWeb/1"
    job: Job = None
    cfg = None

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # journal silencieux : jamais le corps d'une requete (pas de jeton)
        pass

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ aides
    def _send(self, status, body, content_type="application/json; charset=utf-8"):
        data = body if isinstance(body, bytes) else body.encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def _json(self, status, obj):
        self._send(status, json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))

    def _error(self, status, message):
        self._json(status, {"error": message})

    def _body(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        raw = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
        if not raw:
            return {}
        return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))

    def _static(self, name, content_type):
        path = STATIC_DIR / name
        if not path.is_file():
            self._error(404, "not found")
            return
        self._send(200, path.read_bytes(), content_type)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ routes
    def do_GET(self):
        split = urlsplit(self.path)
        path = split.path
        lang = (parse_qs(split.query).get("lang") or [None])[0]
        if lang in ("fr", "en"):
            i18n.set_lang(lang)
        if path == "/":
            self._static("index.html", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        elif path == "/app.css":
            self._static("app.css", "text/css; charset=utf-8")
        elif path == "/app.js":
            self._static("app.js", "application/javascript; charset=utf-8")
        elif path == "/api/config":
            self._json(200, self._config_payload())
        elif path == "/api/status":
            self._json(200, self.job.snapshot())
        elif path == "/api/dremio/status":
            self._dremio_status()
        elif path == "/api/download":
            self._download()
        elif path == "/api/accounts":
            self._accounts()
        elif path == "/api/funds":
            self._funds()
        else:
            self._error(404, "not found")

    def do_POST(self):
        path = urlsplit(self.path).path
        try:
            body = self._body()
        except ValueError:
            self._error(400, "corps JSON invalide")
            return
        if path == "/api/run":
            self._start(body)
        elif path == "/api/dremio/token":
            self._dremio_token(body)
        else:
            self._error(404, "not found")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ implementation
    def _config_payload(self):
        cfg = self.cfg
        return {
            "lang": i18n.get_lang(),
            "server": dremio_server(cfg),
            "servers_allowed": allowed_servers(cfg),
            "periods": cfg["periodes_admises"],
            "period_labels": cfg.get("libelles_periodes_luxis", {}),
            "bcr_periods": list(BCR_PERIODS),
            "bcr_period_labels": {code: t("bcr_period." + code) for code in BCR_PERIODS},
            "date_columns": list(DATE_COLUMNS),
            "date_column_labels": {code: t("date_column." + code) for code in DATE_COLUMNS},
            "defaults": {"output": cfg["sortie"], "period": cfg["periode"], "bcr_period": cfg.get("periode_bcr", "plage"),
                         "date_column": cfg.get("colonne_date", "lots"), "formats": cfg["formats"]},
            "texts": {key: t(key) for key in _TEXT_KEYS},
        }

    def _dremio_status(self):
        qs = parse_qs(urlsplit(self.path).query)
        env = (qs.get("env") or [dremio_server(self.cfg)])[0]
        if env not in allowed_servers(self.cfg):
            self._error(400, t("dremio.server_unknown", server=env, known=", ".join(allowed_servers(self.cfg))))
            return
        cfg = load_config()
        cfg["dremio"] = {**cfg.get("dremio", {}), "serveur": env}
        ok, _msg = Gateway(cfg=cfg).probe()
        self._json(200, {"env": env, "connected": ok,
                         "label": t("web.dremio_connected") if ok else t("web.dremio_disconnected")})

    def _dremio_token(self, body):
        env = body.get("env") or dremio_server(self.cfg)
        if env not in allowed_servers(self.cfg):
            self._error(400, t("dremio.server_unknown", server=env, known=", ".join(allowed_servers(self.cfg))))
            return
        try:
            submit_dremio_token(body.get("token"), env, self.cfg)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self._json(400, {"accepted": False, "message": t("web.token_refused", exc=exc)})
            return
        self._json(200, {"accepted": True, "message": t("web.token_accepted", env=env.upper())})

    def _accounts(self):
        qs = parse_qs(urlsplit(self.path).query)
        fund = (qs.get("fund") or [""])[0].strip()
        output = (qs.get("output") or ["irp"])[0]
        if not fund:
            self._error(400, t("web.accounts_fund_missing"))
            return
        try:
            comptes = account_catalogue(fund, output, Gateway(cfg=self.cfg), cfg=self.cfg)
        except EXPECTED_ERRORS as exc:
            self._error(400, str(exc))
            return
        self._json(200, {"comptes": comptes})

    def _funds(self):
        try:
            fonds = fund_catalogue(Gateway(cfg=self.cfg), cfg=self.cfg)
        except EXPECTED_ERRORS as exc:
            self._error(400, str(exc))
            return
        self._json(200, {"fonds": fonds})

    def _start(self, body):
        action = body.get("action")
        fields = _fields_from(body)
        cfg = self.cfg
        if action != "run":
            self._error(400, t("web.bad_action", action=action))
            return
        worker = run_job(fields, cfg)
        if not self.job.start(action, worker):
            self._error(409, t("web.busy"))
            return
        self._json(202, {"started": True})

    def _download(self):
        qs = parse_qs(urlsplit(self.path).query)
        name = (qs.get("name") or [""])[0]
        folders = self.job.folders
        if not folders or "/" in name or "\\" in name or name in ("", "..", "."):
            self._error(400, t("web.download_refused"))
            return
        for folder in folders:
            try:
                safe_output_dir(folder, self.cfg)
            except PathError:
                continue
            target = (folder / name).resolve()
            if target.is_relative_to(folder.resolve()) and target.is_file():
                content_type = "text/csv; charset=utf-8" if target.suffix.lower() == ".csv" else "application/octet-stream"
                self._send(200, target.read_bytes(), content_type)
                return
        self._error(404, t("web.download_missing", name=name))


_TEXT_KEYS = ("webui.title", "webui.heading", "webui.dremio_section", "webui.dremio_token_label", "webui.dremio_token_submit",
             "webui.dremio_check", "webui.run", "webui.log_title",
             "webui.checks_title", "webui.preview_title", "webui.downloads_title", "webui.ready",
             "gui.fund", "gui.output", "gui.period", "gui.bcr_period", "gui.nav_date", "gui.calc_date", "gui.date_from", "gui.date_to",
             "gui.date_column", "gui.acc_from", "gui.acc_to", "gui.acc_list", "gui.load_accounts", "gui.formats", "gui.language",
             "report.th.check", "report.th.value", "report.th.verdict", "webui.output_hint_irp", "webui.output_hint_bcr",
             "web.accounts_fund_missing")


def _free_port(preferred):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:
        try:
            s.bind(("127.0.0.1", preferred))
            return preferred
        except OSError:
            s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
            return s.getsockname()[1]


def main(cfg=None, port=8765, open_browser=True):
    cfg = cfg or load_config()
    port = _free_port(port)
    Handler.job = Job()
    Handler.cfg = cfg
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), Handler)
    print(t("web.starting", port=port), flush=True)
    if open_browser:
        url = "http:" + "//127.0.0.1:" + f"{port}/"
        threading.Timer(0.3, lambda: webbrowser.open(url)).start()
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
    return 0
