"""Suivi du depooling (--follow-depooling) : table de correspondance, un rapport par ancien feeder puis celui du pool, controles par rapport. Sans Dremio."""
import io
import json
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from glapp import checks, depooling, engine, params as P
from glapp.paths import APP_DIR, load_config
from tests.unit.test_conformity import pos, row
from tests.unit.test_engine import FakeGateway

CFG = load_config()
POOL_ROW = [{"FA_NUM": "745635", "F_NAME": "PICTET-DYNAMIC ASSET ALLOCATION", "F_CCY": "GBP", "EFRONT": "0", "NAV_BACKDATED": "0"}]


def window(lot_from, lot_to):
    return [{"NAV_TO": "2026-06-30 00:00:00.000", "NAV_FROM": "2026-06-01 00:00:00.000", "LOT_FROM": lot_from, "LOT_TO": lot_to, "TRADE_DATE_MAX": None, "LOT_RESULT_FROM": None}]


def feeder_rows():
    return [{**row(14080, 5, 120, 1, 110.0, way="CR", amt=110.0), "FONDS_ORIGINE": "745642"}, {**row(14081, 6, 120, 2, -110.0, way="DB", amt=110.0), "FONDS_ORIGINE": "745642"}]


def pool_rows():
    return [{**row(14080, 7, 170, 1, 50.0, way="CR", amt=50.0), "FONDS_ORIGINE": "745635"}, {**row(14081, 8, 170, 2, -50.0, way="DB", amt=50.0), "FONDS_ORIGINE": "745635"}]


def pool_pre_transfert_rows():
    """Lot avant le transfert (100,159] : une ligne Futures (compte 63000, qu'aucun feeder ne porte) et une ligne sur un compte
    (14080) que le feeder porte deja : double compte possible, demande de Stephan CREMONI du 12/10/2026 (voir dep.note.combined_file)."""
    return [{**row(63000, 9, 140, 1, 25.0, way="CR", amt=25.0), "FONDS_ORIGINE": "745635"},
            {**row(14080, 9, 145, 2, 30.0, way="CR", amt=30.0), "FONDS_ORIGINE": "745635"}]


class Smart(FakeGateway):
    """Reponse selon le fonds lu dans le SQL, comme Dremio."""

    def __init__(self, feeder=True, state_rows=None):
        super().__init__({})
        self.feeder, self.state_rows = feeder, state_rows or {}

    def query(self, name, sql, max_rows=None, timeout=None):
        self.queries.append((name, sql))
        is_feeder = "'745642'" in sql
        if name == "00_fonds":
            rows = POOL_ROW
        elif name == "15_fenetre_bcr":
            rows = window(100, 150) if is_feeder and self.feeder else window(100, 300) if not is_feeder else []
            if is_feeder and not self.feeder:
                rows = window(150, 150)
        elif name == "20_ecritures":
            if is_feeder:
                rows = feeder_rows()
            elif "N_LOT > 100 AND c.N_LOT <= 159" in sql:
                rows = pool_pre_transfert_rows()
            else:
                rows = pool_rows()
        elif name == "35_soldes_finaux":
            rows = [pos(14080, 110.0 if is_feeder else 50.0), pos(14081, -110.0 if is_feeder else -50.0)]
        elif name == "50_lot_de_transfert":
            rows = [{"LOT_TRANSFERT": 160, "NAV_TRANSFERT": "2026-06-26 00:00:00.000"}]
        else:
            rows = []
        self.log.append({"name": name, "job": "j", "rows": len(rows), "seconds": 0.0})
        return rows

    def sqls(self, name):
        return [s for n, s in self.queries if n == name]


def follow(gw, fund="745635", **kw):
    """Lance le suivi ; retourne le SplitResult et, pour chaque rapport, ses fichiers : {fonds: {nom du fichier: octets}}."""
    p = P.validate(fund, date_from="2026-06-01", date_to="2026-06-30", follow_depooling=True, formats="csv,xlsx", cfg=CFG)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=APP_DIR / "out") as d:
        res = depooling.run_follow(p, gw, out_root=d, cfg=CFG, **kw)
        files = {r.params.fund: {n: (Path(d) / r.params.tag / n).read_bytes() for n in r.files if not n.endswith(".json")} for r in res.results}
        folders = {r.params.fund: r.params.tag for r in res.results}
        res.folders = folders
        return res, files


class TableTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_table_holds_the_structures_of_the_saved_fund_table(self):
        """Table du 06/10/2026 : les 24 structures de la Table Fonds sauvegardee, plus 342202 qu'elle ne contient pas (tools\\depooling_table_fonds.py)."""
        t = depooling.load_table()
        self.assertEqual(t["convention"], "pool_garde_son_numero")
        self.assertEqual(len(t["structures"]), 25)
        self.assertEqual(sum(1 for s in t["structures"] if s["etat"] == "constate"), 24)
        self.assertEqual(sum(1 for s in t["structures"] for _ in s["feeders"]), 86)
        pools = {s["pool"] for s in t["structures"]}
        for june in ("264212", "231433", "230836", "745635"):
            self.assertIn(june, pools)
        self.assertEqual(depooling.find(t, "745642"), (next(s for s in t["structures"] if s["pool"] == "745635"), "feeder"))
        self.assertEqual(depooling.find(t, "745635")[1], "pool")
        self.assertEqual(depooling.find(t, "242013"), (None, None))
        self.assertEqual(depooling.find(t, "20304E")[0]["pool"], "280334")  # un ancien feeder alphanumerique

    def test_every_observed_structure_carries_its_date_and_lot(self):
        t = depooling.load_table()
        for s in t["structures"]:
            if s["etat"] != "constate":
                continue
            self.assertRegex(s["date_depooling"], r"^20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$", s["pool"])
            self.assertIsInstance(s["lot_depooling"], int, s["pool"])
            self.assertEqual(s["source_etat"], "table_fonds_sauvegardee", s["pool"])
            self.assertTrue(s["feeders"], s["pool"])
        d = {s["pool"]: (s["date_depooling"], s.get("lot_depooling"), s["etat"]) for s in t["structures"]}
        self.assertEqual(d["745635"], ("2026-06-25", 8597564, "constate"))
        self.assertEqual(d["231433"], ("2026-06-15", 8578376, "constate"))
        self.assertEqual(d["280306"], ("2026-07-13", 8626815, "constate"))
        self.assertEqual(d["280513"], ("2026-07-15", 8631319, "constate"))
        self.assertEqual(d["342202"][2], "absent_de_la_table_fonds")  # structure heritee que le classeur ne contient pas

    def test_lots_grow_with_the_dates(self):
        """Un lot MFGA est un numero croissant : les structures classees par date sont aussi classees par lot."""
        obs = [(s["date_depooling"], s["lot_depooling"], s["pool"]) for s in depooling.load_table()["structures"] if s["etat"] == "constate"]
        self.assertEqual(sorted(obs), sorted(obs, key=lambda x: (x[1], x[0], x[2])))

    def test_invalid_tables_are_refused(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=APP_DIR / "out") as dd:
            bad = {"version": "x", "structures": [{"pool": "A11", "feeders": [{"numero": "A11"}]}]}
            p = Path(dd) / "t.json"
            p.write_text(json.dumps(bad), encoding="utf-8")
            with self.assertRaises(depooling.DepoolingError):
                depooling.load_table(p)
            bad = {"version": "x", "structures": [{"pool": "A11", "feeders": [{"numero": "B22"}]}, {"pool": "C33", "feeders": [{"numero": "B22"}]}]}
            p.write_text(json.dumps(bad), encoding="utf-8")
            with self.assertRaises(depooling.DepoolingError):
                depooling.load_table(p)

    def test_no_forbidden_text_in_table(self):
        text = (APP_DIR / "config" / "depooling.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertNotIn(":" + "/", text)
        self.assertNotIn(":" + chr(92), text)


class FollowTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_one_report_per_feeder_then_the_pool_from_the_transfer_lot(self):
        gw = Smart()
        res, files = follow(gw)
        self.assertEqual([r.params.fund for r in res.results], ["745642", "745635"])
        self.assertEqual([r.depooling["role"] for r in res.results], [depooling.ROLE_FEEDER, depooling.ROLE_POOL])
        feeder, pool = res.results
        self.assertEqual(len(feeder.rows), 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(pool.rows), 2)
        self.assertEqual({r["FONDS_ORIGINE"] for r in feeder.rows}, {"745642"})
        self.assertEqual({r["FONDS_ORIGINE"] for r in pool.rows}, {"745635"})
        ent = gw.sqls("20_ecritures")
        # 3 requetes : le feeder, le pool a partir du transfert, et le pool avant le transfert (comptes propres au pool, point 1 Cremoni).
        self.assertEqual(len(ent), 3)
        feeder_sql = [s for s in ent if "= '745642'" in s][0]
        # le feeder est presente sous son propre numero : plus d'en-tete du pool
        self.assertIn("c.C_FUND AS SUBFUND_NUMBER", feeder_sql)
        self.assertNotIn("'745635' AS SUBFUND_NUMBER", feeder_sql)
        self.assertIn("c.N_LOT > 100 AND c.N_LOT <= 150", feeder_sql)
        pool_sqls = [s for s in ent if "= '745642'" not in s]
        # Le pool reprend au lot de transfert lui-meme : lot_from = 160 - 1, l'etape 20 filtrant N_LOT > LOT_FROM.
        pool_sql = [s for s in pool_sqls if "N_LOT > 159" in s][0]
        self.assertIn("c.N_LOT > 159 AND c.N_LOT <= 300", pool_sql)
        # Fenetre pre-transfert du pool, de la plage demandee jusqu'au lot de transfert exclu : lit les comptes propres au pool (Futures, etc.).
        pre_sql = [s for s in pool_sqls if "N_LOT > 100" in s][0]
        self.assertIn("c.N_LOT > 100 AND c.N_LOT <= 159", pre_sql)
        self.assertEqual(pool.resolved["lot_de_transfert"], 160)
        self.assertEqual(res.depooling["lot_de_transfert"]["origine"], "etape_50")  # le lot de la table (8597564) est hors fenetre ici
        self.assertEqual([s["fonds"] for s in res.depooling["segments"]], ["745642", "745635"])

    def test_the_table_lot_anchors_the_transfer_and_the_step_50_is_only_a_control(self):
        """Quand le lot du depooling de la table tombe dans la fenetre du pool, c'est lui qui ouvre le rapport du pool, pas celui de l'etape 50."""
        t = depooling.load_table()
        for s in t["structures"]:
            if s["pool"] == "745635":
                s["lot_depooling"] = 165
        gw = Smart()
        res, _ = follow(gw, table=t)
        pool = res.results[-1]
        self.assertEqual(res.depooling["lot_de_transfert"], {"lot": 165, "nav": "2026-06-25", "origine": "table"})
        self.assertEqual(res.depooling["lot_de_transfert_etape_50"], {"lot": 160, "nav": "2026-06-26", "origine": "etape_50"})
        self.assertEqual(res.depooling["lot_du_depooling_table"], 165)
        self.assertIn("c.N_LOT > 164 AND c.N_LOT <= 300", [s for s in gw.sqls("20_ecritures") if "= '745642'" not in s][0])
        self.assertTrue(any("lot du depooling de la table" in n for n in pool.notes))
        self.assertTrue(any("160" in n and "Ã©tape 50" in n for n in pool.notes))  # la divergence est dite, pas tue
        self.assertEqual(pool.conformite["verdict"], "CONFORME")

    def test_notes_say_where_each_report_stops_and_starts(self):
        res, _ = follow(Smart())
        feeder, pool = res.results
        self.assertTrue(any("ancien feeder du pool 745635" in n and "lot 150" in n for n in feeder.notes))
        self.assertTrue(any("lot de transfert 160" in n for n in pool.notes))
        self.assertTrue(any("lot de transfert du pool : 160" in n for n in pool.notes))
        self.assertTrue(any("un rapport par ancien feeder" in n for n in res.notes))
        self.assertFalse(any("jonction" in n or "deux fois" in n for r in res.results for n in r.notes))

    def test_pool_entries_before_the_transfer_lot_reach_only_the_combined_file(self):
        """Retour qualite Stephan CREMONI (point 1, 08/10/2026, puis demande des auditeurs le meme jour) : les ecritures du pool d'avant son
        lot de transfert (Futures compte 63000, et compte 14080 deja porte par le feeder) doivent figurer dans le fichier combine, sans filtre,
        mais rester absentes des deux rapports separes, qui restent les seuls a faire foi (docs\\DEPOOLING.md Â§1)."""
        res, files = follow(Smart())
        feeder, pool = res.results
        self.assertNotIn(63000, {r["ACCOUNT_NUMBER"] for r in feeder.rows})
        self.assertNotIn(63000, {r["ACCOUNT_NUMBER"] for r in pool.rows})  # pool.rows = seulement apres le lot de transfert
        combined_csv = next(n for n in pool.files if n.endswith("_avant_apres_depooling.csv"))
        csv_text = files[pool.params.fund][combined_csv].decode("utf-8-sig")
        lines = [l for l in csv_text.split("\n") if l]
        self.assertEqual(len(lines) - 1, 6)  # 2 feeder + 2 pre-transfert (futures + compte partage, sans filtre) + 2 pool
        futures_line = [l for l in lines if ";63000;" in l][0]
        self.assertTrue(futures_line.startswith("745635;"))  # ecriture du pool, tagguee sous son propre numero
        # compte 14080 : porte par le feeder, repris quand meme sous le pool (demande des auditeurs) ET dans son propre rapport post-transfert

    def test_combined_file_gathers_feeder_and_pool_rows_without_touching_the_separate_reports(self):
        """Demande du Reporting du 08/10/2026 : un troisieme fichier, automatique, qui reunit avant et apres depooling (docs\\DEPOOLING.md Â§1)."""
        res, files = follow(Smart())
        pool_fund = res.results[-1].params.fund
        combined = [n for n in res.results[-1].files if "avant_apres_depooling" in n]
        self.assertEqual(len(combined), 2)  # csv + xlsx
        csv_name = [n for n in combined if n.endswith(".csv")][0]
        csv_text = files[pool_fund][csv_name].decode("utf-8-sig")
        lines = [l for l in csv_text.split("\n") if l]

        origines = {l.split(";")[0] for l in lines[1:]}

"""Table du depooling tirÃ©e de MFGA : chargeable, sans nom, choisie par le mode sans LUXIS ; dÃ©rivation et comparaison."""
import importlib.util
import json
import unittest

from glapp import depooling, params as P
from glapp.paths import APP_DIR

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("depooling_mfga", APP_DIR / "tools" / "depooling_mfga.py")
tool = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(tool)


def link(pool, feeder, start, end, feeder_last, pool_last, pool_ccy="EUR", feeder_ccy="EUR"):
    return {"POOL": pool, "FEEDER": feeder, "LIEN_DEBUT": start, "LIEN_FIN": end, "FEEDER_DERNIERE_NAV": feeder_last, "POOL_DERNIERE_NAV": pool_last,
            "POOL_CCY": pool_ccy, "FEEDER_CCY": feeder_ccy}


class DepoolingMfgaTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_table_loads_and_holds_no_name(self):
        t = depooling.load_table(depooling.TABLE_PATH_MFGA)
        self.assertTrue(t["structures"])
        for s in t["structures"]:
            self.assertNotIn("nom", s)
            self.assertEqual(s["etat"], "constate")
            self.assertRegex(s["date_depooling"], r"^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$")
            self.assertNotIn("lot_depooling", s)  # MFGA ne porte pas le lot : l'etape 50 le calcule (glapp\\depooling.py, _transfer_lot)

    def test_the_two_tables_agree_where_they_overlap(self):
        """Les deux tables ne se recouvrent que sur 5 structures : la table MFGA vient d'INTG figee au 03/07/2026, la table LUXIS de la Table Fonds sauvegardee.

        Sur ces 5, les anciens feeders de la table LUXIS sont tous dans la table MFGA, qui en voit parfois davantage (un feeder sorti avant le depooling).
        Seule 200817 est datee autrement : le 02/07/2026 dans MFGA contre le 21/08/2026 dans la sauvegarde. La derivation MFGA prend la derniere NAV
        commune des feeders, et INTG s'arrete au 03/07/2026 : la date MFGA est l'effet du gel de l'environnement, pas un depooling. La sauvegarde
        LUXIS fait foi (docs\\DEPOOLING.md)."""
        mfga = {s["pool"]: s for s in depooling.load_table(depooling.TABLE_PATH_MFGA)["structures"]}
        luxis = {s["pool"]: s for s in depooling.load_table()["structures"] if s["etat"] == "constate"}
        common = sorted(set(mfga) & set(luxis))
        self.assertEqual(common, ["200817", "230836", "231433", "264212", "745635"])
        for pool in common:
            self.assertLessEqual({f["numero"] for f in luxis[pool]["feeders"]}, {f["numero"] for f in mfga[pool]["feeders"]}, pool)
            if pool != "200817":
                self.assertEqual(mfga[pool]["date_depooling"], luxis[pool]["date_depooling"], pool)
        self.assertEqual((mfga["200817"]["date_depooling"], luxis["200817"]["date_depooling"]), ("2026-07-02", "2026-08-21"))
        self.assertEqual(sorted(set(mfga) - set(luxis)), ["274589", "445572", "553786", "792974", "988642", "M1"])  # depoolings anterieurs a la sauvegarde
        self.assertEqual(len(set(luxis) - set(mfga)), 19)  # structures posterieures au gel d'INTG

    def test_mode_chooses_the_table(self):
        lx = P.validate("745635", date_from="2026-06-01", date_to="2026-06-30", follow_depooling=True)
        sl = P.validate("745635", date_from="2026-06-01", date_to="2026-06-30", follow_depooling=True, sans_luxis=True)
        self.assertEqual(depooling.table_path(lx), depooling.TABLE_PATH)
        self.assertEqual(depooling.table_path(sl), depooling.TABLE_PATH_MFGA)
        self.assertEqual(depooling.table_path(sl, {"depooling": {"table_sans_luxis": "luxis"}}), depooling.TABLE_PATH)

    def test_derivation_rule(self):
        rows = [link("P1", "F1", "2020-01-31", "2026-06-25", "2026-06-25", "2026-07-03"),
                link("P1", "F0", "2010-01-31", "2012-03-31", "2012-03-31", "2026-07-03"),
                link("P2", "F2", "2020-01-31", "2026-07-03", "2026-07-03", "2026-07-03"),
                link("P3", "F3", "2020-01-31", "2026-05-31", "2026-05-31", "2026-07-03"),
                link("P3", "F4", "2020-01-31", "2026-07-02", "2026-07-02", "2026-07-03"),
                link("P4", "F0", "2013-01-31", "2014-03-31", "2014-03-31", "2026-07-03")]
        all_s, dep = tool.derive(rows, "2010-01-01")
        self.assertEqual(dep["P1"]["date_depooling"], "2026-06-25")
        self.assertEqual([f["numero"] for f in dep["P1"]["feeders"]], ["F1"])
        self.assertEqual([f["numero"] for f in dep["P4"]["feeders"]], ["F0"])
        self.assertNotIn("P2", dep)
        self.assertEqual(dep["P3"]["date_depooling"], "2026-07-02")
        self.assertEqual(len(all_s), 4)
        self.assertNotIn("P1", tool.derive(rows, "2026-07-01")[1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Provenance de config\\depooling.json (point 4 de l'iteration) : config\\depooling.meta.json, ecrit par tools\\depooling_table_fonds.py --ecrire.
Sans Dremio, sans classeur reel : charge l'outil par son chemin, puisque tools\\ n'est pas un paquet."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def _load():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("depooling_table_fonds", APP / "tools" / "depooling_table_fonds.py")
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


M = _load()


class MetaTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_hash_matches_hashlib_and_changes_with_content(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=APP / "out") as d:
            f = Path(d) / "classeur.xlsx"
            f.write_bytes(b"un contenu quelconque")
            self.assertEqual(M.empreinte(f), hashlib.sha256(b"un contenu quelconque").hexdigest())
            f.write_bytes(b"un autre contenu")
            self.assertNotEqual(M.empreinte(f), hashlib.sha256(b"un contenu quelconque").hexdigest())

    def test_meta_carries_date_count_and_fingerprint(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=APP / "out") as d:
            f = Path(d) / "TAB_FND_MAIN_BCK.xlsx"
            f.write_bytes(b"export de test")
            nouvelle = {"version": "table-fonds-2026-10-06", "structures": [{"feeders": [{"numero": "1"}, {"numero": "2"}]}, {"feeders": [{"numero": "3"}]}]}
            m = M.meta(f, [{"FA_NUM": "1"}, {"FA_NUM": "2"}, {"FA_NUM": "3"}], nouvelle)
            self.assertEqual(m["classeur"], "TAB_FND_MAIN_BCK.xlsx")
            self.assertEqual(m["version_table"], "table-fonds-2026-10-06")
            self.assertEqual(m["lignes_lues"], 3)
            self.assertEqual(m["structures"], 2)
            self.assertEqual(m["feeders"], 3)
            self.assertEqual(m["empreinte_sha256"], hashlib.sha256(b"export de test").hexdigest())
            self.assertRegex(m["date_execution_outil"], r"^20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$")
            self.assertRegex(m["date_modification_classeur"], r"^20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$")

    def test_metacible_is_a_sibling_of_cible(self):
        self.assertEqual(M.METACIBLE.parent, M.CIBLE.parent)
        self.assertEqual(M.METACIBLE.name, "depooling.meta.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Moteur avec une passerelle simulee : refus d'eFront, enchainement des etapes, fichiers ecrits. Aucun appel a Dremio."""
import csv
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from glapp import engine, params as P
from glapp.dremio import auth_message
from glapp.outputs import read_csv_rows, read_xlsx
from glapp.paths import APP_DIR


class FakeGateway:
    def __init__(self, responses):
        self.responses, self.queries, self.log, self.out_dir = responses, [], [], None

    def sql(self, name):
        return [s for n, s in self.queries if n == name][-1]

    def query(self, name, sql, max_rows=None, timeout=None):
        self.queries.append((name, sql))
        rows = self.responses.get(name, [])
        self.log.append({"name": name, "job": "j", "rows": len(rows), "seconds": 0.0})
        return rows


def entry(acc, way, amt, prev, bal, entry_next, lot=10, line=1, ccy="USD", date="2026-06-29 00:00:00.000"):
    return {"SUBFUND_NUMBER": "242013", "SUBFUND_NAME": "FONDS ESSAI", "SUBFUND_CCY": "USD", "ACCOUNT_NUMBER": acc, "ACCOUNT_RUBRIC": 0,
            "ACCOUNT_NAME": "Compte " + str(acc), "ACCOUNT_CCY": ccy, "DEBIT_CREDIT": way, "CODE_SERVICE": "NA", "OPERATION_CODE": "XX",
            "ACCOUNTING_DATE": date, "TRADE_DATE": date, "VALUE_DATE": date, "MATURITY_DATE": None, "DESCRIPTION": "Ecriture d'essai & <test>",
            "ENTRY": 5, "ENTRY_PTF": 6, "ENTRY_NEXT": entry_next, "AMOUNT_ACCOUNT_CCY": amt, "AMOUNT_SUBFUND_CCY": amt,
            "PREVIOUS_BALANCE_ACCOUNT_CCY": prev, "BALANCE_ACCOUNT_CCY": bal, "STATUS": 20, "N_LOT": lot, "N_LINE": line, "PTF_MANAGER": 0}


FUND_OK = [{"FA_NUM": "242013", "F_NAME": "FONDS ESSAI", "F_CCY": "USD", "EFRONT": "0", "NAV_BACKDATED": "0"}]
WINDOW = [{"NAV_TO": "2026-06-29 00:00:00.000", "NAV_FROM": "2026-06-26 00:00:00.000", "LOT_FROM": 100, "LOT_TO": 200, "TRADE_DATE_MAX": None, "LOT_RESULT_FROM": None}]
ROWS = [entry(1000, "DB", 50.0, 100.0, 50.0, 1), entry(1000, "CR", 50.0, 50.0, 100.0, 2), entry(40100, "CR", 50.0, 0.0, 50.0, 3), entry(40100, "DB", 50.0, 50.0, 0.0, 4)]

    def test_calc_date_adds_one_query(self):

        self.assertEqual(resolved["nav"], "2026-06-29")

    def test_calc_date_without_nav(self):

    def test_no_lot_for_nav(self):

    def test_auth_message_explains_the_renewal(self):

"""Signal "hors des 3 ans" et limite de lignes du classeur. Sans Dremio."""
import datetime as dt
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from glapp import engine, params as P
from glapp.paths import APP_DIR, load_config
from tests.unit.test_engine import FUND_OK, ROWS, WINDOW, FakeGateway

CFG = load_config()
TODAY = dt.date(2026, 10, 2)


class HistoryTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def note(self, nav, nav_de=None, date_from=None, last="2026-07-01 00:00:00.000", gw=None):
        gw = gw or FakeGateway({"51_derniere_nav": [{"DERNIERE_NAV": last}]})
        p = P.validate("242013", nav_date=nav) if not date_from else P.validate("242013", date_from=date_from, date_to="2026-06-29")
        resolved = {"nav": nav, "nav_de": nav_de} if nav else {"nav_de": nav_de}
        return engine.history_note(p, resolved, gw, CFG, today=TODAY), gw

    def test_old_nav_gets_a_note(self):
        n, gw = self.note("2023-06-30", "2023-06-29")
        self.assertIn("hors des 3 ans", n)
        self.assertIn("01/07/2023", n)
        self.assertEqual([x for x, _ in gw.queries], ["51_derniere_nav"])

    def test_recent_nav_needs_no_query(self):
        n, gw = self.note("2026-06-29", "2026-06-26")
        self.assertIsNone(n)
        self.assertEqual(gw.queries, [])
        n, gw = self.note("2023-10-02", "2023-10-02")
        self.assertIsNone(n)
        self.assertEqual(gw.queries, [])

    def test_between_the_two_limits_uses_the_last_nav(self):
        n, gw = self.note("2023-08-15", "2023-08-14")
        self.assertIsNone(n)
        self.assertEqual(len(gw.queries), 1)

    def test_range_start_is_tested(self):
        n, _ = self.note(None, "2023-05-01", date_from="2023-05-15")
        self.assertIn("hors des 3 ans", n)

    def test_last_nav_is_read_once_per_gateway(self):
        gw = FakeGateway({"51_derniere_nav": [{"DERNIERE_NAV": "2026-07-01 00:00:00.000"}]})
        self.note("2023-06-30", "2023-06-29", gw=gw)
        self.note("2022-06-30", "2022-06-29", gw=gw)
        self.assertEqual(len(gw.queries), 1)

    def test_no_data_means_no_note(self):
        n, _ = self.note("2023-06-30", "2023-06-29", gw=FakeGateway({"51_derniere_nav": []}))
        self.assertIsNone(n)

    def test_leap_day(self):
        self.assertEqual(engine.add_years(dt.date(2028, 2, 29), 3), dt.date(2025, 2, 28))
        self.assertEqual(engine.add_years(dt.date(2026, 10, 2), 3), dt.date(2023, 10, 2))

    def test_run_adds_the_note(self):
        gw = FakeGateway({"00_fonds": FUND_OK, "10_fenetre_p01": [{**WINDOW[0], "NAV_TO": "2023-06-30 00:00:00.000", "NAV_FROM": "2023-06-29 00:00:00.000"}],
                          "20_ecritures": ROWS, "51_derniere_nav": [{"DERNIERE_NAV": "2026-07-01 00:00:00.000"}]})
        res = engine.run(P.validate("242013", nav_date="2023-06-30"), gw, write=False, cfg=CFG)
        self.assertTrue(any("hors des 3 ans" in n for n in res.notes), res.notes)

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-general-ledger\tests\unit\test_i18n.py =====
"""Langue de l'interface : un seul catalogue, chaque clÃ© dans les deux langues, aucune chaÃ®ne d'interface en dur dans le code."""
import ast
import re
import string
import unittest

from glapp import i18n
from glapp.paths import APP_DIR

# ChaÃ®nes techniques admises hors du catalogue : identifiants, codes, noms de colonnes LUXIS, clÃ©s JSON, SQL, formats.
WORD = re.compile(r"[A-Za-zÃ€-Ã¿]{3,}")
ACCENT = re.compile(r"[Ã€-Ã¿]")
ALLOWED = re.compile(r"^(?:[A-ZÃ€-Ã0-9_ ./%:=<>\-|,()\[\]'\"{}*+#!?@]+|.*<[a-z/!].*|.*class=.*|[a-z0-9_.\-/\\*]+|.*\.(?:sql|json|csv|xlsx|html|txt|log)|"
                     r"[a-z_]+ [a-z_]+|-- =+ \{step\} =+|\{[a-z_]+\}.*|<\?xml.*|:root\{.*)$", re.S)
# Codes de rÃ´le du depooling : valeurs du CSV brut (identifiants), affichÃ©es par i18n (role.feeder, role.pool).
CODES = {"ancien feeder", "pool (fonds restant)"}


def placeholders(text):
    return sorted({f for _, f, _, _ in string.Formatter().parse(text) if f})


def user_strings(path):
    """ChaÃ®nes littÃ©rales qui ressemblent Ã  un message (au moins deux mots, dont un accentuÃ© ou en minuscules), hors docstrings."""
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    docs = set()
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.Module, ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.body:
            first = node.body[0]
            if isinstance(first, ast.Expr) and isinstance(first.value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(first.value.value, str):
                docs.add(id(first.value))
    found = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str) and id(node) not in docs:
            s = node.value.strip()
            words = WORD.findall(s)
            if len(words) >= 2 and (ACCENT.search(s) or re.search(r"\b[a-z]{3,} [a-z]{3,}\b", s)) and not ALLOWED.match(s) and s not in CODES:
                found.append(f"{path.name}:{node.lineno}: {s[:70]}")
    return found


class CatalogTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_key_exists_in_both_languages(self):
        self.assertEqual(set(i18n.CATALOG["fr"]), set(i18n.CATALOG["en"]))
        for key in i18n.CATALOG["fr"]:
            fr, en = i18n.CATALOG["fr"][key], i18n.CATALOG["en"][key]
            self.assertTrue(fr.strip() and en.strip(), key)
            self.assertEqual(placeholders(fr), placeholders(en), key)

    def test_english_has_no_french_accent(self):
        for key, en in i18n.CATALOG["en"].items():
            self.assertIsNone(re.search(r"[Ã Ã¢Ã§Ã©Ã¨ÃªÃ«Ã®Ã¯Ã´Ã¹Ã»Ã¼]", en), key)

    def test_switching_language(self):
        try:
            i18n.set_lang("en")
            self.assertEqual(i18n.t("cli.err.error", exc="x"), "Error: x")
            self.assertEqual(i18n.verdict_label("CONFORME"), "COMPLIANT")
            i18n.set_lang("fr")
            self.assertEqual(i18n.t("cli.err.error", exc="x"), "Erreur : x")
            self.assertEqual(i18n.verdict_label("CONFORME"), "CONFORME")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                i18n.set_lang("de")
        finally:
            i18n.set_lang("fr")

    def test_every_used_key_exists(self):
        used = set()
        for p in sorted((APP_DIR / "glapp").glob("*.py")):
            used |= set(re.findall(r"""\bt\(\s*["']([a-z0-9_.]*[a-z0-9_])["'](?=\s*[,)])""", p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
        missing = sorted(k for k in used if k not in i18n.CATALOG["fr"])
        self.assertEqual(missing, [])

    def test_no_interface_string_left_in_the_code(self):
        found = []
        for p in sorted((APP_DIR / "glapp").glob("*.py")):
            if p.name != "i18n.py":
                found += user_strings(p)
        self.assertEqual(found, [], "\n".join(found[:30]))

        i18n.set_lang("fr")

class CsvTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def row(self, **kw):
        r = {a: None for a in IRP_MAP.values()}
        r.update({"SUBFUND_NUMBER": "242013", "SUBFUND_NAME": "L'ABC FUND; test", "ACCOUNT_NUMBER": "14000", "ACCOUNTING_DATE": "2026-06-29 00:00:00.000",
                  "AMOUNT_ACCOUNT_CCY": "-1234.5000", "BALANCE_ACCOUNT_CCY": "0.0000", "DESCRIPTION": "caf\u00e9", "STATUS": "20"})
        r.update(kw)
        return r

    def test_format(self):
        data, altered = luxis_csv_bytes(IRP_COLS, IRP_MAP, [self.row(), self.row(MATURITY_DATE=None)], LX)
        self.assertFalse(data.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"))
        self.assertEqual(altered, 2)
        lines = data.split(b"\r\n")
        self.assertEqual(len(lines), 3)
        self.assertNotIn(b"\n", data.replace(b"\r\n", b""))
        self.assertEqual(lines[0].decode("cp1252"), ";".join(IRP_COLS))
        cells = lines[1].decode("cp1252").split(";")
        self.assertEqual(len(cells), 23)
        self.assertEqual(cells[1], "LABC FUND  test")
        self.assertEqual(cells[10], "29.06.2026")
        self.assertEqual(cells[13], "")
        self.assertEqual(cells[14], "caf\u00e9")
        self.assertIn(b"caf\xe9", lines[1])
        self.assertEqual(cells[18], "-1234.5")
        self.assertEqual(cells[21], "0")
        self.assertEqual(cells[22], "20")

    def test_no_final_newline(self):
        data, _ = luxis_csv_bytes(IRP_COLS, IRP_MAP, [self.row()], LX)
        self.assertFalse(data.endswith(b"\r\n"))
        data, _ = luxis_csv_bytes(IRP_COLS, IRP_MAP, [self.row()], {**LX, "csv_retour_final": True})
        self.assertTrue(data.endswith(b"\r\n"))

    def test_extra_column(self):
        data, _ = luxis_csv_bytes(IRP_COLS, IRP_MAP, [self.row()], LX, {"Fonds d'origine": lambda r: "745635"})
        lines = data.split(b"\r\n")
        self.assertTrue(lines[0].decode("cp1252").endswith(";Fonds dorigine"))
        self.assertEqual(lines[1].decode("cp1252").split(";")[-1], "745635")

class LuxisCsvRoundTripTest(unittest.TestCase):
    ROWS = [entry(14000, "DB", 12.5, 100.0, 87.5, 5), {**entry(14001, "CR", 3.0, 0.0, 3.0, 6), "DESCRIPTION": "Frais d'audit ; trimestre Ã© Ã  Ã¼", "SUBFUND_NAME": "FONDS L'Ã‰TÃ‰"},
            {**entry(15000, "CR", 1234567.89, 0.0, 1234567.89, 7), "MATURITY_DATE": "2026-12-31 00:00:00.000", "VALUE_DATE": None}]

    def test_write_then_read_gives_the_same_table(self):
        data, _ = luxis_csv_bytes(IRP_COLS, IRP_MAP, self.ROWS, CFG["fichier_luxis"])
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=APP_DIR / "out") as d:
            f = Path(d) / "x.csv"
            f.write_bytes(data)
            back = read_csv_rows(f)
        self.assertEqual(len(back), 3)
        mine = C.table_from_rows(IRP_COLS, IRP_MAP, self.ROWS)
        res = C.compare_tables(IRP_COLS, mine, C.table_from_reference(IRP_COLS, back))
        self.assertTrue(res["identique"], res)
        self.assertEqual((res["lignes_identiques_toutes_colonnes"], res["colonnes_identiques_au_meme_rang"]), (3, 23))

    def test_dates_and_decimals_of_the_luxis_csv_are_understood(self):
        self.assertEqual(C.norm_ref("Accounting Date", "29.06.2026"), "2026-06-29")
        self.assertEqual(C.norm_ref("Accounting Date", "2026-06-29 00:00:00.000"), "2026-06-29")
        self.assertEqual(C.norm_ref("Amount in Account Ccy", "-1234.5"), -1234.5)
        self.assertEqual(C.norm_ref("Description", "Frais d'audit ; x"), "Frais daudit x")

    def test_utf8_technical_csv_is_still_read(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=APP_DIR / "out") as d:
            f = Path(d) / "t.csv"
            f.write_bytes("\ufeffa;b\r\nÃ©;2\r\n".encode("utf-8"))
            self.assertEqual(read_csv_rows(f), [{"a": "Ã©", "b": "2"}])
            f.write_bytes("a;b\r\n\xe9;2\r\n".encode("latin-1"))
            self.assertEqual(read_csv_rows(f), [{"a": "Ã©", "b": "2"}])


class PartialAccountRangeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    UNBALANCED = [entry(40100, "CR", 100.0, 0.0, 100.0, 1), entry(40200, "CR", 50.0, 0.0, 50.0, 2)]

    def test_definition(self):
        self.assertFalse(checks.partial_account_range("irp", None, None, CFG))
        self.assertTrue(checks.partial_account_range("irp", 40000, 59999, CFG))
        self.assertTrue(checks.partial_account_range("irp", 40000, None, CFG))
        self.assertFalse(checks.partial_account_range("bcr", 1450, 999999, CFG))
        self.assertTrue(checks.partial_account_range("bcr", 40000, 59999, CFG))
        self.assertTrue(checks.partial_account_range("bcr", 1450, 59999, CFG))

    def test_partial_range_does_not_alert_on_the_balance(self):
        p = P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_from=40000, acc_to=59999)
        res = engine.run(p, fake_run(rows=self.UNBALANCED), write=False, cfg=CFG)
        line = [v for v in res.verdicts if v[0] == "Ã©quilibre crÃ©dits et dÃ©bits"][0]
        self.assertEqual(line[2], "INFO")
        self.assertIn("plage de comptes partielle", line[3])
        self.assertEqual(res.status, "OK")
        self.assertNotEqual(res.conformite["verdict"], "Ã‰CART")

    def test_full_range_still_alerts(self):
        p = P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29")
        res = engine.run(p, fake_run(rows=self.UNBALANCED), write=False, cfg=CFG)
        self.assertEqual(res.status, "ALERTE")
        self.assertEqual(res.conformite["verdict"], "Ã‰CART")

    def test_other_controls_stay_decisive_with_a_partial_range(self):

        p = P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_from=40000, acc_to=59999)
        res = engine.run(p, fake_run(rows=bad), write=False, cfg=CFG)
        self.assertEqual(res.status, "ALERTE")
        self.assertEqual(res.conformite["verdict"], "Ã‰CART")

    def test_bcr_default_range_is_not_partial(self):
        p = P.validate("242013", output="bcr", date_from="2026-06-21", date_to="2026-07-01")
        self.assertFalse(checks.partial_account_range(p.output, p.acc_from, p.acc_to, CFG))

            self.assertEqual(summary[0]["statut"], "OK")
            self.assertEqual(recap["alerte"], 0)

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-general-ledger\tests\unit\test_params.py =====
"""Validation des parametres : fonds numerique, dates reelles, periode admise, regle, plages numeriques, aucune chaine libre."""
import unittest

from glapp import params as P


class ParamsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def ok(self, **kw):
        kw.setdefault("fund", "242013")
        return P.validate(**kw)

    def test_default_irp(self):
        p = self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29")
        self.assertEqual((p.output, p.period, p.rule, p.source), ("irp", 1, "corrige", "ic"))
        self.assertEqual(p.tag, "irp_242013_20260629_p1_ic")

    def test_fund_must_be_digits(self):
        for bad in ("24201x", "242013; DROP", "' OR 1=1 --", "12", "12345678901", "", None, "24 2013", "20304e", "Ù¢Ù¤Ù¢Ù Ù¡Ù£", "ï¼’ï¼”ï¼’ï¼ï¼‘ï¼“", "2420-13", "AB\u00c9CD"):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError, msg=repr(bad)):
                P.validate(bad, nav_date="2026-06-29")

    def test_alphanumeric_fund_numbers_are_accepted_in_ascii(self):
        for good in ("20304E", "ABC123", "190", "A1B2C3D4E5"):
            self.assertEqual(P.validate(good, nav_date="2026-06-29").fund, good)

    def test_integers_are_ascii_digits_only(self):
        for bad in ("1_000", "+5", "-5", "Ù£", "ï¼‘ï¼’", "1 2", "0x10"):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError, msg=bad):
                self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_from=bad)

    def test_compat_option(self):
        self.assertFalse(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29").compat)
        p = self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", compat=True)
        self.assertTrue(p.compat)
        self.assertTrue(p.tag.endswith("_compat"))
        self.assertTrue(p.as_dict()["compat_gl_reference"])

    def test_fund_accepts_int(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ok(fund=242013, nav_date="2026-06-29").fund, "242013")

    def test_dates_must_exist(self):
        for bad in ("2026-02-30", "2026-13-01", "29/02/2026", "2026-6-29", "20260629", "2026-06-29'", "1850-01-01", "abc"):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError, msg=bad):
                self.ok(nav_date=bad)

    def test_french_date_is_converted(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ok(nav_date="29/06/2026").nav_date, "2026-06-29")

    def test_exactly_one_of_nav_or_calc_date(self):
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok()
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", calc_date="2026-06-30")
        self.assertEqual(self.ok(calc_date="2026-06-30").tag, "irp_242013_20260630_p1_ic")

    def test_period_in_list(self):
        for code in range(1, 17):
            self.assertEqual(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", period=code).period, code)
        for bad in (0, 17, 99, "x", "1; DROP"):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError, msg=str(bad)):
                self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", period=bad)

    def test_rule(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", period=16, rule="corrige").corrected)
        self.assertFalse(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", period=1, rule="corrige").corrected)
        self.assertTrue(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", period=1, rule="corrige").notes)
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", rule="autre")

    def test_corrected_tag(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", period=13, rule="corrige").tag.endswith("_corrige"))
        self.assertTrue(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", period=16, rule="corrige").tag.endswith("p16_ic_corrige"))

    def test_account_ranges_are_integers(self):
        p = self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_from="1450", acc_to="999999")
        self.assertEqual((p.acc_from, p.acc_to), (1450, 999999))
        for bad in ("14 50", "1e3", "-1", "1450 OR 1=1", "99999999999"):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError, msg=bad):
                self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_from=bad)
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_from=5000, acc_to=1000)

    def test_irp_has_no_account_range_by_default(self):
        p = self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29")
        self.assertEqual((p.acc_from, p.acc_to), (None, None))

    def test_bcr_defaults_and_rules(self):
        p = P.validate("280287", output="bcr", date_from="2026-06-21", date_to="2026-07-01")
        self.assertEqual((p.acc_from, p.acc_to), (1450, 999999))
        self.assertEqual(p.tag, "bcr_280287_20260701_p1_ic")
        for kw in ({"date_from": "2026-06-21"}, {"date_to": "2026-07-01"}, {"date_from": "2026-07-02", "date_to": "2026-07-01"}):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
                P.validate("280287", output="bcr", **kw)
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            P.validate("280287", output="bcr", date_from="2026-06-21", date_to="2026-07-01", nav_date="2026-06-29")
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            P.validate("280287", output="bcr", date_from="2026-06-21", date_to="2026-07-01", period=13)

    def test_bcr_nav_periods(self):
        """Les deux modes de periode que LUXIS deduit de la table NAV (PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES l.2806 a 2812)."""
        last = P.validate("280287", output="bcr", bcr_period="last_available_day")
        self.assertTrue(last.bcr_nav_period)
        self.assertEqual((last.date_from, last.date_to), (None, None))
        self.assertEqual(last.tag, "bcr_280287_last_available_day_ic")
        self.assertEqual(last.as_dict()["periode_bcr"], "last_available_day")
        # LUXIS ne lit aucune des deux dates dans ce mode : elles sont ignorees, avec une note.
        noted = P.validate("280287", output="bcr", bcr_period="last_available_day", date_from="2026-06-21", date_to="2026-07-01")
        self.assertEqual((noted.date_from, noted.date_to), (None, None))
        self.assertTrue(noted.notes)
        pub = P.validate("280287", output="bcr", bcr_period="to_last_date_nav", date_from="2026-06-21", date_to="2026-07-01")
        self.assertEqual((pub.date_from, pub.date_to), ("2026-06-21", None))
        self.assertTrue(pub.notes)
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            P.validate("280287", output="bcr", bcr_period="to_last_date_nav")
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            P.validate("280287", output="bcr", bcr_period="last_available_day", sans_luxis=True)
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            P.validate("280287", output="bcr", bcr_period="derniere_nav", date_from="2026-06-21", date_to="2026-07-01")
        # La periode BCR ne s'applique pas au rapport 17 : sans effet, avec une note.
        irp = self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", bcr_period="last_available_day")
        self.assertFalse(irp.bcr_nav_period)
        self.assertEqual(irp.bcr_period, "plage")
        self.assertTrue(irp.notes)

    def test_irp_refuses_date_range(self):
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", date_from="2026-06-01")

    def test_formats_and_source(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", formats="csv").formats, ("csv",))
        self.assertEqual(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", formats="xlsx,csv").formats, ("xlsx", "csv"))
        for bad in ("pdf", "xlsx,html", ""):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError, msg=bad):
                self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", formats=bad)
        self.assertEqual(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", source="lx").source, "lx")
        for bad in ("table_fonds", "x", "ic; DROP"):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError, msg=bad):
                self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", source=bad)

    def test_output_value(self):
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", output="pdf")

    def test_acc_list_parsed_and_deduplicated(self):
        p = self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_list="1450, 2000,2000,999999")
        self.assertEqual(p.acc_list, (1450, 2000, 999999))
        self.assertEqual((p.acc_from, p.acc_to), (None, None))
        self.assertEqual(p.as_dict()["comptes_liste"], [1450, 2000, 999999])

    def test_acc_list_accepts_sequence(self):
        p = self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_list=(1450, "2000"))
        self.assertEqual(p.acc_list, (1450, 2000))

    def test_acc_list_exclusive_with_range(self):
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_list="1450,2000", acc_from=1000)
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_list="1450,2000", acc_to=5000)

    def test_acc_list_rejects_bad_values(self):
        for bad in ("14 50", "-1", "1450 OR 1=1", "99999999999"):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError, msg=bad):
                self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_list=bad)

    def test_acc_list_bounded_in_size(self):
        many = ",".join(str(1000 + i) for i in range(P.MAX_ACC_LIST + 1))
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_list=many)
        ok = ",".join(str(1000 + i) for i in range(P.MAX_ACC_LIST))
        self.assertEqual(len(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_list=ok).acc_list), P.MAX_ACC_LIST)

    def test_acc_list_empty_is_none(self):
        self.assertIsNone(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_list="").acc_list)
        self.assertIsNone(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", acc_list=()).acc_list)

    def test_date_column_option(self):
        """Choix de colonne de date du Reporting (16/10/2026) : lots par defaut, aucune sortie existante ne change."""
        self.assertEqual(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29").date_column, "lots")
        self.assertFalse(self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29").date_filter)
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", date_column="autre")
        p = P.validate("280066", output="irp", date_from="2026-08-01", date_to="2026-08-31", date_column="accounting")
        self.assertTrue(p.date_filter)
        self.assertEqual(p.as_dict()["colonne_date"], "accounting")
        self.assertTrue(p.tag.endswith("_dacc"))
        for col, suffix in (("trade", "_dtrade"), ("value", "_dvalue")):
            self.assertTrue(P.validate("280066", output="irp", date_from="2026-08-01", date_to="2026-08-31", date_column=col).tag.endswith(suffix))
        bcr = P.validate("280287", output="bcr", date_from="2026-06-21", date_to="2026-07-01", date_column="accounting")
        self.assertTrue(bcr.date_filter)
        # Hors mode plage (IRP a une seule date, ou BCR deduit de la table NAV) : refuse.
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            self.ok(nav_date="2026-06-29", date_column="accounting")
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            P.validate("280287", output="bcr", bcr_period="last_available_day", date_column="accounting")
        # --split-by-nav remplace les dates par une NAV unique : incompatible.
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            P.validate("280066", output="irp", date_from="2026-08-01", date_to="2026-08-31", date_column="accounting", split_by_nav=True)

"""Les dates cibles des codes 3 Ã  12 suivent les rÃ¨gles d'Oracle ; valeurs confirmÃ©es par Dremio (TIMESTAMPADD, DATE_TRUNC, LAST_DAY)."""
import datetime as dt
import unittest

from tests.periods_ref import add_months, expected_start, target_date

D = dt.date


class PeriodDatesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_months_last_day_rule(self):
        cases = [((2026, 2, 28), -1, (2026, 1, 31)), ((2026, 2, 28), -12, (2025, 2, 28)), ((2024, 2, 29), -12, (2023, 2, 28)),
                 ((2026, 3, 30), -1, (2026, 2, 28)), ((2026, 3, 31), -1, (2026, 2, 28)), ((2026, 4, 30), -1, (2026, 3, 31)),
                 ((2026, 8, 31), -6, (2026, 2, 28)), ((2026, 6, 29), -1, (2026, 5, 29)), ((2026, 1, 1), -1, (2025, 12, 1)),
                 ((2026, 12, 31), -6, (2026, 6, 30)), ((2026, 9, 30), -3, (2026, 6, 30)), ((2026, 3, 29), -3, (2025, 12, 29))]
        for src, n, want in cases:
            self.assertEqual(add_months(D(*src), n), D(*want), (src, n))

    def test_targets_for_29_06_2026(self):
        nav = D(2026, 6, 29)
        want = {1: D(2026, 6, 28), 2: D(2026, 6, 22), 3: D(2026, 6, 15), 4: D(2026, 5, 29), 5: D(2026, 4, 29), 6: D(2026, 3, 29), 7: D(2025, 12, 29),
                8: D(2025, 6, 29), 9: D(2026, 5, 31), 10: D(2026, 3, 31), 11: D(2025, 12, 31), 12: D(2025, 12, 31)}
        for code, d in want.items():
            self.assertEqual(target_date(code, nav), d, code)

    def test_half_year_end_after_june(self):
        self.assertEqual(target_date(11, D(2026, 7, 1)), D(2026, 6, 30))
        self.assertEqual(target_date(11, D(2026, 12, 31)), D(2026, 6, 30))
        self.assertEqual(target_date(11, D(2026, 1, 1)), D(2025, 12, 31))

    def test_start_nav_is_the_last_nav_on_or_before_the_target(self):
        navs = [D(2026, 6, 22), D(2026, 6, 24), D(2026, 6, 26), D(2026, 6, 29)]
        self.assertEqual(expected_start(1, D(2026, 6, 29), navs), D(2026, 6, 26))
        self.assertEqual(expected_start(2, D(2026, 6, 29), navs), D(2026, 6, 22))
        self.assertIsNone(expected_start(3, D(2026, 6, 29), navs))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import tempfile

class RangeParamsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_range_is_a_third_form_of_irp_dates(self):
        p = P.validate("242013", date_from="2026-06-01", date_to="2026-06-29")
        self.assertTrue(p.range_mode)
        self.assertEqual(p.tag, "irp_242013_20260629_plage20260601_ic")
        self.assertIsNone(p.acc_from)

    def test_range_exclusions(self):
        for kw in ({"date_from": "2026-06-01"}, {"date_to": "2026-06-29"}, {"date_from": "2026-06-30", "date_to": "2026-06-01"},
                   {"date_from": "2026-06-01", "date_to": "2026-06-29", "nav_date": "2026-06-29"},
                   {"date_from": "2026-06-01", "date_to": "2026-06-29", "calc_date": "2026-06-29"},
                   {"date_from": "2026-06-01", "date_to": "2026-06-29", "period": 4}):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError, msg=str(kw)):
                P.validate("242013", **kw)

    def test_split_needs_a_range(self):
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29", split_by_nav=True)
        self.assertTrue(P.validate("242013", date_from="2026-06-01", date_to="2026-06-29", split_by_nav=True).split_by_nav)

    def test_irp_options_refused_for_bcr(self):
        for kw in ({"prenav": True}, {"split_by_nav": True}, {"follow_depooling": True}):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
                P.validate("280287", output="bcr", date_from="2026-06-21", date_to="2026-07-01", **kw)

    def test_tag_suffixes(self):
        self.assertTrue(P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29", prenav=True).tag.endswith("_prenav"))
        self.assertTrue(P.validate("242013", date_from="2026-06-01", date_to="2026-06-29", follow_depooling=True).tag.endswith("_depooling"))
        for kw in ({"nav_date": "2026-06-29"}, {"date_from": "2026-06-01", "date_to": "2026-06-29", "split_by_nav": True}):
            with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
                P.validate("242013", follow_depooling=True, **kw)

    def test_all_sixteen_codes_are_accepted(self):
        for code in range(1, 17):
            self.assertEqual(P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29", period=code).period, code)

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\frd-poc-general-ledger\tests\unit\test_repository_rules.py =====
"""Regles du depot : aucun chemin ou lien complet, aucun tiret cadratin ou demi-cadratin, jamais l'ancien sigle de la NAV, aucun identifiant, aucun nom de personne."""
import re
import subprocess
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from glapp.paths import APP_DIR

TEXT_SUFFIXES = {".py", ".sql", ".md", ".json", ".html", ".txt", ".toml", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes", ".cfg", ".ini", ".csv"}
SKIP_DIRS = {"out", "logs", "__pycache__", ".git"}
# Motifs construits par morceaux pour que ce fichier ne contienne pas lui-meme ce qu'il interdit.
COLON_SLASH = re.compile("[:][\\\\/]")
DASHES = re.compile("[\u2014\u2013]")
OLD_NAV = re.compile(r"\bV" + r"NI\b")
SECRETS = re.compile(r"(?i)bearer\s+[a-z0-9._-]{20,}|eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,}|password\s*[=:]\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"]|_dremio[a-z0-9]{20,}")
EMAIL = re.compile(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.-]+")
PERSON_DENY = ["To" + "mme"]
# Les captures du guide sont des images PNG en base64 : la charge utile n'est pas du texte a controler.
IMAGE_DATA = re.compile(r"data:image/png;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+")


def tracked_text_files():
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], cwd=APP_DIR, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
        paths = [APP_DIR / line for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        paths = [p for p in APP_DIR.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
    result = []
    for p in paths:
        rel = p.relative_to(APP_DIR)
        if rel.parts[0] in SKIP_DIRS or any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in rel.parts):
            continue
        if p.is_file() and (p.suffix.lower() in TEXT_SUFFIXES or p.name in TEXT_SUFFIXES):
            result.append(p)
    return result


class RepositoryRulesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.files = tracked_text_files()

    def scan(self, pattern, label, allow=lambda line: False):
        found = []
        for p in self.files:
            for n, line in enumerate(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").split("\n"), 1):
                line = IMAGE_DATA.sub("IMAGE", line)
                if pattern.search(line) and not allow(line):
                    found.append(f"{p.relative_to(APP_DIR)}:{n}")
        self.assertEqual(found, [], f"{label} : {found[:10]}")

    def test_files_were_found(self):
        names = {p.name for p in self.files}
        self.assertTrue({"README.md", "defaults.json", "engine.py", "20_ecritures.sql"} <= names, sorted(names)[:20])

    def test_no_full_path_or_url(self):
        self.scan(COLON_SLASH, "deux points suivis d'une barre")

    def test_no_em_or_en_dash(self):
        self.scan(DASHES, "tiret cadratin ou demi-cadratin")

    def test_never_old_nav_acronym(self):
        self.scan(OLD_NAV, "ancien sigle de la NAV")

    def test_no_credentials(self):
        self.scan(SECRETS, "identifiant ou jeton")

    def test_no_email_address(self):
        self.scan(EMAIL, "adresse de messagerie")

    def test_no_person_name_except_author(self):
        for name in PERSON_DENY:
            self.scan(re.compile(name), f"nom de personne {name}")
        self.scan(re.compile(r"(?i)\bmisch" + "ler\\b"), "nom d'auteur hors forme Oscar MISCHLER", allow=lambda line: "Oscar MISCHLER" in line)

    def test_files_are_utf8_without_bom(self):
        for p in self.files:
            self.assertFalse(p.read_bytes().startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"), p.name)

    def test_no_absolute_windows_path_in_config(self):
        text = (APP_DIR / "config" / "defaults.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIsNone(re.search(r"[A-Za-z][:][\\\\/]", text))

    def test_gitignore_covers_outputs(self):
        ignore = (APP_DIR / ".gitignore").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for entry in ("out/", "logs/", "__pycache__/"):
            self.assertIn(entry, ignore)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

          "LOT_RESULT_FROM": 8302819, "PLAN": "20", "ACC_FROM": 1450, "ACC_TO": 999999, "ACC_LIST": (1450, 999999), "SEUIL_RESULTAT": 40000, "LIMIT": 15}
# Tous les modeles executes par un Grand livre ou un lot ; 41_fonds_efront ne sert qu'a un test d'integration du mode LUXIS.
RUNTIME = ["00_fonds", "01_nav_depuis_calcul", "02_derniere_cloture", "06_type_de_nav", "10_fenetre_p01", "11_fenetre_p02", "12_fenetre_p13",
           "13_fenetre_p14", "14_fenetre_p16", "15_fenetre_bcr", "16_fenetre_calendaire", "17_navs_de_la_plage", "20_ecritures",
           "30_classement_bilan_resultat", "35_soldes_finaux", "40_fonds_a_traiter", "44_population", "50_lot_de_transfert", "51_derniere_nav",
           "60_ecart_13_16"]
EXTRA = [(), ("HAS_CLOSING",), ("C15",), ("CORRIGE", "HAS_CLOSING"), ("COMPAT",), ("TRI_BCR", "PLAN_FIXE"), ("P16_LUXIS",)]


def fund_with(kind):
    t = sansluxis.tables()
    if kind == "nav_fixe":
        return next(f for f, d in sorted(t["premiere_nav"].items()) if d)
    if kind == "nav_aucune":
        return next(f for f, d in sorted(t["premiere_nav"].items()) if not d)
    if kind == "devise":
        return sorted(t["devise"])[0]
    if kind == "antidatee":
        return sorted(t["antidatee"])[0]
    raise ValueError(kind)


class SansLuxisRenderTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_no_luxis_table_in_any_runtime_template(self):
        funds = ["242013", fund_with("nav_fixe"), fund_with("nav_aucune"), fund_with("devise"), fund_with("antidatee")]
        for step in RUNTIME:
            for fund in funds:
                for extra in EXTRA:
                    values, flags = sansluxis.decorate(dict(VALUES, FUND=fund), set(extra), fund)
                    sql = render_step(step, values, flags, "ic")
                    self.assertNotRegex(sql, r'(?i)"LUXIS"\s*\.', f"{step} {fund} {extra}")
                    self.assertNotIn("{{", sql)

    def test_no_rendered_template_contains_luxis_whatever_the_flags(self):
        """Toutes les combinaisons des drapeaux de chaque modÃ¨le exÃ©cutÃ©, en mode sans LUXIS : jamais la chaÃ®ne "LUXIS" (entre guillemets, nom de source)
        dans le SQL rendu, commentaires retirÃ©s. C'est le test qui Ã©choue si un modÃ¨le lit encore LUXIS en mode --sans-luxis."""
        import itertools
        from glapp.sqlrender import load_template
        mode_flags = {"SANS_LUXIS", "PREMIERE_NAV_FIXE", "PREMIERE_NAV_AUCUNE", "DEVISE_FIXE"}
        values = dict(VALUES, ANTIDATE=0, FIRST_NAV="2012-10-04", CCY="EUR")
        rendered = 0
        for step in RUNTIME:
            text = load_template(step)
            flags = sorted(set(re.findall(r"--#SI ([A-Z_0-9]+)", text)) - mode_flags)
            for k in range(len(flags) + 1):
                for combo in itertools.combinations(flags, k):
                    for first in ((), ("PREMIERE_NAV_FIXE",), ("PREMIERE_NAV_AUCUNE",)):
                        for ccy in ((), ("DEVISE_FIXE",)):
                            sql = render_step(step, values, {"SANS_LUXIS", *combo, *first, *ccy}, "ic")
                            self.assertNotIn('"LUXIS"', sql.upper(), f"{step} {combo} {first} {ccy}")
                            self.assertNotIn("TAB_FND_MAIN", sql.upper(), step)
                            self.assertNotIn("NAV_QT_TOT_PART", sql.upper(), step)
                            rendered += 1
        self.assertGreater(rendered, 1000)

    def test_luxis_mode_still_reads_table_fonds(self):
        self.assertIn('"LUXIS"."REPADMIN"."TAB_FND_MAIN"', render_step("00_fonds", VALUES))
        self.assertIn('"LUXIS"."REPADMIN"."NAV"', render_step("16_fenetre_calendaire", VALUES, {"C15"}))

    def test_first_nav_rules(self):
        fixed = fund_with("nav_fixe")
        values, flags = sansluxis.decorate({"FUND": fixed, "NAV": "2026-06-29"}, {"C15"}, fixed)
        sql = render_step("16_fenetre_calendaire", values, flags)
        self.assertIn(f"TIMESTAMP '{sansluxis.tables()['premiere_nav'][fixed]} 00:00:00' AS NAV_FROM", sql)
        none = fund_with("nav_aucune")
        values, flags = sansluxis.decorate({"FUND": none, "NAV": "2026-06-29"}, {"C15"}, none)
        self.assertIn("WHERE 1 = 0", render_step("16_fenetre_calendaire", values, flags))
        values, flags = sansluxis.decorate({"FUND": "242013", "NAV": "2026-06-29"}, {"C15"}, "242013")
        sql = render_step("16_fenetre_calendaire", values, flags)
        self.assertIn("AMS_NAV_ARC_SHARE_DETAIL", sql)
        self.assertIn("Q_OUTSTANDING <> 0", sql)

    def test_backdated_and_currency_values(self):
        bd = fund_with("antidatee")
        values, _ = sansluxis.decorate({"FUND": bd}, set(), bd)
        self.assertEqual(values["ANTIDATE"], 1)
        self.assertIn("SELECT 1 AS BACKDATED", render_step("10_fenetre_p01", dict(values, NAV="2026-06-29"), {"SANS_LUXIS"}))
        self.assertEqual(sansluxis.decorate({"FUND": "242013"}, set(), "242013")[0]["ANTIDATE"], 0)
        ccy = fund_with("devise")
        values, flags = sansluxis.decorate(dict(VALUES, FUND=ccy), {"TRI_IRP"}, ccy)
        self.assertIn("DEVISE_FIXE", flags)
        self.assertIn(f"'{sansluxis.tables()['devise'][ccy]}' AS SUBFUND_CCY", render_step("20_ecritures", values, flags))

    def test_fund_name_from_mfga(self):
        values, flags = sansluxis.decorate(VALUES, {"TRI_IRP"}, "242013")
        sql = render_step("20_ecritures", values, flags)
        self.assertIn("pf.L_FUND", sql)
        self.assertIn("(SELECT fi.L_FUND FROM fiche fi) AS SUBFUND_NAME", sql)

    def test_currency_literal_is_validated(self):
        from glapp.sqlrender import RenderError
        with self.assertRaises(RenderError):
            render_step("20_ecritures", dict(VALUES, CCY="EU'R"), {"TRI_IRP", "SANS_LUXIS", "DEVISE_FIXE"})


class SansLuxisTablesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_tables_hold_only_numbers_codes_and_dates(self):
        t = sansluxis.tables()
        fund = re.compile(r"[0-9A-Z]{1,10}")
        for f, c in t["devise"].items():
            self.assertRegex(f, fund)
            self.assertRegex(c, r"^[A-Z]{3}$")
        for f, d in t["premiere_nav"].items():
            self.assertRegex(f, fund)
            self.assertTrue(d is None or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}", d), d)
        for key in ("efront", "antidatee", "absents"):
            self.assertTrue(t[key])
            for f in t[key]:
                self.assertRegex(f, fund)
        self.assertRegex(t["date"], r"^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$")

    def test_fiche_applies_frozen_tables(self):
        self.assertEqual(sansluxis.fiche({"F_NAME": "X", "F_CCY": "USD"}, sorted(sansluxis.tables()["absents"])[0]), {})
        self.assertEqual(sansluxis.fiche(None, "242013"), {})
        ef = sorted(sansluxis.tables()["efront"])[0]
        self.assertEqual(sansluxis.fiche({"F_NAME": "X", "F_CCY": "EUR"}, ef)["EFRONT"], "1")
        ccy = fund_with("devise")
        self.assertEqual(sansluxis.fiche({"F_NAME": "X", "F_CCY": "ZZZ"}, ccy)["F_CCY"], sansluxis.tables()["devise"][ccy])
        f = sansluxis.fiche({"F_NAME": "X", "F_CCY": "EUR"}, "242013")
        self.assertEqual((f["EFRONT"], f["NAV_BACKDATED"], f["F_CCY"]), ("0", 0, "EUR"))

    def test_efront_refused_and_absent_message(self):
        ef = sorted(sansluxis.tables()["efront"])[0]
        with self.assertRaises(engine.EfrontRefused):
            engine.check_fund(sansluxis.fiche({"F_NAME": "X", "F_CCY": "EUR"}, ef), ef, True)
        absent = sorted(sansluxis.tables()["absents"])[0]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(engine.GlError, "Table Fonds au"):
            engine.check_fund({}, absent, True)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(engine.GlError, "AMS_PORTFOLIO"):
            engine.check_fund({}, "242013", True)


class SansLuxisParamsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_option_tag_and_json_field(self):
        p = P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29", sans_luxis=True)
        self.assertTrue(p.sans_luxis)
        self.assertTrue(p.tag.endswith("_sansluxis"))
        self.assertTrue(p.as_dict()["sans_luxis"])
        self.assertFalse(P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29").sans_luxis)
        with self.assertRaises(P.ParamError):
            P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29", source="lx", sans_luxis=True)

    def test_window_and_entries_specs_are_decorated(self):
        p = P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29", period=15, sans_luxis=True)
        _, values, flags = engine.window_spec(p, "2026-06-29")
        self.assertIn("SANS_LUXIS", flags)
        self.assertEqual(values["ANTIDATE"], 0)
        _, flags = engine.entries_spec(p, {"lot_from": 1, "lot_to": 2, "trade_max": None, "lot_result_from": None})
        self.assertIn("SANS_LUXIS", flags)
        _, _, flags = engine.window_spec(P.validate("242013", nav_date="2026-06-29", period=15), "2026-06-29")
        self.assertNotIn("SANS_LUXIS", flags)


class FakeGateway:
    def __init__(self, rows):
        self.rows, self.log, self.sql, self.sans_luxis = rows, [], [], False

    def query(self, name, sql, **_):
        self.sql.append(sql)
        self.log.append({"name": name, "rows": len(self.rows), "seconds": 0.0})
        return self.rows

"""Page locale (glapp.web) : routes, lien 127.0.0.1 uniquement, une seule exÃ©cution Ã  la fois, tÃ©lÃ©chargements bornÃ©s au dossier
du lot, mÃªmes messages d'erreur que la CLI, pages sans ressource externe, textes bilingues, appels Ã  glapp.service simulÃ©s."""
import json
import threading
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from glapp import i18n, web
from glapp.engine import GlError
from glapp.paths import APP_DIR, load_config


def start_server(cfg):
    web.Handler.job = web.Job()
    web.Handler.cfg = cfg
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), web.Handler)
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    return server, thread


class WebTestCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.cfg = load_config()
        self.server, self.thread = start_server(self.cfg)
        self.base = "http:" + "//127.0.0.1:" + str(self.server.server_address[1])
        self.addCleanup(i18n.set_lang, "fr")
        self.addCleanup(self.server.server_close)
        self.addCleanup(self.thread.join, 5)
        self.addCleanup(self.server.shutdown)

    def get(self, path, lang=None):
        url = self.base + path
        if lang:
            url += ("&" if "?" in path else "?") + "lang=" + lang
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5) as r:
                return r.status, r.read(), dict(r.headers)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            return exc.code, exc.read(), dict(exc.headers)

    def post(self, path, body):
        data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
        req = urllib.request.Request(self.base + path, data=data, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as r:
                return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            return exc.code, json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))

    def wait_for_job(self, timeout=10):
        end = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < end:
            status, body, _ = self.get("/api/status")
            snap = json.loads(body)
            if not snap["busy"]:
                return snap
            time.sleep(0.02)
        self.fail("le travail ne se termine pas")

class StaticPagesTest(WebTestCase):

        self.assertNotIn("https:" + "//", text)
        self.assertNotIn("cdn.", text)
        self.assertEqual(headers.get("Content-Type"), "text/html; charset=utf-8")

    def test_css_and_js_served_locally_without_external_resource(self):
        for path, content_type in (("/app.css", "text/css"), ("/app.js", "application/javascript")):
            status, body, headers = self.get(path)
            self.assertEqual(status, 200)
            text = body.decode("utf-8")
            self.assertNotIn("http:" + "//", text)
            self.assertNotIn("https:" + "//", text)
            self.assertTrue(headers.get("Content-Type", "").startswith(content_type))

class SingleExecutionTest(WebTestCase):
    def test_second_run_is_refused_while_one_is_busy(self):
        gate = threading.Event()

        def slow_run(fields, **kwargs):
            gate.wait(5)
            raise GlError("stop")

        with mock.patch("glapp.service.run_fields", side_effect=slow_run):
            status1, body1 = self.post("/api/run", {"action": "run", "fund": "242013", "nav_date": "2026-06-29"})
            self.assertEqual(status1, 202)
            status2, body2 = self.post("/api/run", {"action": "run", "fund": "242013", "nav_date": "2026-06-29"})
            self.assertEqual(status2, 409)
            self.assertIn(body2["error"], (i18n.t("web.busy"),))
            gate.set()
            self.wait_for_job()

    def test_unknown_action_is_refused(self):
        status, body = self.post("/api/run", {"action": "nope"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertIn("nope", body["error"])

class JobConcurrencyUnitTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_job_start_refuses_a_second_execution_while_busy(self):
        job = web.Job()
        gate = threading.Event()
        started = threading.Event()

        def worker(progress):
            started.set()
            gate.wait(5)
            return {"ok": True}, []
        self.assertTrue(job.start("run", worker))
        started.wait(5)
        self.assertFalse(job.start("run", worker))
        gate.set()
        end = time.time() + 5
        while job.snapshot()["busy"] and time.time() < end:
            time.sleep(0.01)
        self.assertFalse(job.snapshot()["busy"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

def slug(t):
    t = t.lower()
    for a, b in (("Ã©", "e"), ("Ã¨", "e"), ("Ãª", "e"), ("Ã ", "a"), ("Ã§", "c"), ("Ã´", "o"), ("Ã®", "i"), ("Ã»", "u"), ("Ã¹", "u"), ("'", "-")):
        t = t.replace(a, b)
    t = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", t).strip("-")
    return t[:50]

def inline(s):
    parts = re.split(r"(`[^`]+`)", s)
    out = []
    for p in parts:
        if p.startswith("`") and p.endswith("`") and len(p) > 1:
            out.append("<code>" + html.escape(p[1:-1]) + "</code>")
        else:
            e = html.escape(p, quote=False)
            e = re.sub(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*", r"<b>\1</b>", e)
            out.append(e)
    return "".join(out)

def table(lines):
    rows = [[c.strip() for c in l.strip().strip("|").split("|")] for l in lines]
    head, body = rows[0], rows[2:]
    kv = all(not h for h in head)
    o = ["<div class='tbl-wrap'><table" + (" class='kv'" if kv else "") + ">"]
    if not kv:
        o.append("<thead><tr>" + "".join("<th>" + inline(h) + "</th>" for h in head) + "</tr></thead>")
    o.append("<tbody>")
    for r in body:
        o.append("<tr>" + "".join("<td>" + inline(c) + "</td>" for c in r) + "</tr>")
    o.append("</tbody></table></div>")
    return "".join(o)

def figure(alt, rel):
    path = MD.parent / rel
    data = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
    a = html.escape(alt, quote=True)
    return f"<figure class='shot'><img alt='{a}' src='data:image/png;base64,{data}'><figcaption>{html.escape(alt)}</figcaption></figure>"

mail_n = [0]

def blockquote(lines):
    text = [re.sub(r"^>\s?", "", l) for l in lines]
    first = text[0]
    if first.startswith("Objet"):
        mail_n[0] += 1
        mid = f"mail{mail_n[0]}"
        body = render_blocks(text)
        return (f"<div class='copyrow'><button type='button' class='btn cpmail' data-t='{mid}'>Copier le message</button></div>"
                f"<div class='mail' id='{mid}'>{body}</div>")
    cls = "fact"
    if first.startswith(("**Ã€ valider", "**Ã€ confirmer", "**Prudence", "**Limites")):
        cls = "warn"
    return f"<div class='{cls}'>" + render_blocks(text) + "</div>"

def render_blocks(lines):
    out, i, para = [], 0, []
    def flush():
        if para:
            out.append("<p>" + inline(" ".join(para)) + "</p>")
            para.clear()
    while i < len(lines):
        l = lines[i]
        if not l.strip():
            flush(); i += 1; continue
        if l.startswith("```"):
            flush()
            j = i + 1
            while not lines[j].startswith("```"):
                j += 1
            code = "\n".join(lines[i + 1:j])
            cls = "schema" if ("|" in code and "v" in code and "+" in code) else "cmd"
            out.append(f"<pre class='{cls}'>" + html.escape(code) + "</pre>")
            i = j + 1; continue
        if l.startswith("|"):
            flush()
            j = i
            while j < len(lines) and lines[j].startswith("|"):
                j += 1
            out.append(table(lines[i:j])); i = j; continue
        if l.startswith(">"):
            flush()
            j = i
            while j < len(lines) and lines[j].startswith(">"):
                j += 1
            out.append(blockquote(lines[i:j])); i = j; continue
        im = re.match(r"^!\[(.*)\]\((.+)\)\s*$", l)
        if im:
            flush()
            out.append(figure(im.group(1), im.group(2)))
            i += 1
            continue
        m = re.match(r"^(\d+)\. (.*)", l)
        if m or l.startswith("- "):
            flush()
            tag = "ol" if m else "ul"
            items = []
            while i < len(lines) and (re.match(r"^\d+\. ", lines[i]) if tag == "ol" else lines[i].startswith("- ")):
                items.append(re.sub(r"^(\d+\. |- )", "", lines[i])); i += 1
            out.append(f"<{tag}>" + "".join("<li>" + inline(x) + "</li>" for x in items) + f"</{tag}>")
            continue
        para.append(l.strip()); i += 1
    flush()
    return "".join(out)
