===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\catalog.py =====
"""Exploration du catalogue Dremio (lecture seule) pour construire le mapping Luxis -> MFGA/Infocentre.

    python -m luxrep_reports.core.catalog tables  [--like AMS_DEAL%] [--schema DWH]
    python -m luxrep_reports.core.catalog columns TABLE [--schema DWH]
    python -m luxrep_reports.core.catalog sample  TABLE [--where "C_FUND='280287'"] [--n 5]
    python -m luxrep_reports.core.catalog find    MOTIF        (colonnes dont le nom contient MOTIF)
    python -m luxrep_reports.core.catalog sql     "SELECT ..."  (requete libre lecture seule)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys

from .gateway import Gateway

DEFAULT_SOURCE = "MFGA_INFOCENTRE"


def _print(cols, rows, limit=200):
    if not rows:
        print("(aucune ligne)")
        return
    for r in rows[:limit]:
        print(" | ".join("" if r.get(c) is None else str(r.get(c)) for c in cols))
    if len(rows) > limit:
        print(f"... {len(rows) - limit} lignes de plus")


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    p.add_argument("--env", default="ctlq")
    p.add_argument("--source", default=DEFAULT_SOURCE)
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    t = sub.add_parser("tables"); t.add_argument("--like", default="%"); t.add_argument("--schema", default=None)
    c = sub.add_parser("columns"); c.add_argument("table"); c.add_argument("--schema", default=None)
    s = sub.add_parser("sample"); s.add_argument("table"); s.add_argument("--schema", default="DWH")
    s.add_argument("--where", default=None); s.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=5)
    f = sub.add_parser("find"); f.add_argument("motif")
    q = sub.add_parser("sql"); q.add_argument("statement")
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    gw = Gateway(env=a.env)
    src = a.source
    if a.cmd == "tables":
        sch = f"AND TABLE_SCHEMA = '{a.schema}'" if a.schema else ""
        sql = (f"SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.\"TABLES\" "
               f"WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE '{src}%' AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) LIKE UPPER('{a.like}') {sch} "
               f"ORDER BY 1, 2")
    elif a.cmd == "columns":
        sch = f"AND TABLE_SCHEMA = '{src}.{a.schema}'" if a.schema else f"AND TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE '{src}%'"
        sql = (f"SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.\"COLUMNS\" "
               f"WHERE UPPER(TABLE_NAME) = UPPER('{a.table}') {sch} ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION")
    elif a.cmd == "find":
        sql = (f"SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.\"COLUMNS\" "
               f"WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE '{src}%' AND UPPER(COLUMN_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%{a.motif}%') ORDER BY 1,2,3")
    elif a.cmd == "sample":
        w = f"WHERE {a.where}" if a.where else ""
        sql = f"SELECT * FROM {src}.{a.schema}.{a.table} {w} LIMIT {a.n}"
    else:
        sql = a.statement
        if sql.startswith("@"):  # @fichier.sql : lit la requete dans un fichier
            from pathlib import Path
            sql = Path(sql[1:]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    cols, rows = gw.query("catalog", sql)
    _print(cols, rows)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\cli.py =====
"""CLI des rapports LuxRep (BCR et TA) : menu interactif ou options, au choix.

    python -m luxrep_reports                         menu interactif (tout est demande, valeurs par defaut proposees)
    python -m luxrep_reports list                    rapports disponibles
    python -m luxrep_reports run coupons_dividendes --funds 280287 --from 2026-06-01 --to 2026-07-01 --yes
    python -m luxrep_reports run coupons_dividendes --funds 280299 --depooling both --from 2026-09-01 --to 2026-09-30
    python -m luxrep_reports funds --like 2802       liste des fonds (selecteur de fonds)
    python -m luxrep_reports depooling 280299        structure de depooling detectee pour un pool
    python -m luxrep_reports probe                   etat de la session Dremio
    python -m luxrep_reports catalog tables --like AMS_DEAL%      exploration du catalogue (mapping)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from . import registry
from .gateway import Gateway, GatewayError, AuthExpired
from .params import (Params, ParamError, DATE_TYPES, PERIOD_TYPES, DEPOOLING_MODES, parse_list, parse_date, ENVS)

DEFAULT_OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "out"


def _ask(label: str, default=None, choices: dict | None = None, allow_empty=False):
    suffix = f" [{default}]" if default not in (None, "") else ""
    while True:
        if choices:
            print(f"\n{label}")
            keys = list(choices)
            for i, k in enumerate(keys, 1):
                print(f"  {i}) {k:<16} {choices[k]}")
            raw = input(f"Choix{suffix} : ").strip()
            if not raw and default is not None:
                return default
            if raw.isdigit() and 1 <= int(raw) <= len(keys):
                return keys[int(raw) - 1]
            if raw in choices:
                return raw
            print("  valeur non reconnue")
            continue
        raw = input(f"{label}{suffix} : ").strip()
        if raw:
            return raw
        if default is not None:
            return default
        if allow_empty:
            return ""
        print("  valeur requise")


def _extra_defaults(spec) -> dict:
    return {e.name: e.default for e in spec.extra_params}


def interactive() -> int:
    avail = registry.available()
    if not avail:
        print("aucun rapport installe")
        return 2
    print("=== LuxRep - rapports BCR / TA (Dremio, lecture seule) ===")
    key = _ask("Rapport", choices=avail, default=next(iter(avail)))
    spec = registry.load(key)
    env = _ask("Serveur Dremio", default="ctlq", choices={e: "" for e in ENVS})
    funds = _ask("Fonds (numeros separes par des virgules" + ("" if spec.windowed else ", vide = selon les options") + ")",
                 allow_empty=not spec.windowed)
    p = Params(env=env, funds=parse_list(funds))
    if spec.windowed:
        p.date_type = _ask("Selecteur de date", default="nav", choices=DATE_TYPES)
        p.period_type = _ask("Type de periode", default="range", choices=PERIOD_TYPES)
        if p.period_type in ("range", "to_last_nav"):
            p.date_from = parse_date(_ask("Date From (AAAA-MM-JJ)"))
        if p.period_type == "range":
            p.date_to = parse_date(_ask("Date To (AAAA-MM-JJ)"))
        p.depooling = _ask("Depooling (le fonds saisi est le pool)", default="none", choices=DEPOOLING_MODES)
    elif spec.dates_required:
        p.date_from = parse_date(_ask("Date From (AAAA-MM-JJ)"))
        p.date_to = parse_date(_ask("Date To (AAAA-MM-JJ)"))
    p.name_source = _ask("Source du nom des fonds", default="mfga",
                         choices={"mfga": "AMS_PORTFOLIO (aucune table LUXIS)", "luxis": "LUXREP_TB_FONDS (nom identique a LUXIS)"})
    for e in spec.extra_params:
        raw = _ask(f"{e.name} - {e.help}", default=e.default if e.default not in (None, []) else None, allow_empty=True)
        p.extra[e.name] = parse_list(raw) if e.kind == "list" else (int(raw) if e.kind == "int" and raw else raw or None)
    p.formats = tuple(parse_list(_ask("Formats (xlsx, csv)", default="xlsx,csv")))
    p.out_dir = Path(_ask("Dossier de sortie", default=str(DEFAULT_OUT)))
    ref = _ask("Sortie LUXIS de reference a comparer (chemin, vide = aucune)", allow_empty=True)
    p.compare_ref = Path(ref) if ref else None
    return _execute(spec, p, yes=False)


def _execute(spec, p: Params, yes: bool, depool_source="mfga") -> int:
    from .runner import run
    try:
        p.validate(needs_dates=spec.dates_required and p.period_type != "last_available",
                   needs_funds=spec.windowed or bool(p.funds))
    except ParamError as exc:
        print(f"parametres invalides : {exc}")
        return 2
    print("\n--- Recapitulatif ---")
    for k, v in p.as_dict().items():
        if v not in (None, [], {}, ""):
            print(f"  {k:<14} {v}")
    if not yes and input("Lancer ? [O/n] ").strip().lower() in ("n", "non", "no"):
        print("annule")
        return 1
    try:
        res = run(spec, p, depool_source=depool_source)
    except AuthExpired as exc:
        print(f"\n{exc}")
        return 3
    except (ParamError, GatewayError, RuntimeError, KeyError) as exc:
        print(f"\nechec : {exc}")
        return 2
    s = res["summary"]
    print(f"\nVerdict : {s['verdict']}")
    for lv, msg in s["checks"]:
        print(f"  [{lv}] {msg}")
    print(f"Dossier : {res['run_dir']}")
    for f in s["files"]:
        print(f"  - {f}")
    return 0 if s["verdict"] != "ECART" else 4


def _add_run_args(ap, spec_keys):
    ap.add_argument("report", choices=spec_keys)
    ap.add_argument("--env", default="ctlq", choices=ENVS)
    ap.add_argument("--funds", default="", help="numeros de fonds separes par des virgules")
    ap.add_argument("--date-type", default="nav", choices=list(DATE_TYPES), help="nav = date NAV ; calc = date de calcul")
    ap.add_argument("--period", default="range", choices=list(PERIOD_TYPES))
    ap.add_argument("--from", dest="date_from")
    ap.add_argument("--to", dest="date_to")
    ap.add_argument("--depooling", default="none", choices=list(DEPOOLING_MODES))
    ap.add_argument("--depooling-source", default="mfga", choices=["mfga", "table"],
                    help="mfga = detection dans MFGA (aucune table LUXIS) ; table = table Fonds sauvegardee versionnee")
    ap.add_argument("--formats", default="xlsx,csv")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=str(DEFAULT_OUT))
    ap.add_argument("--compare", default=None, help="sortie LUXIS de reference (XLSX ou CSV)")
    ap.add_argument("--names", default="mfga", choices=["mfga", "luxis"],
                    help="source du nom/devise des fonds : mfga (AMS_PORTFOLIO, aucune table LUXIS) ou luxis (LUXREP_TB_FONDS, nom identique a LUXIS)")
    ap.add_argument("--include-from-nav", action="store_true", help="garder la NAV de depart (hors regle LUXIS)")
    ap.add_argument("--max-rows", type=int, default=500000)
    ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=1800)
    ap.add_argument("--yes", action="store_true", help="ne pas demander de confirmation")
    ap.add_argument("--set", action="append", default=[], metavar="NOM=VALEUR",
                    help="parametre propre au rapport (voir `list`), repetable")


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    argv = list(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
    if not argv:
        return interactive()
    cmd = argv[0]
    if cmd == "list":
        for k, label in registry.available().items():
            spec = registry.load(k)
            extras = ", ".join(f"{e.name}" for e in spec.extra_params)
            print(f"{k:<24} {label}" + (f"   (--set {extras}=...)" if extras else ""))
        missing = set(registry.REPORTS) - set(registry.available())
        for k in sorted(missing):
            print(f"{k:<24} (non installe)")
        return 0
    if cmd == "probe":
        env = argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else "ctlq"
        ok, msg = Gateway(env=env).probe()
        print(f"{env.upper()} : {msg}")
        return 0 if ok else 3
    if cmd == "catalog":
        from . import catalog
        return catalog.main(argv[1:])
    if cmd == "funds":
        ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="funds")
        ap.add_argument("--env", default="ctlq", choices=ENVS)
        ap.add_argument("--like", default="")
        a = ap.parse_args(argv[1:])
        from .sqlutil import q
        like = a.like.upper().replace("'", "")
        sql = ("SELECT x.C_FUND, x.L_FUND, x.C_CCY, x.C_CONSOLIDATED FROM (SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY, p.C_CONSOLIDATED, "
               "ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p"
               + (f" WHERE UPPER(p.C_FUND) LIKE '%{like}%' OR UPPER(p.L_FUND) LIKE '%{like}%'" if like else "")
               + ") x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.C_FUND")
        for r in Gateway(env=a.env).rows("funds", sql):
            print(f"{str(r['C_FUND']).strip():<10} {str(r['C_CCY']).strip():<4} {str(r['L_FUND']).strip()}")
        return 0
    if cmd == "depooling":
        ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="depooling")
        ap.add_argument("pool")
        ap.add_argument("--env", default="ctlq", choices=ENVS)
        ap.add_argument("--source", default="mfga", choices=["mfga", "table"])
        a = ap.parse_args(argv[1:])
        from .depooling import resolve_structure
        try:
            st = resolve_structure(Gateway(env=a.env), a.pool.upper(), a.source)
        except ParamError as exc:
            print(exc)
            return 2
        import json
        print(json.dumps(st.as_dict(), indent=1, default=str))
        return 0
    if cmd == "run":
        keys = list(registry.REPORTS)
        ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="run")
        _add_run_args(ap, keys)
        a = ap.parse_args(argv[1:])
        spec = registry.load(a.report)
        extra = _extra_defaults(spec)
        for item in a.set:
            if "=" not in item:
                print(f"--set attend NOM=VALEUR (recu {item!r})")
                return 2
            k, v = item.split("=", 1)
            names = {e.name: e for e in spec.extra_params}
            if k not in names:
                print(f"parametre {k!r} inconnu pour {spec.key} (connus : {', '.join(names) or 'aucun'})")
                return 2
            e = names[k]
            extra[k] = parse_list(v) if e.kind == "list" else (int(v) if e.kind == "int" else v)
        p = Params(env=a.env, funds=parse_list(a.funds), date_type=a.date_type, period_type=a.period,
                   date_from=parse_date(a.date_from) if a.date_from else None,
                   date_to=parse_date(a.date_to) if a.date_to else None,
                   depooling=a.depooling, formats=tuple(parse_list(a.formats)), out_dir=Path(a.out),
                   compare_ref=Path(a.compare) if a.compare else None, inclusive_from=a.include_from_nav, name_source=a.names,
                   extra=extra, max_rows=a.max_rows, timeout=a.timeout)
        return _execute(spec, p, yes=a.yes, depool_source=a.depooling_source)
    print(__doc__)
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\compare.py =====
"""Rapprochement ligne a ligne et colonne a colonne d'une sortie produite avec une sortie LUXIS de reference (XLSX ou CSV)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from . import xlsxread
from .outputs import coerce
from .report import ReportSpec

TOL = 0.0051


def read_reference(path: Path, spec: ReportSpec) -> list[dict]:
    path = Path(path)
    if path.suffix.lower() == ".csv":
        with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
            sample = f.read(4096)
            f.seek(0)
            delim = ";" if sample.count(";") >= sample.count(",") else ","
            rows = [dict(r) for r in csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=delim)]
        return rows
    names = xlsxread.sheet_names(path)
    sheet = spec.sheet if spec.sheet in names else names[0]
    data = xlsxread.read_sheet(path, sheet)
    if not data:
        return []
    head = [str(h).strip() if h is not None else "" for h in data[0]]
    # certains classeurs LUXIS ont une ligne vide avant les en-tetes
    start = 1
    if not any(h in spec.columns for h in head) and len(data) > 1:
        head = [str(h).strip() if h is not None else "" for h in data[1]]
        start = 2
    return [dict(zip(head, r + [None] * (len(head) - len(r)))) for r in data[start:]]


def _norm(v):
    if v is None or v == "":
        return None
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v.replace(microsecond=0)
    if isinstance(v, str):
        s = v.strip()
        return s if s != "" else None
    return v


def _equal(a, b) -> bool:
    a, b = _norm(a), _norm(b)
    if a is None and b is None:
        return True
    if a is None or b is None:
        return (a in (None, 0, 0.0) and b in (None, 0, 0.0)) or False
    if isinstance(a, (int, float)) and isinstance(b, (int, float)):
        return abs(float(a) - float(b)) <= TOL
    if isinstance(a, datetime) or isinstance(b, datetime):
        return str(a)[:10] == str(b)[:10]
    try:
        return abs(float(a) - float(b)) <= TOL
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return str(a) == str(b)


def _key_part(v) -> str:
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    v = _norm(v)
    if v is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, float) and v == int(v):
        return str(int(v))
    return str(v)


def _keyed(rows: list[dict], key_cols: list[str], spec: ReportSpec) -> dict:
    out = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        out[tuple(_key_part(coerce(spec, c, r.get(c))) for c in key_cols)].append(r)
    return out


def compare(spec: ReportSpec, produced: list[dict], ref_path: Path, max_diffs: int = 500) -> dict:
    ref = read_reference(ref_path, spec)
    keys = spec.key_columns or spec.columns[:6]
    cols = [c for c in spec.columns if c in (ref[0] if ref else {}) and c not in spec.volatile_columns]
    a, b = _keyed(ref, keys, spec), _keyed(produced, keys, spec)
    identical = different = only_ref = only_out = 0
    diffs = []
    for k in sorted(set(a) | set(b)):
        ra, rb = a.get(k, []), b.get(k, [])
        for i in range(max(len(ra), len(rb))):
            if i >= len(rb):
                only_ref += 1
                diffs.append([" | ".join(k), "(ligne)", "presente", "absente"])
            elif i >= len(ra):
                only_out += 1
                diffs.append([" | ".join(k), "(ligne)", "absente", "presente"])
            else:
                bad = [c for c in cols if not _equal(coerce(spec, c, ra[i].get(c)), coerce(spec, c, rb[i].get(c)))]
                if bad:
                    different += 1
                    for c in bad:
                        diffs.append([" | ".join(k), c, coerce(spec, c, ra[i].get(c)), coerce(spec, c, rb[i].get(c))])
                else:
                    identical += 1
    return {"reference": str(ref_path), "ref_rows": len(ref), "out_rows": len(produced), "identical": identical,
            "different": different, "only_ref": only_ref, "only_out": only_out,
            "columns_compared": cols, "key": keys, "differences": diffs[:max_diffs],
            "equal": different == 0 and only_ref == 0 and only_out == 0}



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\depooling.py =====
"""Depooling : avant / apres, depuis MFGA seulement (aucune table LUXIS) ou depuis la table de correspondance versionnee.

Convention 2026 (decision du Reporting, reprise du General Ledger) : le pool garde son numero et reprend les classes de ses feeders.
  * AVANT depooling : un rapport par ancien feeder, sous son propre numero, jusqu'a sa derniere NAV ;
  * APRES depooling : le rapport du pool seul, a partir du lot de transfert (premier lot du pool posterieur au dernier lot des feeders) ;
  * both : les deux, plus un fichier qui les reunit pour l'envoi.
Les lignes du pool avant le lot de transfert ne sont dans aucun segment (le pool consolide deja ses feeders : double compte).

Detection MFGA (AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL : C_FUND = pool, C_SUB_FUND = feeder, une ligne par position et par NAV) :
un feeder est dedoole quand sa derniere NAV de lien est anterieure a la derniere NAV du pool.
Source `table` : config/depooling_table_fonds.json (Table Fonds sauvegardee de LUXIS, copiee du General Ledger) - donne
aussi le lot de depooling constate ; elle ne sert que de liste de feeders, les lots sont toujours lus dans MFGA.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from .params import Params, ParamError
from .sqlutil import q, in_list
from .window import FundWindow, compute_windows, _to_date

CONFIG_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "config"
TABLE_FILE = CONFIG_DIR / "depooling_table_fonds.json"


@dataclass
class Feeder:
    number: str
    link_end: date | None = None
    last_lot: int | None = None
    last_nav: date | None = None


@dataclass
class Structure:
    pool: str
    feeders: list[Feeder] = field(default_factory=list)
    depooling_date: date | None = None
    transfer_lot: int | None = None     # premier lot du pool apres le dernier lot des feeders
    transfer_nav: date | None = None
    source: str = "mfga"

    def as_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {"pool": self.pool, "source": self.source,
                "depooling_date": self.depooling_date.isoformat() if self.depooling_date else None,
                "transfer_lot": self.transfer_lot,
                "transfer_nav": self.transfer_nav.isoformat() if self.transfer_nav else None,
                "feeders": [{"number": f.number, "link_end": f.link_end.isoformat() if f.link_end else None,
                             "last_lot": f.last_lot, "last_nav": f.last_nav.isoformat() if f.last_nav else None}
                            for f in self.feeders]}


@dataclass
class Segment:
    label: str                 # 'direct' | 'avant' | 'apres'
    windows: list[FundWindow]
    note: str = ""


def _feeders_from_mfga(gw, pool: str) -> list[Feeder]:
    sql = (
        "SELECT v.C_SUB_FUND AS FEEDER, MAX(v.D_NAV) AS LINK_END\n"
        "FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_VAL_POOL v\n"
        f"WHERE v.C_FUND = {q(pool)}\n"
        "GROUP BY v.C_SUB_FUND\nORDER BY 1"
    )
    return [Feeder(str(r["FEEDER"]).strip(), _to_date(r["LINK_END"])) for r in gw.rows("depool_links", sql)]


def _feeders_from_table(pool: str) -> list[Feeder]:
    if not TABLE_FILE.is_file():
        raise ParamError(f"table de depooling absente : {TABLE_FILE}")
    data = json.loads(TABLE_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for s in data.get("structures", []):
        if s["pool"] == pool:
            return [Feeder(f["numero"], _to_date(s.get("date_depooling"))) for f in s["feeders"]]
    return []


def resolve_structure(gw, pool: str, source: str = "mfga") -> Structure:
    """La structure de depooling d'un pool ; ParamError si le fonds n'est pas un pool depoole."""
    feeders = _feeders_from_table(pool) if source == "table" else _feeders_from_mfga(gw, pool)
    feeders = [f for f in feeders if f.number != pool]
    if not feeders:
        raise ParamError(f"{pool} n'a aucun feeder connu ({source}) : pas de depooling a suivre")
    funds = [pool] + [f.number for f in feeders]
    sql = (
        "SELECT l.C_FUND, MAX(l.N_LOT) AS LAST_LOT, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS LAST_NAV\n"
        f"FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l WHERE l.C_FUND IN ({in_list(funds)})\nGROUP BY l.C_FUND"
    )
    last = {str(r["C_FUND"]).strip(): r for r in gw.rows("depool_last_lots", sql)}
    pool_last = last.get(pool)
    if pool_last is None:
        raise ParamError(f"{pool} : aucun lot dans AMS_LOT")
    pool_nav = _to_date(pool_last["LAST_NAV"])
    kept = []
    for f in feeders:
        r = last.get(f.number)
        if r is None:
            continue
        f.last_lot, f.last_nav = int(r["LAST_LOT"]), _to_date(r["LAST_NAV"])
        if f.link_end is None:
            f.link_end = f.last_nav
        # feeder depoole : il n'a plus de NAV alors que le pool en a
        if f.last_nav is not None and pool_nav is not None and f.last_nav < pool_nav:
            kept.append(f)
    if not kept:
        raise ParamError(f"{pool} : ses feeders ont encore des NAV, aucun depooling constate")
    st = Structure(pool, kept, source=source)
    st.depooling_date = max(f.last_nav for f in kept if f.last_nav)
    last_feeder_lot = max(f.last_lot for f in kept if f.last_lot)
    sql = (
        "SELECT MIN(l.N_LOT) AS LOT_TRANSFERT, MIN(l.D_NAV) AS NAV_TRANSFERT\n"
        f"FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l WHERE l.C_FUND = {q(pool)} AND l.N_LOT > {int(last_feeder_lot)}"
    )
    rows = gw.rows("depool_transfer", sql)
    if rows and rows[0]["LOT_TRANSFERT"] is not None:
        st.transfer_lot = int(rows[0]["LOT_TRANSFERT"])
        # NAV du premier lot de transfert (MIN(D_NAV) du MIN lot peut differer : on relit proprement)
        r2 = gw.rows("depool_transfer_nav", "SELECT l.D_NAV FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l "
                     f"WHERE l.C_FUND = {q(pool)} AND l.N_LOT = {st.transfer_lot}")
        st.transfer_nav = _to_date(r2[0]["D_NAV"]) if r2 else None
    return st


def build_segments(gw, p: Params, source: str = "mfga") -> tuple[list[Segment], Structure | None]:
    """Decoupe la demande en segments (un par rapport a produire)."""
    if p.depooling == "none":
        return [Segment("direct", compute_windows(gw, p.funds, p))], None
    pool = p.funds[0]
    st = resolve_structure(gw, pool, source)
    segs: list[Segment] = []
    if p.depooling in ("before", "both"):
        wins = []
        for f in st.feeders:
            wins += compute_windows(gw, [f.number], p, segment="avant")
        segs.append(Segment("avant", wins,
                            f"anciens feeders {', '.join(f.number for f in st.feeders)}, jusqu'au depooling du {st.depooling_date}"))
    if p.depooling in ("after", "both"):
        wins = compute_windows(gw, [pool], p, segment="apres")
        out = []
        floor = max(f.last_lot for f in st.feeders if f.last_lot)
        for w in wins:
            lo = max(w.lot_from_excl or -1, floor)
            out.append(replace(w, lot_from_excl=lo, note=(w.note or "") + f"a partir du lot de transfert {st.transfer_lot}"))
        segs.append(Segment("apres", out, f"pool {pool} seul, apres le lot {floor} (dernier lot des feeders)"))
    return segs, st



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\gateway.py =====
"""Acces Dremio en lecture seule pour les rapports LuxRep.

S'appuie sur le client verrouille `dremio_sql.py` (SELECT / WITH uniquement, hotes connus, jamais modifie).
Aucun jeton n'est lu ici : la session est celle creee par `python dremio_sql.py login --env <env>`.

Particularites du client verrouille prises en compte :
  * il refuse certains mots meme en tant que nom de colonne (COMMENT, SET, USE, LOAD, EXPORT, ...) :
    il faut les mettre entre guillemets doubles ("COMMENT") ;
  * `query -o` n'ecrit que sous `User Guides/dremio` : ici on appelle `Client.query` directement
    et les fichiers sont ecrits par `core/outputs.py` dans le dossier de sortie choisi.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

CORE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SUITE_DIR = CORE_DIR.parent            # luxrep_reports/
ROOT_DIR = SUITE_DIR.parent            # dossier qui contient dremio_sql.py


class GatewayError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class AuthExpired(GatewayError):
    pass


def _find_client_module() -> Path:
    env = os.environ.get("LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT")
    candidates = [Path(env)] if env else []
    candidates += [ROOT_DIR / "dremio_sql.py", SUITE_DIR / "dremio_sql.py"]
    for c in candidates:
        if c.is_file():
            return c
    raise GatewayError("dremio_sql.py introuvable (attendu a " + str(ROOT_DIR) +
                       " ; ou variable d'environnement LUXREP_DREMIO_CLIENT)")


def _load_client_module():
    path = _find_client_module()
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("dremio_sql", path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules["dremio_sql"] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod


class Gateway:
    """Execute des requetes SELECT/WITH et garde un journal (nom, job, lignes, secondes)."""

    def __init__(self, env: str = "ctlq", out_dir: Path | None = None,
                 timeout: int = 900, max_rows: int = 500000):
        self._mod = _load_client_module()
        if env not in self._mod.ENVIRONMENTS:
            raise GatewayError(f"serveur inconnu {env!r} (connus : {', '.join(self._mod.ENVIRONMENTS)})")
        self.env = env
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.max_rows = max_rows
        self.out_dir = Path(out_dir) if out_dir else None
        self.log: list[dict] = []
        self._client = self._mod.Client(env=env)

    def query(self, name: str, sql: str, max_rows: int | None = None, timeout: int | None = None):
        """Retourne (colonnes, lignes[dict]). Refuse toute troncature silencieuse."""
        sql = sql.strip().lstrip("\ufeff")
        if self.out_dir is not None:
            (self.out_dir / "sql").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (self.out_dir / "sql" / f"{name}.sql").write_text(sql + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        limit = max_rows or self.max_rows
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            job, cols, rows, total = self._client.query(sql, limit, timeout or self.timeout)
        except self._mod.DremioError as exc:
            msg = str(exc)
            if "HTTP 401" in msg:
                raise AuthExpired(
                    f"Session Dremio {self.env.upper()} expiree : relancer "
                    f"`python dremio_sql.py login --env {self.env}` dans un terminal.") from None
            raise GatewayError(f"[{name}] {msg}") from None
        if total > len(rows):
            raise GatewayError(f"[{name}] resultat tronque : {total} lignes, limite {limit} (augmenter --max-rows)")
        self.log.append({"name": name, "job": job, "rows": len(rows), "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1)})
        return cols, [dict(r) for r in rows]

    def rows(self, name: str, sql: str, **kw) -> list[dict]:
        return self.query(name, sql, **kw)[1]

    def probe(self) -> tuple[bool, str]:
        try:
            data = self._client.call("GET", "/api/v3/catalog")
        except self._mod.DremioError as exc:
            return False, str(exc)
        except Exception as exc:  # reseau, jeton absent
            return False, str(exc)
        return True, f"session valide ({len(data.get('data', []))} entrees de catalogue)"



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\outputs.py =====
"""Ecriture des sorties : XLSX et CSV au gabarit LUXIS, JSON de synthese, page statique HTML autonome."""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import html
import json
from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

from .report import (ReportSpec, FMT_TEXT, FMT_INT, FMT_QTY, FMT_AMT, FMT_RATE, FMT_DATE, FMT_DATETIME, FMT_STATUS)

_NUM = {FMT_INT: "#,##0", FMT_QTY: "#,##0.000000", FMT_AMT: "#,##0.00", FMT_RATE: "#,##0.000000", FMT_STATUS: "##0"}


def _dt(v):
    if v is None or v == "":
        return None
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, date):
        return datetime(v.year, v.month, v.day)
    s = str(v).strip().replace("T", " ")
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(s[:19])
    except ValueError:
        pass
    for fmt in ("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S", "%d/%m/%Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(s, fmt)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None


def _num(v):
    if v is None or v == "":
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return v
    try:
        f = float(str(v).replace(",", "."))
    except ValueError:
        return v
    return int(f) if f == int(f) and abs(f) < 1e15 and "." not in str(v) else f


def coerce(spec: ReportSpec, col: str, v):
    kind = spec.formats.get(col, FMT_TEXT)
    if kind in (FMT_DATE, FMT_DATETIME):
        d = _dt(v)
        return d.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) if (d and kind == FMT_DATE) else d
    if kind in _NUM:
        return _num(v)
    return "" if v is None else v


def table(spec: ReportSpec, rows: list[dict]) -> list[list]:
    """Lignes de la requete -> matrice dans l'ordre exact des colonnes LUXIS. Colonne manquante = erreur explicite."""
    if rows:
        missing = [c for c in spec.columns if c not in rows[0]]
        if missing:
            raise KeyError(f"colonnes absentes de la requete : {missing}")
    return [[coerce(spec, c, r.get(c)) for c in spec.columns] for r in rows]


def _csv_val(v):
    if v is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v.strftime("%d/%m/%Y") if (v.hour, v.minute, v.second) == (0, 0, 0) else v.strftime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S")
    if isinstance(v, float):
        return repr(v) if abs(v) < 1e15 else f"{v:.2f}"
    return v


def write_csv(path: Path, columns: list[str], matrix: list[list]) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f, delimiter=";")
        w.writerow(columns)
        for r in matrix:
            w.writerow([_csv_val(v) for v in r])
    return path


def write_xlsx(path: Path, spec: ReportSpec, sheets: list[tuple[str, list[list]]]) -> Path:
    """Un classeur ; chaque (nom de feuille, matrice). Premiere ligne = en-tetes LUXIS, formats de cellule du rapport."""
    import xlsxwriter
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    wb = xlsxwriter.Workbook(str(path), {"default_date_format": "dd/mm/yyyy", "nan_inf_to_errors": True})
    fmts = {k: wb.add_format({"num_format": v}) for k, v in _NUM.items()}
    fmts[FMT_DATE] = wb.add_format({"num_format": "dd/mm/yyyy"})
    fmts[FMT_DATETIME] = wb.add_format({"num_format": "dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss"})
    head = wb.add_format({"text_wrap": True})
    for name, matrix in sheets:
        ws = wb.add_worksheet(name[:31])
        for j, c in enumerate(spec.columns):
            ws.write(0, j, c, head)
            ws.set_column(j, j, max(11, min(45, len(c) + 2)))
        for i, row in enumerate(matrix, start=1):
            for j, v in enumerate(row):
                kind = spec.formats.get(spec.columns[j], FMT_TEXT)
                if v is None or v == "":
                    ws.write_blank(i, j, None) if kind != FMT_TEXT else ws.write_string(i, j, "")
                elif isinstance(v, datetime):
                    ws.write_datetime(i, j, v, fmts.get(kind, fmts[FMT_DATE]))
                elif isinstance(v, (int, float)) and kind in fmts:
                    ws.write_number(i, j, v, fmts[kind])
                elif isinstance(v, (int, float)):
                    ws.write_number(i, j, v)
                else:
                    ws.write_string(i, j, str(v))
    wb.close()
    return path


def write_json(path: Path, obj) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


_CSS = (
    "body{font:14px/1.45 Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;margin:24px;color:#1b1b1b}h1{font-size:22px}h2{font-size:17px;margin-top:28px}"
    "table{border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}th,td{border:1px solid #ccd;padding:3px 7px;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}"
    "th{background:#eef1f8}.ok{color:#0a7a2f;font-weight:600}.warn{color:#b26a00;font-weight:600}.bad{color:#b00020;font-weight:600}"
    ".scroll{overflow:auto;max-height:520px;border:1px solid #ccd}code{background:#f3f3f6;padding:1px 4px}"
)


def _tbl(headers, rows, cls=""):
    h = "".join(f"<th>{html.escape(str(x))}</th>" for x in headers)
    b = "".join("<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{html.escape('' if v is None else str(_csv_val(v)))}</td>" for v in r) + "</tr>" for r in rows)
    return f"<div class='scroll {cls}'><table><thead><tr>{h}</tr></thead><tbody>{b}</tbody></table></div>"


def write_static_page(path: Path, summary: dict, spec: ReportSpec, previews: dict[str, list[list]], preview_rows: int = 300) -> Path:
    """Page HTML autonome (aucun serveur, aucun script) : parametres, depooling, fenetres, controles, rapprochement, apercu."""
    p = summary["params"]
    parts = [f"<!doctype html><html lang='fr'><meta charset='utf-8'><title>{html.escape(spec.title)}</title><style>{_CSS}</style><body>",
             f"<h1>{html.escape(spec.title)}</h1>",
             f"<p>Genere le {html.escape(summary['generated_at'])} - serveur Dremio <b>{html.escape(p['env'].upper())}</b> - "
             f"verdict : <span class='{summary['verdict_class']}'>{html.escape(summary['verdict'])}</span></p>"]
    parts.append("<h2>Parametres</h2>" + _tbl(["Parametre", "Valeur"], [[k, v] for k, v in summary["params_display"].items()]))
    if summary.get("depooling"):
        d = summary["depooling"]
        parts.append("<h2>Depooling</h2>" + _tbl(["Pool", "Date de depooling", "Lot de transfert", "NAV de transfert", "Feeders", "Source"],
                     [[d["pool"], d["depooling_date"], d["transfer_lot"], d["transfer_nav"],
                       ", ".join(f["number"] for f in d["feeders"]), d["source"]]]))
    parts.append("<h2>Fenetres de lots lues</h2>" + _tbl(
        ["Segment", "Fonds", "Lot depart (exclu)", "Dernier lot", "Date depart", "Date fin", "Lignes", "Note"],
        [[w["segment"], w["fund"], w["lot_from_excl"], w["lot_to_incl"], w["key_from"], w["key_to"], w.get("rows", ""), w["note"]]
         for w in summary["windows"]]))
    parts.append("<h2>Controles</h2>" + _tbl(["Niveau", "Controle"], [[lv, msg] for lv, msg in summary["checks"]]))
    if summary.get("comparison"):
        c = summary["comparison"]
        parts.append("<h2>Rapprochement avec la sortie LUXIS</h2>" + _tbl(
            ["Lignes LUXIS", "Lignes produites", "Identiques", "Ecarts de valeur", "Seulement LUXIS", "Seulement ici"],
            [[c["ref_rows"], c["out_rows"], c["identical"], c["different"], c["only_ref"], c["only_out"]]]))
        if c.get("differences"):
            parts.append(_tbl(["Cle", "Colonne", "LUXIS", "Produit"], c["differences"][:200]))
    parts.append("<h2>Fichiers</h2><ul>" + "".join(f"<li><code>{html.escape(f)}</code></li>" for f in summary["files"]) + "</ul>")
    for name, matrix in previews.items():
        parts.append(f"<h2>Apercu : {html.escape(name)} ({len(matrix)} lignes, {min(len(matrix), preview_rows)} affichees)</h2>"
                     + _tbl(spec.columns, matrix[:preview_rows]))
    parts.append("</body></html>")
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text("".join(parts), encoding="utf-8")
    return path



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\params.py =====
"""Parametres communs des rapports LuxRep et leur validation.

Les memes champs que ceux du cahier des charges (LuxRep Queries BCR / TA) :
  fonds, selecteur de date (NAV ou calcul), plage Date From / Date To, type de periode, formats,
plus ceux du Grand livre : serveur Dremio, depooling (avant / apres / les deux), comparaison a une sortie LUXIS.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, asdict
from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path

DATE_TYPES = {
    "nav": "Date NAV (date de prise de prix, AMS_LOT.D_NAV)",
    "calc": "Date de calcul (date de traitement du lot, AMS_LOT.D_H_PROCESS)",
}
PERIOD_TYPES = {
    "range": "Plage : Date From / Date To",
    "last_available": "Dernier jour disponible (les deux dernieres NAV a ce jour, aucune date lue)",
    "to_last_nav": "De Date From jusqu'a la derniere NAV publiee (Date To non lue)",
}
DEPOOLING_MODES = {
    "none": "Aucun depooling : les fonds demandes tels quels",
    "after": "Apres depooling : le pool seul, a partir du lot de transfert",
    "before": "Avant depooling : un rapport par ancien feeder, jusqu'a sa derniere NAV",
    "both": "Avant + apres : les deux, avec fichier reunissant les deux",
}
FORMATS = ("xlsx", "csv")
FUND_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9A-Z]{1,10}$")
ENVS = ("ctlq", "intg")


class ParamError(ValueError):
    pass


def parse_date(value, name="date") -> date:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.date()
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value
    s = str(value).strip()
    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%Y%m%d", "%d/%m/%Y", "%d.%m.%Y", "%d-%m-%Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(s, fmt).date()
        except ValueError:
            pass
    raise ParamError(f"{name} : date illisible {s!r} (attendu AAAA-MM-JJ)")


def parse_list(value) -> list[str]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        items = value
    else:
        items = re.split(r"[,\s;]+", str(value))
    return [str(i).strip() for i in items if str(i).strip()]


@dataclass
class Params:
    env: str = "ctlq"
    funds: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    date_type: str = "nav"
    period_type: str = "range"
    date_from: date | None = None
    date_to: date | None = None
    depooling: str = "none"
    formats: tuple = ("xlsx", "csv")
    out_dir: Path = Path("out")
    compare_ref: Path | None = None
    inclusive_from: bool = False         # False = la NAV de depart est exclue (regle LUXIS)
    name_source: str = "mfga"            # nom/devise des fonds : mfga (AMS_PORTFOLIO) ou luxis (LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS)
    statuses: tuple = ()                 # () = defaut du rapport
    extra: dict = field(default_factory=dict)   # parametres propres a un rapport (registres, isin, ...)
    max_rows: int = 500000
    timeout: int = 1800

    def validate(self, needs_dates: bool = True, needs_funds: bool = True) -> "Params":
        if self.env not in ENVS:
            raise ParamError(f"serveur {self.env!r} inconnu ({', '.join(ENVS)})")
        self.funds = [f.upper() for f in parse_list(self.funds)]
        if needs_funds and not self.funds:
            raise ParamError("au moins un fonds est requis")
        for f in self.funds:
            if not FUND_RE.match(f):
                raise ParamError(f"numero de fonds invalide {f!r} (1 a 10 caracteres 0-9 A-Z)")
        if len(self.funds) != len(set(self.funds)):
            raise ParamError("fonds en double")
        if self.date_type not in DATE_TYPES:
            raise ParamError(f"selecteur de date {self.date_type!r} inconnu ({', '.join(DATE_TYPES)})")
        if self.period_type not in PERIOD_TYPES:
            raise ParamError(f"type de periode {self.period_type!r} inconnu ({', '.join(PERIOD_TYPES)})")
        if self.name_source not in ("mfga", "luxis"):
            raise ParamError(f"source des noms de fonds {self.name_source!r} inconnue (mfga, luxis)")
        if self.depooling not in DEPOOLING_MODES:
            raise ParamError(f"mode depooling {self.depooling!r} inconnu ({', '.join(DEPOOLING_MODES)})")
        self.formats = tuple(f.lower() for f in parse_list(self.formats)) or ("xlsx", "csv")
        for f in self.formats:
            if f not in FORMATS:
                raise ParamError(f"format {f!r} inconnu ({', '.join(FORMATS)})")
        if needs_dates:
            if self.period_type == "range":
                if self.date_from is None or self.date_to is None:
                    raise ParamError("Date From et Date To sont requises en mode plage")
            elif self.period_type == "to_last_nav" and self.date_from is None:
                raise ParamError("Date From est requise pour 'jusqu'a la derniere NAV publiee'")
            if self.date_from is not None:
                self.date_from = parse_date(self.date_from, "Date From")
            if self.date_to is not None:
                self.date_to = parse_date(self.date_to, "Date To")
            if self.date_from and self.date_to and self.date_from > self.date_to:
                raise ParamError("Date From posterieure a Date To")
        if self.depooling != "none" and len(self.funds) != 1 and needs_funds:
            raise ParamError("le depooling se demande sous le numero du pool : un seul fonds")
        self.out_dir = Path(self.out_dir)
        if self.compare_ref is not None:
            self.compare_ref = Path(self.compare_ref)
            if not self.compare_ref.is_file():
                raise ParamError(f"fichier de reference introuvable : {self.compare_ref}")
        return self

    def as_dict(self) -> dict:
        d = asdict(self)
        for k, v in d.items():
            if isinstance(v, (date, datetime)):
                d[k] = v.isoformat()
            elif isinstance(v, Path):
                d[k] = str(v)
            elif isinstance(v, tuple):
                d[k] = list(v)
        return d



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\registry.py =====
"""Registre des rapports : un sous-dossier par rapport, chargÃ© a la demande."""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib

from .report import ReportSpec

# cle CLI -> (module, alias lisible)
REPORTS = {
    "coupons_dividendes": ("luxrep_reports.coupons_dividendes.report", "BCR - Coupons / Dividendes"),
    "mouvements": ("luxrep_reports.mouvements.report", "BCR - Mouvements"),
    "tx_change_nav": ("luxrep_reports.tx_change_nav.report", "BCR - Taux de change NAV (Tx change NAV)"),
    "ta_registres": ("luxrep_reports.ta.registres", "TA - Registres"),
    "ta_sub_red": ("luxrep_reports.ta.sub_red", "TA - Sub / Red TA"),
    "ta_positions_registre": ("luxrep_reports.ta.positions_registre", "TA - Positions par registre"),
    "ta_positions_isin": ("luxrep_reports.ta.positions_isin", "TA - Positions par ISIN"),
    "ta_comptes_bloques": ("luxrep_reports.ta.comptes_bloques", "TA - Comptes bloques"),
}


def load(key: str) -> ReportSpec:
    if key not in REPORTS:
        raise KeyError(f"rapport inconnu {key!r} (connus : {', '.join(REPORTS)})")
    module = importlib.import_module(REPORTS[key][0])
    return module.SPEC


def available() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Rapports dont le module existe (les autres sont signales 'non installe')."""
    out = {}
    for k, (mod, label) in REPORTS.items():
        try:
            importlib.import_module(mod)
            out[k] = label
        except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
            if exc.name and mod.startswith(exc.name) or exc.name == mod:
                continue
            raise
    return out



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\report.py =====
"""Contrat d'un rapport LuxRep : ce qu'un sous-dossier doit fournir, et le contexte qu'il recoit.

Un rapport = un module `luxrep_reports/<dossier>/report.py` qui expose `SPEC` (un `ReportSpec`) ; une fonction
`build(ctx) -> str` rend la requete SQL principale (SELECT/WITH Dremio, lecture seule) dont les colonnes portent
EXACTEMENT les en-tetes LUXIS (alias entre guillemets doubles) ; le moteur (`runner.py`) fait le reste :
fenetres de lots, depooling, execution, controles, fichiers (XLSX, CSV, JSON, page statique), comparaison.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Callable

from .params import Params
from .sqlutil import lot_condition, in_list, q
from .window import FundWindow

# Familles de formats de cellule XLSX (reproduisent les formats du fichier LUXIS fourni)
FMT_TEXT, FMT_INT, FMT_QTY, FMT_AMT, FMT_RATE, FMT_DATE, FMT_DATETIME, FMT_STATUS = (
    "text", "int", "qty", "amt", "rate", "date", "datetime", "status")


@dataclass
class ExtraParam:
    """Parametre propre a un rapport, expose par la CLI (--<name>) et demande dans le menu interactif."""
    name: str
    help: str
    kind: str = "str"               # str | list | int | bool
    default: object = None
    choices: tuple = ()


@dataclass
class ReportSpec:
    key: str                        # identifiant CLI : coupons_dividendes, mouvements, ...
    title: str                      # titre lisible
    file_tag: str                   # fragment du nom de fichier : Bcr_Coupons_Dividends
    columns: list[str]              # en-tetes LUXIS, dans l'ordre
    build: Callable                 # build(ctx) -> sql
    formats: dict = field(default_factory=dict)     # colonne -> FMT_*
    sheet: str = "A"
    windowed: bool = True           # True : rapport par fenetre de lots (dates, depooling) ; False : photo (TA)
    needs_dates: bool | None = None  # None = comme `windowed` ; True pour un rapport non fenetre qui lit Date From / Date To (Sub/Red TA)
    key_columns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)   # cle de rapprochement avec une sortie LUXIS
    volatile_columns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)   # colonnes horodatees a la generation (ignorees au rapprochement)
    extra_params: list[ExtraParam] = field(default_factory=list)
    post: Callable | None = None    # post(rows, ctx) -> rows (corrections Python apres la requete)
    checks: Callable | None = None  # checks(rows, ctx) -> [(niveau, message)]
    description: str = ""
    luxis_source: str = ""          # procedure LUXIS reproduite (documentation)

    @property
    def dates_required(self) -> bool:
        return self.windowed if self.needs_dates is None else self.needs_dates


@dataclass
class Context:
    params: Params
    windows: list[FundWindow]
    segment: str
    gw: object
    spec: ReportSpec

    @property
    def funds(self) -> list[str]:
        return [w.fund for w in self.windows] if self.windows else list(self.params.funds)

    def lots(self, alias: str, fund_col: str = "C_FUND", lot_col: str = "N_LOT") -> str:
        """Condition SQL de fenetre de lots : `(d.C_FUND = 'x' AND d.N_LOT > a AND d.N_LOT <= b) OR ...`."""
        return lot_condition(self.windows, alias, fund_col, lot_col)

    def funds_in(self) -> str:
        return in_list(self.funds)

    def extra(self, name: str, default=None):
        return self.params.extra.get(name, default)

    def fund_ref_cte(self, name: str = "fund_ref") -> str:
        """CTE (C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY) : nom et devise de chaque fonds au dernier lot d'AMS_PORTFOLIO (substitut MFGA de
        REPADMIN.GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS / GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS)."""
        if self.params.name_source == "luxis":
            return (f"{name} AS (\n  SELECT t.FA_NUM AS C_FUND, t.FUND_NAME AS L_FUND, t.FUND_CCY AS C_CCY\n"
                    "  FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS t\n"
                    f"  WHERE t.FA_NUM IN ({self.funds_in()})\n)")
        return (
            f"{name}_rk AS (\n"
            "  SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY,\n"
            "         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn\n"
            "  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p\n"
            f"  WHERE p.C_FUND IN ({self.funds_in()})\n"
            "),\n"
            f"{name} AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM {name}_rk WHERE rn = 1)"
        )



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\runner.py =====
"""Moteur d'execution commun : parametres -> fenetres -> depooling -> requete -> controles -> fichiers -> page statique."""
from __future__ import annotations

import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from . import outputs, compare as cmp
from .depooling import build_segments
from .gateway import Gateway
from .params import Params, ParamError, DATE_TYPES, PERIOD_TYPES, DEPOOLING_MODES
from .report import Context, ReportSpec
from .window import FundWindow, compute_windows


class RunResult(dict):
    pass


def _stamp(now: datetime) -> str:
    return f"{now:%Y_%m_%d}_{now:%H_%M_%S}_{now.microsecond // 10000:02d}"


def _display(p: Params, spec: ReportSpec, source: str) -> dict:
    d = {"Rapport": spec.title, "Serveur Dremio": p.env, "Fonds": ", ".join(p.funds) or "(selon le rapport)",
         "Selecteur de date": DATE_TYPES[p.date_type], "Periode": PERIOD_TYPES[p.period_type],
         "Date From": p.date_from or "", "Date To": p.date_to or "", "Depooling": DEPOOLING_MODES[p.depooling],
         "Source du depooling": source if p.depooling != "none" else "", "Formats": ", ".join(p.formats),
         "NAV de depart": "incluse" if p.inclusive_from else "exclue (regle LUXIS)",
         "Nom des fonds": "MFGA (AMS_PORTFOLIO)" if p.name_source == "mfga" else "LUXIS (LUXREP_TB_FONDS)"}
    for k, v in p.extra.items():
        d[k] = ", ".join(v) if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) else v
    return d


def run(spec: ReportSpec, p: Params, depool_source: str = "mfga", log=print, gw: Gateway | None = None) -> RunResult:
    p.validate(needs_dates=spec.dates_required and p.period_type != "last_available", needs_funds=bool(spec.windowed or p.funds))
    if not spec.windowed and p.depooling != "none":
        raise ParamError("le depooling ne s'applique pas a ce rapport (photo a une date, pas de fenetre de lots)")
    now = datetime.now()
    stamp = _stamp(now)
    run_dir = p.out_dir / f"{spec.key}_{now:%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}"
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    gw = gw or Gateway(env=p.env, out_dir=run_dir, timeout=p.timeout, max_rows=p.max_rows)
    gw.out_dir = run_dir
    ok, msg = gw.probe()
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(f"session Dremio {p.env.upper()} inutilisable : {msg}")
    log(f"[{spec.key}] {msg}")

    t0 = time.time()
    structure = None
    if spec.windowed:
        segments, structure = build_segments(gw, p, depool_source)
    else:
        from .depooling import Segment
        segments = [Segment("direct", [FundWindow(f, None, None) for f in p.funds])]

    checks: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    windows_out: list[dict] = []
    seg_rows: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    seg_matrix: dict[str, list[list]] = {}
    for seg in segments:
        label = seg.label
        usable = [w for w in seg.windows if (not spec.windowed) or not w.empty]
        for w in seg.windows:
            if spec.windowed and w.empty:
                checks.append(("INFO", f"{w.fund} ({label}) : fenetre vide - {w.note or 'aucun lot'}"))
        if not usable and (spec.windowed or p.funds):
            seg_rows[label], seg_matrix[label] = [], []
            for w in seg.windows:
                d = w.as_dict(); d["rows"] = 0; windows_out.append(d)
            continue
        ctx = Context(p, usable if spec.windowed else seg.windows, label, gw, spec)
        sql = spec.build(ctx)
        log(f"[{spec.key}] segment {label} : {len(ctx.windows)} fonds, requete principale ...")
        cols, rows = gw.query(f"main_{label}", sql)
        if spec.post:
            rows = spec.post(rows, ctx)
        seg_rows[label] = rows
        seg_matrix[label] = outputs.table(spec, rows)
        per_fund: dict[str, int] = {}
        fund_col = next((c for c in ("SubFund Number", "Fa Number", "Fund Number") if c in spec.columns), None)
        for r in rows:
            f = str(r.get(fund_col, "")).strip() if fund_col else ""
            per_fund[f] = per_fund.get(f, 0) + 1
        for w in seg.windows:
            d = w.as_dict(); d["rows"] = per_fund.get(w.fund, 0) if fund_col else len(rows); windows_out.append(d)
        if spec.checks:
            checks += spec.checks(rows, ctx)
        if not rows:
            checks.append(("WARN", f"segment {label} : aucune ligne"))
        log(f"[{spec.key}] segment {label} : {len(rows)} lignes")

    total = sum(len(m) for m in seg_matrix.values())
    checks.insert(0, ("OK" if total else "WARN", f"{total} lignes produites"))

    # ---- fichiers ----
    fund_label = p.funds[0] if len(p.funds) == 1 else (f"{len(p.funds)}fonds" if p.funds else "TOUS")
    files: list[str] = []
    suffix = {"direct": "", "avant": "_avant_depooling", "apres": "_apres_depooling"}
    for label, matrix in seg_matrix.items():
        base = f"{fund_label}-{spec.file_tag}-{stamp}{suffix.get(label, '_' + label)}"
        if "xlsx" in p.formats:
            files.append(str(outputs.write_xlsx(run_dir / f"{base}.xlsx", spec, [(spec.sheet, matrix)]).name))
        if "csv" in p.formats:
            files.append(str(outputs.write_csv(run_dir / f"{base}.csv", spec.columns, matrix).name))
    if p.depooling == "both" and "apres" in seg_matrix:
        base = f"{fund_label}-{spec.file_tag}-{stamp}_avant_apres_depooling"
        if "xlsx" in p.formats:
            files.append(outputs.write_xlsx(run_dir / f"{base}.xlsx", spec,
                         [(spec.sheet, seg_matrix["apres"]), ("Avant depooling", seg_matrix.get("avant", []))]).name)
        if "csv" in p.formats:
            both = [[""] + r for r in seg_matrix.get("avant", [])] + [[""] + r for r in seg_matrix["apres"]]
            avant_n = len(seg_matrix.get("avant", []))
            for i, r in enumerate(both):
                r[0] = "AVANT" if i < avant_n else "APRES"
            files.append(outputs.write_csv(run_dir / f"{base}.csv", ["Segment"] + spec.columns, both).name)

    # ---- rapprochement avec la sortie LUXIS ----
    comparison = None
    all_rows = [r for rows in seg_rows.values() for r in rows]
    if p.compare_ref:
        comparison = cmp.compare(spec, all_rows, p.compare_ref)
        outputs.write_json(run_dir / "comparaison.json", comparison)
        files.append("comparaison.json")
        lvl = "OK" if comparison["equal"] else "ECART"
        checks.append((lvl, f"rapprochement LUXIS : {comparison['identical']} lignes identiques, {comparison['different']} avec ecart, "
                            f"{comparison['only_ref']} seulement LUXIS, {comparison['only_out']} seulement ici"))

    bad = any(lv in ("ECART", "ERREUR") for lv, _ in checks)
    warn = any(lv == "WARN" for lv, _ in checks)
    verdict = "ECART" if bad else ("A VERIFIER" if warn else "CONFORME")
    summary = {
        "report": spec.key, "title": spec.title, "generated_at": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "params": p.as_dict(), "params_display": _display(p, spec, depool_source),
        "depooling": structure.as_dict() if structure else None, "windows": windows_out, "checks": checks,
        "verdict": verdict, "verdict_class": {"CONFORME": "ok", "A VERIFIER": "warn", "ECART": "bad"}[verdict],
        "comparison": comparison, "files": files, "rows": {k: len(v) for k, v in seg_matrix.items()},
        "queries": gw.log, "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1), "luxis_source": spec.luxis_source,
    }
    page = outputs.write_static_page(run_dir / f"{spec.key}_page.html", summary, spec, seg_matrix)
    files.append(page.name)
    summary["files"] = files
    outputs.write_json(run_dir / "synthese.json", summary)
    log(f"[{spec.key}] verdict {verdict} - dossier {run_dir}")
    return RunResult(summary=summary, run_dir=run_dir, rows=seg_rows, matrix=seg_matrix)

"""Aides SQL : litteraux, listes, conditions de lots. Jamais de valeur utilisateur concatenee sans passer par ici."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import date, datetime

_SAFE_IDENT = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$.]*$")


def q(value) -> str:
    """Litteral SQL : texte entre apostrophes (apostrophes doublees), nombres tels quels, NULL, dates en TIMESTAMP."""
    if value is None:
        return "NULL"
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "1" if value else "0"
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return repr(value)
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return f"TIMESTAMP '{value:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}'"
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return f"TIMESTAMP '{value:%Y-%m-%d} 00:00:00'"
    s = str(value)
    if "\x00" in s:
        raise ValueError("caractere nul interdit")
    return "'" + s.replace("'", "''") + "'"


def in_list(values) -> str:
    vals = list(values)
    if not vals:
        return "NULL"
    return ", ".join(q(v) for v in vals)


def ident(name: str) -> str:
    if not _SAFE_IDENT.match(name):
        raise ValueError(f"identifiant SQL invalide : {name!r}")
    return name


def lot_condition(windows, alias: str, fund_col: str = "C_FUND", lot_col: str = "N_LOT") -> str:
    """Condition `(fonds = x AND lot > a AND lot <= b) OR ...` pour une liste de FundWindow non vides.
    Aucune fenetre exploitable -> `1 = 0` (la requete rend 0 ligne)."""
    ident(alias)
    parts = []
    for w in windows:
        if w.empty:
            continue
        c = f"{alias}.{fund_col} = {q(w.fund)}"
        if w.lot_from_excl is not None:
            c += f" AND {alias}.{lot_col} > {int(w.lot_from_excl)}"
        c += f" AND {alias}.{lot_col} <= {int(w.lot_to_incl)}"
        parts.append(f"({c})")
    return "(" + " OR ".join(parts) + ")" if parts else "(1 = 0)"



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\window.py =====
"""Fenetre de lots d'un fonds : de quelles NAV / quels lots un rapport doit-il lire ?

Regle LUXIS reproduite (PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES, proc_Bcr_* : GET_NAV_DATE_NAV / GET_LOT_DATE_NAV, puis
`N_LOT > lot_from AND N_LOT <= lot_to`) :
  * la fenetre est un intervalle de LOTS (AMS_LOT.N_LOT), pas un filtre sur la date comptable : un rapport ne lit que
    les ecritures des lots publies entre la NAV de depart (exclue) et la NAV d'arrivee (incluse) ;
  * la NAV de depart est la derniere NAV <= Date From, la NAV d'arrivee la derniere NAV <= Date To ;
  * type 'last_available' : les deux dernieres NAV a ce jour ; 'to_last_nav' : de Date From a la derniere NAV a ce jour ;
  * le selecteur de date choisit la "date" d'un lot : la date NAV (D_NAV) ou la date de calcul (jour de D_H_PROCESS) ;
  * `inclusive_from` garde la NAV de depart (hors LUXIS, defaut non).
La fenetre est calculee en Python (testable) a partir d'une seule lecture d'AMS_LOT limitee aux fonds demandes.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from datetime import date, datetime

from .params import Params
from .sqlutil import q, in_list


@dataclass
class Lot:
    lot: int
    nav: date
    calc: date | None


@dataclass
class FundWindow:
    fund: str
    lot_from_excl: int | None      # None = depuis le debut
    lot_to_incl: int | None        # None = aucun lot : fenetre vide
    key_from: date | None = None   # date (NAV ou calcul) du lot de depart
    key_to: date | None = None     # date (NAV ou calcul) du dernier lot
    segment: str = ""              # etiquette du segment (depooling)
    note: str = ""

    @property
    def empty(self) -> bool:
        return self.lot_to_incl is None or (
            self.lot_from_excl is not None and self.lot_to_incl <= self.lot_from_excl)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {"fund": self.fund, "lot_from_excl": self.lot_from_excl, "lot_to_incl": self.lot_to_incl,
                "key_from": self.key_from.isoformat() if self.key_from else None,
                "key_to": self.key_to.isoformat() if self.key_to else None,
                "segment": self.segment, "note": self.note, "empty": self.empty}


def _to_date(v) -> date | None:
    if v is None or v == "":
        return None
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v.date()
    if isinstance(v, date):
        return v
    s = str(v)[:10]
    return datetime.strptime(s, "%Y-%m-%d").date()


def load_lots(gw, funds: list[str], name="lots") -> dict[str, list[Lot]]:
    """Tous les lots des fonds (un seul aller-retour Dremio)."""
    sql = (
        "SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, l.D_NAV, l.D_H_PROCESS\n"
        "FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l\n"
        f"WHERE l.C_FUND IN ({in_list(funds)})\n"
        "ORDER BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT"
    )
    out: dict[str, list[Lot]] = {f: [] for f in funds}
    for r in gw.rows(name, sql):
        nav = _to_date(r["D_NAV"])
        if nav is None:
            continue
        out.setdefault(str(r["C_FUND"]).strip(), []).append(
            Lot(int(r["N_LOT"]), nav, _to_date(r["D_H_PROCESS"]) or nav))
    return out


def compute_window(fund: str, lots: list[Lot], p: Params, today: date | None = None) -> FundWindow:
    today = today or date.today()
    key = (lambda l: l.nav) if p.date_type == "nav" else (lambda l: l.calc or l.nav)
    cand = sorted(lots, key=lambda l: l.lot)

    def last_le(d: date):
        sel = [l for l in cand if key(l) <= d]
        return max(sel, key=lambda l: l.lot) if sel else None

    def last_lt(d: date):
        sel = [l for l in cand if key(l) < d]
        return max(sel, key=lambda l: l.lot) if sel else None

    if not cand:
        return FundWindow(fund, None, None, note="aucun lot dans AMS_LOT pour ce fonds")

    if p.period_type == "last_available":
        to = last_le(today)
        if to is None:
            return FundWindow(fund, None, None, note="aucune NAV a ce jour")
        prev = last_lt(key(to))
        return FundWindow(fund, prev.lot if prev else None, to.lot,
                          key_from=key(prev) if prev else None, key_to=key(to))

    if p.period_type == "to_last_nav":
        to = last_le(today)
        d_to = today
    else:
        d_to = p.date_to
        to = last_le(d_to)
    if to is None:
        return FundWindow(fund, None, None, note=f"aucune NAV <= {d_to}")
    frm = last_lt(p.date_from) if p.inclusive_from else last_le(p.date_from)
    w = FundWindow(fund, frm.lot if frm else None, to.lot,
                   key_from=key(frm) if frm else None, key_to=key(to))
    if w.empty:
        w.note = "aucun nouveau lot dans la fenetre (la NAV de depart est exclue)"
    return w


def compute_windows(gw, funds: list[str], p: Params, segment: str = "") -> list[FundWindow]:
    lots = load_lots(gw, funds)
    out = []
    for f in funds:
        w = compute_window(f, lots.get(f, []), p)
        out.append(replace(w, segment=segment))
    return out



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\core\xlsxread.py =====
"""Lecture minimale d'un classeur XLSX (bibliotheque standard seulement) : sert a rapprocher une sortie du reference LUXIS.

Plus robuste qu'openpyxl face aux classeurs LUXIS (styles non standard, `biltinId`) : lit chaines partagees, chaines en ligne,
nombres, booleens ; reconnait les dates par le format de cellule (numFmtId) et les rend en `datetime`.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import zipfile
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = {"m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
      "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
      "rel": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"}
_BUILTIN_DATE = set(range(14, 23)) | set(range(27, 37)) | set(range(45, 48)) | set(range(50, 59))
_DATE_TOKENS = re.compile(r"[dmyhs]", re.I)
EPOCH = datetime(1899, 12, 30)


def _col_index(ref: str) -> int:
    letters = re.match(r"[A-Z]+", ref).group(0)
    n = 0
    for ch in letters:
        n = n * 26 + ord(ch) - 64
    return n - 1


def _date_styles(zf) -> set[int]:
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/styles.xml"))
    except KeyError:
        return set()
    custom = {}
    for nf in root.findall(".//m:numFmts/m:numFmt", NS):
        code = re.sub(r'"[^"]*"|\[[^\]]*\]|\\.', "", nf.get("formatCode", ""))
        custom[int(nf.get("numFmtId"))] = bool(_DATE_TOKENS.search(code))
    out = set()
    for i, xf in enumerate(root.findall(".//m:cellXfs/m:xf", NS)):
        fid = int(xf.get("numFmtId", "0"))
        if fid in _BUILTIN_DATE or custom.get(fid):
            out.add(i)
    return out


def sheet_names(path) -> list[str]:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
        wb = ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
        return [s.get("name") for s in wb.findall(".//m:sheets/m:sheet", NS)]


def read_sheet(path, sheet: str | None = None) -> list[list]:
    """Toutes les lignes d'une feuille (par nom ; la premiere si None) sous forme de listes de valeurs Python."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
        wb = ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
        sheets = wb.findall(".//m:sheets/m:sheet", NS)
        chosen = next((s for s in sheets if sheet is None or s.get("name") == sheet), None)
        if chosen is None:
            raise KeyError(f"feuille {sheet!r} absente de {path}")
        rid = chosen.get("{%s}id" % NS["r"])
        rels = ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
        target = next(r.get("Target") for r in rels if r.get("Id") == rid)
        target = target.lstrip("/")
        member = target if target.startswith("xl/") else "xl/" + target
        shared = []
        if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in zf.namelist():
            for si in ET.fromstring(zf.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml")).findall("m:si", NS):
                shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{%s}t" % NS["m"])))
        dates = _date_styles(zf)
        rows = []
        for row in ET.fromstring(zf.read(member)).findall(".//m:sheetData/m:row", NS):
            vals: list = []
            for c in row.findall("m:c", NS):
                idx = _col_index(c.get("r"))
                while len(vals) < idx:
                    vals.append(None)
                t, s = c.get("t"), int(c.get("s", "0"))
                v = c.find("m:v", NS)
                if t == "inlineStr":
                    val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in c.iter("{%s}t" % NS["m"]))
                elif v is None:
                    val = None
                elif t == "s":
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif t in ("str", "e"):
                    val = v.text
                elif t == "b":
                    val = v.text == "1"
                else:
                    num = float(v.text)
                    if s in dates:
                        val = EPOCH + timedelta(days=num)
                    else:
                        val = int(num) if num == int(num) and abs(num) < 1e15 else num
                vals.append(val)
            rows.append(vals)
        return rows
