"""Rapport BCR - Coupons / Dividendes (LuxRep Queries BCR, chapitre 3).

Reproduit `REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Div` (code_source.txt l.1883-2222) depuis MFGA / Infocentre.

Ecarts corriges par rapport a la version precedente (cause probable des operations manquantes) :
  1. VERRUE : l'ecriture d'origine est relue dans AMS_CASH_MVT (comme LUXIS : DWH_AMS_CASH_MVT) et non plus dans
     AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND. Les deux tables ne contiennent pas les memes lignes / dates comptables.
     (CASH_SOURCE = "deal" permet de revenir a l'ancien substitut, plus rapide.)
  2. VERRUE : l'extourne est orpheline si son numero d'entree n'a AUCUN statut 20 (tous fonds confondus,
     `DIV_ENTRY NOT IN (...)` sans condition de fonds), et non par couple (fonds, entree).
  3. VERRUE : test de date `D_ACC BETWEEN Date_From AND Date_To` fait sur des dates/heures (Oracle compare des DATE
     a minuit), pas sur une chaine tronquee a 10 caracteres.
  4. JOINTURE : LUXIS fait `T.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID` en jointure INTERNE sur DWH_AMS_SEC_MASTER avec le C_N_ID de
     l'ecriture elle-meme : une ecriture dont le C_N_ID n'a pas de ligne titre disparait du rapport LUXIS, et le pays
     vient de ce titre (pas du sous-jacent d'un future / option). STRICT_SEC_MASTER = True reproduit cela.
  5. SEC_MASTER_ALL_LOTS : si DWH_AMS_SEC_MASTER contient plusieurs lignes par C_N_ID, LUXIS duplique les ecritures.
     Mettre True pour reproduire ce comportement (a tester avec le diagnostic du rapport).

Regles LUXIS inchangees :
  * fenetre de lots `N_LOT > lot_from AND N_LOT <= lot_to` (core/window.py) ;
  * statut 30 = extourne : quantite et montants inverses (DECODE(C_STATUS, 20, x, -x)) ;
  * montants de taxes = taxe + taxe_2 ;
  * ligne d'origine ajoutee : montants = oppose de l'extourne, quantite recopiee telle quelle, statut 20 ;
  * tri final : date comptable, entree, entree-portefeuille.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, time

from ..core.report import (ReportSpec, ExtraParam, Context, FMT_TEXT, FMT_INT, FMT_QTY, FMT_AMT, FMT_RATE, FMT_DATE, FMT_STATUS)
from ..core.sqlutil import q, in_list

CASH_SOURCE = "cash_mvt"        # "cash_mvt" = fidele a LUXIS (lent) ; "deal" = ancien substitut
STRICT_SEC_MASTER = True        # jointure interne sur le titre de l'ecriture, comme LUXIS
SEC_MASTER_ALL_LOTS = False     # True = une ligne par lot du titre (doublons eventuels de LUXIS)

COLUMNS = [
    "SubFund Number", "SubFund Name", "SubFund Ccy", "Service Code", "Isin Code", "Internal Fa Code", "Security Name",
    "Security Ccy", "Country Code", "Country Name", "Accounting Date", "Trade Date", "Value Date", "Execution Date",
    "Payment Date", "Operation Code", "Account Number", "Entry", "Entry Ptf", "Contract", "Description", "Quantity",
    "Price in Security Ccy", "Price in Settlement Ccy", "Settlement Ccy", "Gross Amount", "Unrecoverable Tax",
    "Recoverable Tax", "Other Tax", "Fees in Security Ccy", "Net Amount in Security Ccy", "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    "Interest Rate", "Settl./SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate", "Sec/SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate", "Sec/Tax Ccy Exchange Rate",
    "Operation Status",
]

FORMATS = {
    "Internal Fa Code": FMT_INT, "Accounting Date": FMT_DATE, "Trade Date": FMT_DATE, "Value Date": FMT_DATE,
    "Execution Date": FMT_DATE, "Payment Date": FMT_DATE, "Account Number": FMT_INT, "Entry": FMT_INT, "Entry Ptf": FMT_INT,
    "Contract": FMT_INT, "Quantity": FMT_QTY, "Price in Security Ccy": FMT_RATE, "Price in Settlement Ccy": FMT_RATE,
    "Gross Amount": FMT_AMT, "Unrecoverable Tax": FMT_AMT, "Recoverable Tax": FMT_AMT, "Other Tax": FMT_AMT,
    "Fees in Security Ccy": FMT_AMT, "Net Amount in Security Ccy": FMT_AMT, "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy": FMT_AMT,
    "Interest Rate": FMT_RATE, "Settl./SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate": FMT_RATE, "Sec/SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate": FMT_RATE,
    "Sec/Tax Ccy Exchange Rate": FMT_RATE, "Operation Status": FMT_STATUS,
}

_LOG: dict = {}


def build(ctx: Context) -> str:
    statuses = ctx.extra("statuses") or []
    status_filter = f"\n      AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) IN ({in_list(statuses)})" if statuses else ""
    sm_where = "1 = 1" if SEC_MASTER_ALL_LOTS else "rn = 1"
    own_join = "INNER JOIN" if STRICT_SEC_MASTER else "LEFT JOIN"
    return f"""
WITH {ctx.fund_ref_cte()},
-- 1. ecritures de la fenetre de lots (sens inverse pour les extournes, statut 30)
deals AS (
    SELECT d.C_FUND, d.C_SRV, d.C_SRV_POSITION, d.C_N_ID, d.C_SEC_CCY,
           d.D_ACC, d.D_TRADE, d.D_VALUE, d.D_EXECUTION, d.D_PAYMENT,
           d.C_OPE, d.C_N_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF, d.N_CONTRACT, d.L_DEAL, TRIM(d.C_STATUS) AS ST,
           CASE WHEN TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS SGN,
           d.Q_QTY, d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY, d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.A_GROSS,
           COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0) AS UNREC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX, 0)   + COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0)   AS REC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_TAX_2, 0)                             AS OTHER_TAX,
           d.A_FEE_COR, d.A_NET, d.A_NET_PTF_CCY, d.R_INTEREST, d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY, d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE, d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND d
    WHERE d.C_FUND IN ({ctx.funds_in()})
      AND {ctx.lots('d')}{status_filter}
),
sec_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID FROM deals WHERE C_N_ID IS NOT NULL),
-- titre de l'ecriture elle-meme (jointure T.C_N_ID = S.C_N_ID de LUXIS) : pays
own_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_N_ID, UPPER(TRIM(m.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_N_ID ORDER BY m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER m INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = m.C_N_ID),
sm_own AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_COUNTRY FROM own_rk WHERE {sm_where}),
-- 2. referentiel titres (futures / options : sous-jacent, echeance, devise propre)
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = f.C_N_ID),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = o.C_N_ID),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
deals_svc AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV_POSITION), ''),
                    CASE WHEN fu.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FU' WHEN op.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'OP' END,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV), '')) AS SVC,
           fu.C_N_UNDERLYING AS FU_UND, fu.D_MATURITY AS FU_MAT, fu.C_FUT_CCY AS FU_CCY,
           op.C_N_UNDERLYING AS OP_UND, op.D_MATURITY AS OP_MAT, op.C_OPT_CCY AS OP_CCY, UPPER(TRIM(op.C_OPT_NATURE)) AS OP_NATURE
    FROM deals d LEFT JOIN fut fu ON fu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID LEFT JOIN opt op ON op.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID),
deals_key AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_UND WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_UND ELSE t.C_N_ID END AS C_N_ID_MASTER,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_MAT WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_MAT ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) END AS D_MATURITY,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_NATURE ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS C_OPT_NATURE,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'BO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'PO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS INSTR_TYP,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_CCY ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS SEC_CCY_DERIV
    FROM deals_svc t),
master_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID_MASTER AS C_N_ID FROM deals_key WHERE C_N_ID_MASTER IS NOT NULL),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_N_ID, m.L_NAME, m.C_SEC_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_N_ID ORDER BY m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER m INNER JOIN master_ids k ON k.C_N_ID = m.C_N_ID),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_SEC_CCY FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = i.C_N_ID
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11'),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 3. libelles : pays et nature d'option (langue 2 d'abord, sinon toute langue)
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'OPT_NATURE')),
ctry AS (SELECT celem, L_LIBELLE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'COUNTRY'),
optnat AS (SELECT celem, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'OPT_NATURE')
SELECT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    d.SVC AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code",
    d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.SVC
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(optnat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'BO' THEN sm.L_NAME WHEN 'PO' THEN sm.L_NAME
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(d.SEC_CCY_DERIV, sm.C_SEC_CCY, d.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm_own.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Accounting Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date",
    d.D_EXECUTION AS "Execution Date", d.D_PAYMENT AS "Payment Date",
    d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code", d.C_N_ACC AS "Account Number", d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "Entry Ptf",
    d.N_CONTRACT AS "Contract", d.L_DEAL AS "Description",
    d.SGN * d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity",
    d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY AS "Price in Security Ccy", d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Price in Settlement Ccy",
    d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Settlement Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_GROSS AS "Gross Amount",
    d.SGN * d.UNREC_TAX AS "Unrecoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.REC_TAX AS "Recoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.OTHER_TAX AS "Other Tax",
    d.SGN * d.A_FEE_COR AS "Fees in Security Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_NET AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.SGN * d.A_NET_PTF_CCY AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.R_INTEREST AS "Interest Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY AS "Settl./SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE AS "Sec/SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY AS "Sec/Tax Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.ST AS "Operation Status"
FROM deals_key d
     {own_join} sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID_MASTER
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.INSTR_TYP
     LEFT JOIN ctry ON ctry.celem = sm_own.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN optnat ON optnat.celem = d.C_OPT_NATURE
ORDER BY d.D_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF
"""


def _to_float(v):
    try:
        return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0


def _entry(v) -> int:
    return int(float(v))


def _dt(v) -> datetime | None:
    """Date/heure d'une valeur renvoyee par la passerelle (str, date ou datetime) ; une date seule = minuit."""
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, date):
        return datetime.combine(v, time.min)
    s = str(v).strip().replace("T", " ")
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(s[:19])
    except ValueError:
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(s[:10])
        except ValueError:
            return None


def post(rows: list[dict], ctx: Context) -> list[dict]:
    """Verrue LUXIS : complete les extournes (statut 30) dont l'ecriture d'origine n'est pas dans le resultat."""
    global _LOG
    _LOG = {"orphelines": 0, "origine_introuvable": 0, "hors_periode": 0, "ajoutees": 0, "detail_rejets": []}
    p = ctx.params

    # LUXIS : DIV_ENTRY NOT IN (entrees de statut 20) -> sur le numero d'entree seul, tous fonds confondus
    have_20 = {_entry(r["Entry"]) for r in rows if str(r["Operation Status"]).strip() == "20"}
    orphans = [r for r in rows if str(r["Operation Status"]).strip() == "30" and _entry(r["Entry"]) not in have_20]
    _LOG["orphelines"] = len(orphans)
    if not orphans:
        return rows

    wins = {w.fund: w for w in ctx.windows}
    by_fund: dict[str, set] = {}
    for r in orphans:
        by_fund.setdefault(str(r["SubFund Number"]).strip(), set()).add(_entry(r["Entry"]))

    table = "AMS_CASH_MVT" if CASH_SOURCE == "cash_mvt" else "AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND"
    cash: dict[tuple, list] = {}
    for fund, entries in by_fund.items():
        sql = ("SELECT c.C_FUND, c.C_OPE, c.N_ENTRY, c.N_ENTRY_PTF, c.D_ACC\n"
               f"FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.{table} c\n"
               f"WHERE c.C_FUND = {q(fund)} AND c.N_ENTRY IN ({in_list(sorted(entries))})\n"
               "ORDER BY c.N_ENTRY, c.N_ENTRY_PTF")
        for c in ctx.gw.rows(f"verrue_origine_{fund}", sql):
            cash.setdefault((fund, str(c["C_OPE"]).strip(), _entry(c["N_ENTRY"])), []).append(
                (_entry(c["N_ENTRY_PTF"]), _dt(c["D_ACC"])))

    added = []
    for r in orphans:
        fund = str(r["SubFund Number"]).strip()
        ident = f"fonds {fund} entree {_entry(r['Entry'])} ptf {_entry(r['Entry Ptf'])} ope {str(r['Operation Code']).strip()}"
        # LUXIS : premiere ligne de CASH_MVT (meme fonds, meme operation, meme entree, autre entree-portefeuille)
        cands = [c for c in cash.get((fund, str(r["Operation Code"]).strip(), _entry(r["Entry"])), [])
                 if c[0] != _entry(r["Entry Ptf"])]
        if not cands:
            _LOG["origine_introuvable"] += 1
            _LOG["detail_rejets"].append(f"origine introuvable ({CASH_SOURCE}) : {ident}")
            continue
        entry_ptf, d_acc = cands[0]
        w = wins.get(fund)
        lo = _dt(p.date_from) or (_dt(w.key_from) if w and w.key_from else None)
        hi = _dt(p.date_to) or (_dt(w.key_to) if w and w.key_to else None)
        # Oracle : v_Date_Acc BETWEEN v_Date_From AND v_Date_To (DATE a minuit, heure comprise)
        if d_acc is None or lo is None or hi is None or not (lo <= d_acc <= hi):
            _LOG["hors_periode"] += 1
            _LOG["detail_rejets"].append(f"date origine {d_acc} hors [{lo}, {hi}] : {ident}")
            continue
        n = dict(r)
        n["Accounting Date"], n["Entry Ptf"], n["Operation Status"] = d_acc.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), entry_ptf, "20"
        for c in ("Gross Amount", "Unrecoverable Tax", "Recoverable Tax", "Other Tax", "Fees in Security Ccy",
                  "Net Amount in Security Ccy", "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy"):
            n[c] = -_to_float(r[c])
        added.append(n)
    _LOG["ajoutees"] = len(added)
    out = rows + added
    out.sort(key=lambda r: (str(r["Accounting Date"])[:10], _entry(r["Entry"]), _entry(r["Entry Ptf"])))
    return out


def checks(rows: list[dict], ctx: Context) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    out = []
    by_status: dict[str, int] = {}
    for r in rows:
        s = str(r["Operation Status"]).strip()
        by_status[s] = by_status.get(s, 0) + 1
    out.append(("INFO", "repartition des statuts : " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(by_status.items())) if by_status else "aucune ligne"))
    missing_isin = sum(1 for r in rows if not r.get("Isin Code") and str(r.get("Service Code")) in ("BO", "PO"))
    out.append(("WARN" if missing_isin else "OK", f"{missing_isin} ligne(s) obligataire/action sans code ISIN"))
    gross = sum(_to_float(r["Gross Amount"]) for r in rows)
    out.append(("INFO", f"somme des montants bruts (devises melangees) : {gross:,.2f}"))
    if _LOG:
        out.append(("INFO", f"verrue ({CASH_SOURCE}) : {_LOG['orphelines']} extourne(s) orpheline(s), {_LOG['ajoutees']} origine(s) ajoutee(s), "
                            f"{_LOG['origine_introuvable']} origine(s) introuvable(s), {_LOG['hors_periode']} hors periode"))
        for d in _LOG["detail_rejets"]:
            out.append(("WARN", d))
    return out


SPEC = ReportSpec(
    key="coupons_dividendes", title="LuxRep Queries BCR - Coupons / Dividendes", file_tag="Bcr_Coupons_Dividends",
    columns=COLUMNS, build=build, formats=FORMATS, post=post, checks=checks,
    key_columns=["SubFund Number", "Entry", "Entry Ptf", "Operation Status"],
    extra_params=[ExtraParam("statuses", "statuts d'operation retenus (vide = tous, comme LUXIS), ex. 20,30", kind="list", default=[])],
    description="Coupons et dividendes des fonds, par fenetre de lots NAV, au format du rapport LuxRep BCR.",
    luxis_source="PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Div (code_source.txt l.1883-2222)",
)

# BCR - Mouvements (`mouvements`)

Reproduit `proc_Bcr_Mvts` (`code_source.txt` l.1017-1882) depuis `MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH` : une requete a trois branches
(BO+PO titres, FU futures, OP options). Le mapping complet est dans la docstring de `report.py`.

Parametres propres :
- `--set services=...` : services retenus.
- `--set bloomberg=none|luxis` : `GET_BLOOMBERG_TICKER` n'est pas dans les sources et aucune table MFGA ne porte le ticker.
  `luxis` lit `LUXIS.REPADMIN.FUND_PTF_CONSO` (ticker retenu seulement s'il est unique pour le PUID).

```
python -m luxrep_reports run mouvements --funds 280287 --from 2026-06-01 --to 2026-07-01 --names luxis --set bloomberg=luxis --compare Bcr_Movments.xlsx --yes
```

Validation (fonds 280287) : 70 / 70 lignes identiques sur toutes les colonnes hors Bloomberg ; 68 / 70 avec `bloomberg=luxis`
(RIO LN Equity et STLAM IM Equity : PUID a plusieurs tickers, non reproductible).

Note de performance : sur un fonds pool avec `--depooling both`, la fenetre "avant" couvre tous les sous-fonds du pool et peut
etre longue ; reduire la periode ou lancer `--depooling after`.



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\mouvements\report.py =====
"""Rapport BCR - Mouvements (LuxRep Queries BCR, chapitre 2).

Reproduit `REPADMIN.PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Mvts` (code_source.txt l.1017-1882) depuis MFGA / Infocentre :

  LUXIS (REPADMIN)                                      MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH (ce rapport)
  ----------------------------------------------------  --------------------------------------------------------
  DWH_AMS_MVT  T  (CR_BO / CR_FU / CR_OP)               AMS_MVT (une requete, trois branches : BO+PO, FU, OP)
  DWH_AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET  D  (jointure interne)      AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET (EXISTS, le DISTINCT de LUXIS est conserve)
  DWH_AMS_DEAL_FUTURE / DWH_AMS_DEAL_OPTION             AMS_DEAL_FUTURE (P_FUT) / AMS_DEAL_OPTION (P_PREMIUM)
  DWH_AMS_FUTURES_MASTER / DWH_AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER       idem, dernier lot par C_N_ID
  DWH_AMS_SEC_MASTER  S  (type, pays)                   AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER (dernier lot par C_N_ID)
  GET_DATE_NAV_WITH_LOT(fonds, lot)                     AMS_LOT.D_NAV
  GET_DWH_MESSAGE('COUNTRY' | 'SOF_TYP' | 'OPE', code)  AMS_MESSAGE (langue 2 puis toute langue)
  GET_CODE_ISIN_FROM_SEC / GET_SEC_NAME / GET_SEC_CCY   AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID (C_ID_TYP = '11') / masters
  GET_FUND_NAME_TB_FDS / GET_FUND_CCY_TB_FDS            AMS_PORTFOLIO (ou LUXREP_TB_FONDS avec --names luxis)
  fonds coches : LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS                   parametre --funds
  GET_BLOOMBERG_TICKER(PUID, devise)                    fonction PL/SQL absente de code_source.txt : voir `bloomberg`

Regles LUXIS reproduites :
  * fenetre de lots `N_LOT > lot_from AND N_LOT <= lot_to` (core/window.py) ;
  * BO / PO : montant = A_BUY si non nul sinon A_SALE ; montant fonds = A_BUY_PTF (+ frais fonds si statut 20, - sinon) ou
    A_SALE_PTF (- frais fonds si statut 20, + sinon) ; jointure interne avec DEAL_STOCK_MARKET (fonds, service, entree,
    statut) ; resultat DISTINCT ; sous-jacent = 0 ;
  * FU : prix = P_FUT, montant = A_BUY(_PTF) si code operation 310 sinon A_SALE(_PTF) ; type / pays = ceux du sous-jacent ;
  * OP : prix = P_PREMIUM, montant = A_BUY(_PTF) si code operation 300 ou 307 sinon A_SALE(_PTF) ;
  * nom FU = nom du sous-jacent + echeance (format Oracle `DD-MON-YY`, mois francais sur 5 caracteres : `30-JUIN -26`,
    `30-SEPT.-26`) ; nom OP = nature + nom du sous-jacent + echeance ;
  * la colonne Contract est vide pour BO / PO ;
  * branche eFront (fonds hors Multifonds) : hors perimetre, comme pour le grand livre ;
  * tri (absent du curseur LUXIS, ajoute pour un resultat stable) : fonds, entree, date comptable.

Code Bloomberg : `GET_BLOOMBERG_TICKER` n'est pas dans les sources et aucune table MFGA ne porte le ticker (le PUID est dans
AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID, C_ID_TYP = '24'). Parametre `bloomberg` : `none` (defaut, colonnes vides) ou `luxis`
(table de travail LUXIS.REPADMIN.FUND_PTF_CONSO : ticker retenu seulement s'il est unique pour le PUID ; ambigu -> vide).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from ..core.report import (ReportSpec, ExtraParam, Context, FMT_TEXT, FMT_INT, FMT_QTY, FMT_AMT, FMT_RATE, FMT_DATE, FMT_STATUS)
from ..core.sqlutil import q, in_list

COLUMNS = [
    "SubFund Number", "SubFund Name", "SubFund Ccy", "Service Code", "Isin Code", "Internal Fa Code", "Security Name",
    "Security Ccy", "Country Code", "Country Name", "Acc. Date", "Trade Date", "Value Date", "Operation Code", "Entry",
    "Contract", "Quantity", "Price in Security Ccy", "Net Amount in Security Ccy", "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    "Fees in Security Ccy", "Fees in SubFund Ccy", "Interest in Security Ccy", "Interest in SubFund Ccy",
    "Realized in Security Ccy", "Realized in SubFund Ccy", "Operation Status", "Underlying Internal Fa Code",
    "Underlying Isin Code", "Underlying Name", "Underlying Ccy", "Security Type Code", "Security Type Name", "Description",
    "Bloomberg Code", "Underlying Bloomberg Code", "Nav Date",
]

FORMATS = {
    "Internal Fa Code": FMT_INT, "Acc. Date": FMT_DATE, "Trade Date": FMT_DATE, "Value Date": FMT_DATE, "Entry": FMT_INT,
    "Contract": FMT_INT, "Quantity": FMT_QTY, "Price in Security Ccy": FMT_RATE, "Net Amount in Security Ccy": FMT_AMT,
    "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy": FMT_AMT, "Fees in Security Ccy": FMT_AMT, "Fees in SubFund Ccy": FMT_AMT,
    "Interest in Security Ccy": FMT_AMT, "Interest in SubFund Ccy": FMT_AMT, "Realized in Security Ccy": FMT_AMT,
    "Realized in SubFund Ccy": FMT_AMT, "Operation Status": FMT_STATUS, "Underlying Internal Fa Code": FMT_INT,
    "Nav Date": FMT_DATE,
}

SERVICES = ("BO", "PO", "FU", "OP")

# Mois francais d'Oracle (NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE FRENCH) pour le format MON, completes a 5 caracteres comme `30-JUIN -26`.
_MONTHS = ["JANV.", "FÃ‰VR.", "MARS ", "AVR. ", "MAI  ", "JUIN ", "JUIL.", "AOÃ›T ", "SEPT.", "OCT. ", "NOV. ", "DÃ‰C. "]


def _mat_fmt(col: str) -> str:
    cases = " ".join(f"WHEN {i} THEN {q(m)}" for i, m in enumerate(_MONTHS, 1))
    return (f"LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM {col}) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM {col}) {cases} END"
            f" || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM {col}) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2)")


def build(ctx: Context) -> str:
    services = [s.upper() for s in (ctx.extra("services") or [])] or list(SERVICES)
    if "BO" in services and "PO" not in services:
        services.append("PO")
    use_bbg = str(ctx.extra("bloomberg", "none")).lower() == "luxis"
    branches = []
    if "BO" in services or "PO" in services:
        branches.append(f"""
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, t.P_PRICE AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE, 0) END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0
                THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY_PTF, 0) + (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
           END AS AMT_PTF,
           COALESCE(t.A_FEES, 0) AS FEES, COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0) AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF,
           t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF, TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS UND_ID, t.C_N_ID AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ({ctx.funds_in()}) AND {ctx.lots('t')} AND t.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET d
                  WHERE d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = TRIM(t.C_STATUS))""")
    if "FU" in services:
        branches.append(f"""
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_FUT AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_FUTURE d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN fut fm ON fm.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ({ctx.funds_in()}) AND {ctx.lots('t')} AND t.C_SRV = 'FU'""")
    if "OP" in services:
        branches.append(f"""
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_PREMIUM AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_OPTION d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN opt om ON om.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ({ctx.funds_in()}) AND {ctx.lots('t')} AND t.C_SRV = 'OP'""")
    body = "\n    UNION ALL".join(branches)
    if not branches:
        raise ValueError("aucun service retenu (BO, PO, FU, OP)")

    bbg_cte = ""
    bbg_sel = 'CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Bloomberg Code", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Underlying Bloomberg Code"'
    bbg_join = ""
    if use_bbg:
        bbg_cte = f""",
puid_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '24' AND i.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
puid AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM puid_rk WHERE rn = 1),
tick AS (
    SELECT CODE_PUID, MIN(C_BLOOMBERG_CODE) AS TICKER
    FROM (SELECT CODE_PUID, C_BLOOMBERG_CODE FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.FUND_PTF_CONSO WHERE LENGTH(C_BLOOMBERG_CODE) > 0
          UNION
          SELECT UNDERLYING_CODE_PUID, UNDERLYING_CODE_BLOOMBERG FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.FUND_PTF_CONSO WHERE LENGTH(UNDERLYING_CODE_BLOOMBERG) > 0)
    GROUP BY CODE_PUID HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)"""
        bbg_sel = 'tk.TICKER AS "Bloomberg Code", tku.TICKER AS "Underlying Bloomberg Code"'
        bbg_join = """
     LEFT JOIN puid pu  ON pu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND pu.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN tick tk  ON tk.CODE_PUID = pu.G_ID_VALUE
     LEFT JOIN puid puu ON puu.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND puu.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN tick tku ON tku.CODE_PUID = puu.G_ID_VALUE"""

    return f"""
WITH {ctx.fund_ref_cte()},
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
mvt AS ({body}
),
mvt_f AS (
    SELECT m.*, CASE m.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE 'S' END AS SRV_TYP FROM mvt m),
all_ids AS (SELECT C_N_ID FROM mvt_f UNION SELECT UND_ID FROM mvt_f WHERE UND_ID <> 0 UNION SELECT MASTER_ID FROM mvt_f),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT s.C_N_ID, s.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(s.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, s.C_SEC_CCY, s.C_SEC_TYP,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.C_N_ID ORDER BY s.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER s WHERE s.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY, C_SEC_TYP FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11' AND i.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'SOF_TYP', 'OPE', 'OPT_NATURE')),
msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navd AS (
    SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS D_NAV FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l
    WHERE l.C_FUND IN ({ctx.funds_in()}) GROUP BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT){bbg_cte}
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy", d.C_SRV AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code", d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.C_SRV
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE({_mat_fmt('fut.D_MATURITY')}, '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(nat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE({_mat_fmt('opt.D_MATURITY')}, '')
        ELSE sm_own.L_NAME END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(CASE d.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN fut.C_FUT_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN opt.C_OPT_CCY ELSE sm_own.C_SEC_CCY END, sm_own.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Acc. Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date", d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code",
    d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", CASE WHEN d.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO') THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE d.N_CONTRACT END AS "Contract",
    d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity", d.PRICE AS "Price in Security Ccy",
    d.AMT AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.AMT_PTF AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.FEES AS "Fees in Security Ccy", d.FEES_PTF AS "Fees in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_INTEREST AS "Interest in Security Ccy", d.A_INTEREST_PTF AS "Interest in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_PNL AS "Realized in Security Ccy", d.A_PNL_PTF AS "Realized in SubFund Ccy", d.ST AS "Operation Status",
    d.UND_ID AS "Underlying Internal Fa Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN SUBSTR(isin_u.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) END AS "Underlying Isin Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.L_NAME END AS "Underlying Name",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.C_SEC_CCY END AS "Underlying Ccy",
    sm.C_SEC_TYP AS "Security Type Code", styp.L_LIBELLE AS "Security Type Name", ope.L_LIBELLE AS "Description",
    {bbg_sel}, nv.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "_EP"
FROM mvt_f d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.MASTER_ID
     LEFT JOIN sm sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fut ON fut.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'FU'
     LEFT JOIN opt ON opt.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'OP'
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN isin isin_u ON isin_u.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND isin_u.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN msg ctry ON ctry.ctab = 'COUNTRY' AND ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT{bbg_join}
) z
ORDER BY "SubFund Number", "Entry", "Acc. Date", "_EP"
"""


def post(rows: list[dict], ctx: Context) -> list[dict]:
    for r in rows:
        r.pop("_EP", None)
    return rows


def checks(rows: list[dict], ctx: Context) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    out = []
    by_srv: dict[str, int] = {}
    for r in rows:
        by_srv[str(r["Service Code"])] = by_srv.get(str(r["Service Code"]), 0) + 1
    out.append(("INFO", "repartition par service : " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(by_srv.items())) if by_srv else "aucune ligne"))
    no_isin = sum(1 for r in rows if not r.get("Isin Code"))
    out.append(("WARN" if no_isin else "OK", f"{no_isin} ligne(s) sans code ISIN"))
    no_nav = sum(1 for r in rows if not r.get("Nav Date"))
    out.append(("WARN" if no_nav else "OK", f"{no_nav} ligne(s) sans date NAV"))
    if str(ctx.extra("bloomberg", "none")).lower() != "luxis":
        out.append(("INFO", "codes Bloomberg non renseignes (parametre bloomberg=none) : voir MAPPING.md"))
    return out


SPEC = ReportSpec(
    key="mouvements", title="LuxRep Queries BCR - Mouvements", file_tag="Bcr_Movments",
    columns=COLUMNS, build=build, formats=FORMATS, post=post, checks=checks,
    key_columns=["SubFund Number", "Entry", "Service Code", "Operation Status"],
    extra_params=[
        ExtraParam("services", "services retenus parmi BO, PO, FU, OP (vide = tous)", kind="list", default=[]),
        ExtraParam("bloomberg", "codes Bloomberg : none (vide) ou luxis (table de travail FUND_PTF_CONSO)", kind="str", default="none"),
    ],
    description="Achats / ventes de titres, futures et options des fonds, par fenetre de lots NAV, au format LuxRep BCR.",
    luxis_source="PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Bcr_Mvts (code_source.txt l.1017-1882)",
)

WITH fund_ref_rk AS (
  SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p
  WHERE p.C_FUND IN ('280287')
),
fund_ref AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM fund_ref_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 1. ecritures de la fenetre de lots (sens inverse pour les extournes, statut 30)
deals AS (
    SELECT d.C_FUND, d.C_SRV, d.C_SRV_POSITION, d.C_N_ID, d.C_SEC_CCY,
           d.D_ACC, d.D_TRADE, d.D_VALUE, d.D_EXECUTION, d.D_PAYMENT,
           d.C_OPE, d.C_N_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF, d.N_CONTRACT, d.L_DEAL, TRIM(d.C_STATUS) AS ST,
           CASE WHEN TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS SGN,
           d.Q_QTY, d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY, d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.A_GROSS,
           COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0) AS UNREC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX, 0)   + COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0)   AS REC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_TAX_2, 0)                             AS OTHER_TAX,
           d.A_FEE_COR, d.A_NET, d.A_NET_PTF_CCY, d.R_INTEREST, d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY, d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE, d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND d
    WHERE d.C_FUND IN ('280287')
      AND ((d.C_FUND = '280287' AND d.N_LOT > 8554978 AND d.N_LOT <= 8607153))
),
sec_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID FROM deals WHERE C_N_ID IS NOT NULL),
-- 2. referentiel titres (futures / options : sous-jacent, echeance, devise propre)
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = f.C_N_ID),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = o.C_N_ID),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
deals_svc AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV_POSITION), ''),
                    CASE WHEN fu.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FU' WHEN op.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'OP' END,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV), '')) AS SVC,
           fu.C_N_UNDERLYING AS FU_UND, fu.D_MATURITY AS FU_MAT, fu.C_FUT_CCY AS FU_CCY,
           op.C_N_UNDERLYING AS OP_UND, op.D_MATURITY AS OP_MAT, op.C_OPT_CCY AS OP_CCY, UPPER(TRIM(op.C_OPT_NATURE)) AS OP_NATURE
    FROM deals d LEFT JOIN fut fu ON fu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID LEFT JOIN opt op ON op.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID),
deals_key AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_UND WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_UND ELSE t.C_N_ID END AS C_N_ID_MASTER,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_MAT WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_MAT ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) END AS D_MATURITY,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_NATURE ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS C_OPT_NATURE,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'BO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'PO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS INSTR_TYP,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_CCY ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS SEC_CCY_DERIV
    FROM deals_svc t),
master_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID_MASTER AS C_N_ID FROM deals_key WHERE C_N_ID_MASTER IS NOT NULL),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_N_ID, m.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(m.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, m.C_SEC_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_N_ID ORDER BY m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER m INNER JOIN master_ids k ON k.C_N_ID = m.C_N_ID),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = i.C_N_ID
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11'),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 3. libelles : pays et nature d'option (langue 2 d'abord, sinon toute langue)
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'OPT_NATURE')),
ctry AS (SELECT celem, L_LIBELLE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'COUNTRY'),
optnat AS (SELECT celem, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'OPT_NATURE')
SELECT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    d.SVC AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code",
    d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.SVC
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(optnat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'BO' THEN sm.L_NAME WHEN 'PO' THEN sm.L_NAME
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(d.SEC_CCY_DERIV, sm.C_SEC_CCY, d.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Accounting Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date",
    d.D_EXECUTION AS "Execution Date", d.D_PAYMENT AS "Payment Date",
    d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code", d.C_N_ACC AS "Account Number", d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "Entry Ptf",
    d.N_CONTRACT AS "Contract", d.L_DEAL AS "Description",
    d.SGN * d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity",
    d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY AS "Price in Security Ccy", d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Price in Settlement Ccy",
    d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Settlement Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_GROSS AS "Gross Amount",
    d.SGN * d.UNREC_TAX AS "Unrecoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.REC_TAX AS "Recoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.OTHER_TAX AS "Other Tax",
    d.SGN * d.A_FEE_COR AS "Fees in Security Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_NET AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.SGN * d.A_NET_PTF_CCY AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.R_INTEREST AS "Interest Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY AS "Settl./SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE AS "Sec/SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY AS "Sec/Tax Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.ST AS "Operation Status"
FROM deals_key d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID_MASTER
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.INSTR_TYP
     LEFT JOIN ctry ON ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN optnat ON optnat.celem = d.C_OPT_NATURE
ORDER BY d.D_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\out\coupons_dividendes_20261027_140819\sql\verrue_cash_mvt_280287.sql =====
SELECT c.C_FUND, c.C_OPE, c.N_ENTRY, c.N_ENTRY_PTF, c.D_ACC
FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_CASH_MVT c
WHERE c.C_FUND = '280287' AND c.N_ENTRY IN (1406)

WITH fund_ref_rk AS (
  SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p
  WHERE p.C_FUND IN ('280287')
),
fund_ref AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM fund_ref_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 1. ecritures de la fenetre de lots (sens inverse pour les extournes, statut 30)
deals AS (
    SELECT d.C_FUND, d.C_SRV, d.C_SRV_POSITION, d.C_N_ID, d.C_SEC_CCY,
           d.D_ACC, d.D_TRADE, d.D_VALUE, d.D_EXECUTION, d.D_PAYMENT,
           d.C_OPE, d.C_N_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF, d.N_CONTRACT, d.L_DEAL, TRIM(d.C_STATUS) AS ST,
           CASE WHEN TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS SGN,
           d.Q_QTY, d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY, d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.A_GROSS,
           COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0) AS UNREC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX, 0)   + COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0)   AS REC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_TAX_2, 0)                             AS OTHER_TAX,
           d.A_FEE_COR, d.A_NET, d.A_NET_PTF_CCY, d.R_INTEREST, d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY, d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE, d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND d
    WHERE d.C_FUND IN ('280287')
      AND ((d.C_FUND = '280287' AND d.N_LOT > 8554978 AND d.N_LOT <= 8607153))
),
sec_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID FROM deals WHERE C_N_ID IS NOT NULL),
-- 2. referentiel titres (futures / options : sous-jacent, echeance, devise propre)
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = f.C_N_ID),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = o.C_N_ID),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
deals_svc AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV_POSITION), ''),
                    CASE WHEN fu.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FU' WHEN op.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'OP' END,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV), '')) AS SVC,
           fu.C_N_UNDERLYING AS FU_UND, fu.D_MATURITY AS FU_MAT, fu.C_FUT_CCY AS FU_CCY,
           op.C_N_UNDERLYING AS OP_UND, op.D_MATURITY AS OP_MAT, op.C_OPT_CCY AS OP_CCY, UPPER(TRIM(op.C_OPT_NATURE)) AS OP_NATURE
    FROM deals d LEFT JOIN fut fu ON fu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID LEFT JOIN opt op ON op.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID),
deals_key AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_UND WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_UND ELSE t.C_N_ID END AS C_N_ID_MASTER,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_MAT WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_MAT ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) END AS D_MATURITY,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_NATURE ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS C_OPT_NATURE,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'BO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'PO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS INSTR_TYP,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_CCY ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS SEC_CCY_DERIV
    FROM deals_svc t),
master_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID_MASTER AS C_N_ID FROM deals_key WHERE C_N_ID_MASTER IS NOT NULL),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_N_ID, m.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(m.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, m.C_SEC_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_N_ID ORDER BY m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER m INNER JOIN master_ids k ON k.C_N_ID = m.C_N_ID),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = i.C_N_ID
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11'),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 3. libelles : pays et nature d'option (langue 2 d'abord, sinon toute langue)
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'OPT_NATURE')),
ctry AS (SELECT celem, L_LIBELLE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'COUNTRY'),
optnat AS (SELECT celem, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'OPT_NATURE')
SELECT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    d.SVC AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code",
    d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.SVC
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(optnat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'BO' THEN sm.L_NAME WHEN 'PO' THEN sm.L_NAME
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(d.SEC_CCY_DERIV, sm.C_SEC_CCY, d.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Accounting Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date",
    d.D_EXECUTION AS "Execution Date", d.D_PAYMENT AS "Payment Date",
    d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code", d.C_N_ACC AS "Account Number", d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "Entry Ptf",
    d.N_CONTRACT AS "Contract", d.L_DEAL AS "Description",
    d.SGN * d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity",
    d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY AS "Price in Security Ccy", d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Price in Settlement Ccy",
    d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Settlement Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_GROSS AS "Gross Amount",
    d.SGN * d.UNREC_TAX AS "Unrecoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.REC_TAX AS "Recoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.OTHER_TAX AS "Other Tax",
    d.SGN * d.A_FEE_COR AS "Fees in Security Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_NET AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.SGN * d.A_NET_PTF_CCY AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.R_INTEREST AS "Interest Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY AS "Settl./SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE AS "Sec/SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY AS "Sec/Tax Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.ST AS "Operation Status"
FROM deals_key d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID_MASTER
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.INSTR_TYP

     LEFT JOIN optnat ON optnat.celem = d.C_OPT_NATURE

     LEFT JOIN ctry ON ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN optnat ON optnat.celem = d.C_OPT_NATURE
ORDER BY d.D_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\out\coupons_dividendes_20261027_174712\sql\main_avant.sql =====
WITH fund_ref_rk AS (
  SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p
  WHERE p.C_FUND IN ('280376', '447064', '531736', '531737', '541842')
),
fund_ref AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM fund_ref_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 1. ecritures de la fenetre de lots (sens inverse pour les extournes, statut 30)
deals AS (
    SELECT d.C_FUND, d.C_SRV, d.C_SRV_POSITION, d.C_N_ID, d.C_SEC_CCY,
           d.D_ACC, d.D_TRADE, d.D_VALUE, d.D_EXECUTION, d.D_PAYMENT,
           d.C_OPE, d.C_N_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF, d.N_CONTRACT, d.L_DEAL, TRIM(d.C_STATUS) AS ST,
           CASE WHEN TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS SGN,
           d.Q_QTY, d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY, d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.A_GROSS,
           COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0) AS UNREC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX, 0)   + COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0)   AS REC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_TAX_2, 0)                             AS OTHER_TAX,
           d.A_FEE_COR, d.A_NET, d.A_NET_PTF_CCY, d.R_INTEREST, d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY, d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE, d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND d
    WHERE d.C_FUND IN ('280376', '447064', '531736', '531737', '541842')
      AND ((d.C_FUND = '280376' AND d.N_LOT > 8505799 AND d.N_LOT <= 8606033) OR (d.C_FUND = '447064' AND d.N_LOT > 8505819 AND d.N_LOT <= 8606049) OR (d.C_FUND = '531736' AND d.N_LOT > 8505847 AND d.N_LOT <= 8606065) OR (d.C_FUND = '531737' AND d.N_LOT > 8505849 AND d.N_LOT <= 8606067) OR (d.C_FUND = '541842' AND d.N_LOT > 8505871 AND d.N_LOT <= 8606079))
),
sec_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID FROM deals WHERE C_N_ID IS NOT NULL),
-- 2. referentiel titres (futures / options : sous-jacent, echeance, devise propre)
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = f.C_N_ID),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = o.C_N_ID),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
deals_svc AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV_POSITION), ''),
                    CASE WHEN fu.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FU' WHEN op.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'OP' END,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV), '')) AS SVC,
           fu.C_N_UNDERLYING AS FU_UND, fu.D_MATURITY AS FU_MAT, fu.C_FUT_CCY AS FU_CCY,
           op.C_N_UNDERLYING AS OP_UND, op.D_MATURITY AS OP_MAT, op.C_OPT_CCY AS OP_CCY, UPPER(TRIM(op.C_OPT_NATURE)) AS OP_NATURE
    FROM deals d LEFT JOIN fut fu ON fu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID LEFT JOIN opt op ON op.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID),
deals_key AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_UND WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_UND ELSE t.C_N_ID END AS C_N_ID_MASTER,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_MAT WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_MAT ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) END AS D_MATURITY,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_NATURE ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS C_OPT_NATURE,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'BO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'PO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS INSTR_TYP,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_CCY ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS SEC_CCY_DERIV
    FROM deals_svc t),
master_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID_MASTER AS C_N_ID FROM deals_key WHERE C_N_ID_MASTER IS NOT NULL),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_N_ID, m.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(m.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, m.C_SEC_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_N_ID ORDER BY m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER m INNER JOIN master_ids k ON k.C_N_ID = m.C_N_ID),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = i.C_N_ID
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11'),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 3. libelles : pays et nature d'option (langue 2 d'abord, sinon toute langue)
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'OPT_NATURE')),
ctry AS (SELECT celem, L_LIBELLE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'COUNTRY'),
optnat AS (SELECT celem, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'OPT_NATURE')
SELECT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    d.SVC AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code",
    d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.SVC
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(optnat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'BO' THEN sm.L_NAME WHEN 'PO' THEN sm.L_NAME
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(d.SEC_CCY_DERIV, sm.C_SEC_CCY, d.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Accounting Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date",
    d.D_EXECUTION AS "Execution Date", d.D_PAYMENT AS "Payment Date",
    d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code", d.C_N_ACC AS "Account Number", d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "Entry Ptf",
    d.N_CONTRACT AS "Contract", d.L_DEAL AS "Description",
    d.SGN * d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity",
    d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY AS "Price in Security Ccy", d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Price in Settlement Ccy",
    d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Settlement Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_GROSS AS "Gross Amount",
    d.SGN * d.UNREC_TAX AS "Unrecoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.REC_TAX AS "Recoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.OTHER_TAX AS "Other Tax",
    d.SGN * d.A_FEE_COR AS "Fees in Security Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_NET AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.SGN * d.A_NET_PTF_CCY AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.R_INTEREST AS "Interest Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY AS "Settl./SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE AS "Sec/SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY AS "Sec/Tax Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.ST AS "Operation Status"
FROM deals_key d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID_MASTER
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.INSTR_TYP
     LEFT JOIN ctry ON ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN optnat ON optnat.celem = d.C_OPT_NATURE
ORDER BY d.D_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF

-- 2. referentiel titres (futures / options : sous-jacent, echeance, devise propre)
fut_rk AS (

     LEFT JOIN ctry ON ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN optnat ON optnat.celem = d.C_OPT_NATURE
ORDER BY d.D_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\out\coupons_dividendes_20261028_095020\sql\main_direct.sql =====
WITH fund_ref_rk AS (
  SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p
  WHERE p.C_FUND IN ('812645')
),
fund_ref AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM fund_ref_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 1. ecritures de la fenetre de lots (sens inverse pour les extournes, statut 30)
deals AS (
    SELECT d.C_FUND, d.C_SRV, d.C_SRV_POSITION, d.C_N_ID, d.C_SEC_CCY,
           d.D_ACC, d.D_TRADE, d.D_VALUE, d.D_EXECUTION, d.D_PAYMENT,
           d.C_OPE, d.C_N_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF, d.N_CONTRACT, d.L_DEAL, TRIM(d.C_STATUS) AS ST,
           CASE WHEN TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS SGN,
           d.Q_QTY, d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY, d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.A_GROSS,
           COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0) AS UNREC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX, 0)   + COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0)   AS REC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_TAX_2, 0)                             AS OTHER_TAX,
           d.A_FEE_COR, d.A_NET, d.A_NET_PTF_CCY, d.R_INTEREST, d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY, d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE, d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND d
    WHERE d.C_FUND IN ('812645')
      AND ((d.C_FUND = '812645' AND d.N_LOT > 8145063 AND d.N_LOT <= 8639394))
),
sec_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID FROM deals WHERE C_N_ID IS NOT NULL),
-- 2. referentiel titres (futures / options : sous-jacent, echeance, devise propre)
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = f.C_N_ID),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = o.C_N_ID),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
deals_svc AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV_POSITION), ''),
                    CASE WHEN fu.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FU' WHEN op.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'OP' END,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV), '')) AS SVC,
           fu.C_N_UNDERLYING AS FU_UND, fu.D_MATURITY AS FU_MAT, fu.C_FUT_CCY AS FU_CCY,
           op.C_N_UNDERLYING AS OP_UND, op.D_MATURITY AS OP_MAT, op.C_OPT_CCY AS OP_CCY, UPPER(TRIM(op.C_OPT_NATURE)) AS OP_NATURE
    FROM deals d LEFT JOIN fut fu ON fu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID LEFT JOIN opt op ON op.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID),
deals_key AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_UND WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_UND ELSE t.C_N_ID END AS C_N_ID_MASTER,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_MAT WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_MAT ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) END AS D_MATURITY,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_NATURE ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS C_OPT_NATURE,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'BO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'PO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS INSTR_TYP,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_CCY ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS SEC_CCY_DERIV
    FROM deals_svc t),
master_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID_MASTER AS C_N_ID FROM deals_key WHERE C_N_ID_MASTER IS NOT NULL),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_N_ID, m.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(m.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, m.C_SEC_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_N_ID ORDER BY m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER m INNER JOIN master_ids k ON k.C_N_ID = m.C_N_ID),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = i.C_N_ID
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11'),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 3. libelles : pays et nature d'option (langue 2 d'abord, sinon toute langue)
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'OPT_NATURE')),
ctry AS (SELECT celem, L_LIBELLE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'COUNTRY'),
optnat AS (SELECT celem, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'OPT_NATURE')
SELECT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    d.SVC AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code",
    d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.SVC
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(optnat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'BO' THEN sm.L_NAME WHEN 'PO' THEN sm.L_NAME
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(d.SEC_CCY_DERIV, sm.C_SEC_CCY, d.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Accounting Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date",
    d.D_EXECUTION AS "Execution Date", d.D_PAYMENT AS "Payment Date",
    d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code", d.C_N_ACC AS "Account Number", d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "Entry Ptf",
    d.N_CONTRACT AS "Contract", d.L_DEAL AS "Description",
    d.SGN * d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity",
    d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY AS "Price in Security Ccy", d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Price in Settlement Ccy",
    d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Settlement Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_GROSS AS "Gross Amount",
    d.SGN * d.UNREC_TAX AS "Unrecoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.REC_TAX AS "Recoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.OTHER_TAX AS "Other Tax",
    d.SGN * d.A_FEE_COR AS "Fees in Security Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_NET AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.SGN * d.A_NET_PTF_CCY AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.R_INTEREST AS "Interest Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY AS "Settl./SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE AS "Sec/SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY AS "Sec/Tax Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.ST AS "Operation Status"
FROM deals_key d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID_MASTER
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.INSTR_TYP
     LEFT JOIN ctry ON ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN optnat ON optnat.celem = d.C_OPT_NATURE
ORDER BY d.D_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF

deals AS (
    SELECT d.C_FUND, d.C_SRV, d.C_SRV_POSITION, d.C_N_ID, d.C_SEC_CCY,
           d.D_ACC, d.D_TRADE, d.D_VALUE, d.D_EXECUTION, d.D_PAYMENT,
           d.C_OPE, d.C_N_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF, d.N_CONTRACT, d.L_DEAL, TRIM(d.C_STATUS) AS ST,
           CASE WHEN TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS SGN,
           d.Q_QTY, d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY, d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY, d.A_GROSS,
           COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_UNRECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0) AS UNREC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX, 0)   + COALESCE(d.A_RECOVERABLE_TAX_2, 0)   AS REC_TAX,
           COALESCE(d.A_TAX, 0) + COALESCE(d.A_TAX_2, 0)                             AS OTHER_TAX,
           d.A_FEE_COR, d.A_NET, d.A_NET_PTF_CCY, d.R_INTEREST, d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY, d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE, d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_COUPON_DIVIDEND d
    WHERE d.C_FUND IN ('280299')
      AND ((d.C_FUND = '280299' AND d.N_LOT > 8665878 AND d.N_LOT <= 8668252))
),
sec_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID FROM deals WHERE C_N_ID IS NOT NULL),
-- 2. referentiel titres (futures / options : sous-jacent, echeance, devise propre)
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = f.C_N_ID),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = o.C_N_ID),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
deals_svc AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV_POSITION), ''),
                    CASE WHEN fu.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FU' WHEN op.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'OP' END,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV), '')) AS SVC,
           fu.C_N_UNDERLYING AS FU_UND, fu.D_MATURITY AS FU_MAT, fu.C_FUT_CCY AS FU_CCY,
           op.C_N_UNDERLYING AS OP_UND, op.D_MATURITY AS OP_MAT, op.C_OPT_CCY AS OP_CCY, UPPER(TRIM(op.C_OPT_NATURE)) AS OP_NATURE
    FROM deals d LEFT JOIN fut fu ON fu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID LEFT JOIN opt op ON op.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID),
deals_key AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_UND WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_UND ELSE t.C_N_ID END AS C_N_ID_MASTER,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_MAT WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_MAT ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) END AS D_MATURITY,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_NATURE ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS C_OPT_NATURE,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'BO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'PO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS INSTR_TYP,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_CCY ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS SEC_CCY_DERIV
    FROM deals_svc t),
master_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID_MASTER AS C_N_ID FROM deals_key WHERE C_N_ID_MASTER IS NOT NULL),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_N_ID, m.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(m.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, m.C_SEC_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_N_ID ORDER BY m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER m INNER JOIN master_ids k ON k.C_N_ID = m.C_N_ID),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = i.C_N_ID
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11'),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 3. libelles : pays et nature d'option (langue 2 d'abord, sinon toute langue)
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'OPT_NATURE')),
ctry AS (SELECT celem, L_LIBELLE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'COUNTRY'),
optnat AS (SELECT celem, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'OPT_NATURE')
SELECT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    d.SVC AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code",
    d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.SVC
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(optnat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'BO' THEN sm.L_NAME WHEN 'PO' THEN sm.L_NAME
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(d.SEC_CCY_DERIV, sm.C_SEC_CCY, d.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Accounting Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date",
    d.D_EXECUTION AS "Execution Date", d.D_PAYMENT AS "Payment Date",
    d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code", d.C_N_ACC AS "Account Number", d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "Entry Ptf",
    d.N_CONTRACT AS "Contract", d.L_DEAL AS "Description",
    d.SGN * d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity",
    d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY AS "Price in Security Ccy", d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Price in Settlement Ccy",
    d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Settlement Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_GROSS AS "Gross Amount",
    d.SGN * d.UNREC_TAX AS "Unrecoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.REC_TAX AS "Recoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.OTHER_TAX AS "Other Tax",
    d.SGN * d.A_FEE_COR AS "Fees in Security Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_NET AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.SGN * d.A_NET_PTF_CCY AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.R_INTEREST AS "Interest Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY AS "Settl./SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE AS "Sec/SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY AS "Sec/Tax Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.ST AS "Operation Status"
FROM deals_key d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID_MASTER
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.INSTR_TYP
     LEFT JOIN ctry ON ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN optnat ON optnat.celem = d.C_OPT_NATURE
ORDER BY d.D_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF

fut_rk AS (

    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = f.C_N_ID),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = o.C_N_ID),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
deals_svc AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV_POSITION), ''),
                    CASE WHEN fu.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FU' WHEN op.C_N_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'OP' END,
                    NULLIF(TRIM(d.C_SRV), '')) AS SVC,
           fu.C_N_UNDERLYING AS FU_UND, fu.D_MATURITY AS FU_MAT, fu.C_FUT_CCY AS FU_CCY,
           op.C_N_UNDERLYING AS OP_UND, op.D_MATURITY AS OP_MAT, op.C_OPT_CCY AS OP_CCY, UPPER(TRIM(op.C_OPT_NATURE)) AS OP_NATURE
    FROM deals d LEFT JOIN fut fu ON fu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID LEFT JOIN opt op ON op.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID),
deals_key AS (
    SELECT t.*,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_UND WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_UND ELSE t.C_N_ID END AS C_N_ID_MASTER,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_MAT WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_MAT ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) END AS D_MATURITY,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_NATURE ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS C_OPT_NATURE,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'BO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'PO' THEN 'S' WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS INSTR_TYP,
           CASE t.SVC WHEN 'FU' THEN t.FU_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN t.OP_CCY ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS SEC_CCY_DERIV
    FROM deals_svc t),
master_ids AS (SELECT DISTINCT C_N_ID_MASTER AS C_N_ID FROM deals_key WHERE C_N_ID_MASTER IS NOT NULL),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_N_ID, m.L_NAME, m.C_SEC_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_N_ID ORDER BY m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER m INNER JOIN master_ids k ON k.C_N_ID = m.C_N_ID),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_SEC_CCY FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i INNER JOIN sec_ids s ON s.C_N_ID = i.C_N_ID
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11'),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
-- 3. libelles : pays et nature d'option (langue 2 d'abord, sinon toute langue)
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'OPT_NATURE')),
ctry AS (SELECT celem, L_LIBELLE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'COUNTRY'),
optnat AS (SELECT celem, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1 AND ctab = 'OPT_NATURE')
SELECT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    d.SVC AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code",
    d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.SVC
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(optnat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(TO_CHAR(d.D_MATURITY, 'dd/MM/yyyy'), '')
        WHEN 'BO' THEN sm.L_NAME WHEN 'PO' THEN sm.L_NAME
        ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(d.SEC_CCY_DERIV, sm.C_SEC_CCY, d.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm_own.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Accounting Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date",
    d.D_EXECUTION AS "Execution Date", d.D_PAYMENT AS "Payment Date",
    d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code", d.C_N_ACC AS "Account Number", d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "Entry Ptf",
    d.N_CONTRACT AS "Contract", d.L_DEAL AS "Description",
    d.SGN * d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity",
    d.A_UNIT_SEC_CCY AS "Price in Security Ccy", d.A_UNIT_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Price in Settlement Ccy",
    d.C_SETTLEMENT_CCY AS "Settlement Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_GROSS AS "Gross Amount",
    d.SGN * d.UNREC_TAX AS "Unrecoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.REC_TAX AS "Recoverable Tax", d.SGN * d.OTHER_TAX AS "Other Tax",
    d.SGN * d.A_FEE_COR AS "Fees in Security Ccy",
    d.SGN * d.A_NET AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.SGN * d.A_NET_PTF_CCY AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.R_INTEREST AS "Interest Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_PTF_CCY AS "Settl./SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.R_EXCHANGE_RATE AS "Sec/SubFund Ccy Exchange Rate", d.R_EXCHANGE_TAX_CCY AS "Sec/Tax Ccy Exchange Rate",
    d.ST AS "Operation Status"
FROM deals_key d
     INNER JOIN sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID_MASTER
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.INSTR_TYP
     LEFT JOIN ctry ON ctry.celem = sm_own.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN optnat ON optnat.celem = d.C_OPT_NATURE
ORDER BY d.D_ACC, d.N_ENTRY, d.N_ENTRY_PTF

fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,

    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
