           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, t.P_PRICE AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE, 0) END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0
                THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY_PTF, 0) + (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
           END AS AMT_PTF,
           COALESCE(t.A_FEES, 0) AS FEES, COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0) AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF,
           t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF, TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS UND_ID, t.C_N_ID AS MASTER_ID

    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280287') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280287' AND t.N_LOT > 8554978 AND t.N_LOT <= 8607153)) AND t.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET d
                  WHERE d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = TRIM(t.C_STATUS))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_FUT AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_FUTURE d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN fut fm ON fm.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280287') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280287' AND t.N_LOT > 8554978 AND t.N_LOT <= 8607153)) AND t.C_SRV = 'FU'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_PREMIUM AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_OPTION d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN opt om ON om.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280287') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280287' AND t.N_LOT > 8554978 AND t.N_LOT <= 8607153)) AND t.C_SRV = 'OP'
),
mvt_f AS (
    SELECT m.*, CASE m.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE 'S' END AS SRV_TYP FROM mvt m),
all_ids AS (SELECT C_N_ID FROM mvt_f UNION SELECT UND_ID FROM mvt_f WHERE UND_ID <> 0 UNION SELECT MASTER_ID FROM mvt_f),
sm_rk AS (

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.C_N_ID ORDER BY s.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER s WHERE s.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY, C_SEC_TYP FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'SOF_TYP', 'OPE', 'OPT_NATURE')),
msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navd AS (
    SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS D_NAV FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l
    WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280287') GROUP BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT)
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy", d.C_SRV AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code", d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.C_SRV
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fut.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(nat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM opt.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        ELSE sm_own.L_NAME END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(CASE d.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN fut.C_FUT_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN opt.C_OPT_CCY ELSE sm_own.C_SEC_CCY END, sm_own.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",

    d.D_ACC AS "Acc. Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date", d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code",
    d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", CASE WHEN d.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO') THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE d.N_CONTRACT END AS "Contract",
    d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity", d.PRICE AS "Price in Security Ccy",
    d.AMT AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.AMT_PTF AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.FEES AS "Fees in Security Ccy", d.FEES_PTF AS "Fees in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_INTEREST AS "Interest in Security Ccy", d.A_INTEREST_PTF AS "Interest in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_PNL AS "Realized in Security Ccy", d.A_PNL_PTF AS "Realized in SubFund Ccy", d.ST AS "Operation Status",
    d.UND_ID AS "Underlying Internal Fa Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN SUBSTR(isin_u.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) END AS "Underlying Isin Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.L_NAME END AS "Underlying Name",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.C_SEC_CCY END AS "Underlying Ccy",
    sm.C_SEC_TYP AS "Security Type Code", styp.L_LIBELLE AS "Security Type Name", ope.L_LIBELLE AS "Description",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS BBG, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS UND_BBG, nv.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "_EP"
FROM mvt_f d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.MASTER_ID
     LEFT JOIN sm sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fut ON fut.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'FU'
     LEFT JOIN opt ON opt.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'OP'
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN isin isin_u ON isin_u.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND isin_u.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN msg ctry ON ctry.ctab = 'COUNTRY' AND ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT
) z
ORDER BY "SubFund Number", "Entry", "Acc. Date", "_EP"

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
mvt AS (

           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE, 0) END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0
                THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY_PTF, 0) + (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
           END AS AMT_PTF,
           COALESCE(t.A_FEES, 0) AS FEES, COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0) AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF,
           t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF, TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS UND_ID, t.C_N_ID AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t

      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET d
                  WHERE d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = TRIM(t.C_STATUS))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_FUT AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_FUTURE d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN fut fm ON fm.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280287') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280287' AND t.N_LOT > 8554978 AND t.N_LOT <= 8607153)) AND t.C_SRV = 'FU'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_PREMIUM AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_OPTION d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN opt om ON om.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280287') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280287' AND t.N_LOT > 8554978 AND t.N_LOT <= 8607153)) AND t.C_SRV = 'OP'
),
mvt_f AS (
    SELECT m.*, CASE m.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE 'S' END AS SRV_TYP FROM mvt m),
all_ids AS (SELECT C_N_ID FROM mvt_f UNION SELECT UND_ID FROM mvt_f WHERE UND_ID <> 0 UNION SELECT MASTER_ID FROM mvt_f),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT s.C_N_ID, s.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(s.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, s.C_SEC_CCY, s.C_SEC_TYP,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.C_N_ID ORDER BY s.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER s WHERE s.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY, C_SEC_TYP FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11' AND i.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'SOF_TYP', 'OPE', 'OPT_NATURE')),
msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navd AS (
    SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS D_NAV FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l
    WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280287') GROUP BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT)
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy", d.C_SRV AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code", d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.C_SRV
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fut.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(nat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM opt.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        ELSE sm_own.L_NAME END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(CASE d.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN fut.C_FUT_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN opt.C_OPT_CCY ELSE sm_own.C_SEC_CCY END, sm_own.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Acc. Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date", d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code",
    d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", CASE WHEN d.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO') THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE d.N_CONTRACT END AS "Contract",
    d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity", d.PRICE AS "Price in Security Ccy",
    d.AMT AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.AMT_PTF AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.FEES AS "Fees in Security Ccy", d.FEES_PTF AS "Fees in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_INTEREST AS "Interest in Security Ccy", d.A_INTEREST_PTF AS "Interest in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_PNL AS "Realized in Security Ccy", d.A_PNL_PTF AS "Realized in SubFund Ccy", d.ST AS "Operation Status",
    d.UND_ID AS "Underlying Internal Fa Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN SUBSTR(isin_u.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) END AS "Underlying Isin Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.L_NAME END AS "Underlying Name",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.C_SEC_CCY END AS "Underlying Ccy",
    sm.C_SEC_TYP AS "Security Type Code", styp.L_LIBELLE AS "Security Type Name", ope.L_LIBELLE AS "Description",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Bloomberg Code", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Underlying Bloomberg Code", nv.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "_EP"
FROM mvt_f d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.MASTER_ID
     LEFT JOIN sm sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fut ON fut.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'FU'
     LEFT JOIN opt ON opt.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'OP'
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN isin isin_u ON isin_u.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND isin_u.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN msg ctry ON ctry.ctab = 'COUNTRY' AND ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT
) z
ORDER BY "SubFund Number", "Entry", "Acc. Date", "_EP"

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),

    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,

    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o),

           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, t.P_PRICE AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE, 0) END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0
                THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY_PTF, 0) + (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
           END AS AMT_PTF,
           COALESCE(t.A_FEES, 0) AS FEES, COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0) AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF,
           t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF, TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS UND_ID, t.C_N_ID AS MASTER_ID

      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET d
                  WHERE d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = TRIM(t.C_STATUS))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_FUT AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_FUTURE d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN fut fm ON fm.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280287') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280287' AND t.N_LOT > 8554978 AND t.N_LOT <= 8607153)) AND t.C_SRV = 'FU'
    UNION ALL

                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID

    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280287') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280287' AND t.N_LOT > 8554978 AND t.N_LOT <= 8607153)) AND t.C_SRV = 'OP'

    tk.TICKER AS "Bloomberg Code", tku.TICKER AS "Underlying Bloomberg Code", nv.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "_EP"
FROM mvt_f d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.MASTER_ID
     LEFT JOIN sm sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fut ON fut.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'FU'
     LEFT JOIN opt ON opt.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'OP'
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN isin isin_u ON isin_u.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND isin_u.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN msg ctry ON ctry.ctab = 'COUNTRY' AND ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT
     LEFT JOIN puid pu  ON pu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND pu.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN tick tk  ON tk.CODE_PUID = pu.G_ID_VALUE
     LEFT JOIN puid puu ON puu.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND puu.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN tick tku ON tku.CODE_PUID = puu.G_ID_VALUE
) z
ORDER BY "SubFund Number", "Entry", "Acc. Date", "_EP"

),
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (

opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),

           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, t.P_PRICE AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE, 0) END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0
                THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY_PTF, 0) + (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
           END AS AMT_PTF,
           COALESCE(t.A_FEES, 0) AS FEES, COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0) AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF,
           t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF, TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS UND_ID, t.C_N_ID AS MASTER_ID

      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET d
                  WHERE d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = TRIM(t.C_STATUS))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_FUT AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_FUTURE d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN fut fm ON fm.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID

    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_PREMIUM AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,

    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_OPTION d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.C_N_ID ORDER BY s.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER s WHERE s.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY, C_SEC_TYP FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i

msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'SOF_TYP', 'OPE', 'OPT_NATURE')),
msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navd AS (
    SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS D_NAV FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l
    WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280287') GROUP BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT),
puid_rk AS (

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '24' AND i.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
puid AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM puid_rk WHERE rn = 1),
tick AS (
    SELECT CODE_PUID, MIN(C_BLOOMBERG_CODE) AS TICKER
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CODE_PUID, C_BLOOMBERG_CODE FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.FUND_PTF_CONSO WHERE LENGTH(C_BLOOMBERG_CODE) > 0)
    GROUP BY CODE_PUID HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy", d.C_SRV AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code", d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.C_SRV
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fut.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(nat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM opt.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        ELSE sm_own.L_NAME END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(CASE d.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN fut.C_FUT_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN opt.C_OPT_CCY ELSE sm_own.C_SEC_CCY END, sm_own.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",

    d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", CASE WHEN d.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO') THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE d.N_CONTRACT END AS "Contract",

    d.AMT AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.AMT_PTF AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",

    SELECT s.C_N_ID, s.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(s.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, s.C_SEC_CCY, s.C_SEC_TYP,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.C_N_ID ORDER BY s.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER s WHERE s.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY, C_SEC_TYP FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11' AND i.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'SOF_TYP', 'OPE', 'OPT_NATURE')),
msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navd AS (
    SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS D_NAV FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l
    WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280287') GROUP BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT),
puid_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '24' AND i.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
puid AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM puid_rk WHERE rn = 1),
tick AS (
    SELECT CODE_PUID, MIN(C_BLOOMBERG_CODE) AS TICKER
    FROM (SELECT CODE_PUID, C_BLOOMBERG_CODE FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.FUND_PTF_CONSO WHERE LENGTH(C_BLOOMBERG_CODE) > 0
          UNION
          SELECT UNDERLYING_CODE_PUID, UNDERLYING_CODE_BLOOMBERG FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.FUND_PTF_CONSO WHERE LENGTH(UNDERLYING_CODE_BLOOMBERG) > 0)
    GROUP BY CODE_PUID HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy", d.C_SRV AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code", d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.C_SRV
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fut.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(nat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM opt.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        ELSE sm_own.L_NAME END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(CASE d.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN fut.C_FUT_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN opt.C_OPT_CCY ELSE sm_own.C_SEC_CCY END, sm_own.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Acc. Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date", d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code",
    d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", CASE WHEN d.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO') THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE d.N_CONTRACT END AS "Contract",
    d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity", d.PRICE AS "Price in Security Ccy",
    d.AMT AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.AMT_PTF AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.FEES AS "Fees in Security Ccy", d.FEES_PTF AS "Fees in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_INTEREST AS "Interest in Security Ccy", d.A_INTEREST_PTF AS "Interest in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_PNL AS "Realized in Security Ccy", d.A_PNL_PTF AS "Realized in SubFund Ccy", d.ST AS "Operation Status",
    d.UND_ID AS "Underlying Internal Fa Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN SUBSTR(isin_u.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) END AS "Underlying Isin Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.L_NAME END AS "Underlying Name",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.C_SEC_CCY END AS "Underlying Ccy",
    sm.C_SEC_TYP AS "Security Type Code", styp.L_LIBELLE AS "Security Type Name", ope.L_LIBELLE AS "Description",
    tk.TICKER AS "Bloomberg Code", tku.TICKER AS "Underlying Bloomberg Code", nv.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "_EP"
FROM mvt_f d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.MASTER_ID
     LEFT JOIN sm sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fut ON fut.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'FU'
     LEFT JOIN opt ON opt.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'OP'
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN isin isin_u ON isin_u.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND isin_u.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN msg ctry ON ctry.ctab = 'COUNTRY' AND ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT
     LEFT JOIN puid pu  ON pu.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND pu.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN tick tk  ON tk.CODE_PUID = pu.G_ID_VALUE
     LEFT JOIN puid puu ON puu.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND puu.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN tick tku ON tku.CODE_PUID = puu.G_ID_VALUE
) z
ORDER BY "SubFund Number", "Entry", "Acc. Date", "_EP"

WITH fund_ref_rk AS (
  SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p
  WHERE p.C_FUND IN ('280376', '447064', '531736', '531737', '541842')
),
fund_ref AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM fund_ref_rk WHERE rn = 1),
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
mvt AS (
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, t.P_PRICE AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE, 0) END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0
                THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY_PTF, 0) + (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
           END AS AMT_PTF,
           COALESCE(t.A_FEES, 0) AS FEES, COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0) AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF,
           t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF, TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS UND_ID, t.C_N_ID AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280376', '447064', '531736', '531737', '541842') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280376' AND t.N_LOT > 8505799 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606033) OR (t.C_FUND = '447064' AND t.N_LOT > 8505819 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606049) OR (t.C_FUND = '531736' AND t.N_LOT > 8505847 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606065) OR (t.C_FUND = '531737' AND t.N_LOT > 8505849 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606067) OR (t.C_FUND = '541842' AND t.N_LOT > 8505871 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606079)) AND t.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET d
                  WHERE d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = TRIM(t.C_STATUS))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_FUT AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_FUTURE d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN fut fm ON fm.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280376', '447064', '531736', '531737', '541842') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280376' AND t.N_LOT > 8505799 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606033) OR (t.C_FUND = '447064' AND t.N_LOT > 8505819 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606049) OR (t.C_FUND = '531736' AND t.N_LOT > 8505847 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606065) OR (t.C_FUND = '531737' AND t.N_LOT > 8505849 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606067) OR (t.C_FUND = '541842' AND t.N_LOT > 8505871 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606079)) AND t.C_SRV = 'FU'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_PREMIUM AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_OPTION d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN opt om ON om.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280376', '447064', '531736', '531737', '541842') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280376' AND t.N_LOT > 8505799 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606033) OR (t.C_FUND = '447064' AND t.N_LOT > 8505819 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606049) OR (t.C_FUND = '531736' AND t.N_LOT > 8505847 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606065) OR (t.C_FUND = '531737' AND t.N_LOT > 8505849 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606067) OR (t.C_FUND = '541842' AND t.N_LOT > 8505871 AND t.N_LOT <= 8606079)) AND t.C_SRV = 'OP'
),
mvt_f AS (
    SELECT m.*, CASE m.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE 'S' END AS SRV_TYP FROM mvt m),
all_ids AS (SELECT C_N_ID FROM mvt_f UNION SELECT UND_ID FROM mvt_f WHERE UND_ID <> 0 UNION SELECT MASTER_ID FROM mvt_f),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT s.C_N_ID, s.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(s.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, s.C_SEC_CCY, s.C_SEC_TYP,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.C_N_ID ORDER BY s.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER s WHERE s.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY, C_SEC_TYP FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,

    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i

isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
msg_rk AS (

msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navd AS (

     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))

                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)

),

    SELECT m.*, CASE m.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE 'S' END AS SRV_TYP FROM mvt m),

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.C_N_ID ORDER BY s.N_LOT DESC) AS rn

sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY, C_SEC_TYP FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn

                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'SOF_TYP', 'OPE', 'OPT_NATURE')),
msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),

    SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS D_NAV FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l
    WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280376', '447064', '531736', '531737', '541842') GROUP BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT)

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy", d.C_SRV AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code", d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.C_SRV
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fut.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(nat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM opt.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        ELSE sm_own.L_NAME END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(CASE d.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN fut.C_FUT_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN opt.C_OPT_CCY ELSE sm_own.C_SEC_CCY END, sm_own.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Acc. Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date", d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code",
    d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", CASE WHEN d.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO') THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE d.N_CONTRACT END AS "Contract",
    d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity", d.PRICE AS "Price in Security Ccy",
    d.AMT AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.AMT_PTF AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.FEES AS "Fees in Security Ccy", d.FEES_PTF AS "Fees in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_INTEREST AS "Interest in Security Ccy", d.A_INTEREST_PTF AS "Interest in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_PNL AS "Realized in Security Ccy", d.A_PNL_PTF AS "Realized in SubFund Ccy", d.ST AS "Operation Status",
    d.UND_ID AS "Underlying Internal Fa Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN SUBSTR(isin_u.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) END AS "Underlying Isin Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.L_NAME END AS "Underlying Name",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.C_SEC_CCY END AS "Underlying Ccy",
    sm.C_SEC_TYP AS "Security Type Code", styp.L_LIBELLE AS "Security Type Name", ope.L_LIBELLE AS "Description",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Bloomberg Code", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Underlying Bloomberg Code", nv.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "_EP"
FROM mvt_f d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.MASTER_ID
     LEFT JOIN sm sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fut ON fut.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'FU'
     LEFT JOIN opt ON opt.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'OP'
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN isin isin_u ON isin_u.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND isin_u.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN msg ctry ON ctry.ctab = 'COUNTRY' AND ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT
) z
ORDER BY "SubFund Number", "Entry", "Acc. Date", "_EP"

WITH fund_ref_rk AS (
  SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p
  WHERE p.C_FUND IN ('280421')
),
fund_ref AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM fund_ref_rk WHERE rn = 1),
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
mvt AS (
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, t.P_PRICE AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE, 0) END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0
                THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY_PTF, 0) + (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
           END AS AMT_PTF,
           COALESCE(t.A_FEES, 0) AS FEES, COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0) AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF,
           t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF, TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS UND_ID, t.C_N_ID AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280421') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280421' AND t.N_LOT > 8736356 AND t.N_LOT <= 8762284)) AND t.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET d
                  WHERE d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = TRIM(t.C_STATUS))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_FUT AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_FUTURE d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN fut fm ON fm.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280421') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280421' AND t.N_LOT > 8736356 AND t.N_LOT <= 8762284)) AND t.C_SRV = 'FU'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_PREMIUM AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_OPTION d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN opt om ON om.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280421') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280421' AND t.N_LOT > 8736356 AND t.N_LOT <= 8762284)) AND t.C_SRV = 'OP'
),
mvt_f AS (
    SELECT m.*, CASE m.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE 'S' END AS SRV_TYP FROM mvt m),
all_ids AS (SELECT C_N_ID FROM mvt_f UNION SELECT UND_ID FROM mvt_f WHERE UND_ID <> 0 UNION SELECT MASTER_ID FROM mvt_f),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT s.C_N_ID, s.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(s.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, s.C_SEC_CCY, s.C_SEC_TYP,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.C_N_ID ORDER BY s.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER s WHERE s.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY, C_SEC_TYP FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn

msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'SOF_TYP', 'OPE', 'OPT_NATURE')),
msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navd AS (

    WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280421') GROUP BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT)

     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.MASTER_ID
     LEFT JOIN sm sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID

     LEFT JOIN msg ctry ON ctry.ctab = 'COUNTRY' AND ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT

ORDER BY "SubFund Number", "Entry", "Acc. Date", "_EP"

    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g

msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navd AS (

    WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280299') GROUP BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT)

    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy", d.C_SRV AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code", d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.C_SRV
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fut.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.'         WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(nat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM opt.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        ELSE sm_own.L_NAME END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(CASE d.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN fut.C_FUT_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN opt.C_OPT_CCY ELSE sm_own.C_SEC_CCY END, sm_own.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",

    d.FEES AS "Fees in Security Ccy", d.FEES_PTF AS "Fees in SubFund Ccy",

     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT

WITH fund_ref_rk AS (
  SELECT p.C_FUND, p.L_FUND, p.C_CCY,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p
  WHERE p.C_FUND IN ('812645')

fund_ref AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM fund_ref_rk WHERE rn = 1),
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
mvt AS (
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, t.P_PRICE AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE, 0) END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0
                THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY_PTF, 0) + (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
           END AS AMT_PTF,
           COALESCE(t.A_FEES, 0) AS FEES, COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0) AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF,
           t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF, TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS UND_ID, t.C_N_ID AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('812645') AND ((t.C_FUND = '812645' AND t.N_LOT > 8145063 AND t.N_LOT <= 8639394)) AND t.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET d
                  WHERE d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = TRIM(t.C_STATUS))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_FUT AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_FUTURE d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN fut fm ON fm.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('812645') AND ((t.C_FUND = '812645' AND t.N_LOT > 8145063 AND t.N_LOT <= 8639394)) AND t.C_SRV = 'FU'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,

           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,

    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t

                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID

    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('812645') AND ((t.C_FUND = '812645' AND t.N_LOT > 8145063 AND t.N_LOT <= 8639394)) AND t.C_SRV = 'OP'
),

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.C_FUND ORDER BY p.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_PORTFOLIO p
  WHERE p.C_FUND IN ('280299')
),
fund_ref AS (SELECT C_FUND, L_FUND, C_CCY FROM fund_ref_rk WHERE rn = 1),
fut_rk AS (
    SELECT f.C_N_ID, f.C_N_UNDERLYING, f.D_MATURITY, f.C_FUT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.C_N_ID ORDER BY f.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_FUTURES_MASTER f),
fut AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_FUT_CCY FROM fut_rk WHERE rn = 1),
opt_rk AS (
    SELECT o.C_N_ID, o.C_N_UNDERLYING, o.D_MATURITY, o.C_OPT_NATURE, o.C_OPT_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.C_N_ID ORDER BY o.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_OPTIONS_MASTER o),
opt AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_N_UNDERLYING, D_MATURITY, C_OPT_NATURE, C_OPT_CCY FROM opt_rk WHERE rn = 1),
mvt AS (
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, t.P_PRICE AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0 THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE, 0) END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY, 0) <> 0
                THEN COALESCE(t.A_BUY_PTF, 0) + (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
                ELSE COALESCE(t.A_SALE_PTF, 0) - (CASE WHEN TRIM(t.C_STATUS) = '20' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) * COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0)
           END AS AMT_PTF,
           COALESCE(t.A_FEES, 0) AS FEES, COALESCE(t.A_FEES_PTF, 0) AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF,
           t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF, TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS UND_ID, t.C_N_ID AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280299') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280299' AND t.N_LOT > 8553816 AND t.N_LOT <= 8776480)) AND t.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_STOCK_MARKET d
                  WHERE d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY AND TRIM(d.C_STATUS) = TRIM(t.C_STATUS))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_FUT AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE = 310 THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, fm.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_FUTURE d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN fut fm ON fm.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280299') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280299' AND t.N_LOT > 8553816 AND t.N_LOT <= 8776480)) AND t.C_SRV = 'FU'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.C_FUND, t.C_SRV, t.C_N_ID, t.N_LOT, t.D_ACC, t.D_TRADE, t.D_VALUE, t.C_OPE, t.N_ENTRY, t.N_ENTRY_PTF,
           t.N_CONTRACT, t.Q_QTY, d.P_PREMIUM AS PRICE,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY ELSE t.A_SALE END AS AMT,
           CASE WHEN t.C_OPE IN (300, 307) THEN t.A_BUY_PTF ELSE t.A_SALE_PTF END AS AMT_PTF,
           t.A_FEES AS FEES, t.A_FEES_PTF AS FEES_PTF, t.A_INTEREST, t.A_INTEREST_PTF, t.A_PNL, t.A_PNL_PTF,
           TRIM(t.C_STATUS) AS ST, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS UND_ID, om.C_N_UNDERLYING AS MASTER_ID
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MVT t
         INNER JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_DEAL_OPTION d
                 ON d.C_FUND = t.C_FUND AND d.N_LOT = t.N_LOT AND d.C_SRV = t.C_SRV AND d.N_ENTRY = t.N_ENTRY
                AND d.N_ENTRY_PTF = t.N_ENTRY_PTF AND d.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
         INNER JOIN opt om ON om.C_N_ID = t.C_N_ID
    WHERE t.C_FUND IN ('280299') AND ((t.C_FUND = '280299' AND t.N_LOT > 8553816 AND t.N_LOT <= 8776480)) AND t.C_SRV = 'OP'
),
mvt_f AS (
    SELECT m.*, CASE m.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN 'F' WHEN 'OP' THEN 'O' ELSE 'S' END AS SRV_TYP FROM mvt m),
all_ids AS (SELECT C_N_ID FROM mvt_f UNION SELECT UND_ID FROM mvt_f WHERE UND_ID <> 0 UNION SELECT MASTER_ID FROM mvt_f),
sm_rk AS (
    SELECT s.C_N_ID, s.L_NAME, UPPER(TRIM(s.C_COUNTRY)) AS C_COUNTRY, s.C_SEC_CCY, s.C_SEC_TYP,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.C_N_ID ORDER BY s.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_MASTER s WHERE s.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
sm AS (SELECT C_N_ID, L_NAME, C_COUNTRY, C_SEC_CCY, C_SEC_TYP FROM sm_rk WHERE rn = 1),
isin_rk AS (
    SELECT i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, i.G_ID_VALUE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.C_N_ID, i.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP ORDER BY i.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_SECURITIES_INTL_ID i
    WHERE i.C_ID_TYP = '11' AND i.C_N_ID IN (SELECT C_N_ID FROM all_ids)),
isin AS (SELECT C_N_ID, C_INSTRUMENT_TYP, G_ID_VALUE FROM isin_rk WHERE rn = 1),
msg_rk AS (
    SELECT UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) AS ctab, UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT)) AS celem, g.L_LIBELLE, g.L_ABREGE,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)), UPPER(TRIM(g.C_ELEMENT))
                              ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(g.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_MESSAGE g
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(g.C_TABLE)) IN ('COUNTRY', 'SOF_TYP', 'OPE', 'OPT_NATURE')),
msg AS (SELECT ctab, celem, L_LIBELLE, L_ABREGE FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navd AS (
    SELECT l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT, MAX(l.D_NAV) AS D_NAV FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT l
    WHERE l.C_FUND IN ('280299') GROUP BY l.C_FUND, l.N_LOT)
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy", d.C_SRV AS "Service Code",
    SUBSTR(isin.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) AS "Isin Code", d.C_N_ID AS "Internal Fa Code",
    CASE d.C_SRV
        WHEN 'FU' THEN COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fut.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fut.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        WHEN 'OP' THEN COALESCE(nat.L_ABREGE, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sm.L_NAME, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-' || CASE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM opt.D_MATURITY) WHEN 1 THEN 'JANV.' WHEN 2 THEN 'FÃ‰VR.' WHEN 3 THEN 'MARS ' WHEN 4 THEN 'AVR. ' WHEN 5 THEN 'MAI  ' WHEN 6 THEN 'JUIN ' WHEN 7 THEN 'JUIL.' WHEN 8 THEN 'AOÃ›T ' WHEN 9 THEN 'SEPT.' WHEN 10 THEN 'OCT. ' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        ELSE sm_own.L_NAME END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(CASE d.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN fut.C_FUT_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN opt.C_OPT_CCY ELSE sm_own.C_SEC_CCY END, sm_own.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Acc. Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date", d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code",
    d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", CASE WHEN d.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO') THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE d.N_CONTRACT END AS "Contract",
    d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity", d.PRICE AS "Price in Security Ccy",
    d.AMT AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.AMT_PTF AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.FEES AS "Fees in Security Ccy", d.FEES_PTF AS "Fees in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_INTEREST AS "Interest in Security Ccy", d.A_INTEREST_PTF AS "Interest in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_PNL AS "Realized in Security Ccy", d.A_PNL_PTF AS "Realized in SubFund Ccy", d.ST AS "Operation Status",
    d.UND_ID AS "Underlying Internal Fa Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN SUBSTR(isin_u.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) END AS "Underlying Isin Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.L_NAME END AS "Underlying Name",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.C_SEC_CCY END AS "Underlying Ccy",
    sm.C_SEC_TYP AS "Security Type Code", styp.L_LIBELLE AS "Security Type Name", ope.L_LIBELLE AS "Description",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Bloomberg Code", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Underlying Bloomberg Code", nv.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "_EP"
FROM mvt_f d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.MASTER_ID
     LEFT JOIN sm sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fut ON fut.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'FU'
     LEFT JOIN opt ON opt.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'OP'
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN isin isin_u ON isin_u.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND isin_u.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN msg ctry ON ctry.ctab = 'COUNTRY' AND ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT
) z
ORDER BY "SubFund Number", "Entry", "Acc. Date", "_EP"

' WHEN 11 THEN 'NOV. ' WHEN 12 THEN 'DÃ‰C. ' END || '-' || SUBSTR(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM opt.D_MATURITY) AS VARCHAR), 3, 2), '')
        ELSE sm_own.L_NAME END AS "Security Name",
    COALESCE(CASE d.C_SRV WHEN 'FU' THEN fut.C_FUT_CCY WHEN 'OP' THEN opt.C_OPT_CCY ELSE sm_own.C_SEC_CCY END, sm_own.C_SEC_CCY) AS "Security Ccy",
    sm.C_COUNTRY AS "Country Code", ctry.L_LIBELLE AS "Country Name",
    d.D_ACC AS "Acc. Date", d.D_TRADE AS "Trade Date", d.D_VALUE AS "Value Date", d.C_OPE AS "Operation Code",
    d.N_ENTRY AS "Entry", CASE WHEN d.C_SRV IN ('BO', 'PO') THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE d.N_CONTRACT END AS "Contract",
    d.Q_QTY AS "Quantity", d.PRICE AS "Price in Security Ccy",
    d.AMT AS "Net Amount in Security Ccy", d.AMT_PTF AS "Net Amound in SubFund Ccy",
    d.FEES AS "Fees in Security Ccy", d.FEES_PTF AS "Fees in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_INTEREST AS "Interest in Security Ccy", d.A_INTEREST_PTF AS "Interest in SubFund Ccy",
    d.A_PNL AS "Realized in Security Ccy", d.A_PNL_PTF AS "Realized in SubFund Ccy", d.ST AS "Operation Status",
    d.UND_ID AS "Underlying Internal Fa Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN SUBSTR(isin_u.G_ID_VALUE, 1, 12) END AS "Underlying Isin Code",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.L_NAME END AS "Underlying Name",
    CASE WHEN d.UND_ID <> 0 THEN sm.C_SEC_CCY END AS "Underlying Ccy",
    sm.C_SEC_TYP AS "Security Type Code", styp.L_LIBELLE AS "Security Type Name", ope.L_LIBELLE AS "Description",
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Bloomberg Code", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS "Underlying Bloomberg Code", nv.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", d.N_ENTRY_PTF AS "_EP"
FROM mvt_f d
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = d.C_FUND
     LEFT JOIN sm ON sm.C_N_ID = d.MASTER_ID
     LEFT JOIN sm sm_own ON sm_own.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID
     LEFT JOIN fut ON fut.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'FU'
     LEFT JOIN opt ON opt.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND d.C_SRV = 'OP'
     LEFT JOIN isin ON isin.C_N_ID = d.C_N_ID AND isin.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = d.SRV_TYP
     LEFT JOIN isin isin_u ON isin_u.C_N_ID = d.UND_ID AND isin_u.C_INSTRUMENT_TYP = 'S'
     LEFT JOIN msg ctry ON ctry.ctab = 'COUNTRY' AND ctry.celem = sm.C_COUNTRY
     LEFT JOIN msg styp ON styp.ctab = 'SOF_TYP' AND styp.celem = UPPER(TRIM(sm.C_SEC_TYP))
     LEFT JOIN msg ope ON ope.ctab = 'OPE' AND ope.celem = UPPER(TRIM(CAST(d.C_OPE AS VARCHAR)))
     LEFT JOIN msg nat ON nat.ctab = 'OPT_NATURE' AND nat.celem = UPPER(TRIM(opt.C_OPT_NATURE))
     LEFT JOIN navd nv ON nv.C_FUND = d.C_FUND AND nv.N_LOT = d.N_LOT
) z
ORDER BY "SubFund Number", "Entry", "Acc. Date", "_EP"

WITH msg_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_TABLE AS T, m.C_ELEMENT AS E, m.L_LIBELLE AS L, m.L_ABREGE AS A,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_TABLE, m.C_ELEMENT ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(m.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_MESSAGE m WHERE m.C_TABLE IN ('COPER', 'TCOMM', 'COUNTRY', 'TYPREG', 'CDELIV')),
msg AS (SELECT T, E, L, A FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
reg_rk AS (
    SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.C_N_REGISTER ORDER BY r.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER r),
cli_rk AS (
    SELECT c.C_N_CLIENT, c.L_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.C_N_CLIENT ORDER BY c.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_CLIENT c),
reg AS (
    SELECT r.C_N_REGISTER, SUBSTR(TRIM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')) THEN COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')
                                            ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, ''), ' ', COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) END), 1, 40) AS L_NAME, r.C_N_OUTLET, r.C_N_CLIENT, TRIM(c.L_NAME) AS CLIENT_NAME, r.C_REGISTER_TYP, r.C_GROUP_TYP,
           r.C_PERSON_TYP, r.C_REG_TYP, r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP, r.C_RESIDENCE, r.C_CITY, r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE, r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL,
           r.D_CREATED, r.D_UPDATED, r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE
    FROM reg_rk r INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM cli_rk WHERE rn = 1) c ON c.C_N_CLIENT = r.C_N_CLIENT
    WHERE r.rn = 1),
ta_funds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TA_NUM FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN WHERE FA_NUM IN ('280273', '280274') AND TA_NUM IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT b.TA_NUM FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN b WHERE b.FA_NUM IN (SELECT FA_NUM_IN_TA FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN WHERE FA_NUM IN ('280273', '280274') AND FA_NUM_IN_TA IS NOT NULL)
      AND b.TA_NUM IS NOT NULL),
tf_rk AS (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.ISIN_CODE ORDER BY f.D_ACTIVATION DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN f),
tf AS (SELECT * FROM tf_rk WHERE rn = 1),
delay_rk AS (
    SELECT v.C_FUND, v.C_OPE, v.N_DAYS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.C_FUND, v.C_OPE ORDER BY v.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE v),
delay AS (SELECT C_FUND, C_OPE, N_DAYS FROM delay_rk WHERE rn = 1),
x AS (
    SELECT t.*, tf.FA_NUM AS TF_FA_NUM, tf.FUND_NAME AS TF_FUND_NAME, rb.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE, rb.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON,
           rb.FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT, rb.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE, rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE, rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON,
           rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT, rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE,
           CASE WHEN t.OPT_OP_DATE >= rb.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR t.OPT_OP_DATE < rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_FULL,
           CASE WHEN t.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '04' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS SGN
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.OP_TA t
         JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED rb ON rb.REGISTER_NUMBER = t.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO
         JOIN tf ON tf.ISIN_CODE = t.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN
    WHERE t.OPT_OP_DATE >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND t.OPT_OP_DATE <= DATE '2026-07-06'
      AND t.OPT_NPTF IN (SELECT TA_NUM FROM ta_funds)
      AND t.OPT_TYPE_LOG IN ('03', '04')  
      AND ((t.OPT_OP_DATE >= rb.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR t.OPT_OP_DATE < rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)) OR (t.OPT_OP_DATE >= rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR t.OPT_OP_DATE < rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE))
           OR (rb.FUNDS_BLOCKED = tf.STRUCTURE_NUM AND (t.OPT_OP_DATE >= rb.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR t.OPT_OP_DATE < rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)))
           OR (rb.FUNDS_BLOCKED = tf.STRUCTURE_NUM AND (t.OPT_OP_DATE >= rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR t.OPT_OP_DATE < rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)))))
SELECT
    x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO AS "Register Number", r.L_NAME AS "Register Name", r.C_RESIDENCE AS "Register Residence Code",
    m_res.L AS "Register Residence Name", r.C_CITY AS "Register City Code", m_cit.L AS "Register City Name",
    r.C_REGISTER_TYP AS "Register Type", m_typ.L AS "Register Type Name", x.OPT_NPTF AS "TA Number", x.TF_FA_NUM AS "FA Number",
    x.TF_FUND_NAME AS "Fund Name", x.OPT_FUNDS_CCY AS "Fund Ccy", x.OPT_TPART AS "Part", x.OPT_QUOT_CCY AS "Part Ccy",
    x.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN AS "Isin Code", x.OPT_INPUT_DATE AS "Input Date", x.OPT_OP_DATE AS "Oper Date", x.OPT_VALUE_DATE AS "Value Date",
    x.OPT_OP_CODE AS "Ope Code", m_ope.L AS "Ope Code Name", x.SGN * x.OPT_QUANTITY AS "Quantity",
    x.SGN * x.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ AS "Gross Amount", x.SGN * x.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ AS "Net Amount", x.SGN * x.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ AS "Commission",
    x.OPT_EXT_CODE AS "Reversal Code", x.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN AS "STP Reference",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "STP Flag",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "Clearing Flag",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO END AS "Clearing Regiter Number",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE r.L_NAME END AS "Clearing Regiter Name",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE x.OPT_NREGISTER_ACC_NO END AS "Clearing Account",
    x.OPT_OP_NUM_TA AS "Operation Ta Number", x.OPT_OUTLET_NO AS "Outlet Number", x.OPT_TYPE_LOG AS "Log Type", x.OPT_PRICE AS "Price",
    x.OPT_PRICE_FUNDS_CCY AS "Price Fund Ccy", dl.N_DAYS AS "Operation Code Nb Days Value", x.IS_FULL AS "Full Blocked",
    CASE WHEN x.IS_FULL = 'Y' THEN x.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE ELSE x.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE END AS "Blocked Reason Code",
    CASE WHEN x.IS_FULL = 'Y' THEN x.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON ELSE x.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON END AS "Blocked Reason",
    CASE WHEN x.IS_FULL = 'Y' THEN x.FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT ELSE x.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT END AS "Blocked Comment",
    CAST(CASE WHEN x.IS_FULL = 'Y' THEN x.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE ELSE x.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE END AS DATE) AS "Blocked Date",
    r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE AS "Custody Settlement Code", m_cus.L AS "Custody Settlement Description"
FROM x
     JOIN reg r ON r.C_N_REGISTER = x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO
     LEFT JOIN delay dl ON dl.C_FUND = x.OPT_NPTF AND dl.C_OPE = x.OPT_OP_CODE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_res ON m_res.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_res.E = r.C_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_cit ON m_cit.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_cit.E = r.C_CITY
     LEFT JOIN msg m_typ ON m_typ.T = 'TYPREG'  AND m_typ.E = r.C_REGISTER_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m_ope ON m_ope.T = 'COPER'   AND m_ope.E = x.OPT_OP_CODE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_cus ON m_cus.T = 'CDELIV'  AND m_cus.E = r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE
ORDER BY x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO, x.OPT_OP_DATE, x.OPT_OP_NUM_TA, x.OPT_TYPE_LOG

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\out\ta_positions_isin_20261027_174335\sql\main_direct.sql =====
WITH fonds AS (SELECT DISTINCT FA_NUM FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN WHERE FA_NUM IN ('280274')),
navs AS (
    SELECT n.NAV_FUND_NO, n.NAV_DATE_NAV, CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) AS D_CALC, CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE) AS D_PUB,
           LAG(n.NAV_DATE_NAV) OVER (PARTITION BY n.NAV_FUND_NO ORDER BY n.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS D_PREV
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV n WHERE n.NAV_TYP_TRT = 'O'),
navs_ok AS (SELECT * FROM navs WHERE D_PREV IS NOT NULL OR D_CALC IS NOT NULL),
nav_fund AS (
    SELECT n.NAV_FUND_NO, n.NAV_DATE_NAV, n.D_CALC, n.D_PUB, n.D_PREV,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.NAV_FUND_NO ORDER BY n.NAV_DATE_NAV DESC) AS rn
    FROM navs_ok n WHERE CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV AS DATE) <= DATE '2026-06-30'),
nf AS (SELECT * FROM nav_fund WHERE rn = 1),
parts AS (
    SELECT tf.FA_NUM, tf.FUND_NAME, tf.FUND_CCY, tf.ISIN_CODE, tf.PART_FA_CODE, tf.PART_CCY, tf.PART_TA_CODE, tf.TA_NUM,
           tf.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, COALESCE(tf.FA_NUM_IN_TA, tf.FA_NUM) AS FUND_ID, f.FA_NUM AS MASTER, tf.NAV_BACKDATED
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN tf JOIN fonds f ON tf.FA_NUM = f.FA_NUM OR tf.FA_POOL_NUM = f.FA_NUM),
parts_nav AS (
    SELECT p.*, nm.NAV_DATE_NAV AS D_NAV_MASTER, nm.D_CALC AS D_CALC, nm.D_PUB AS D_PUB, nm.D_PREV AS D_POS,
           CASE WHEN p.FA_NUM = p.MASTER THEN nm.NAV_DATE_NAV ELSE np.NAV_DATE_NAV END AS D_NAV_PART
    FROM parts p LEFT JOIN nf nm ON nm.NAV_FUND_NO = p.MASTER
         LEFT JOIN nf np ON np.NAV_FUND_NO = p.FA_NUM),
pos AS (
    SELECT pn.FA_NUM, pn.PART_FA_CODE, pn.FUND_ID, SUM(t.PTA_QUANTITY) AS QTY
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FA_NUM, PART_FA_CODE, PART_TA_CODE, FUND_ID, D_POS FROM parts_nav) pn
         JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS t ON t.PTA_FUND_ID = pn.FUND_ID AND t.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= pn.D_POS AND t.PTA_E_POS_DATE >= pn.D_POS
    WHERE t.PTA_UNIT_TYPE = pn.PART_TA_CODE
       OR (pn.PART_TA_CODE IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS t2 WHERE t2.PTA_FUND_ID = t.PTA_FUND_ID AND t2.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= pn.D_POS
              AND t2.PTA_E_POS_DATE >= pn.D_POS AND t2.PTA_UNIT_TYPE <> t.PTA_UNIT_TYPE))
    GROUP BY pn.FA_NUM, pn.PART_FA_CODE, pn.FUND_ID),
fa AS (
    SELECT n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV, MAX(n.NAP_QT_PART) AS QT, MAX(n.NAP_PRICE_PART) AS PRICE, MAX(n.NAP_MNT_PART) AS MNT
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS n WHERE n.NAP_FUND_NO IN (SELECT FA_NUM FROM parts) AND n.NAP_TYP_TRT = 'O'
    GROUP BY n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV),
res AS (
    SELECT x.FA_NUM, x.FUND_NAME, x.FUND_CCY, COALESCE(x.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, x.PART_FA_CODE) AS PART, x.PART_CCY, x.ISIN_CODE,
           COALESCE(ps.QTY, 0) AS QTY_TA, COALESCE(fa.QT, 0) AS QTY_FA, COALESCE(fa.PRICE, 0) AS NAV, COALESCE(fa.MNT, 0) AS AMOUNT,
           x.D_POS, x.D_NAV_MASTER, x.D_CALC, x.D_PUB
    FROM parts_nav x
         LEFT JOIN pos ps ON ps.FA_NUM = x.FA_NUM AND ps.PART_FA_CODE = x.PART_FA_CODE AND ps.FUND_ID = x.FUND_ID
         LEFT JOIN fa ON fa.NAP_FUND_NO = x.FA_NUM AND fa.NAP_TPARTS = x.PART_FA_CODE AND fa.NAP_DATE_NAV = x.D_NAV_PART)
SELECT r.FA_NUM AS "Fa Number", r.FUND_NAME AS "Fund Name", r.FUND_CCY AS "Fund Ccy", r.PART AS "Part", r.PART_CCY AS "Part Ccy",
       r.ISIN_CODE AS "Isin Code", r.QTY_TA AS "Quantity TA", r.QTY_FA AS "Quantity FA", r.QTY_TA - r.QTY_FA AS "Quantity Difference",
       r.NAV AS "Nav", r.AMOUNT AS "Amount", CAST(r.D_POS AS DATE) AS "TA - Position Date", CAST(r.D_NAV_MASTER AS DATE) AS "FA - Nav Date",
       r.D_CALC AS "FA - Calculation Date", r.D_PUB AS "FA - Publication Date"
FROM res r
WHERE NOT (r.QTY_TA = 0 AND r.QTY_FA = 0)
ORDER BY r.FA_NUM, r.PART
