WITH fonds AS (SELECT DISTINCT FA_NUM FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN WHERE FA_NUM IN ('280274')),
navs AS (
    SELECT n.NAV_FUND_NO, n.NAV_DATE_NAV, CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) AS D_CALC, CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE) AS D_PUB,
           LAG(n.NAV_DATE_NAV) OVER (PARTITION BY n.NAV_FUND_NO ORDER BY n.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS D_PREV
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV n WHERE n.NAV_TYP_TRT = 'O'),
navs_ok AS (SELECT * FROM navs WHERE D_PREV IS NOT NULL OR D_CALC IS NOT NULL),
nav_fund AS (
    SELECT n.NAV_FUND_NO, n.NAV_DATE_NAV, n.D_CALC, n.D_PUB, n.D_PREV,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.NAV_FUND_NO ORDER BY n.NAV_DATE_NAV DESC) AS rn
    FROM navs_ok n WHERE CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV AS DATE) <= DATE '2026-06-30'),
nf AS (SELECT * FROM nav_fund WHERE rn = 1),
parts AS (
    SELECT tf.FA_NUM, tf.FUND_NAME, tf.FUND_CCY, tf.ISIN_CODE, tf.PART_FA_CODE, tf.PART_CCY, tf.PART_TA_CODE, tf.TA_NUM,
           tf.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, COALESCE(tf.FA_NUM_IN_TA, tf.FA_NUM) AS FUND_ID, f.FA_NUM AS MASTER, tf.NAV_BACKDATED
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN tf JOIN fonds f ON tf.FA_NUM = f.FA_NUM OR tf.FA_POOL_NUM = f.FA_NUM
    JOIN nf nm0 ON nm0.NAV_FUND_NO = f.FA_NUM
    WHERE (tf.ACTIVATION = 2 OR (tf.ACTIVATION = 1 AND tf.D_ACTIVATION <= nm0.NAV_DATE_NAV))
      AND (tf.LIQUIDATION = 2 OR (tf.LIQUIDATION = 1 AND tf.D_LIQUIDATION > nm0.NAV_DATE_NAV))),
parts_nav AS (
    SELECT p.*, nm.NAV_DATE_NAV AS D_NAV_MASTER, nm.D_CALC AS D_CALC, nm.D_PUB AS D_PUB, nm.D_PREV AS D_POS,
           CASE WHEN p.FA_NUM = p.MASTER THEN nm.NAV_DATE_NAV ELSE np.NAV_DATE_NAV END AS D_NAV_PART
    FROM parts p LEFT JOIN nf nm ON nm.NAV_FUND_NO = p.MASTER
         LEFT JOIN nf np ON np.NAV_FUND_NO = p.FA_NUM),
pos AS (
    SELECT pn.FA_NUM, pn.PART_FA_CODE, pn.FUND_ID, SUM(t.PTA_QUANTITY) AS QTY
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FA_NUM, PART_FA_CODE, PART_TA_CODE, FUND_ID, D_POS FROM parts_nav) pn
         JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS t ON t.PTA_FUND_ID = pn.FUND_ID AND t.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= pn.D_POS AND t.PTA_E_POS_DATE >= pn.D_POS
    WHERE t.PTA_UNIT_TYPE = pn.PART_TA_CODE
       OR (pn.PART_TA_CODE IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS t2 WHERE t2.PTA_FUND_ID = t.PTA_FUND_ID AND t2.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= pn.D_POS
              AND t2.PTA_E_POS_DATE >= pn.D_POS AND t2.PTA_UNIT_TYPE <> t.PTA_UNIT_TYPE))
    GROUP BY pn.FA_NUM, pn.PART_FA_CODE, pn.FUND_ID),
fa AS (
    SELECT n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV, MAX(n.NAP_QT_PART) AS QT, MAX(n.NAP_PRICE_PART) AS PRICE, MAX(n.NAP_MNT_PART) AS MNT
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS n WHERE n.NAP_FUND_NO IN (SELECT FA_NUM FROM parts) AND n.NAP_TYP_TRT = 'O'
    GROUP BY n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV),
res AS (
    SELECT x.FA_NUM, x.FUND_NAME, x.FUND_CCY, COALESCE(x.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, x.PART_FA_CODE) AS PART, x.PART_CCY, x.ISIN_CODE,
           COALESCE(ps.QTY, 0) AS QTY_TA, COALESCE(fa.QT, 0) AS QTY_FA, COALESCE(fa.PRICE, 0) AS NAV, COALESCE(fa.MNT, 0) AS AMOUNT,
           x.D_POS, x.D_NAV_MASTER, x.D_CALC, x.D_PUB
    FROM parts_nav x
         LEFT JOIN pos ps ON ps.FA_NUM = x.FA_NUM AND ps.PART_FA_CODE = x.PART_FA_CODE AND ps.FUND_ID = x.FUND_ID
         LEFT JOIN fa ON fa.NAP_FUND_NO = x.FA_NUM AND fa.NAP_TPARTS = x.PART_FA_CODE AND fa.NAP_DATE_NAV = x.D_NAV_PART)
SELECT r.FA_NUM AS "Fa Number", r.FUND_NAME AS "Fund Name", r.FUND_CCY AS "Fund Ccy", r.PART AS "Part", r.PART_CCY AS "Part Ccy",
       r.ISIN_CODE AS "Isin Code", r.QTY_TA AS "Quantity TA", r.QTY_FA AS "Quantity FA", r.QTY_TA - r.QTY_FA AS "Quantity Difference",
       r.NAV AS "Nav", r.AMOUNT AS "Amount", CAST(r.D_POS AS DATE) AS "TA - Position Date", CAST(r.D_NAV_MASTER AS DATE) AS "FA - Nav Date",
       r.D_CALC AS "FA - Calculation Date", r.D_PUB AS "FA - Publication Date"
FROM res r
WHERE NOT (r.QTY_TA = 0 AND r.QTY_FA = 0)
ORDER BY r.FA_NUM, r.PART

WITH msg_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_TABLE AS T, m.C_ELEMENT AS E, m.L_LIBELLE AS L, m.L_ABREGE AS A,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_TABLE, m.C_ELEMENT ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(m.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_MESSAGE m WHERE m.C_TABLE IN ('TYPREG', 'SETTLE', 'COUNTRY', 'MONNAIES')),
msg AS (SELECT T, E, L, A FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
reg_rk AS (
    SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.C_N_REGISTER ORDER BY r.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER r),
cli_rk AS (
    SELECT c.C_N_CLIENT, c.L_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.C_N_CLIENT ORDER BY c.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_CLIENT c),
reg AS (
    SELECT r.C_N_REGISTER, SUBSTR(TRIM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')) THEN COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')
                                            ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, ''), ' ', COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) END), 1, 40) AS L_NAME, r.C_N_OUTLET, r.C_N_CLIENT, TRIM(c.L_NAME) AS CLIENT_NAME, r.C_REGISTER_TYP, r.C_GROUP_TYP,
           r.C_PERSON_TYP, r.C_REG_TYP, r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP, r.C_RESIDENCE, r.C_CITY, r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE, r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL,
           r.D_CREATED, r.D_UPDATED, r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE
    FROM reg_rk r INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM cli_rk WHERE rn = 1) c ON c.C_N_CLIENT = r.C_N_CLIENT
    WHERE r.rn = 1),
clr_acc AS (SELECT CAST(C_ID AS VARCHAR) AS REG_ID, MIN(G_ACC_NO1) AS ACC FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_COLL_ACCOUNT WHERE C_ACC_TYPE = '0000' GROUP BY C_ID),
fonds AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.FA_NUM, f.FA_NUM_IN_TA, f.FUND_NAME, f.FUND_CCY FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN f
          WHERE f.FA_NUM IN ('280268') AND f.FA_NUM_IN_TA IS NOT NULL),
lastpos AS (
    SELECT p.PTA_FUND_ID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN p.PTA_POS_DATE <= DATE '2025-12-31' THEN p.PTA_POS_DATE END) AS L1,
           MAX(CASE WHEN p.PTA_POS_DATE <= DATE '2025-12-31' THEN p.PTA_POS_DATE END) AS L2
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.POS_TA p WHERE p.PTA_FUND_ID IN (SELECT FA_NUM_IN_TA FROM fonds) GROUP BY p.PTA_FUND_ID),
tf_rk AS (
    SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.FA_NUM_IN_TA, t.PART_TA_CODE ORDER BY t.D_ACTIVATION DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN t WHERE t.FA_NUM_IN_TA IN (SELECT FA_NUM_IN_TA FROM fonds)),
tf AS (SELECT * FROM tf_rk WHERE rn = 1),
pos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.PTA_POS_DATE, CAST(p.PTA_REG_ACC AS BIGINT) AS REG_NO, p.PTA_FUND_ID, p.PTA_UNIT_TYPE, p.PTA_QUANTITY, p.PTA_NAV,
           p.PTA_AMOUNT, p.PTA_NAV_DATE, p.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.POS_TA p JOIN lastpos l ON l.PTA_FUND_ID = p.PTA_FUND_ID
    WHERE p.PTA_POS_DATE BETWEEN COALESCE(l.L1, DATE '2025-12-31') AND COALESCE(l.L2, DATE '2025-12-31')
      AND COALESCE(p.PTA_QUANTITY, 0) <> 0 AND p.PTA_NAV_DATE IS NOT NULL ),
navp AS (
    SELECT n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV, MAX(n.NAP_PRICE_PART) AS PRICE
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS n WHERE n.NAP_FUND_NO IN (SELECT FA_NUM FROM fonds) GROUP BY n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV),
rows_ AS (
    SELECT ps.*, f.FA_NUM, f.FUND_NAME AS F_NAME, f.FUND_CCY AS F_CCY, tf.TA_NUM, tf.ISIN_CODE, tf.PART_CCY, tf.PART_FA_CODE,
           COALESCE(tf.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, tf.PART_FA_CODE, ps.PTA_UNIT_TYPE) AS PART, mq.A AS QUOT_CCY
    FROM pos ps JOIN fonds f ON f.FA_NUM_IN_TA = ps.PTA_FUND_ID
         LEFT JOIN tf ON tf.FA_NUM_IN_TA = ps.PTA_FUND_ID AND tf.PART_TA_CODE = ps.PTA_UNIT_TYPE
         LEFT JOIN msg mq ON mq.T = 'MONNAIES' AND mq.E = ps.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY)
SELECT
    r.C_N_REGISTER AS "Register Number", r.L_NAME AS "Register Name", CAST(r.D_CREATED AS DATE) AS "Register Creation Date",
    r.C_N_CLIENT AS "Client Number", r.CLIENT_NAME AS "Client Name", r.C_REGISTER_TYP AS "Register Type", m_typ.L AS "Register Title",
    r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP AS "Settlement Type", m_set.L AS "Settlement Name", r.C_RESIDENCE AS "Residence Code", m_res.L AS "Residence Name",
    r.C_CITY AS "Register Citizenship Code", m_cit.L AS "Register Citizenship Name", r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE AS "Tax Residence Code",
    m_tax.L AS "Tax Residence Name",
    CASE WHEN r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "Clearing Flag", r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL AS "Clearing Register Number",
    g.L_NAME AS "Clearing Register Name", COALESCE(s.CLEARING_ACCOUNT, ca.ACC) AS "Clearing Account",
    x.TA_NUM AS "SubFund TA Number", x.FA_NUM AS "SubFund Number", x.F_NAME AS "SubFund Name", x.F_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    x.PART AS "Shareclass", x.ISIN_CODE AS "Isin Code", COALESCE(x.PTA_QUANTITY, 0) AS "Quantity", x.QUOT_CCY AS "Quotation Ccy",
    COALESCE(x.PTA_NAV, 0) AS "Price in Quotation Ccy", COALESCE(x.PTA_AMOUNT, 0) AS "Amount in Quotation Ccy",
    x.PART_CCY AS "Shareclass Ccy",
    CASE WHEN x.QUOT_CCY <> x.PART_CCY THEN COALESCE(np.PRICE, 0) ELSE COALESCE(x.PTA_NAV, 0) END AS "Price in Shareclass Ccy",
    CASE WHEN x.QUOT_CCY <> x.PART_CCY THEN ROUND(COALESCE(x.PTA_QUANTITY, 0) * COALESCE(np.PRICE, 0), 2) ELSE COALESCE(x.PTA_AMOUNT, 0) END AS "Amount in Shareclass Ccy",
    x.PART_CCY AS "Report Ccy", 1 AS "Report Ccy Exchange Rate",
    CASE WHEN x.QUOT_CCY <> x.PART_CCY THEN COALESCE(np.PRICE, 0) ELSE COALESCE(x.PTA_NAV, 0) END AS "Price in Report Ccy",
    CASE WHEN x.QUOT_CCY <> x.PART_CCY THEN ROUND(COALESCE(x.PTA_QUANTITY, 0) * COALESCE(np.PRICE, 0), 2) ELSE COALESCE(x.PTA_AMOUNT, 0) END AS "Amount in Report Ccy",
    CAST(x.PTA_NAV_DATE AS DATE) AS "Date Nav", x.PTA_POS_DATE AS "TA - Position Date"
FROM rows_ x
     JOIN reg r ON r.C_N_REGISTER = x.REG_NO
     LEFT JOIN reg g ON g.C_N_REGISTER = r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL
     LEFT JOIN msg m_typ ON m_typ.T = 'TYPREG'  AND m_typ.E = r.C_REGISTER_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m_set ON m_set.T = 'SETTLE'  AND m_set.E = r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m_res ON m_res.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_res.E = r.C_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_cit ON m_cit.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_cit.E = r.C_CITY
     LEFT JOIN msg m_tax ON m_tax.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_tax.E = r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN clr_acc ca ON ca.REG_ID = CAST(r.C_N_REGISTER AS VARCHAR)
     LEFT JOIN navp np ON np.NAP_FUND_NO = x.FA_NUM AND np.NAP_TPARTS = x.PART_FA_CODE AND np.NAP_DATE_NAV = x.PTA_NAV_DATE
     LEFT JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES s ON s.REGISTER_NUMBER = r.C_N_REGISTER
ORDER BY x.PTA_POS_DATE, x.FA_NUM, x.PART, r.C_N_REGISTER

     LEFT JOIN msg m_res ON m_res.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_res.E = r.C_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_cit ON m_cit.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_cit.E = r.C_CITY
     LEFT JOIN msg m_tax ON m_tax.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_tax.E = r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN clr_acc ca ON ca.REG_ID = CAST(r.C_N_REGISTER AS VARCHAR)

     LEFT JOIN msg m8 ON m8.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m8.E = r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m9 ON m9.T = 'CDELIV'  AND m9.E = r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE
     LEFT JOIN reg g ON g.C_N_REGISTER = r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL
     LEFT JOIN clr_acc ca ON ca.REG_ID = CAST(r.C_N_REGISTER AS VARCHAR)
     LEFT JOIN blk b ON b.REGISTER_NUMBER = r.C_N_REGISTER
     LEFT JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES s ON s.REGISTER_NUMBER = r.C_N_REGISTER
ORDER BY r.C_N_REGISTER

WITH msg_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_TABLE AS T, m.C_ELEMENT AS E, m.L_LIBELLE AS L, m.L_ABREGE AS A,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_TABLE, m.C_ELEMENT ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(m.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_MESSAGE m WHERE m.C_TABLE IN ('TYPREG', 'TYPGRP', 'TYPPERS', 'REGTYP', 'SETTLE', 'COUNTRY', 'CDELIV')),
msg AS (SELECT T, E, L, A FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
reg_rk AS (
    SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.C_N_REGISTER ORDER BY r.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER r),
cli_rk AS (
    SELECT c.C_N_CLIENT, c.L_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.C_N_CLIENT ORDER BY c.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_CLIENT c),
reg AS (
    SELECT r.C_N_REGISTER, SUBSTR(TRIM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')) THEN COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')
                                            ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, ''), ' ', COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) END), 1, 40) AS L_NAME, r.C_N_OUTLET, r.C_N_CLIENT, TRIM(c.L_NAME) AS CLIENT_NAME, r.C_REGISTER_TYP, r.C_GROUP_TYP,
           r.C_PERSON_TYP, r.C_REG_TYP, r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP, r.C_RESIDENCE, r.C_CITY, r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE, r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL,
           r.D_CREATED, r.D_UPDATED, r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE
    FROM reg_rk r INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM cli_rk WHERE rn = 1) c ON c.C_N_CLIENT = r.C_N_CLIENT
    WHERE r.rn = 1),
clr_acc AS (SELECT CAST(C_ID AS VARCHAR) AS REG_ID, MIN(G_ACC_NO1) AS ACC FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_COLL_ACCOUNT WHERE C_ACC_TYPE = '0000' GROUP BY C_ID),
blk_rk AS (
    SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.REGISTER_NUMBER
                                   ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, b.FUNDS_BLOCKED DESC) AS rn
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED b),
blk AS (SELECT * FROM blk_rk WHERE rn = 1)
SELECT
    r.C_N_REGISTER AS "Register Number", r.L_NAME AS "Register Name", r.C_N_OUTLET AS "Outlet Number",
    r.C_N_CLIENT AS "Client Number", r.CLIENT_NAME AS "Client Name",
    r.C_REGISTER_TYP AS "Register Type", m1.L AS "Register Type Name", r.C_GROUP_TYP AS "Group Type", m2.L AS "Group Type Name",
    r.C_PERSON_TYP AS "Person Type", m3.L AS "Person Type Name", r.C_REG_TYP AS "Reg Type", m4.L AS "Reg Type Name",
    r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP AS "Settlement Type", m5.L AS "Settlement Name",
    r.C_RESIDENCE AS "Residence Code", m6.L AS "Residence Name", r.C_CITY AS "City Code", m7.L AS "City Name",
    r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE AS "Tax Residence Code", m8.L AS "Tax Residence Name",
    CASE WHEN r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "Clearing Flag",
    r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL AS "Clearing Register Number", g.L_NAME AS "Clearing Register Name", COALESCE(s.CLEARING_ACCOUNT, ca.ACC) AS "Clearing Account",
    s.FLAG_STP AS "Flag STP",
    r.D_CREATED AS "Creation Date", r.D_UPDATED AS "Update Date", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS "Insert Date", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS "Last Update Date",
    b.ALL_FUNDS_BLOCKED AS "All Funds Blocked", b.FULL_BLOCKED AS "Full Blocked", b.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE AS "Full Blocked Reason Code",
    b.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON AS "Full Blocked Reason", b.FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT AS "Full Blocked Comment",
    b.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AS "Full Blocked Last Date", b.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE AS "Full Blocked Unblocked Date",
    b.REDEM_BLOCKED AS "Redem Blocked", b.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE AS "Redem Blocked Reason Code",
    b.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON AS "Redem Blocked Reason", b.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT AS "Redem Blocked Comment",
    b.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AS "Redem Blocked Last Date", b.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE AS "Redem Blocked Unblocked Date",
    r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE AS "Custody Settlement Code", m9.L AS "Custody Settlement Description"
FROM reg r
     LEFT JOIN msg m1 ON m1.T = 'TYPREG'  AND m1.E = r.C_REGISTER_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m2 ON m2.T = 'TYPGRP'  AND m2.E = r.C_GROUP_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m3 ON m3.T = 'TYPPERS' AND m3.E = r.C_PERSON_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m4 ON m4.T = 'REGTYP'  AND m4.E = r.C_REG_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m5 ON m5.T = 'SETTLE'  AND m5.E = r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m6 ON m6.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m6.E = r.C_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m7 ON m7.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m7.E = r.C_CITY
     LEFT JOIN msg m8 ON m8.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m8.E = r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m9 ON m9.T = 'CDELIV'  AND m9.E = r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE
     LEFT JOIN reg g ON g.C_N_REGISTER = r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL
     LEFT JOIN clr_acc ca ON ca.REG_ID = CAST(r.C_N_REGISTER AS VARCHAR)
     LEFT JOIN blk b ON b.REGISTER_NUMBER = r.C_N_REGISTER
     LEFT JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES s ON s.REGISTER_NUMBER = r.C_N_REGISTER
ORDER BY r.C_N_REGISTER

WITH msg_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_TABLE AS T, m.C_ELEMENT AS E, m.L_LIBELLE AS L, m.L_ABREGE AS A,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_TABLE, m.C_ELEMENT ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(m.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_MESSAGE m WHERE m.C_TABLE IN ('COPER', 'TCOMM', 'COUNTRY', 'TYPREG')),
msg AS (SELECT T, E, L, A FROM msg_rk WHERE rn = 1),
reg_rk AS (
    SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.C_N_REGISTER ORDER BY r.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_REGISTER r),
cli_rk AS (
    SELECT c.C_N_CLIENT, c.L_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.C_N_CLIENT ORDER BY c.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_CLIENT c),
reg AS (
    SELECT r.C_N_REGISTER, SUBSTR(TRIM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')) THEN COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')
                                            ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, ''), ' ', COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) END), 1, 40) AS L_NAME, r.C_N_OUTLET, r.C_N_CLIENT, TRIM(c.L_NAME) AS CLIENT_NAME, r.C_REGISTER_TYP, r.C_GROUP_TYP,
           r.C_PERSON_TYP, r.C_REG_TYP, r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP, r.C_RESIDENCE, r.C_CITY, r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE, r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL,
           r.D_CREATED, r.D_UPDATED, r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE
    FROM reg_rk r INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM cli_rk WHERE rn = 1) c ON c.C_N_CLIENT = r.C_N_CLIENT
    WHERE r.rn = 1),
tf_rk AS (
    SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.TA_NUM, f.PART_TA_CODE ORDER BY f.D_ACTIVATION DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN f),
tf AS (SELECT * FROM tf_rk WHERE rn = 1),
pool_ta_num AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT tf2.TA_NUM, tf2.ISIN_CODE
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN tf1 CROSS JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN tf2
    WHERE tf1.FA_NUM IN ('280273')
      AND (COALESCE(tf2.FA_POOL_NUM, tf2.FA_NUM) = COALESCE(tf1.FA_POOL_NUM, tf1.FA_NUM)
           OR REPLACE(tf1.FUND_NAME, 'POOL - ', '') = REPLACE(tf2.FUND_NAME, 'POOL - ', ''))),
pool_ta_all AS (
    SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_num
    UNION
    SELECT h.OPT_NPTF FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.OP_TA h WHERE h.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN IN (SELECT ISIN_CODE FROM pool_ta_num WHERE ISIN_CODE IS NOT NULL)),
delay_rk AS (
    SELECT v.C_FUND, v.C_OPE, v.N_DAYS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.C_FUND, v.C_OPE ORDER BY v.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE v),
delay AS (SELECT C_FUND, C_OPE, N_DAYS FROM delay_rk WHERE rn = 1),
navs AS (
    SELECT n.NAV_FUND_NO, n.NAV_DATE_NAV, CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) AS DATE_CALCUL
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV n WHERE n.NAV_TYP_TRT = 'O' AND n.NAV_FUND_NO IN (SELECT DISTINCT FA_NUM FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN WHERE TA_NUM IN (SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_all))),
ops AS (
    SELECT t.*, tf.FA_NUM AS TF_FA_NUM, tf.FUND_NAME AS TF_FUND_NAME, tf.FUND_CCY AS TF_FUND_CCY,
           COALESCE(tf.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, tf.PART_FA_CODE, t.OPT_TPART) AS PART,
           COALESCE(tf.ISIN_CODE, t.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN) AS ISIN,
           CASE WHEN t.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '04' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS SGN,
           CAST(t.OPT_INPUT_DATE AS DATE) AS INPUT_DAY
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.OP_TA t LEFT JOIN tf ON tf.TA_NUM = t.OPT_NPTF AND tf.PART_TA_CODE = t.OPT_TPART
    WHERE t.OPT_NPTF IN (SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_all)
      AND t.OPT_OP_DATE >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.OPT_OP_DATE <= DATE '2026-07-31'
      AND t.OPT_OP_CODE NOT IN ('0014', '0015')  
      AND (t.OPT_OP_CODE <> '0018'
           OR t.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO IN (SELECT DISTINCT t2.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.OP_TA t2
                                       WHERE t2.OPT_OP_CODE = '0016' AND t2.OPT_OP_DATE >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND t2.OPT_OP_DATE <= DATE '2026-07-31'
                                         AND t2.OPT_NPTF IN (SELECT TA_NUM FROM pool_ta_all)))
      AND (t.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '04'
           OR (t.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '03' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.OP_TA t3
                                                    WHERE t3.OPT_OP_NUM_TA = t.OPT_OP_NUM_TA AND t3.OPT_OUTLET_NO = t.OPT_OUTLET_NO
                                                      AND t3.OPT_OP_CODE = t.OPT_OP_CODE AND t3.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '04')))),
nav_for_op AS (
    SELECT o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA, o.OPT_OUTLET_NO, o.OPT_OP_CODE, o.OPT_TYPE_LOG, MIN(n.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS NAV_DATE
    FROM ops o JOIN navs n ON n.NAV_FUND_NO = o.TF_FA_NUM AND n.DATE_CALCUL >= o.INPUT_DAY
    GROUP BY o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA, o.OPT_OUTLET_NO, o.OPT_OP_CODE, o.OPT_TYPE_LOG)
SELECT
    o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO AS "Register Number", r.L_NAME AS "Register Name", r.C_RESIDENCE AS "Register Residence Code", m_res.L AS "Register Residence Name",
    r.C_CITY AS "Register Citizenship Code", m_cit.L AS "Register Citizenship Name", r.C_REGISTER_TYP AS "Register Type", m_typ.L AS "Register Type Name",
    o.OPT_NPTF AS "SubFund TA Number", COALESCE(o.TF_FA_NUM, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR)) AS "SubFund Number",
    o.TF_FUND_NAME AS "SubFund Name", o.TF_FUND_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy", o.PART AS "Shareclass", o.ISIN AS "Isin Code",
    o.OPT_INPUT_DATE AS "Input Date", o.OPT_OP_DATE AS "Trade Date", o.OPT_VALUE_DATE AS "Value Date",
    o.OPT_OP_CODE AS "Operation Code", m_ope.L AS "Operation Name",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_QUANTITY, 0) AS "Quantity", o.OPT_QUOT_CCY AS "Quotation Ccy", COALESCE(o.OPT_PRICE, 0) AS "Price in Quotation Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Gross Amount in Quotation Ccy", o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Net Amount in Quotation Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Fees in Quotation Ccy", o.OPT_QUOT_CCY AS "Shareclass Ccy", COALESCE(o.OPT_PRICE, 0) AS "Price in Shareclass Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Gross Amount in  Shareclass Ccy", o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Net Amount in Shareclass Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Fees in Shareclass Ccy",
    o.OPT_EXT_CODE AS "Reversal Code", o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN AS "STP Reference",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "STP Flag",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "Clearing Flag",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO END AS "Clearing Register Number",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE rc.L_NAME END AS "Clearing Register Name",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE o.OPT_NREGISTER_ACC_NO END AS "Clearing Account",
    o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA AS "Operation Number", o.OPT_OUTLET_NO AS "Outlet Number", o.OPT_TYPE_LOG AS "Log Type",
    nv.NAV_DATE AS "Price Date Nav FA",
    (SELECT MIN(n2.DATE_CALCUL) FROM navs n2 WHERE n2.NAV_FUND_NO = o.TF_FA_NUM AND n2.NAV_DATE_NAV = nv.NAV_DATE) AS "Price Date Calcul FA",
    dl.N_DAYS AS "Operation Nb Days Value", o.OPT_QUOT_CCY AS "Report Ccy", 1 AS "Report Ccy Exchange Rate",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Gross Amount in Report Ccy", o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Net Amount in Report Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Fees in Report Ccy", COALESCE(o.OPT_PRICE, 0) AS "Price in Report Ccy",
    o.OPT_CLIENT_CODE AS "Client Code", o.OPT_CLIENT_NAME AS "Client Description"
FROM ops o
     LEFT JOIN reg r  ON r.C_N_REGISTER = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO
     LEFT JOIN reg rc ON rc.C_N_REGISTER = o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO
     LEFT JOIN msg m_res ON m_res.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_res.E = r.C_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_cit ON m_cit.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_cit.E = r.C_CITY
     LEFT JOIN msg m_typ ON m_typ.T = 'TYPREG'  AND m_typ.E = r.C_REGISTER_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m_ope ON m_ope.T = 'COPER'   AND m_ope.E = o.OPT_OP_CODE
     LEFT JOIN nav_for_op nv ON nv.OPT_OP_NUM_TA = o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA AND nv.OPT_OUTLET_NO = o.OPT_OUTLET_NO
                            AND nv.OPT_OP_CODE = o.OPT_OP_CODE AND nv.OPT_TYPE_LOG = o.OPT_TYPE_LOG
     LEFT JOIN delay dl ON dl.C_FUND = o.OPT_NPTF AND dl.C_OPE = o.OPT_OP_CODE
ORDER BY o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO, o.OPT_OP_DATE, o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA, o.OPT_TYPE_LOG

    o.OPT_OP_CODE AS "Operation Code", m_ope.L AS "Operation Name",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_QUANTITY, 0) AS "Quantity", o.OPT_QUOT_CCY AS "Quotation Ccy", COALESCE(o.OPT_PRICE, 0) AS "Price in Quotation Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Gross Amount in Quotation Ccy", o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Net Amount in Quotation Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Fees in Quotation Ccy", o.OPT_QUOT_CCY AS "Shareclass Ccy", COALESCE(o.OPT_PRICE, 0) AS "Price in Shareclass Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Gross Amount in  Shareclass Ccy", o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Net Amount in Shareclass Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Fees in Shareclass Ccy",
    o.OPT_EXT_CODE AS "Reversal Code", o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN AS "STP Reference",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "STP Flag",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "Clearing Flag",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO END AS "Clearing Register Number",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE rc.L_NAME END AS "Clearing Register Name",
    CASE WHEN o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE o.OPT_NREGISTER_ACC_NO END AS "Clearing Account",
    o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA AS "Operation Number", o.OPT_OUTLET_NO AS "Outlet Number", o.OPT_TYPE_LOG AS "Log Type",
    nv.NAV_DATE AS "Price Date Nav FA",
    (SELECT MIN(n2.DATE_CALCUL) FROM navs n2 WHERE n2.NAV_FUND_NO = o.TF_FA_NUM AND n2.NAV_DATE_NAV = nv.NAV_DATE) AS "Price Date Calcul FA",
    dl.N_DAYS AS "Operation Nb Days Value", o.OPT_QUOT_CCY AS "Report Ccy", 1 AS "Report Ccy Exchange Rate",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Gross Amount in Report Ccy", o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Net Amount in Report Ccy",
    o.SGN * COALESCE(o.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ, 0) AS "Fees in Report Ccy", COALESCE(o.OPT_PRICE, 0) AS "Price in Report Ccy",
    o.OPT_CLIENT_CODE AS "Client Code", o.OPT_CLIENT_NAME AS "Client Description"
FROM ops o
     LEFT JOIN reg r  ON r.C_N_REGISTER = o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO
     LEFT JOIN reg rc ON rc.C_N_REGISTER = o.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO
     LEFT JOIN msg m_res ON m_res.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_res.E = r.C_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_cit ON m_cit.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_cit.E = r.C_CITY
     LEFT JOIN msg m_typ ON m_typ.T = 'TYPREG'  AND m_typ.E = r.C_REGISTER_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m_ope ON m_ope.T = 'COPER'   AND m_ope.E = o.OPT_OP_CODE
     LEFT JOIN nav_for_op nv ON nv.OPT_OP_NUM_TA = o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA AND nv.OPT_OUTLET_NO = o.OPT_OUTLET_NO
                            AND nv.OPT_OP_CODE = o.OPT_OP_CODE AND nv.OPT_TYPE_LOG = o.OPT_TYPE_LOG
     LEFT JOIN delay dl ON dl.C_FUND = o.OPT_NPTF AND dl.C_OPE = o.OPT_OP_CODE
ORDER BY o.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO, o.OPT_OP_DATE, o.OPT_OP_NUM_TA, o.OPT_TYPE_LOG

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\out\tx_change_nav_20261027_151739\sql\main_direct.sql =====
WITH fund_ref AS (
  SELECT t.FA_NUM AS C_FUND, t.FUND_NAME AS L_FUND, t.FUND_CCY AS C_CCY
  FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS t
  WHERE t.FA_NUM IN ('280287')
),
win AS (
    SELECT '280287' AS C_FUND, 8554978 AS LOT_FROM, 8607153 AS LOT_TO
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT w.C_FUND, lf.D_NAV AS NAV_FROM, lt.D_NAV AS NAV_TO
    FROM win w
         LEFT JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT lf ON lf.C_FUND = w.C_FUND AND lf.N_LOT = w.LOT_FROM
         LEFT JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT lt ON lt.C_FUND = w.C_FUND AND lt.N_LOT = w.LOT_TO
),
flag AS (
    SELECT b.FUND_NO AS C_FUND, CAST(b.NAV_BACKDATED AS INTEGER) AS BACKDATED
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG b WHERE b.FUND_NO IN ('280287')
),
rates_rk AS (
    SELECT r.C_FUND, r.N_LOT, r.D_NAV, r.C_NAV_TYP, r.C_CCY, r.R_EXCHANGE_MF, r.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY, r.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY,
           r.G_ROUNDING_PTF_CCY, r.G_ROUNDING_CCY, r.N_DECIMAL_PTF_CCY, r.N_DECIMAL_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.C_FUND, r.D_NAV, r.C_NAV_TYP, r.C_CCY ORDER BY r.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES r
    WHERE r.C_FUND IN ('280287')
),
rates AS (
    SELECT r.*,
           CASE WHEN b.NAV_FROM IS NULL THEN TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
                WHEN TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00' IS NULL OR b.NAV_FROM > TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00' THEN b.NAV_FROM
                ELSE TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00' END AS LOWER_NAV,
           b.NAV_TO AS UPPER_NAV, fl.BACKDATED
    FROM rates_rk r
         INNER JOIN bounds b ON b.C_FUND = r.C_FUND
         INNER JOIN flag fl ON fl.C_FUND = r.C_FUND
    WHERE r.rn = 1 AND ((fl.BACKDATED = 0 AND TRIM(r.C_NAV_TYP) = 'O') OR fl.BACKDATED = 1)
)
SELECT
    r.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    r.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", r.C_CCY AS "Ccy",
    r.R_EXCHANGE_MF AS "Exchange Rate MFFA",
    r.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY AS "Exchange Rate Ccy To SubFund Ccy",
    r.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY AS "Exchange Rate SubFund Ccy To Ccy",
    r.G_ROUNDING_PTF_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy Rounding", r.G_ROUNDING_CCY AS "Ccy Rounding",
    r.N_DECIMAL_PTF_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy Decimal", r.N_DECIMAL_CCY AS "Ccy Decimal"
FROM rates r
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = r.C_FUND
WHERE (r.LOWER_NAV IS NULL OR r.D_NAV >= r.LOWER_NAV)
  AND (r.UPPER_NAV IS NULL OR r.D_NAV <= r.UPPER_NAV)
ORDER BY r.C_FUND, r.D_NAV, r.C_CCY

    r.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY AS "Exchange Rate SubFund Ccy To Ccy",

    r.N_DECIMAL_PTF_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy Decimal", r.N_DECIMAL_CCY AS "Ccy Decimal"
FROM rates r
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = r.C_FUND
WHERE (r.LOWER_NAV IS NULL OR r.D_NAV >= r.LOWER_NAV)
  AND (r.UPPER_NAV IS NULL OR r.D_NAV <= r.UPPER_NAV)
ORDER BY r.C_FUND, r.D_NAV, r.C_CCY

WITH fund_ref AS (
  SELECT t.FA_NUM AS C_FUND, t.FUND_NAME AS L_FUND, t.FUND_CCY AS C_CCY
  FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TB_FONDS t
  WHERE t.FA_NUM IN ('280287')
),
win AS (
    SELECT '280287' AS C_FUND, 8554978 AS LOT_FROM, 8607153 AS LOT_TO
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT w.C_FUND, lf.D_NAV AS NAV_FROM, lt.D_NAV AS NAV_TO
    FROM win w
         LEFT JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT lf ON lf.C_FUND = w.C_FUND AND lf.N_LOT = w.LOT_FROM
         LEFT JOIN MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_LOT lt ON lt.C_FUND = w.C_FUND AND lt.N_LOT = w.LOT_TO
),
flag AS (
    SELECT b.FUND_NO AS C_FUND, CAST(b.NAV_BACKDATED AS INTEGER) AS BACKDATED
    FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.V_FUND_BACKDATED_FLAG b WHERE b.FUND_NO IN ('280287')
),
rates_rk AS (
    SELECT r.C_FUND, r.N_LOT, r.D_NAV, r.C_NAV_TYP, r.C_CCY, r.R_EXCHANGE_MF, r.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY, r.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY,
           r.G_ROUNDING_PTF_CCY, r.G_ROUNDING_CCY, r.N_DECIMAL_PTF_CCY, r.N_DECIMAL_CCY,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.C_FUND, r.D_NAV, r.C_NAV_TYP, r.C_CCY ORDER BY r.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES r
    WHERE r.C_FUND IN ('280287')
),
rates AS (
    SELECT r.*,
           CASE WHEN b.NAV_FROM IS NULL THEN TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
                WHEN TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00' IS NULL OR b.NAV_FROM > TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00' THEN b.NAV_FROM
                ELSE TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00' END AS LOWER_NAV,
           b.NAV_TO AS UPPER_NAV, fl.BACKDATED
    FROM rates_rk r
         INNER JOIN bounds b ON b.C_FUND = r.C_FUND
         INNER JOIN flag fl ON fl.C_FUND = r.C_FUND
    WHERE r.rn = 1 AND ((fl.BACKDATED = 0 AND TRIM(r.C_NAV_TYP) = 'O') OR fl.BACKDATED = 1)
)
SELECT
    r.C_FUND AS "SubFund Number", fr.L_FUND AS "SubFund Name", fr.C_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    r.D_NAV AS "Nav Date", r.C_CCY AS "Ccy",
    r.R_EXCHANGE_MF AS "Exchange Rate MFFA",
    r.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY AS "Exchange Rate Ccy To SubFund Ccy",
    r.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY AS "Exchange Rate SubFund Ccy To Ccy",
    r.G_ROUNDING_PTF_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy Rounding", r.G_ROUNDING_CCY AS "Ccy Rounding",
    r.N_DECIMAL_PTF_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy Decimal", r.N_DECIMAL_CCY AS "Ccy Decimal"
FROM rates r
     LEFT JOIN fund_ref fr ON fr.C_FUND = r.C_FUND
WHERE (r.LOWER_NAV IS NULL OR r.D_NAV >= r.LOWER_NAV)
  AND (r.UPPER_NAV IS NULL OR r.D_NAV <= r.UPPER_NAV)
ORDER BY r.C_FUND, r.D_NAV, r.C_CCY

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\ta\common.py =====
"""Briques SQL communes aux rapports TA.

Sources (schema LUXIS.REPADMIN, copies Dremio des tables Multifonds Global Transfer Agent MFGI.GTA) :
  DWT_GTA_REGISTER / DWT_GTA_CLIENT / DWT_GTA_MESSAGE / DWT_GTA_COLL_ACCOUNT / DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE
  <-> MFGI.GTA.REGISTER / CLIENT / (messages) / ... : meme contenu, colonnes renommees (voir MAPPING.md).
Les tables de reference Luxis TAB_FND_MAIN (fonds / parts / ISIN / numero TA), OP_TA (operations TA), POS_TA (positions TA) et
LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES(_BLOCKED) n'ont pas d'equivalent MFGA / Infocentre : elles sont conservees (cf. consigne du projet).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from ..core.sqlutil import in_list

REG = "MFGI.GTA.REGISTER"
CLI = "MFGI.GTA.CLIENT"
MSG = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_MESSAGE"
COLL = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_COLL_ACCOUNT"
FND = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN"


def msg_cte(tables: list[str], name: str = "msg") -> str:
    """CTE (T, E, L, A) : libelle (langue 2) de DWT_GTA_MESSAGE pour les tables demandees (equivalent REPADMIN.GET_DWT_MESSAGE)."""
    return f"""{name}_rk AS (
    SELECT m.C_TABLE AS T, m.C_ELEMENT AS E, m.L_LIBELLE AS L, m.L_ABREGE AS A,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.C_TABLE, m.C_ELEMENT ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM(m.C_LNG) = '2' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
    FROM {MSG} m WHERE m.C_TABLE IN ({in_list(tables)})),
{name} AS (SELECT T, E, L, A FROM {name}_rk WHERE rn = 1)"""


def register_cte(name: str = "reg") -> str:
    """CTE : dernier etat de chaque registre (DWT_GTA_REGISTER) avec son client (DWT_GTA_CLIENT)."""
    return f"""{name}_rk AS (
    SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.C_N_REGISTER ORDER BY r.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM {REG} r),
cli_rk AS (
    SELECT c.C_N_CLIENT, c.L_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.C_N_CLIENT ORDER BY c.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM {CLI} c),
{name} AS (
    SELECT r.C_N_REGISTER, SUBSTR(TRIM(CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')) THEN COALESCE(r.L_NAME, '')
                                            ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(r.L_NAME, ''), ' ', COALESCE(r.L_FIRSTNAME, '')) END), 1, 40) AS L_NAME, r.C_N_OUTLET, r.C_N_CLIENT, TRIM(c.L_NAME) AS CLIENT_NAME, r.C_REGISTER_TYP, r.C_GROUP_TYP,
           r.C_PERSON_TYP, r.C_REG_TYP, r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP, r.C_RESIDENCE, r.C_CITY, r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE, r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL,
           r.D_CREATED, r.D_UPDATED, r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE
    FROM {name}_rk r INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM cli_rk WHERE rn = 1) c ON c.C_N_CLIENT = r.C_N_CLIENT
    WHERE r.rn = 1)"""



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\ta\comptes_bloques.py =====
"""Rapport TA - Operations TA sur comptes bloques (LuxRep Queries TA).

Reproduit `PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Ope_Cpt_Bloque` (code_source.txt l.15475-15700) :

  LUXIS (REPADMIN)                                      Ce rapport
  ----------------------------------------------------  --------------------------------------------------------
  OP_TA  T  (operations TA)                             idem (copie du flux MFGI.GTA, sans equivalent MFGA -> table conservee)
  DWT_GTA_REGISTER R / DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE V         idem
  TAB_FND_MAIN TF (jointure sur l'ISIN)                 idem
  LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED RB                        idem (etat de blocage des registres : alimente par LUXIS depuis RKS)
  GET_DWT_MESSAGE('COPER'|'TCOMM'|'CDELIV')             DWT_GTA_MESSAGE
  fonds coches (DWT_GTA_FUNDS / TURNOVER_CORRESP...)    parametre --funds (numeros FA -> numeros TA de TAB_FND_MAIN)
  registres / codes operation coches                    parametres --set registers=... / code_ope=...

Regles reproduites :
  * operations dont la date d'operation est dans [Date From ; Date To] ;
  * la ligne n'est retenue que si l'operation tombe dans une periode de blocage (totale ou rachat), c.-a-d.
    date >= date de blocage et (pas de date de deblocage ou date < date de deblocage), pour le registre de clearing ;
  * si le blocage est total, les colonnes Blocked* viennent du blocage total, sinon du blocage sur rachat ;
  * quantite et montants signes selon le type de log (03 = +1, 04 = -1) ;
  * un registre ayant plusieurs lignes de blocage produit autant de lignes (jointure LUXIS identique).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from ..core.report import (ReportSpec, ExtraParam, Context, FMT_INT, FMT_QTY, FMT_AMT, FMT_RATE, FMT_DATE, FMT_DATETIME)
from ..core.sqlutil import in_list
from .common import msg_cte, register_cte, FND

OP_TA = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.OP_TA"
DELAY = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWT_GTA_FUND_DELAYDATE"
BLOCKED = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED"

COLUMNS = [
    "Register Number", "Register Name", "Register Residence Code", "Register Residence Name", "Register City Code", "Register City Name",
    "Register Type", "Register Type Name", "TA Number", "FA Number", "Fund Name", "Fund Ccy", "Part", "Part Ccy", "Isin Code",
    "Input Date", "Oper Date", "Value Date", "Ope Code", "Ope Code Name", "Quantity", "Gross Amount", "Net Amount", "Commission",
    "Reversal Code", "STP Reference", "STP Flag", "Clearing Flag", "Clearing Regiter Number", "Clearing Regiter Name", "Clearing Account",
    "Operation Ta Number", "Outlet Number", "Log Type", "Price", "Price Fund Ccy", "Operation Code Nb Days Value", "Full Blocked",
    "Blocked Reason Code", "Blocked Reason", "Blocked Comment", "Blocked Date", "Custody Settlement Code", "Custody Settlement Description",
]

FORMATS = {
    "Register Number": FMT_INT, "Input Date": FMT_DATETIME, "Oper Date": FMT_DATE, "Value Date": FMT_DATE, "Quantity": FMT_QTY,
    "Gross Amount": FMT_AMT, "Net Amount": FMT_AMT, "Commission": FMT_AMT, "STP Flag": FMT_INT, "Clearing Flag": FMT_INT,
    "Clearing Regiter Number": FMT_INT, "Operation Ta Number": FMT_INT, "Outlet Number": FMT_INT, "Price": FMT_RATE,
    "Price Fund Ccy": FMT_RATE, "Operation Code Nb Days Value": FMT_INT, "Blocked Date": FMT_DATE,
}


def build(ctx: Context) -> str:
    if not ctx.params.funds:
        raise ValueError("au moins un fonds (--funds) est requis")
    p = ctx.params
    d_from, d_to = p.date_from.isoformat(), p.date_to.isoformat()
    codes = ctx.extra("code_ope") or []
    regs = ctx.extra("registers") or []
    code_filter = f"AND t.OPT_OP_CODE IN ({in_list(codes)})" if codes else ""
    reg_filter = f"AND t.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO IN ({in_list([int(r) for r in regs])})" if regs else ""
    full = ("t.OPT_OP_DATE >= rb.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL "
            "OR t.OPT_OP_DATE < rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)")
    redem = ("t.OPT_OP_DATE >= rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL "
             "OR t.OPT_OP_DATE < rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)")
    return f"""
WITH {msg_cte(['COPER', 'TCOMM', 'COUNTRY', 'TYPREG', 'CDELIV'])},
{register_cte()},
ta_funds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TA_NUM FROM {FND} WHERE FA_NUM IN ({ctx.funds_in()}) AND TA_NUM IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT b.TA_NUM FROM {FND} b WHERE b.FA_NUM IN (SELECT FA_NUM_IN_TA FROM {FND} WHERE FA_NUM IN ({ctx.funds_in()}) AND FA_NUM_IN_TA IS NOT NULL)
      AND b.TA_NUM IS NOT NULL),
tf_rk AS (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.ISIN_CODE ORDER BY f.D_ACTIVATION DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM {FND} f),
tf AS (SELECT * FROM tf_rk WHERE rn = 1),
delay_rk AS (
    SELECT v.C_FUND, v.C_OPE, v.N_DAYS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.C_FUND, v.C_OPE ORDER BY v.N_LOT DESC) AS rn FROM {DELAY} v),
delay AS (SELECT C_FUND, C_OPE, N_DAYS FROM delay_rk WHERE rn = 1),
x AS (
    SELECT t.*, tf.FA_NUM AS TF_FA_NUM, tf.FUND_NAME AS TF_FUND_NAME, rb.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE, rb.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON,
           rb.FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT, rb.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE, rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE, rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON,
           rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT, rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE,
           CASE WHEN {full} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_FULL,
           CASE WHEN t.OPT_TYPE_LOG = '04' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS SGN
    FROM {OP_TA} t
         JOIN {BLOCKED} rb ON rb.REGISTER_NUMBER = t.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO
         JOIN tf ON tf.ISIN_CODE = t.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN
    WHERE t.OPT_OP_DATE >= DATE '{d_from}' AND t.OPT_OP_DATE <= DATE '{d_to}'
      AND t.OPT_NPTF IN (SELECT TA_NUM FROM ta_funds)
      AND t.OPT_TYPE_LOG IN ('03', '04') {code_filter} {reg_filter}
      AND (({full}) OR ({redem})
           OR (rb.FUNDS_BLOCKED = tf.STRUCTURE_NUM AND ({full}))
           OR (rb.FUNDS_BLOCKED = tf.STRUCTURE_NUM AND ({redem}))))
SELECT
    x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO AS "Register Number", r.L_NAME AS "Register Name", r.C_RESIDENCE AS "Register Residence Code",
    m_res.L AS "Register Residence Name", r.C_CITY AS "Register City Code", m_cit.L AS "Register City Name",
    r.C_REGISTER_TYP AS "Register Type", m_typ.L AS "Register Type Name", x.OPT_NPTF AS "TA Number", x.TF_FA_NUM AS "FA Number",
    x.TF_FUND_NAME AS "Fund Name", x.OPT_FUNDS_CCY AS "Fund Ccy", x.OPT_TPART AS "Part", x.OPT_QUOT_CCY AS "Part Ccy",
    x.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN AS "Isin Code", x.OPT_INPUT_DATE AS "Input Date", x.OPT_OP_DATE AS "Oper Date", x.OPT_VALUE_DATE AS "Value Date",
    x.OPT_OP_CODE AS "Ope Code", m_ope.L AS "Ope Code Name", x.SGN * x.OPT_QUANTITY AS "Quantity",
    x.SGN * x.OPT_GROSS_AMT_MQ AS "Gross Amount", x.SGN * x.OPT_NET_AMT_MQ AS "Net Amount", x.SGN * x.OPT_COMM_AMT_MQ AS "Commission",
    x.OPT_EXT_CODE AS "Reversal Code", x.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN AS "STP Reference",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_OP_NUM_TA_EXTERN IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "STP Flag",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "Clearing Flag",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO END AS "Clearing Regiter Number",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE r.L_NAME END AS "Clearing Regiter Name",
    CASE WHEN x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO = x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO THEN NULL ELSE x.OPT_NREGISTER_ACC_NO END AS "Clearing Account",
    x.OPT_OP_NUM_TA AS "Operation Ta Number", x.OPT_OUTLET_NO AS "Outlet Number", x.OPT_TYPE_LOG AS "Log Type", x.OPT_PRICE AS "Price",
    x.OPT_PRICE_FUNDS_CCY AS "Price Fund Ccy", dl.N_DAYS AS "Operation Code Nb Days Value", x.IS_FULL AS "Full Blocked",
    CASE WHEN x.IS_FULL = 'Y' THEN x.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE ELSE x.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON_CODE END AS "Blocked Reason Code",
    CASE WHEN x.IS_FULL = 'Y' THEN x.FULL_BLOCKED_REASON ELSE x.REDEM_BLOCKED_REASON END AS "Blocked Reason",
    CASE WHEN x.IS_FULL = 'Y' THEN x.FULL_BLOCKED_COMMENT ELSE x.REDEM_BLOCKED_COMMENT END AS "Blocked Comment",
    CAST(CASE WHEN x.IS_FULL = 'Y' THEN x.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE ELSE x.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE END AS DATE) AS "Blocked Date",
    r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE AS "Custody Settlement Code", m_cus.L AS "Custody Settlement Description"
FROM x
     JOIN reg r ON r.C_N_REGISTER = x.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO
     LEFT JOIN delay dl ON dl.C_FUND = x.OPT_NPTF AND dl.C_OPE = x.OPT_OP_CODE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_res ON m_res.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_res.E = r.C_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_cit ON m_cit.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_cit.E = r.C_CITY
     LEFT JOIN msg m_typ ON m_typ.T = 'TYPREG'  AND m_typ.E = r.C_REGISTER_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m_ope ON m_ope.T = 'COPER'   AND m_ope.E = x.OPT_OP_CODE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_cus ON m_cus.T = 'CDELIV'  AND m_cus.E = r.C_CUSTODY_SETTLE
ORDER BY x.OPT_REG_CLIENT_NO, x.OPT_OP_DATE, x.OPT_OP_NUM_TA, x.OPT_TYPE_LOG
"""


def checks(rows: list[dict], ctx: Context) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    out = [("INFO", f"{len(rows)} operation(s) sur compte bloque entre {ctx.params.date_from} et {ctx.params.date_to}")]
    full = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("Full Blocked") == "Y")
    out.append(("INFO", f"blocage total : {full} ; blocage rachat : {len(rows) - full}"))
    no_fund = sum(1 for r in rows if not r.get("FA Number"))
    out.append(("WARN" if no_fund else "OK", f"{no_fund} operation(s) sans fonds (TAB_FND_MAIN)"))
    return out


SPEC = ReportSpec(
    key="ta_comptes_bloques", title="LuxRep Queries TA - Operations sur comptes bloques", file_tag="Ta_Ope_Cpt_Bloque",
    columns=COLUMNS, build=build, formats=FORMATS, windowed=False, needs_dates=True, checks=checks,
    key_columns=["Operation Ta Number", "Outlet Number", "Ope Code", "Log Type", "Blocked Reason Code"],
    extra_params=[
        ExtraParam("code_ope", "codes operation retenus (vide = tous), ex. 0001,0002", kind="list", default=[]),
        ExtraParam("registers", "numeros de registre retenus (vide = tous)", kind="list", default=[]),
    ],
    description="Operations TA saisies sur des registres dont le compte est bloque (blocage total ou sur rachat) a la date d'operation.",
    luxis_source="PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Ope_Cpt_Bloque (code_source.txt l.15475-15700)",
)



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\luxrep_reports\ta\positions_isin.py =====
"""Rapport TA - Positions TA par ISIN (LuxRep Queries TA, rapprochement TA / FA).

Reproduit `PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Position_Globale` (code_source.txt l.14114-14470), branche Multifonds :

  LUXIS (REPADMIN)                                      Ce rapport
  ----------------------------------------------------  --------------------------------------------------------
  TAB_FND_MAIN  (fonds / parts / ISIN / FA_NUM_IN_TA)   idem (referentiel LUXIS conserve, sans equivalent MFGA complet)
  TA_POSITIONS  (positions TA par fonds, part, periode) idem (copie du flux MFGI.GTA)
  NAV_PARTS     (quantite / prix / montant FA)          idem (copie MFGA NAV par part)
  NAV           (NAV_DATE_NAV / _TRT / _PUBLICATION)    idem : date calcul = NAV_DATE_TRT, date publication = NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION
  GET_NAV_DATE_NAV(fonds, date, -1, 'Y')                derniere NAV officielle dont la date NAV <= date demandee
  Get_Date_Nav_Prev(fonds, date NAV)                    date NAV officielle precedente (date de position TA)
  fonds coches : LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS                   parametre --funds (numeros FA)

Regles reproduites :
  * date demandee = Date To (ou date du jour pour `last_available`) ;
  * parts du fonds et de ses sous-fonds (FA_POOL_NUM = fonds) actives et non liquidees a la date NAV ;
  * quantite TA = somme de TA_POSITIONS (fonds TA = FA_NUM_IN_TA) valides a la date de position, pour la part TA ; une part sans
    code TA n'est prise que si le fonds est mono-part ;
  * quantite FA / NAV / montant = NAV_PARTS a la date NAV propre au sous-fonds (NAV officielle ; toutes si NAV antidatee) ;
  * ecart = quantite TA - quantite FA ; les lignes dont les deux quantites sont nulles sont ignorees.
Non reproduit : la branche eFront (hors perimetre).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from ..core.report import (ReportSpec, Context, FMT_INT, FMT_QTY, FMT_AMT, FMT_RATE, FMT_DATE)
from .common import FND

POSITIONS = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.TA_POSITIONS"
NAVP = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS"
NAV = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV"

COLUMNS = [
    "Fa Number", "Fund Name", "Fund Ccy", "Part", "Part Ccy", "Isin Code", "Quantity TA", "Quantity FA", "Quantity Difference",
    "Nav", "Amount", "TA - Position Date", "FA - Nav Date", "FA - Calculation Date", "FA - Publication Date",
]

FORMATS = {
    "Quantity TA": FMT_QTY, "Quantity FA": FMT_QTY, "Quantity Difference": FMT_QTY, "Nav": FMT_RATE, "Amount": FMT_AMT,
    "TA - Position Date": FMT_DATE, "FA - Nav Date": FMT_DATE, "FA - Calculation Date": FMT_DATE, "FA - Publication Date": FMT_DATE,
}


def build(ctx: Context) -> str:
    if not ctx.params.funds:
        raise ValueError("au moins un fonds (--funds) est requis")
    p = ctx.params
    d = date.today().isoformat() if p.period_type == "last_available" else p.date_to.isoformat()
    return f"""
WITH fonds AS (SELECT DISTINCT FA_NUM FROM {FND} WHERE FA_NUM IN ({ctx.funds_in()})),
navs AS (
    SELECT n.NAV_FUND_NO, n.NAV_DATE_NAV, CAST(n.NAV_DATE_TRT AS DATE) AS D_CALC, CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV_PUBLICATION AS DATE) AS D_PUB,
           LAG(n.NAV_DATE_NAV) OVER (PARTITION BY n.NAV_FUND_NO ORDER BY n.NAV_DATE_NAV) AS D_PREV
    FROM {NAV} n WHERE n.NAV_TYP_TRT = 'O'),
navs_ok AS (SELECT * FROM navs WHERE D_PREV IS NOT NULL OR D_CALC IS NOT NULL),
nav_fund AS (
    SELECT n.NAV_FUND_NO, n.NAV_DATE_NAV, n.D_CALC, n.D_PUB, n.D_PREV,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.NAV_FUND_NO ORDER BY n.NAV_DATE_NAV DESC) AS rn
    FROM navs_ok n WHERE CAST(n.NAV_DATE_NAV AS DATE) <= DATE '{d}'),
nf AS (SELECT * FROM nav_fund WHERE rn = 1),
parts AS (
    SELECT tf.FA_NUM, tf.FUND_NAME, tf.FUND_CCY, tf.ISIN_CODE, tf.PART_FA_CODE, tf.PART_CCY, tf.PART_TA_CODE, tf.TA_NUM,
           tf.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, COALESCE(tf.FA_NUM_IN_TA, tf.FA_NUM) AS FUND_ID, f.FA_NUM AS MASTER, tf.NAV_BACKDATED
    FROM {FND} tf JOIN fonds f ON tf.FA_NUM = f.FA_NUM OR tf.FA_POOL_NUM = f.FA_NUM
    JOIN nf nm0 ON nm0.NAV_FUND_NO = f.FA_NUM
    WHERE (tf.ACTIVATION = 2 OR (tf.ACTIVATION = 1 AND tf.D_ACTIVATION <= nm0.NAV_DATE_NAV))
      AND (tf.LIQUIDATION = 2 OR (tf.LIQUIDATION = 1 AND tf.D_LIQUIDATION > nm0.NAV_DATE_NAV))),
parts_nav AS (
    SELECT p.*, nm.NAV_DATE_NAV AS D_NAV_MASTER, nm.D_CALC AS D_CALC, nm.D_PUB AS D_PUB, nm.D_PREV AS D_POS,
           CASE WHEN p.FA_NUM = p.MASTER THEN nm.NAV_DATE_NAV ELSE np.NAV_DATE_NAV END AS D_NAV_PART
    FROM parts p LEFT JOIN nf nm ON nm.NAV_FUND_NO = p.MASTER
         LEFT JOIN nf np ON np.NAV_FUND_NO = p.FA_NUM),
pos AS (
    SELECT pn.FA_NUM, pn.PART_FA_CODE, pn.FUND_ID, SUM(t.PTA_QUANTITY) AS QTY
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FA_NUM, PART_FA_CODE, PART_TA_CODE, FUND_ID, D_POS FROM parts_nav) pn
         JOIN {POSITIONS} t ON t.PTA_FUND_ID = pn.FUND_ID AND t.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= pn.D_POS AND t.PTA_E_POS_DATE >= pn.D_POS
    WHERE t.PTA_UNIT_TYPE = pn.PART_TA_CODE
       OR (pn.PART_TA_CODE IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM {POSITIONS} t2 WHERE t2.PTA_FUND_ID = t.PTA_FUND_ID AND t2.PTA_S_POS_DATE <= pn.D_POS
              AND t2.PTA_E_POS_DATE >= pn.D_POS AND t2.PTA_UNIT_TYPE <> t.PTA_UNIT_TYPE))
    GROUP BY pn.FA_NUM, pn.PART_FA_CODE, pn.FUND_ID),
fa AS (
    SELECT n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV, MAX(n.NAP_QT_PART) AS QT, MAX(n.NAP_PRICE_PART) AS PRICE, MAX(n.NAP_MNT_PART) AS MNT
    FROM {NAVP} n WHERE n.NAP_FUND_NO IN (SELECT FA_NUM FROM parts) AND n.NAP_TYP_TRT = 'O'
    GROUP BY n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV),
res AS (
    SELECT x.FA_NUM, x.FUND_NAME, x.FUND_CCY, COALESCE(x.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, x.PART_FA_CODE) AS PART, x.PART_CCY, x.ISIN_CODE,
           COALESCE(ps.QTY, 0) AS QTY_TA, COALESCE(fa.QT, 0) AS QTY_FA, COALESCE(fa.PRICE, 0) AS NAV, COALESCE(fa.MNT, 0) AS AMOUNT,
           x.D_POS, x.D_NAV_MASTER, x.D_CALC, x.D_PUB
    FROM parts_nav x
         LEFT JOIN pos ps ON ps.FA_NUM = x.FA_NUM AND ps.PART_FA_CODE = x.PART_FA_CODE AND ps.FUND_ID = x.FUND_ID
         LEFT JOIN fa ON fa.NAP_FUND_NO = x.FA_NUM AND fa.NAP_TPARTS = x.PART_FA_CODE AND fa.NAP_DATE_NAV = x.D_NAV_PART)
SELECT r.FA_NUM AS "Fa Number", r.FUND_NAME AS "Fund Name", r.FUND_CCY AS "Fund Ccy", r.PART AS "Part", r.PART_CCY AS "Part Ccy",
       r.ISIN_CODE AS "Isin Code", r.QTY_TA AS "Quantity TA", r.QTY_FA AS "Quantity FA", r.QTY_TA - r.QTY_FA AS "Quantity Difference",
       r.NAV AS "Nav", r.AMOUNT AS "Amount", CAST(r.D_POS AS DATE) AS "TA - Position Date", CAST(r.D_NAV_MASTER AS DATE) AS "FA - Nav Date",
       r.D_CALC AS "FA - Calculation Date", r.D_PUB AS "FA - Publication Date"
FROM res r
WHERE NOT (r.QTY_TA = 0 AND r.QTY_FA = 0)
ORDER BY r.FA_NUM, r.PART
"""


def checks(rows: list[dict], ctx: Context) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    out = [("INFO", f"{len(rows)} ligne(s)")]
    ko = [r for r in rows if abs(float(r["Quantity Difference"] or 0)) > 0.00001]
    out.append(("WARN" if ko else "OK", f"{len(ko)} ligne(s) avec ecart de quantite TA / FA"))
    return out


SPEC = ReportSpec(
    key="ta_positions_isin", title="LuxRep Queries TA - Positions TA par ISIN (rapprochement TA / FA)", file_tag="Ta_Positions_by_Isin",
    columns=COLUMNS, build=build, formats=FORMATS, windowed=False, needs_dates=True, checks=checks,
    key_columns=["Fa Number", "Part"],
    description="Quantite TA contre quantite FA par part (ISIN) a une date NAV, avec NAV, montant et ecart.",
    luxis_source="PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Position_Globale (code_source.txt l.14114-14470)",
)

"""Rapport TA - Positions TA par registre (LuxRep Queries TA, chapitre 4).

Reproduit `PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Position` (code_source.txt l.11469-12731), branche Multifonds TA en date de position :

  LUXIS (REPADMIN)                                      Ce rapport
  ----------------------------------------------------  --------------------------------------------------------
  POS_TA  T  (positions TA par registre et par date)    idem : copie LUXIS du flux Multifonds GTA (MFGI.GTA.REG_POSITION), sans
                                                        equivalent MFGA / Infocentre -> table conservee
  TAB_FND_MAIN  TF  (fonds / parts / ISIN / numero TA)  idem (referentiel LUXIS conserve)
  DWT_GTA_REGISTER R + DWT_GTA_CLIENT C                 idem (copies de MFGI.GTA.REGISTER / CLIENT)
  GET_DWT_MESSAGE('TYPREG'|'SETTLE'|'COUNTRY')          DWT_GTA_MESSAGE ; GET_DWT_MESSAGE_ABREGE('MONNAIES', code) = abrege
  GET_LAST_DATE_POSITION_TA(fonds TA, date)             plus grande date de position <= date dans POS_TA
  GET_PRICE_FA_PART(fonds, part, date NAV)              LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS.NAP_PRICE_PART (prix en devise de la part)
  fonds coches : LUXREP_QUERIES_FONDS                   parametre --funds (numeros FA)

Regles reproduites :
  * fenetre : positions dont la date est entre derniere_date_position(Date From) et derniere_date_position(Date To) (a defaut,
    les dates elles-memes) ; 'last_available' = derniere position disponible a la date du jour ;
  * quantite non nulle et date NAV renseignee ; resultat DISTINCT ;
  * prix et montant de cotation = PTA_NAV / PTA_AMOUNT ; si la devise de cotation differe de celle de la part, le prix part est
    relu dans NAV_PARTS et le montant recalcule (arrondi 2 decimales) ;
  * devise du rapport = devise de la part (taux 1) ; les autres devises (taux de change MF) ne sont pas reproduites ;
  * un registre sans client n'est pas liste.
Non reproduit : la branche Â« trade date Â» (fonds dont la date TA est la date de pricing : DWT_GTA_NAV_SHARE_PRICE x TA_POSITIONS)
et la branche eFront (hors perimetre).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from ..core.report import (ReportSpec, ExtraParam, Context, FMT_TEXT, FMT_INT, FMT_QTY, FMT_AMT, FMT_RATE, FMT_DATE, FMT_DATETIME)
from ..core.sqlutil import q, in_list
from .common import msg_cte, register_cte, FND, COLL

POS = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.POS_TA"
NAVP = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.NAV_PARTS"
REGISTRES = "LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES"

COLUMNS = [
    "Register Number", "Register Name", "Register Creation Date", "Client Number", "Client Name", "Register Type", "Register Title",
    "Settlement Type", "Settlement Name", "Residence Code", "Residence Name", "Register Citizenship Code", "Register Citizenship Name",
    "Tax Residence Code", "Tax Residence Name", "Clearing Flag", "Clearing Register Number", "Clearing Register Name", "Clearing Account",
    "SubFund TA Number", "SubFund Number", "SubFund Name", "SubFund Ccy", "Shareclass", "Isin Code", "Quantity", "Quotation Ccy",
    "Price in Quotation Ccy", "Amount in Quotation Ccy", "Shareclass Ccy", "Price in Shareclass Ccy", "Amount in Shareclass Ccy",
    "Report Ccy", "Report Ccy Exchange Rate", "Price in Report Ccy", "Amount in Report Ccy", "Date Nav", "TA - Position Date",
]

FORMATS = {
    "Register Number": FMT_INT, "Register Creation Date": FMT_DATE, "Client Number": FMT_INT, "Clearing Flag": FMT_INT,
    "Clearing Register Number": FMT_INT, "Quantity": FMT_QTY, "Price in Quotation Ccy": FMT_RATE, "Amount in Quotation Ccy": FMT_AMT,
    "Price in Shareclass Ccy": FMT_RATE, "Amount in Shareclass Ccy": FMT_AMT, "Report Ccy Exchange Rate": FMT_RATE,
    "Price in Report Ccy": FMT_RATE, "Amount in Report Ccy": FMT_AMT, "Date Nav": FMT_DATE, "TA - Position Date": FMT_DATE,
}


def _dates(ctx: Context) -> tuple[str, str]:
    p = ctx.params
    if p.period_type == "last_available":
        today = date.today().isoformat()
        return today, today
    return p.date_from.isoformat(), p.date_to.isoformat()


def build(ctx: Context) -> str:
    if not ctx.params.funds:
        raise ValueError("au moins un fonds (--funds) est requis")
    if str(ctx.extra("report_ccy", "part")).lower() not in ("part", "1", ""):
        raise ValueError("report_ccy : seule la devise de la part (`part`) est reproduite")
    d1, d2 = _dates(ctx)
    regs = ctx.extra("registers") or []
    reg_filter = f"AND CAST(p.PTA_REG_ACC AS BIGINT) IN ({in_list([int(r) for r in regs])})" if regs else ""
    use_tbl = str(ctx.extra("from_luxis", "table")).lower() == "table"
    acc = "COALESCE(s.CLEARING_ACCOUNT, ca.ACC)" if use_tbl else "ca.ACC"
    s_join = f"LEFT JOIN {REGISTRES} s ON s.REGISTER_NUMBER = r.C_N_REGISTER" if use_tbl else ""
    return f"""
WITH {msg_cte(['TYPREG', 'SETTLE', 'COUNTRY', 'MONNAIES'])},
{register_cte()},
clr_acc AS (SELECT CAST(C_ID AS VARCHAR) AS REG_ID, MIN(G_ACC_NO1) AS ACC FROM {COLL} WHERE C_ACC_TYPE = '0000' GROUP BY C_ID),
fonds AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.FA_NUM, f.FA_NUM_IN_TA, f.FUND_NAME, f.FUND_CCY FROM {FND} f
          WHERE f.FA_NUM IN ({ctx.funds_in()}) AND f.FA_NUM_IN_TA IS NOT NULL),
lastpos AS (
    SELECT p.PTA_FUND_ID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN p.PTA_POS_DATE <= DATE '{d1}' THEN p.PTA_POS_DATE END) AS L1,
           MAX(CASE WHEN p.PTA_POS_DATE <= DATE '{d2}' THEN p.PTA_POS_DATE END) AS L2
    FROM {POS} p WHERE p.PTA_FUND_ID IN (SELECT FA_NUM_IN_TA FROM fonds) GROUP BY p.PTA_FUND_ID),
tf_rk AS (
    SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.FA_NUM_IN_TA, t.PART_TA_CODE ORDER BY t.D_ACTIVATION DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM {FND} t WHERE t.FA_NUM_IN_TA IN (SELECT FA_NUM_IN_TA FROM fonds)),
tf AS (SELECT * FROM tf_rk WHERE rn = 1),
pos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.PTA_POS_DATE, CAST(p.PTA_REG_ACC AS BIGINT) AS REG_NO, p.PTA_FUND_ID, p.PTA_UNIT_TYPE, p.PTA_QUANTITY, p.PTA_NAV,
           p.PTA_AMOUNT, p.PTA_NAV_DATE, p.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY
    FROM {POS} p JOIN lastpos l ON l.PTA_FUND_ID = p.PTA_FUND_ID
    WHERE p.PTA_POS_DATE BETWEEN COALESCE(l.L1, DATE '{d1}') AND COALESCE(l.L2, DATE '{d2}')
      AND COALESCE(p.PTA_QUANTITY, 0) <> 0 AND p.PTA_NAV_DATE IS NOT NULL {reg_filter}),
navp AS (
    SELECT n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV, MAX(n.NAP_PRICE_PART) AS PRICE
    FROM {NAVP} n WHERE n.NAP_FUND_NO IN (SELECT FA_NUM FROM fonds) GROUP BY n.NAP_FUND_NO, n.NAP_TPARTS, n.NAP_DATE_NAV),
rows_ AS (
    SELECT ps.*, f.FA_NUM, f.FUND_NAME AS F_NAME, f.FUND_CCY AS F_CCY, tf.TA_NUM, tf.ISIN_CODE, tf.PART_CCY, tf.PART_FA_CODE,
           COALESCE(tf.PART_FA_CODE_PUBLIE, tf.PART_FA_CODE, ps.PTA_UNIT_TYPE) AS PART, mq.A AS QUOT_CCY
    FROM pos ps JOIN fonds f ON f.FA_NUM_IN_TA = ps.PTA_FUND_ID
         LEFT JOIN tf ON tf.FA_NUM_IN_TA = ps.PTA_FUND_ID AND tf.PART_TA_CODE = ps.PTA_UNIT_TYPE
         LEFT JOIN msg mq ON mq.T = 'MONNAIES' AND mq.E = ps.PTA_FUND_QUOT_CCY)
SELECT
    r.C_N_REGISTER AS "Register Number", r.L_NAME AS "Register Name", CAST(r.D_CREATED AS DATE) AS "Register Creation Date",
    r.C_N_CLIENT AS "Client Number", r.CLIENT_NAME AS "Client Name", r.C_REGISTER_TYP AS "Register Type", m_typ.L AS "Register Title",
    r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP AS "Settlement Type", m_set.L AS "Settlement Name", r.C_RESIDENCE AS "Residence Code", m_res.L AS "Residence Name",
    r.C_CITY AS "Register Citizenship Code", m_cit.L AS "Register Citizenship Name", r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE AS "Tax Residence Code",
    m_tax.L AS "Tax Residence Name",
    CASE WHEN r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS "Clearing Flag", r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL AS "Clearing Register Number",
    g.L_NAME AS "Clearing Register Name", {acc} AS "Clearing Account",
    x.TA_NUM AS "SubFund TA Number", x.FA_NUM AS "SubFund Number", x.F_NAME AS "SubFund Name", x.F_CCY AS "SubFund Ccy",
    x.PART AS "Shareclass", x.ISIN_CODE AS "Isin Code", COALESCE(x.PTA_QUANTITY, 0) AS "Quantity", x.QUOT_CCY AS "Quotation Ccy",
    COALESCE(x.PTA_NAV, 0) AS "Price in Quotation Ccy", COALESCE(x.PTA_AMOUNT, 0) AS "Amount in Quotation Ccy",
    x.PART_CCY AS "Shareclass Ccy",
    CASE WHEN x.QUOT_CCY <> x.PART_CCY THEN COALESCE(np.PRICE, 0) ELSE COALESCE(x.PTA_NAV, 0) END AS "Price in Shareclass Ccy",
    CASE WHEN x.QUOT_CCY <> x.PART_CCY THEN ROUND(COALESCE(x.PTA_QUANTITY, 0) * COALESCE(np.PRICE, 0), 2) ELSE COALESCE(x.PTA_AMOUNT, 0) END AS "Amount in Shareclass Ccy",
    x.PART_CCY AS "Report Ccy", 1 AS "Report Ccy Exchange Rate",
    CASE WHEN x.QUOT_CCY <> x.PART_CCY THEN COALESCE(np.PRICE, 0) ELSE COALESCE(x.PTA_NAV, 0) END AS "Price in Report Ccy",
    CASE WHEN x.QUOT_CCY <> x.PART_CCY THEN ROUND(COALESCE(x.PTA_QUANTITY, 0) * COALESCE(np.PRICE, 0), 2) ELSE COALESCE(x.PTA_AMOUNT, 0) END AS "Amount in Report Ccy",
    CAST(x.PTA_NAV_DATE AS DATE) AS "Date Nav", x.PTA_POS_DATE AS "TA - Position Date"
FROM rows_ x
     JOIN reg r ON r.C_N_REGISTER = x.REG_NO
     LEFT JOIN reg g ON g.C_N_REGISTER = r.C_N_REGISTER_GLOBAL
     LEFT JOIN msg m_typ ON m_typ.T = 'TYPREG'  AND m_typ.E = r.C_REGISTER_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m_set ON m_set.T = 'SETTLE'  AND m_set.E = r.C_SETTLEMENT_TYP
     LEFT JOIN msg m_res ON m_res.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_res.E = r.C_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN msg m_cit ON m_cit.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_cit.E = r.C_CITY
     LEFT JOIN msg m_tax ON m_tax.T = 'COUNTRY' AND m_tax.E = r.C_TAX_RESIDENCE
     LEFT JOIN clr_acc ca ON ca.REG_ID = CAST(r.C_N_REGISTER AS VARCHAR)
     LEFT JOIN navp np ON np.NAP_FUND_NO = x.FA_NUM AND np.NAP_TPARTS = x.PART_FA_CODE AND np.NAP_DATE_NAV = x.PTA_NAV_DATE
     {s_join}
ORDER BY x.PTA_POS_DATE, x.FA_NUM, x.PART, r.C_N_REGISTER
"""


def checks(rows: list[dict], ctx: Context) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    out = [("INFO", f"{len(rows)} position(s)")]
    dates = sorted({str(r['TA - Position Date'])[:10] for r in rows})
    if dates:
        out.append(("INFO", f"date(s) de position : {', '.join(dates[:6])}{' ...' if len(dates) > 6 else ''}"))
    no_isin = sum(1 for r in rows if not r.get("Isin Code"))
    out.append(("WARN" if no_isin else "OK", f"{no_isin} position(s) sans ISIN (classe absente de TAB_FND_MAIN)"))
    qty = sum(float(r["Quantity"] or 0) for r in rows)
    out.append(("INFO", f"quantite totale : {qty:,.5f}"))
    return out


SPEC = ReportSpec(
    key="ta_positions_registre", title="LuxRep Queries TA - Positions TA par registre", file_tag="Ta_Positions_by_Register",
    columns=COLUMNS, build=build, formats=FORMATS, windowed=False, needs_dates=True, checks=checks,
    key_columns=["Register Number", "SubFund Number", "Shareclass", "TA - Position Date"],
    extra_params=[
        ExtraParam("registers", "numeros de registre retenus (vide = tous)", kind="list", default=[]),
        ExtraParam("from_luxis", "compte de clearing : table (LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES) ou none (recalcule)", kind="str", default="table",
                   choices=("table", "none")),
        ExtraParam("report_ccy", "devise du rapport : part (seule valeur reproduite)", kind="str", default="part", choices=("part",)),
    ],
    description="Positions TA (quantite et montant) des registres, par fonds, classe et date de position.",
    luxis_source="PKG_LUXREP_QUERIES.proc_Ta_Position (code_source.txt l.11469-12731)",
)

import sys, json, pathlib, collections
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from luxrep_reports.core import compare as cmp
from luxrep_reports.core.registry import load
from luxrep_reports.core.xlsxread import read_sheet

key, produced_xlsx, ref = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
spec = load(key)
sh = read_sheet(produced_xlsx, "A")
hdr = sh[0]
rows = [dict(zip(hdr, r)) for r in sh[1:]]
res = cmp.compare(spec, rows, pathlib.Path(ref), max_diffs=10**7)
print(res["identical"], res["different"], res["only_ref"], res["only_out"])
print(collections.Counter(d[1] for d in res["differences"]).most_common(20))
n = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 8
col = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else None
print([d for d in res["differences"] if col is None or d[1] == col][:n])

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\scratch\mv_q.py =====
"""Aide scratch (mouvements) : python scratch/mv_q.py "@fichier.sql" | "SELECT ..."  -> sortie verticale (col = valeur) dans scratch/mv_out.txt"""
import sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
from luxrep_reports.core.gateway import Gateway

arg = sys.argv[1]
sql = Path(arg[1:]).read_text(encoding="utf-8") if arg.startswith("@") else arg
vertical = "--h" not in sys.argv
gw = Gateway(env="ctlq")
t = time.time()
cols, rows = gw.query("mv", sql)
out = [f"-- {len(rows)} lignes en {time.time() - t:.1f}s"]
if vertical:
    for i, r in enumerate(rows[:int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 and sys.argv[2].isdigit() else 40]):
        out.append(f"## ligne {i}")
        for c in cols:
            out.append(f"   {c} = {r.get(c)}")
else:
    out.append(" | ".join(cols))
    for r in rows[:300]:
        out.append(" | ".join("" if r.get(c) is None else str(r.get(c)) for c in cols))
Path(__file__).with_name("mv_out.txt").write_text("\n".join(out), encoding="utf-8")
print(out[0])

import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from luxrep_reports.core.gateway import Gateway

gw = Gateway("ctlq", pathlib.Path(__file__).parent / "gw_out", 900, 100000)
sql = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
cols, rows = gw.query("qs", sql)
limit = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 5
for r in rows[:limit]:
    print("-----")
    for c, v in zip(cols, r):
        print(f"{c} = {v}")
print(len(rows), "lignes")



===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\scratch\qs2.py =====
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from luxrep_reports.core.gateway import Gateway

gw = Gateway("ctlq", pathlib.Path(__file__).parent / "gw_out", 900, 100000)
sql = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
cols, rows = gw.query("qs", sql)
limit = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 5
skip_null = len(sys.argv) > 3
for r in rows[:limit]:
    print("-----")
    for i, c in enumerate(cols):
        v = r[c] if isinstance(r, dict) else r[i]
        if skip_null and (v is None or v == ""):
            continue
        print(f"{c} = {v}")
print(len(rows), "lignes")

"""Usage: python scratch/ta_q.py file.sql [maxrows]  -> prints rows as column=value (one block per row) or table."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
from luxrep_reports.core.gateway import Gateway
import time
sql = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read()
n = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 50
t = time.time()
cols, rows = Gateway(env="ctlq").query("ta_q", sql)
print(f"-- {len(rows)} lignes en {time.time()-t:.1f}s")
if len(cols) > 12 and len(rows) <= 5:
    for r in rows[:n]:
        print("-----")
        for c in cols:
            print(f"{c} = {r.get(c)!r}")
else:
    print(" | ".join(cols))
    for r in rows[:n]:
        print(" | ".join("" if r.get(c) is None else str(r.get(c)) for c in cols))

===== FICHIER : C:\Users\padadmin\Downloads\reporting\reporting\scratch\txn_e.sql =====
WITH m AS (
  SELECT r.C_FUND, r.N_LOT, r.D_NAV, r.C_NAV_TYP, r.C_CCY, r.R_EXCHANGE_MF, r.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY, r.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.C_FUND, r.D_NAV, r.C_NAV_TYP, r.C_CCY ORDER BY r.N_LOT DESC) AS rn
  FROM MFGA_INFOCENTRE.DWH.AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES r
  WHERE r.C_FUND IN ('280287','280421','280499') AND r.D_NAV >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'),
l AS (
  SELECT r.C_FUND, r.N_LOT, r.D_NAV, r.C_NAV_TYP, r.C_CCY, r.R_EXCHANGE_MF, r.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY, r.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY
  FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES r
  WHERE r.C_FUND IN ('280287','280421','280499') AND r.D_NAV >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
SELECT 'luxis_total' AS k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'mfga_total', COUNT(*) FROM m
UNION ALL SELECT 'mfga_dedup_total', COUNT(*) FROM m WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL SELECT 'luxis_not_in_mfga_dedup(lot+val)', COUNT(*) FROM l LEFT JOIN m ON m.rn = 1 AND m.C_FUND = l.C_FUND AND m.D_NAV = l.D_NAV AND m.C_NAV_TYP = l.C_NAV_TYP AND m.C_CCY = l.C_CCY AND m.N_LOT = l.N_LOT AND m.R_EXCHANGE_MF = l.R_EXCHANGE_MF AND m.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY = l.R_CCY_TO_PTF_CCY AND m.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY = l.R_PTF_CCY_TO_CCY WHERE m.C_FUND IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'mfga_dedup_not_in_luxis', COUNT(*) FROM m LEFT JOIN l ON l.C_FUND = m.C_FUND AND l.D_NAV = m.D_NAV AND l.C_NAV_TYP = m.C_NAV_TYP AND l.C_CCY = m.C_CCY AND l.N_LOT = m.N_LOT WHERE m.rn = 1 AND l.C_FUND IS NULL

FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.DWH_AMS_HIS_PTF_FRX_RATES r
WHERE r.C_FUND = '280287' AND r.C_NAV_TYP = 'O' AND r.D_NAV >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND r.D_NAV <= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00'

SELECT t.OPT_NPTF, tf.FA_NUM, COUNT(*) N FROM LUXIS.REPADMIN.OP_TA t JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.LUXREP_TA_REGISTRES_BLOCKED rb ON rb.REGISTER_NUMBER=t.OPT_REG_CL_DEAL_NO JOIN LUXIS.REPADMIN.TAB_FND_MAIN tf ON tf.ISIN_CODE=t.OPT_FUNDS_ISIN WHERE t.OPT_OP_DATE>=DATE '2024-01-01' AND ((t.OPT_OP_DATE>=rb.FULL_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR t.OPT_OP_DATE<rb.FULL_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE)) OR (t.OPT_OP_DATE>=rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_LAST_DATE AND (rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE IS NULL OR t.OPT_OP_DATE<rb.REDEM_BLOCKED_UNBLOCKED_DATE))) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 5
